entry.title: Natal Neptune and North Node Aspects 💫✨
entry.content:
Neptune Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ This is an enlightening aspect even if it’s painfully challenging to process.

^ You are intuitive, you already know what to do, where to go, how to get what you want, yet you may be vulnerable to a lot of negative energies/mindsets that gets imposed on your psyche.

^ You’re somehow always walking on the right track but get dragged into paths that are dark & scary, often by others’ influence, may be by manipulative/obsessive/narcissistic people, or by your own lack of confidence due to the subconscious programming of your mind since childhood/early life events, or both, that somehow always takes you on a completely different tangent to learn through the darkest lessons of life.

^ Most people might even consider your life to be unfortunate or they can’t completely comprehend the kind of things you go through since it’s not their definition of “normal”.

^ You’re however an incredibly pure person deep inside, all you will have to do is break the illusion of security that you think someone/some people are providing, since there’re usually outside sources trying to take advantage of your empathic character.

^ So your biggest lesson in life will be to break illusions, whether it’s from others’ or yourself. 

^ You have a bigger purpose in life, and going through these dark periods of your life, clearing out karma (no matter how heavy) will be enlightening, spiritually elevating you to what you truly deserve, and physically aligning you to a better path.

^ You’ll have to trust your instincts, both while dealing with others and yourself. For example, if you always had a vision for your life, but somewhere along the way, someone comes into your life, and starts telling you the complete opposite of what you think your life should be, or starts projecting negativity into your plans etc. or even tries to integrate themselves into your life so much so that they try to micromanage your moves, you know this person has ulterior motives (even if they are someone that’s supposed to be close to you, like a parent, or sibling, or a friend). So you somehow already have a subconscious insight as to what to do, even if it started out as an unrealistic dream, you know this is your truth and so you must never let someone/thing deter you from that path.

^ As you grow older, into your adulthood, and clear out many karmic ties/illusions in your life, you might even start to realize that you already knew what you truly wanted in life, and somehow even through all the detours, you are still back on track to where you want to go, no matter the sacrifices & loses.

^ Sifting through all your traumas & disappointments and walking forward will always be the right thing to do, because, you are somehow guided by forces unknown, even protecting you from harm all along, this realization will help you through your journey.


Neptune Opposite North Node

☍ You were born with Neptunian talents, overwhelmingly strong creative & artistic urges can lead you to pursue these skills actively.

☍ With Neptune Conjunct South Node, there’s a big resistance to change in life, you might rely on escapism to avoid facing your deepest fears/shadows that come with evolving into your next phase.

☍ You’ve strong passions & urges that don’t seem to let you rest, driving you in many directions, but you will have to remain realistic to direct your passions in the right direction.

☍ You are intuitive, yet you always seem to go through life in a haze of sorts, where you’re pursuing paths that seem to be your destiny, you might just be following them to make your dreams come true, yet they don’t often bring you fulfilment.

☍ You’re a wise & pure soul deep within, and like many Neptune aspects, with the Lunar Nodes’ influence, you could be extra compassionate, & sensitive, even sensual & artistic. 

☍ You will have to be realistic in life, even when you’re dealing with others. 

☍ While pursuing your careers, you can always utilize your talents & urges, and make the best use of them, since they are gifts that can inspire a lot of people.

☍ You might not like being in the spotlight, but like all the adoration it brings, if you’re thinking of pursuing a career(s) that requires you to interact with a larger audience it is important to take your alone time spending it productively and resting in between your work.

☍ There is always a caution with this aspect, to never rely completely on your visions, leading to self-deluding tendencies (even escapism). Since your plans may need many adjustments & corrections, being extra realistic, without which you might end up making decisions to ruin your foundations or anger others’ around you.



Neptune Square North Node

□ This aspect can either bring you from being extremely realistic to believing in miracles, or from being disillusioned to grounded in reality, depending on your early life experiences.

□ So, there may be a need to not fall into escapist behaviors, or self-deceptive mindset, even if they were just programmed ways of thinking that could have come through your past experiences or upbringing.

□ You might have to break free from your own fears by confronting them.

□ Your reality may be challenging, or extremely comfortable, and they are both in a way, completely in your own power, since you can change the circumstances of your life with your thoughts & hence actions.

□ You could either end up breaking illusions & control in the society, enlightening others in the process, or you could end up manipulating & deceiving people by influencing their belief systems in some way, both depends on other aspects in the chart that suggest the good side or the bad side of karma that you might end up creating.

□ The more you work on breaking free from illusions, (even if they are just mindsets, addictions, deceitful people, etc.) the more you might start to see your true purpose in life. This may very well be your biggest lessons in life, in clearing out these karmic lessons to ascend to your higher purpose. Since this process will help you elevate in life.


Neptune Conjunct North Node

☌ This aspect can be regarded as one of the most enchanted Neptune aspects ever. 

☌ Destiny is just a matter of time in your life, since things just naturally happen exactly the way they should, and all you might have to do is believe.

☌ It may seem like a higher source is guiding you towards your purpose, even if you don’t know exactly where you want to go, you know you can always rely on your intuition and just keep walking with faith.

☌ Although, the journey might not really be an easy one, since Neptune & North Node still hold karmic debt. You might endure painful life circumstances (the origin of which may be found in the house where Neptune/NN are in) that maybe regarded as blessings in disguise.

☌ Your intuition is incredibly on-point, and you can tap into your psyche a lot more easily whenever you are envisioning your future.

☌ There’s another positive side to this aspect, being, you can manifest literally anything in your life (especially if in 12H/8H/5H/11H/1H). Since Neptune is boundless potential & North Node aligns your deepest desires with that of your purpose.

☌ You may also be artistically talented, even with psychic & spiritual gifts, which can become important parts of your life & purpose.

☌ Your career when infused with your creative gifts can even inspire others on their own journey. 

☌ Your spiritually positive mindset, inspiring works, and mystical personality may be influential in your career life, and your life as a whole.

☌ You can reach the highest of potentials, integrating your mystical & spiritual talents to elevate both your life & that of others.

☌ But just like all Neptune x North Node aspects, you will have to be careful with your intentions since you can rake up bad karma just as easily you can good karma.



Neptune Sextile North Node 

✱ This aspect gives you a sense of destiny that’s always within reach (depending on other North Node aspects in the chart of-course).

✱ Your intuition always leads you on the right path and most importantly you’re ready to embark on new adventures.

✱ You usually follow your intuition and find yourself on the path to your higher calling without many distractions.

✱ You use your psychic & spiritual gifts for the benefit of others (the opposite is true with bad aspects suggesting otherwise).

✱ You are an inspiring person and have a subtle & positive influence on those around you.

✱ You can infuse your career/work with your innate creative skills, or even pursue your artistic talents.

✱ You must however be cautious not to get involved in deceitful behaviors, or with deceitful people, since there maybe karmic situations where you’ll have to make wise (& the right) decisions and not just go with everyone’s opinions/mindsets.

✱ Since this aspect also has an influential attribute to it, you can attract the attention & respect of many people.

✱ Your positive mindset & good intentions when dealing with others, will bring you karmic rewards (the other way around is equally true.)

✱ So being truthful, walking on the right path, and not succumbing to manipulating public opinion, or playing devil’s advocate will be important from a karmic point of view.


Neptune Trine North Node

△ A promising North Node aspect enriched by the gifts of Neptunian boundless potential.

△ There’s an easy-flowing feeling to your purpose in life, where you seem to have the right mindset to pursue your highest calling.

△ This aspect with all its positives is still a challenging one, since you might have had to experience some disappointing yet deeply transcending experiences in your life, especially from those who you considered to be trustworthy. So, you know how to turn your pain into spiritual enlightenment.

△ You may be drawn to integrate your artistic/creative talents (even spiritual gifts) to your career.

△ Your works are inspirational & can garner the respect of many.

△ You can also influence others with your positive & optimistic personality.

△ You have a clear vision of your future and it’s imbued with your intuitive insights.

△ Although, like other Neptune aspects, it is important not to take advantage of this positive aspect into deceiving others, manipulating the public opinions, etc. since karma spares nobody.

△ Your self-belief & intuition are important driving forces in your life, and so you will need to be extra confident in yourself, without wearing a mask or allowing negative influences to distract you from your true purpose.

entry.title: Natal Neptune in 5th House 🌷✨
entry.content:
(Neptune was last in Leo during 1915-29, next Neptune in Leo generation will start from 2078)

Neptune in the house of self-expression, creativity and romance is an excellent placement in the chart highlighting one’s spiritual & artistic needs being intertwined with their personality. You may come off as shy on the outside, but you are quite outgoing once people get to know you. There is a deep mystery to your aura that others often seek to find more of, which is why many people are drawn towards you. You are also in-tune with your environment; you can pick up on energetic shifts around you. So, you always make sure that to know how your loved ones are feeling. You make soulful connections with people and so you are deeply connected to their needs as your own. You are protective and supportive of your loved ones. Besides the soul-connections that you cherish, you also find solace in your creativity. 


You might have incredible artistic talents that you love to indulge in. You might be gifted in many skills that you can easily immerse yourself in. You might even be recognized for your artistic pursuits. You have a deeper understanding of your subconscious mind that allows you to draw out the many incredible creative treasures into the real world. Although, it might also be very easy for you to get distracted from your tasks and waste time on things that solely bring you joy. So, it is important to be careful about not indulging in things that only seem to bring momentary happiness. Spirituality is a big part of your everyday routine, either through your work or through spiritual/religious practices, which help you with your creative process. 


You are a kindred spirit with unconditional love & generosity for everyone in your life. Although it might take conscious effort to ground yourself in reality since you can easily get absorbed into daydreaming. You might have childhood wounds that you don’t remember or that you intentionally try to forget, but this could be the very thing that you will have to heal. There may even be issues from your past or past lives that seem to repeat themselves in how you handle emotional matters, in what influences your habits & addictions, why you may be afraid of commitments or issues related to abandonment, etc. Love & romance are a major part of your life. You are a charismatic person that a lot of people might have feelings for. You are also drawn towards people that give you a feeling of warmth and vice versa, others feel that about you. 


Your love life however can turn erratic at the drop of a hat. You have a yearning for soulful connections that are deeply spiritual. But you might not have a clear vision about who is right for you and who isn’t. Although you are not quick to jump into relationships, you might make sudden important decisions when you feel like you have found the one. However, you might suffer greatly when you don’t pay attention to red flags waving clear as day. So, it is possible that you might have endured some harsh wake up calls with regards to believing in only the good traits of people without considering their bad traits. You might even lack boundaries due to your naivety that everyone will treat you kindly just because you are a gentle & affectionate person. 



You will have to be ware of all the evil in this world as well as the good especially when your heart is on the line. Your important life lessons may come in the form of toxic, manipulative or abusive relationships with people of ill-intentions, overcoming such bonds may have given you a lot of wisdom (Of course, this could all be vice versa, where you may be the manipulative or abusive partner taking out your insecurities & traumas). You might have to be careful not to indulge in escapist behaviors or get involved with people who have severe additions or other problems since things can quickly turn emotionally or even physically violent. Your relationships (of all kinds) can directly affect your self-confidence and inner strength, so it is important to find what you truly want, what you truly deserve and how to honor your true self with only the best of things & healthiest of connections. 


With this placement, it is extremely important to break the illusions of safety, love & care from abuse (physical/emotional/mental), entrapment & codependency. Wherever Neptune lies in the chart can indicate the areas of life that get better with (both external &) internal guidance (and not influence), like inner & spiritual understanding, professional & medical, or the care of our loved ones. So, you might have endured traumas or psychological wounds relating to intimate relationships, creative expression or self-confidence issues. The unconditional support of your loved ones, meditation or even therapy can help you overcome your fears. On the other hand, you might end up with your soulmate & true love in the most miraculous of ways. You might be spiritually led towards “the one” with whom you can experience the true meaning of unconditional love. Depending on other placements/aspects in your chart and the intense lessons you have to endure, this can be the karmic reward of “true divine love”. 


Your connection to children (or pets even) may be spiritual in itself. You might have unbroken bond(s) with them which might even indicate to having a significant psychic link with them (although it is advised to watch out for any forms of codependency). You might however have to actively conform your right & responsibilities as a parent to yourself, since you might have a hard time fulfilling your duties due to other obligations in your life or may be even due to your own inner child wounds. So, depending on how you treat your inner child wounds and consciously navigate through your parental duties with sincerity & unconditional care, you might either create a beautiful soul bond with your children or make them feel neglected (since Neptune can represent neglect or absence). 


Overall, your self-development may be impacted by your creativity, intimate relationships and/or children (kids, pets, plants, literally anyone/anything in your care). This placement can initially pose problems in recognizing your own personality, expressing yourself genuinely, committing yourself to someone on an intimate level or ignoring red flags in toxic relationships, indulging in hobbies, habits & addictions to escape self-confidence issues, etc. But it can help you sort out your subconscious patterns, yearning for soulful connections & unconditional love, true recognition and most of all happiness in life. So, breaking out of your own self-defeating beliefs & patterns, finding solace in your creative gifts, understanding the meaning of true love & care, etc. will help you progress on your soul path and fulfill your higher purpose in life.

entry.title: Natal Pluto Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
You might feel constantly attacked or have fears of being exposed. You might have experienced obsessive/possessive behaviors from others which might have made you feel unsafe. You might not be comfortable tapping into your subconscious, especially from fear of facing bad/difficult memories. You might even have traumas that seem too big to even confront on an emotional level. Taking control of your life and living your truth will become your primary focus as you enter adulthood. 


You have a probing mind, and this helps you to dig into deep & dark emotional/psychological matters easily as time goes by. You might have realized how exceptionally gifted you are in terms of intuitive/spiritual skills. You will be able to moderate your personal intensity and direct it towards self-transformation. Your passions can inspire you to fulfil your deepest desires. 


You will overcome power-struggles, controlling & manipulative situations with impeachable emotional & psychological intelligence that your life experiences helped you to master. You might also become comfortable expressing your sexuality and allowing trustworthy relationships into your life to experience intimacy on a deeper level. You might have big ambitions that need careful planning. 


Your early experiences could have humbled you and made you realize how to be compassionate to others. You might even realize that healthy compromise and building trust will help in forming successful partnerships (both financial & emotional). You have an influential presence, and you attract jealousy, envy, hate, and other forms of projections, so you will be able to learn how not to take things too personally, but you will also learn how to stand up for yourself and in your truth.

entry.title: Natal Saturn Opposition Lilith 🌋✨
entry.content:
Unconventionality is initially seen as the greatest sin with this Saturn & Lilith Opposition. You might have been punished for not following traditions and mainly for not being “conventional” (beauty, body-image related, sensuality, sexual preference, mindset, etc.). This opposition’s effects in moderation can help us tame our own wild & unrestricted side, but on the extreme can drive us into rebellion. In moderation, we learn how to balance individual ideals with that of societal expectations. On the extreme, this combination can heighten our independent nature and prompt us to “fight for our right to party”, against all odds. 


You might have felt held back in life through parents and/or other elders who at first may have seemed as though they are only trying to help shape your personality in a more mature & rational way. But, that might have created a huge power-imbalance instead, where they may have tried to control your choices, life & in many ways your body, independence & personal power. Too many constraints, challenges especially designed to stall, provoke or humiliate you may have plagued your early years, no matter how humble or how unruly your behavior was. Breaking out of such extreme control and seemingly unfair restrictions may have been almost impossible, but a deeper part of you seemed convinced that you can’t let a power struggle like this continue on forever, as it didn’t seem healthy (at all). At some point, especially in your adulthood, you had to take back control of your life, and take your power back entirely from people/places/situations that seem relentless. 


If you have strong Aquarius/Uranus and/or Scorpio/Pluto/Mars Placements you certainly had a hard time keeping your anger & frustration levels down while dealing with something so unjust. Your personal power and integrity may have been threatened or even your boundaries violated to various degrees. This fight might have been a result of abuse (physical, emotional or psychological), where you had no choice but to take your power back. This Opposition also makes it harder for you to have many people on your side when you clearly need support. Many may think that this is way too much to handle or they don’t like to be part of an uphill battle, some may even stand by and watch you struggle all the way through. But, you taking back your personal power & sovereignty might have felt just & fundamental, in many ways you might not have had a choice but to regain control over your life. 


Using you individuality, passion and raw determination for just causes, and to bring more structure into your life will be one of the positive results of this Opposition. Saturn will keep bringing severe restrictions and keep challenging your ideals, even more so your desire for freedom, until you become aware of them yourself. You must take the time to understand: “What drives you, what do raw passion & desire mean to you, where are you being rebellious out of a wounded ego, even if it is justified as standing up against unfair situations/people”; If you are feeling disempowered in a situation/place/relationship, how are you contributing to that power-imbalance”, etc. Hence, this Opposition demands deep honesty and a strong sense of integrity from you. It can ultimately enlighten you to both your flaws and your strengths. 


You find the reservoirs of your own inner strength when dealing with such circumstances, where you uphold your integrity in a calm yet powerful stance, without giving into anger & frustration, yet not forgetting about your equally-powerful-side as well, since you learn how your need for justice, freedom and respect can easily turn destructive and cause more damage than you can repair. Embracing your wild & untamed side, without letting both others’ & your own weaknesses to control your life, becomes a hard-earned-lesson that adds to your power. 


Saturn can help guide Lilith’s intensity in a more productive and fulfilling way, streamlining your passions. You will also learn how to live an unconventional lifestyle unrestricted by certain societal norms that don’t suit your goals or passions, while simultaneously being conscious of your intense drive for independence. Most of all, you will be able to conquer your own inner demons (as fears & insecurities), all while becoming adept at dealing with others’ who may be subconsciously trying to project their shame & inadequacies onto you. You might also become the voice for those who may be going through similar experiences, especially being focused on social injustices where people who deserve fair treatment are being unfairly shunned, targeted or even hurt. With this Opposition, Peace, Personal Sovereignty & Independence are hard-earned indeed. It will take a lot of time, patience and self-reflection to get a good hold of this Opposition, as overtime the lessons will immensely Empower you and make you a True Force to be Reckoned with.

entry.title: Natal Venus and Ascendant Aspects 🦢✨
entry.content:
Venus Conjunct Ascendant

☌ So effortlessly charming.
☌ Usually considered as the epitome of a beautiful/handsome figure/face.
☌ Fashionista.
☌ P.O.P.U.L.A.R
☌ Every “friend” has a crush on you, and openly express their interest.
☌ You know exactly what to say and get what you want.
☌ Others may do things for you, bring everything you ask for etc., but you must never stop getting things by yourself through hard work and passion, so you don’t become unhappy later on in life (especially if Venus is in 1H, it's the house of Aries after all, the biggest “Imma do it all by myself” zodiac archetype along with Scorpio).
☌ May need to work extra hard to be grounded in reality and understand that not everything revolves around you, i.e., tendency to become selfish. Pretty-privilege can make you a lil forgetful sometimes (especially if in 1H.)
☌ If Venus is in 12H, this may not really be the case, you could actually be humble and sometimes even unaware as to where all this popularity is coming from.
☌ You might become more known for how beautiful/handsome you are and be overlooked for any other note-worthy talents/skills/accomplishments.
☌ Lucky with opportunities falling into your lap (like money & relationships).
☌ Can live a luxurious life (if not born into it, you might work your way towards it).


Venus Square Ascendant

□ Extremely charismatic, sometimes you don't even realize the impact you have on others.
□ A lot of people may have a crush on you and not even tell you about it.
□ You either grew up being spoiled or had to work extra hard to get them (money/opportunities).
□ May need to learn how to balance between self-sacrifice and expecting others to sacrifice themselves in a relationship (friendships, business, romantic).
□ A tendency to become too vain, relying too much on your appearance etc. or you might despise everything that is only based on superficial beauty, no in-between.
□ You might wear a mask of a likeable person but struggle inside with many insecurities especially relating to physical appearance. It's important not to place your self-worth on how much others like you/find you attractive.
□ May become very self-conscious and worry about what others might think/feel about you. There's a need to learn how to let go of others’ opinions.
□ May attract a lot of envious/jealous people. Also, opportunists who may have Ulterior motives.
□ Need to be extra careful not to fall for fashion trends, diet fads, unrealistic beauty-standards, etc. It's okay to create your own fashion sense and not feel obligated to fit-in sometimes.
□ A lot of inner reflection may be needed especially if you that feel you need to people-please to keep up with others. You might just need to get away from superficial people around you and find true friendships/relationships who value you for who you truly are.
□ Your self-value and money matters are usually tied together. So, once you start appreciating and accepting your own self for the amazing person you are, money and luck will naturally surround you.


Venus Sextile Ascendant

✱ A.U.T.H.E.N.T.I.C
✱ You're Artistic and talented.
✱ You may be surrounded by supportive friends and partnerships.
✱ You may also be blessed with Rich/affluential associations.
✱ You may lead a comfortable life, if anything a Luxurious one.
✱ You have a good sense of self-worth, and a relatively peaceful inner fortitude.
✱ You're stylish and have a keen eye for fashion.
✱ May need to learn the importance of living within the means. Over-indulgence of money/food/leisure may cause all kinds of health and financial problems.



Venus Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant

^ Naturally charming, but this may also make you come across as vulnerable to others.
^ You need to be extremely careful not to fall into people-pleasing tendencies.
^ A lot of self-worth issues may be in desperate need to be addressed, either stemming from codependency issues or rejection/abandonment issues.
^ Also, you may need to re-evaluate some of the social norms/standards that may be forced on you or you thought were important to be socially acceptable.
^ You need to balance the give-and-take aspects of relationships.
^ Friends and a loud social life may not need to be all that important when surrounded by superficial people who drain you emotionally/mentally.
^ You must learn how to say “NO” and stand up for yourself. Your insecurities and self-doubt issues shouldn't mean that others can take advantage to your kind & compassionate heart.
^ May need to work on self-love before getting into any physical/committed relationships.


Venus Trine Ascendant

△ You're a Lovely person.
△ A.T.T.R.A.C.T.I.V.E
△ May like to keep up with the fashion trends if not even make some of your own.
△ Making friends left and right, you always have something nice to say about others.
△ May seem almost perfect as an individual, and make others question your ingenuity now and then.
△ You're sensitive with a big heart.
△ Good with money and could be/become wealthy with a commendable social standing.
△ May not like a lot of tense situations in your surroundings, you might wish to be in tranquil and cooperative environments.
△ Although you seem lucky and protected, sometimes you may need to look out for opportunists and scammers.
△ May have artistic talents/interests.
△ Need to stay away from people-pleasing tendencies when feeling insecure.
△ You are a great party host, since you love to make others happy.
△ But lack/excess of socializing can actually drain your energy.


Venus Opposite (Conjunct Descendant) Ascendant

☍ May have a big friends-circle. Social & Outgoing. (Especially if Venus is in 7H)
☍ Partnerships & relationships of all kinds are a vital part of your life.
☍ May even become friends with many influential/resourceful people.
☍ Lover of Arts.
☍ You might have a tendency to seek approval from outside instead from yourself sometimes.
☍ You could use your connections to gain status/fame. Caution not to do things with bad intentions, or just to please your ego/lofty ambitions.
☍ You may become friends/lovers with important people just for the sole purpose of fame/money. Opportunistic tendencies. This could lead to scandals and such.
☍ Or you might tie your self-worth to your relationships.
☍ When you face & deal with your own insecurities and issues of self-worth, you will be able to see how easily opportunities of all kinds flow towards you. So, any efforts towards forcing/manipulating opportunities might just prove be exercise in futility.
☍ Especially if Venus is in 7H, may indicate enjoying prosperous/long-lasting relationships & marriage(s). If Venus is in 6H, you could be blessed with peaceful & lively work environments/jobs.
☍ You need to learn how important being genuine really is, and not to wear a mask or worry about what others may think of you so much.

entry.title: New Moon in Scorpio 2023 | Deep Purge & Sacred Transformation, Nov 13 2023 🦋✨
entry.content:
This New Moon in Scorpio is going to be extra potent and powerful. Mars, the Ruler of Scorpio is home for the season and involved in some really tense aspects, while Pluto the Modern (Co-) Ruler of Scorpio is out of a long Retrograde in Capricorn and currently chilling in the sky with easy aspects. So, this New Moon is going to be an intense one (certainly not for the faint of heart). Uranus in Taurus seems to be single handedly fighting off the Mars, Moon & Sun in Scorpio Opposition. There are high possibilities for conflicts, chaos & destruction. But, there is also healing, focus on peace & compromise with Venus, Jupiter & Neptune making subtle efforts to calm this important opposition.


There is a general dissatisfaction with where life is going and how far we have come, Pluto is still Square North Node in Aries after all. Along with the Opposition of Uranus in Taurus to Sun, Moon & Mars in Scorpio, this New Moon can bring up the very basic yet fundamental issues to the surface. Trigger-points are likely to be on the surface of your skin around this time, so touch-sensitive that they can be activated even by a gentle breeze. Everything can trigger you now, sensitivity is high. This can be frustrating yet can also lead to immense transformations. Internal struggles can easily manifest as external conflicts right now, so it is wise to deal with your inner frustrations all by yourself. :( And definitely not starting any arguements with anyone even if you feel provoked)  


The current climate of both emotional & financial state can lead to concerning feelings of not being enough or not having enough. Although that’s putting it lightly, it can bring up memories from the past (especially recent) that wreak a havoc on your self-esteem. Mars Conjunct Moon & Sun can bring up feelings of “let’s go make things happen”, but Uranus’s opposition although conducive to the idea can still act as a “Start & Stop” button which can be frustrating. Fixed signs will take the brunt of this New Moon’s intensity, much like the the recent Lunar Eclipse in Taurus. So, if you are a Leo, Scorpio, Taurus or Aquarius, you might already be feeling this highly electric tension in the air where you can feel yourself on the edge of a cliff, a cliff of a scary yet magnificent change. 



This Opposition can be productive, with Mars & Uranus’s very similar inclination to turn any & every situation into their favor. So, the tension & intensity you are feeling in one area of your life, you can easily direct it into another and get positive results, essentially redefining being a “Diamond under Pressure”. Since, there is a lot of extra energy (and then some more) to expend on anything that you wish to focus on. The only downside is this funny (not so) emotional disassociation that can come with it. Especially if you are dealing with a lot, all at once. Let’s say you are working on your financial stability at this time, and your family/love life is well-balanced, you are still likely to feel completely disappointed by your financial situation & probably even feel dissatisfied in your loving connections, and vice versa. If both, you are likely to feel the pain of the imbalance and still go on with concentrating on the most immediate problem. There is hence a good time to create your own breakthroughs in areas of your life where you have felt the most unjustly disappointed in.


Either way, there is a surprisingly good judgement on how to handle crisis or imbalanced energies in your life. Scorpio’s ability to alchemize hardships into opportunity and Taurus’s ability to bring consistent effort will lead to excellent outcomes. There is also a general theme of being oddly in control of yourself. Your emotional intelligence is going to be higher than usual almost with surgical precision. So, you know when to speak out and when not to. This level of emotional discernment can greatly help Saturn’s Opposition to Mercury. Mercury in Sagittarius might be quick on speaking up on your grievances & even demanding other’s to listen, but Saturn in Pisces (freshly out of Retrograde) can bring out inner wounds of not being heard or being ignored, even victimized for speaking up. Voicing your opinions will however be vital especially if they are related to social causes or even just calling out people’s bad behavior. 


There is also the dire need to uphold your integrity, and gaining back your sovereignty with Saturn’s Opposition to Lilith making a T-Square with Mercury. Welcome criticism this week, but also make sure that you have your boundaries firm in place. If you don’t like harsh or negative comments & criticism, you don’t have to entertain them. Reevaluating your standards is a big theme with Pisces & Scorpio Transits Opposing Virgo & Taurus’. A general dismay for hyper-criticism or pessimism can actually bring you back into your inner peace all while taking accountability for your actions 


While Pluto in Capricorn is being the silent instigator this week; Venus, Neptune & Jupiter are serving as the silent balancers. With Positive Aspects, Venus & Neptune are making sure to keep the peace (at the best, inner peace). Jupiter although Retrograde is still trying his best to make sure that this time period even with it’s suspenseful tension can bring positive & prosperous outcomes. This astrological climate is hence waking us, the collective to a bigger and wider reality highlighting the importance of resolving inner conflicts and embracing the transformation that comes with it. This is a significant period of catharsis that will bring many wonderful results. 



(On a side note: With Moon Opposing Uranus in Taurus and Jupiter Rx in Taurus, the frustrations of any & every kind can prompt you to over-indulge, so if you have issues with eating or spending, it is best not to go overboard with either. Since, although it can feel satisfying at the moment to do so, it is still wise not to let it become a coping mechanism at this time. There is also a risk of being hyper-focused on everything you are doing, with Mars & Uranus. Although, paying too much attention intently on any task/project can bring you closer to achieving perfection now, but it can also make you lose yourself in the minute-details easily. There is no need to over compensate for anything that you have or have not done in the past either, since you can be tempted to “Go, Go, Go!!!” which can leave you exhausted. Patience and a steady pace towards progress will be your best friends for success. There is a fair chance of overwhelming truth that can come out through the magic of Scorpio season, so be prepared for intense downloads or even uncomfortable clarity, epiphanies & revelations.)


The recent Taurus Eclipse in Oct ended huge cycles from our past, New Moon in Scorpio now is bringing a finality to even deeper cycles. Subconscious thoughts & even memories that may have haunted you for ages may suddenly come to the surface creating an inner atmosphere of fear or paranoia, only to be purged once & for all. Envy, jealousy, hate, resentment, etc. are natural projections of our lives, but they are also energies can be positively transmuted through self-reflection. So, if you are receiving such negative projections, you are likely to handle it with more emotional maturity than ever before. While, if you are the one feeling intense negativity, you are likely to see yourself in situations where you will have to face all those feelings and (almost) forced to reflect on them for your own self-development, since Saturn in Pisces & Pluto in Capricorn are playing games about our negative egotistical tendencies. Hence, this can be a deeply & painfully healing period in time, with the release of toxicity & negativity from within our subconscious and without in our life. 


Your mood swings, intense feeling of dread, paranoia through uncertainty, self-hate, self-pity, sudden sadness, explosive anger, etc. can tire you out now sooner than ever before. But, all this intense purging has it’s own unique purpose, with Moon’s immensely cathartic yet positive influence. If at any point, you feel that you are imploding under the immense pressure that this astrological sky is putting you through, remember to access your vast expanse of inner strength. So, instead of looking outward for answers, go inward to settle tumultuous sea of emotions within. Trust in yourself and the process, your intuition is leading you somewhere wonderful. Use this New Moon to completely close out any cycle/pattern of behavior/connection/thought pattern that you have out grown and completed karmically. With Neptune, Jupiter & Venus’s positive influence, believe in a better tomorrow where you will get to enjoy your just rewards of prosperity & a harmonious life. You might not have the maps yet, but this uncharted territory in-front of you holds all your wishes, dreams & desires, so get ready to jump in with faith. You got this ;) 🦋

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Virgo (6th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Virgo (6th House)

You are an exceptional help to others; you look after your loved ones always making sure that they do well in their endeavors, but you tend to ignore your own priorities sometimes. You can be extremely self-critical; you might even have the tendency to compare yourself to others and their accomplishments. You might even overlook your skills and merits that way. You take great pride in your work, but you might not fully appreciate your efforts for accomplishing those goals. You might even have health issues, especially during your childhood where you fell ill often. You might have stomach & skin related issues or feel extreme anxiety. 


You can even feel sick easily when you are under extreme stress. You take your work seriously, but you might also have tendencies to take opportunities for granted from lack of empathy towards yourself. You might feel inadequate to attain your dreams sometimes just to end up sabotaging your efforts and opportunities. You might even feel unworthy of praise or appreciation for a job well done. You might have a hard time keeping your thoughts positive. You might even suffer from mental health issues over time. You might have depressive mood swings or anger issues as a result. You might even have trouble working in teams or in closely knit organizations since you feel inadequate or over-burdened by responsibilities. 


You are however an adaptive person who can easily adjust to changing circumstances and make split-second decisions. You are good with managerial and organizational works since you pay close attention to details. You can contribute more to team-work than you give yourself credit for, speaking of which, you need to make a habit of giving yourself enough credit for how incredibly amazing you are and how much progress you have made. You need to take care of your mental health by changing your self-talks and thought-patterns. Any number of ups and downs, failures and successes are fair and acceptable, you must learn how not to blame yourself for every outcome or circumstance especially those that are out of your control. 



You will need to be realistic but not cynical about your life’s direction. You can pursue your desires and ambitions with confidence knowing full-well that you are more than capable of accomplishing your goals since you are extremely methodical and practical. You can also improve your health by consciously choosing workouts that fit your needs or other enjoyable physical activities, nutrition, meditation & mindfulness, etc. if you feel overly invested in your health routines, you will have to learn how to rest and relax as well, since your single-minded focus can leave you exhausted even when you are focusing on healthy things/practices. 


Your patience will be tested in many areas of your life, especially when you are waiting for the outcome of your efforts, so you will need to learn when to let go of control and go with the flow instead of over-analyzing what has already been finished especially when you give it your all. You might also have to consider responsibilities more as healthy challenges than as burdens. You can change your perspective on life by actively participating in it without feeling pressured to be perfect or adequate, but instead as your true self. 


Your help, guidance, work and services can bring healing and positivity to others. You might even feel satisfaction in volunteer works or charitable endeavors. Taking part in team based or community related activities can help you to use your skills productively all-while reducing social anxiety. Your knowledge and expertise can take you higher than you ever thought, so you can embrace your hard-earned skills unapologetically.

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Aries (1st House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Aries (1st House)

You might have had vivid memories of your childhood, but the bad times can haunt you deeply in your adulthood. You might have insecurities about your appearance or the way you present yourself. You can suffer from many sudden or chronic illnesses with this placement. There’s an overall lack of self-confidence that can leave you crippled in tense situations. You might even have toxic patterns of talking yourself down and eventually sabotaging many opportunities that could have helped you succeed in life. This self-defeating behavior might have been very prominent in your childhood, but with age and maturity you might have realized how to pace yourself a lot better. You also have a fear of success that you need to keep fighting against in order not to abandon your plans or goals. 


You are incredibly talented, you are a born leader and others look up to you for how courageous you are, but you might have a hard time seeing yourself in that light. Your early life experiences have a lot of influence over your current decisions/choices even if just subconsciously. You have all the capabilities to go on solo-ventures and succeed in your endeavors, but you hold back from being in the spotlight or walking ahead of the pack. You are really good at encouraging others to leave their comfort zone and go after their dreams but have a hard time doing the same. You might even get afraid of change in life directions, since you have an inner wound of things often not going your way. 



This placement can also make you a lil’ pessimistic about your life in general, where you automatically expect everything to go wrong. Your words have an incredible power. You know how to lead by example, and your shadow work can inspire many. You could motivate crowds if you wished to, just by how naturally charismatic you’re. You know how to accept your flaws, even when you’re being pessimistic about yourself, you already have enough inner understanding to embrace your flaws. You are passionate in everything you do; you have to give yourself credit for how hard you work. You can keep reaching farther than you planned every-time you embrace success and failure without rejecting or discrediting your efforts. 


You will have to take care of your health, being conscious of how much stress & extra work you are taking in. Anger issues by either unregulated outbursts or pent-up resentment can also be an issue that can cause problems in your physical/mental health. Paying close attention to how you regulate your anger or disagreement can also help you to express your feelings to your loved ones and form stronger bonds. You might even feel overwhelmed of being the leader, but you must already know that you are fully capable of handling all the responsibilities and risks. 


Being active and getting out of your comfort zone every now and then can help you gain your self-confidence and use your hard-earned talents/skills productively in the process. So, even when you feel like you’re lagging behind, you are not, you are ahead of your game, all you need to do is to keep believing in yourself - the hardest thing for you with this placement and take a risk on yourself once in a while to give yourself the chance to accomplish your dream-life.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Aries (1st House) Generation ⚙️✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 



Natal Saturn in Aries (1st House) Generation ⚙️✨ 

With Aries’s (1H) head strong and impulsivity and Saturn’s methodical and cautious approach to success, this Natal placement can indeed be challenging. The 1st House/Arian aggressive and agitated energy becomes a problem since that alone can cause a lot of unnecessary confrontations and delays. In some ways, the “go-go-go” attitude seems to bring more trouble than it should with this placement. There will be tough lessons to learn regarding patience and persistence under the supervision of the stoic master Saturn. Anger management will likely be a necessary skill to learn as well, since all the extra pressure this Natal placement brings can be frustrating to handle. Especially when your plans get a “yellow” signal and takes a long time to turn to “green”, presenting a level of restlessness that can drive you crazy at times and affect your productivity. 


Your attitude towards life can be affected by all the delays and detours that even the smallest of your goals and ambitions experience. General pessimism, stoic demeanor, lack of enthusiasm, etc. can further deteriorate your drive to pursue your goals. Your self-image can suffer from all the self-criticisms. This can trickle into your body image as well, making you extremely self-conscious. You might either hold yourself back too much or over-exert your authority, both coming from a sense of low self-esteem. Although, that is the important clue with this placement, empathy and compassion can elevate you from your insecurities and self-doubts, since relying on over-bearing self-talks can only make things worse. 



Mastering this placement can be a life-long process yet a satisfying one. Self-acceptance and patience with oneself are the biggest lessons of Saturn in this placement, allowing you to integrate into your strengths and improvise on your weaknesses. Delays and rejections can always be seen as “blessings in disguise”, so you can rest assured that your efforts will be paid in full (if anything in 10 folds) in due time. Your determination and aggressive drive need well-established plans with just enough space for restructuring to make a steady progress in your goals. 


Long term goals will lead you to new heights and bigger achievements, likewise, short-time gratifications will be shut down, might even lead to humiliating experiences. This placement will also challenge you to finish what you started, since giving up in the middle due to distractions or being frustrated by the process will only mean that you miss out on the rewards. Your self-doubts will pose as obstacles, but you can also be put in circumstances where you might have no choice but to excel, since not just your effort but also your pride will be on the line. These trying situations will help you mold yourself into an incredible person, a well-rounded individual with a persistent yet humble personality. 


You can ascend to leadership positions yet often find it difficult to accept yourself as a leader. But your work-ethic and management skills will help you gain both yours and others’ respect. You might have challenging experiences with elders or authority figures, since you seem to attract tough teachers. You will learn valuable lessons from such stern mentors and gain much needed insight into the direction of your life & goals. You might even meet a fair share of unreliable leaders/authorities who only seem to abuse/miss their powers. This can also be a caution to not be domineering or authoritarian in your approach to others, since humility and integrity will be keys to your success, not to mention to your personal & professional identity. 



Representing your authentic self will be your karmic duty with this placement. Your childhood might have taught you tough lessons regarding responsibility/accountability, either due to a strict upbringing or unfortunate situations which held you back from experiencing the lighter & softer sides of life. Aries and 1H represent “you and your life’s general direction”, so a great guide like Saturn here can be both imposing and comforting. You can always rest assured that you will be lead in the right direction with this placement. 


You will be faced with many health issues, be it physical or mental throughout your life reminding you to pay close attention to your well-being. Physical activities, like workouts, sports, or other hobbies can help you stay active, healthy and be productive when you feel restless. Positive mindset, breaking self-imposed restrictions, realistic yet optimistic thought-process with help you to be more kind to yourself which will reflect on how you treat others (especially your loved ones) as well, since you can project your insecurities and impose self-doubts on others. This can also be vice-versa, where your low self-confidence can make you prone to others’ negative projections.

entry.title: Penumbral Lunar Eclipse in Scorpio, May 5, 2023 | Powerful Endings, Rebirth & Transformations 🦋✨
entry.content:
Full Moon Eclipse in Scorpio has already started shaking up everybody’s foundation to its core. So, how has it been, coping with your stability rocked, mocked and dismantled by fated events?  Everything happening right now is out of our control, which will add to our fears, like a horror movie background music, building up tension & mystery every step of the way. Since, this will be the last Scorpio Eclipse of the season before the South Node moves into Libra, expect sudden & shocking events that will bring chaotic blessings into your life.


With Uranus in Taurus opposing the Scorpio Moon, we will see many unexpected events occurring at the speed of lightening. There is already a building tension with Pluto squaring the Lunar Nodes, so this eclipse will be an intense one indeed. There will be sudden dismantling of situations/places/connections that no longer serve our highest good, or worse if they are holding us back from our true potential, marking this an intense time for breakups, separations, rejections, etc. Some may be heart-wrenchingly painful to let go of; others may bring a final & deep sense of relief. 


So, if you have been holding onto someone/something that has caused you a lot of heartbreaks, but deep-down you know that you deserve much better, expect to see that connection/situation to breakdown bringing you the necessary revelations & clarity. On the other hand, if someone has been holding onto you, unwilling to understand that things have come to a natural end, be it in any relationship (romantic, business, familial), there will be major endings with no chance of going back to how things were before. 



The universe has a way of ripping our band-aids off, which usually happens during eclipses. Scorpio Full Moon Eclipse with the backing of Uranus Opposition the Moon & Pluto’s Square the Nodes will be an epic sight to witness. The events that are triggered now may even play out until the Lunar Eclipse in Taurus in November 2023. So, pay close attention to situations that are building up tension & sudden shake-ups in the areas of your life that are being affected now.


With Uranus Opposition & Lilith’s Square to Scorpio Moon, Pluto Square to the Lunar Nodes; this eclipse will trigger fears & insecurities about the past, especially if you are in situations/connections/places that are restricting, overwhelming or undermining you. You will be prompted to break-lose from such shackles with carefully crafted escape plan that the universe presents to you. With Pluto & Mercury currently retrograde, there won’t be much chance for exact information or clarity of the path ahead, but all you will need now is your unbreakable faith & trust in the universe.


Lilith Square & Mercury Opposite to the Full Moon now will bring a lot of agitation within to break-free. Your independence will become the prime focus for the next six months. So, there may be tendencies to make hasty decisions, seek revenge, lash out, expose others, etc. But Saturn in Pisces Sextile Scorpio Moon now will bring a sense of balance and grounding (genuinely, Thank God!). 


*One a side note, Eclipse periods usually caution us about accidents, bruises or cuts, etc. (no matter how small or severe). This Eclipse in particular, we will need extra caution with such things, since it’s in “Scorpio”. So, there may be shocking incidents, even bad news that can be heart-breaking, God-forbid. I sincerely hope that we find the strength to heal through such sudden loses 🥺🫶🏼.*



Lunar Eclipses in general are like release points, South Node does the exact same thing, it brings fated endings & closures. So, with Scorpio in the mix, there will be a lot of chaos, bringing up fears, deep rooted insecurities, with the added pressure from both within & without, the very thought of lacking control over the events will be immensely scary. So, there is a high risk of self-sabotage at this time. The safest way to navigate this period is to let go of control and introspect on “how & why the current dismantling process is probably the best way-out of an old chapter and into a brand new one?!?”.


With this Eclipse more than ever, we will be expected to go with the flow and let go of control, since it will certainly prove to be an exercise in futility. This period will be chaotic, making us feel disempowered at first, but as you trust your intuition and not the physical circumstances around you, you will be able to slowly see the changes that are taking place, changes that are happening in your favor. So, before you know it, you will be transformed into an empowered version of yourself, with a whole new chapter waiting for you to enter.


Letting go of certain people/places/things no matter if you realize how toxic they are no not will be painful, but this Eclipse will be brutally honest with you, forcing you to close stagnant & unstable chapters, to begin wonderful new ones where you can feel secure & spread your wings. Since “Endings are just doors to new beginnings’, with a potent Scorpio Lunar Eclipse, transformation is eminent, with old fears being replaced with faith, pain with wisdom, control with power, and toxicity with purity. May this period of intense change removing negativity and clear out the way, allowing room for blessings & newness, with a renewed sense of faith & clarity in purpose. 🦋

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid Mythology (Natal Interpretation) 🐚✨
entry.content:
Sirene or Siren, famously appear in the Greek mythologies, like that in Homer’s Odyssey and Argonautica. The most well-known description of Sirens is that of mystical and alluring creatures who are half fish & half human (which are also seen in Roman Myths). There is also another even older description of Sirens being half bird (with wings & feathers) and half human. Yet in both descriptions, they are depicted as women with an enchanting voice, hypnotizing beauty and alluring charm. In some versions, their origin is through the union of Muses/Nymphs & Sea/River Gods, and in other versions they were Nymphs who served Persephone or angered Aphrodite (in both of these versions, they are cursed by Demeter for not protecting Persephone from being abducted or by Aphrodite for taking an oath of chastity & there by challenging her duty as a Goddess of love & fertility), and so on. 


Sirens are said to be treacherous creatures who lived on the rocky shores of mysterious island(s) surrounded by dangerous water currents. These islands were generally said to be difficult to navigate, there by invoking a sense of danger and adventure. Sirens enchant those who are closer in proximity to where they are, often times luring unsuspecting sailors into diverting their ships towards the island(s). So, they are usually not creatures who actively seek out their victims, but rather entice those who cross their path (although, there is always a deliberate intention to harm). Their effects worked like a hypnotic spell, causing their victims to abandon all reasoning; out of touch with reality, enchanted by the promise of witnessing immense beauty or the allure of mystery; playing on the desperate human temptations, emotions and carnal desires. The spell bound sailors then would meet their doom trying to find the source of the sweet voice that drove their imaginations to expect a beauty beyond comprehension. Thereby meeting their end on the rocky shores, tragically bereft of all conscious control, responsible for their own doom. Hence, One thing that is often agreed upon in all the mythologies of Sirens is that “A Siren's call is one best left unanswered.”


Sirens were also believed to meet their own tragic end when they come across someone who can resist their temptation and/or severely hurt their ego, hence breaking their over-confidence (or curse). So, there is an element of being prideful of their natural talents, and also of desperate longing to be free of their curse. This can be regarded as a way of keeping one safe from the Sirens’ spell or to hurt them without endangering oneself. According to the myths, one has to : exert exceptional self-control & self-discipline; have a stronger sense of purpose, morality & integrity; inner strength and a resilient willpower; restraint on ones’ carnal desires & ability to resist temptations; a mind that is rational & of sound reasoning; in order to escape the otherwise irresistible spell of the Sirens. Other deeper meaning can be that, one often meets Sirens when on an important journey and during the most crucial time in their life, as a test of both ‘strength of character’ and ‘the devotion to their true purpose in life’.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Taurus (2nd House) Generation 🌴✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)



Natal Saturn in Taurus (2nd House) Generation 🌴✨

Natal Saturn in the sign & house of Taurus is a more comfortable placement. The hard-working and dedicated nature of Taurus/2H is an incredible boost to Saturn’s ethics. There’s also a stigma to this placement since Saturn in the house/sign of Money & materialistic abundance can be a lot of extra work, but Saturn here will help you build a solid and unshakable foundation for your financial security. You might experience delays or obstacles in attaining certain material or financial goals, yet you will also understand in due time that those detours where blessings in disguise. 


You will gain a lot of experience through many tough lessons regarding time-management, money management and dependability. You might even have the mindset of doing everything all by yourself which will further cultivate a strong work-ethic. Your resources are always a concern since you value everything you have & own through your efforts. But this excessive need to preserve or save for a rainy day might make you a miser if you are not being careful, since such a mindset could also turn into Poverty-consciousness. 


Saturn here teaches you about self-sustainability but there is no need to feel lack when there is plenty. So, being aware of your resources is a great way to stay in control of your financial stability but also allowing yourself to enjoy what you have acquired through your own hard work every now and then is not such a bad thing to do either. You might even be really good at taking care of everything you own, so you know how to safeguard your possessions and maintain them responsibly. You might not see the hype in extravagance since you value good quality things, since you know that expensive doesn’t always mean quality or class. You know how to set healthy standards for the things you own, buy, sell, make, etc. 



You might also like to collect things that you feel are helpful for a later day, but once again, if you are doing it with a poverty-mindset, you might feel more pressured in maintaining the responsibility than in actually utilizing them. However, you are also good at discerning quantity and quality, so this good judgement comes in handy both in materialistic and relationship choices. You will have to be careful not to become too stingy with your money & generosity, since your help can mean the world to those who may need it, so holding yourself back just because you feel you don’t have enough when you actually do will only weigh on your conscience.


Your early upbringing might have had a profound effect on the way you saw life later on. You were either born into a wealthy family with a lot of pressure to maintain the status or in a humble family with a lot of pressure to maintain financial stability. In both circumstances, there could have been a sense of lack that might have affected your inner stability (sometimes, this placement could also mean that you might have experienced lack & poverty at a certain point in your life). You might even realize in your adulthood, the need to break certain generational curses/patterns with regards to relationships or money. 


You take your values, traditions and culture very seriously. You might even be quite traditional (even if it's not particularly religious) in your views and have strong opinions on morals. You highly value ethics and don’t stand for any form of vulgarity. You might even detest people who seem to bring negativity into your life, since you don’t like anyone or anything constantly creating chaos, drama or instability, so you are likely to remove such distracting connections or elements. Basically, you don’t encourage or participate in any kind of nonsense. 



You might work hard to elevate your status and social position, especially your living surroundings and community. You except to live a certain standard of lifestyle and you will eventually attain them through your diligence and intentions. You might like to have a pleasantly decorated house or a minimalistic setting, either way, you pay attention to the details, and maintain a clean aesthetic. Relationships during your early years may have been particularly difficult or tense. But, with time and maturity you might notice improvements in your friendships, relationships and other professional contacts due to your willingness to slowly open your heart to positive and uplifting connections. 


You are loyal and value commitments so you might consider solid relationships over flings. You might not be the type to jump into anything without thinking things through either, so you take time to assess the person and situation before you make anything official. You are likely to enjoy stable and reliable connections. Romance and sex are important parts of your intimate relationship, so you except to be with someone who is equally mature and loyal. You might even marry someone who is financially stable and emotionally secure. You might wish to create financial security with your partner through sharing resources or building sources of income together. 


Your status, professional success, social position and financial stability can determine your self-esteem & vice versa. Lack mentality can affect both your self-worth and your productivity. You might be prone to self-criticism which can reflect on your health, self & body image as well. You are good with creating and maintaining a healthy lifestyle. Although, you might have to face some health issues (especially in your early years) that will remind you to take care of yourself. 



Self-care, workout or physical activities, hobbies, etc. may be helpful in your routines. Occasional R&R may also be essential since you deserve to give yourself the permission to just relax and have a care-free day or two. Your food and nutritional choices must be carefully curated as well, since you might be a picky eater, or you like to maintain a healthy diet. This can even make you health-conscious in your early adulthood, but again, you will have to be careful not to over-exert yourself or neglect your well-being due to excessive self-criticism. 


You are a hard worker, you cultivate your work-ethic through effort and experience, so you also know how to handle stress and responsibilities very well. You make no excuses when it comes to your work/duties. You might even be very big on time-management and hate to be late. You have a stern personality that helps you make difficult yet necessary decisions, so you might even consider careers with entrepreneurial, managerial or leadership roles. You take decisive steps towards your goals, you make methodical plans, you might even be meticulous in their execution, so you take your own time to reach your goals. 


You are ambitious and you set long-term intentions, you like climbing the mountain of success. You might even enjoy high positions as a result of your ingenuity and efforts. You are humble, respectful, graceful and hence admired by many. Your solid personality garners much respect from your peers and loved ones alike. You are also likely to build wealth and abundance over time, either through a satisfying career or successful business(s) and other sources of income.

entry.title: Natal Mars Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
You might be confrontational or meet people who are always out for a fight. You might even feel uneasy while expressing your opinions in tense situations, or you might avoid being in conflicting places altogether. You might have troubles starting new endeavors, usually due to lack of self-confidence. You might even sabotage opportunities due to fear of “being not good enough”. You are however an exceptional leader, even if at first you feel unworthy of such great responsibilities. 


You are also a passionate individual with a lot of ingenuity. With age & maturity you might even realize how powerful you are. You might however have to regulate your intensity, as to how much or how little effort/pressure you exert. You will need to learn patience in order to effectively implement your actions and spontaneity instead of impulsivity. You have a lot of personal charisma that others look up to. 


You will have to give yourself enough time to integrate your passions with your plans. You might also have to learn to be committed to your goals and see all projects/interests through till the end. You will need to process your desires and find the right ways to achieve them. You will also need to learn how to voice your disagreements, likewise, how to react to others’ disagreements. 


You will need to express your anger in a healthy way and avoid unnecessary confrontations with tact or sometimes with compromise. You will realize how confident and incredibly strong you are in your character through tough situations that you face, so you will also be able to embrace your imperfections and fears, in order to live your life with purpose and accomplish your goals successfully.

entry.title: New Moon Partial Solar Eclipse in Virgo 29° 🦩✨ Sept 21, 2025
entry.content:
An extraordinary Partial Solar Eclipse takes place mere hours before the year’s Autumn Equinox, in Virgo supported by Mercury’s Conjunction, Uranus & Pluto’s Trine, while simultaneously challenged by Saturn & Neptune’s Opposition. Hence, creating a Kite Aspect Formation in the Astrological sky, which intensifies both the New Moon and the Solar Eclipse. 


Butterfly Effect. Little mishaps can snowball into bigger problems. Negligence can lead to big Catastrophes. It will be very easy to miss Important steps in the process unless one is paying careful attention. Even minuscule imperfections & impurities can cause Major Harm. The results will be almost immediate, so although you might have to deal with immediate consequences, that are messy & seemingly counterproductive, such mishaps now are truly “blessings in disguise”, they may prevent something much worse down the line. 


The same can be true about certain things that have not worked out for you in the recent months (or even in the recent years). You will see signs of how these delays, rejections & disappointments may be for the best, that likely prevented you from getting stuck in things that are not for your Highest Good. You will have plenty of time for deep-reflection if you are in the midst of such realizations. Something to be truly grateful for indeed.


For the next few days in particular, pay closer attention to everything without getting distracted by the noise. The devil is ‘certainly’ somewhere in the detail. Make decisions carefully. If you are leaning more towards your Practical & Analytical side, you might have to also integrate your Intuition & Feelings into the Equation. Likewise, if you are drawn towards something based on your Emotions & Subconscious Impulses, you will need to incorporate Practicality & Rationality in order to make a Balanced Decision. Handle dilemmas that you encounter now with wisdom.


As the Eclipse occurs on the South Node of Virgo (at a critical 29°), during this period in time the situations you face will likely be related to your Past (even your childhood &/or past life), especially those that may have been incredibly hard to deal with. Yet, as with the South Node’s release and Virgo’s ability to cleanse impurities, this may be an Auspicious Moment to leave the past behind, where you can feel the relief of the burden being lifted. So, if the Past memories & situations come back, whether with a subtle or overwhelming impact on your Emotions, you will feel naturally Balanced & Confident to face them (or not, if you choose to simply let them pass by, either way), you will be releasing them to make way for something entirely New & Healthy; emotionally, spiritually, psychologically & karmically… A deep Spiritual & Karmic Detox. 


Solar Eclipse during a New Moon in Virgo will invigorate your Passions & Dreams. You will be ready for exciting New experiences. You can use this opportune time to completely transform your Life in every way imaginable. Although, you will need to trust your Intuition a lot more than your Conscious Mind, which can seem challenging at first, yet, you will be surprised by the Potential that you tap into as a result, and the Rewards that follow. A Pleasant Shift in Perspective, being Open-minded towards New Ideas & Approaches will be more beneficial, opening Hidden Doors to Unique Opportunities. 


Prepare for the Auspiciousness that you are Manifesting, while wrapping up the very Last chapters of the past. Stay vigilant for mishaps, and optimistic for Awe-Inspiring Newness. Just as one small mistake can lead to a catastrophe, one small decision & step in the right direction now can lead you towards a Blessed New Path. 


Happy Autumn Equinox. ✨


Many hugs, and much luv.

xo


Background Photo by Justin Dickey on Unsplash
