entry.title: Natal Jupiter and Ascendant Aspects 🦚✨
entry.content:
Jupiter Trine Ascendant

△ You’ve an Inspiring personal aura.

△ Passionate, hardworking, talented, optimistic.

△ You’re also charming, generous, down-to-earth.

△ Adventurous, ambitious, studious, friendly.

△ You might find good karma through travel, creative endeavors & being spontaneous.

△ You can easily accumulate fame and wealth (especially if Jupiter is in 5H/9H).

△ You might also make wealthy and affluential associations.

△ You will however need to be careful not to let fame/money bring down your moral standards.

△ You might also easily become lazy (Trine energies are not easy to negate laziness/procrastination).

△ You must also be cautious of Over-indulgence (especially troubling if it stems from instant gratification/mental health issues.)


Jupiter Sextile Ascendant

✱ You’ve a positive mindset & approach to life.

✱ You’re friendly and have a happy-go-lucky personality.

✱ Friendships/relationships play an important role in your life.

✱ You might make many wealthy/influential friends/connections.

✱ Yet you are grounded & kind-hearted, so you’re also popular.

✱ You can accumulate wealth and status over time.

✱ Although you must be careful with over-indulgence of any kind.

✱ You can accumulate good karma from kind-deeds.


Jupiter Opposite Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

☍ You might have to face occasional low self-esteem issues.

☍ You’re often times lucky in relationships/partnerships (especially business related).

☍ You might enjoy having a big & supportive social circle (if Jupiter is in 7H, the emphasis may be on friends/lovers. If Jupiter is in 6H, it may be regarding work/institutions/community).

☍ But there may be a need to learn how to be self-sufficient and assertive.

☍ Also, there needs to be a caution against Codependency issues, which can cause a lot of disappointments with others (friendships/business partners etc.)

☍ You might easily attract friends/partners from different backgrounds/cultures/lands, etc.

☍ You might have a tendency towards Self sabotaging behaviors while in stressful/highly competitive situations.

☍ So there might be a need to work on improving self-confidence, in learning how capable and resourceful you are.

☍ You might also have the ability to easily turn enemies into friends through your witty & cooperative personality.

☍ You might develop an interest in law/welfare of community/activism, etc.



Jupiter Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant

^ You’re lucky but are usually in-Denial of it.

^ You might have a tendency to Self-sabotage during sad/depressive times of your life.

^ A lot of self/character development will be a constant theme of your life.

^ Living within one’s means might also be a big lesson.

^ You might however have to be careful when over-doing/over-playing your part in any kind of relationship (even in charity/helping others).

^ You will need to humble yourself when feeling overzealous, likewise, you may need to count your blessings and realize just how talented you are when feeling unworthy.


Jupiter Square Ascendant

□ You might often suffer from Self-doubt. You could however hide this behind a confident mask.

□ You might have to be cautious about Overindulgence (4H/IC, food and sensual securities. 10H/MC, monetary and material pleasures).

□ Your Adventurous/travel/explorative endeavors may be profitable (both for career and self-development).

□ You make a truly Great Friend/partner.

□ You might however have difficult relationships with your parents.

□ This might also lead to excessive desires (even desperation) for freedom to live on your own terms.

□ You must be careful not to rely solely on your luck (which could easily lead to laziness/boastful attitude).

□ Or you could have struggled with believing that you are worthy & that you can rely on luck, early on in life.

□ You must also be careful “not to bite more than you can swallow”. 

□ You might find good karma in helping (sometimes just supporting & having faith in) family members/neighborhood/mother figure(s) (4H/IC), or coworkers/father figure(s)/businesses (10H/MC). *Careful not to go overboard though*.


Jupiter Conjunct Ascendant 

☌ One of the best (and my fav) Ascendant aspects ever.

☌ You’re Joyous, Inspiring, Generous.

☌ It may be easy for you to access good fortune, wealthy connections, prestige (especially if Jupiter is in in 1H).

☌ You’re also Adventurous, hardworking, a go-getter with all the luck in the world, a great friend/partner.

☌ You’re an Optimist, always looking at the good in everyone and everything.

☌ A lot of people admire you, want to be around you, learn from you and enjoy life the way you do so effortlessly.

☌ A big caution towards over-indulgence (if Jupiter is in 12H, for alcohol/escapism; if Jupiter is in 1H, with everything from alcohol, food to over confidence/self-centered behaviors, taking things for granted, etc.). Even in moderation, you will be regarded as Hedonistic (for good or for bad, you will be loved for both).

☌ It’s almost like you can make anything happen, all you have to do is go for it, and the Universe aligns it all for you. 

☌ You must however be very careful not to rely completely on luck alone.

☌ Also (especially if Jupiter is in 12H), you might have to be extra careful not to divulge important information to just about anyone (with opposition to Descendant, it can attract a lot of haters/enemies who want to steal your ideas/credits).

☌ You are somehow with a naturally giving personality who often doesn’t have any expectations. You will likely accumulate good karma from helping others (in general, for any charity, social causes, etc.)

entry.title: Jupiter, Venus and Chiron Conjunction in Aries | March 1, 2023 🍀✨
entry.content:
Jupiter and Venus make a glorious conjunction in Aries on March 1st, 2023. Later in the week, Venus makes an exact conjunction with Chiron as she moves forward through Aries. 


Jupiter in Aries has been an exciting transit with increased productivity, passion and a sense of acceleration in life. Venus in Aries has sparked an interest to balance all that intensity while enjoying the spontaneity. These two aspecting each other in a beautiful conjunction is a sight to behold (we can see this glorious conjunction play out in the night sky for the most part of early March 😍). 


Happening in the fiery cardinal sign, there is a momentum that is being created to speed up the slow-moving energies from all the heavy retrogrades we recently ended. A lot of determination to jump into projects that you always wished to start, more focus on routines, put plans into motion, etc. Love and relationships in general get a boost of optimism and harmony, although there may be tension with how pushy you are while expressing your feelings (and vice versa, others towards you). This whole week (and until the mid-March), we can feel the enthusiasm rising, our surroundings will start to feel refreshing with positive new energies flowing in. 


Jupiter has been Conjunct Chiron for a while now (and will reach an exact conjunction soon), helping on our healing journey, with an optimistic outlook on life. Venus joining them will add more positivity. Although with Chiron here, it won’t particularly feel like “roses & lavenders” on the outside, since issues related to self-worth, money, love & relationships, karmic rewards, luck & fortune, etc. will reach a peak in a positive yet melancholy kind of way. There may have been a sudden rush of positive energies sweeping into your life that you don’t know what to do with, since all your past wounds & insecurities may be making it harder to truly enjoy the shift. 



Jupiter & Venus conjunction is one of the most auspicious aspects that brings luck & fortune in all forms. With Chiron in the mix, issues relating to luck & fortune themselves may bring back bad memories where you might have experienced misfortune or didn’t have much luck in certain areas of life in general. If you have Jupiter, Venus or Chiron retrograde placements or challenging aspects to them in your chart, then you might have felt this even more deeply. You might receive enlightening intuitive downloads regarding previous unfortunate situations especially regarding money & personal relationships that will help you to make a final release of financial karma & break karmic bonds with people/places/things that are no longer in alignment with you.     


Jupiter and Venus are the divine couple in astrology, so this can be a great time to heal & harmonize our divine masculine & divine feminine energies within. Similarly, there can be healing in romantic relationships by clearing out karmic cycles and inviting cooperation, prosperity & peace.


You might be feeling more grounded and in harmony with yourself, integrating wisdom and insights at this time. You might also be realizing how protected and divinely guided you are when you look back on certain situations that you have overcome. You could be letting go of a past version of yourself in the form of releasing patterns & experiences that no longer serve you, and this conjunction is here to help you leave the past behind as happily as you are welcoming the new You. You are no longer holding yourself back out of doubts or fears of past cycles repeating again. There may be a sense of slow progression in your life, especially if you felt stuck & stagnant during the past 6-8 months. 


Fears of the unknown, waiting for the other shoe to drop, a sense of instability, financial karma, indecisiveness, etc. may be some of the aspects that you’re willing to make positive changes in. You might be more serious about your shadow work and releasing limiting beliefs a lot more than usual around this time, healing on a soul level. Acknowledging the past while letting go of the karmic cycles for good. Through Spiritual/religious & self-care routines, making use of this time to take adequate rest and release any inner blockages will fully prepare you to ride this wave of positive changes a lot easier. You can expect to see advancements in professional & personal life. This conjunction is bringing in a much-needed shift in perspective by igniting a passion for life with a renewed faith & inner strength.

entry.title: Mars Opposition Pluto 2024 🌋✨ The cathartic opposition brings incredible challenges & opportunities along with major abundance • Nov 3, 2024
entry.content:
Background Pic by Anni Roenkae via Pexel


Pluto’s last transit in Capricorn will end eventfully with an intense Opposition to Mars in Cancer at 29º. This Opposition will bring up many issues, fears & even traumas that you will have to face one last time as well, if not actually at least mentally & emotionally. Hence, the next few months (until Jan 3, 2025 when Mars & Pluto oppose again at 1º Leo & Aquarius respectively) will bring incredible challenges along with equally rewarding opportunities. With future-focused Capricorn and ingenious Cancer in the mix, the Opposition on Nov 3, 2024 will hence be a major reawakening of your own Passions & Desires, creating a tumultuous whirlpool of intense emotions & restlessness.


For the next two months in particular, pay attention to how you’re approaching the goals that you hold close to you. This period will inspire you to give your all to anything you do (are doing), so it can feel like “All or Nothing” at times, further motivating you to keep going forward. However, with such a combination, things won’t seem to be easy or fun, especially with Mars & Pluto being in Cancer & Capricorn. There will be a big emphasis on your higher ambitions & career goals all the while family, security & the responsibility towards loved ones’ equally taking up much of your mind-space. Sacrificing one for the other will not be plausible, so if you are in such a bind, you can consider yourself to actually be in the midst of an internal war of desires & duties. 


The intense energy that is created due to this Opposition can also invoke your own Inner Strength, activating your determination to Succeed. So, this will be a great personal challenge to overcome your own limitations. On negative end, obstacles both old & new will present themselves, creating internal & external resistance to change as well as progress. So, it is advisable to be extra patient with yourself and other, especially with those who may be your opponents, competitors or even enemies. Instead of being straightforward in your response to such negative people, you will naturally be able to take a more reserved yet tactical approach, thereby avoiding more stress & conflict. 



So, be strategic and utilize soft power to overcome any such negativity without directly involving yourself in it if possible of course. This Opposition will hence give you numerous opportunities to understand a new way to handle such situations & people. It is also especially important to stay vigilant and careful with people in general since this time period can have an adverse effect on the whole of collective, and those who can’t get a hold of this energy can become a danger to themselves & others alike. Exercising caution can be a good approach to dealing with this rather Intense Opposition.


On the positive side, allow things to flow instead of trying to control the process & the outcomes alike. Paranoia in general will be high after all, especially with regards to your Career/Personal Ambitions. Hence, you might be tempted to control & obsession over every little detail, which can be a wonderful instinct bringing out the perfectionist in you, but on the extreme can affect you mentally & emotionally. So, be prepared to find solace in the uncertainty and the unknown, the waiting period & delays, etc. Patience and a set of healthy coping mechanisms will hence become vital to your mental & physical health. This will be a great time to revive an old project or to finish a long drawn ongoing one. 


Dealing with delays, oppositions from others, internal fears, rejections & other issues can feel extremely irritating indeed. So, brace yourself for a rather intense personal development period in the process. This can be an incredibly productive period for you if you know how to adapt to changing situations, reinvent yourself, readjust your approach, and be strategic overall. Focus on either a long term project or a short term one, anything that has been on your mind quite sometime now. This can be in your career life or in your family/personal life, or both. Give this immense reserve of energy a direction, towards your Passions, towards an incredible ambition (no matter how big or small). Make the best use of this wonderfully chaotic Opposition.


Closing out karmic cycles & patterns, in both your career & personal life will be a major part of this Opposition overall. Hence, if this Opposition is affecting you in a personal particular way, you likely are in the midst of closing out karmic cycles related to either or both your career & family related issues. This can hence stake up your internal & external foundations, maybe even prompt you to rebuild them more securely. Your sense of security & stability will see immense shifts. Make little adjustments, one inch at a time, one step further at a moment and you will be able to see massive changes in your life, elevating you out of the struggles that you are working on. This time period will indeed test your resilience and almost give you no choice but to transform your life in a major way. I hope this phase will safely take us through the process, preparing us for the next exciting chapter of our lives.

entry.title: Natal Moon and North Node Aspects 🌙✨
entry.content:
Moon Square North Node

□ There may be a reluctance to believing in yourself, especially since a very young age.

□ You might constantly doubt your instinctive nudges even though you’ve a sharp intuition.

□ You might also let your fears and insecurities guide your decisions than your dreams & aspirations, which in turn blocks your intuition.

□ You are creative and artistic, you’re a people-person even if you look reserved at times, but you don’t always know where to direct your passions. You might feel like nobody understands you or might have had difficulty with feminine figures in your early life that left you feeling like you need to walk on eggshells every-time you have to interact with others. A lack of sense of comfort, intimacy & trust in relationships (of all kinds) might make things even harder.

□ You might hold on to your past out of guilt or a sense of responsibility/security, but a new fulfilling path may be nudging you to take a leap of faith.

□ You often know how to express your sensitive self, you’re deeply emotional, yet you might be guarded to ever let others know your vulnerability.

□ Although your ability to verbalize your feelings, your intense & deep emotional depths might actually be part of your calling. Your vulnerability, genuine emotions - pain, sadness, sorrow, happiness, etc. are part of your lessons, and so you are fully aware of how to connect to others on such a deep level.

□ There may be intense emotional situations that seem to realign you on your true path, since you might have been resisting change. You will have to learn the importance of accepting your own vulnerability before locking yourself & others out of your heart. Your passions and life purpose will help you realize how to balance vulnerability & find emotional security.

□ Your scars and journey to recovery have the power to inspire many others who have been through tough times. You’re a motivational factor in so many people’s lives, which in turn helps you heal while healing others.

□ You’ll likely understand the value of emotional vulnerability & security; use your instinctual skills & talents to open up on a heart-to-heart level simultaneously helping others understand both yours and their own feelings; forming reliable & relatable relationships; gaining confidence, developing your creative & intuitive skills, accepting healthier relationships with others & self; finding true comfort, stability & peace, fulfilling your life purpose.


Moon Sextile North Node 

✱ Every moment you are connected to your emotional self, you feel fully integrated with your life purpose.

✱ There’s a sense of reliability that comes with this aspect to NN, since you know that you can always find people to support your vision.

✱ You’re also a source of inspiration to others, especially your loved ones who enjoy a close emotional bond with you.

✱ Feminine figures (mostly motherly) play an important role in helping you gain a sense of stability in your life that in turn gives you enough confidence to follow your purpose. 

✱ You might also have Feminine figures who enter your life to transform your inner world, hence helping you become more mature in the way you ride the tides of your emotions.

✱ You’ll meet many who will want to support you and be a guiding light, in both good & bad times. You will return this feeling of intimate security to your loved ones.

✱ You can use your intuition and your rational mind equally well, which helps you to navigate through any situations, good or bad, in a soulful and tactful way. You’re rooted in your traditions and strong moral values, this also helps you stay grounded through all the ups & downs, adding to your charm, this emotional fortitude appeals to others.

✱ You might have many artistic skills; you’re an effective communicator, you know how to express your feelings without much effort; you have good people skills that help you make trustworthy connections in both your personal & professional life.

✱ Your generous, mellow and well-mannered personality attracts all kinds of people and opportunities towards you. You might be quite popular for the same reasons. You value such connections no matter how vague or deep they may be.

✱ You’ll likely enhance your intuitive & logical fortitude; nurture deep emotional & supportive connections; spread positivity, healing & compassion; following your life path with faith, endurance & purpose; cultivating happiness, comfort, and prosperity.



Moon Trine North Node

△ You exude a serene aura when in your element, that attracts all kinds of people and opportunities towards you.

△ You are in tune with your intuition, even if you’re not consciously aware of it. You have a natural emotional fortitude, that helps you to tap into your inner guidance.

△ You might have many artistic and creative skills, that you deeply feel are connected to your soul purpose.

△ You don’t mind making decisions solely based on your gut instincts, and fearlessly take a leap of faith. Sometimes, these sudden changes you make can startle even your close personal relationships, since you seem to start things even without making plans. 

△ You trust yourself enough to take calculated & un-calculated risks, and always land on your feet.

△ You follow your emotions, wherever you feel the most fulfilled & secure, so you don’t mind wandering in roads less travelled, eventually creating a path for others to follow.

△ You have a vision in mind, and you know how to get there. You rarely plan out every little detail, since all you need is the initial step and the route to the goal opens up on its own.

△ You are an optimistic person; this deep inner faith helps you to stay grounded even through the storms of your life. You believe that you’re somehow always guided by higher forces, that brings you enough inner strength to continue forward, safe in the knowledge that you’re following your true purpose.

△ You have a nurturing side to you, that helps guide others. You have a natural calling to integrate your spiritual self with that of your career/purpose, hence creating soulfully inspiring works/services that help in the collective healing, just the way you’re able to heal your inner most traumas and wounds.

△ You’ll likely work towards a better life for yourself and the world at large; spread positivity, healing and happiness; inspire others to walk in faith and trust their intuition; cultivate peace, comfort, prosperity, and compassion following your inner calling and fulfilling your life purpose.


Moon Opposite North Node (Conjunct South Node)

☍ You might find yourself repeating painful experiences over and over again in your life, even when you know how to exist them.

☍ You might often feel crippled by fears whether they are real or imaginary. Whenever you feel the urge to make positive changes in your life, you might stop yourself through the projection of your own insecurities.

☍ You might have had childhood experiences that were either true or a fantasy or both, which seem to have a strong hold on your life choices. You have a strong sense of fear of accepting help from others, even though there may be many who love you dearly enough to support you through anything that you may be going through. 

☍ You might also be extremely sensitive & emotional yet feel like you can’t fully express them to others, out of certain restrictions that you think are being imposed on you, even if there’re none.

☍ You might be blocking emotional intimacy or feel trapped whenever you’re in a healthy connection. Resulting in ups and downs, turmoil and distrust in your close personal relationships.

☍ You might also have a hard time embracing your intuitive gifts. Your past experiences, traumas and fears often cloud your judgement, and hence locking you out from your own inner guidance.

☍ You might follow a comfortable path, feeling safe and secure, yet feel completely dissatisfied with it. Changing course might be a painful experience since you were emotionally invested in your early path, even if you didn’t have the full trust in where you were going. But eventually, all circumstances, lead you towards your rightful path, helping you become more aware of yourself, emotionally and mentally.

☍ As you evolve and understand the depths of your own inner world, you’ll start to find the missing pieces of your happiness. Reconnecting with yourself and your true purpose might be scary at first, since there’s a lack of security that the old path (Moon conjunct South Node) might have given you. 

☍ Facing your fears also helps you to reconnect with your intuition, and hence getting back the access to your inner guidance. This also helps you to tap into your creative gifts, develop people-skills, form trustworthy bonds without the fears & insecurities, and display your true emotions to the world.

☍ You’ll likely go through intense emotional transformations; learn how to trust in your instincts and hence trust that there’s a higher force guiding you towards your true path; release negativity and fears from past experiences; show love & compassion without holding yourself back; nurturing your inner self and hence inspiring others to do the same for themselves; establishing security, stability, peace and comfort in your life following your life path with faith. 



Moon Conjunct North Node 

☌ You have a profound sense of self, even if it was a hard-earned gift.

☌ You have a strong intuition, even when you’re not consciously aware of it, you trust your inner feelings & gut instincts.

☌ You can make split-second decisions, or plan for a bigger mission, you have the ability to ride the waves of change with ease.

☌ You naturally follow where your intuition leads you, you value your emotions and how the direction you’re taking feels rather than how it looks on the outside.

☌ You might have been through intense emotional situations, or had to witness them in others, which might have ignited a passion for healing, nurturing and providing security as a part of your inner calling.

☌ You are an endearing person; you know how to make soulful connections and nurture them. You might also have strong connections with feminine figures, whom you love and cherish, or wish to be an inspiring role model to others.

☌ You know how to relate to others and give off a perception of relatability to others. Your friendly and welcoming nature invites all kinds of people, opportunities and situations towards you.

☌ You yearn to create lasting relationships in both your personal & professional life, and so you enjoy a good social circle full of supportive and resourceful people. You have a healthy emotional balance, so you don’t over-take or over-give. You expect to form harmonious relationships, since you have a successful one with yourself.

☌ You integrate your compassion and happiness into your career and life path easily. Hence, providing the necessary guidance & support to others, in turn helping yourself heal through your own traumas & past experiences.

☌ You’ll likely express your genuine emotions and create balanced relationships; encourage others to follow their heart; spread positivity and happiness; create a healthy life for yourself and others; gain support, fame, fulfilment & prosperity following your higher calling.


Moon Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ With this aspect, you will be put in situations where you’ll have to face your fears, no matter how painful they may be.

^ You might feel unsure of your path, even if you know what your true purpose in life is.

^ You might ignore your intuitive calling, and instead let fears lead your way. Eventually making decisions that put you in unfulfilling situations.

^ You might also have a fear of abandonment or rejection. Feelings of inadequacies and imperfections might creep up on you, every-time you wish to make necessary changes in your life.

^ But when you give into those insecurities, you might find yourself being codependent, emotionally manipulated or dissatisfied. 

^ You might have to find the right balance between your needs and the needs of others, since you might over-give or over-take in emotional connections. There’s a longing for emotional intimacy and security that usually is at the root of all of your coping mechanisms and insecurities.

^ You will eventually reach a conclusion, to make the necessary changes, and to face your inner wounds to heal them.

^ You will go through painful yet satisfying emotional transformations that lead you back on your true path giving you the happiness and stability that you have always craved for.

^ Your biggest assets are your intuition, inner compassion and unconditional love. You’ll learn how to consciously use these gifts to move forward in life and inspire others to have faith.

^ You’ll likely understand the value of believing in yourself enough to trust in the process; following your inner guidance and facing your fears head-on; having faith, safe in the knowledge that there is a higher force guiding you every step of the way; using your life experiences to inspire others’ healing; spreading positivity and compassion; finding peace, true intimacy, security, comfort and fulfilment, following your higher calling.

entry.title: Natal Uranus Conjunct Neptune ✨
entry.content:
Inter-generational aspect. Occurs once in about 168 years. Recent: 1988 - 1999.

Unconventional, unorthodox and out of the ordinary. You seem to possess a deeper understanding on life, empathy, service, and compassion. You have a depth to your personality that is hard to unravel yet you have an Electric presence. You are exceptionally gifted and talented especially in spiritual and artistic fields. Your intuition is excellent, you are likely to have psychic gifts. You know how to integrate Spiritual insights into your Career/Interests. You often feel a calling towards unravelling Mysteries and Sacred knowledge that are unconventional or even controversial. 


You cannot be held down, restricted or bound to anything especially not in the name of Tradition & Societal norms. You seek justice and freedom. You might have felt trapped by restrictive households or cultural backgrounds growing up. You might grow up to completely disown such constraints or you might integrate only those beliefs that you deem to be useful and discard the rest. You are likely to follow the path towards Love and Emotional fulfillment. You are also eager to attain your dreams & aspirations despite challenges, even if they are overwhelming, karmic or generational. So, you are likely to fulfill your dreams with faith and determination, but to everyone else it may seem unimaginable and miraculous. You seek unconditional love, oneness and peace. You are connected to your Inner-self and seem to find solace in nature. Environmentalism, Activism, Charity and Social service are likely part of your Soul calling. You have a vision for the future that is exemplary yet to everyone else, it seems to be too controversial or even unorthodox. So, you might be seen as a troublemaker, a rebel or even scandalous. 


Your talents reflect your ideals. You know how to channel your visions through your work, hence your projects, inventions & creations themselves can help you bring about the changes & revolutions that you wish to see in the world. You are inspirational; your words & actions have a profound influence on others. On a spiritual level, you are deeply connected to the collective conscious. So, you can gain fame & popularity with a significant amount of influence. You are a leader, yet you are also a team player. You know how to support others in their cause and also bring people from different backgrounds to work towards a common goal. You are connected to this generation (in particular) on a more spiritual & intellectual way, so you are able to empathize with global issues, support one another through catastrophes, work on collective healing & spiritual evolution.

entry.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | August 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes August 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

Aug 1 - 6, 2023

It is hard to be triggered on multiple level Pisces, but that is probably the exact thing that you need for your own spiritual & emotional growth at this time. There have been many issues, memories and patterns making themselves apparent to you for a while now, that you might be feeling on edge about. This week can trigger your insecurities to new heights making you question EVERYTHING. You are deeply introspecting all your fears, flaws & insecurities, sometimes pointing figures at others and other times at yourself. Some deep wounds can be so complex to comprehend, but this process can turn into a pingpong-blame-game. Through all this craziness, you are coming to rational conclusions, holding both yourself and others accountable. 



Forgiveness (of self and/or others) happens in layers when healing trauma, which you are experiencing now in a more profound way dear Pisces. You might even consider it as emotional-clean-up. You are not the same person that got hurt or felt helpless when all of this first started, since you are realizing your true strength of character and pure innocence through it all. You can look forward to wonderful new prospects soon, so this is a wonderful opportunity to clear out any residual pain, resentment, anger or self-blame from your past. Your mindset is rapidly evolving as a result, helping you to positively reprogram your thought-patterns. You are a giver, healer and ultimately, a lover sweet Pisces. But, you are now learning how to use discernment in order not to waste your care & compassion unnecessarily to your detriment. 


You’re deeply empathetic, absolutely true, but now more than ever, you are connecting to your practical side as well. You are seeing how all the healing you are doing internally is reflecting in your outer world. Your relationship with both yourself and others is likely elevating. There is a new wave of optimism flooding into your life. You are learning the importance of healthy reciprocity, give & take, without feeling guilty for either. You are grounding in reality with your spiritual & mystical sides intact. That’s some powerful transformation right there Pisces. This week, you are busy & productive, you are learning to laugh whole heartedly again. You will feel the need to take short naps or self-care days. Wonderful opportunities will soon start to show up in finances and career. Feel free to settle into the newness dear Pisces, only positive shifts awaits you this week.

entry.title: Natal Neptune Retrograde
entry.content:
You could have been unbalanced spiritually where you might have felt like you couldn’t access your deeper subconscious. You might have also neglected parts of yourself or felt neglected by others during your childhood no matter how subtle it was, since in your early 20s and onwards, you might have realized how you have so much more to learn about yourself. You might even feel compelled to dive into spirituality, religion, or philosophy in search of answers to a feeling of emptiness. 


You might have exceptional creative and artistic skills, which can also help you to reconnect with your inner self. You might have psychic/intuitive gifts and become aware of them as you become more curious about yourself. You are extremely sensitive to your environment and so you can pick up on all kinds of energy shifts, you might even have health related sensitivities. 


You might feel called to heal others, either physically or spiritually, through charity or other social services. You might feel lost sometimes and seek outside validation or escapism just to come back to yourself and realize that you need to find answers within, since you can tap into your spiritual self and draw out invaluable insights. Your ego might not have been developed in your childhood or was inhibited due to certain situations, so you might not know how to stand-up for yourself or set healthy boundaries at first. 


You might even have troubles establishing your true identity since you allow others’ opinions influence you a little too much. So, such experiences might have prompted you to reinvent yourself, starting from building a strong belief system and following it through with your actions/decisions. So, releasing limiting beliefs/mindsets, embracing your true desires and setting intentions to manifest them will become prime focus in your adulthood.

entry.title: Cosmic Test of True Love • Venus, Mars & Neptune T-Square ❤️‍🩹✨ Aug 23 - Sept 2, 2024
entry.content:
This week will feel like a Trigger-Fest. Mars in Gemini will Square Venus in Virgo while Venus forms an Opposition to Neptune in Pisces who is also Sqauring Mars. Expect some serious changes in your relationships, especially Romantic. You might find out heart-breaking information about your partner (or vice versa), if they have been unfaithful or haven’t been giving you the love & respect that you deserve. OR, this will all be a misunderstanding that can blow out of proportion. Either way, this will be a Test of Faith for those who are in a serious relationship, and Venus in Virgo is sparing nobody from taking their own accountability. 


Pluto in Rx Trining Venus is partly responsible for these revelations heading our way. So, this is likely something you might have been expecting to know/speak about for a while now. This is why any Blow-Up in your relationship right now, can make or break it, for the better. Hence, this can be a major turning point in your personal life indeed. I emphasize this T-Square’s impact on Romantic & Committed Relationships not just because of Mars & Venus in the mix, but also because of Lilith Conjunct South Node (exact soon) in Libra. 


Even if there are no arguments or disputes, you are very likely to overthink things, even the smallest details can trigger your past wounds. This is especially true if you are healing a relationship with someone or even with your own self. Neptune, Mars & Venus in a particularly difficult aspect can find problems within ourselves and in our relationships without definitive reasons. So, if you and/or your partner are naturally an over-thinker and prone to anxiety attacks, this period of time will prove to be extra sensitive. Abandonment issues, anger issues, misinterpretation, replaying hurtful memories, etc. can severely damage your self-esteem, and if you are not careful, you might even end up projecting your feelings onto your partner (or vice versa) there by complicating the situation. 


It is very understandable to feel overwhelmed at this time 🥺, but be mindful not to sabotage your relationship and if your partner is feeling anxious, try your best to have compassion for them during this time. Allow yourself to go through this hazy period with grace, since there will be clarity & certainty, and true love will shine through soon enough. 🥹 Clear communication, empathy and understanding will be vital. On a positive note, you can clear out any misunderstandings or concerns in your relationship and take your relationship to the next level now. So, it can be tricky to balance your emotions, insecurities and empathy altogether, but this phase can help you overcome any past baggage, move up many levels on your self-development along with elevating your commitment to one another.


Any old pattern & karmic cycle that need to be closed out will take precedence now for a wonderful renewal in September when Pluto will Trine the South Node, Lilith & Venus in Libra. So, the truth will come to light and create a breakthrough for a transformation. If this is about Unfaithfulness (Neptune’s Shadow) or just a Misunderstanding, in both cases, you will be able to eventually find the right resolution. Chiron & Mercury in Trine, both Sextiling Mars is a huge relief, as this will help heal the situation truthfully & justly. Communicating your grief, disappointment or sorrow earnestly will lead to wonderful resolutions. 


So, if you find yourself in the midst of this T-Square, allow it to play out, express your feelings & thoughts with faith and you will see how this process can strengthen your relationship, or help you sever ties without regret however the Truth reveals itself in your life. With Pluto Sextile Neptune & Trine Venus, this will likely (mostly) not lead to breakups, but rather to major karmic cycles ending in your relationship, freeing you from an old phase and opening new chapters in your relationship. 


This will be especially true for those in a soul-mate and/or twin flame relationship. You might be clearing out painful cycles even from your past-lives together. If the difficulties that arise now are truly rectifiable (and I mean truly, since this will be like a powerful Tower-Moment, if you know Tarot, then you might also know that only things built on a true foundation can stand the test of time, or you will have to rebuild it), then you will see how beautifully this period strengthens your connection. 


Hence, this will lead to renewed passion, love & a deeper spiritual soul connection. Breaking cycles & karmic patterns will take a lot out of you both emotionally & spiritually. Spiritual protection can help you and your partner tremendously at this time, especially if you feel called & guided to pray or do some spiritual/religious practice.


Expect clarity, renewed trust & wonderful new beginnings in your romantic relationships. This will indeed be an Intense Test for your Commitments, where truth, loyalty & love will prevail in the end. This will be a great time to clear out any misunderstandings, may be to forgive past mistakes or however this T-Square plays out for you in your life, you will be happy with how things turn out. A lil’ Cosmic Chaos now will lead to well-deserved Happy-Endings. ❤️‍🩹✨

entry.title: New Moon in Cancer 4° 🌑♋️ Jun 25, 2025
entry.content:
Fresh Starts  •  Tough Decisions  •  Optimistic Outlooks


With the 🌑 Conjunct Sun & Jupiter in ♋️, the Summer starts with a Positive & Renewed Spirit. Along with a Sextile to Mars in Virgo, this is a Wonderful time for some much needed Energy Boost in both your day-to-day Life and your Career. You are likely to feel extra motivated to get started with Projects, Business Ideas & Ventures. Especially w.r.t. your Passions & Ambitions that also consequently elevate your Professional & Social Status. 


This brief period can be extremely stressful, with Head Aches and/or Stomach related issues. A sense of uneasiness and spikes in anxiety levels for seemingly no apparent reason. You are likely to make Important Life Style Changes that greatly benefit you. This can be true for your loved ones as well, where you may become more focused on their well-being and happiness. So, a good time to start healthy habits and cut back on unhealthy ones. Careful with seasonal or chronic conditions. Excellent time to learn more about nutrition & improvise on your recipes. Also, make time for some R&R 🥰.


There may however be some serious disruptions in your Home Life, where there can be conflicts or even big revelations. With Neptune & Saturn Squaring Moon, Jupiter & Sun, this New Moon will indeed be quite a Life-Changing one, with ripples of change becoming more & more obvious in the coming months. Take your time when making Serious Decisions as you may have to navigate through some Tough Choices & Uncertainty for a little while (say till the Next Full Moon). New Responsibilities whether concerning your own Personal Life or w.r.t. your Family can gently nudge you towards making Mature Decisions. 🐻


This is also an excellent time for some Deep Cleaning both in your Physical Environment and your Emotional Inner World. 🧸 Heal from Emotional and Psychological Mindsets, Thought-Patterns & Cycles that no longer serve your Highest Good. These Inner Changes will reflect on Key Relationship-dynamics making the bond stronger & more nurturing. The same can be true with cutting out relationships that bring only Emotional Turmoil & Instability. 


Overall a tremendously Intuitive & Enlightening New Moon. With your Emotional World revitalized and renewed, you will discover Newer Depths of your Inner World, an expansive space for more Growth, Compassion, Nurturing and Love. 🌱✨

entry.title: Black Moon Lilith and the Shadow 🦇✨
entry.content:
Lilith in Astrology often points to how Human Shadow & Ego work in one’s life. There is always some kind of Ego-related wound that gets triggered/created either in others or within you when Lilith is activated in a chart. Often Dark themes like bullying, abuse, harassment, obsession, possession, murder, corruption, etc. are associated with Black Moon Lilith. Something about you can trigger someone’s Shadow (or vice versa) to such an extreme level that they may loose control of their conscience and perpetrate acts of violence (again, ranging from subtle to severe). Lilith hence simply exposes just how cultivated (or not) one truly is within oneself, since to harbor negative feelings & thoughts about someone is often considered Human nature, but to unleash one’s darkness (at all) brings totally justified concerns towards that person. 


Again, this is not an epilogue to justify any Human behavior, dark or otherwise. But, only an observation of Social Behavioral Psychology if I can put it subtly. Regardless of Lilith’s 

Mythological, Religious or Historical origins and validity, Lilith is primarily an Archetypal energy, which is very real & relevant in our Society and Human Sociology. 


In astrology, Black Moon Lilith is a placement that signifies potential for danger in one’s chart. Much like the Mythological Lilith, you can trigger someone’s Shadow based on their own Inner Wounds and the Darkness that lies within them (or vice versa someone/people w.r.t. you). In most cases, Lilith related triggers can go completely un-acknowledged by the one being triggered almost as if they are consumed by their own darkness, giving-in to their Negative urges and hence are able to justify their thoughts, intentions & actions. Belittling, controlling, harming & disempowering you might give them a strange satisfaction, high and/or validation. You can often notice a prominent Lilith placement (+ its activation) in the charts of criminals, Narcissists and other Dark Triad personalities. 


In your own chart, it is vital to see how Lilith affects you, in what areas of your life you must exercise caution against danger. 

Attacks on your Reputation, Self-Image, Confidence, Self-worth, Career, Achievements, Livelihood, …

Lilith in 1H / 2H / 5H / 9H / 10H / 3H / 6H 

Lilith aspecting Sun / Venus / Mercury / Saturn / Mars


Destructive/Dangerous relationships (+ Power Imbalance), Domestic/Emotional/Physical abuse, Victim-abuser dynamics, …

Lilith in 2H / 8H / 7H / 4H / 5H

Lilith aspecting Venus / Mars / Saturn / Moon / Pluto / Neptune 


Sudden violence, threats, accidents, …

Lilith in 8H / 6H 

Lilith aspecting Uranus / Pluto / Saturn / Mars 


Abuse, Physical Violence, harassment, fear-tactics, …

Lilith in 8H / 12H

Lilith aspecting Pluto / Neptune / Mars / Saturn


Manipulation, entrapment, coercive abuse, …

Lilith in 4H / 6H / 8H / 12H

Lilith aspecting Moon / Neptune / Pluto / Mars / Mercury


Financial Manipulation, Fraud, Schemes, …

Lilith in 2H / 8H / 10H / 11H / 12H / 3H

Lilith aspecting Venus / Mercury / Pluto / Neptune 


Lilith related life experiences are hence extremely painful (to say the least): which can either lead to your own ego being severely damaged to the extent where you give in-to the darkness yourself, OR you choose to “transform Pain into Power” and take absolute control over your Ego, your Soul and your Life. Cultivating your Darkness and Commanding your Shadow-self, Healing your Inner Wounds. Hence is how Lilith affects our charts, where we awaken to our own Raw Primordial Power by walking out of the Fire of Despair, renewed, refined & re-inspired.

entry.title: Vesta 🔥✨ Mythology x Astrology of Asteroids
entry.content:
Vesta is the Roman Goddess of hearth, home and family. She is the Greek equivalent of Hestia. As the story goes, she was the first child of Cronus and Rhea (in Greek Mythology), hence the first to be swallowed by her father. She was a gentle and peace-loving Goddess who was more focused on fulfilling her duties than in love, romance or any other adventurous matters that most other Gods & Goddesses in mythology were interested in, so she was rarely involved in dramas and hence she appears less in Greek/Roman mythology. After the Olympians won the Great War against Titans, order and peace were restored, she was pursued by Apollo and Poseidon for her hand in marriage, but she refused them earnestly. She had long decided to remain a virgin. Zeus honored her decision and granted her the duty to tend to the Sacred Olympian Hearth, hence she became an important deity of Scared Flame, Hearth, Home and Family. She was worshipped in everyday rituals and domestic affairs. She was said to protect and nurture the people by providing food and heat through the fire of the hearth, etc. Hence, she gained a prominent position in Greek (and later Roman) society as the virgin Goddess of Sacred Flame and Hearth, where the flame in her temple was said to be worshipped and always kept burning. 

In Roman times, a tradition was started where young girls were selected to become worshippers of Vesta, known as the Vestal Virgins whose main duty was to tend to the sacred flame in her temple, to honor her by being virgins & protecting their chastity for 30 years. This position was considered to be a sacred one as they were revered for their selfless devotion. Vesta is also considered as a messenger connecting the mortals to their Gods since she was invoked as sacrificial flames, hence she was not only worshipped during everyday routines but also during important festivals and ceremonies. She was said to help humanity prosper as she provided fire, hence food, warmth and comfort to people. The fireplace in essence being her alter gave her prominence as she occupied the most important part of the house. She was hence worshipped also as a protector since she ensured harmony in family and in society at large. 

Vesta hence represents a more spiritually grounded side of oneself, devoid of material pleasures yet with sufficiency and satisfaction. She represents how devotion and determination can be spiritually rewarding. (Vesta is said to have her orbit between Mars and Jupiter.) She also represents the sacred fire within oneself that burns brighter with discipline and dedication to one’s goals providing inspiration. She can also indicate about one’s sexuality, either in rejecting it or accepting it due to an inner knowing or lack of, accordingly. She also shows the importance of being spiritually content and whole to be satisfied in life, only with and by one’s own efforts can inner peace be found and sustained.


Vesta’s placement in one’s chart can hence indicate:

What makes you who you are from a spiritual perspective

What are you devoted to 

What inspires you and helps you keep moving forward in faith

What are your spiritual desires and goals

What makes you fulfilled spiritually

How you look at your sexuality, how do you integrate your spiritual self to that of your sexual/mortal self

How do you devote yourself to your goals and aspirations

What you feel a strong dedication towards

How you are devoted to your family (with retrogrades or other placements & aspects, how disconnected do you feel from your family)

How comfortable and satisfying is your home/family life

What you show the most gratitude towards and how

What can rejuvenate your faith and confidence 

How you can tend to your spiritual needs

How you can translate carnal desires into more selfless & sacred goals

How you can be of service to others as a part of your spiritual purpose, etc.


Vesta is one of the main asteroids/dwarf planets in astrology, due to the significance it holds in one’s everyday spiritual needs and selfless devotion. This placement can tell a lot about one’s inner strength and their soul-purpose. So, it can be karmic in nature or have a more spiritual bend to it depending on one’s resolve and circumstances. It can also indicate how one can recover spiritually and hence rejuvenate their strength to go after what they desire; hence it can tell how/where they can invoke the support and guidance of their inner/higher self, keeping their spirit burning brighter through life’s ups & downs.

entry.title: Natal Mars and North Node Aspects 🌋✨
entry.content:
Mars Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ This aspect could have made itself apparent during your early years through explosive anger, impulsivity and impatience (Shadow side of Mars).

^ You might have had to learn painful (even embarrassing) lessons on how not to get ahead of yourself in situations, especially those that question your values or your passions.

^ Your temperament needs careful conscious control in order to avoid unnecessary conflicts, even when you are being provoked. 

^ This may be one of the many lessons of this aspect that becomes important on your soul journey.

^ You might go through intense situations where you have to hold yourself back from defending yourself to the point of break downs, since with this aspect you can easily attract people who try their best to push your buttons.

^ With time, maturity and guidance you will be able to regulate your anger, even when unjustly provoked, giving you the upper hand in such troublesome situations.

^ This level of self-control will prove to be a gift since you will be able to direct your Martian passionate energy into your career/purpose helping you achieve greater things.

^ Exercising patience and taking calculated risks will help you create great breakthroughs.

^ Your calm & collected, reserved and methodical side will be much praised and looked up to by others, you might even gain their support when in tense situations later on. 

^ The other way around is also true, if you don’t make the effort to learn how to control your anger and impulsivity.

^ You’ll have to work through some of your own intense emotions and urges in order to balance how you express your passionate energies, and will likely be well-respected, honored, accomplish great things and notoriety with age & time.


Mars Sextile North Node

✱ This aspect helps you tap into your inner strength and stamina making you bold and adventurous.

✱ You’re proactive, energetic and driven, you know what you want, and you won’t stop until you get it.

✱ You likely have a goal(s) in mind that feels like destiny, especially during your early years, that made you work towards attaining it/them.

✱ You don’t mind walking on uncharted territories, since you have an inner guidance that helps you take calculated risks and land safely on your feet.

✱ You are a born leader; your successes inspire others and hence you can gain fans/followers/supporters along the way.

✱ You are competitive, yet you are ahead of the game since your first competition is yourself and you always strive to be & do better than yesterday.

✱ Your physical stamina might also be really impressive, you might like to be involved in careers that demand you to be on your toes, to even work rigorous hours tirelessly.

✱ Your determination helps you bolt through obstacles and climb the mountains of success.

✱ You might be impulsive when you’re restless or anxious, but you also have the necessary inner balance to moderate yourself. 

✱ You’ll likely create breakthroughs, accomplish great things, inspire many people with your courage, garner acclaim & honor, and diligently make progress on your life purpose.



Mars Square North Node

□ This aspect brings the dangers of using Martian shadow side to the extremes.

□ You like to move forward with full momentum, but often might not consider the ups & downs of the journey ahead.

□ You are a great leader, but you might also need to moderate your tendency to be ‘recognized’ as a leader, since most people already know how incredible you’re and being too demanding to be known as so and so might only backfire and anger those who look up to you.

□ You might feel defensive when others oppose you, since you might assume that they are attacking you when in real they might just be expressing their opinions. So, you could end up creating conflicts even in otherwise peaceful conversations.

□ This can also be true in your personal relationships, where your demanding and relentless nature might go out of control and cause heart breaks.

□ You will have to realize that your innate sense of responsibility and determination are always recognized & admired by others. So, seeking validation in an aggressive & defensive way will only drive people away.

□ You might also have to understand when to take risks and when to wait for the right time, when to be methodical and when to make spontaneous decisions.

□ You will have to learn the important & painful lessons of containing your excess Martian energy, since it only causes more harm than good whenever you give-in to its intensity.

□ You’ll also have to keep your anger in check, especially when things don’t go your way. You’re a winner, but you’ll also have to develop humility from loses.

□ You’ll be able to create great accomplishments, since even in your setback & your successes, as long as you’re learning the lessons, you will keep elevating along your life path, reaching your biggest goals and attaining honors & notoriety.


Mars Opposite North Node

☍ You might not like taking spontaneous risks, even when you know what choices you need to make.

☍ You might wait too long or procrastinate or freeze in the moment of high tension.

☍ Your indecisions may cost you a lot of opportunities, since your fear of failure, or even fear of success might be holding you back from everything you wished for.

☍ As a result, you may have many regrets, and disappointments can pile up making you feel even more inadequate.

☍ You have innate-assertive and leadership qualities, that you might need a little bit more of self-confidence to fully embrace.

☍ You might eventually learn how to turn indecisions into patience, and procrastination into methodical approach.

☍ So your abilities to take calculated risks, steady focus and balanced approach will help you elevate in your career and general life.

☍ You are courageous and passionate; your self-awareness will help you reach greater heights on your life path eventually.

☍ You’ll likely be able to move past any setbacks or disappointments successfully and reach your goals.

☍ Your struggles & battles are usually inward, not many may know much about how you overcame some of the most tiring situations in your life, yet they will be able to recognize & admire your stamina and inner strength that you exude through all those triumphs.



Mars Conjunct North Node

☌ This NN aspect is one of the few most intense aspects ever. You’re a force to be reckoned with when you set out to pursue your true purpose in life.

☌ There’s a strong pull towards your destiny that makes you ecstatic and anxious all at the same time, opportunities line up every-time you feel ready for a new adventure.

☌ You’re driven and won’t stop until you reach your goals. There may be goals that are more like ambitions to you as well, making you take things seriously.

☌ You have immense inner mental & physical stamina, that allows you to work tirelessly towards your passions.

☌ Your career path might seem like a solo expedition to you but that might be one of the karmic lessons you have to learn, being independent and assertive, with a solid foundation of self and others.

☌ With Mars here, you might also have to face many challenges that may seem difficult at first, but you will effortlessly solve them with courage and determination.

☌ You might be seen as a strong competitor in your field of work, since you always seamlessly climb up the ladder. 

☌ You might be prone to anger, since you expect perfection and precision in your work, so working with you might be a little challenging to those who don’t have the same stamina as you do.

☌ Although to those that have the will and skills to keep up with you, you are an inspiration and a positive representation of a bold leader. So, you might like to work on your own, or where you can lead others forward.

☌ You’ll likely attain immense success, honor & acclaim, inspire others through your courage and accomplishments, make great strides in your career, and elevate on your life path through diligence and determination.


Mars Trine North Node

△ There’s a strong sense of destiny to your goals and ambitions, which motivates you to take them seriously.

△ You are focused and assertive, you also know when to be patient and methodical.

△ You’re a charming individual and most people look up to you for how courageously you move forward through life.

△ You enjoy working on your passions, you seem to attract opportunities that help you elevate even further on your life path.

△ You don’t mind challenging situations; you have enough humility to accept setbacks and enough determination to keep moving forward.

△ You know how to take calculated risks, which always brings the best out of you.

△ You are independent and assertive, but you might have also learnt how cooperation and teamwork can help you go further as of the many karmic lessons of this aspect, so you know how to make & sustain resource & influential connections.

△ You have tremendous amounts of inner and physical stamina, you might also like careers that demand endurance and a lot of physical activities.

△ You are bold and courageous, yet compassionate and friendly so, many might love to be in your company/work with you.

△ You’ll likely attain your ambitions, pave way for many incredible successes, inspire others through your boldness, gain respect & notoriety following your life path.

entry.title: Mars & Uranus Conjunction in Taurus 26° ⚡️✨ Great Positive Changes ignited by Intense Inner Passions • July 15, 2024
entry.content:
Mars and Uranus join forces in Taurus at 26° on July 15, 2024 making it their last Conjunction in Taurus together. Mars will start a two-year cycle with Uranus, marking the beginnings & completions of major projects, mainly tangible & practical in nature. The Conjunction also happens with Algol, the infamous Fixed Star of Disaster & Misfortune. This Conjunction will hence create a sense of panic and sets off negative events which later lead to a much brighter & prosperous future.


In your personal life, you can experience stress & anxiety to the extreme levels just a few days leading up to July 15th & right after. Mars & Uranus’s energies are too volatile for each other, fueling the passions & ambitions within you, but simultaneously creating overwhelm & tension. This can lead to physical & mental exhaustion, severe anxiety & panic attacks to say the least. You might wake up to a sudden change that shakes up your stability in life, either in finances or health. Your life can feel a little out of your control, affecting your sense of security. Calming your nerves will feel harder and harder the more you think about it. More over, stressful overthinking can lead you to sleepless nights & disrupt your daily routine.


On the other hand, there will be moments where you will feel completely in control of your mind & body, your life & ambitions alike. Sudden realizations & epiphanies can bring you wonderful insights with regards to your plans for the future. Your productivity can increase significantly. You might feel this intense inspiration to take on certain idealistic dreams & goals to make them a reality, one step at a time (the True Taurian way). You can surprise yourself with what you can do with this innately exhilarating energy. So, this all means that you don’t have the tolerance for any kind of outdated restrictions that may be holding you back. 


There is an almost primal need to release the past and pave a path to your future. Impulsive decisions can lead to disappointments, but intuitive decisions can lead to immense abundance. So please, do exercise caution and discern your moves carefully for at least the next few months. Since this happens to be the last Uranus x Mars Conjunction in Taurus before Uranus moves into Gemini in 2025, we will feel tempted to get to the finish line at top speed. Any Projects, Major Ambitions, etc. that we are currently completing or yet to begin New Ones will be on our “To-Do-ASAP-List” for the whole year, or at least to lay solid foundations now in order to revisit them in the near future. Pacing ourselves will make things much easier and help us direct all this wonderful momentum in the right direction.



Mars x Uranus Conjunction with Algol can indicate that a great source of karmic restriction in our personal life will be dispersed through sudden circumstances. This can be a toxic relationship, a troublesome contract, negative mindset, or even our own bad habits/patterns. Any restriction or overwhelming control on our life & ambitions will be released. Personal freedom, independence & sovereignty will be restored on a soul-level. There can be massive shake ups in life, especially in finances. It will all feel extremely chaotic and stressful. Spiritual abilities & intuition may be heightened during this time, along with a few health/routine changes. Globally, this can be a stressful time. Many sudden incidents, that seem extremely sudden & dangerous (to say the least) can shock (Mars x Uranus) us. But, if we stay a little patient & grounded, we can weather this storm of uncertainty, the looming darkness & overwhelm a bit more easily.


Pluto Retrograde can add to the immense anxiety; things/people/cycles from the past can come back around or bring back unpleasant memories. Stay strong, and take time-outs whenever necessary. The past will only revisit us now to be released out of our lives, and to test if we have learnt our lessons or not. It will be important not to get discouraged and also not to get too caught up with the uncertainties at hand right now, as they will all resolve favorably pretty soon. Memories or even situations that relate to past injustices can drudge up feelings of repressed anger, angst & sorrow. 


But, this Conjunction along with a Trine to Pluto in Rx (also Sextile Neptune in Rx) can urge us to face those feelings of anger & betrayal, and finally let it all go. To let Karma handle it all so that we can fully embrace our new life. This can hence be a powerful time of reinvention where your past hurt doesn’t define who you are now and ever again. You can take this opportunity to connect to your true inner self, untouched by trauma and anguish of the past. Taking back your Power from everything that has been holding you back and walking fearlessly on your destined path. Karmic ties & cycles broken, curses & trauma released.


Algol although creates disastrous situations, can also lead us to deep transformation. Any sense of overwhelm, stress or fear that we are faced with now will only take us through a process of awakening. Soon, the very stress & fear that overpowered us will be warded off by our own transformation. This is not an easy combination of energies to deal with, nonetheless, it is an extremely powerful time of change. Personal growth opportunities will push us into a whole new way of thinking & being. The shift in perspectives will help us find remarkable solutions to problems & situations that may have seemed puzzling & impossible before. Moving beyond the past and embracing the future will open up doors of abundance. ⚡️🗝️

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Virgo + 6th House 🐹✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Virgo +  6H  +  Mercury Aspects  +  6° 18°

LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You have the blessings of great Focus and Visualization. You have a sharp Intellect and can make the best use of your skills. You are also dedicated to your craft, causes and loved ones. You know how to make incredible works happen, since you can even calculate & handle all the details (no matter how big or small) all by yourself. You are also a good team player, you just need people who have the same work-ethic and passion as you do. So, it is not uncommon to meet people who only seem to cause troubles, but you can also meet those who perfectly fit into your career expectations. You can attract excellent friends, mentors & partners who support your dreams. 


You can also bring a community together to work towards a common cause. You voice your opinions very articulately, you can even inspire others to work for/with you. So, you make an excellent Co-worker, Boss, Business partner, etc. Furthermore, your down-to-earth, selfless, & humble demeanor can draw in many admirers of your character, elevating your Social status & respect. You might be blessed with an Innate Knowledge on medicine and so healing might come to you naturally. You can also find success in helping out the community with your knowledge & expertise. You can gain a lot of admirers who are often drawn to your ingenuity. You can be good at dealing with government related issues, documentation’s, legalities and bureaucracies since you can often be involved in those matters. So, you also seem to attract people who need your expertise, either as advise, suggestion or service. 


You can gain Notable Recognition and be respected by others, also have those who are thankful for your help/services. This Sirene placement can hence bring you opportunities to use your skills & knowledge towards positive causes, hence reaping Good Karma. This is a wonderful placement to be aware of, since though subtle and mundane, Sirene here can bring immense blessings, abundance & karmic rewards.



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You encounter people who are almost desperate to steal your work and peace. You likely come across people who don’t seem to understand the value of effort, dedication, and self-discipline. These are the kind of people who rely on other people’s honest hard work to get ahead in life. So, this can be thievery, plagiarism or even through enslavement. Hence, you will have to be cautious of such people especially in your career field. You can see them as bosses, managers, coworkers, or even as clients, patients, etc. In one way or another, they are able to first appeal to your kindness or earn your trust and then slowly start making more ‘requests’, which become ‘demands’ overtime. Sometimes subtle, other times blatant. 


This can also be someone who holds a favor they did for you over your head and expects a few in return. Hence, be cautious of any contract that you sign or laws & regulations that can be unfairly used against you. There is a real sense of threat to your sovereignty and honor when are dealing with these people as well, since they don’t seem to have strong morals themselves, at least not really even if they are pretentious. They don’t seem to know how to work as a team with mutual understanding & equal respect. This can be a difficult placement if you are in careers/situations that need your service, where you will have to be unconditionally available or empathetic as part of your job/relationship; such as a medic, civic duty officer, nurse, social worker, etc. / child to a parent, a parent to a child, taking care of (may be even sickly) relatives, spouse, siblings, etc. 


So, you will have to be vigilant of those who can play the victim all while exploiting your services, empathy or efforts. They may even use underhanded manipulative tactics, belittle your capabilities, harsh criticism, etc. Since there is a karmic element to this placement, you will also need to understand the value of what you can offer to the world, and not underestimate your own accomplishments. ‘Not letting others to be entitled to your time, hard work & rewards while they disrespect, exploit and/or belittle you’, this will likely be a painful yet Empowering lesson in your life.

entry.title: New Moon in Taurus 25° + Mars & Chiron Conjunction in Aries 28° 🌑♉️🌷 May 16, 2026
entry.content:
Lovely Taurus New Moon 🌿

🌱 The lovely New Moon in Taurus illuminates the Inner World and establishes Peace & Serenity.

🌱 As the New Moon sweeps through the celestial sky, it removes the unseen Karmic Blockages & undetermined fears in our lives (especially in the House where Taurus sits in your Natal Chart).

🌱 If you are feeling anxious, uncertain, restricted & closed in, even after Uranus’s ingress into Gemini, the 🌑 will help clean out the residue of mess & unrest that Uranus in Taurus Transit left us with.

🌱 Events that ‘loosen you up’ in areas you felt stuck in, ‘solidify’ where you felt uncertain in, and ‘revitalize’ in areas where you felt lack in: will surround you during the next two weeks.


Mars & Chiron Conjunction in Aries 🌷

🌱 Mars & Chiron meet in an exact Conjunction on the New Moon making a wonderful Sextile with Venus in Gemini. 

🌱 Balancing your Inner Divine Feminine & Healing your Inner Divine Masculine will become a conscious & easeful process now. 

🌱 The combined energies of the Conjunction & New Moon mark the end of healing: self-doubt, fear of failure & inadequacy, lack of motivation and feeling out of control over one’s own life & direction.

🌱 Revitalizing your Confidence, Inner Strength, Resilience, Passion & Purpose in Life.

🌱 This can not only bring peace within, but also harmony in a very significant Relationship(s) that may have been rattled by unexpected events in the recent years. Strengthening such bonds and re-establishing Love, Stability & Security in them will feel natural & healing now.


New Moon + Algol 🍃

🌱 As the New Moon occurs (very) close to the infamous Fixed Star Algol, this can be a tumultuous time for most relationships, especially those that are unhealthy (on the mild side) or destabilizing & disruptive to peace (on the extreme side).

🌱 The last Scorpio Full Moon might have triggered certain unpleasant events that may have taken you into a deep self-reflection & analyzation mode. 

🌱 There may have been triggers that either caused you or someone else to “loose their head” for no apparent reason, creating unnecessary conflict & distress. 

🌱 The 🌑 hence will bring much needed clarity, to wisely handle one’s own Shadow and that of others (or if it’s worth it to deal with them at all). 

🌱 Keeping your cool, being diplomatic and respectful even in the midst of conflict will now be vital to protecting yourself & the foundations that you have built in your life.

🌱 As to how others handle their Shadow will likely also get you rethinking your relationship with them. Since, anyone who “flies off the handle”, is unstable and indulges in emotional outbursts & tantrums (for whatever reason) may feel as a threat to the safety, security & stability of your Life.

🌱 So, look out for opportunities (especially if you feel Intuitively guided) to free yourself from Karmic Cycles, Patterns & even Dynamics that feel unstable & unsupportive of who you are, what you truly value and the kind of Legacy you are creating in your life.

🌱 On a personal note, Handling unexpected crisis situations with a clear mind and decisiveness will save you from otherwise getting lost in the confusion and losing important opportunities to find timely solutions.

🌱 Manage high levels of anxiety & stress. If necessary, Medical Attention for Severe Headaches. 


New Moon + Revival of Prosperity & Hope 🌿

🌱 You will feel more grounded and lighter within. Ease into comfort and peace. Self Love + Self Care. 

🌱 Re/visit Projects & Ideas that you wish to “get off the ground”. Make worthy long-term plans & investments that increase your Confidence, Stability & Abundance. 

🌱 This 🌑 will present the much needed ease & Positivity to reinvent yourself, to re-embrace your core values and re-establish your wants, needs & desires as both Affirmations and Priorities.

🌱 Focus back on the fundamentals of You.

🌱 Plant the Golden Seeds of Prosperity, Love, Balance & Serenity to cultivate long term Abundant Resources & Legacy, Comfort & Ease, Happiness & Bliss for yourself and your loved ones. 


xo

Sharpening your skills & intuition, working on your self-confidence & concentration, learning to be consistent & organized, using negotiation & innate people skills, cultivating patience & wisdom, etc. will be some of the things that can help you understand your strengths and your true purpose in life.
