entry.title: Mars & Jupiter Conjunction in Gemini + Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Moon & Venus form a Grand Cross in the Heavens • Aug 14, 2024 ❤️‍🔥🕊️
entry.content:
With the Four Heavenly Guardians overlooking the transformations happening right in front of us, the events that are sparking ambers of great change will soon become wild fires of transformation before quelling down. On Aug 14, 2024 we witness Mars joining forces with Jupiter in Gemini 16° along with the Royal Star Aldebaran (Gemini 10°) who will add strength to the already intense Square between Saturn & Jupiter, there by also activating Fomalhaut (Pisces 4°). 


Venus in Virgo 12° enters the Square Down by Opposing Saturn in Pisces Rx 17° and simultaneously Squaring Mars & Jupiter, not to forget Moon in Sagittarius (on Aug 14) thereby activating Antares in Sagittarius 10°. While these three Royal Stars are activated by the Grand Cross, Regulus (Virgo 0°) is activated by Mercury in Rx & Sun in Leo. So, that accounts for all the Four Royal Fixed Stars in Astrology taking center stage during one the most Powerful Aspects of 2024. 


Saturn in Pisces (as expected) is trying to bring up major issues which are disrupting Jupiter’s stay in Gemini. This intense Square of Jupiter & Saturn (which will continue until Jan 2025) is further agitated by Mars’s Conjunction with Jupiter in Gemini (thereby Squaring Saturn). Hence, the Saturn x Jupiter Square will remain an impactful force of change and catharsis in our lives. All around the world, there are major signs of agitation and other times there is blatant chaos. In everything, discernment will be a key factor indeed. Distractions are numerous, confusion will be rampant, yet everything will come to light eventually.


Governments, Institutions, Systemic Structures of Societies: Saturn will clash with Jupiter: the Ideological, Moral, Judicial, Expansive View Points of people as a whole. Migrant/Immigrant population, Refugees, Medical Services, Medical Workers, Vulnerable sections of Society, (also Criminals): Pisces along with the Local/Indigenous Residents, Students, Artists, Journalists, Communities, Financial Sectors: Gemini will be majorly affected for the next 5-6 months. Mars in Gemini can take things to either extremes very quickly now. This Mars x Jupiter Conjunction is particularly volatile in nature since as mentioned, all the Four Royal Stars are activated at the same time. 


Moon in Sagittarius on the day of the Mars x Jupiter Conjunction and a day later when Mars makes a 0° orb Square to Saturn will keep us all on our toes. Even the most patient people can lose their cool. There will be a destabilizing atmosphere with regards to Global events. With this particular Jupiter x Saturn Square (+ Mercury Rx) it is extremely important not to jump into conclusions, as understandable as it may seem since things can change at the spur of the moment and those in the middle of (any) issue can feel compelled to take immediate actions. Emotions will run high, there will be an eruption of anger & other suppressed emotions, this will also fuel the division on who is right and who is wrong.



Venus in Virgo will simultaneously make an Opposition & Squares to Jupiter x Mars, which indicates that it can seem almost impossible to find common ground and negotiate for peace. On the other hand, events can prompt us to demand for justice (Pallas Athena is in Scorpio my darlings, with a blooming Full Moon in Aquarius just around the corner on Aug 19). Things can go out of hand very very fast. Although Moon in Sagittarius helps form a Grand Cross for a moment (for about a day), it will give us both the ability to see things from a higher perspective and to make sense of the situation at hand. 


After Moon moves along on her journey towards the Aquarius (Super) Full Moon, we will be left with the T-Square of Venus x Mars x Jupiter x Saturn. No matter how this heavenly T-Square affects you, the only advise that I can offer is to take things only as seriously as you can, since I fully understand that it will be hard not to at all. Paranoia can easily cloud judgement, whether it is justified or not. This is hence a time of great confusion & uncertainty. Allowing things to play out will not be an easy process, yet things can seem out of everybody’s control right now, so this time period can demand & force us to sit on the edge of our seats and await for Karmic Justice to play out. This is however a great time for all kinds of revelations, which will come around the Aquarius Full Moon creating another Grand Cross of Super Full Moon, Pallas Athena, Sun, Mercury & Uranus in the Fixed Signs. 


On a personal level you are likely feeling a little more anxious than usual, insomnia & fatigue can also become frequent. You might have been overwhelmed and spirally down a train of obsessive & intrusive thoughts without even realizing it. You might have a lot of trouble keeping up with your everyday life & tasks. It will be harder to take care of yourself (both Mentally & Physically), but it can also alert on how your past patterns & habits may be affecting you now, making it hard to grasp onto your everyday routines. Life can feel a little too out of your control right now. So, take time to reflect yet give yourself breaks from rethinking your past, which can help you stay balanced mentally. Your mental health will have to be your biggest priority, since your physical health can take a hit otherwise.


(I wish to clarify that I am not writing this based on any specific matter currently in our world, but rather from a collective understanding. I wanted to share this since everywhere I see there is one sensitive & egregious matter after another, which has frankly overwhelmed me and so I understand that compassion for each other is what we need more than ever. I write this from a purely Astrological Interpretation. So, I intend only Peace & Resolution to all of us regardless of how these times are affecting us. More strength, luv & light to you all. 🥹🫂💕)


The Four Guardians of the Sky are hence paying close attention to every-single-thing happening here both Globally & Personally. No injustice will go unnoticed. No intentional or unintentional sabotage to the process will be successful (hence rest assured that justice & truth will prevail). So, we are living in the historical times that will be remembered for years to come, whatever issues/incidents/events take place now will affect our futures immensely, not just individually but also as a collective. Hence, no matter how grim it all seems now, stay strong in your belief & faith (since this is beyond religion, spirituality, or politics; but more on humanity & unity of our communities). This is especially helpful now as nothing will seem stable, predictable or decisive. Uncertainty & Civil Unrest will be rampant (at least until the end of Aug) which can shroud our ability to see beyond the confusion. 


Make your best efforts to avoid accidentally or unknowingly falling for the misinformation (of any kind) right now. Avoiding Social Media & limiting your time on the screen for a while can also be a major help. Form stronger bonds with your loved ones, handle personal conflicts with grace (as much as possible). This dark cloud of confusion will soon disperse, and we will be able to find fairness & justice (no matter what it is that we are dealing with & where we are in the world). There is hope, there will be light. May the ambers of change burn deep inside you & elevate you on your life path. ❤️‍🔥🕊️

An otherwise excellent time for self-reflection & self-love. Venus finally out of the Rx will help soothe any doubts, misunderstandings, or fears concerning certain soulful connections. entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Sagittarius + 9th House 🐆✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Sagittarius + 9H + Jupiter Aspects + 9° 21° 🐆✨


LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You are an intellectual, you like to delve into things head-first. Whether it is academic or artistic, you have a clear view of what your calling in life is. You are able to gain recognition for your work and become quite accomplished in life. Others look up to you with amazement whenever they see you following your Heart’s Desires & Soul’s Path. This can be a Popularity placement, very much so on a Grander scale. Your words in guidance can be very inspiring, so a lot of people will seek your advice, expertise & in general your support. Your generosity, optimism & happy-go-lucky attitude can be so mesmerizing to others. 


Religion, especially Philosophies around the world can attract your interest. So, you are likely drawn towards learning about theology, mythology & philosophy from different cultures. You also like to explore the world through traveling. Your own culture & religion can bring you a Sense of Purpose and grounding, along with exploring other cultures. Politics and Law can interest you as well, academically and socially. So, you can gain a lot of knowledge and sound-wisdom about a vast number of studies & fields. Wonder & wander can bring you many unexpected experiences and opportunities. 


You are innately lucky, so you can draw more Luck, Abundance, Blessings & Good Karma towards you through your virtue & morals. Your optimistic-outlook on life can help you weather any storm as you keep moving forward with faith & hope. The ‘World is truly your oyster’, so exploring it with your Intuitive Knowledge can lead you towards your True Dreams. You can achieve your Highest Ideals in life and inspire many. Truly believe in your own Inner Guide & Inner Mentor to lead you towards your Life’s Purpose and hence also Great Abundance & Immense Success. This is a wonderful Sirene placement to envision, manifest & work for success in all areas of life.



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You encounter people who are somehow obsessed with your Charismatic personality, and wish to have what you have. They can see you as extremely lucky & blessed in life, and so become envious of your successful, peaceful & wondrous life. They may attempt to lead you astray from your Life’s Blessings, Opportunities & essentially your Life Purpose through all kinds of distractions. This can be through unfair criticism, bad advise & even unnecessary arguments/challenges. They can literally lead you into a trap or misguide you in order to keep you from ever succeeding. 


Your open mindedness can also get you into trouble if you are not being careful about who can influence you with what kind of information or narrative. Such people may seem quite knowledgeable about things that you are interested in, but they can easily misguide & misinform you. They may wish to see you missing out on important opportunities or even give you the wrong advice. They can also try to limit your Movement & Progress in Life, by preventing you from exploring New Possibilities & Understanding other Perspectives. So, they can mainly play with your mind, and your ability to explore your own True Potential. There will be lessons to not compromise your morals under anybody’s influence. You being authentic to yourself and standing firmly on your standards & morals in life can help you detangle yourself from their mess and to also deter such people in general. 


You might even learn a lesson or two on why not to be generous with your time, resources & effort to just about anybody & everybody, since there will always be people who are willing to do anything & everything to distract you while robbing you of your positivity & hope. You must be vigilant of those who are willing to do anything in order to bring you down, discourage, loose your hope, faith & optimism, etc. You will also have to be careful not to fall for others’ schemes & lies, especially when they only talk about their Grand Plans for their life, yet don’t really follow up with making their own Visions come true.

entry.title: Natal Midheaven MC and North Node Aspects 🌍✨
entry.content:
Midheaven (MC) Trine North Node

△ One of the very few fortunate MC aspects, with many amazing accomplishments in store for your professional life.

△ It may be easy for you to tap into your true potential, and one of the many ways to do that could be through your career.

△ Since MC is in harmonious aspect to NN, MC being the highest point on the chart, this aspect could easily indicate Fame, that goes hand-in-hand with your career achievements.

△ There may be an element of destiny in your career path.

△ Your dedication and faith can lead you further in life with ease and little to no controversy (given that there aren’t other problematic aspects to say otherwise).

△ There may be a spiritual quality to your personality and your work that seems to draw a lot of people’s admiration.

△ People in positions of power and authority may have your back and support you on your path. 

△ You might easily get into positions of power and authority eventually (sometimes much sooner than expected) and be guided to fulfil bigger responsibilities. 

△ This aspect also indicates that you can be aware of your purpose in life and know how to better serve your role from a very young age.


Midheaven (MC) Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ You might have had to choose your career path with the primary purpose of emergency or duty and not much from your own will or choice, or at-least that’s how it might have felt.

^ With time, you will discover your passion for the path you have chosen and begin to come to terms with it.

^ You might feel that you don’t feel inspired enough or are capable of handling the responsibilities you agreed to take on.

^ There may be a sense of confusion or anxiety that takes over while pursing your career path early on.

^ You may have to heal the parts of your that makes you feel unworthy or unmotivated, to progress further in your career and life in general.

^ Since what you thought was an obligation or as uninspiring might actually be your true calling in life which could help you achieve many things beyond your imagination.

^ You might have to work diligently and with much more dedication than others, which will eventually help you attain recognition & well-deserved respect. 

^ Your humility, charitable endeavors, down-to-earth personality, even your guiding skills will earn you much fame.



Midheaven (MC) Conjunct North Node

☌ A beautiful NN-MC aspect, nonetheless a rather difficult SN to deal with.

☌ You were born with a strong sense of destiny.

☌ Your early life could have been productive regardless of if it was stable or not, since you always knew that you were being guided by unforeseen events and forces towards a greater purpose in life.

☌ Your intuitive and spiritual side will help you further your career in many ways and keep you grounded throughout the ups & downs.

☌ Being opposite IC, it may be difficult to break away from your comfort-zone.

☌ You might have inner feelings of stage-fright which easily disappears once you make up your mind.

☌ Your family/home life can seem confining, regardless, you will find a sense of peace there whenever you feel overwhelmed. 

☌ Although there may be a danger of family taking advantage of your success/money/recognition (with other similarly troubling aspects). Either way, you might find it hard to leave what is familiar to you at first and may also have to overcome depression or other mental health issues stemming from subconscious fears about the future.

☌ You might find many destined opportunities to ascend through the career ladder much faster and gain immense recognition and fame.

☌ Your professional achievements may be viewed with high regard by others.

☌ One of the gifts of this aspect is that you are aware of your talents, and you may intuitively know how to work on your passions & find support from authority figures/affluential people.

☌ You may very well achieve many incredible things in life, including wealth and fame with every dedicated passion-project you pursue.


Midheaven (MC) Square North Node

□ A harsh-reality-check-aspect, a difficult journey, with immense rewards at the end.

□ There may be a lot of setbacks, disappointments, dead-end situations that you may have to face in your professional/career life early on.

□ A lot of satisfaction may be found through family-affairs, home life, and being grounded in oneself than in focusing solely on career/work.

□ This does not mean, to give up a professional life, or become a home/family person, but to strike a perfect work-life balance, and to stay humble yet assertive in both home & career lives, and not to ever get completely engulfed in either aspects of your life, which means workaholism or extreme procrastinations are both not recommended if you truly wish to find fulfilment in life.

□ It is important to know where the NN is placed in this aspect, since, usually it is either conjunct Asc or Dsc and the clues as to how to negate this aspect lies there.

□ Ex, if your NN is in 1H, you may have to work on your self-esteem and walk your life path independently, whereas, if NN is in 7H, you may have to learn cooperation, and build healthy partnerships who will better support & guide you in your career life.

□ So, with this MC x NN aspect, (and in Opposition aspect), there is a clear need to follow ones' NN and make your career choices based on the paths that align well with your NN than to solely rely on the MC/10H.

□ Whenever you face roadblocks, you will have to re-assess your choices/decisions without getting discouraged or caught-up in your ego.

□ Moreover, since NN is squaring both MC & IC, you will have to rely on your NN. If you follow your inner-callings/intuition (NN), instead of your ego (MC) and/or your family's (if any) restrictive expectations (IC), you will find many fulfilling career opportunities which not only may elevate your social status (MC) and satisfy your family (IC) in the long run, but also help follow your spiritual life-purpose (NN). Creating Win-win situations out of roadblocks. 



Midheaven (MC) Sextile North Node

✱ One of the fortune MC aspects, with many blessings.

✱ You are extremely professional, yet humble in your approach to life.

✱ Recognition and fame come to you naturally, each career advancement is noticed and well-appreciated by others.

✱ Your career path(s) is always something that inspires you deeply and holds a much spiritual importance than that of just satisfying the ego.

✱ Your determination takes you to greater heights with ease, and you will remain humble without being tainted by power.

✱ Destined opportunities will help you elevate in the world; your dedication will win the support of those in higher positions.

✱ Your work may be inspiring to others.

✱ This aspect can also indicate fame and popularity, with a good social standing.


Midheaven (MC) Opposite North Node

☍ This aspect can be overwhelming to some (depending on other aspects in the chart), since regardless of how many or if there are any placements in the 10H/conjunct MC, you’re always longing to establish yourself in the world, and to find a purpose to fulfil in life, which with this aspect can become a little difficult to recognize & follow one's true calling. Since ones’ ego and sense of pride (MC) is muddled with uncertainty and feelings of general dissatisfaction no matter how much effort is put into it. 

☍ With other aspects encouraging this, a sense of urgency in attaining power or career recognition may become a detriment to your public image.

☍ Generally, you may have to assess and realign your passions to a much personal/private sense and be grounded in your approach before diving head-first into your career path(s).

☍ Also, there may be a danger of mental health issues and general dissatisfaction in life to self-sabotage your career life.

☍ If your family/childhood life was uncertain/insecure in the past, you may have to work on establishing that stability which will further help you pursue your life-purpose.

☍ This being one of the key aspects in the chart, life-lessons may be harsh and anything you do/say without grounding yourself or solving your subconscious issues will likely be detrimental to your professional life.

☍ You may be prone to pessimism and negative projection.

☍ You will be forced to humble yourself, and approach life with a positive mindset, until which distractions and other destined events will keep affecting your public image.

☍ For example, the lessons could even come to you as fame & fortune, where you’ll be handed opportunities, but you might feel compelled to act out of character due to all the triggers that may come with those opportunities, eventually sabotaging both your career path(s) & your reputation.

☍ When you do muddle through all the lessons, you will find many rewards with each cycle you complete, helping you further in your life.

entry.title: Venus Conjunct Uranus & Jupiter in Taurus • May 18th & 23rd, 2024 🍀✨
entry.content:
Now you can also find me on YouTube. If you like learning more about Astrology with me, do subscribe to my YouTube channel 🥰

Here’s the video for Venus Conjunct Uranus & Jupiter in Taurus • May 18th & 23rd, 2024 🍀✨


We recently had a Jupiter - Uranus Conjunction in Taurus at 21°. Now, we will have Venus & Uranus Conjunction at 23°, followed by a Venus & Jupiter Conjunction at 29°. May has been a wonderful month with many activations to the recent Jupiter - Uranus Conjunction: First, the New Moon in Taurus that happened on May 8th, then Sun Conjunct Uranus that happened on May 13th, later Venus Conjunct Uranus that happened on May 18th. So there is a lot of Taurian Goodness in the air. With that also comes a touch of extravagance, the need for comfort, sometimes even luxury. This can make us all more concentrated on our stability, especially our Financial Stability. 


But, it can also make a little bit too restless and feeling a little ungrounded (especially since Pluto is Retrograde in Aquarius right now). We are already seeing the instabilities happening in the global economy, which can either make us a little too cautious in how we are spending our money, or it can do the opposite (with Uranus in the mix). It can make us spend a lot more money than we were planning on. Venus Conjunct Uranus in Taurus is a very tricky aspect. Around the last 10 days of May, there will be this urge and desire to buy new things. Even if it is not something as drastic as impulsive online shopping, it can still bring out these feelings of goodness & stability somehow. But, it can also make us loose track of our budget very easily. Before we know it, we might be burning holes in our pockets. This is indeed a very risky energy to deal with. Of course, make allowances for some splurging. It is a good time to splurge on ourselves & our loved ones (Taurus Season ♡. But, a bit of caution can help us a lot). It is a wonderful time for online shopping, purchasing tech related things, and upgrading your whole entire lifestyle in a way. But, make sure that you are not spending a little too much or loosing track of all your purchases. 


Try not to make major commitments & investments without thinking things through. (! This is not me trying to fear monger or point fingers 🤗!). But, it is advised to take calculated risks right now, instead of jumping into things that seem exciting & adventurous. (All I’m saying is…) Taking calculated risks will be a lot more feasible than making big promises to even yourself. It’s that Jupiter energy!!! Particularly, with the Venus & Jupiter Conjunction that is happening right around the end of May. Jupiter can bring out this exaggerated amounts of confidence in oneself & others. Even if you are dealing with Business Partners or Acquaintances who seem to be promising a lot but don’t have much to bring to the table just yet. Maybe, believe in them but not if you already don’t have a trusting relationship with them.


This is a very tricky (ik, it bares repeating) alignment of planets, especially in Taurus. Since, Taurus doesn’t appreciate uncertainty, and definitely not impracticality. So, maybe a bit of assuredness in your own words & actions, also expecting the same from others will do you a lot of wonders, all while giving you that sense of stability & certainty (rather than the guessing game, or “do you trust me or don’t you” kind of back & forth). Things will improve as Pluto makes a good Trine to Jupiter in Gemini and comes back into Aquarius by the end of this year. But… until then, maybe it’s best not to make really big commitments (financially) around this time. Just be a little too cautious & mindful of who you are partnering up, and what kind of risks are you willing to take. Since, these are kind of desperate times for all of us (and I understand the urge to find that sense of stability). Uranus will transit in Taurus until July 2025, so these financial instabilities happening on a global scale can bring up fears & insecurities, that can drive us into a little (uk) risk taking behaviors. 



So, as important advise: make long term goals, they will give a lot more reassurance and also purpose. Specifically, plan your financial goals keeping in mind a timeline until July 2025, since it’s amazing how Venus will make a Conjunction with Jupiter at the end of May (May 23, 2024) and a Conjunction with Uranus next year on July 4th, 2025. Those Conjunctions happen at 29° of Taurus, which is quite special, since those are the last Conjunctions of Venus to Jupiter & Uranus individually before they move into Gemini. Both of these (exact) Conjunctions happen at 29° of Taurus, which is a special degree in and of itself, since it relates to Leo. Hence, make BIG Plans and work on them, you will have all the resources that you need. There is so much prosperity ahead. This moth is quite special, with so many things happening in Taurus along with so many activations happening in Taurus. 


There is just, a great potential to manifest your dreams & desires now. Things may seem a little stagnant or delayed, or even feel a little difficult in the beginning, the road initially might seem a little bumpy. But, things will get on track relatively soon. So, keep executing your plans. Take your time, go as slow as you want, or speed up when you feel it’s the best thing to do. With Mars & North Node Conjunction (along with Chiron) happening in Aries around the same time, there is So much potential to explore especially when it comes to finances. Direct your focus towards your financial goals and plan wisely (has to be said, with Jupiter & Uranus in the mix). Karmic blessings will come your way as well. Since, every-time Jupiter leaves a sign & enters another sign, he tends to give massive Karmic Rewards (by next July in 2025 we can expect the same from Uranus). So, manifest to your heart’s content. 


If you have ideas & plans to invest in things that grow overtime, like your business or your career, even your lifestyle. Things that just improve you & your life as a whole; Things that get you closer to your goals, then that’s excellent since this Venus’s Conjunction to Uranus & Jupiter brings the very best out of us. Being resourceful will be a lot more easier around this time, and the results that we get out of these actions & the productivity that comes out of these inspired actions will be incredible (overtime). So, even if these are just ideas to invest, improve or to put your efforts towards things that seem long term, that grow with time & give back to you, and multiply overtime; Then, please go ahead, work on them, plan as much as you feel comfortable and take action. Since, this energy will keep pushing you towards taking that action. So, you’ll likely be a little restless & enthusiastic.


Dream big and outlandishly, yet be a little careful with your spending, earning & budgeting. This is going to be a major turnaround for all of us, although the fruits of our labor will come a little late, we will just have to wait & be patient for all the good things that are on their way towards us. 

 

This season, 

Optimism + Caution + Conscious Decisions = Luck + Prosperity. 🍀✨

entry.title: Mercury Retrograde Guide : Handle Mercury Rx with Ease 🐰✨
entry.content:
Mercury is the planet of communication, travel, trade & commerce in Astrology. When in Retrograde, Mercury tends to affect these themes of our life immensely given how close the planet is to us. The damage this Retrograde can do within just a span of about 15 days (for almost three times a year) is hence astounding. Okay, I’m being dramatic 😉😂😌 but it’s still one of the most influential Retrogrades of the year, affecting our everyday life in unthinkable ways. 

Let’s look at some of the things to DO and NOT to Do during a Mercury Rx to make sure we don’t stumble along our way during this rather important Transit.


Signing Important Contracts and/or Documents

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : This is one of the most famous advice many Astrologers give during a Mercury Rx. Since any Document & Contract you sign now can have a significant impact on you (be it mentally, emotionally or financially), signing or agreeing to them during this Transit can be a little risky. You might miss out on important details, misread or even misinterpret. This can also be vice versa, where the other person might misunderstand the details, etc. If you are not careful you might end up with a bad deal, rush into things that you didn’t think through, fall into a trap (like a scam), or you just might not want to commit to it in the long run. You might also be wise not to apply for important documentation or verification works in government, organizations and/or banking services during this Rx, since the process can take excruciatingly long time or even get delayed significantly. 

➕ Do Instead : Try to Postpone signing / agreeing to any official agreement. If you have been discussing and working on it for quite some time before the Rx began, then you might not have many problems, except for a few detail revisions & checks here and there. So, if possible consider postponing the official signing process or if you have been working on it for a while you can take some time to check every detail and once you are confident enough, you can sign / agree to it during the Rx. Make sure that you are giving yourself the time to think & rethink, try not rush into anything or let anybody else rush you into a decision (might be a Red Flag, just saying). Assess the details, future plans & implications, etc. and you will be just fine.


Traveling 

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : Sudden travel plans can be stressful & tricky during Mercury Rx. You are likely to face problems like issues in your vehicle (that you have either previously known or didn’t), reservation of tickets or bookings being unexpectedly cancelled or delayed, booking the wrong flight or misreading the timings, etc. If you ride/drive by yourself you will need to be a little more vigilant during your travels since you might run into issues, either from someone else or just unexpectedly. 

➕ Do Instead : Be as careful as you can be while traveling. Make sure you have all your documentations, fuel tank full, vehicle checked for issues, being extra vigilant on the road etc. If you are traveling by other means, make sure to give yourself the time to properly plan & prepare. Double check tickets & other reservations. If possible, book ahead of time and read through all the necessary information carefully. Leave ahead of time, being early is much better than late during Mercury Rx, that way you will have enough extra time to deal with any issues that may arise. 


Productivity 

Since Mercury is the Planet of everyday activities, it also represents our swiftness, accuracy & overall productivity.

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : During Rx however, we can expect a general decline in productivity of both our daily activities & career related projects. There will be many chances to make mistakes, skip important steps, or forget details that can lead to mishaps. Even small missteps can become huge issues during this time. 

➕ Do Instead : It is usually advised to slow things down, as much as possible in both our personal & professional lives during Mercury Rx. Efficiency & accuracy will become more important than just swiftness. Since, even with wisdom and years of expertise, you can still take precautions not to let small mishaps derail big projects or to let simple issues become complex, because this can be an illusive time where even the best of us can stumble. So, it is advised to focus on one thing at a time, also to avoid multi-tasking since it can easily make you feel burdened during this transit. Delay starting New Projects & Ventures. 


Leisure + Rest

Over-thinking, stress & anxiety levels can rise during this Rx, affecting your mental & physical health. You may be prone to taking on more than you can handle. You might even feel the need to over-compensate in stressful situations, but all that may be counter-productive and can easily over-whelm you if you are not careful.

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : Hence, you may be prone to experiencing mind fog, mental burnouts, high-anxiety and chronic health issues now more than ever.

➕ Do Instead : You can take this time to re-strategize and re-organize your life in simple ways to de-stress yourself. If you can, you are advised to take on much less work than you usually do, giving you the room to both work well with the delays and also not to overload your schedules. You can certainly also take some time off to just do things that bring you joy, simple things that light up your day. Hobbies, art, music, reading, writing, etc. that can help you relax in a mindful way can help you stay grounded & refreshed, avoiding the mental & physical burnout.


Technology 

Mercury being the Planet of Communication & Finances is most frequently noted for how its Rx can affect our Technology based & dependent lifestyle.

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : You can expect minor to major disruptions in social media, servers, internet services, softwares, applications, etc. Much like delays in travels & documentations, etc. you may be wise to expect delays and hiccups in technologies that you use. Your smartphone, laptops or tablets may freeze or have a sudden issue with bugs & updates; you might forget to save an important document/project that you are working on or even delete important files by accident, send the wrong message/email to a different person; a device you use everyday may suddenly need to be repaired or even replaced; set the wrong alarms or reminders; etc. Looking back, Mercury Rxs may have been the time for some of the most bizarre incidents, delays & issues that you had to face, things you may have never imagined could go wrong. You can also see such instances playing out in others’ lives. So, at the very least Mercury Rxs often bring wonderfully strange life lessons.

➕ Do Instead : You will need to be alert about all the important devices you use during Mercury Rx. You may have to be prepared to replace/repair something (that you might have known to have issues with before). Make sure to double check all the significant software updates and server/internet connections. Back-up important files, save projects and re-check multiple times just to be sure. Avoid deleting files during this time, even if you are sure, just in case you might need them again. Re-check who you are sending messages & emails to, pay attention to even the grammar, since miscommunications are very likely. 


Finances

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : It is wise to avoid big purchases during Mercury Rx, as it can either lead to the loss of precious Money due to defects, scam, missing the wrong details (sizes, quantity, quality, etc.) and so on. Impulse buying can also lead to regrets often. Online Shopping especially can be tricky, as the process can get dragged & delayed, there are chances for mistakes in delivery time/date/address. Hence, it is not uncommon to have unpleasant experiences in shopping during Mercury Rxs. Lending or borrowing money can be tricky as well, so be extra careful in such matters, likewise in investments. 

➕ Do Instead : If you can avoid putting down advances or investments on really big ventures like a loan, car, house, etc. until Mercury Rx ends, it will be much less risky & stressful, also more likely successful. Make sure you are patient & detail oriented during any kind of purchase. Always recheck how much you are paying (& receiving), the bank/bill details, etc. Also if you have suspicions of being hacked or tracked in anyway, follow your instincts and take necessary precautions. Being a little too cautious around Money (and belongings) during Mercury Rx will always be very helpful, avoiding unnecessary stress and possibly a huge financial threat.



Communications

Mercury Rx often provides the opportunity to understand ourselves & each other through difficult & sometimes awkward situations involving communication. This is often the time when everybody is misreading everyone else in one way or another. So, to have obvious miscommunications is one of the primary effects of Mercury Rx.

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : This can mean that there is a high chance of misinterpretation, misunderstanding and confusion. You can expect to feel a little less attentive, experience brain fog, replay awkward/embarrassing situations in your mind, to revisit the past in your thoughts, etc. There is often an introspective vibe to all Retrogrades, hence it is common to experience that with Mercury Rx as well. This can also mean that we can be a lot more sensitive to triggers, mood swings & occasional depressions as well. So, conflicts & verbal confrontations with others can be excepted. Maintaining harmony in relationships (personal & professional) can hence prove to be rather difficult. 

➕ Do Instead : This Rx can bring disruption in the flow of our everyday lives, but it can also give us the opportunity to break certain cycles & patterns in our communication & thought-process. You can use this period to understand & reevaluate certain mindsets and to reprogram your thoughts. You can process memories & thoughts that you may have suppressed in the past. Misunderstandings in relationships can reveal hidden intentions & confusions, allowing you the opportunity to reevaluate those relationships. You will be able to analyze your own strengths & flaws in communication, which can better allow you to change/adjust. 


Past Relationships

Infamously, Exes usually tend to come back during Mercury Rx, if not physically at-least through calls, texts, etc. Sometimes you may see them even in dreams & sudden memories, so you can except them to remember you, whether they choose to contact you or not. (This can also include friends, acquaintances & family members that you may not have been in contact with for a long time.)

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : This is a personal decision, so you can choose to contact someone from your past, or be open to Talking to them if they happen to contact you first. But as an advise, if you have a clear reason as to why you don’t wish to engage with somebody, you might be tested during this Rx to stand firm on your decisions. Mercury is often also seen as a mischievous planet, so those who play mental tricks can have a strong negative Mercury influence in their chart. Hence, Mercury Rxs can often bring back people who have such tendencies, as a special test/lesson designed for you . Even if its not as serious, the feelings of nostalgia that arise during Mercury Rx can often be superficial in certain situations, hence can be regarded only as a curiosity or desperation to reconnect just for the sake of it. That is usually the reason why most ‘make-ups’ during Mercury Rxs don’t seem to work out after a month or so.

➕ Do Instead : On the other hand, this can bringup chances to reconcile differences, misunderstandings, etc. and may be even to bridge the gap (again, given that you know their true character and feel intuitively drawn to re-connect with them). It is often a good time to re-connect with long-time friends & relatives. Kindred connections can reunite during this Rx bringing back nostalgia and fond memories. So if you really wish to, be cautious (uk, just in case) as to whether or not a reconnection during Mercury Rx is genuine & worth the effort or not, you can test its validity until at-least a month after the end of Mercury Rx, where if you still feel the relationship getting stronger & better, you will know it was the right choice. The same can be true if you choose not to reconnect or to completely end a relationship during Mercury Rx, since if you do so with the certainty of your intuition & reasoning, you will be able to close out that relationship karmically once and for all.


Delays

Mercury is an extremely adaptable energy in Astrology, and so during its Rx that ability can dull down significantly. Delays x Detours, Rejections x Redirections; can become repeating yet frustrating themes. 

✖️ Avoid (Don’t) : Dealing with such things especially on a daily basis can become a hassle, leading to irritability & frustration. This can increase your anxiety & stress levels or can make you impulsive & impatient. Either way, you will be likely to jump to conclusions easily, have a tendency to misinterpret, experience panic-attacks, not pay attention to the details, etc. Sometimes, this can also bring up severe chronic health issues and lead to extreme mental health problems.

➕ Do Instead : Allow things to flow, even if you don’t see the bigger picture. Pay close attention to details and take things as slowly as possible. Allow yourself to adjust to the flow of things, so that you can move through delays & detours without getting caught up in the frustrating parts of this transit. Patience is Key. Be prepared, but not restless. Manage your everyday schedules & tasks one at a time. Create better coping mechanisms to manage everyday stress & irritability. 

Background Image by Dee from Pixabay

Emotional intelligence & maturity will play a huge role during this time. This eclipse will bring many imbalances back to their rightful state of balance. Soulful Relationships will strengthen, wonderful new developments in career will bring much joy. Conclusion to long-term projects, and Beginning exciting New ones. Reconnect to your religion and faith, or spirituality. Meditation, QiGong, Yoga, etc. can be therapeutic. Center yourself and focus on balancing your higher ambitions with that of your current goals. Retrace & reorganize if needed. Take one step at a time towards your ideals. Reclaim your dreams & aspirations. entry.title: Sirene Asteroid (1009) Astrology 🌊✨ Natal Placements + Degrees + Aspects + Mythology
entry.content:
Sirene in Astrology can be regarded as the kind of people, situations or events that we encounter in our lives when we are at a significant impasse on our path towards our most determined goals and during challenging times when confusion, temptation & manipulation can easily lead us astray. These are often people who seem enchanting either with their physical qualities or of character that appeal to our ideals, hidden desires or fantasies. But, all that may just be an illusion and an elaborate act to lure you into danger in one way or another. They may be quite conscious of their intentions & actions or they may just be under the spell of their own subconscious delusions. So, we can meet them as sociopaths, narcissists, etc. (not necessarily as a complete definition, but as parts of their personality) that are Highly Manipulative, charming on the outside, wear Masks to fit-in and entice, have a Darker Inner World, scarier True Face, shallow & vain, Shape-Shifter, Fatal Seduction, Hyper-Sensitive Ego & Super-Ego, regard themselves very highly, Destructive & also Self-Destructive, etc. 


In general, these are the kind of Archetypes that you need to be wary of. Hence, Sirene’s Placement in one’s chart can indicate (on the Extreme Negative) the kind of people with the Archetypes and the Red Flags that one must stay cautious of. On the other hand, (and on the Extreme Positive) this Placement indicates the Natural Gifts one possesses that can effortlessly attract situations, people, opportunities, etc. and how to best utilize Sirene’s Innate Talents & Charm to attain one’s desires & dreams.


Significant Sirene Placement

Sirene as an Asteroid in your Natal Chart can be a very significant placement. 

  1. Sirene Conjunctions of 0º to 4º orb with your Ascendant, Midheaven, North Node, or any other Planet. The closer the orb of their Conjunction the more prominent the effects of Sirene. 
  2. In Signs: Pisces, Leo, Scorpio, Gemini, Taurus & Aries particularly. Similarly in Houses: 1H, 2H, 3H, 5H, 8H & 12H. Other signs and houses are significant as well, but Sirene in these signs & houses is often more pronounced.
  3. + Making other Aspects of 0º to 4º orb (like Sextile, Opposition, Square & Trine).
  4. At Prominent Degrees like 0º, 1º, 2º, 3º, 5º, 6º, 8º, 11º, 12º, 13º, 16º, 19º, 20º, 21º, 22º, 24º, 27º, 28º & 29º.


One of the best websites to calculate where Asteroid Sirene is located in your Natal Chart is on astro.com  (also known as ASTRODIENST).

In their home page, click on “Charts & Calculations”  →   “Extended Chart Selection”   →  Enter your Birth Data (Birth Date + Time + Location)  

Sections : Natal Chart Wheel (which is usually a default)   →  ➕ Additional Objects  Selections from following list “Asteroid name/number list”   →  Enter “1009”  in the “Manual Entry” box or Search for Sirene in the name list under “S” 

Click on “Show the Chart” >>

(Although this is not a paid promotion, this website is free and easy to navigate, used & relied on by many Astrologers & enthusiasts.)



In this Asteroid Interpretation, we will consider Sirene as an Archetype which in Astrology can have Light & Dark Attributes. We will focus on how Sirene in its Dark Attributes can be the Major Red Flags of someone’s (or even your own) Shadow Side, while its Light Attributes can show you how to utilize this Mystical Placement to attract your Sacred Dreams & Desires. 


So in general, Sirene’s

Light Attributes 

(How you can Best utilize this Placement)

  • Incredible Manifestation Abilities
  • Feminine Attraction
  • Other worldly Psychic Abilities & Strong Intuition 
  • Sexuality, Natural yet Unreal Beauty, Art & Sensuality
  • Personal Magnetism
  • Making the Best use of one’s Innate Talents
  • Captivating Presence
  • Have people at your mercy, i.e., a Persuasive Personality
  • Wonderful Speaking/Signing Skills + Social & Communication Skills


Dark Attributes 

(What to look out for mostly from others who may have ulterior motives. Often encountering people with such malicious intentions, OR this is how your Shadow Side can manifest in others’ life)

  • People leading you off your course/path (in general) + Intentional Sabotage 
  • Misguiding you to trap you into doing their biding (which may hinder or harm you in the process)
  • Highly Manipulative + a Terrifying Mask 
  • Creating Illusions to draw out your deepest Desires & Vulnerabilities, then to use them against you
  • Creating Illusionary Desires to draw you in closer and play on your insecurities
  • Jealousy & Envy + Projection of their insecurities onto you in order to make you feel uncomfortable about your own Talents & Natural Gifts
  • Sabotage your Purpose & Goals in hopes that they can either steal your Talents OR so that they can drag you down with them because of their misery; and that they Lack your Skills or Willpower.
  • Hard to prove or expose to everyone else, since they carefully pick their targets + Extremely Illusive.


Sirene in Asteroid Astrology can be seen as a Double-edged sword. Sirene is generally a silent & subtle Asteroid Placement. Sirene is a highly manipulative energy, which is more on a verbal, psychological & emotional level. The same way, it can alert you & provide you with wonderful insights into the type of people & situations you might encounter (usually on the Dark Attributes). Also to remind & empower you on how to utilize your own Innate Talents, Manifestation Abilities, Intuitive Urges & Personal Magnetism in order to attract your Desired Goals, Opportunities and hence also Abundance. So, with a Prominent Placement and during important Transits, both Light & Dark Attributes are likely to become apparent in your chart.

entry.title: Natal Aphrodite (1388) Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
You might have self-confidence issues regarding your body image or sexuality. You might have felt inadequate in personal relationships, especially in romantic ones. You might have been dragged into conflicts over lovers, compared based on popularity or been unfairly judged through impossible beauty-standards, etc. You might have felt unappealing or undesirable in your adolescence (even if it wasn’t true). 


But, moving past such experiences, you might have found how truly beautiful, attractive and loved you are. You might create your own fashion-sense and aesthetics that defy or even surpass superficial standards of beauty & desirability. You might even attain popularity for your beauty, style, aesthetics, etc.


It is important that you are being mindful about how you are projecting your insecurities onto others. In relationships it is also vital that you take responsible decisions and hold others accountable for their actions as well. You will benefit greatly from self-care, healthy relationship choices, drawing boundaries, not participating in petty comparison games, and even avoiding people who pull you into competition for their affection. 


Your relationships can improve, helping you to feel comfortable in your own skin when you don’t let negative projections or envy to lower your self-worth. This retrograde placement can help you realize that true beauty is one that shines from within and can only be appreciated by those with a pure heart.

Aug 1 - 6, 2023

You are naturally creative and insightful Gemini. You are in tune with your artistic side which adds to your sense of self and promotes character development. This week, you might feel triggered in someway to reconnect with your skills & creativity. Lately you might have noticed a glitch in your intuition making you feel disconnected with your authentic self. But, with certain situations playing out in the background, you will wish to go back to the things that allow you to feel closer to yourself. There might even be big realizations that you feel your best when you are expressing your interests and skills. 



You are being prompted to reevaluate your lifestyle choices & routines, work schedules & long term goals in order to find the right balance between the two, especially if you have been feeling that one may be more overwhelming that the other lately. You might be feeling the need to rest and take some time away from your career & other such responsibilities, but you might not have been able to catch a break. Lately there just seems to be one issue after another that has been causing emotional disturbances. Some of those may be highlighting the imbalances in your personal life & relationships. You are serious & driven about your professional goals but also a little agitated in your home life. You might feel like you can’t relax or find inspiration no matter where you go. 


This frustration can tempt you to escape from everything altogether for some time Gemini, which can be a good thing if you are thinking about a vacation or a few self-care days. You might initially feel too tied up in things but you will be able to make some time for yourself. There may be anxieties with regards to big financial investments or contracts (even debts) that you are looking forward to complete/pay off soon. This can be a wonderful time to look after your health or habits that you have been feeling the need to moderate & readjust. Overall, there is a lot of inspiration to build a more secure foundation for yourself and your loved ones, so, balancing work-life responsibilities will bring a profound sense of peace and grounding this week.

entry.title: New Moon in Virgo 0° 🌑♍️ Aug 23, 2025
entry.content:
Reorganize, Reprioritize & Rest.


This 🌑 will be a little chaotic and that very chaos will bring unexpected clarity. It is very likely that you are more irritable &/or frustrated with certain situations & people now. There may be disruptions in Technology & Logistics, everyday schedules in general. Little things can make a big difference during this New Moon. 🪙


Sudden health issues or Chronic illness can cause worries. The same can be true about mishaps & misinterpretations, little things can become big Wake-Up calls. These issues (be it in Health, Work, Relationships or otherwise) will prompt you to make changes that will help you Rebalance your Life in a New Way. 🌷


Getting things in Perspective and having your Priorities aligned will become a huge part of this 🌑. Make the best of this rather restless time as you may have to be extra patient with yourself, everyone & everything around you. Manage anxiety, stress & anger wisely. 🪭


This will also be an Eye Opening period of time with regards to People around you as well as your own Mind-Set, where some people may behave rather strangely and expose their True Intentions towards you (Good or Bad); your own Thought-Process, Behavioral Patterns & Mindsets can show what you can improve upon. 🌿


Allow certain things to settle on their own, while other things will need your attention. Recalibrate your Intentions, Actions & Goals. Avoid distractions that create unnecessary stress. Take adequate Breaks & Rest. 


Prioritize Plans, Streamline your Work, get inspired by New Ideas & Passion Projects. 🗝️


Make intentional moves, one step at a time. Methodical plans lead to Inevitable Success now. Breakthroughs & Blessings abound. ⚡️

entry.title: Part of Fortune in Aries + 1st House + 1° 13° 25° 🗝️🍀💰✨
entry.content:
The Keys to your Innate Fortune & Luck with Natal Part of Fortune in Aries / 1H / 1° 13° 25° 🗝️🍀


Strong Sense of Self 

You will have many opportunities to develop a strong Self-Confidence and Immense belief in your own Capabilities. Above all with PoF here, a Positive Self-Image is Key to your Good Fortune. Your radiant Personality naturally attracts many admirers, friends, acquaintances, partners, etc. A strong Sense of Self is simply your Authenticity. Staying True to who you are will naturally bring you exactly the right kind of relationships, opportunities, situations, etc. With this PoF, you will have to learn how to be Loud & Proud of who you are, and unapologetically yourself. 


Independent + Self Reliant 

You naturally thrive in environments, relationships & careers where you can be Free from extra restrictions & bureaucratic constraints. You have excellent Leadership skills and a Charismatic personality that can inspire others around you. Although you work well in groups & teams, you are likely to find fulfilling Success when you take a Solo-Path to Career & Life as a whole. You can hence do well in Entrepreneurial, Business and/or Freelance endeavors that give you the flexibility to express your Innate Potential as a True Achiever. Relying on your Knowledge, Skills & Capabilities will bring out the best in you, unlocking many opportunities that feel more like an adventure.


Pioneering Spirit

Being a Leader not just in your Career but also in Life, you are likely to ‘march to the beat of your own drums’. This means you may be a little unconventional, or take on challenges that others might rather not. You will hence encounter the most satisfying Success when finding your own Path, following your own Dreams. So, you are likely to choose what you wish to achieve on your own terms, rather than to let someone else’s expectations, plans or advice influence you. This will lead you on a journey of both Self-Discovery and finding New Frontiers. Hence, finding your Niche, your own Passions & Inspirations will make you a Trailblazer in those fields (especially if you create a whole new Career Path in the the process, or set effortless Impressive Records in existing ones). 


Assertiveness

Being Spontaneous will bring you numerous Opportunities in all areas of your Life. A little bit of (calculated) recklessness, impulsivity and (dare I say) audacity will set you up for Success in many ways. This hence also emphasizes on being in-tune with your Intuition, as naturally moving through your Instincts should bring various opportunities. Your bold ‘decisiveness’ will be a Major factor in your Successes. This will give a Daring Quality to your Personality, further adding to your Courage and Self-Confidence.


Passions + Ambitions

Your Innate Talents & Skills along with Energetic Curiosity will need the right Direction to Focus and Achieve. Your Passionate and Immensely Ambitious Personality can take you to Greater Heights. Explore your Passions & Desires, Dreams & Aspirations, those Instinctual Goals that naturally light a spark of Inspiration within you. You need to focus all that Energy in a Positive, Productive & Fulfilling Direction. Loyalty towards your own Goals & Aspirations will naturally and effortlessly bring all the necessary Opportunities & then some more.


Courage + Determination 

One of your biggest strengths is in your Raw Determination & Courage. You are ‘a force to be reckoned with’, as when you Passionately set your sights on your Goals, you become Unstoppable. You have Immense Will-Power and often don’t back down from obstacles, competition, or even opposition. Your Bold and Ambitious nature will help you win even the most impossible battles in your life.


Take on Worthy Challenges

Your Life Path is what you choose for it to be with this PoF, and everything you do (and not do) has a huge impact on your Life. Take on challenges enthusiastically. You can take one step at a time, jump into things without much forethought or even stumble and make mistakes, but as long as you are following your Instincts & Passions, you are listening to your Heart and so all of this is worth it. Here, you will need to challenge yourself in order to keep bettering yourself, and every time you better yourself, you naturally reach New Heights of Success. More than competing with others, you can always compete with yourself, as your most worthy opponent is you yourself. You are also likely to meet people with whom you can have a healthy competition with as well. 



Pot of Blessings + Fortune 💰✨

You are blessed with a Positive Self-Image and an Optimistic Outlook on Life. You likely have an attractive body type (regardless of your gender), even a charming personality. Healthy obsession with fitness (Mars influence) can make you even more alluring. Your Boundless Energy naturally lights up the path to your Success. Your Passions bring Purpose & Clarity into your Life. You can naturally and skillfully navigate through Life’s Ups & Downs, where listening to your Intuition & Instincts lead you to a more Fulfilling Life. Your Inner Fortitude often gains the trust & respect of those around you. 


Your Authenticity opens the right Doors to the right Opportunities at the Right Place & Time. You need to put yourself out there to make the most of this Incredible placement, where your Personal & Public Image will lead you towards the Success that you wish to accomplish. Be energetic, if even a bit restless & eager to achieve your goals. Taking care of yourself, health-wise and aesthetic-wise can also bring many more Fortunate opportunities. 


A bit of healthy Self-Respect, Pride & Confidence can always do you wonders. You will find the most Success & Fortune when you are working towards New Endeavors, Individual Growth, Passionate Goals, Grand Ambitions, etc. anywhere you can be Yourself, and Inspire others. Fighting for yourself, your loved ones and others in need will also bring you Personal & Public Gratification. You will also learn how to choose your battles wisely, and how not to waste your effort towards meaningless action & goals. 


Seize opportunities, explore New Frontiers and build an Immaculate Self-Image through your Life’s Journey (with both your Achievements & Failures). Make as many mistakes as you can, learn the right lessons and stand up to try again, conquer your own Fears & inadequacies in the process. Achieve as many Goals as you want, reach however far & high as you can, ‘the World is your Oyster’. Most of all, love Yourself and commit to always uphold your Honor through achieving worthy Goals.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Scorpio (8th House) Generation ☄️✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Scorpio (8th House) Generation ☄️✨

Saturn in the house/sign of death, rebirth and transformation can be an interesting yet powerful placement. You are extremely loyal and reliable. Your love is deep and enduring, yet you rarely feel loved the same way you do from others. You might have had a hard time accepting yourself for all your flaws, which in-turn could have affected your view on intimacy & love. If anything, you might either forbid yourself from intimacy or have no limits for your lust, all depending on the aspects Saturn is making in your chart and what other placements there are. You view relationships as painful experiences especially if you have had to endure traumatic situations in the past. You might not trust others too easily, since most people in your life betrayed and backstabbed you in one way or another. You have a firm disdain for people who are disloyal, greedy or generally envious since you might have endured harsh experiences due to such people. 


Your life experiences may have given you a keen sense of self and intuition. You might even have latent psychic & other spiritual gifts. Death may either be a fascination or a terrible fear as well. You might have escaped from near death accidents or endured serious ones; you might have even witnessed your loved ones suffering through harsh health issues. So, you know how cruel, yet inevitable death & suffering are. You are realistic and practical in your approach to life as a result. You rarely let yourself enjoy the good times since in the back of your mind, you are always expecting for something to go wrong. This cautiousness encourages you to always have a back-up plan and think several steps ahead of everyone else, since you feel a sense of instability that scares you deeply. However, it is also important not to get enveloped by your fears so much so that you are always expecting an impending doom to occur in your life, since this placement can certainly trigger your deepest insecurities so there is a high possibility for paranoia. 


Staying realistically cautious and taking everything that happens with a grain of salt will save you a lot of mental & emotional stress. This placement can help you make your deepest desires become a reality through methodical & practical approach, giving you great manifesting abilities. So, you can use your rich inner world and a positive subconscious to your advantage making use of your true potential. You might have had a rough upbringing, maybe even raised in dangerous surroundings. Even if you have not experienced poverty, you might be afraid of ever being in a situation where you or your loved ones have to suffer. You might have been falsely accused of crimes, involved in dangerous situations, fraud, or even set up in some way, etc. You might have felt lonely and abandoned during your childhood, even if it wasn’t anything physical, you always felt it on an emotional level none the less, making you feel distant and unloved in some way. You might have endured some sort of abuse, neglect, or accident that left you traumatized, wounding your inner child gravely. 


You might have vowed to yourself that you will never again be in such situations, yet you are constantly afraid of history repeating itself. You are excellent at reading people’s intentions, so you are a great lie-detector. You despise dishonest people especially those who are fake & lack integrity. You might have encountered emotionally/psychologically manipulative people in your life who may have played on your love & loyalty for them. Such betrayals may have wounded you deeply making you extremely cautious of others. However, deceptive relationships like that helped you gain emotional intelligence as a form of defense mechanism which is your greatest asset. You can almost read others’ minds if you wanted to. You can pick up on details that others miss, and you know how to easily connect those patterns. You are extremely skilled at detail-oriented works and your curiosity is highly focused. 



You will however have to be careful not to become the monster you are fighting, since it is very easy to get consumed by others’ sins & darkness especially if you are prone to seeking justice, revenge or even losing control over your anger. You are extremely defensive whenever others falsely accuse you or are trying to ruin your reputation in any way. But you must also not get caught up in their traps by your aggression and reacting without reading their intentions. Your emotional and psychological intelligence will be your greatest weapon, so it is wise to exercise patience and plan your way out, since Saturn here can help you find logical solutions to even the most dangerous problems. This placement will often force you to undergo painful transformations both within and with-out, where you might experience external loses or have to let go of toxic people who don’t serve your highest good, while internally you will have to experience ego deaths; releasing your need to control, curb your rage, face your deepest fears, come out feeling renewed and more connected to your soul.


Money is an important factor in your life. You might have been poor or born rich, either way, you have a complicated relationship with money. You might have to break generational curses and karmic cycles relating to money and relationships with this placement, which will be challenging yet immensely rewarding. You might work hard tirelessly and neglect the rest of your life since you can be prone to being a workaholic or you might let your fears & insecurities to hold you back from making any kind of career moves. You have an inner passion to accomplish great goals, but you will have to work on your self-esteem in order not to let your fears stop you or your ego to sabotage your efforts. You will have to overcome some deep-rooted feelings of unworthiness before you can fulfill your career goals. You are extremely passionate, and have an unstoppable determination, so it’s important that you don’t let your fears of inadequacy to deter you from your ambitions. 


Scorpio/8H also rules taxes, shared resources and banks, so you might have a successful career related these themes. You will have to however be careful not to fall into any forms of temptation and indulge in fraudulent practices, in taxes, or not paying due bills/loans, embezzlement, etc. since Saturn won’t be pleased with any injustice and karma will be repaid in a big way, so if its vice versa, where others have done such things to you or have devious intentions towards you, you can rest assured that you are karmically protected. You might notice that you have a good handle on money, or you might have been encouraged by certain events in your life to become good with financial management. You can find opportunities to accumulate wealth over time with patience & persistence especially through partnerships, marriage, divorce, or inheritance, etc. although, you might have to face delays, troubles or obstacles along the way (especially if there are challenging aspects or other placements indicating the same). Wealth, power and position may be your ambitions, always determined to find opportunities to attain them. 


You might be extremely attractive to others. You are a dutiful lover. You love with all your heart. You are also a passionate partner in intimate settings. You are loyal and you expect the same kind of devotion from your partner and nothing less. It is hard for you to open up to others, even those you love, but you will feel at ease when you can form enduring bonds with them even when you feel vulnerable to let others into your world. You are mysterious and might even guard your heart with all your might, but this is also what makes you attractive to others. Discernment is important with this placement, since you are aware of those who might want to get close to you just to hurt you, but you will also have to be careful not to accidentally hurt those who truly love you by misunderstanding their intentions. You can expect to find trustworthy connections (romantic, business, platonic) through the heap of toxic ones that you had to let go of. Saturn here will protect you from other’s ego and that of your own, helping you transform, and attain your deepest desires.

You are wrapping up old cycles and ready to welcome new energies Aquarius. You are confident and clear about the next directions to take. You are likely reevaluating your wants & needs in personal relationships thoroughly this week. You need a lot of independence to be yourself without the burden of fitting into moulds Aquarius, and that applies extra to your relationships. You are always there for your loved ones, loyal and protective. But, you also deeply aware of your needs & desires, so you rarely sacrifice them to please anyone else. You might have many doubts, thoughts and feelings swirling around in your mind about the kind of relationship dynamics you have had until now. You might be realizing just how much you have grown as a person with refined & healthy expectations in romantic relationships and how you wish to honor love & commitment moving forward. 


You are able to resolve any issues of commitment, people-pleasing, over extending, overthinking, etc. within yourself. You are also building your understanding of boundaries and how to set healthy expectations in your relationships both from yourself & others. You are fierce about making sure that your love, rights & safety (emotional, physical, financial, etc.) are taken into consideration in all existing & future relationships. There may be many triggers early on this week, making you revisit old memories of pain & disappointment, heart break & despair. 


The whirlwind of intense emotions will subside as the week ends, bringing necessary clarity on the issues you need to work on/be aware of in order to allow true love, loyalty and reciprocity in your relationships. So, get ready to dip your toes into your emotions Aquarius, your logical mind will have to confront the needs of your big heart with love to make the best use of the astrological climate this week, helping you to get closer to your own self-love and to honor others with your compassion. This might not be a good time for major investments. It is also advised to double check on all transactions and review contracts more carefully, if possible consult experts/professionals regarding financial matters Aquarius.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Gemini + 3rd House 🦜✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Gemini + 3H + 3° 15° 27° + Mercury Aspects 🦜✨ 

LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE


Your endearing yet playful personality can be quite alluring to others. You have a brilliant mind, very intellectually driven in your interests, academically focused and/or into artistic endeavors, etc. You might actually be here, there, everywhere, doing the most exciting things and delving into the most interesting topics with an enthusiastic curiosity. This wonder and child-like spirit can attract a lot of people, especially those who share similar interests with you. So, you likely befriend many who have very similar mindsets and opinions as you do. This can become a fair advantage when in business/work settings, gaining you good partners, colleagues & supporters. 


You can hence make friends pretty much wherever you go. Your ingenious wonderment can also make you eager to understand many different things, where this placement can add to your Multi-tasking ability & hence Multi-talented, making you even more mesmerizing to others with how much enthusiasm and effort you can put into life as a whole. Your way of expressing your thoughts can be quite impressive to others, so your communication & social skills are likely excellent. You can use just the right words and the right tone, paired with a good body language to express your opinions, feelings & thoughts accurately, leaving people wanting for more. They can become quite curious to know more about you and what you think.


 This is therefore also a placement that can indicate to Popularity and Fame. Your talents & skills are hence valued and admired by many. Your own siblings, family & community can be very supportive of you, admiring everything that you do and everything that you are. Building a good social network, supportive community and friends is a major positive of this Sirene placement, making you equally resourceful, confident and successful. This placement can hence add to your Career & Public Success as a whole.



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE


You encounter people who are just too good with their words, so pretty much anyone can fit the bill; manipulators, con-artists, … anybody. So, it is wise to stay away from people who think they are too smart and wish to get you into doing things simply because they are a little too charming. There is usually a big emphasis on their intellect or even talents than on their empathy or compassion. So, there is a high risk of manipulation, emotional and psychological abuse. This can be especially true with people that you meet through someone you know or through your Social Circles where you have a common ground of sorts. So, they may be con-artists who swindle money, want to pitch a bogus deal, make you invest in a fake fund, join an exploitative business/company/group, etc. 


This can also be through Social Media where you might follow people who seem charming & successful but are living a lie or have a ‘completely-alternate-cruel-true face’. So, the extreme side of Sirene here can have quite a distracting and majorly devastating impact on many levels of your life. Siblings, Family Members, Friends and Acquaintances may also become Frenemies which can be quite a daunting thing. There can be a risk of developing severe Trust Issues with this placement. But, not so dangerous as becoming too intellectually focused and calculative yourself, since this placement can make it easier for you to be influenced by others’ Shadow side, both good & bad. 


So, distractions in life can be astoundingly many, where without a really strong Will-Power and Mindset, you can be led astray by any number of things. So, as wondrous a placement it is on the Positive side, this can be an equally Devastating Placement on the extreme Negative side indeed. Having a strong Mind with Crystal-clear Intentions & focusing on Purposeful Goals can make you Successful and reach your Ambitions. So, Abundance and Achievements that are well-deserved for all your Aspirations, Skills & Talents will need your Conscious & Productive Efforts.


Aries + 1H  |  Taurus + 2H  |  Gemini + 3H  |  Cancer + 4H  |  Leo + 5H  |  Virgo + 6H  |  Libra + 7H  |  Scorpio + 8H  |  Sagittarius + 9H  |  Capricorn + 10H  |  Aquarius + 11H  |  Pisces + 12H  |  0°  |  Retrograde  |  Mythology  |  Astrology  |  North Node Aspects  |  Chiron Aspects  |  Lilith Aspects  |  Life Calling / Career ✨
