entry.title: Natal Jupiter Conjunct Neptune 🐬✨
entry.content:
A rare planetary Conjunction that is considered as one of the most fortunate aspects in the chart. You are virtuous, generous, culturally enlightened & spiritual. You have a kind and compassionate heart that is often admired by others. You are likely down-to-earth and grounded, making you approachable & friendly, increasing your likability. You are determined and devoted often not just towards your own self & loved ones, but also towards others and the world as a whole. 


As Jupiter & Neptune combine to enhance each other’s ethereal effects in the chart, they also amplify Pisces + 12H Archetypal energy. You are altruistic, and often selflessly invest your time & effort towards people/causes that need unconditional care or dedication. You hence find Spiritual and Emotional Gratification in charity, social work, volunteering & activism that call to your heart and soul. Nature and Animals also get your endless compassion and love. You might even be drawn towards professions in Medicine and Health Care. 


You are ethical and morally upright. You stand up for yourself and others against Injustice and (especially) Moral corruption. You do Good deeds without expecting praise or rewards. Many naturally trust and admire you. You are likely also pious and down-to-earth earning the respect of others. Although often admired & respected, you showcase humility, simplicity & modesty. You are immensely Spiritual even though you may or may not be religious. You naturally gravitate towards Spiritual and/or Religious Belief Systems, Lifestyle and practices. 


You are drawn towards Spirituality, Religion, Astrology, Mysticism, Supernatural and Metaphysical concepts. Likewise, you are likely to also be interested in History, Philosophy, Mythology, Politics and Sociology. You might have a deep calling to travel and go on Adventures. This may be especially true w.r.t. Religious + Spiritual Sacred places, Monuments, Museums, Art galleries, etc, exploring different cultures and its people. Careers that involve Art, Architecture, Tourism, Museums, Long-distance Travels, etc. can also be profitable and fulfilling. Artistic & Creative gifts are extremely likely. Music, Cinema, Art, Dancing, Crafting, Acting, etc. may be some of your interests. You can be extraordinarily talented in some Artistic field(s) that can bring immense Fame, Acclaim & Success. 


Education is also an important focus to you, whether Academic or Worldliness, you are likely to pursue both successfully. You are able to understand knowledge and information intellectually & intuitively. You can innately understand practical knowledge along with abstract + intuitive information. You likely see many signs & synchronicities that bring you guidance & conformation on your path. You might be aware of your own psychic + intuitive + spiritual gifts & abilities. You might often have supernatural and/or Divine experiences that can cause periodic Spiritual Awakenings within you. Magical + Mystical events are hence likely quite Enlightening. You can have some of the bizarrely vivid mystical experiences in Dreams and Astral worlds that bring omens and predictions to guide, confirm & protect you. 


You are Hopeful and full of Faith. Often times your Positivity and Optimism can uplift and inspire others, even in the most dire times. You are full of Love and Happiness that you wish to share with everyone; Peace and Love for the whole world. Your deep empathy allows you to connect with the world & the collective on Emotional & Spiritual levels, where you can share joy & sorrows of the world very strongly within your heart (often also psychosomatically). Your imagination much like your heart is boundless. Along with endless optimism, you are able to believe in a better, brighter & peaceful future without giving-in to fear or hopelessness. 


Although this undeterred and relentless positivity is Awe-inspiring, this Conjunction will require you to be Grounded and Realistic, to see things/people/situations for what they truly are. This level of Positivity & faithful determination is only appropriate and rewarding when you are facing the truth of the reality along with the fears, discomforts, risks & uncertainties. As this powerful aspect heightens your optimism for desired outcomes, you might fall victim to your own grand Delusions and distorted Perceptions. Since your desperation can often lead to ignoring signs of risks & dangers, along with unrealistic expectations and also steering towards manipulation/coercion (often as ‘a means to an end’) to try and bend the reality, truth & outcomes to your favor, which of course can greatly backfire causing chaos and shattering of illusions. 


Your good deeds and intentions lead to accumulating immense Good Karma and Good Fortune. You are likely to acquire massive Wealth, Prosperity and Status. Your decisiveness and ability to follow intuitive nudges naturally mean that you can make the most of your blessings, to be at the right place at the right time, manifest miraculous opportunities, make use of twists of fate and destined encounters effortlessly. Good Luck and Good Fortune hence follow you everywhere you go, in everything you do. Hence, along with Spiritual Inner Peace you can also enjoy the Prosperity & Worldly pleasures equally well. 


However, without proper Grounding and Self-discipline, this aspect can easily influence you to become over-indulgent. Relying heavily on your Luck alone can lead to catastrophic consequences, as you might become too engrossed in ‘gambling with your life’ instead of making honest use of your own potential. This is hence a cautionary advice to not let wealth, status, power or even comfort to override your Conscience, Morals & Values. It is advised to always stay grateful and humble, to not forget to keep working hard and to have Self-restraint especially when you are plentiful in life. Since otherwise, it is very likely that you might loose everything that you have earned, as the Good Luck & Good Karma can eventually run out overtime, especially when life’s harsh lessons replace them from time to time. Gratitude will save you from loosing Karmic Favor & Blessings bestowed upon you. 


It is also vital that you do not give-in to Self-delusion and become lost on your path. Stay vigilant about both others’ and your own temptations that are born out of greed, entitlement and desperation to attain Power & Wealth. It is best not to over-indulge in Escapism be it in Fantasies & Desires, or Alcohol & Substances. Since Neptune can influence you towards Self-destructive tendencies and decisions that can lead to your doom, slowly before you know it. 


You are also advised not to get involved with people of questionable backgrounds & motives. Since whether through your innocence or willful ignorance, you might often fall victim to devious and manipulative people who may seem special, mystical or powerful, but may turn out to be fraudulent and dangerous who can take grave advantage of you. You might get dragged into Scandals and Legal/Public troubles because of such dubious associations (especially in spiritual, religious, artistic and/or political circles & matters). It is hence also important to stay extra vigilant in financial / romantic / business relationships. 


It is best not to use short-cuts to attain wealth & status, even if opportunities are presented to you. Since, not all offers may be well-intended. This aspect hence although exceptionally Auspicious & Fortunate, needs to be considered, used & navigated with extreme caution. With great Fortune, Luck & Spiritual Favor also come great Moral responsibility, Self-accountability and need for Realistic expectations + approach to fully and genuinely reap the enormous benefits of this Rare Conjunction.

entry.title: Part of Fortune in Gemini + 3rd House + 3° 15° 27° 🗝️🍀💰✨
entry.content:
The Keys to your Innate Fortune & Luck with Natal Part of Fortune in Gemini / 3H / 3° 15° 27° 🗝️🍀

Sharp Intellect + Curiosity 

With PoF here, you are able to Sharpen your Intellect tremendously. You are likely to awaken certain Intellectual Abilities during your Childhood (Schooling years) which will get better over time. You are able to learn & grasp Information with ease. You are likely to be Intellectual and Rational (a lot more than Emotional). What’s more special is, that you seem to possess a Child-like Curiosity that helps you to explore the World both within you and around you. The simple act of Curious Exploration alone brings you Immense Joy and can help you discover some Unique Opportunities. You are able to use your Intellect & Rationality to attain your Goals, often times more effectively and effortlessly than others. 


Communication + Wit

This is one of your Greatest Strengths, as you are able to attain the fullest of this Potential the more you learn, engage & innovate in Communication. Utilizing any & every way to Communicate your Thoughts, Ideas & Feelings, in ways small or big, you will gain more and more Confidence & Social Skills. These interactive experiences will help you stay Positive and Easygoing. With Social & Communicative Skills, you will also become good at developing your Wit. These essential Skills tremendously increase your Charm & Popularity, as speaking & interacting with you will feel natural, engaging & joyous to many.


Connections + Sociability

It is very likely that you enjoy good kinship with your Siblings & other Extended Family members, even if not with all, you still have quite a few who are dear to you. In the Neighborhood & Community you grew up in (and even later on if & when you move), you are likely to feel Safe, Prosperous, Harmonious & at Peace in the place(s) you live in. School (& likely even College) life may have been very Joyous, Exciting & Wondrous. This PoF naturally makes you Sociable, often the Center of every group you belong to. You are able to make many Resourceful & Wonderful Friendships and Associations both in your Personal & Professional Life. From enjoying beautiful Moments & Memories with loved ones to being able to Prosper & Achieve Great things with Acquaintances, these seemingly mundane Relationships often bring Immense Joy, Satisfaction & Prosperity into your life. Networking & Connectivity with Like-Minded people is hence one of your Keys to Happiness & Success.


Learning + Teaching

You are able to learn a Myriad of different things and whether you get to the Deeper core or Scratch the Surface, you are able to fully grasp onto the knowledge in time. In fact, you need to keep yourself busy in learning new things just to satisfy your Insatiable thirst for knowledge. You likely have a unique ability or approach to learning that is efficient and often even fun. Similarly, you have a way of communicating and presenting your Thoughts & Ideas, which can seem so Thought-Provoking yet simple. This makes you a great Teacher, especially if you feel drawn towards sharing the knowledge that you have learned.


Restlessness + Listlessness

With PoF in a Placement that almost enjoys Mental Stimulation, you need to apply your Mind towards something, anything, even if it’s a hobby or a pass-time. You need to implement your ideas, indulge in yours Talents & Creativity. Be bored. Be restless. Often spend time just sitting, doing nothing. Daydreaming can turn into Brainstorming, and before you know it you are Thinking about ways to bring your Ideas & Dreams into Reality. Make a habit of Jotting things down, your Simple Ideas can give rise to Immensely Powerful things. Your Mind is extremely Inventive & Versatile, as it can learn how to connect Dots and recognize Patterns. Discovering (often easy & simple) ways to getting things done more efficiently. Being Listless hence will work as a wonderful way to avoid (and recover from) Over Mental Stimulation, as that can be a concerning Fatigue which can otherwise lead to Anxiety, Mental Exhaustion & other Health Issues.


Adaptability 

You are extremely adept at reprogramming your Mindset, Thought-Patterns & hence your whole Outlook on life, whenever & wherever necessary. You are extremely Adaptable: Intellectually, Socially, Emotionally & Situationally. You have a flexible Mindset & Personality that can fit in & out of any situation, connection or opportunity. You are able to keep redefining your Goals, Plans & Ambitions; through New Discoveries, Desires & Inspirations. The same can be true about Re-fining your Goals & Ambitions to achieve them more efficiently, to manifest them more easily. Distractions or Self-Imposed Restrictions (which can turn into a Mental Maze of your own doing) need to be avoided & maintained by finding Healthy Coping Mechanisms, developing Self-Discipline & Self-Control. Hence, Clarity of Mind is an essential Key to Immense Success & Prospects. 


Talents + Skills 

Your Curious Mind loves exploring New things, especially Skills that you can pick up on the go. Being adaptable, you are always ready to take up challenges & opportunities with equal enthusiasm. This also makes you adept at learning New Skills, those that peak your Interest. You are extremely versatile, often making you a living example of this famous (but often shortened quote) “A jack of all trades is a master of none, but oftentimes better than a master of one”. This of course by no means stops you from Mastering Skills (& Courses), as PoF here will most definitely help you become Masterful in everything you put your Mind to. Nothing is too small or big for you to learn, almost turning what you learn into Muscle Memory. Hence learning, adapting & implementing in & of itself become a special Talent. You are able to explore your Latent Talents, be it in Writing, Speaking, Arts, Music, Teaching, Driving, etc. This PoF especially gives you Musical & Artistic Talent(s), essentially providing you all the opportunities to become a Virtuoso in the field.


Power of the Mind

With this wonderful PoF placement, you are Cheerful and Child-Like. You are naturally connected to your Inner Child on many levels including Spiritual, Emotional & Intellectual. This Inner Connection & Deeper Understanding (whether you are consciously aware of it or not) help you in Unlocking the Power of your own Mind & Intellect. You are hence able to tap into the Immense Potential within, giving your Ideas & Thoughts a Tangible Physical Form. Hence, your Manifestation & Visualization abilities are greatly enhanced with this PoF, helping you Manifest whatever kind of Life, Dream or Ambition into Reality. The same is true for Voicing your Dreams & Desires into Existence, through the Power of your Words & Voice. 



Pot of Blessings + Fortune 💰✨

PoF in this Placement is more about harnessing the Immense Potential within Subtle & seemingly Small Possibilities. Opportunities here find you and often you get to discover them yourself. You naturally go where your Mind wanders, as you are always looking for something that can inspire you. You have Clarity of Mind, devoid of Self-Doubt, especially in the skills you possess & acquire through Sheer Passion & Effort. You are able to understand different points of views without judging them or being judged by them. This ability to stay connected to the information without involving your Personal Feelings often helps you ascertain the World as to what truly needs your Attention and what’s not worth your time. 


Your Mind loves to be Over Stimulated (let’s be honest), so you often don’t shy away from diving into numerous Interests & Subjects. Multi-tasking hence is an Impressive Skill that you hone effortlessly. You can hence direct your focus on multiple tasks simultaneously, running many different projects at once. Versatility is your best asset after all, making you a Valuable Resource in any Career / Business Field, since you are able to fill multiple roles sometimes without much preparation needed as you pick up the important skills as you go. This also gives you an edge to be an Entrepreneur, a Leader who can both be Successful and Relatable with your Employees. 


The Archetype of Gemini + 3H is often regarded as a Trickster in the Shadow, and a Magician in the Light. You are hence extremely skilled at persuasion and gaining others’ trust, sometimes just through your Words. This ability, or rather Power needs to be used responsibly, since PoF is a Point of Good Karma. The same is true for others who interact with you. On one hand, (especially with other difficult Placements or Aspects) you are likely to have encountered Deceitful, Manipulative & Cunning people. This can be from a random Fraudster Sales Person to a Trusted Friend or Family Member(s) who may have lied, manipulated, played mind games, created illusions or deceived you. 


Yet with this Part of Fortune, you are protected from Mental Manipulation & Attacks. Psychological & Spiritual Attacks, Manipulation and Abuse are things that you are almost Divinely protected from. Although, granted that you will need to initially understand these concepts either through unpleasant experiences, trauma &/or research. Hence, you are able to completely resists, and even overturn such situations if ever you encounter them. You are able to protect yourself & your loved ones from such Negative Influences effectively, as you already know the Dark Psychology Playbook and know how to connect the dots & patterns.


On the other hand, this also involves protecting yourself from your own mind. As, this Archetype often can develop (in extreme cases of course) Split interests or even Personalities, where the Mind becomes your own worst enemy. So, PoF here can keep you grounded and in-tune with yourself without the risk of losing control over your own Thoughts. You hence have a Strong Mind & Will-Power that can shield you from severe anxiety, shifts in circumstances, changes, etc. that Trauma or Life’s Abrupt Challenges can cause. You can become your own Best Friend & Ally with this Placement, where you may even recover from previous Psychological Trauma and deep Childhood Wounds. You can easily gain control over your thoughts, change your mindset or even reprogram your mind, so if you wish to restructure your Thought-patterns and make them more Positive, you have the Innate ability to do so.


You can speak your way in & out of any situation that you wish to, at any time. This is of course a High-Level Skill that you can only learn through conscious practice and experience. You can hence access any opportunity or resource that you want, especially through Networking & Asserting yourself. ‘Trial and error’ is another approach to Mastering your skills & craft, so you can easily adapt to Careers that allow you a certain degree of flexibility and freedom to experiment with new & different approaches. Your hands and dexterity can also become your best assets. This Placement can especially enhance the ability, appeal & appearance of your Hands, Fingers and Lips. So, whether in Modeling, Designing, or in Body Language during Communication, you naturally attract others’ attention. 


Here, you are able to tap into Happiness & Abundance just by indulging in Simple Pleasures of Life like: Spending time with Loved ones, Hobbies, Interests, Short Courses, Reading, Writing, Learning, Creating Art, Traveling to your favorite places, sharing ideas with your friends & acquaintances, brainstorming, etc. Little things that connect you to your Inner Child, can also help others connect to theirs. Humor in & of itself is a great source of Joy with this PoF placement. Smiling, Laughing & Humor hence effortlessly bring Peace, Happiness & Serenity. This also helps you to maintain a Pleasant State of Mind, balancing your Inner & Outer World, making it easier to manifest & utilize Opportunities for Success & Abundance. 


You have the unique ability to use any & every means necessary to achieve your Goals, as you can find ways where there may have been none, or paths that lead to Special Treasures that others may not have considered before. Social Media & Media in general can also open you up to your own Little World of Unlimited Opportunities. Whether for Marketing, Creativity or Connectivity; Social Platforms & Technology can immensely benefit you, hence bringing numerous Fortunate Opportunities & Prosperity. Put yourself out there, especially by expressing your Ideas, Thoughts & Talents, you are able to create Success (and possibly even Unique Financial Opportunities).


Your Words, Ideas & the way you Communicate are Immensely Powerful, dare I say can turn into Gold. Others are often able to relate to you & what you do/say. They are also often curious about you and your opinions. Since your way with Words & Thinking are so Interesting & Intellectually Stimulating to many. Tapping into this Rare Potential within yourself can hence make you a Sensation (in any field you choose to & life in general). Hence, Popularity & Fame become your PoF’s Natural Blessing. Whether it is in your Personal or Professional life, in Social Media or Public Life; you can influence the Mood, Ideas & Thoughts of many (of course only when you can tap into the Fullest of this PoF’s Potential). In other words, you have a Divine Purpose to express yourself and bring your skills into the World. Regardless, whether in a Small or Big way, you are likely to be quite Popular, Endearing & Charming to others. So, will you promise to use this Power generously & responsibly on us 😘, you Adorable Magician you?! 


Your Words and the Intentions they carry can bring Good Fortune and Good Karma. So, consciously engage in Conversations even with yourself, where your Words, Thoughts & Actions are filled with Good Will and Positivity. As, you are able to Naturally Uplift, spread Light-Hearted Joy & Optimism simply by being yourself. Others will feel this Serenity and Child-Like Spirt, where they can feel truly appreciated. Your Good Thoughts, Intentions, Ideas & Words, they carry such Positive Lightness that with a Wonderful Part of Fortune placement like this, you can truly speak Heaven, Love, Peace and hence Abundance, Prosperity, Luck & Fortune into your Life.

entry.title: Natal Venus Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
Your ability to express compassion and love were limited in your childhood. You might have felt unworthy of love or luxury in some way, this could easily be the opposite case too, where you felt entitled or greedy about money and favors. You might have problems in estimating your own worth and so, also that of others. You might even feel that you are not good enough, in some way, either physically or financially to live a peaceful life, so you might have poor personal boundaries in relationships which can cause huge problems. 


Or you might show superficial affection, stay in relationships for personal gain, etc. In both cases however, you feel you lack something or the other, so you might feel undeserving of consistency in efforts from/for others, especially in close-personal relationships. Money, luxury, and inner peace also become a focus of your life, where you will need to moderate your need or lack thereof. 


With this retrograde placement in your chart, you will need to find balance in everything you might be over-doing or neglecting, that includes your own self as well. Self-care and love become extremely important, especially in your early 20s where you might feel an overwhelming sense of imbalance in your life. So, correcting such patterns/behaviors, loving yourself enough to feel worthy of love, affection, care & comfort will be your prime focus. 

You might even have exceptional talents, especially in beauty, fashion, poetry, arts, politics, law, etc. that can help you access your Venusian side a lot easier and heal any self-worth issues, since with age you will develop a healthy self-esteem and hence finding the right balance both inside and outside of yourself.

entry.title: Eros (433) 💘✨ Mythology x Astrology of Asteroids
entry.content:
Eros is the Greek God of love and sexual desires. He is considered to be a God of Chaos (a primordial God of creation), yet most believe that he is the son of Aphrodite and Ares. Cupid is famously the Roman counterpart of Eros represented as an infant with wings, bow & arrows. In most of Greek Mythology he is often depicted as a youthful & handsome man with beautiful wings on his back, golden arrows & bow in his hands. He is considered to be a mischievous God who has the ability to strike love in the hearts of both mortals and Gods (when he shoots his Golden arrows, similarly when he shoots with his Lead arrows, he can make someone feel repulsed by another). He is responsible for most affairs, scandals, misfortunes and happy endings in mythology. Much like Aphrodite, he is respected as the god of love since he has the power to ignite passion for life and hence responsible for the continuation of it, so he is associated with Fertility. He is often worshipped along with his mother, but he is also a prominent deity who had many cults, ceremonies and rituals in his name. 


In most Greek versions, he was considered to be an irresistible being who could ignite the fire of love and passion in the hearts of those who saw him. His powers were not always just of love, since he also represents playfulness, passion, with lust & desire. His abilities included a maddening and overwhelming desire for love. Sometimes, it is accounted that he would randomly shoot his golden arrows which could make one lose logical reasoning and become consumed by love. So, most victims of his love-arrow-shot either had to face immense disappointments or had happy-endings. Hence, unlike his brother Anteros (who is a similar god of love, but he represents love that is requited, hence guarantees mutual love) he was not responsible for anything that he did, he often didn’t take any accountability for the outcome of his actions.   


There were many stories in Greek Mythology that involved Eros’s contribution, but most famous of them all was of his own. When his mother, Aphrodite ordered him to punish Psyche by striking her heart with one of his golden arrows to fall tragically in love with a hideous beast, he goes to see Psyche but falls in love with her at first sight. However, as an awe-stricken accident, he gets wounded by his own arrow that he was holding in his hands to shoot at Psyche, hence, falling victim to his own powers of love. Both Psyche and he had to go through many trials and tribulations in their own way to finally reunite as lovers. 


In astrology, Eros 433 is a key asteroid whose orbit is near to Mars. Eros placement represents one’s passions, desires, kinks, sexual interests, turn-ons/offs, etc. Eros can also represent:

How you express your sexual desires.

Who is your type, what turns you on in a potential lover.

How (& if or if not) you wish to experience lust.

What drives you sexually.

Who could be most compatible with you sexually and/or romantically.

What is your definition of love.

How (& if or if not) you objectify others.

How others may objectify you.

What makes you passionate, it can be hobbies, interests, skills, creativity, etc.

How you pursue your passions.

How you pursue commitments, for example, do you prefer long term or short-term relationships, etc.

How you express yourself in an intimate relationship.

How vulnerable or closed off, responsible or carefree, are you in such connections.

What is your sexual preference/orientation.

What qualities others see in you as irresistible.

What makes you attractive, etc.


It’s placement & aspects are most preferably seen in synastry and composite charts to determine sexual compatibility, attraction, kinks, intimate satisfaction, etc. between two partners which can add more information to their overall compatibility. Eros 433 is one of the asteroid placements most searched for in a chart to find one’s passions & desires. So, this placement and significant aspects in your chart can indicate your attractiveness, most desired qualities, sensual aura & sex appeal.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Libra (7th House) Generation 🌹✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)


Natal Saturn in Libra (7th House) Generation 🌹✨

With Saturn in the house/sign of relationships, contracts and public relations, can be a mix of polarities just like the symbol of Libra being a balance-scale. You are a humble and responsible person. You are graceful and respect your commitments. You have a serious and stoic approach to relationships of all kinds even when you are burning with passion inside. You are a just person and would never do or say anything that can hurt somebody on purpose. You might have a deep interest in law and justice as a whole. You might even do well in careers relating to the public, finances, fashion, entertainment, Human Resources, law, etc. You have a clear view of any situation that demands your attention especially if you are called to negotiate on behalf of someone else. Through your life experiences, you can be good with communication/people skills and know how to express your opinions. You are calm and collected in your interactions with others, especially in business/professional settings. Others often believe/trust your decisions, they may even come to you for guidance. You are well-respected and admired by everyone around you. 


The same way, you might feel that some people come to you only when they need something from you, or some may even intend to become your lifelong responsibility. So, you might feel that most relationships in your life are just burdensome, especially if they are constantly taking advantage of your kindness. You might have a lot of admiration for women/feminine figures in your life or you might even have troubles with/from feminine figures in your life or both. You are a great friend and a confidant. You might be shy or reluctant to new friendships but when you open-up to someone, you are willing to fully trust them and be their solace. You value friendships deeply. You might not always like a big social circle, but you surely enjoy your time with your most trusted friends. You will however have to be careful who you let into your life, even as a friend, since you might encounter many who may not have the best of intentions for you. You will also have to be truthful in your heart about how you treat those you call your friends, since any form of disloyalty will eventually get exposed risking your reputation.


Romantic relationships play a much more important role in your life. You are a loyal and passionate lover. You are always there for your partner no matter what the circumstance. You are dependable and compassionate. Hence, you will need someone who can match your loyalty in every way as well. But most of your early relationships (including romantic, business, or platonic) may have been extremely disappointing. You might have experienced a lot of difficulties like miscommunications, misunderstandings, etc. or even dangerous situations like abuse, manipulation, scandalous cheating, etc., which may have left you feeling devastated and robbed emotionally. You might have learnt a lot about yourself through such relationships leading you to reconsider your choices and introspecting on who truly deserves your love. This is a vital lesson that Saturn here will teach you throughout your early life. Since, in some ways, you might not have fully understood who you want, what kind of relationship suits you best and how it can truly make you happy. 



Marriage, hence, becomes a matter of clear perspective of not just your feelings but also practicality. You might have experienced major delays or disappointments in relationships that you rushed into without fully understanding your needs & how the other person may be a good fit for you or not. So, if you are considering marriage or a serious commitment, even when you are sure of the other person, it may be wise to wait and gain a full perspective of what you are getting into, taking things a little slower can save you a lot of trouble if there are any such possibilities. Especially with this placement, it may also be a wise choice to wait until your first Saturn return (29-31) before getting married if you are looking forward to one. Since, Saturn is the planet of binding & responsibility, so most relationships or contracts that you get into will be a lasting one, painfully or blissfully, either way, you will be committed for a long time with this placement. This can also indicate that, if you were ever involved in a toxic relationship, it might have been a lot of struggle and hardship to remove yourself out of it. 


Libra/7H also has an element of karma to it, so relationships in your life can have a touch of karma, somehow relating to your past life(s) or generational curses. Hence, relationships play such a significant role in your life for karmic reasons where you might even be breaking negative cycles & generational patterns. So, you can expect to reap karmic rewards in the form of a loving & prosperous relationship/marriage. You might be attracted to older people or even have relationships with a significant age gap, either way, you might be interested in mature and stable partners. Your early experiences may have made you reluctant to any relationship that is not peaceful and brings constant drama into your life. So, you might prefer to have a caring, compassionate, practical and responsible partner.



You might have similar experiences with business and professional partnerships where you could have seen your fair share of either toxic or trustworthy ones. You are a skilled negotiator, and you can have a good grasp on business acumen, so you will be able to make great strides in business deals and other professional contracts. You will however have to be careful while signing contracts, be it business or marriage/commitment related, since fraudulence or hidden clauses may become troublesome. You might even have to fight for your rights/freedom through the law & justice system. You have a friendly yet reserved personality that attracts a lot of people’s attention even when sometimes you might not be in the mood to socialize. You can make resourceful contacts and have helpful people on your side through your excellent people skills. You are a great host especially in a professional setting, you know how to convey your opinions and hence you can impress others easily. 


You might not like public interactions especially in a crowded event, but you enjoy your time when you are with your loved ones. You will have to make the best use of such occasions since you love to make & cherish happy memories. With time, you can gain a good reputation through your graceful demeanor and attain high social standing as well. You are quite popular even if you don’t acknowledge it. But you will have to be cautious of how you are presenting yourself to others. Since, if you are not sure of who you are, or if you don’t feel confident/comfortable enough, others may easily misunderstand you unless you openly express yourself. You might notice how every interaction with others in your life somehow adds to your maturity in a way. Hence, your biggest teachers are other people, who are a reflection of you (Libra/7H). So, you will realize a lot about yourself through those who love/hate you. 


You might have people who openly oppose you or envy you, but you are also someone who is not deeply bothered by such people since you are always looking for practical solutions and hence you don’t often mind responding to others’ spitefulness or petty behavior. Saturn here will expect you to hold yourself up to a high degree of standard when it comes to your interactions with others in all kinds of relationships/partnerships. Anyone who has devious intentions or has caused you grievances will be karmically dealt with and likewise, you will be expected to uphold truth and hence be righteous in how you treat others. So, any form of superficiality, envious/petty behaviors, negative intentions/evil eye, toxic patterns, etc. will also be karmically dealt with (either in your favor or against you depending on your actions/responses). This placement will bring you karmic justice & rewards, helping you in forming and maintaining balanced, prosperous, fulfilling & peaceful relationships.

entry.title: Natal Moon and Midheaven MC Aspects 🌝✨
entry.content:
Moon Conjunct Midheaven MC

☌ Your early upbringing had a profound effect on your world view and your purpose in life.

☌ Especially your experiences with your mother/maternal figure(s) and your family might have shaped your inner emotional stability. So, bad or good, reflects in your adult life and in your interactions with others, particularly in public/professional settings.

☌ You have a soothing presence that others are drawn towards. You make people feel at ease with your gentle personality. So, it is likely that you’re popular with a big social circle and helpful connections. 

☌ Your career path might involve you working with/for feminine figures, expressing your creative & artistic skills, healing/caring professions, or being in the public eye. Since you don’t mind sharing your time & efforts with others and enjoy their pleasant company. You’re also good with reading the room and hence you’re able to gauge the moods of others very well.

☌ You might prefer working on one project at a time, since you like to finish what you started with all the attention and focus you can offer. You also might not like to rush into anything. You take a lot of responsibility in the completion & success of your work.

☌ You might also be well praised for your work ethic, since you manage to put your all into everything you do. Although you might be temperamental depending on your external circumstances. 

☌ You’re quite sensitive to your surroundings and the people you’re around. So, negative/toxic environments can affect your moods significantly and hence your productivity. Wherever you work, you have the need to be needed, a sense of belonging & stability. 

☌ You’re also likely to be intuitive (may be even psychic), you seem to follow your heart while making important decisions in your life and your life purpose might feel like a spiritual calling to you.

☌ Your emotional fortitude plays an important role in maintaining the public’s support, since every-time you show inner strength & lead with calmness you might gain the respect of others and other times, when you lose your temper, or show emotional instability, others might be repulsed by you.

☌ You’ll likely create works that are close to your heart & inspire others; establish many endearing relationships in your personal & professional life; spread positivity & compassion; gain support, respect, comfort and prosperity in your professional life and hence feeling content following your purpose/calling.


Moon Sextile Midheaven MC

✱ You’ve a soothing personality that gives you a dreamy yet intriguing personality.

✱ You’re kind & compassionate, sometimes hyper-sensitive to other’s feelings. (Especially if Moon is in 8H or 12H) It’s also important not to always put others’ first and allow yourself to be loved by them just the way you are always there for everybody else.

✱ You have a rich inner world, so it’s likely that you’re creative. You’re also quite intuitive, may be even psychic. These spiritual qualities make you mysterious & alluring to others.

✱ You might be popular with many admirers who feel a sense of calm in your company. So, you likely have a big social circle & professional connections who play an instrumental role in both your personal & career life.

✱ Your inner stability is paramount to your outer stability. You likely realized early on in your life that you’ll need to regulate your intense emotions, since it affects public’s view on you. So, you maintain a calm & mature demeanor that helps you strengthen your connection with others.

✱ Your emotional fortitude also helps you focus on your career endeavors, giving you the intuitive edge to be productive and create incredible works.

✱ Your work is also an integral part of your emotional self, since you feel led to certain careers & projects. So, it's also unlikely that you would feel content settling for a job that doesn’t give you a sense of peace & comfort.

✱ You’ve an optimistic view on the world and your life path in general, since you often feel there’s a higher calling to whatever you’re doing, you sense a much bigger purpose to your life.

✱ You have a vision for your life and your works reflect your inner boundless creativity. You might be admired & respected by your colleagues & mentors for how responsible & sensible you’re with everything you do. Your workplace is also a place of comfort for you, so you’ll do well in positive & uplifting work environments whereas you might suffer in toxic work dynamics. 

✱ You’ll likely spread positivity & inspiration to the world; creating heart-felt & supportive connections; finding contentment in your professional & personal endeavors'; gaining respect, honor and prosperity following your life purpose.



Moon Square Midheaven MC

□ You’re a sensitive person with a lot of compassion for others. Although you might not be so good at taking care of yourself.

□ Your inner desires for comfort might not be compatible with your need to succeed in the world.

□ You have a lot of inner creative talents to offer to the world, so you greatly benefit from putting yourself & your works first, making your visions come true.

□ You see your work as an extension of yourself, and so, you feel the need to give all your care & attention in completing your passion projects. You might also be prone to overworking when you feel driven and vice versa.

□ Although you might find yourself feeling emotionally drawn to career(s) & projects but have a hard time directing your focus on the work when you’re dealing with emotional instabilities due to past experiences or outside circumstances.

□ You might have an intense need to be loved & to belong in the world, this might have been due to your childhood experiences or early romantic connections.

□ Your emotional wounds seem to have a hold on you subconsciously, and hence your drive for success might fluctuate. 

□ You’ll have to work on your emotional traumas, upbringing patterns, and subconscious fears about self & others in order to create a stable emotional foundation for yourself which in turn helps you accomplish your dreams & desires.

□ Self-love and balancing your relationship dynamics (of all kinds) will also reflect greatly on your public image, since your confidence & harmonious personal relationships give you a much stable & secure self-image that others are impressed by.

□ You’ll likely create works of inspiration; learn the importance of work-life balance; attain contentment, honor, & respect through your professional accomplishments and emotional stability, comfort & fulfilment in your personal life.


Moon Inconjunct Midheaven MC

^ This aspect brings out your inner fears & insecurities that may be hindering your worldview and career path.

^ You might have intense feelings of inadequacy, inner fears and even traumas that come from your early upbringing or childhood experiences.

^ You might feel unworthy of all the success you receive initially or feel like you’re not ready for big responsibilities & positions, hence sabotaging your own efforts in the process.

^ You might also feel the need to rely more on others, feeling safe and comfortable in the company of people you already, hence closing yourself out from meeting new people and exploring possibilities.

^ You might also form your opinions based on others’ input, more than that of your own, or through your traditional upbringing and, hence halting your self-development.

^ You might however reach a boiling-point due to some sudden emotional situation in your life which could trigger you to break out of your own emotional bubble, in a way leaving you with no choice but to face the world.

^ Being true to yourself and understanding your emotions will help you set yourself free from your deepest nightmares.

^ You will realize just how rich your inner world is, and how capable you truly are, motivating you to explore the world beyond illusionary restrictions.

^ You might finally find the perfect career path that helps you with your inner exploration to express yourself more creatively & passionately. Or you might start feeling more confident & mature in your abilities to handle responsibilities further adding to your accomplishments.

^ You’ll likely find your true inner self and face your fears; make significant jumps in your personal development; rediscover your own strengths & weaknesses; gaining more confidence, comfort, contentment & prosperity on your life path.


Moon Trine Midheaven MC

△ You have an optimistic outlook on life, and it reflects on your career endeavors and world view.

△ You feel passionate desires to accomplish great things and create works of inspiration.

△ You lead by your heart and this works in your favor since your intuition always guides you to be in the right place at the right time.

△ You have a strong emotional connection to your work and the people in your life. Your relationship with loved ones motives you to keep aiming higher in life, you also find support in others who believe in you & your capabilities.

△ You have a good sense of direction in life, you can tap into your inner knowing and recognize what your soul calling is and how to reach it.

△ Your emotional stability is also a key factor to your success, since you feel grounded and secure in your personal life, enough to give you the necessary strength to achieve your career goals.

△ You know how to read the room. You have good communication skills that helps you maintain good relationships with others on professional & personal levels.

△ You have a calming aura that attract many admirers who wish to know you more. You’re also alluring & mysterious, which can draw a crowd when you put yourself & your works out into the world, making you quite popular.

△ You equally focus on your work and personal life, so you’re capable of maintaining a healthy work-life balance. Although it is also likely that your emotional fortitude dictates your dedication in both areas, so you might easily over-work yourself or indulge in comforts excessively.

△ You’ll likely be an inspiration to your loved ones & the public through your career accomplishments; spreading peace & positivity in the world; gaining comfort, contentment, support, admiration, respect and prosperity following your life purpose.


Moon Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC)

☍ Your upbringing and childhood experiences play a much bigger role in how you approach matters of career and your sense of direction in life as a whole. 

☍ You might have had good times that helped you form healthy coping mechanisms and develop emotional stability necessary to face the world. You might have endured traumatic events/toxic households that either made you fearful of the future, further clouding your judgement on life purpose or it inspired you to strive for success and create a fulfilling life for yourself.

☍ You need a strong sense of emotional stability in your life to feel secure following your life’s calling.

☍ You might also wish to involve your family/loved ones in your career-endeavors and enjoy sharing the spotlight, recognition & success with them.

☍ Even when you know what you wish to accomplish in life, you might hesitate on following through your plans if you feel like you don’t have the necessary inner stability, or support from loved ones. 

☍ If you don’t have a stable or healthy relationship with your parents/family you might feel devastated with every lows & loses in your life since you might lack a sense of emotional grounding & support. So, you might even strive to create a harmonious & happy family for yourself in the future to fill that deep emotional void.

☍ You might also expect your work-environment to be your comfort zone, to work with colleagues who are dear to you as family members. Since a positive workplace is extremely important to your productivity and creative self-expression, so you might strive to create healthy workplace dynamics.

☍ You love to invest yourself in your career endeavors, you are responsible & reliable in your work, hence you easily gain the admiration & support of others, which adds to your motivation & drive to accomplish more.

☍ But you also have your moments of procrastination, (especially with other aspects/placements suggesting the same) due to self-doubts & insecurities that makes you feel trapped in your own emotional bubble making you unable to focus on your career life.

☍ You’ll likely learn the importance of creating a positive and secure emotional foundation for yourself & others; creating works of inspiration through your unique skills & talents hence making significant accomplishments; maintaining emotional & professional stability; gaining support, comfort, admiration, respect, honor & prosperity in your personal & professional life.

entry.title: September Transits 2024 ✨
entry.content:
September 2024 Transits

March • April • May • June • July • August • September • October • November • December
Sept 1, 2024 - Jan 25, 2025

Uranus Stations Retrograde
in Taurus 🐉✨


Uranus Rx in the sign of Taurus always highlights the areas in our life that need change. So, during the next 4 months, you are likely to feel a hint of dissatisfaction in some of those areas in your life (pay attention to which house Taurus is in & Uranus is transiting in your Natal Chart). That hint can either be a small yet nagging feeling, or it can be a sudden jolt of realization. ⚡️ In general, we will be compelled to take our financial & professional lives more seriously. You might wish to make sudden changes to your career or stumble upon a better investment.

Either way, you will know if this is Uranus’s Intuitive nudge or the Saturn x Jupiter Square tension creating anxiety within you. So, it is recommended to take your time in confirming with yourself and to use discernment before making sudden changes (highly highly recommended). Overall, since this will be the last to second Rx for Uranus in Taurus, you will feel the deep urge to make haste and complete certain projects that you might have been working on over the last few years. 🪭 Allow things to slow down to re-evaluate progress. This period will give us the opportunity to go over some of the details that we may have missed and to make modifications to our plans.

This Rx will be especially significant if you have been working on your self-worth/image issues, financial improvements, and career/stability related projects. 🪽 You might also be able to see the finish line at sight. There’re great rewards waiting for all the hard work & sudden twists in the road that taught us how to transform unpredictability into certain success. 🐉

  • Tumblr
  • Threads
September 2, 2024

Pluto Retrogrades
back into Capricorn 29°
One-Last-Time 🐦‍🔥✨


Things come full circle. It’s almost as if we have been waiting to revisit certain things in our past just for a brief moment. 🪻 Major endings, closing massive cycles & transforming through great changes. The next two months will be cathartic to say the least. Fears, sorrow, remorse, and even anguish from the past can resurface to be cleared out once and for all.

Excellent time for a deep purge. Concluding inner shadow work. Retrieving a wealth of wisdom from past experiences. Healing. ❤️‍🩹 Regaining your personal Power. Dismantling restrictive & dead-end systems in your life that have held you back in your past. 💗 Finding peace within. Moving forward towards a whole new life. Leaving behind things/places/people that you have outgrown. Deciding what/who can still walk with you into the new chapter. Major realizations and transcending past traumatic experiences.

This can be a particularly challenging time for your mental health, so be sure to let your loving support systems to help you when you most need it. Breaking free from the mental prison of fear, shame, guilt, etc. Stay strong, and know that you can tap into your inner resilience to overcome any obstacle (within/without). Be proud of your journey through the last decade in particular. A true Phoenix Rising from the Ashes kind of Spiritual Awakening. 🐦‍🔥

  • Tumblr
  • Threads
September 3, 2024

New Moon
in Virgo 11° 🎀🌑


Extreme self-criticism. Hyper sensitivity, especially to your surroundings. Susceptible to Psychic Attacks. Collective angst. High anxiety. Intrusive negative thoughts. Fears & Paranoia. Take extra care of your mental health right now, avoid stressful situations, people, environment, etc. for a few days. Take breaks periodically. 🧸

Humility and integrity can take you farther than ever before, even in tense situations, try your best to seek a healthy compromise. 🎀 Temporary setbacks. Connect to your loved ones for a sense of comfort & ease. This can also highlight areas of your life where there may have been a deep sense of imbalance building up quietly in the past few months. Handle stressful responsibilities one at a time.

Good time for self-reflection, but also for self-compassion. 💗 Breakthroughs in personal issues. Making new and improved plans for the future. Take account of your resources, choices & opportunities. New beginnings in health & lifestyle choices. Aspiration to seek new frontiers in career & finances. 💰 Grounding and inner growth.

  • Tumblr
  • Threads
September 4, 2024

Mars Transits
into Cancer ✨
September 4 + 6, 2024

Venus, Lilith & South Node
Conjunction in Libra 7° 🦢✨


Venus & Lilith in Virgo continued their tense opposition to Neptune even after moving into Libra, right before they met South Node and this previous Opposition has a profound impact on the current South Node Conjunction. South Node in Libra has bought the most powerful revelations about our relationships and inner harmony for the past year. While Chiron & Mars’s Conjunction to North Node made us more aware of our inner ego and strengthened our self-awareness, Venus & Lilith now will revitalize the connection to our inner feminine and there by making us more aware of our needs, wants & desires in life.

September 8, 2024

Sun Opposition Saturn 16°
+ Jupiter T-Square 🦢✨


Clear tension with your practical life with that of your inner-world. There may be extreme mental/physical health issues suddenly becoming more apparent. There may even be issues with finances. This T-Square with Jupiter in particular can highlight loses & deceitful behavior (your own or someone else’s), making things a little too unstable in your finances. Or, there may be stressful schedules & even realizations of toxic work culture that can lead to burnout & a possible outburst.

September 9, 2024

Mercury re-enters
into Virgo ✨
September 12 to 24, 2024

Sun Opposition Neptune
+ Saturn Opposition Mercury
+ Venus Opposition Chiron ☘️✨


In the wake of the Partial Lunar Eclipse, keep your eye out for these three Oppositions happening simultaneously. 1. Sun Opposition Neptune, 2. Saturn Opposition Mercury, & 3. Venus Opposition Chiron. ☘️✨

Saturn Opposition Mercury (Sept 18) will trigger our sensitivities, and dial them up to a 💯. We can become extremely self-critical & cynical towards others. Sun Opposition Neptune (Sept 21) can trigger many hidden insecurities. Careful with what kind of fears you are entertaining around this time. It can lead to heightened paranoia before you even know it. With these two oppositions particularly taking place on the axis of Pisces & Virgo (along with the Lunar Eclipse), we will need to be vigilant as to how our subconscious is perceiving the world. We can have self-doubts, become paranoid about the future, all the negative & horrific things happening in the world can directly affect our subconscious, fear-anxiety can reach new heights if we don’t exercise healthy coping mechanisms now, not to forget the psychic attacks in both your dream-state & in your waking life. 🪬

Venus Opposition Chiron (Spet 16) can be an incredibly healing transit. Your inner & outer worlds can find balance now, with a little bit of effort towards deep shadow work, especially that related to your inner feminine & masculine. You can now see the signs of growth in finances & relationships that may have suffered a little during the last two years. You can expect to feel a sense of liberation from inner fears & insecurities, finding newer ways to handle them, even overcome them. Healthy ego & mature inter-personal-skills. Social anxiety can heighten for a brief moment, but you can also find some positives in how to better handle yourself in groups & friendships later on. Find inner balance in everything that you do. If this overwhelms you, take time to indulge in self-care, work towards your passions, etc. This is a wonderful Opposition that brings the opportunity to move past our own inhibitions with regards to both our personal & relationship goals. ❣️

  • Tumblr
  • Threads
September 18, 2024

Full Moon
in Pisces 25° ♓️🌕


This will be an excellent time to shift your focus inwards and to ground yourself, preparing for the next phase of your spiritual journey. Paired with the Partial Lunar Eclipse & Neptune, this 🌕 will be enlightening on a personal level. A sense of calm can wash over you, even relieving you from the rampant anxiety & stress of the recent August Transits.

Any fears & insecurities that come up to the surface now, try your best to face them head on. Compassion & kindness towards yourself can help you overcome these worries effectively. Find solace in religious &/or spiritual practices. 🪬 This won’t be a great time to start anything new, but it will be a good time to start wrapping things up from the recent 5-6 months. Take time to de-stress, rest & sleep well. Avoid sensory & information overload as much as you can.

Overall, this will be a serene Full Moon. Reflective, Inspiring & Refreshing. 🪷✨

  • Tumblr
  • Threads
September 18, 2024

Partial Lunar Eclipse
+ Saturn + Naptune in Pisces 25° 🪬✨


Not to alarm or create paranoia, but this is not a great combination of Transits Conjunct a Partial Lunar Eclipse, at least on a global level. Pay attention to the events that have transpired in the last 5-6 months in particular, they will reveal a subtle pattern of both good & bad events to come (and to continue). Crimes will increase exponentially. New Health Hazards can emerge. Global Tensions will increase. Nature related Disasters will continue to haunt various parts of the world (which are majorly related to the ongoing Saturn Jupiter Square). 🤍

On a personal level, this can be a cathartic Eclipse, both leading up to the day & a few weeks later. Anxiety & frustrations can increase. Negative self-thought or even self-doubt can spiral you down into a panic. If you have depressive thoughts or anxiety attacks, I urge you to talk to a therapist or even just your loved ones 🥺, please take extra care & be kind to yourself. The next two years in particular will be extremely challenging to highly sensitive people, empaths and little kids as well. Take good care of yourself & your loved ones. Get good rest & sleep. 🦦

This eclipse in particular is a Transition from Aries North Node to Pisces, so you can start to see the results of your hard work from the past two years. Any personal projects & goals that you have been working on will come to fruition in the next 5-6 months. It will be a relatively busy time until the end of 2024, but it will all be worth it. Managing your time, mind & efforts will be crucial. Distractions will pop up here and there in the process, yet it will be much easier to manage them and to understand how to change your thought-processes, habits & lifestyle according to your current goals. I wish us all a great last quarter of the year. May we be safe, healthy, focused & victorious. 🌟

  • Tumblr
  • Threads
September 22, 2024

Sun enters
Libra ✨


Libra Season Begins

September 23 2024

Venus enters
Scorpio ✨
September 26, 2024

entry.title: Natal Mercury and Ascendant Aspects 🐹✨
entry.content:
Mercury Square Ascendant 

□ You’re a controversial intellectual, in a sweet way.

□ You love to think & analyze and encourage others to do the same since you often feel that people aren't paying attention to details and that can sometimes frustrate you.

□ You have a playful-friendly personality that sometimes can get out of hands and become troublesome to others, but there’s no situation your sense of humor can’t defuse.

□ You’re a lover of knowledge, you love to learn, dive deep into details, and vocalize them appropriately.

□ You often feel the need to express your ideas, that are thought-provoking to others. This is where you might be considered controversial since you don’t hold back on your opinions, and they are always on point no matter how bitter the truth might taste to others.

□ This also gives you many skills and talents that you actively indulge in, since keeping up with yourself is a challenge well received for you. 

□ So, keeping your mind busy & sharp is extremely important for your mental health, since listlessness can severely disrupt your enthusiasm.

□ Your voice, words, opinions, and ideas can create waves of change in the world (for better or for worse, depending on your intentions). 

□ You might be well liked and disliked for the same reason. Controversies, rumors, gossips about you are a part and parcel of this Aspect, that you may have to deal with skillfully. □ Indulging in such things yourself might not go well for you either and could affect your credibility in the view of the public.

□ Although, since this aspect might suggest that with Mercury being either close to MC/IC (in most cases) or in 10H/9H or 3H/4H, you might have to balance between your personal/home life and your career/public life. There may be troubles in these areas that affect the other.

□ Since Mercury is your conscious mind and Ascendant represents your personal aura, you might have to be actively conscious of yourself, with everything you say and everything you do. Since everybody else can clearly see it too. 

□ You might have to exercise patience, while facing stressful situations, since you might be prone to become impulsive or even over-share this can also be seen in your body-language (which you’re also skilled at).

□ Your popularity can soar every-time you express your truth in an honest & creative way. (The other way around is true if your intentions are no good).

□ So, you might find success in creative & intellectual careers where you can sing, act, write, teach, speak, etc. where you’ll be well-respected and admired.


Mercury Sextile Ascendant 

✱ You have a friendly and likeable personality that makes others trust you with ease and become your friends/acquaintances.

✱ You have a way with words, and you know how to use it for the good of others. So, your ideas and opinions are often well received.

✱ You might also be interested in many different topics/subjects that you love to study & learn.

✱ You are an intellectual at heart, but you’re also kind & know how to express your feelings (but if you’re being in-genuine others’ can easily catch on to it as well).

✱ You are able to articulate your ideas and opinion in a physical way through your body language and gestures that adds to your speaking/writing/marketing skills.

✱ This can also mean that you’re talented in many different things that need active mind-to-body coordination skills.

✱ You’re also methodical & patient in your general approach to life & career but sometimes you might seem impatient especially when you’re excited about a phase/project.

✱ You’re reliable and knowledgeable, which makes others trust your judgement & opinions easily.

✱ You might be able to gain the trust of those in higher positions/authorities who can help you further your goals & implement your ideas.

✱ (Especially if Mercury is in 11H/3H) You might find more success in teamwork, collaborative endeavors, since you have the skills to bring people together for a common cause.

✱ You might love to love, but more in an intellectual way, so it’s likely that you are more impressed by a person’s mind/mindset than only on their looks. This might also be the way others’ see you, they might love your intellectual side and find it to be charming.

✱ You’ll enjoy a good amount of popularity and success, with accomplishments & respect.


Mercury Opposite Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

☍ This aspect gives you a youthful personality that most people might find to be endearing.

☍ You love people and to be loved by people (and sometimes with insecurities involved this might escalate to people-pleasing behaviors especially if Mercury is in 7H, so it’s important to be careful).

☍ You enjoy working, organizing, you might have also been able to work since a young age or could have trained for a particular career (especially if Mercury is in 6H).

☍ You love good debates, exchange of opinions, healthy competition and are sportive about everything (although you might take things too seriously sometimes.)

☍ You’ve a compassionate heart, you are likely not judgmental, light-hearted and fun-loving.

☍ This friendly aura might help you attract a lot of friends who wish to spend time with you, and acquaintances who enjoy working with you. 

☍ You can express your feelings with words and this in turn makes others trust you easily. 

☍ Since Mercury is in 6H/7H, you might have a tendency to be invested in other’s lives than in your own, if not careful this might turn into co-dependency and might also cause problems in all kinds of inter-personal relationships even professional ones.

☍ You love to indulge in many different skills and enjoy doing them with your friends/loved ones.

☍ You will likely enjoy a big social life with many who love & admire you, a good social standing and satisfying personal relationships.



Mercury Trine Ascendant 

△ You are an intellectual and an endearing person.

△ You are liked by many for your friendliness, there’s a sense of fluidity to your personality that helps you adapt to different situations well.

△ Most people love to work with you for how resourceful and skilled you are.

△ You have a curious mind, and it always helps you learn new things and stay on-pace with the current trends and changes.

△ This trine aspect also gives you the charm & charisma necessary to make trust-worthy connections, be it romantic or professional.

△ You’re likely popular as a result of your big social circle. 

△ Many admire the way you express yourself and how well you articulate your ideas.

△ You might have good people & communication skills, here Trine energy gives you the ability to access your emotions and your intellect equally well. 

△ You might also have a soothing personality or voice that many are drawn towards.

△ Your career achievements will be inspiring to many adding to your popularity. You might be successful in careers that help you tap into Mercurial talents like writing, speaking, acting, marketing, teaching, etc. 

△ You might have to maintain healthy routines & create a balanced lifestyle, since it’s important to be health conscious with this aspect.

△ This is also true when it comes to being organized in your work life, since with Trine energies, you might be tempted to not take the opportunities seriously & chase distractions easily.

△ It is also important to keep your mind occupied with worth-while topics/subjects to learn since listlessness is your biggest enemy, which can make you anxious & affect your mental health.


Mercury Conjunct Ascendant

☌ This aspect gives you excellent intellectual and communication skills.

☌ You’re youthful, curious, and attentive, you’re also equally street smart & book smart.

☌ You might have grown up focusing on developing your intellectual skills, be it in school or extracurricular activities, since you are an active person who likes to keep busy.

☌ You might do well in careers that involve speaking/writing/multitasking where you get to express your ideas & thoughts openly with others.

☌ You have a captivating presence and might make good first impressions that attract many people towards you.

☌ So you’re also likely popular, with a big social circle of friends, acquaintances and family.

☌ You are however easily distracted especially when you are excited or anxious.

☌ There is also a concern, while expressing your opinions since you have a rational point-of-view, others’ might misinterpret you as being self-centered. So, it may be important to consider others’ opinions & include them in conversations to have a healthy balance of interaction.

☌ Most might consider you an intellectual but also cold & distant, since you might have problems expressing your feelings as easily as you do thoughts. So, you might find it paramount to be emotionally expressive especially with your loved ones.

☌ It is also important to not indulge in gossiping & rumors since you might be tempted to do so, and this can have a negative impact on public’s view on your ingenuity.

☌ Your career life is also in focus with this aspect since your cheerful, yet intellectual personality might gain you many resourceful connections & supports.

☌ You will enjoy a life of popularity, respect and happiness through your social and personal relationships/interactions.


Mercury Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant

^ This aspect can bring your insecurities to the forefront.

^ You often feel a sense of inadequacy about your intellectual talents, you might feel that you don’t have the necessary skills to hold a conversation or write your thoughts on the paper without crumbling them.

^ Your insecurities might tempt you to speak fast, exaggerate yourself, speak over others, etc. 

^ You might have to learn how to pace yourself more efficiently in order to have a good handle on your thoughts.

^ Since you might have an over-active mind that seems distracted and tangled in itself.

^ So you might have to consciously choose your words, body gestures, etc. instead of speaking empty words.

^ It might be a good exercise to organize your space, to help you feel comfortable and patient.

^ It might also be important to be truthful while expressing your opinions and not try to impress others with exaggerations. You will find that many will actually appreciate your skills and honesty even if you don’t believe so. 

^ You might have to improve your self-confidence to acknowledge your intellectual talents and fully appreciate them. If you feel insecure, you are also advised to pursue courses/subjects/studies that help you improve these skills even further. 

^ You’ll eventually find yourself being genuinely appreciated by others and you can expect to learn & enjoy the company of many new acquaintances & friends that you might be able to make on the way.

entry.title: Pluto Transit in Aquarius 2023 ⚡️✨ Mar 23, 2023
entry.content:
Pluto, the higher octave of “go-getter” Mars and Uranus/Aquarius who barely ever stand still, together heighten the intensity & curiosity phenomenally. From now, keeping up with the rapid change of time & technology will become vital for our own personal progress. Using the technological developments instead of being intimidated by their rapid growth in potential can be challenging, quite frankly overwhelming. With this transit, we have officially entered a completely new, uncharted terrain full of possibilities accompanied by old fears, where Adaptability is key. 


Making the best use of social media & the online world can bring a feeling of togetherness in the upcoming times of turmoil and possible discord. AI is taking the world by surprise already, taking a brief gasp before turning it upside down, momentarily. Since, Pluto has the habit of dismantling the themes of the sign/house that it enters into and exposing what needs to be eliminated and what needs to be transformed. With Aquarian Technological side getting a serious power-boost, we can also expect to see what lies underneath this sudden rise to power. 


So, even with the threat of AI possibly taking away millions of jobs with a single line of code or software, we can rest ensured that, such a future is not sustainable. So, even if mind-blowing technological advancements and AI threaten our livelihoods & possibly even our whole perception of reality, it is also important to know that human intelligence, ingenuity & creativity are positively & certainly irreplaceable. Hence, there is a good chance that we won’t be living in a dystopian technological world, at-least not anytime sooner. 



Pluto will encourage us to take back our power and invest it into our community. A shift in consciousness has already taken effect collectively, making us more interested in opportunities to correct social-economic systems, reinvent cultural structures, down to the subconscious programming. Aquarius rules our higher consciousness; intelligence that is rooted in knowledge, curiosity & humility. So, we will see many incredible inventions, scientific discoveries and technological leaps like never before. Coming up with out-of-the-box solutions to problems instead of arguing about the only possible solutions that we already know (which may or may not be good enough) will spark debates globally about every existing problem. 


Pluto’s presence initially brings all the fears & dread of possible chaos & uncertainty, but with it come the long-buried treasures. Understanding, learning and refining crude yet valuable resources will become our priority as well as responsibility. So, making the best use of everything that this transit brings will lead to a wonderful transformation both in our personal lives and collectively as a society. 


Finding smart yet reliable ways to invest, save and make money will become more of a necessity than an option for the next few years, especially since Pluto in Aquarius will keep bringing many surprises to our doorsteps and bank accounts, since Aquarius/11H are linked to share/stock-markets, investments, etc. and Pluto rules, banking, taxes, shared income, savings, etc. 


Pluto only destroys what doesn’t align with our higher purpose, so even through the chaos, we must be wise enough to look for the silver lining. We are currently witnessing the dismantling of old structures of doing/being/thinking, so confusion arises when we don’t know what/who to rely on. We will be called to come up with better & stronger rules/systems that can both replace the old ones and fix any loopholes or defects. This is probably the beauty of this transit, since now we have the opportunity, and dare I say, the Power to create the new structures that will endure for hundreds (possibly thousands) of years, consciously benefiting humanity & nature.
