entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Aquarius & 11th House ⚡️✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Aquarius + 11H + Uranus & Saturn Aspects + 11° 23° ⚡️✨


LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

Your Uniqueness effortlessly stands out to others, mesmerizing them. Your originality, quirky personality and even radical opinions can draw people in. This placement can attract people who are not just smitten with you but also inspired by you. Your brave, calm & cool demeanor can encourage them to adapt to such qualities within themselves. Your approach to certain restraining & confining aspects of life, culture or society can open people’s eyes to how they can liberate from such constraints themselves. So, there is a huge ‘DIY aspect’ to the effect you have on others, more on ‘an intellectual, life style & world view’ way. Hence, you can become popular & famous even notoriously so just by being yourself. This can make you an intimidating person as well. 


None the less, your views on the world, even if it is about your own life can inspire others to have a different perspective over conventional ones. Social Injustice issues & Activism that you are involved in can also draw in a lot of attention. So, you can gain followers based on your opinions & thoughts in general. Your ideas & ideals can hence be massively Influential. Intellectual pursuits can gain you both good Social connections & support, especially if you are involved in the Sciences, or Futuristic, even Altruistic fields. Your endeavors in research, invention & discovery can gain traction, funds, & positive feedback. 


You are very likely to draw in friends and acquaintances wherever you go, almost effortlessly. Something about you can make others feel as though they can trust & rely on you, making them feel instantly comfortable. Hence, belonging to a tribe, group or organization that best suits your interests & values become vital & easier with this placement, simultaneously making the people who are around you more proud & enthused to have someone as charismatic as you. You have a lot to offer to the world, your intentions & actions can hence be immensely Impactful. You can bring your Dreams and Aspirations to Reality through your Brilliant Intellect, thereby creating a Wonderful Future for yourself and others.


DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

This Sirene Placement can be very subtle in its negative manifestation, as you can encounter multiple people who would want to influence you with the wrong intentions. It is very easy to fall prey to cults & groups with toxic environments built within them, that can seem good in the beginning but turns oppressive & controlling in the long run. So, Social Justice movements with ‘good intentions’ but ‘bad ideologies & rhetorics’ can draw you in very quickly, but can go against your Core Values eventually as the mask slips. Hence, it is important not to get swept into Social Movements & Ideologies without fully understanding their true intentions & purpose. 


This can even be true for Political Movements & ideologies that are tied to Social Causes. Tribes & Groups that appeal to your vulnerabilities, Societal views & your previous negative experiences with injustice, can be completely on the opposite side of what your Values truly are. So, Radical Ideologies & Deconstructive Narratives of such groups can easily steer you in the wrong direction, distracting you from Real Solutions and possibly Peaceful Resolutions. Hence, you will need to be mindful of who has an influence on you and your views. You can expect Friends & Acquaintances in actuality to be Frenemies, Social Environments that become toxic and even Work Culture that doesn’t help you develop your Individuality. You might often meet those who are very much Virtue-signaling, chasing Popularity, Grifting or even Wealth through Fraud & Social Climbing. 


You might have had a hard time adjusting to certain Cultural & Societal views, even had problems with certain Authoritative Figures & Elders. You can be pushed to feel lonely sometimes with Sirene’s negative effects here. Finding strength in your Individuality and defending your opinions can keep you safe from being swept into harmful Group dynamics, and to honor yourself by accepting your Uniqueness. Your Originality, Courage & Self-belief are the Key to reforming both your Life and the Society as a whole, bringing your Ideals into Practical use, working on your Aspirations & Dreams to make them a Reality, benefiting both you the Individual & the collective.

entry.title: Black Moon Lilith Transit in Leo | Jan 8, 2023 ❤️‍🔥✨
entry.content:
On January 8th, 2023, Lilith entered Leo leaving the watery realms of Cancer. Lilith in the sign of self-expression, inner child, children, and creativity, will expect demand originality. Here, “you either go big or go home”, there is no patience for small minds and narrow views. The rage and internalized frustration will seek outlets in Leo’s themes. Lilith will stay in Leo until October 3rd, so we are already about halfway through her transit now (currently at 110).


Lilith represents our inner passion, power that is equal to the forces of nature, raw and untamed. In Leo, it is expressed as undeterred self-confidence, bold sexuality, graceful sensuality, eye-catching, alluring yet not easily attained. With Lilith, also comes shame, inflicted shame, forced guilt and sculpted victimization. This astrological point gains its full potential through turning injustice into a reason for rebellion, pain into power, vengeance into life’s purpose. So, there’s great suffering within the darkness, that brews and culminates into power.


You might have noticed a transformation taking place, what seems quietly happening within you, is loud when the rest of the world looks at you. Self-confidence issues that plagued you before, you are now finding strength to overcome immaculately. Sudden events that seem to be forcing you to face your fears, even people/places/things that make you feel powerless, making it more and more easy for you to process the pain & trauma instead of running from it. You are braver and stronger now, mentally and emotionally. 



Issues with body-image and self-image in general may be giving you the necessary motivation to make healthier lifestyle choices, even revolutionize your personal style, look and wardrobe. You might be more expressive about your emotions, especially honest with your opinions. You might be finding it hard to put up with anybody’s bs and getting more used to standing up for yourself & your loved ones. This will also help you put up stronger boundaries. You will be naturally prompted to raise your standards and allow only the ones that bring the best in you. Happiness, fun and loyalty become the absolute priority. Anybody/anything that hold you back from your ambitions naturally become “the enemy of your progress”.


You might also be more confident about your sexuality, battling through any guilt or shame, snuffing societal narrow-minded opinions. If you had issues expressing your sensual side, you will be able to make bolder choices and break away from any self-limiting beliefs you previously had, even if it’s just about being confident in your looks, in wearing make-up/grooming or well-fitted clothes, etc.


You might have been prompted to become more spiritual and find the inner strength to bring out your boundless potential. As a result, removing any emotional/mental blocks you had about creativity may be crumbling down. You will be able to integrate your intuition and psychic insights into your creative works. You are more ready to embrace your true self than ever through this transit, so making the best of this extra courage will help you access your creative subconscious, unhindered. Your passions reignite demanding you to give them form.



You might be slowly getting frustrated with what you are consuming as entertainment. This can include TV, shows, movies, music, social media, etc. Any signs of forced inclusivity, propaganda or cliche moral lectures can easily ring the “bs bell” in your mind. You might also be gravitating more towards people with talents, real talents, instead of just popularity. Also, on a small note, the “nepo-babies” controversy might take an even bigger turn, making the collective to feel repulsed by their force-fed media marketing. Low effort, minimal creativity that is only based on looks, affluence or trends might even get scrutinized (rightfully so). Recognition and popularity will shift towards truly deserving artists bringing them & their work, justice so to speak.


Children (kids/pets) can become a source of trigger to your transformational process. You might also be feeling more protective of children, seeing patterns and signs that alarm you about their safety. You might be seeing an awareness on global levels about children’s safety and their well-being. You might even be feeling more protective of your loved ones in general, finding strength in them by being able to take care of them. 


Your transformational journey includes your inner child as well. So, all the internal blocks that you will be removing during this transit will also help you heal your inner wounds. Resentment, rage and hunger for vengeance may not really bring you the satisfaction you need deserve, but taking back control over your life and empowering yourself surely will. Lilith transit in Leo this year will be a glorious one, where you will find your voice again, and finally… ROAR. With everything in astrology, this transformation too is a process, albeit a painfully rewarding one. So, expect great personal progress, increased courage, demolished restrictive norms, a more colorful and regal change to your life’s outlook with this powerful transit. ❤️‍🔥

entry.title: Natal Jupiter Square Uranus ⚡️✨
entry.content:
Recent: 1992-93, 2000, 2006-07, 2013-14, 2021. Next: 2027.


You are an innovative genius with a quirky personality. You have a strong sense of purpose that often involves changing the world in a major way, especially by fighting for worthy causes or by eliminating dangerous societal mindsets. You might however take things too far with your ideologies. Your life’s philosophy can inspire others and attract their attention, but your actions towards accomplishing those ideals may lead to disagreements and backlash. You have a strong need for independence and are dead set on never letting anyone/anything have too much power over you, but your need for freedom can sometimes seem like an act of defiance or extreme rebelliousness. This can create a tensed relationship with elders, parents, teachers, and/or authority figures.


You are a true lover of life, always trying to find new and exciting adventures. You have a depth of intellectual capacity that allows you to learn various topics and understand the nuances well. You are an exceptional ally to have since you are loyal and reliable. But you are also quite unpredictable which can cause trust issues with others. Your eccentricity can make you seem more individualistic which can cause tensions in group setting & communities. You will have to temper your extreme idealism in order to feel like you truly belong, since being upbeat & perfectionistic will only make you seem too unapproachable to others. Expecting sudden changes and enforcing your ideologies (no matter how crude or excellent) will only make you seem pompous and imperious. Instead of dreading mediocrity, by accepting old norms you can find inspiration to seek much more fulfilling & enriching experiences.


You have the innovative and realistic gifts to make a huge difference in the world. But you will also need to discern “when to play by the rules” and “when to bend them to your liking”, since not everything is about breaking existing rules and reconstructing systems from the ground up. So, any tendencies towards extremism & risk-taking behaviors will need to be carefully directed towards productive and constructive avenues. You are a true inspiration. You have an influential voice of reason, but you will also have to accept responsibility for your actions. You can express your true-self and claim your originality through experimentation and seeking eventual perfectionism, but you will also need to understand that sometimes being in the present and enjoying the simpler things in life can be equally fulfilling.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Taurus + 2nd House 🌷✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Taurus  +  2H  +  Venus Aspects  +  2° 14° 26°

LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

Captivating personality (even physical appearance & body language). Your strong Character coupled with your Natural Sensuality can attract a lot of admirers. They can easily become quite possessive of you if you ever give them the honor of being in your inner circle. Your Value Systems & High Standards can intimidate a lot of people but can also inspire them to do the best for themselves the way that you do. You can tap into the abundance of your family lineage (even if you didn’t come from a rich family). 


You have a humble quality to you that can elude you from even your own magnetism, so having a strong Sense of Self and a High Self-esteem is essential with this placement. You can attract people who are equally Trust worthy, with High Moral Standards and Praise-worthy Character. Your romantic life can also bring wealth & success, either through Income/Inheritance and/or through Successful Financial ventures. Your Personal Style, Sense of Fashion, Self-Care, Body-Image & Fitness, etc. can be extremely alluring to others. You might have a captivating Voice as well, and coupled with excellent communication skills you can maintain good Social Networks of Resourceful people. 


You can also attract opportunities that will help you build the foundation of Security & Stability in all areas of your life. Focusing on building a Legacy & an Abundant Life can bring you many Achievements in Life. Creating wealth, security and comfort in life for both yourself and your loved ones can also make you well-adored and respected by others. You might even recognize how you have certain innate qualities, virtues, nobility & talents that are invaluable, which can bring you both Monetary Success and High Social Status. 


 

DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

With this placement, it can be very easy to fall victim to fraudulent people, in romance, finance & life in general. You encounter those that try to portray themselves as someone quite Important & Valuable when in real they may likely have severe Low Self-esteem issues. The same way you can also come across people who are romantically (or even just sexually attracted to you) but deep within they don’t feel deserving of you. 


Financially, you can encounter con-artists here and there of course, the biggest Red Flags will however come from those around you, meaning your family, friends & associates who can take advantage of either your Lack of Self-worth in order to steal your hard-earned rewards in life, or to simply steal what you have. If you have Self-esteem issues, you can also become your own tough critique (especially of your body), this can either lead you into depressive/excessive eating or dieting beyond necessary, both can lead you into a Vicious Cycle if you are not careful. 


You might also encounter people who wish to ‘project their own issues’ onto you. If you are not careful, Sirene here can also make you extremely Money-minded, or you might meet people who are Money-obsessed and Shallow in personality. Being grounded and allowing space for gratitude will be very essential in avoiding the Negative side of this placement, hence avoiding people who don’t have such virtues will also be important. Seeing the Red Flags in others and standing firmly in your beliefs, values & standards can help you negate unpleasant experiences and avoid distractions (which may be created by both others & yourself).

Love & Self-Love, a balance that you can easily find now. With all the chaos & uncertainty in the Astrological Sky, this Full Moon can be strangely calming. Meeting challenges with Confidence, taking leaps of faith towards Ambitions & Aspirations. This 🌕 can test to see if you will be Truthful to Yourself & your Heart before making the Next big moves. Courage & Clarity towards Massive Goals will ensure Success. ✨

entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

Your focus will be on finances and career this week. You are fired up with just the right motivation and intuitive inspiration, ready to go after your goals. But Gemini, sometimes delays happen to take us on a detour, towards a much better place. But, the changes & circumstances you are facing may be too intense to ignore. Even your cheerful-self might find it hard to center yourself this week. There may be minor irritations in your family life that affects your concentration or your work responsibilities may make you too exhausted to even rest properly. So, finding the right balance between your personal life and career life will become a little bit of a challenge. 



Growing tensions in your surroundings or even with your loved ones can bring up some deep rooted insecurities with regards to your self-esteem. There may be major transformations taking pace in your finances that can make you concerned. But, the new & almost silent changes happening in your career will help you stay grounded and optimistic. Your intuition and logical reasonings can clash dramatically yet surprisingly bring up incredible creative insights. Some, memories of trauma can sneak up on you, disturbing your focus here and there, but you will also be able to utilize such opportunities to release any fears or hurt. 


You might find just the right people or interests as an outlet to your emotions, so you can expect some soulful healing conversations and revelations. There’s more to look forward to even if sometimes it seems a little too difficult to see the bigger picture. So, hold on Gemini, you are on the right track. Take some time to indulge in artistic skills and hobbies, or have yourself a good outing with loved ones. You will be able to utilize your enthusiasm more productively since you are quite active and lively. Connect with your inner-child and enjoy your free-time, especially if you have been tied up with work lately.

🐆 Starting hence New Cycles & Chapters, where your Passions & Ambitions will lead the way to Immense Well-deserved Success & Desired Abundance.

entry.title: Natal Mars and Ascendant Aspects ☄️✨
entry.content:
Mars Conjunct Ascendant

☌ S E X Y

☌ Strong-personal power. Extremely independent & assertive.

☌ Super-energetic, you might also be fitness conscious. Sports and outdoorsy activities excite you immensely.

☌ Impulsiveness will get the best of you every now & then, but other times it can open the doors to some exciting adventures, there’s usually no in-between.

☌ Entrepreneurial mindset, strong leadership qualities, hardworking and passionate.

☌ Something so attractive and equally scary about you that most people can’t help but admire you (some even from a safe distance ;P)

☌ You might come off as Extremely self-confident almost egotistical, so you tend to either easily attract or repel support in varying situations.

☌ You know how to stand up for yourself, and this can lead to troublesome battles which you won’t mind fighting & winning.

☌ Extremely competitive, usually a winner but at times when you do lose, you might refuse to admit defeat.

☌ If Mars is in 12H, you may need to be extremely careful not to hold back in arguments, and the complete opposite if Mars is in 1H.

☌ Either way, diplomacy and compromise in (especially romantic) relationships can save a lot of heartbreaks and misunderstandings.


Mars Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant 

^ Healthy ways to be assertive & taking care of oneself will be constant learning experiences in your life.

^ Being overly helpful may put you in problematic situations, carrying others’ troubles will prove to be burdensome.

^ You constantly doubt your own importance in social settings. 

^ Self-confidence is something you will have to actively work towards, since there is nothing wrong with choosing oneself before lending a helping hand to others.

^ You hold a lot of potential inside you, which will eventually seek you out on its own. 

^ All you have to do is, trust in yourself, and keep moving forward with confidence, which will be another (painful yet) important lesson throughout your life.


Mars Sextile Ascendant

✱ One of the few aspects involving Mars that gives one a fiery personality but doesn’t burn others with all that intensity.

✱ Independent, energetic strong-willed, Success-driven.

✱ Extremely Attractive, in all kinds of relationships & partnerships.

✱ Exercises & involvement in sports of any kind that adds to your muscle strength (even if it’s just being active) will also add to your physical attractiveness & personal aura.

✱ Extremely loyal, you will fight for your loved ones, no questions asked.

✱ Although, compromise may be a bit of a problem since you have a strong independent spirit.

✱ Quite impulsive, especially when involved in your passions.

✱ You must be cautious, since sometimes you could be distracted from the main goals.

✱ Brave & Opinionated, these Martian-qualities usually adds to your popularity.



Mars Square Ascendant

□ Raw passionate energy.

□ Popular for being both courageous and abrasive, also sexy in an intense way.

□ You can be a Great leader, but your intensity might tick people off way more easily than motivate them, so this is always a hit or miss.

□ Every word you speak and every step you take seems like you are in a battle, which can be both motivating and scary to others.

□ You may be quite tactless while expressing yourself, resulting in misunderstands and even aggression.

□ Frequent troubles in private and public relations. Quite chaotic in dealing with since they are quite important to you, but you don’t know how to resolve such situations most of the time.

□ Your confrontational nature usually comes in handy while fighting for the people & causes that you love. 

□ You are the best while you are working on your passions. Your aggressive drive for your passions can light a fire in others’ hearts easily.

□ Personal Relationships may suffer from lack of compromise and timely expression of true feelings.


Mars Trine Ascendant

△ Straight-forward, strong-willed, energetic and confident.

△ Sexy in a subtle way.

△ Quite popular with little to less negative attention.

△ A go-getter, you are success-driven, you usually have fun in competitive environments which will keep you motivated and humble.

△ Your friendly and welcoming personality will win over a lot of people.

△ You are good with expressing your intensity in a healthy way without offending others even by mistake.

△ Sports and physical activities will help you stay motivated & spend all that Martian excess energy in a productive way.

△ There is however a need to actively involve yourself in activities that will help you expend your excess energy, be it physical or mental, since trine energy can make one lethargic and lose track of one’s goals now & then and being physically active can negate the side-effects of an otherwise positive aspect.


Mars Opposite Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

☍ Extremely attractive, passionate, and bold.

☍ You have a Strong personal character, you’re not one to be messed with.

☍ You are friendly and compromising (but only) until confronted unfairly.

☍ A big social circle, with many friends and associates.

☍ If Mars is in 7H, this can mean many love-at-first-sight moments (on either your side or the others’). 

☍ Also indecisiveness may lead to impulsiveness, finding a balance between the two will become a vital part of your learning experience.

☍ If Mars is in 6H, this can mean a productive-competitive work environment(s) (but with secret sometimes openly troublesome attacks, enemies.)

☍ A lot of people may be attracted to you (even in non-romantic ways). But just as easily, a lot of people may hate you (usually for no-reason).

☍ Most people might mistake your friendly yet assertive nature to be arrogant (even when it’s not) and may make wrong assumptions about you, sometimes leading to unnecessary confrontations.

☍ You might have to face many battles due to simple misunderstandings usually from others’ side. So, this aspect can indicate that you enjoy a chaotic yet an eventful social life.

entry.title: Neptune Retrograde in Pisces, June 30 2023 | The Planet of Boundlessness will dip us back into reality 🎐✨
entry.content:
Neptune has been in its home-sign of Pisces since 2011 making waves of reality-bending changes in our lives. Now, almost at the tail-end of its transit, at 27º Pisces, Neptune goes retrograde from June 30, 2023 until December 6, 2023. Whenever a planet starts to move backwards (Rx), we are taken back in time to re-trace our steps and make adjustments whenever/however necessary. We have entered the densest part of transits. Pluto, Saturn, Venus & Chiron are currently in retrograde, along with Jupiter, and Mars joining the Retrograde Party later in the year. 


Neptune in Retrograde will take us out of our spiritual & psychic comfort zones, throwing us smack in the middle of situations that we were consciously and/or subconsciously oblivious to. There is always a sense of ‘a veil being lifted off of our eyes” when Neptune starts to move backwards astrologically. Neptune is the boundless, formless & limitless part of our human existence which seeks oneness, peace and spiritual liberation. So, during this period, we will feel disillusioned in the most confusing yet best way possible. Although, with Saturn also in Pisces (for the next 2-3 years), this ride won’t be an easy one. 


Saturn is also retrograde in Pisces until November 4, 2023 making his presence known. When Neptune goes retrograde, we feel the past resurfacing, Memories of the past becoming more and more clearer, with immaculate details than we once could recall. Seeking redemption for the things that we didn’t do, almost as a form of taking personal accountability. But with Saturn Rx here, we will likely feel unworthy of redemption or closure, i.e., we are vulnerable to letting our remorse & pain to consume our conscious mind, rendering us unable to let go of mistakes whether we were responsible for them or not. So, this (collective) Retrograde season will have a magnifying effect on everything good & bad, but focusing more on the wrongs than the right. 



Saturn’s influence can likely leave us feeling aimless (and beating ourselves up about that, w/ Pluto Rx in Capricorn). Old fears and illusions will now slip into our thoughts more easily, making us feel hopeless and powerless. Sometimes, this can also manifest as a feeling of disconnect from the universe/source/God, which can also mean that we start to doubt our own intuition greatly now. The disconnect from faith will further lead towards extreme rationality where everything is measured through practical means, further making us feel powerless and like a failure. Disillusionment and disenchantment, happen in almost a brutal way. Or, we will feel stuck in between the reality and other people’s illusionary bubble worlds, unable to find a way out (initially).


Depression and anxiety disorders will see a major peak, with many mental & nerve related problems becoming apparent. It brings a feeling of fatigue, as though we are battered emotionally, mentally & physically. If we are not fully aware of our routines, both conscious & subconscious ones, it is highly likely that we will start disassociating from reality altogether, almost as a defense mechanism, or in order not to deal with the traumatic memories that are resurfacing now. So, escapism through alcohol, food, substances or social media addictions can become harder to sustain. Chronic illnesses can resurface, especially if they are stress related. Overall, health issues are assured to make a come back, even if not severely, they may still frighten us especially if we have battled certain serious conditions previously. This retrograde period (at least until Saturn goes direct) will hence be a trying time, urging us to make necessary re-adjustments with regards to our health.


A decisive Opposition will take place around mid-August with Mars in Virgo (along with Mercury in Virgo). This can feel like a disconnect from your heart and mind, as if they are operating as two separate people. Highly critical reevaluation of your past, present & future can take place both internally and physically. You will however have to stay vigilant of anyone trying to hijack this crucial introspection, since they can easily project their opinions & insecurities onto you. Uranus Sextile Neptune and Trine Mars will help you with keeping this self-evaluation a sacred one which will ultimately lead to your conscious & subconscious evolution. Integrating your routines with rest, self-care with productivity, flow with stillness, and letting the past go with hope for the future will be helpful during this period (for the most part of Aug and Sept with Sun in Virgo’s Opposition).



People or situations that wronged you, will seep into your mind/dreams/thoughts, to either evoke a sense of nostalgia or fear based on your experiences with them. Strong connections to past events and people that you left behind will come up now only to be cleansed from your mind & energy for good this time. These experiences can intensify around the first week of November when Venus in Virgo will make a brief opposition to Neptune. Neptune/Pisces also represent unions and reunions, often speaking of soulful love, almost fairytale love stories. With Venus, the planet of Love & relationships Opposing Neptune, there may be tensions that rise out of nowhere. If you have placed someone a pedestal when they don’t deserve to (either due to your own high & fanatical expectations of them or through the effects of their intentional deceit & manipulation), such relationships may end abruptly, making space for true (divine) connections that can elevate you on your life path. 


With Pluto Rx (currently) in Capricorn making a wonderful Sextile to Neptune for a good few months, we will be able to relax a little bit, drawing courage from our inner-strength. Tests of faith will be rigorous yet liberating experiences. Breaking out of falsehood, toxic patterns and bonds will feel as pleasant as a self-care routine. However, with Pluto wrapping up a major transit in Capricorn good for a century or two, there will be an air of illusion which can make shadows seem monstrous before they are fully illuminated. Amidst all the fears, confusions and internal chaos, there are questions that will hit us hard, but will bring us back home to ourselves. “Do the people/situations from the past fulfill your hopes and dreams moving ahead?!? Does the past really matter to you in the present?!? What do you wish to bring along with you to your future and what do you wish to leave behind in the past?!? Are you committed to creating your dream-life abandoning everything/everyone that stand in your way for the good of all, true peace and happiness???” 


This Retrograde season, make the most of the realness that the astrological calendar presents to you. Raw truths and painful realizations can tear the safety nets that we may have unconsciously made our comfort zone. “Living on (such an) edge” will not be the best kind of life, since we all carry the innocence & divine light that deserve peace, harmony and true love. May this Neptune Retrograde help us breakout (gently if possible) of our comfort zones to make our dreams a reality instead of just a fantasy that we escape into. 🎐

  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Gemini (3rd House)

Your inner wounds of communication can have their roots in your childhood either from siblings/family or schooling/friends (even teachers). You might even feel like you need to speak a lot to make sense of what you are thinking or speak too little when you feel not welcomed in a place/conversation. You might have experienced challenges in your early schooling. You might even have been/or become the victim of rumors and gossip. You might feel ignored, or others read too much into what you say, either way, you often feel misunderstood. You might not know when to use silence and words as an answer. You might even over-explain your actions sometimes out of fear of misunderstandings. 


You might have been criticized unfairly as a kid. You will however have to be careful not to criticize others too harshly since you might just be projecting your wounds and insecurities onto others. In worst cases, you can be too cutting with your words even to your loved ones. You are gifted with many creative talents, and you can learn technical/mechanical skills. You are curious and quick-minded, but you will also need to learn not to let your curiosity make impulsive decisions. You have great communication & people skills, yet you hold back when you need to express yourself. You can use your talents as an outlet to express yourself when in doubt. 



You might not be thrilled about being popular at first, but you will eventually like the appreciation you receive from others. You can be a good teacher/mentor to others and a great friend. You can be too logical sometimes and be disconnected from your emotional self, so you’ll need to face your emotions even when you feel challenged to do so. Since, your words and communication skills greatly rely both on your intellectual skills and emotions. This makes you a heartfelt communicator. You can be an incredible public and motivational speaker. 


You have a lot of wisdom and experience that you can convey through your works and services. You will also need to be careful not to let negative mindsets ruin your enthusiasm. You’ll need to consciously reprogram your thought-patterns and think positively about yourself, others and life in general since pessimistic thinking can easily turn to self-sabotaging behaviors and potentially even hurtful confrontations with others. You have an inner child that needs attention and fun, since you might have grown up too early due to certain circumstances in your childhood. 


You can use your literary, artistic or marketing skills to best use in your career endeavors since you know how to make a good first impression. You are an avid learner, especially of people and their behavior, this can also help you advance in your career through good people-skills. If you have wounds related to family/siblings, you can heal that through forming healthy friendships. Your words, actions and works can be quite influential, so knowing how impactful you are will help you to consciously channel your healing journey into your works/services and inspire others in their recovery.

entry.title: Natal Uranus Sextile Pluto ✨
entry.content:
Inter-generational aspect. Recent: 1990s, Expected next: 2080s. 

You are a rebel, lover, revolutionary and a warrior of justice. You have a unique personality that is captivating, even though all you are doing is being authentic. You rarely entertain superficial people/behaviors since your presence alone commands depth and originality. You have a strong inner character that never lets you betray your conscience. You value your intelligence, both emotional & mental. You have empathy for others, but you have no mercy for betrayers and cowards. You might have dealt with dishonest and manipulative people early on in your life especially those who were in your friend's circle or were elders with some sort of authority/control. Such encounters may have made you more certain about who is worthy of being in your life and who isn’t. 


You don’t let restrictive mindsets and outdated belief systems to hold you back, if anything, you might get offended by those who try to oppress you with such intentions. Your ideas and general behavior are often considered controversial by elders, making you a natural rebel who is often at odds with authoritative figures, yet your daring personality simultaneously inspires the younger generations. You are a fighter and a leader. You move forward, breaking shackles restriction, seeking freedom and passion, transforming limitations into possibilities. You don’t settle for co-dependent relationships (romantic, friendship, business, etc.) and hence you will always leave toxic situations once you realize that they are only holding you back. 


You have ideas & ideals that are far ahead of your time. You are passionate and undeterred in your resolve. Your opinions command attention. You are an influential figure. People are drawn to your depth, intelligence, electric personality and unique perspectives. You have the ability to find resourceful people who believe in your causes and help you in creating an idealistic future together. You are able to bring out the genius in others and help them find their highest potential with ease (this can be vice versa). You are hence quite inspiring. Your reputation may precede you. You might have initial troubles while working with groups, but you have the ability to lead and bring people together to work harmoniously. 


You are determined to do away with any toxic mindsets, systems, ideologies that have been detrimental to the society. But no elder before you (& sometimes your own generation) may have not bothered to change or eradicate them out of negligence or some archaic views on how a society needs certain necessary evils, which you consider to be inexcusable. Your creative, intuitive and spiritual capabilities are strong, giving you an almost prophetic ability to predict the future (both the good and the bad) since you’re good at picking up on patterns (and even intentions). This also means that you have a strong connection to the collective conscious. 


You are an excellent problem solver; you might have a keen interest in technological, scientific and/or mathematical fields. You might even have ambitions of inventing solutions to solve major issues or have plans for projects that contribute to the betterment of society, etc. You have a strong moral compass which allows you to make use of your gifts in a positive & productive way. You have incredible manifesting abilities; you have big aspirations and are determined to make your dreams a reality. You will always keep making incredible strides on your personal transformation, often elevating you instantly to greater levels, hence your passions will keep getting more intense, helping you reach your highest potential on your soul path.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid at 0º (Natal) 🔥✨
entry.content:
0º is one of the most Powerful Degrees for any placement in a chart, and certainly with Sirene we are bound to see the Archetype of Sirene develop in incredible ways. You might feel the urge to explore your own Shadow Side, whether through innocent curiosity or the influence of someone/something outside of you. This Degree can greatly enhance the influence of Sirene in the respective Sign & House. So, you are likely to be a little apprehensive at first to recognize this placement (on a Personal level) but also excited to explore its potential. You can hence utilize Sirene’s placement through understanding your own Innate Talents & Natural Charm. 


Since this degree is also considered as a significant one, you are likely to see Sirene’s effects in your Chart more prominently. As 0º is the very first degree in Astrology, it can often indicate how we perceive things in life for the first time. So, when Sirene is at 0º, pay attention to the House & Sign, as you will very likely be surprised as to how profoundly Sirene here affects your chart. Hence, you will have to be conscious of your first reactions & impressions to everything related to that House & Sign placement in your chart. 


You are likely to encounter situations, people & places that may not be exactly who/what they claim to be. Your first impressions can hence be misleading, either through your own Innocence or through External manipulation. So, it is highly likely that having extremely High or Unrealistic expectations here can be risky and dangerous. Yet on the other hand, you are likely more driven to explore your Innate Talents and to honor your Inner desires related to this House/Sign. Sirene here at 0º can hence be the significant placement which can bring many life changing experiences into your life, potentially changing it completely.

entry.title: Pluto Transit in Aquarius 2023-43 | Pluto is back in Aquarius after 248 years 🦋✨
entry.content:
We will bear witness to a marvelous shift in the astrological calendar on March 23, 2023, as Pluto moves into Aquarius for the first time since the late 1770s (248 years). Pluto will transit back and forth between Capricorn and Aquarius till 2024, until it goes direct in November 2024 in Aquarius where it will stay for the next 20 years. 


Coming out of Capricorn in which it wreaked havoc for the past 15 years, revealing many government and power-structure corruptions relating to economy, security, control, misguidance and abuse, Pluto will step into the realms of freedom, revolution, technology, community and oneness. It will indeed be a ride into the future of humanity, destroying old structures to create a true Aquarian Dream. 


Pluto will find a lot of freedom when in Aquarius (much like how Uranus loves its stay in Scorpio). We can expect to see a massive paradigm shift that slowly starts from 2023.


On a global level:

Power now will slowly shift back to the hands of people rather than a select few. There may be outrage over the control and corruption through social media platforms & information media outlets. Exposure of misinformation and misdirection spread by technological groups. There may even be leaks or demands for disclosure of “classified information”. Group and community efforts toward solving many important societal issues. Humanitarian ideologies will become a collective focus as activism, environmentalism and conservational efforts take the center stage. 


Societal and cultural norms will see significant shifts. Individual rights and freedom may first see major compromises or even restrictions leading to mass revolutions to end any subversive dictatorial rule. Major breakthroughs in inventions, technology and science. There may be a rise in social media obsession which will soon reach a peak and transform into conscious ways of utilizing information & internet. Surveillance and information monopolization that have their roots in social media will face backlash or even take down from the general public. 



Like everything related to Pluto, there will be extremes in the way issues arise, are exposed, and dealt with all at the same time. Causalities of revolution may be too high if the reasons are blurred by rage & impulsivity. There may be major events in the technological world that will arise questions regarding the dangers of A. I./V. R, personal information on digital platforms, digital economy, etc. There may be a push towards equality, but to the extreme where everyone wants inclusivity in the notion that “everyone who participates must get a certificate just because” which can become a complex solution to simple issues rather than the other way around. So, this transit can either clear the way for a better future or silently get us closer to a dystopian one. 


Pluto in the sign of community, shared information & resources, technology and revolution will bring about an era of liberation in self & collective expression, freedom of speech and new ways of accessing/distributing resources. Gender & economic equality, sexual & gender identity issues, right to information, etc. will meet with defiance before finding their resolutions. Class systems based on economic and other discriminatory status may see a popularity decline. Global markets will go through major transformations, including digital & foreign currencies, stocks and taxes. Natural & energy resource management may face crises and later find consensual resolutions. Global efforts toward bringing a sense of oneness and encouragement of peace will lead to major leaps in collective evolution.


On a personal level:

You might become more and more aware of possible toxicity in your personal & social circles, be it family, friends, or acquaintances. There may be an urge to explore hobbies and interests that stimulate your intellect & mind. You might stumble upon studies and topics that seem to demand your attention and slowly overwhelm you until you are submerged in their research. Art, technology and science may take a much more integrated space in your life where you seem to discover and rediscover interesting & enlightening information. You might even find yourself delving into occult, conspiracy, mystery, sci-fi, or other such controversial topics.  Spirituality might become a significant part of your life. 



You might even develop kindred & soulful bonds with others. Those who share common interests and mindsets may become a significant part of your soul purpose. Healing with regards to issues relating to family, friends, trusted acquaintances, or social groups. You might feel the urge to join activism & movements related to community/global issues. You will feel the urge to remove anyone/anything that is toxic, holding you back from your goals, preventing you from attaining your highest potential, and you will have no mercy for deceitful/controlling connections/situations. There may be victorious resolutions to issues surrounding power struggles with authority figures (in tyrannical, controlling and overbearing situations). You might be able to break free from constricting traditional ideologies or even family dynamics in order to realize your true calling. 


You will be able to utilize this surge of transformational energy to manifest your dreams and aspirations. You will see extremes in your capacity of emotional expression, so, with conscious effort and healing you can use this transit to recover from attachment/detachment issues by developing a stronger emotional intelligence. Hence, you will find yourself focusing more on healthy relationships of all kinds especially with yourself. So, this can also provide a good opportunity to change any underlying negative psychological patterns in mindsets and self-talk. You might also become more adventurous in terms of leaving your comfort zone, pursuing your passions, socializing and expressing your opinions. 


Although you might have to be careful with taking risks since it is easy to overestimate/underestimate the actual gravity of the situation. You can expect to experience a transformation in your Self-confidence. If you are aiming to become famous or wealthy, or both, your authentic self-expression, individuality, resourcefulness and unique personality will be the key, since Pluto also rules karma, transformation, power, riches and influence. You might experience spiritual events with sudden insights and shifts. You can expect to make significant progress on your soul purpose through extreme ups & downs leading to personal transformation and hence reap karmic rewards on your journey.  


This transit will be one of its kind, bringing a much-needed shift in consciousness, societal change and collective evolution. Through the chaos and ruins of everything that no longer serve us anymore, will rise a Phoenix of transformation & prosperity. Pluto in Aquarius transit will usher in a brand-new era moving into the Age of Aquarius.

entry.title: Natal Uranus and Ascendant Aspects 🪶✨
entry.content:
Uranus Conjunct Ascendant 

☌ You’re a creative genius, with many talents & skills, full of great potential. Hence, from a young age you must have been able to accept your uniqueness and embrace all its gifts.

☌ You have an intense need for freedom to express yourself to the fullest. You rarely stay in restrictive places/situations/relationships.

☌ You have a vision in mind, and you likely won’t settle for anything less than extra-ordinary. You are also more inclined on working alone/for yourself than in groups/teams, although you’ve the potential to lead people and bring them together for a common cause, especially for social change & charity.

☌ You are knowledgeable, adventurous, and restless; always seeking new frontiers. You rarely ever settle for mundane routines, or jobs that don’t let you explore your ever expansive imagination. 

☌ You have an electric personality, you might tick people off with your brutal honesty, or your eccentric lifestyle. This is also why people love you, they might see you as a bold trendsetter, with a unique perspective on life, gaining you notoriety & popularity accordingly.

☌ Your ideas and visions are usually futuristic, making you think many steps ahead of the crowd. Most people might not be able to accept your opinions readily, but you’ll eventually gain support from those who have a similar mindset as you.

☌ You live life by a unique set of rules & morals, since you don’t necessarily follow traditions & norms, nor do you completely embrace them. You change with the tides of time, and so do your values.

☌ Your life is likely not normal. You might have experienced incredible things & events out of the blue, both good & bad. You gain maturity & wisdom through such incomprehensible (to others) situations. You might also actively seek exciting experiences, although you can easily be swept away into dangerous situations if you’re not being cautious. This can also mean that you need to be careful not to over-stimulate or under-stimulate your mind, since both extreme cases can cause serious damage to your self-confidence and mental health. 

☌ You’re in tune with your intuition (especially if Uranus is in 12H), this can prove to be your greatest asset. Since you know the importance of change and evolution, so you strongly discourage people to stay stuck & stagnant in comfortable places/situations. Your adaptability also gives you the ability to go with the flow and accept much needed changes often leading to better & brighter times. This can also be on a physical level, where you might suddenly change aspects of your appearance, lifestyle, attitude, etc. You might even be psychic with many spiritual gifts that you value a lot as you grow older.

☌ You’ll likely be a conduit for great change, both in your life and that of others; create incredible things/works/projects that help you showcase your intuitive/creative gifts; inspire many to embrace their uniqueness and to think from a different perspective; gain & share knowledge, wisdom, compassion, happiness and positivity.


Uranus Inconjunct/Qiuncunx Ascendant

^ You might have grown up feeling like you were the odd-one-out. Since, in a way, either your environment/upbringing didn’t encourage you to embrace your uniqueness, or you felt uncomfortable doing so yourself.

^ There might have also been instances where you “got into trouble” for speaking your mind or going against certain rules/traditions etc. no matter how innocent/silly that was. So, you might have learnt not to express yourself openly ever since.

^ You might have also been pushed to follow rules/traditions, live a certain lifestyle, or behave a certain way to suit your family/societal expectations, etc.

^ All those early life experiences, whether big or small, had a significant impact on your personality, and hence on your self-confidence.

^ You might have learnt a lot of lessons as the result of certain restrictions, that proved to be valuable to you as you grew older. (If not careful, you might rebel against all odds and welcome many troubles into your life, possibly even well into your adulthood, gaining notoriety for recklessness or irresponsible/disrespectful/unapologetic behaviors.)

^ You might have learnt the importance of patience, endurance, discipline, self-control and solemnness as part of your maturity. 

^ As you grew into adulthood, you might slowly get the chance to express yourself and explore all your untapped potentials.

^ All your early experiences & wisdom help you to stay grounded & humble enough to harness your latent talents and hence create many incredible changes in your life through the intentional use of your unique gifts.

^ You are once again able to embrace your personal intensity and present it in a more relaxed, controlled and acceptable way, which can gain you a lot of respect & popularity.

^ You’ll likely accept the need to harness your intense inner emotions & needs to direct them in a more responsible & productive way; create inspiring works/services that can make a positive impact on the world; use your incredible gifts to create necessary changes in your life and that of the others; gain & share wisdom, innovative ideas, happiness & positivity using your unique charm.



Uranus Opposite Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

☍ You might constantly feel the need to be defensive. You might have rebelled as a child, and those experiences might have left you feeling that’s the only way to react to people who have different opinions than yours.

☍ You might easily feel like you’re being pulled into a conflict even when others are stating their opinions, this is especially true if they’re talking about you. This can be vice versa, where you are the one constantly pushing people’s buttons & picking fights, even if it's just for thrills.

☍ You might have learnt however, that unnecessary confrontations, especially with those you love, never works out in the long run, since you might lose them over seemingly unimportant reasons.

☍ You might have learnt the importance of maturity, consistency, compromise and compassion through painful endings or situations.

☍ You might also be prone to justifying your actions by blaming others, or claiming to be unbothered but in reality, you might just be holding onto your ego and being stubborn.

☍ Your relationships in general may be a big, unusual & exciting chapter of your life, with many twists & turns. You might not really like some of the revelations that you get to find out or others may find out about you.

☍ You have an insatiable need for independence, yet you might want people who can keep up with you. This might not always work out in your favor unless the other person (especially in romantic terms) is also equally eccentric & adventurous as you’re.

☍ There may be both good and bad situations that can pop-up in your personal life with this aspect. You might either be interested in non-traditional kinds of relationships or find the perfect match who can be your happily-ever-after. Your friend's circle is also an important part of your life. 

☍ The more you engage in unsettling & unorthodox relationship dynamics (even in work partnerships, etc.) the more you might find yourself feeling ungrounded and prone to risk-taking behaviors to cope with such highly stimulating experiences. There may be a need to pace yourself, your eccentricity and your intense desire for freedom; since you might already be all that you ever wanted to be and have all that you hoped for, so now you might just have to take time to enjoy your blessings & hard work. 

☍ You’ll likely understand the importance of acknowledging others’ opinions just the way you value yours; learning how to pick your battles instead of living in constant conflict; cherishing significant connections and balancing your needs with that of theirs; allowing life’s lessons to humble your eccentricity (sometimes erratic side) to ground you and hence give you the opportunity to present your uniqueness with integrity & modesty; gaining & sharing wisdom, positivity, happiness and respect.


Uranus Square Ascendant

□ You’re proud and independent, you don’t mind walking alone and going off on solo-adventures.

□ You might have many creative (even intuitive) skills. You fully embrace your uniqueness, your eccentric personality and all your quirks even though this level of self-acceptance didn’t come easy at first and evolved over-time.

□ You also know how to bring out the best in others, although you might hold yourself back from connecting that deeply with others. 

□ You might have deep insecurities about being controlled or feeling trapped in restrictive patterns/relationships. In such actual situations, you might develop serious mental issues, so you actively seek independence with all the freedom in the world to help you learn more and do more.

□ This aloof and eccentric attitude might sometimes slip out of bounds, and hence can cause huge riffs in your personal/professional relationships. 

□ You might burn important bridges and not even worry about the consequences. These heartbreaks might even further encourage you to risk losing other connections in your life, eventually causing a lot of remorse.

□ You might often feel conflicted with maintaining healthy relationships with others and focusing on yourself. With maturity, you might realize how important certain connections are and how to cherish them without feeling the need to compromise your freedom.

□ You are an incredible force to be reckoned with, since you know who you are, and what you want.  You have boundless potential, and you actively harness it in productive & innovative ways.

□ You have a lot of passion and drive, you might however feel reluctant to work with others, or find it hard to compromise on team efforts, etc. This extreme sense of independence and non-conformity might prove to be troublesome in fulfilling most of your wishes, since you’re also a visionary, and you have bigger ideas that can impact others’ lives, their mindsets/opinions & perspectives, which can’t be accomplished without the support of others.

□ You’ll likely create inspiring & innovative works/services that help change the collective perspective; live a life of fun & adventure embracing your untamed individuality; learn the importance of maintaining balanced-healthy relationships that ground you & simultaneously ignite your passions; understand the values of compromise & diplomacy in order to stay grounded and respect others’ opinions; gain & share wisdom, knowledge, positivity & happiness.



Uranus Sextile Ascendant

✱ You value eccentricity, in yourself and others. You have a unique perspective on life, and society as a whole.

✱ Although you’re extremely independent, you are also friendly and love to interact with others. You likely have a big social circle composed of people from all corners of the world with different opinions and ideals.

✱ You know how to blend the old with the new, so you don’t rebel without a cause, nor do you stick to traditions unreadably.

✱ You are a visionary. You’re able to alter your mindset to keep up with the changing times, but you’re also good with analyzing patterns and hence, at understanding how the future might unfold.

✱ This is also due to your strong intuition. Whether you’re consciously aware of it or not, you can tap into your psychic abilities and bring out the best in you.

✱ You are able to focus all your will into bringing your visions into reality, no matter how outlandish it may be in the current times. You know how to put a unique spine on your ideas & opinions that attracts the attention of many.

✱ You have an agreeable personality, since you know how to easily showcase your ideas and interpret them well-enough to gain support from others. 

✱ You have an optimistic mindset. You never take “no” for an answer, you’ll not be discouraged even if your ideas are rejected/reviewed over and over again, since you know success is just around the corner. This positivity and faith in yourself usually pay off in the end.

✱ You need a lot of mental stimulation. You’re not just a logical being though, you also crave emotional bonds with others. You have good people & communication skills, which helps you form many resourceful connections and endearing relationships. Your likeable-reliable personality also attracts a lot of admirers & hence popularity.

✱ You’ll likely create inspiring works; spread positivity & happiness; bring people together to work on important social causes; encourage positive change in the world; gain and share wisdom, knowledge, innovation, and support. 


Uranus Trine Ascendant

△ You are an optimistic person, with a lot of faith in what you can do and accomplish in life.

△ You embrace your quirks and uniqueness with no room for self-doubts. This level of confidence might not have been easy to cultivate, but you likely reached it through all the wisdom from your early life experiences.

△ You like to march to the beat of your own drums, but you also don’t mind dancing to the beats that others enjoy. This ability to adapt and accept others as they are, without judgements makes you likeable and endearing. Hence, you likely enjoy a big social circle, even leading to popularity.

△ You are a visionary, you let your ideas evolve over a certain period of time before taking any actions towards them, but when you are ready, you take the leap of faith and land safely on your feet.

△ You have a strong intuition, a spiritual blend to your personality. This keeps you grounded and well-balanced, or at the very least, even in your worst times, you are able to appear well-put-together. You might even have psychic abilities that you are able to integrate into your life path.

△ You know how to express yourself, and your innovative ideas, no matter how futuristic they may seem. You use your creative/intuitive abilities to bring incredible ideas into existence. Your clear mindset helps you interpret these ideas & visions to their finest details, hence gaining support and encouragement from others. 

△ You might have experienced restrictions no matter how minor or major they may be, that made you understand the importance of independence. You value your independence; you encourage the ability to freely express oneself without unnecessary restrictions. You likely might also involve yourself in activism & fight for social causes and support those who need their voices heard.

△ You know how to embrace change, since you understand how valuable positive shifts in life can be. You might also like to keep evolving on a personal level, in appearance, lifestyle, attitude, etc., some of which might come as a sudden surprise to others.

△ You know how to blend your visions with that of others. You like to spend time working with others, learning interesting new things, sharing opinions, making memories, etc. yet you also love your solitude, gaining more knowledge, hobbies & talents, refining your skills, etc. so you likely have a healthy balance of self & others. 

△ You’ll likely encourage yourself and others to embrace positive change; to lead with optimism & compassion; work towards a better future; create innovative works/services; inspire others break out of their limiting mindset through your own journey & experiences; gaining & sharing wisdom, knowledge, support and happiness.

entry.title: Black Moon Lilith 🌪️✨ Mythology x Astrology of Asteroids
entry.content:
Lilith, the first wife of Adam, meaning she was one of the first humans created. Since she was fairly equal to her husband for her rights as a human being, she often expected to be respected, supported and valued the same as Adam (especially by Adam himself). This soon turned into internal fights, disagreements and power struggles in their relationship. In some versions of her story, it is believed that Lilith was expelled from Eden for being presumptuous, and in other versions, Lilith left Adam to get her independence (aka the first divorce of mankind). So, depending on the version, she is either viewed as an arrogant woman who was too prideful or the first feminist who was seeking a simple yet profound sense of equality. Accordingly, she is either viewed as a demon (hence, the mother of all demons). 


Lilith’s mythology is presumably the most famous of all, with varying versions, written from a million point of views. Yet, her presence in mythology is immense no matter where and how she is described. Similarly, in astrology, she is represented by different points, namely, Black Moon Lilith (Mean), Osculating Lilith (True), Waldemath Black Moon Lilith (Dark Moon) and Asteroid Lilith (1181). Lilith being true to her “untameable force of nature” personality is hard to lock down in one particular calculation or point, and so, we have a few different ways of calculating her (the first three mentioned above), each giving their version of Lilith placement in the chart, varying only by a few degrees at most. These points refer to the farthest apogee of the Moon in its orbit. Although, Black Moon Lilith (Mean), is often the preferred point of calculation for Lilith. Some may prefer to calculate Osculating Lilith or True Lilith as well. 


Lilith in a chart represents our inner natural instincts, primal desires, untamed version of ourselves that can scare us and others at the same time. It can also represent:

Where you feel restricted, bound by traditions or rules that are hindering your personal growth.

Where/how your need for independence can shake up certain set of rules or systems of organisation.

Where/how you will be forced to live a life that you do not resonate with on a soul level.

Where/how you will have no choice but to rebel and find your own freedom.

Where you will be ostracised, excluded, blamed, banished, demonised, criticised, etc. for choosing what you want, for putting yourself first.

Where/how you will be condemned by unfair systems of society, like patriarchy or religion & culture, etc. for going against the norms.

Where you feel a lack of support.

Where/how you will be targeted unfairly and victimised unjustly.  

Where you are the rawest version of yourself.

Where you tolerate no non-sense from others.

How you view your sexuality.

What are your sexual desires.

Where you will feel sexualised by others. 

How others sexualise you in a form of criticism or other gaslighting techniques.

How you secretly wish to express yourself, both physically and sexually.

Where/how you are initially misunderstood and hence feared.

Where/how you are hated without much reason.

Where others wish to know more about you, mostly to know about your dark secrets.

Where you either naturally command others’ attention (sometimes unwanted) or are ignored unfairly (depending on the placement and other aspects). 

Where/how others will have extreme opinions about your character and/or intentions.

Where/how you will be pulled into controversies, and vice-versa, where you will create controversies either for good intentions/bad intentions or sometimes just for fun (that clearly goes out of hand).

Where/how your inner femininity may have been targeted and experienced trauma (either in this lifetime or the past ones, or both).

How you can heal your inner feminine side. 

How you associate with your inner femininity (regardless of your gender or sexual orientation).

Where you are the most intuitive and possibly psychic.

Where/how you can integrate your raw feminine energy with your intuition to utilise both in a more profound way as powerful outlets to creativity and innovation.

Where you will fight for your rights, against subjects of equality and discrimination that constantly surround you.

Where/how you will have to fight for yourself, even if it means you are the only one on your side.

Where you must never excuse anyone for trying to control, dominate or belittle you. 

Where you must reclaim your independence.

Where you must never give up your independence but also where you must be careful not to let your need for independence to sabotage potentially healthy connections, and to be careful not to let your ego to sabotage good opportunities.

Where you must control your urges for vengeance in extreme forms.

Where you must unapologetically command respect and uphold your integrity. 

Where you must also have self-respect, find self-acceptance & self-love, etc.


Lilith, being a polarising character in mythology can represent the same characteristics in astrology, where its placement and aspects can give one a drastically controversial personality, where either the person is hated or adored, or both. With a prominent Lilith placement and/or aspects in a chart, you can expect to command attention, extreme opinions, fight for what you are and who you want to be, etc. Lilith is a powerful representation of raw femininity in the chart, hence it is also a placement of exceptional manifestation energy. This is a placement that can grant you the freedom and rights that you deserve, the strength to fight for your desires and unapologetically own your dreams, ambitions and integrity.

This week, be sure to take extra time for yourself dear Taurus. You are healing through continual pain that has been surfacing up, you need all the self care and peace of mind right now, to think objectively and make the best decisions for your mental & physical well-being. This week, however, you might be branded as selfish or egotistical for holding up your boundaries. Your self-worth and confidence are going through immense upgrades where you are more sure about your needs, wants & desires clearly. Holding onto your self-worth and integrity are becoming your No. 1 priority. Those who truly love you are silently celebrating your growth and confidence, but those who suddenly seem to have a problem with your refined boundaries may have never appreciated you in the first place.

No doubt, within the first few days of the week, you will find your answers.

There is a quite change taking root within yourself, slowly transforming you from within, Taurus. Remember to add fun to your schedule as well.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Scorpio + 8th House 🐦‍🔥✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Scorpio + 8H + Pluto & Mars Aspects + 8º 20º 🐦‍🔥✨

LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

This is one of the most powerful placements for Asteroid Sirene, but also the most dangerous, so caution is paramount. You are extremely sensual, alluring and magnetic. Your personality can captivate anybody that you wish to charm. There are likely many Secret Admirers in (all areas of) your life. This is especially true in your Romantic life. You are likely desired by many, but being Unapproachable & maintaining a Sense of Mystery can work in your favor. You also likely have an excellent Business Acumen that can make you quite successful. You are shrewd & ambitious in Money Matters and can often attract the right kind of Financial Partners. 


You can be quite intuitive and even inclined towards spirituality. Your passions & ambitions can be both intimidating & enchanting to many. You are extremely Emotionally Intelligent and good with words, quite enticing in many ways. You have a Powerful Presence that instantly captures those around you. You likely have many (many many) Secret Admirers, some of whom may even fantasize about you. Many may fall in love with you but some can become quite fearful of you right after, even if they don’t have a reason to. 


You can attract trustworthy people (who can also become quite obsessed & over-protective of you) overtime with the Highest of Intentions and well-suited to your Ideals. You can also attract a Romantic Partner(s) who is equally Powerful and Resourceful, so you can likely Marry into Money, Inherit money through your own family (or both) and/or create Monetary Success together with your Spouse. You manifest & work towards Excellency, Great Success and Abundance in life. You have the Power of Pure Intentions to achieve your Ambitions and wield Great Authority if you so desire to (again, emphasizing on the “good” part of intentions) where even the universe will equip and cater to you with whatever is necessary. You have Karmic Blessings & Protection that will help you overcome numerous challenges and transform Pain into Power.



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You often encounter Malicious and dare I say, quite Formidable people. They may be obsessed with dismantling your life. You are likely to be surrounded by frenemies as well. There can be those who scheme, plot & derail you into an entrapment, not just in terms of Finances but also Sexually and Social Status-wise. It is hence important not to commit yourself to any kind of partnership/relationship without first discerning others’ True Motives. Temptations for infidelity and cheating are likely when dealing with inherently manipulative & devious people. But most importantly, (in any kind of relationship) you are advised not to waste your loyalty on those who don’t deserve it, not to hold onto such relationships and to let go of them as safely & quickly as possible. 


Since, in relationships (of all sorts) there can be those who wish to create power-dynamics where they want to dominate you, suppress you or even disempower you either to gain control over you or just to feel superior. On the extreme side, you might have to deal with jealousy, envy & unreasonable hatred. On the extreme - extreme side: Severe Emotional, Psychological & even Physical Manipulation. So, you might learn some gruesome truths about the dark human emotions, intentions & wickedness. This can also be true when it comes to Spiritual Attacks (even involving Dark Arts) which can not just be directed at you but also towards your family & loved ones. 


Vicious rumors & falsehoods can plague you especially during your younger years (and towards your early adulthood). You might even have been victimized in someway. There is an almost ‘otherworldly essence’ to you that these kind of people will want to capture and misuse if not to destroy. But you are also bestowed with Incredible Resilience and a strong Willpower that will help you overcome any challenge no matter how arduous. Standing in your Power, owning/reclaiming it and whenever necessary “showing people who they are up against” will be essential with this Sirene placement.

entry.title: Venus & Jupiter Conjunction 2025 • Aug 12, 2025 💗💐✨
entry.content:
Venus’s Conjunction with Jupiter in Cancer opens up a Bright and Beautiful phase in our lives, especially in our Relationships & Finances. The two Great Benefics of Astrology together in the Serene Water Sign of Cancer will bring many Positive Changes & Rewards, filling our lives with Joy, Peace & Prosperity.


With Jupiter in Cancer, your focus is on your family/personal relationships, where there are likely Positive developments happening in your Private Life, be it in improving your bond with loved ones, releasing Negative Karma within your Family (/ Blood Line), celebrating Newness in your Home Life, etc. Venus now will add more Optimism, Love, Harmony & Luck to these areas of your life. 


You can expect to see Expansive Growth and Prosperous Opportunities to further these changes in a more balanced & grounded way. This can be the Perfect time to organize get-togethers, House Warming Ceremonies, Parties, Weddings, etc. the kind of celebratory events that can bring all your loved ones together. The same can be true about children, where you might welcome new Members of the family (either your own or your extended family’s). Marriages & Engagements can feel extra special and promising.


With other excellent Aspects in the Astrological Sky during this Conjunction, there will be many opportunities to reunite with those that you may have fallen out with or lost touch with for whatever reason. So, rekindling friendships and other relationships that bring you genuine joy will be a great thing to consider. This can also emphasize on valuing balanced & healthy relationships, instead of those that are chaotic & destabilizing. You will be able to discern which ones are worth your effort & which ones aren’t. 


With Venus & Jupiter representing the Divine Feminine & Divine Masculine Energies, your Romantic Relationship can significantly improve. You might meet a Potential Love Interest who may just be “the One”. If you are already in a Fulfilling Relationship, your Love can strengthen and grow in beautiful ways. You will be able to resolve misunderstandings or imbalances in your relationship, making it more profound & energized with Positivity. You might even take things to the next level, in whatever way you choose to honor this New & more Fulfilling Love. There will be a Spiritual & Destined aspect to your Romantic Relationship that will be undeniable. 


Overall, this Conjunction will greatly strengthen your Values & Ideals, encouraging Positive relationships and Prosperous new opportunities to develop healthy dynamics. Spend invaluable moments with your loved ones, form stronger bonds and close out cycles of dynamics that aren’t healthy. For at least the next week or so, try to spend more time with friends & loved ones, as these interactions will bring more Positivity, Luck & Serenity into everyone’s lives. Even small gestures of love to show how much you treasure your family, friends (especially childhood friends), partner, etc. will bring so much joy & light.


Money & Financial Stability will also be on your mind as well, where implementing new Business Ideas, Financial Strategies, Work Projects, etc. will bring huge Profits & substantial Lucrative Success. This is a wonderful time to invest in Big Monetary value things like Cars, Houses, Jewelry, etc. Buying surprise gifts for your loved ones can also be a simple way of expressing your appreciation & love. If you wish to, you can also involve yourself in charitable activities around this time as well.


This Lucky Conjunction can open up Portals for Manifestation, where you can bring Dreams & Aspirations into Reality. You will be able to envision a Life of Prosperity, Luck, Love, Abundance, whatever you wish to accomplish and have. Incredibly Powerful & Attractive of all things Wondrous, for a Sweet & Blessed Life. Consciously maintain an Optimistic & Forward-Looking Mindset. Bring more Laughter, Joy & Light-hearted fun in your own unique way. Expect huge Positive Karmic Returns, Blessings & Abundance in all forms. 💗

This retrograde placement can initially create confusions in your sexuality, or possibly even making you uncomfortable in expressing yourself sexually/romantically. You might have been objectified by others (or vice versa) which may have left you feeling disrespected or even exploited. You might not know what you truly desire in your partner, or what kind of relationship satisfies you both physically & emotionally. You might even feel disconnected from your sensual self (or the complete opposite). 


It is important to not entertain distractions that only seem to lead you astray from your true desires and not to repeat unhealthy patterns, since you might end up hurting others and yourself trying to prank or play in love/relationships. Taking responsibility for your actions and holding others accountable for theirs can help you in the long run. 


You might experience relationships or sexual encounters that will make you want to go inwards and meditate on what your true desires & fantasies are. If you have body-image and/or self-confidence issues, this introspection can clear up your internal struggle regarding your attractiveness and even your sex appeal.
