entry.title: Natal Lilith Square + Opposite Moon ✨
entry.content:
Natal Lilith Square Moon & Lilith Opposite Moon bestow astoundingly Strong Intuition along with serious Emotional Depth. Sharp Emotional Intelligence, wise beyond years and intensely Spiritual. During the early part of your life, this combination can make you unaware of your own true Emotional Nature. Our childhood shapes our Inner Emotional World but this aspect holds significant influence over these matters to the full extent of it all. In many ways, you are also hence likely to find clarity over ‘all that makes you who you are emotionally’ later on in your life, especially in your mid-teens and onwards. This then makes you painfully aware of your Inner world, its depth, its darkness, its light, its grace, its beauty, its ridges, everything. 


In general, you likely have Unconventional relationships & Private life + Lifestyle as a whole. You can read people like a book, especially their Shadow side and their intentions. You have a very Intimate relationship with your own Shadow Self, sometimes at the risk of merging with it. Fears, deep dark fears. Intense Feelings & Emotions, Mood swings like tectonic plates shifting, you never know when they can cause an earthquake, and what kind of volcanic eruption or tsunami it can trigger. It’s almost as if you have hidden your Raw Power within your Shadow Self.


As our Moon represents our Mother + Family, Lilith’s aspect here can emphasize on your early & close personal relationships. You’re likely to have experienced extreme Co-dependence & impossibly High Expectations from Parents & Family. Unusual or Unconventional Parent, where at least one parent (or other family member) lived a self-indulgent lifestyle + emotionally manipulative. This may have included a parent with hovering & obsessive attitude during your childhood or the parent was distant & absent. This of course may have led to a painfully deeper understanding of Emotional + Psychological Manipulation and Abuse. 


They may have at times gleefully enjoyed playing with your fears & deep insecurities, to perpetuate a cycle of unfulfilled emotional needs & creating a terrible feeling of being unsafe emotionally. This hence could have driven you to a state of being unable to feel safe in Close Personal Relationships, especially with parents &/or family regardless of how the dynamic played out. Now, this can also indicate to step-parent(s), foster or adoptive parents/family, even extending to friends or kins emphasizing on certain impactful childhood relationships. Thus creating a strong sense of apathy towards early Personal relationships. Eventually, either you get ostracized by them, or you choose to cut ties with them because you don’t feel genuine reasons to hold onto the relationship any longer. 


Hence, abrupt endings in Personal Relationships are to be expected with this aspect, especially where there is Power Imbalance and Lack of Trust & Transparency. You might even realize that you are attracted towards people/relationships that lack Emotional Dept and so they can’t provide Emotional/Spiritual nourishment, probably even in turn may siphon out nourishment from you to fulfill their needs without reciprocating. You will learn the harsh lesson of choosing yourself & your desires over family’s (loved ones’) expectations. You will learn this through the previous experiences, the true cost of sacrificing your needs, wants & desires to keep the balance & peace of someone else’s emotional state, to the point where you may become unapologetically driven by your own desires & needs and care not for anyone else’s expectations what so ever. 


Thereby attaining Emotional Sovereignty through years of grit & tears, lessons from emotional wounds that left a scar on your heart. You will hence also painfully understand the importance, “the Power of Boundaries”. This can however lead to extreme Self-Reliance & Independence, later on creating problems in maintaining Close Relationships, if it’s not done through a healthy approach & intention. Dynamics & Life circumstances that swing to extremes may lead to eventual fatigue w.r.t. such relationships. This can also affect future relationships where emotional intimacy can cause distress & suspicion instead of physical & emotional contentment due to the lack of emotional safety that was developed during early childhood experiences. 


Exploring your sexuality may come about either through temptations or inspirations, all of which may depend on your emotional state. Sexual control, either of yourself own or someone else’s (others’s) may be a bit of a tendency (which can either empower you & your relationships or cause deep troubles). Falling for people who you want to save, but for the most part they may be hopeless and dangerous. This tendency may have been a reflection of the relationship dynamic with your parent(s) somehow, or reflects how your parents’ dynamic was with each other. This can of course leave you vulnerable to all kinds of troubles, especially of being taken advantage of through your kindness, having to mother them, or even being used as a substitute to take out the resentment towards their own mother. 


You might have Inner Conflicts with regards to being happily & safely in a relationship (of any kind) vs. being goal-oriented & free from commitments. You yearn for emotional depth in your relationships but you might have a hard time coming to terms with the responsibilities of such commitments, be it in family, friendships, marital, parent-children/pets, or romantic relationships. You may come to realize that you seem to carry huge Inner Wounds with regards to being a nurturer, whether you think you are not fully capable of such a responsibility or that this responsibility may threaten your Independence. It is likely true about all personal relationships where commitment to unconditional love & care is absolutely expected from you. You may be running from committing yourself to relationships that need you to take on a protective & supportive role, which could mean that you may have to give up on your freedom in someway. Or, you may feel more comfortable in relationships that burn bright and fade out just as quickly, settling for toxic & potentially threatening relationships. Such avoidant tendencies can further fuel the cycle of pain. 


Allow yourself to lead by your magnetic personality that may be a little odd yet filled with intense emotions. Understand how you hurt yourself and/or others when you don’t feel fully secure or in control of a relationship. Face your darkest fears & insecurities that may be driving you towards extreme self-reliance & independence, potentially making you afraid of commitments, or when you repress your true desires & emotions that can lead to violent outbursts, resentment & apathy leading to destructive behaviors & self-sabotage. Expressing your raw emotions in a safe relationship (this also includes with yourself) will give you the confidence you need to master your intense feelings & fears alike.


Intense, Emotionally Engaging & Mature Relationships, where you feel true comfort & safety to be yourself are the absolute best for you, thanks to this equally unusual aspect. You can turn this emotional need to nurture someone towards a more fulfilling direction, perhaps to someone who may have been through injustice or betrayal, who may have suffered and healed, who needs unconditional love & support. The same is true w.r.t. to children, pets & other relationships where you need to be vulnerable & provide unconditional support. Even when you hesitate to take on such responsibilities, there will come a point in your journey where you may need to take on an emotional connection that will require you to step out of your own comfort zone & lifestyle. With discernment, you will be able to commit yourself to the right connection(s), if anything you are encouraged to do so, as it can in-turn heal your Inner Wounds all while your presence & care can heal the other. 


This aspect combination can greatly indicate to strained relationships with Women (especially the mother, but in general most women that you may or not know as well). Societal expectations & their idea of morals may clash with your ability to see and tell the truth as it is. Since, you often witness how the rest of the world would rather ignore the actual immorality & injustice within its own systems & imperfect laws. Your observations & actions on so called controversial & taboo issues can potentially make you an Outcast from family &/or society. This is hence a prime ‘scapegoat aspect’. Moreover, you may have been victimized and turned into a scapegoat by someone or some people at least once in your life, where the burden of carrying the shame, lies, deceit or ignorance of these people was placed on you so that they can keep the illusion of peace in their dysfunctional system (family, society, organization, company, team, class, etc.).


Rising above such injustice, avenging your own self, along with overcoming the unfair labels that such people place on you, these are soul challenges that will trigger an awakening within you. Since understanding & completely analyzing the Darkness that you were put through will awaken the Primordial Divine Feminine within you. You literally ‘turn Pain into Power’, as you take back your Power, Dignity & Freedom, courageously standing back up & walking with your shoulders broad, head held high & proud. Your transformation hence will unlock the deep Potential within you to be both a Benevolent Nurturer & a Fierce Protector of everyone & everything that you love (starting with yourself through Graceful Self-love). This will indeed be an empowering inspiration to many who may be going through similar challenges & injustice in their own life. You might even feel guided to fight for causes that are often considered taboo around marginalized & vulnerable groups of individuals, especially women & children. 


You are deeply connected to your Subconscious & Spiritual Side along with your Shadow. You likely have experienced Paranormal & such unusual things especially during your childhood. Although, these experiences may not have been Pleasant for the most part. Through the Subconscious, you are also able to develop a connection to your Dream World. So, this aspect’s influence can show up in your dreams, where your emotional state and everything you are experiencing in your daily life can impact your dreams. Vivid nightmares & lucid dreams, even brief episodes of Sleep Paralysis are greatly amplified by this aspect (along with other Placements & Aspects of course). Likewise, this aspect can also greatly enhance your Intuition, Psychic powers, ability to Astral travel, Spiritual sensitivity & gifts.


You are very much likely to also become the target of Darker Forms of Magic & Spells, where (very likely) someone from your family may have dabbled in such Dark Arts directing it towards you. Or, close family member(s) may at some point have been the victim of (someone else’s) Dark Magic. This can even be true with someone somewhere down in your family lineage may have created bad Karmic consequences & Ancestral curses that may be affecting you now in this lifetime. Or, you may have carried bad karma, dark attachments & curses from your own past life that you may need to deal with now. 


In one way or another, you are likely to be susceptible to Spiritual Attacks, Evil Eye, Dark Spells, Psychic Sensitivity, etc. that you may not even be aware of until you’ve been through quite a lot. However, these experiences awaken you to your own Inner Power to protect yourself & your loved one’s Spiritually. You are just as Powerful and hold significant influence over these matters in the Spiritual Realm. Karmic Consequences to those who dabble in such unpleasant & taboo arts is highlighted by the influence of this aspect, along with Divine & Karmic Protection over you against such attacks. You are protected & covered in many ways, even when you go through incredibly hard times you are likely protected from much larger forces than what you experience.

entry.title: Natal Saturn and North Node Aspects 🐘✨
entry.content:
Saturn Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ There may be a strong reluctance in pursuing your destiny, due to lack of support from others.

^ Being neglected, ignored or treated coldly by elders/parents (especially the dominant parent)/mentors could have turned into deep childhood wounds.

^ You might also have an inner resentment towards such elders and always seem to clash with authority figures or feel restricted in your path no matter what you try to do.

^ With age, you will be able to gain more confidence in yourself and also able to trust authorities/elders in general who will be receptive to your needs.

^ As a result, you could have experienced pessimism, depression, lack of purpose, etc. especially during childhood.

^ There may be a need to develop good decision-making skills, discipline, methodical approach, and understanding how rewarding hard work & persistence are.

^ You will have to continue working on your self-esteem, step goals and make realistic plans without the fear of rejection/opposition, since with time you will find supportive people who will guide you towards your destiny.

^ Staying on-course, believing in yourself enough to dream big regardless of all the discouragement or negative projections will become your important life lessons.


‌Saturn Opposite North Node

☍ A challenging yet rewarding aspect. Early life could have been riddled with feelings of lack of purpose and a sense of destiny all at the same time.

☍ You might have understood the (painful) importance of duty, or you may be forced to assume responsibilities (even at a very young age).

☍ There may be a danger of being bound to restrictive habits, mindsets out of fear of leaving the comfort zone, and so welcoming new & innovative ideas might become a challenge. As a result, you could come across as pessimistic, hyper-critical or cynical.

☍ This attitude could easily slip into your view on life purpose. If not careful, you might miss opportunities to develop personally and spiritually due to your negative mindset and reluctance to accepting fresh ideas.

☍ You might have grown up learning how important persistence, hard work and self-discipline are, giving you a strong character.

☍ You will have to adapt new and positive mindsets, to overcome the stagnant cycles you seem to keep going through over and over again without much satisfaction, since combining optimism with your great work ethic will reward you with stable foundations and help you redirect to a life path that's more aligned with your true destiny. 

☍ Here Saturn will teach you how important structure and organization are, yet how to go with the flow following your karma without resisting it because of old/outdated ideologies.



‌Saturn Square North Node

□ This aspect creates a sense of lack of control over one's purpose.

□ Your life seems to be riddled with obstacles and challenges, often testing you to the brink. 

□ There may be a strong personal sense of duty and high ambitions that you actively seek to pursue. But the constant feeling of being over-burdened can leave you exhausted.

□ As a result, you might feel compelled to become pessimistic, losing a sense of self even, since you seem to associate your hard work & self-identity with your ambitions & goals.

□ The rejections might even leave you feeling defeated and to give up on your dreams altogether, making you feel even more miserable.

□ Difficult relations with father/parent figures, authorities can add fuel to the disappointments you experience in your life.

□ There may be a difficult relation with the general public at first as well, during your early teens for example, yet with age, your mature and solid character can easily dispel all the misunderstandings others have on you.

□ With age & maturity, you will find that persistence and self-discipline pay off with big rewards. This can mean a good position in society, well respected, may be even highly honored for your dedicated work, wealth and status.


Saturn Trine North Node 

△ This aspect is rather a special one, Trine energy is difficult to cultivate, yet since the strong driving forces involved here are Saturn & North Node, it creates a powerful sense of destiny.

△ Hence, there is hardly any chance for lethargy or lack of ambition (even in trying times) that Trine energy brings, in fact it is the exact opposite, with increased focus on one’s life purpose.

△ You could have been an inspiring and charismatic character from a young age.

△ You could have been through many challenging situations, often resulting in productive outcomes, helping you master skills, learn patience through the process.

△ It’s as if all the difficulties seem to arise when you are aligned with your destiny (more like positive lessons through obstacles) and when you are off course, you could experience stagnancy leading to restlessness, making this an indication as to if or not you are on the right path.

△ Your struggles inspire you to accomplish more, and push even harder, giving you a practical yet positive mindset. This quality often attracts the respect and admiration from others.

△ You may also be blessed with mentors/elders/authority figures who seem to guide you through your journey, helping you mastering skills even.

△ You are focused on your path, even with many detours and mishaps, you seem to be determined to achieve your truest potential.

△ This aspect gives you the ability to accept your flaws much more easily, with an optimistic outlook.

△ You will likely attain a good social standing, wealth and respect with age, blessed with the karmic rewards of your past endeavors.



‌Saturn Conjunct North Node

☌ This aspect helps to easily access the good graces of Saturn. You are patient, persistent, grounded, & organized, making you reliable and well-respected.

☌ There is a potential to attain good social standing, especially through your career endeavors. 

☌ You may be blessed with mentors who guide you through life's troubles, (especially after your 1st Saturn Return), giving you a sense of support.

☌ With a career or not, your life may seem very eventful with many situations often showing up as obstacles and rewards for work well done, helping you attain mastery in everything you do. 

☌ You may be compelled to find new ways of doing things, merging the old with the new, traditions with innovations. 

☌ This can give you the ability to attract the admiration of both elder and younger generations equally, since you know how to blend-in with both.

☌ You look serious yet heartwarming since you can connect to your inner self easily, which could have been a challenge during your young age. 

☌ This aspect doesn't mean that you will be rid of all the restrictions and burdens that Saturn often seems to bring, but quite the opposite. You will however learn how to effectively face such challenges, reaping many karmic rewards for the same (this is really true for any Saturn x North Node aspect). 

☌ You have a steady focus on your goals, and often seem to be working dutifully to fulfil your purpose.

☌ Karmic path and destiny are both intertwined in this aspect, which makes the journey towards North Node that much more rewarding, giving this aspect a sort of cleansing quality. 


Saturn Sextile North Node 

✱ This aspect gives one an optimistic outlook on life (surprisingly, Yes!). 

✱ Much like most other Saturn aspects, your early years could have been filled with challenging situations, often coming in as blessings-in-disguise. Yet you seem to gain more and more courage with each obstacle you overcome,

✱ You may be blessed with mentors who could have been particularly harsh on you, but you still harbor a sense of respect towards them since you had the opportunity to learn many important skills/lessons in the process.

✱ The challenges and difficulties you face time & again seem to always be redirecting you on better and much better paths towards your life purpose.

✱ If anything, all your struggles and consequent victories could have inspired you to create a stable and strong foundation for yourself growing into your adulthood.

✱ This resilient attitude gives you a certain charm that garners admiration from others (especially during & after the 1st Saturn Return), often inspiring others.

✱ The patience you learnt throughout your early years will eventually lead you to a path of good fortune, with karmic rewards.

☁️ A quiet empowerment that can both resolve your inner insecurities and reignite your passions. 


☁️ Although this New Moon will demand a level of mastery over your Inner Self, Sub Conscious & Unconscious Mind. 


☁️ Attaining Spiritual & Emotional Maturity can become a worthy ‘Self Awareness + Actualization’ Goal now.

☁️ Along with a positively charged + supportive Sextile to Uranus in Taurus, you’ll have numerous opportunities to cultivate your Dreams, Hopes & Wishes through a practical perspective.

☁️ Focus on what you wish to achieve both in your life and in the world. 


Wishing Prosperity, Happiness & Collective Good. 💫


Many hugs, Much luv.

xo 💕

entry.title: Mercury Retrograde begins in Taurus this Summer | April 21, 2023 🌷✨
entry.content:
This summer, a particularly significant Mercury Retrograde starts on April 21st right in between two powerful eclipses. With Total Solar Eclipse in Aries on April 20th and a Penumbral Lunar Eclipse in Scorpio on May 5th bringing in intense energy shifts, if you felt a sudden drop in your energy levels, feeling particularly drained and lethargic, like you are dragging your feet and forcing yourself to do even the simplest of things, then Mercury Retrograde in Taurus is here to make it a little more challenging yet rewarding. So, get ready to take a lazy day off whenever you feel the need to, because this ride will be draining and exhaustive, for all the right reasons. 


Mercury in Taurus has been a wonderful transit, giving us the clarity of mind to see things for what they are, assert practicality, restore our self-esteem and voice our desires more courageously. You might have noticed an increase in your focus and productivity, with an intense passion to prioritize responsibilities since the beginning of the month. On 21st, with Moon in Taurus, closely Conjunct Mercury & Uranus, your need for stability and comfort will be both rational and intuitive. 


Mercury retrograde comes with people/places/things from our past, some unwelcomed and others surprising. Taurus related: financial opportunities, previously planned purchases, previously unsuccessful plans, career/business proposals, etc. may show up unexpectedly. Along with the Uranus-Moon Conjunction & Mars Sextile, doors of opportunities that were closed before may open up in due time as blessings. Mercury retrograde will bring relationships from the past as well, so using discernment while letting in anybody from the past will be highly advised. 


This also applies to triggers and traumatic flashbacks, which may have already started to creep up at the most unexpected moment. Since we are in Eclipse season, it is quite natural that such uncomfortable memories start to pop up, especially those that you have recently healed from. If it scares you and puts you in panic mode, fearing what if “you are not completely over those triggers, what if you haven’t closed off those karmic bonds/cycles?”, here is your reassurance, since those are just triggers that are coming back for one final revision (even if they are just passing thoughts) before you completely close those chapters out. So, this is “a powerful purging season”.



This mercury retrograde, it's wise not to let anything/anyone rush you. Taurus involved here will emphasize on having a slow & steady mindset. Since, any feelings of panic or sense of immediacy will only lead to anxiety. If you can, it is best to take some extra time to complete on projects/services even if you don't think it's necessary. That way, you can ensure calmness and certainty that you will be able to finish things up without any troubles. If in case you run into technical hiccups or other unexpected circumstances, you will be able to explain your situation easily as well. So, make sure to let things flow at their natural pace and allow yourself to have some wiggle room for relaxation & breaks.


Any contracts/deals/proposals that need to be signed must go through numerous revisions, if possible, it might also be wise to postpone the finalizations until after the retrograde. There may be opportunities to revisit old hobbies or studies. This period in fact is a wonderful time to slow down and revise on things, so any previous courses or interests that you suddenly feel drawn towards can bring fresh inspiration, even a brilliant idea or two. Delays will cause frustrations; minor inconveniences about payments, travel, technology/machinery and communications are also expected.


With Total Solar Eclipse in Aries just a day before, and a Lunar Eclipse in Scorpio a few weeks after, this Mercury retrograde will help you calm the passions of Aries and to exercise patience through Taurus’s wisdom, helping you make calm & precise plans, without giving into impulsivity, (reinforced by Mars Sextile Mercury) hence ensuring that the flames of inspiration are still ignited within. This can also help you negate the internal frustrations of Lilith squaring Moon, Mercury & Uranus’s close conjunction. 


It is a great time to reevaluate your financial & emotional stability. Emphasize on what relationships/environments add value to your life. Keep an eye out for impulsive spending, and make sure to purchase carefully researched products/services. This Mercury retrograde, give yourself the permission to be a little lazy, but also take care of your health and priorities without being too hard on yourself. So, take a deep-soulful breath and make yourself comfortable in this intense energy shift. For the next few weeks, allow yourself to take periodic breaks, indulge in R&R, self-care, with good food (watch out for stress-eating though), some relaxing tea/coffee/wine, spend quality time with loved ones, & unapologetically embrace your sensuality. 🌷

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Retrograde (Natal) 🦋✨
entry.content:
Sirene Rx in your Natal Chart can either appear in your life through subtle ways (almost undetectable) or make you embody the Dark Attributes of Sirene through subconscious ways. You might even feel drawn towards dangerous people or situations without even realizing it, until it’s too late. You can portray the Dark Sirene yourself in others’ life without being conscious of it. You might find ways to distract yourself from following your own Higher Goals, fearing the unknown or the overwhelming weight of responsibilities that come with your Higher Goals. 


You might hence become subconsciously comfortable attracting people, places & things that tempt you away from your own Calling, adding to your fear & confusion of your own Life’s Higher Purpose. You might often question your own Innate Talents without giving yourself the time & regard to explore your Potential. You might even miss out on key opportunities to express your Natural Gifts out of fear, misguidance or even Over-Confidence. Hence, Sirene Rx in your Natal Chart can enable your temptations and play on your vulnerabilities either through your own actions/choices or through others’. 


This might have played out significantly in your childhood & early adulthood. But later on, you might notice how you are being redirected towards your True Calling, since Sirene represents temptations, it also represents your Sacred Desires. Sirene Rx can hence indicate to karmic lessons that teach you how to honor your Sacred Desires and Higher Purpose in life over the Immediate Distractions & Shallow Temptations.

entry.title: Venus Ingress in Taurus 🍎💕✨ Venus Transit Astrology
entry.content:
Venus in Taurus  •  June 6 to July 4, 2025

(Also applicable for Venus Transit in Natal 2nd House.)


Venus enters her Sign of Rulership, Taurus this Summer, inviting New Vitality and Passion into the themes of the House that Taurus sits in your Natal Chart (and in general). Venus here is at Home, bringing more ease and comfort for the coming month (Home Sweet Home, indeed 🥰). We can expect favorable outcomes in both Romance & Finances (of course w.r.t. other Placements being activated during this Transit in our respective Chart(s).) 


In Romance, Partnerships and other Personal Relationships, Venus’s Transit will bring a sense of Belonging, Stability & Purpose. You are more willing to invest in relationships that bring trust & stability rather than those that are tumultuous or unpleasant. A wonderful time to Date with Serious Intentions (usually with the intent to Marry/Settle Down). If already in a relationship, you are likely to take things to the next level, even more likely to do so after certain tests for Trustworthiness and Longevity. 


You will feel the need to maintain Harmonious & Prosperous relationships with your loved ones especially with your family. (Depending on other Transits & Aspects) This can be a wonderful time for celebrations like Engagements, Marriage, House Warming Ceremonies, etc. Spending quality time with the people you love will become a priority that you will enjoy keeping promises with. You are hence likely to entertain Guests, Friends, Family & Acquaintances alike for Get-Togethers & such Parties. 


「 Long Term Plans, Ambitious Goals & Future Focused Efforts. Building Solid Foundations, cultivating Resources, Slow & Steady progress that will lead to Immense Growth & Success down the line. 」


Finances can become a Passionate Priority, as the Taurus & Venus combination can make us more productive, motivated & focused towards attaining Monetary Success, Stability & Security. Applying for New Positions or Jobs, Starting New Projects, Creative Ventures or Inspiring Business Ideas, etc. may feel Favorable and Positively Rewarding. Clearing out debts or outstanding payments, etc. now can also feel relieving. Excellent time to buy New Things and make Big Investments which add to your Financial Stability. Also a great time to plan & work towards your Financial Independence. 



Lifestyle & Living Standard Upgrades during this time will feel so Natural & Gratifying. Indulging in pleasurable experiences, foods, products, activities, etc. will be extra fun & rewarding. Enjoying the Finer-things in Life. Simplicity, Serenity & Comfort (even Luxury). Self-Love & Self-Care are Venus in Taurus’s Fortes after all. The World becomes so much more colorful, enjoyable & lovelier. 


Although, it is also extremely important that you take things one step at a time and not get carried away with over-spending, over-sharing and especially over-indulging. Best not to become too set in your own ways and stubborn when dealing with both Business, Career, Personal & Romantic Relationships. 「 Focusing now only on Luxury, Profits, Practicality & even Status over Heart, Health, Comfort & Loyalty can likely cost you more than just your Pride, but also good Relationships & Opportunities. 」


As Venus is generally considered to be one of the Benevolent & Auspicious Planets in Astrology, here are some more tips to reap the best of Venus’s Blessings & Gifts.

When in Taurus, (if you wish to and can…)

❤︎  Purchase Precious Stones, Jewelry (especially Gold & Diamonds), Ornaments, Aesthetic Products &/or Clothes. 

❤︎  Invest in Long Term Plans and in those things that yield Rewards in the long run.

❤︎  Buy heartfelt gifts for yourself & loved ones. 

❤︎  Invest in your &/or your loved ones’ future in any way you can.

❤︎  Take part in social & ceremonial events wholeheartedly, you never know what opportunities you will find there aside from having a good time. 

❤︎  Invest in your home &/or real-estate.

❤︎  Take up Personal Home/Office Decor Projects. Improve your Home and surroundings by decorating with Beautiful & Colorful things. 

❤︎  Make time for yourself, indulge in Self-Care. Focus on your physical well-being, through maintaining good health, hygiene, beauty, routines & nutrition.

❤︎  Take up gardening, spend time in Greenery / Flower gardens, Art galleries / Museums, Creative Pursuits, learning more about Nutrition, etc. 

❤︎  Make wise Financial choices, work on Projects / Businesses that bring Stability, Wealth & Good Status. 


Venus’s Ingress in Taurus can activate the Divine Feminine Energy within, making you more attractive and receptive to all kinds of Abundance, Grace & Blessings. Hence, this transit can be a Wonderful Window of Time to heal from Lack & Scarcity Mindset, Low Self-Esteem & Self-Worth, and Financial Burdens or Instability. 


「 Slip into the Timeline of Prosperity, Luck, Longevity, Wealth & Serenity this Venus Transit. Let Abundance, Bliss, Beauty & Love become your Natural Language. 」

Wishing you a Graceful & Lovely Venus Ingress in Taurus. 🍎💕✨

entry.title: Saturn goes Retrograde in Mystical Pisces | June 17, 2023 🪐✨
entry.content:
Saturn, the planet of karmic justice will go retrograde in Pisces from June 17, 2023 till Nov 4, 2023. Along with Pluto Retrograde, Saturn’s retrograde will be a massive energy & ego cleansing process. For the most of June, Saturn will appear to be frozen in the sky at 7-6 deg Pisces, and will retrograde till he reaches 0 degrees of Pisces. This will be a time of deep introspection and spiritual healing, inside & out. 


It’s only been a few months since Saturn entered Pisces (March 7, 2023) and lo and behold, there are major conversations happening about drug use & abuse. Neptune & Pisces rule the world of the subconscious also serves as the safe haven for escapism. This sign & it’s associated 12H house deals with healing, medicine, therapy & rehabilitation. But when the boundaries are blurry even the things that provide health benefits can become a form of escapism. Saturn seems to be plowing down on the misuse of this very healing sign/house. Saturn is currently at 7 deg Pisces, so all the issues bubbling up to the surface now will keep getting bigger matters of discussion. 


Those who have grown accustomed to their ways of being self-centered or completely delusional, we will witness these people telling on themselves. It’s one of those transits that will not be kind to people who are overindulging in things that they have long numbed their sensitivity to the real world. One of the many reasons why Saturn is most feared is because he will force us to clean up our own mess. This transit will be a good wake up call (depending on the severity), we have no choice but to take off the rose colored glasses and look at things for what they are, before we clean up everything, wipe the glasses a little too, and put it back on. 



This is where the karmic nature of Saturn is highlighted, because when we ignore the real life problems that our indulgent ways may have created, it becomes vital to clear things out that only seem to be holding us back and enabling our bad habits/toxic patterns. Regardless of if we have been overindulging & neglecting reality or not, this period usually comes in as a major-ego cleanser. We will be held accountable for the duties that must be followed. With Pluto in Aquarius now moving back into Capricorn, this period will be a big redemption process for some and revelation time for others.


Taking accountability is the first lesson of Saturn, always and in every area of our life. Dealing with problems and circumstances that seem out of our control and more karmic in nature can make us feel trapped in a loop where no practical solution seems to work. So, even when we are caught up in situations that we didn’t have a say in or that we didn’t really cause, Saturn will test us by seeing if we will take the first step to resolve those issues before helping us out. Hence, this period will bring major revelations about such situations and how to break out of vicious cycles methodically. Likewise, Blame-shifting, escapism and paranoia even in the face of actual consequences will lead to painful lessons.


One of the best things about Saturn in Pisces is the discernment that we learn, about our empathy. “How to share our compassion and how much to share, most importantly, who deserves it”. This can be a harsh lesson given that Pisces/Neptune/12H always extend empathy to everyone and everything unconditionally. But, that is also how we fall into traps of manipulation, deceit, theft, misuse, etc. Saturn here brings us clarity on why we need to discipline our compassion & empathy. This retrograde will hence bring up any issue with regards to over-extending our care & compassion. 


Jupiter Sextiling Saturn for the early part of Saturn Rx will be a great relief. Jupiter now in Taurus will help us solve any extreme issues that Saturn in Pisces digs up, allowing us the opportunities & resources to learn from & resolve them. This aspect can also alleviate the occasional depressive episodes that Saturn Rx (especially in Pisces) can bring with periodic boosts in optimism. So, even the most dramatic upheavals that arise can see happy outcomes in the log run. We can certainly make use of this period to rest & relax through both introspection and practical means, via self care (or even counseling & therapy). This combination can also help us dive deep into spirituality through religion, meditation, philosophy or education, while simultaneously increasing our creativity through insights & inspiration.



Delays are to be expected when Saturn goes retrograde. But, we can also see the silver-lining in them a lot more quicker than usual. Although, July can be a bit challenging month when it comes to dealing with delays & obstacles, since Mars in Virgo opposing Saturn in Pisces will prove to be a huge spectacle. We might be more inclined to losing our temper and patience. Any new project or venture that we try to start during this month might feel blocked or met with opposition. Navigating this period with caution and a little less impulsivity will be well-advised. There can also be chances for arguments and disagreements with elders/authorities which can soon turn into ego-battles. But, this can also be a good time to stand up for our beliefs and decisions. Overall, this period must be handled with extra care and patience even when our tolerance is running low.


Venus and Lilith will be facing off Saturn in an opposition next in October, which can bring up many unresolved self-worth issues that may be sensitive to address. Personal & professional relationships may feel strained or distant. Finding our independence vs. maintaining relationships can prove to be a bit difficult with responsibilities related to both ourselves and others clashing. This can also be the time when we can break away from oppressive or unhealthy situations to uphold our integrity and duty towards fulfilling our life purpose. So, our self-esteem can hit rock bottom prompting us to make the necessary shifts in our relationships, goals /ambitions and mindsets, to allow room for a more self-assured and determined version of ourselves to emerge.


Overall, this will be a great period for purposeful rest where we can introspect and dive deep into our subconscious to clean out any emotional baggage from our past (…lives even) and remove energetic/mental blocks. This process can help us heal our inner child, revitalizing our hopes & dreams. Finding balance and healing through self-love will be essential. Any self-hate, doubt or even paranoia that we come across now will need to be resolved through deep contemplation, accountability & self-love. This period can also help us break out of karmic cycles/bonds, habits/addictions, and mindsets/programming. 


So, this Saturn Retrograde will bring us opportunities to clear out the clutter from the past that may be holding us back from our true potential while simultaneously helping us make room for new beginnings. Since this is also the period of karmic cleansing, we can expect to see some well-deserved rewards and blessings heading our way for the dedication we have shown towards Saturn’s lessons. ✨

entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries

  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

A productive week to keep yourself occupied, Sagittarius. You are getting ready to make waves in your career/business with incredible new plans. So, if you haven’t had a brilliant idea or two yet, watch out for some during your brainstorming sessions. You have an explorative mind Sagittarius, and you are extra proud of it. You feel inspired to go on adventures, either through travel or interests. But, with a demanding work schedule, you might feel a little tied down by professional obligations and everyday responsibilities. You are handling past experiences & memories with a lot of maturity this week, which are helping you realize how much you have grown over the years. 



You might still have the urge to settle some accounts, but you are making wise choices to free yourself from negativity altogether, putting the past behind you. After all, you have bigger and brighter things to look forward to Sagittarius, and you have your eyes set on your ambitions. You might however have to deal with minor frustrations in your private life, especially from your family. Such disturbances may be irritating and also make you furious easily this week. But, your biggest challenge will be to stay emotionally balanced and to not loose your cool. You might have to take the high road and not let delays or oppositions to deter you. 


With patience and a little bit of methodical planning, you will be able to gain back control over key areas of your life once again. You are a ball of positive energy, with big ambitions and awe-inspiring enthusiasm. The recent shake ups have changed your viewpoint on life in a major way. You have a renewed sense of self now. You are slowly gaining confidence in yourself and your capabilities. You are starting to see new possibilities in life. This week dear Sagittarius, take some time to do the things you love the most, meet up with people who bring joy into your life and relax while indulging in your hobbies.

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

An intense week awaits you Capricorn, especially with your focus on your family & private life. You might have had serious issues to deal with regards to your loved ones. Past is resurfacing and brining up painful memories, even repeating patterns that are becoming more and more intense. So, if you have been ignoring any toxic behaviors or cycles (both from others & yourself), this week, although the tension is brewing underneath, you will be able to sense the tremors it is about to bring to the surface sooner or later. Being completely honest with the people, places and patterns that you will have to let go of will be extremely important for both your karmic path and others, since otherwise, the coming astrological climate will shake things further, until what needs to be let go of, no longer can be sustained even by your strong will. 



Speaking of which, your ambitions are calling you and you are inspired to take action now more than ever. But, you might still be experiencing external blockages and delays in your plans causing extreme restlessness, not to mention anxiety. You might be feeling unready with the preparations or changes you are supposed to make. Your insecurities may be bringing up fears about past mistakes & failures. Your optimism might also be low, making you question your capabilities. But, you are also confident about your purpose and goals, so you are fighting the good fight against all odds. 


Your admirable inner strength is helping you stand strong in your convictions. You have come a long way on your life path, Capricorn, with incredible self-growth & progress on your spiritual journey. You are starting to find your true power and gaining more control over your life after a prolonged chaotic phase. You are now more focused on building a stronger foundation in all areas of your life, especially that of emotional & financial stability. Through wonderful & trustworthy people in your life, you will be able to find peace and harmony again. So this week, be as patient with yourself as possible, since when you have done all the hard work with honesty, you can be assured to get great rewards in due time, delays & detours are just tests of faith.

entry.title: Mars Enters Leo on May 20, 2023 | The Red Planet in the sign of Courage & Creativity 🌻✨
entry.content:
Mars transits into the sign of Leo this summer further intensifying the astrological skies. Mars in Cancer bought up many near explosive showdowns with passive-aggressive confrontations, some inner wounds that needed resolutions and an increased drive to balance familial & financial foundations. Moving into the sign of creative & authentic self-expression, Mars is sure to feel more comfortable spending time with a fellow fire element. Mars will transit through Leo from May 20, 2023 to July 10, 2023 bringing more excitement, fun and enthusiasm.


Mars in Leo will rejuvenate our self-confidence and help us find our inner voice of courage. There is bound to be excitement and the need for socializing. So, vacation, festivals, concerts, get-to-gathers, outings with friends, romantic dates, etc. are certainly on the calendar. Self-doubt and creative-mental-emotional blocks you might have had previously (especially through the recent Mercury Retrograde in Taurus) will likely be replaced with renewed inspiration. The late summer of 2023 will get a fresh momentum forward through Mars’s passionate drive. 


Mars here will make you extra protective of your heart and your loved ones. Your focus may be more on your goals, and on romance. So, if you are interested in love, whether you are hitched, in a relationship or looking for “the one”, this can prove to be a significant time for a late-summer romance. 



Mars in Cancer & Jupiter in Aries have already started their “side-eye staring contest” with a potent Square but as Jupiter & Mars both enter Taurus & Leo (respectively, exact on May 23), the Square between them will be further intensified by Mars’s opposition with Pluto in Aquarius (exact Opposition on May 21), essentially all three planets adding to the tense (and dense) T-Square in the fixed signs (stubborn of them all). This is the time to stand your ground against anyone/anything that may be threatening your independence, ambitions & authority. 


It is however important not to let your emotions (/ego) get in the way while trying to prove your point, since your words/actions or the other person’s words/actions can easily invoke an extra tense fight for superiority. Either way, this astrological climate is quite fragile that can instantly collapse into ego-battles. Any effort towards gaining your independence, freeing from toxic/stressful situations, regaining control over your own life, rebuilding your monetary structure, etc. will be met with opposition in some form. 


Navigating through such obstacles will need strategy and a bit of patience, since otherwise things can go ballistic in an instant. Fighting for your passions and chasing your goals will give you immense satisfaction. Mars in Leo & Jupiter in Taurus in particular will start to rebuild our confidence and endurance. Our self-esteem and inner strength will hence go through major upgrades (so to speak). Since Mars will also make a brief square to North Node (in Taurus), you might feel a little resistant towards the sudden inevitable changes taking place in your life (which were initiated since the Lunar Eclipse in Scorpio on May 5, 2023 & the continuing square of Pluto & North Node). 


But, this build-up of inner-tension will also ignite your passion to make the necessary readjustments to your path. Gaining clarity on “your life purpose, what you need to release and what your next mission is, etc.” will be through such internal-struggles, introspections and unexpected external circumstances that will push you towards your right choices during this period.



Mars will make a fabulous conjunction with Lilith in Leo on June 21, 2023. Lilith in Leo has already sparked a process of immense transformation to reignite our passion for life, which will get a positive boost of energy from Mars. Our self-confidence (also sex-appeal 😉😘😝) will be over the roof, helping us access our innate charisma and allure. Any ambition that you work on will become your primary goal and an (almost) obsession. There are no delays or oppositions that can hold you back from reaching your destination. Your passions will be set on fire, and you will be able to embody your raw - authentic energy, unapologetically. 


Mars also makes a Square with Uranus in Taurus from the mid part of June 2023 which can cause issues with impatience. There may be high-risk of making impulsive decisions, especially if previously you were stuck in a delayed process or in a pinch. Speeding through the check-points at this time will only exhaust you, making you lose momentum in the process. So, careful redirection of all the restless & impatient energies from this square can bring much more tangible results, leaving room for innovative brainstorming and clever detours. 


Mars in Leo this year will make way for some much needed inner-child healing, bringing back the ability to enjoy and accept true happiness. The tense aspects during this transit can help us break-open new creative inspirations & follow our heart’s desires more earnestly. With Lilith here too, being a little more selfish when it comes to yourself, taking extra care of your needs & wants, expressing yourself (and your talents) unapologetically and paying more attention to what/who brings you joy will be more rewarding. So, this Mars transit, get comfortable standing in the spot-light and enjoy the show. 🌻

entry.title: Natal Venus and Midheaven MC Aspects 🦩✨
entry.content:
Venus Conjunct Midheaven MC

☌ This is one of the most amazing MC aspects.

☌ You make friends everywhere you go, a social butterfly with unlimited charm and charisma.

☌ You have an eye for beauty & fashion, so you might have a great sense of style or even be well-known for your beauty/physical appearance & fashion sense.

☌ You might be an artist, in music, singing, dancing, make-up, aesthetician, fashion modelling/designing, acting, painting, etc. or have hobbies related to the arts.

☌ You might also be good with finances, like business management, networking, marketing, etc.

☌ You might attract all kinds of opportunities, resources, influential people, friends in high places, great career prospects, etc. 

☌ Your key to success may be the peace in your heart, how you always strive to think positively and believe in the good things. 

☌ You might also be in good accordance with your family or would love to build a family of your own. You love to work towards a harmonious personal life, a fulfilling one.

☌ This is also a Fame/Popularity indicator. You are adored & admired by many, especially since you can blend-in with different people very well, and you exude a serene aura, most people love to spend time, & work with you.

☌ You know how to make things work, settle arguments & conflicts amicably, you’re also organized and are good with time/money management, so you might be suited for managerial, HR, or higher positions, since you know how to maintain a good PR and keep the workplace together using your incredible people skills.

☌ You might also find yourself working towards living a luxurious & comfortable life, filled with harmony and peace.

☌ You might attract/expect your partner to be career-minded, someone you could work/build businesses with. Your romantic relationships might be the most talked about or could be well praised by the public. You both might be well respected and admired by others. You might wish to be in a prosperous relationship like that, where you both can be well-respected, working towards common goals and be regarded as a power-couple even.

☌ Being true to yourself is also paramount, and not just accepting praises but also criticism equally, so it will be in your best interest to not just surround yourself with “yes sir/ma’am” people.

☌ There may be a danger of being a people-pleaser or attention-seeking due to insecurities or fears of being inadequate. Social standing is very important to you but being enslaved to maintaining a certain lifestyle or image would be a detriment to your mental-health or the public might catch on to your insecurities quickly resulting in loss of popularity. So, it’s essential to have a healthy self-confidence and always remind yourself of your self-worth without being pressured by your position/status. 

☌ You might be well-regarded by authority figures, elders, mentors, etc. for your disciple and studiousness. 

☌ You might even be an inspiration to many as to how to conduct oneself in public/social settings, and how to have healthy PR all while working towards worthy goals.


Venus Square Midheaven MC

□ This MC aspect can bring up your self-esteem or over-indulgence issues to the forefront.

□ You might be overly invested in yourself, your career, life, looks, popularity, materialism, etc. to ever give & receive equally which could cause disappointments in your personal relationships.

□ Or you might be too loyal and trusting, needy & dependent on your loved ones and their needs to focus on self-love.

□ You might feel distracted from your career life every-time you encounter problems in your home/love life, and vice versa.

□ You might feel obligated to work harder to neglect the problems at home or vice versa but you might still not feel satisfied.

□ Either way, you will have to face your own inadequacies to find the perfect balance between self-love and love for others.

□ You will have to find clarity in your own self-worth and never let anyone treat you any less, or you might have to humble yourself & be grateful for the blessings you have so as not to take anyone for granted.

□ You might attract partners who will love you madly enough to fulfil all your wishes or who might take advantage of your good heart, both depend on your own perception of self.

□ So, in both cases, you need a strong sense of self in order to recognize love from others’, this way you will always know when you’re truly loved and when someone isn’t being honest with you. 

□ You will have to find a good work-life balance. Most importantly you will have to balance your home/love life and your work life to feel satisfied with both. 

□ Your self-confidence is also important in your career success just as much as it is in your personal relationships, so you might have to be assertive in your career pursuits, since you have all the capabilities to take on anything you put your mind & heart towards.

□ That’s also another important attribute to any Venus x MC aspects, you can only be satisfied in professions that you love, where you can find inner peace fulfilling your purpose. So, it’s recommended that you carefully choose such perfect career path(s). 

□ You might be interested in careers related to arts, performance, fashion, finances, etc. and you will do well using your innate creative talents.

□ Your career & public life could be filled with many who love you and envy you, there may be no in-betweens.

□ You’re charming, and loving, yet you might have an air of mystery that may be regarded by others as alluring.

□ You will work towards building a solid foundation for your career, and a harmonious home/personal life, finding the right balance for both will give you everything you ever wished for. So, it’s likely that even with ups & downs, you might find yourself enjoying a good position in society, wealth, harmony, love, peace & recognition.



Venus Trine Midheaven MC 

△ This MC aspect can indicate a relatively peaceful career/public & personal life. 

△ You might be an ambitious person who has a lot of passion for your work, which reflects on all the dedication you show. So, you likely work hard and play hard.

△ You might also attract partners (romantic) who encourage your passions. 

△ They might also bring the necessary peace & harmony into your love/home life that allows you to focus on your career life.

△ Your public reputation might increase based on your romantic connections, since most people like to see you being in prosperous relationships. Hence peace in your love life can also equally influence how loved you’re by others in your social circles. (So, the opposite might be equally true, where chaotic relationships might affect your PR).

△ You might also be able to attract necessary connections, resources, finances, business partners, etc. to help you progress in your career path.

△ You are likely popular; your career & love life can equally influence your fame in general.

△ You’re a great friend, and partner, you love to mingle with all kinds of people, make worthy connections, build your repertoire, also spend quality time with your family.

△ Your physical appearance/personal style may be extra appealing to others.

△ Your cooperative & compromising personality will earn you a good reputation, and also gain you good PR.

△ Your career might involve arts & finances, mediating, HR, marketing, creativity, etc. where you can actively express your talents & interact with many people.

△ You’ll likely work towards building a beautiful family, a good reputation, wealth and prosperity in life.


Venus Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ This aspect brings up many insecurities & inadequacies one might have about themselves to the forefront.

^ You might feel (or have been made to feel) inadequate about your physical appearance or your presence & impact. 

^ This might make you feel over-looked or attacked for how you look or how you behave.

^ But most of those feelings may be your unfounded fears, or fears that come up due to the tension of competition you may be facing.

^ Issues like jealousy or envy (by others or yourself or both) might come up in your work environment(s) which might only make you feel even more insecure.

^ You will have to work through your own insecurities & self-confidence issues since no matter how much you try to hide them, others can easily see through your happy/brave face. 

^ You might also have to rely more on your own talents & efforts instead of expecting others to hand-deliver opportunities to you. Since you might be able to use your connections & popularity to get what you want but you most likely won’t find lasting success without putting-in the groundwork yourself.

^ You must also be careful not to climb the ladder too soon, or by devious means, since you might find it much harder to cope with all the big responsibilities that comes with the big titles & positions. 

^ (With Venus x MC) Since your work & career achievements reflect your true character, you’ll have to never forget that people are watching your every move, since they see your potential (even when you don’t).

^ This pressure to achieve great things must motivate you to work harder & more diligently instead of taking it for granted and confusing it for admiration, because it could all back-fire when people don’t see you fulfilling your goals or taking short cuts (also true in matters of money & finances). So, maintaining the support & admiration of others lies in your ability to deliver your promises and not just in your charm or charisma.

^ You might eventually pave a way for great success and others might look up to you & all your accomplishments with respect, inspiring many who might be struggling with similar things you over-came. (The other way around may be true if you had not put in the necessary efforts).

^ So this aspect places a lot of pressure and emphasis on conquering your fears of self and working towards your dreams without slipping into hate/envy or resentment/self-indulgence. 



Venus Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC) 

☍ This opposing aspect is fairly an easy-going one.

☍ You might have grown up with loving/supportive parents & family members. 

☍ You might have a special place in your heart for one of your parents in particular or even a family member. 

☍ You’re articulate and are detail-oriented in your work & home environments since the place you spend the most time in affects your mood & productivity.

☍ You like to be surrounded by supportive people be it friends or family members.

☍ You might find success in family businesses, home related products/services/investments (if Venus is in 4H particularly) shared assets with family members (if Venus is in 3H), or you might find opportunities through your family members/friends/acquaintances that help you advance in your career pursuits.

☍ You don’t mind working behind the scenes, in team related activities/projects, where you can spend more time with like-minded people.

☍ You might also have a fulfilling social circle, that includes family & friends, but you are also quite selective of who you let into your world.

☍ You might take your time in finding “the one” and would rather not be rushed into marriages since you are particular about the kind of family you would want to build.

☍ Your public-image might even be reflective of your cheerful inner child who is also a bit shy.

☍ Many might want to work with you for your pleasant and resourceful nature.

☍ You’ll likely enjoy a good reputation, but you’ll also have to be mindful of your temperament & your general conduct since they will be reflective of your own emotional stability that can widely influence others’ opinions of you.

☍ You might have to find a career path that matches your time with family, since over-working & staying away from your loved ones for extended periods might only deteriorate your focus on work and vice versa. So, finding a good work-life balance might be a challenge with this aspect but an important one to overcome, nonetheless.

☍ You’ll likely enjoy a good social standing, a fulfilling home life, wealth and comfort.


Venus Sextile Midheaven MC 

✱ You are likely a charismatic person who knew what you wanted from life since a very young age.

✱ You are peace-loving and often enjoy spending your time with loved ones and acquaintances indulging in harmonious relationships.

✱ You might be able to attract opportunities, resources, & influence necessary for your career advancements.

✱ You might also be well-supported by your family, elders, mentors, etc.

✱ You’re a romantic at heart and might even wish to make your fantasies a reality.

✱ You might be talented in art related subjects & careers. 

✱ You’ll likely gain a lot of notoriety for your career accomplishments throughout your life since you rarely take any opportunity for granted.

✱ You might even be known for your looks & appearance, your social conduct, and your serene personality.

✱ You might be popular for the same reasons both with your family & the public.

✱ You have good people-skills that you might have learnt from your pleasant childhood/upbringing.

✱ You are social and wouldn’t mind mingling with people, but you are also an introvert at heart since you love to spend quality time with family, or alone time relaxing in the comforts of your home.

✱ You’ll likely enjoy a luxurious & prosperous life, recognition and comfort in life.

entry.title: Mythology x Astrology of Asteroids 📚✨
entry.content:
Chiron 🌿✨

In Greek Mythology, Chiron was said to be the greatest healer, scholar and teacher revered by all. Kronos happened to see a beautiful sea nymph Philyra whom he relentlessly pursued (in between his search for Zeus and other children to devour so as to escape the prophecy of his death). The uninterested Philyra turns into a mare in order to disguise herself from Kronos, but Kronos ends up taking advantage of this by turning himself into a horse thereby impregnating her. When Philyra gave birth to a half human and half horse baby, she was repulsed by the fact that she was tricked and so abandoned the baby Chiron out of shame. Read More →


Lilith 🌪️✨

Lilith, the first wife of Adam, meaning she was one of the first humans created. Since she was fairly equal to her husband for her rights as a human being, she often expected to be respected, supported and valued the same as Adam (especially by Adam himself). This soon turned into internal fights, disagreements and power struggles in their relationship. In some versions of her story, it is believed that Lilith was expelled from Eden for being presumptuous, and in other versions, Lilith left Adam to get her independence (aka the first divorce of mankind). So, depending on the version, she is either viewed as an arrogant woman who was too prideful or the first feminist who was seeking a simple yet profound sense of equality. Accordingly, she is either viewed as a demon (hence, the mother of all demons).  Read More →


Juno 🦚✨ 

Juno, the Roman Supreme Goddess and counterpart to Greek mythology’s Hera. Juno is the sister and wife of Jupiter; the Roman Supreme God is the Greek mythology’s counterpart to Zeus. Jupiter and Juno being the supreme deities are involved in many Roman Mythological stories, mainly due to Jupiter’s infidelity or some shenanigans and Juno’s jealous rage or timely wisdom. These two divine couples are considered to be the ultimate pairing due to their individual greatness and the endless bond they share together. Juno, much like Hera is associated with marriage and childbirth. She is also the main deity of Rome back in the time, where she was revered by several names and associated with many important aspects of its people. She was considered to be the protector of Rome, often depicted in war attire.  Read More →


Vesta 🔥✨

Vesta is the Roman Goddess of hearth, home and family. She is the Greek equivalent of Hestia. As the story goes, she was the first child of Cronus and Rhea (in Greek Mythology), hence the first to be swallowed by her father. She was a gentle and peace-loving Goddess who was more focused on fulfilling her duties than in love, romance or any other adventurous matters that most other Gods & Goddesses in mythology were interested in, so she was rarely involved in dramas and hence she appears less in Greek/Roman mythology. After the Olympians won the Great War against Titans, order and peace were restored, she was pursued by Apollo and Poseidon for her hand in marriage, but she refused them earnestly. She had long decided to remain a virgin. Zeus honored her decision and granted her the duty to tend to the Sacred Olympian Hearth, hence she became an important deity of Scared Flame, Hearth, Home and Family. She was worshipped in everyday rituals and domestic affairs.  Read More →

Ceres 🌾✨

Ceres is the Roman Goddess of agriculture, nurturing and fertility. She is the Greek equivalent of Demeter, so she is the daughter of Saturn and Ops, with Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno & Vesta as her siblings. She is one of the central figures of important mythological events although she is not involved in many stories. She was widely worshipped by the Greeks (as Demeter) and later Romans as she was believed to be the benevolent goddess of agriculture and harvest. She has many temples, rituals, festivals, and cults in her honor. She is worshipped as the goddess who protects crops, for fertility of the soil, a bountiful harvest, etc. She is mostly known for her motherly love and generosity.  Read More →


Pallas Athena 🦉✨

Pallas Athena is a Greek Goddess of Wisdom, Strategic War & Artistic Skills. She is the daughter of Zeus & Metis. Like most stories that involves Zeus, he was believed to have pursued Metis, a Titan Goddess (who also helped him during the war with his father) and impregnated her. But soon after, he was afraid of his fate turning out to being that of his father & grandfather, since there was a prophecy that the kids born from this union will be much stronger and wiser than Zeus himself. So, he decided to swallow Metis while she was still pregnant. After a while, he began to experience severe headaches as if something was inside his head trying to come out. Read More →


Aphrodite (1388) 🌹✨

Aphrodite, the Greek goddess of love, sexuality, justice, and beauty. When Cronus killed his father Uranus, he was said to have castrated him and threw Uranus’s testicles into the sea, from the foam that formed came a Goddess (already fully developed in appearance as an adult) standing on a clam shell, who was named Aphrodite. She is the roman counterpart of Venus. She was said to be the most beautiful of all Greek goddesses. She was also the most sought-after character in mythology. As a result, there are many stories that involve her or where she involves herself. She is known to be a flighty and extremist character none the less. She is often depicted in nude, from half naked to warrior attire depending on the places and the form she was worshipped in. Read More →


Eros (433) 💘✨

Eros is the Greek God of love and sexual desires. He is considered to be a God of Chaos (a primordial God of creation), yet most believe that he is the son of Aphrodite and Ares. Cupid is famously the Roman counterpart of Eros represented as an infant with wings, bow & arrows. In most of Greek Mythology he is often depicted as a youthful & handsome man with beautiful wings on his back, golden arrows & bow in his hands. He is considered to be a mischievous God who has the ability to strike love in the hearts of both mortals and Gods (when he shoots his Golden arrows, similarly when he shoots with his Lead arrows, he can make someone feel repulsed by another). He is responsible for most affairs, scandals, misfortunes and happy endings in mythology.  Read More →


Psyche (16) 💫✨

In (Greek) Mythology, Psyche’s story begins as the youngest daughter of a King. Though her two elder sisters were beautiful, Psyche’s natural beauty was extraordinary, so much so that most people admired her more than Aphrodite (aka. Roman Goddess of Love & Beauty, Venus). She received countless marriage proposals, gifts and compliments from people who would soon start to ignore worshipping Aphrodite, thereby angering her. In a pure jealous rage, Aphrodite orders her son, Eros, the God of Lust & Romance, to make her fall in love with the most hideous creature on earth. Eros instead fell in love with Psyche the moment he first laid eyes on her.  Read More →

entry.title: Rare Planetary Aspects ❄️✨
entry.content:
Natal Jupiter Square Uranus

Recent: 1992-93, 2000, 2006-07, 2013-14, 2021. Next: 2027.

You are an innovative genius with a quirky personality. You have a strong sense of purpose that often involves changing the world in a major way, especially by fighting for worthy causes or by eliminating dangerous societal mindsets. You might however take things too far with your ideologies. Your life’s philosophy can inspire others and attract their attention, but your actions towards accomplishing those ideals may lead to disagreements and backlash. You have a strong need for independence and are dead set on never letting anyone/anything have too much power over you, but your need for freedom can sometimes seem like an act of defiance or extreme rebelliousness.  Read More →

Natal Jupiter Opposite Uranus 

Recent: 1989-90, 2002-04, 2016-17. Next: 2031

Your genius is a blessing indeed. But, you might need to temper your enthusiasm a little sometimes, since, you might seem a little rowdy or rude. You have excellent creativity. You are innovative, with a wicked sense of humor. You are social and simultaneously an introvert. You love to explore new studies, interests, places and even realms. You have a strong hold on your morality, but others may not always agree with your moral stand point. You are however just and uphold your integrity.  Read More →

Natal Jupiter Conjunct Neptune

Generational 

A rare planetary Conjunction that is considered as one of the most fortunate aspects in the chart. You are virtuous, generous, culturally enlightened & spiritual. You have a kind and compassionate heart that is often admired by others. You are likely down-to-earth and grounded, making you approachable & friendly, increasing your likability. You are determined and devoted often not just towards your own self & loved ones, but also towards others and the world as a whole.  Read More →

Natal Uranus Conjunct Neptune 

Inter-generational aspect. Occurs once in about 168 years. Recent: 1988 - 1999.

Unconventional, unorthodox and out of the ordinary. You seem to possess a deeper understanding on life, empathy, service, and compassion. You have a depth to your personality that is hard to unravel yet you have an Electric presence. You are exceptionally gifted and talented especially in spiritual and artistic fields. Your intuition is excellent, you are likely to have psychic gifts.  Read More →

Natal Uranus Sextile Pluto

Inter-generational aspect. Recent: 1990s, Expected next: 2080s. 

You are a rebel, lover, revolutionary and a warrior of justice. You have a unique personality that is captivating, even though all you are doing is being authentic. You rarely entertain superficial people/behaviors since your presence alone commands depth and originality. You have a strong inner character that never lets you betray your conscience. You value your intelligence, both emotional & mental. You have empathy for others, but you have no mercy for betrayers and cowards. 

Read More →
Natal Neptune Sextile Pluto

Inter-generational aspect. Recent: From 1950 - 2032 with 49 exact aspects over three generations.

Pioneer of Change. A control freak who seeks to deconstruct and reconstruct the fabrics of society. About politics, religion, gender, law, etc. New Age. Super Intuitive. Powerful Psychic gifts/insights. Urging freedom of expression and speech. Bringing people together on a spiritual level. Merging Creativity and Spirituality. Peace, Love & Harmony.


Counter-Productivity. Extremely idealistic, out of touch with reality. Lacking focus, unclear direction of life. Unrealistic expectations. Repeating patterns. 

Natal Chiron Opposite Uranus

A generational transit. Recent: Between 1950 - 1989, a 40 yearlong transit. 

Exemplary inventions, forever changing the direction of history. Accelerated growth in technological developments was seen during this transit.


Desire for Freedom, to break free from traditions & norms, especially those that no-longer serve the ever-evolving society. Seeking freedom from generational wounds, desperate need to keep moving forward, throwing caution to the wind. A rebellious activist, who loses the motivation and drive to fight because of unresolved wound of self in the subconscious. Read More →

Natal Chiron Square Uranus

A generational transit. Recent: 1996-98.

Your individuality could have gotten you into a lot of trouble in your early years, creating a lot of conflict within yourself. You could have suppressed your true self to fit in, or rebel against everyone who expected you to behave a certain way, either way, you might have been in constant agony. This could come out as emotional outbursts every time you are pushed to the edge. Your independence was compromised growing up making it even harder to develop your self-esteem and hindered your character development.  Read More →

Natal Chiron Square Neptune

A generational transit. Recent: 1996-97.

Neptune & Chiron often make a great impact in our Natal Chart, since they are both similar in their energies, focused on self-healing & service to others. You might have had extreme paranoia and fears regarding your past, even as a kid, due to your surroundings, household situations, or even past life experiences. This might have made you afraid of looking into your own inner self, from exploring your subconscious without feeling overwhelmed at first.  Read More →

entry.title: Natal Chiron Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
This retrograde placement in the chart may be one of the hardest to work through especially since Chiron itself is a placement of painful realizations and deep spiritual healing. It can feel like, the early part of your life was one big “dark night of the soul” kind of experience where you might have endured through heart-breaking, disappointing and hopeless situations, events that seem to rub salt on your inner wounds. It’s as if your inner wounds are out in the open, for those with bad intentions to hurt you even more.


So, you might have gone through one major healing journey after another, just to end up repeating the previous cycles until you were sure that you can move on. This process might have left you feeling exhausted and (frankly) defeated. But the key to truly healing yourself is “acceptance”, as simple as it sounds, it can be harder to internalize the fact that you are hurt, that you have been hurting for a long time, but every bad thing must also come to an end, and so it will. Walking with faith may have been the most testing experience for you, but staying on the course and never giving up on hope will be a vital lesson with this placement. 


In the process, you will have to confront the part of you that thinks that “you are nothing but a victim of gruesome circumstances”, since self-pity and victimhood may manifest into projections onto others if you are not being careful about them. Finding a silver-lining in every situation, changing your thought-patterns, making healthier choices/decisions, believing in yourself & hence finding enough courage to face any possible future whether good or bad, speaking of which, re-programming your mind to expect positive situations/outcomes, etc. will be hard yet vital steps that you can take towards self-development from consciously shifting your perspective towards an optimistic life thereby eventually manifesting it into existence. 


Therapy, meditation, spiritual/religious practices, artistic endeavors, etc. can help you stay connected to your inner self. Celebrating every small win will help you cultivate a stronger self-confidence. Assimilating your past, or even accepting some of the things that you have endured can be an emotionally taxing work, but you might discover that you have the internal strength to do it and come out wiser, stronger & more in tune with yourself. The journey to healing & recovering may have been long & tiresome, but you will be happy to realize that you are already near the finish line before you know it. This placement can seem karmic, heavily so, but that is exactly what makes it powerful and significant when it comes to being spiritually led & protected.
