entry.title: Natal Pluto and Ascendant Aspects 🦋✨
entry.content:
Pluto Sextile Ascendant 

✱ You have an intense yet a friendly personality. 

✱ This aspect can be regarded as one with lesser drama compared to many other Pluto aspects.

✱ Persistent, confident, hardworking, creative, compassionate.

✱ People in positions of power seem to naturally gravitate towards you, so you usually have good contacts of helpful people.

✱ You are quite influential yourself, who can motivate people in many aspects of life.

✱ A lot of people may look up to you because of your brave & confident personality.

✱ Your sexy & alluring aura, can attract a lot of people who are deeply invested in relationships with you.

✱ You can make friends everywhere you go, even though you encounter a bit of jealousy here & a bit of hate there, you lead an overall fulfilling social life with trustworthy people, weeding out the unnecessary every now & then.

✱ Like other Pluto aspects, you can deeply influence others & transform yourself by helping others.

✱ You can attract many admirers without a lot of negative attention. 


Pluto Square Ascendant 

□ This aspect is almost like a double-edged sword, since Pluto’s controlling nature can take advantage of your deep-rooted fears much easily in this aspect.

□ It’s that, “kill or be killed” mindset that usually gets misunderstood, which you must learn not to give-into. 

□ This constant need to stay on-guard, to defend yourself usually works against your true intentions, coming off as being arrogant & snobbish. 

□ You might offend others and get offended even more easily. Confrontational sometimes without any reason.

□ There’s a need to learn the importance of compromise, and how it can build one’s image & personal character in the long run.

□ A lot of people are curious about you & sometimes can show (with other bad aspects/contacts to Lilith) almost stalker-ish behaviors which could make you want to recluse even more.

□ So, most others think you are wearing a mask, hiding something important, etc. when truly you are not. Regardless, you should show your intentions with pride without the fear of being taken advantage of.

□ Family could be a problem to your public image (with Pluto usually Conjunct MC or IC). Your family members may be jealous/manipulative/have a dark past etc. which could make you extra cautious as to how this can potentially affect your PR.

□ That headstrong, goal-oriented, go-getter warrior attitude will always be commendable, helping you achieve your ambitions.

□ Usually in a leadership position, you can either inspire people around you to work with you by believing in others and having enough professional faith or can make others feel used/controlled, by resorting to manipulations due to lack of trust in others and a perceived sense of fear & autonomy. 

□ In worst case scenarios, there can be a tendency to attract dangerous people who may put you through physical/mental/psychological trauma or you could end up doing this to someone else. 

□ You have a strong physically attractive aura that can easily draw in a lot of admirers, sometimes an obsessive fan base(s).


Pluto Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant 

^ A painfully transformative aspect.

^ You might have had a traumatic childhood with many disappointing incidents either in your own life or those around you.

^ Deep rooted trust issues especially about adults can mess with the way you view other relationships as you grow up.

^ Injustice rattles you to the core (more pronounced here compared to other Pluto aspects).

^ Counselling & therapy may help you immensely in your adulthood, where unlocking each inner resentment can open up blocks in your current situations (especially issues related to trusting others and being vulnerable without feeling threatened).

^ Problems relating to personal power & control over one’s life are a big theme in your life.

^ This aspect shows exactly how powerful Pluto’s ability to turn “pain into power” is. Every inner wound you heal, will level you up in life simultaneously, giving you possess deep transformational abilities.



Pluto Trine Ascendant 

△ Another easy-going Pluto aspect, yet the personal intensity it brings is no joke.

△ You’re extremely attractive in romantic situations & are immensely passionate, you could also experience almost life-changing encounters.

△ Unstoppable drive for success. Motivational life-experiences.

△ One of the very few Pluto aspects that doesn’t intimidate people easily. You have a Friendly & passionate aura that is mysteriously attractive.

△ You’re outgoing and adventurous. 

△ There could be a compulsion to control those who love you, since others in your life almost fall for you/trust you easily. Avoiding that Plutonic impulse will save you from a lot of karmic situations (even retributions).

△ This aspect can give one great manifesting abilities; your undying confidence can become a key.

△ You can attract a lot of admirers in a subtle way. 


Pluto Opposite Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

 ☍ This could be a powerful aspect in one’s chart, since there is a good chance of being with/in a position of authority.

☍ If Pluto is in 7H, can give one the ability to have transformative relationships, and in 6H can give one an amazing tenacity to attain more power & position.

☍ Either way, being Conjunct Descendant, One-on-one relationships of all kinds play an important role in your life, and your influence on those people is immense.

☍ A low self-esteem (especially in 7H) can lead to co-dependency, that can attract a lot of abusive/possessive/controlling partners (both in monetary & romantic relationships).

☍ On the flip side, you could be the one taking advantage of/manipulating/ab*sing partners in close-personal relationships.

☍ In 6H can indicate tiresome work-situations with a lot of jealousy/character-assassinations. But when you do stand up for yourself, you can actually turn any situation to your favor, no matter what the outcome may look like, Pluto’s transformative powers will help you learn more about your own capabilities and getting the attention/support of authority figures helping you propel forward.

☍ Although this aspect is challenging to handle since it involves people you interact with on a daily basis and those you believe to be close to you, it also gives you the ability to ascend higher in life when you learn how to recognize the fakes (& the creeps) from the real ones in life.

☍ Pluto in 6H/7H & Conjunct Descendant is quite powerful since both relate to resources & connections which can become helpful when aiming to create a legacy & attaining power/luxury in the long run. 

☍ You could end up marrying an influential person or help create businesses with your partner(s) leading to a lot of success. 

☍ It is advised not to fall for the bad-boy/bad-girl types, or to jobs that clearly have toxic work-environments. If blessed with a healthy relationship/work it is also advised not to take advantage of/manipulate the partner(s)/situations (at worst, at the very least), not to self-destruct/sabotage and miss out on good opportunities.


Pluto Conjunct Ascendant 

☌ Another personal fav Ascendant aspect of mine. This aspect screams *Power*. 

☌ There is a deep need to control one’s personal image & the way others view you. Ultra-Perfectionistic. 

☌ You are tenacious, a go-getter with no boundaries strong enough to hold you back.

☌ There is a strong sense of self (even in 12H) that keeps you inspired through tough times (which are many).

☌ Pluto seeks intimacy & secrecy which becomes a priority with this aspect, keeping both yourself and your personal relationships hidden away and out in the open (in a more controlled setting) only when you feel necessary.

☌ You will go through intense changes in life, in self & in character yet each time you come out transformed into a higher & better version of yourself, which can be a sight to behold.

☌ Extremely independent, you hate to be in situations where you are being “managed”, worse, controlled by anyone. Sometimes this deep paranoia can cause a lot of tense situations in inter-personal relationships. 

☌ If ever in a place/situation of being controlled, you might live the rest of your life feeling resentful and this could easily spiral out & cause destructive (physical/psychological) behaviors.

☌ On the flip side, you might wish to control others around you, especially those you care & love, which can prove to be disastrous since Pluto is also one of the key planets of karma (after Saturn), so any wrongdoing will backfire.

☌ There will be many sudden events in your life that will put you through painful cycles of self-discovery (especially if Pluto is in 12H), in worse cases, relating to death/violence/addictions (usually from others) leading to paranoia/suicidal thoughts/physical & substance abuse. 

☌ Detail-oriented, workaholic, with great ambitions and even greater drive for success. Your intense & intimidating personality will attract a lot of admirers (an obsessive fan base even) & haters in equal amounts. This is one of the many aspects of immense fame and stardom after all.

☌ Your magnetic, alluring, fiery personality can garner many suitors who are (usually) obsessively attracted to you. 

☌ You can be hard on others but the hardest on yourself which not many will ever be able to comprehend.

☌ So you will have to learn moderation while exerting your personal power.

entry.title: Scorpio Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

July 24th - 31st, 2023

You start the week being a little off balance emotionally, Scorpio. Old memories and even traumatic flash backs can stress you out, making you question your past, present & the future. You might even feel the rage building up within you that can be chaotic. Self sabotage might be something to be aware of, especially in significant relationships. Trust me, Scorpio, by the end of the week you will be in a much better mood, if anything, you will be able to resolve most of your resentment & anxiety through the healing that you will be prompted to do. It will be a powerful change in your perspective on your self-worth, on what you wish to see in your life, what kind of experiences you deserve, how your selflessness & kindness can be reserved to only the trustworthy, how these changes can impact your life-style, relationships and material success, etc. 


You will feel more in balance and in-sync with your needs and wants through your transformative healing. After all, you are that powerful, Scorpio. This will be an intense week in terms of your passions being revived. With a mindful reset to your self-confidence, you are ready to conquer your goals. Your hopes and dreams get a new boost of divine inspiration. There is no stopping you from your success now. There is more support coming in for you, at the most opportune time from the most miraculous people & places. By the end of the week, you will have all green signals from the universe. There may be significant new chapters opening up in your personal relationships this week, with either new people or existing bonds that may start/restart suddenly and last for a long time well into the future. 



You are driven by passion and adventure, but also through childlike innocence. Deep conversations, brainstorming, spending time together, revisiting childhood dreams together, etc. will feel almost soul inspiring. Friendships and romantic relationships will get a depth of newness to them. Likewise, any old and stale, even toxic bonds that you might have been struggling to get rid off will be severed through a weird sense of apathy.  You will have to take care of your health a lot more closely, since you might be prompted to reorganize your lifestyle by realigning with the rhythms of your body & mind. 


Intuitive Messages

You can sense something in the air Scorpio, and you know it’s not good. Someone (or some people) around you are plotting something against you, but you can already pick up on their intentions. You are intuitively sound and clever. Scorpio, if there is anyone it’s you who can always see through any mask or deception. This week, you are right on top of it. You are shrewd and attentive. So, nothing can go past you undetected. Your advice is to stay alert and watch their moves (if you already know definitively as to who or what is being sneaky & shady around you). You might have to be swift and agile in the way you catch them, since rest assured they will slip up soon, spectacularly so. You are in control of your emotions and passions, whatever this situation is, you are more than ready to resolve/uncover/expose it. You have good karma on your side Scorpio, you are righteous and you uphold your integrity even in the face of treachery. You are protected karmically, you will be safe from others’ bad intentions. You will come out on top of it, without even having to lift a figure. You will see things working out in your favor soon, in miraculous ways. So, let the universe handle this for you and take the opportunity if/when you find it. Scorpio, overall, it’s going to be a wonderful week, with lots of joy and hope. You can dream big and expect only the best. Karmic rewards await. 



July 17th - 23rd, 2023

Scorpio, all your focus this week will likely be on your career life. You are lively and motivated to make great progress in your career. You can see substantial improvements in your businesses & projects. However, if you are looking for good investors or partners, it is advised to be well-informed about the associates you pick. Legal documentations or other such important matters may cause minor frustrations due to either the process or the authorities involved. Your self-confidence can hit terrible lows and major highs due to sudden delays or momentum that occur chaotically. Finding the right balance between your self-esteem and pride will be important to navigate the intense push & pull situations that may take place unexpectedly this week. 



Such outside influences may make you question your vision and goals for the future. Your drive & determination, dreams & aspirations will be under serious review during your introspective alone-times. None-the-less, even with all the built up tensions and frustrations, you will be able to recover your confidence and stand strong in your integrity. Your conviction will become firm through these tests of faith. Your love life is also likely to be in forefront with many exciting developments happening rather quickly. Friends & family can become a source of inspiration. You are also likely to be in a rather adventurous mood this week, with big plans for vacation or a quite getaway with loved ones. 


Speaking of which, it might be safe to stay extra cautious of traveling especially when with family or friends. There may be problems in your health mainly due to sudden changes in the climate or work-induced stress, so taking time out for rest & relaxation will do you a lot of good. You can also spend some time indulging in your hobbies or in perfecting your skills, since a bit of healthy distraction can help you stay productive and minimize any extra stress. Overall, you can except to see some destined changes that can redirect you on a more rewarding path, both professionally & spiritually, reviving even some of your old dreams and boosting your ambitions.

entry.title: Natal Sun and Ascendant Aspects 🌞✨
entry.content:
Sun Sextile Ascendant

✱ You are charismatic and joyous. You have a clear sense of direction in life.

✱ You have a good sense of self, so you always express yourself with authenticity.

✱ You carry yourself with dignity even amidst opposition and conflicts which make you admirable.

✱ Others see you as a capable leader, they admire and respect your brave personality.

✱ You are career driven and you likely combine your life purpose with your endeavors. 

✱ Your works/services are carefully made with all your passion & determination. So, you gain recognition for how incredible your works are.

✱ You attract significant opportunities and connections that help you to elevate on both personal and professional levels.

✱ You are confident and self-reliant, yet you crave personal relationships to feel empowered, since you’re loving and compassionate. You also make resourceful connections in your professional field.

✱ You are confident and have a healthy ego. But you might have to manage the way you present yourself, since your public image needs extra originality from you. You can be quite popular for the same reason. Staying humble and grounded will also help you maintain a good reputation.

✱ You’ll likely work hard on your ambitions and make your dreams come true; form fulfilling connections; create incredible works/services; use your personal charisma to inspire others; spread happiness, creativity and optimism; gain respect, wisdom, wealth and honor following your inner calling and find contentment.


Sun Conjunct Ascendant

☌ You have a positive and uplifting aura that others are easily drawn towards.

☌ You are true to your heart’s desires and so your passions always seem to drive you forward in the right direction.

☌ You have a strong sense of self that others see as an admirable character. You inspire others through your own life’s journey towards success.

☌ You face challenges and oppositions with integrity. You don’t back down from obstacles, you take both success and failure with humility.

☌ You are confident in your capability to attain your goals. You don’t get influenced by negativity easily, since you are filled with optimism and have a positive mindset. 

☌ You are also humble. You have a down-to-earth personality. Others can sometimes misunderstand your stance on certain situations, but your strong will always gains you their support in the end.

☌ You move forward towards your goals; you don’t dwell on any disappointment and struggle for far too long.

☌ You are a determined leader, you are hard on yourself to work immaculately, but you will also have to be careful not to overwhelm others with too many expectations.

☌ Your originality & honesty will earn you a good reputation and even popularity. Your works/services will also gain recognition and support through your positive self/public image.

☌ You’ll likely inspire many through your authenticity; make creative & impactful works/services; work with dedication and consistency towards your ambitions; spread positivity and joy; be humble through all phases of your life; gain recognition, power, wealth and humility following your inner calling and find fulfilment.



Sun Opposition Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

☍ This aspect will help you to balance your need for healthy connections and your personal power.

☍ You are enthusiastic and courageous, yet you might not believe in yourself as much as you let others know.

☍ Your insecurities and feelings of inadequacy can plague you especially in your early teens through your 20s. With maturity and experience you will come to terms with your short-comings and be able to embrace your strengths more.

☍ You have a strong desire to be with supportive people, in both your personal & professional life. So, you are happy making new connections, and are always seeking meaningful relationships.

☍ You will have to be careful not to project your insecurities onto others, especially your loved ones since you can easily create unnecessary conflicts in your relationships otherwise. 

☍ You will also need to keep improving your sense of self by self-care and creative activities to maintain a healthy ego and a positive mindset.

☍ Your self-image can get a boost through your success in personal and professional life. You also have a significant amount of influence on the public since you always seem to carry yourself with integrity and courage even through challenging times.

☍ You don’t like unnecessary conflict, but you might often get pulled into situations by others who envy you. Your humility, wit and courage will help you come out on top of any such confrontations.

☍ You attract significant opportunities and connections that elevate you further on your life path. You are creative and invested in your passions. You create inspiring works/services gaining you recognition and support.

☍ You’ll likely face challenging situations that help you develop your core personality; embrace uplifting and positive relationships; inspire others through your humility, determination and diplomacy; gain recognition, position, wealth and prosperity following your inner calling and fulfilling your heart’s desires.


Sun Square Ascendant

□ You have a strong sense of self, but you also focus more on your public image.

□ You might feel that your core personality and your professional/public image are incompatible, or you feel that you need to project a sterner & courageous side of yourself to the public.

□ This subconscious need to look strong and incredibly capable may come from inner fears of inadequacy and sometimes even from fear of humiliation.

□ So, you likely don’t take failures and setbacks lightly, if you’re not careful, you might even feel defeated when you are.

□ You might also be in danger of basing your self-image on how successful you are in your public/professional life. Hence, your self-confidence fluctuates with successes & failures.

□ You might have a hard time accepting help from others, even in the form of advice, since you think its criticism or weakness on your part.

□ This can also be true when it comes to your relationship with authority figures/elders/mentors. But you will have to break through that negative mindset since you need to accept help and guidance in order to move farther than you have been before.

□ You are a capable leader, with an incredible work-ethic. Others admire your works/services since you know how to integrate your passions and creativity. But you will have to learn how to manage your dominant personality when working with others and understand the importance of compromise and diplomacy.

□ You will go through many situations that challenge your public image, especially those from your enemies/oppositions. You will be called to work on your insecurities and fears in order to overcome such challenges. Hence, you will be able to develop your character and strengthen your sense of self, by reinventing your self-image & public image.

□ You’ll likely make significant progress on your professional & personal life through your journey of self-development; make impactful & creative works/services and inspire others through your successes; learn to embrace your fears of inadequacy and move forward with reviewed self-confidence; gain wealth, recognition, respect and power following your inner calling and find contentment in your professional/public accomplishments.



Sun Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant

^ You might have felt disconnected from your ego in your early years. 

^ As a result, you might have held back from voicing your opinions and expressing your true self.

^ But through certain sudden & miraculous events, you get to reconnect with your inner self and so you are able to tap into your heart’s desires.

^ You are able to standup for yourself and make life changing decisions without guilt or regret.

^ You follow your heart’s desires with immense determination and are able to direct your passions in a productive way.

^ You will have to face your insecurities and fears of inadequacy with each level up you wish to make. Hence, you are able to honor your wishes and follow your inner calling unhindered.

^ Your self-confidence gets a boost through your active participation in interests/activities that you love. Your career/business also get recognition for how passionately involved you are in your works.

^ You will have to consciously fight power struggles in your personal & professional connections. You will also have to draw healthy boundaries in your connections since you are extremely empathic and so you sometimes feel compelled to over-give/do.

^ You will have to keep re-inventing your goals and ambitions throughout your life. This can give you the ability to adapt to changing times and help you to keep your confidence high at a healthy & balanced level.

^ You’ll likely honor your inner calling and follow your heart’s desires to succeed; make significant progress on your life path through your conscious self-development phases; inspire others to embrace their creative self-expression and originality; spread positivity and joy; gain perspective, wisdom, recognition and respect following your life path and find contentment in your incredible contributions.


Sun Trine Ascendant

△ You have an admirable personality. You are optimistic and authentic in your self-expression.

△ You have a clear sense of direction and so you set goals for your life easily.

△ You have a healthy self-confidence and a balanced ego. So, even your occasional arrogant/boastful attitude is overlooked since others know that you are a humble person at heart.

△ You attract significant opportunities and connections that help you to elevate on your life path.

△ You use your creative and management skills to create incredible works/services.

△ You are a born leader, although you don’t often pride yourself to be one, since you know to work with others without overexerting your power/authority.

△ Your honesty and integrity will help you overcome any oppositions and conflicts from envious people.

△ Others admire your charisma and respect your work-ethic. Your professional contributions can gain popularity and support for the same reasons.

△ Although you are confident in your capability to succeed, you will have to be open to criticism and guidance. You might also feel divinely guided in some ways, so staying open to new opportunities and trusting in the changes will help you to reach your ambitions quickly and easily.

△ You’ll likely embrace your inadequacies and talents equally well to create incredible works/services; inspire others through your bold yet down-to-earth character; make significant progress on your professional & personal life; spread creativity, optimism and joy; gain wealth, recognition, power and honor following your inner calling and find fulfilment on your life path.

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Cancer (4th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Cancer (4th House)

You might have experienced struggles early on in your life, either emotional instability or a lack of warmth from family, you felt neglected and rejected. In worst case scenario, might have even had to fight for your birth right in some way. Your home could have been the cause of your fears and trauma. You can be very compassionate towards others but neglect your own feelings in the process. You feel deeply and you express your emotions with honesty, yet you might feel misunderstood sometimes. You might even feel distant from your parents in some way or you had to fight for their affection/attention at some point in your childhood. 


You might however wish to create a loving and generous family of your own in the future. If you have unresolved issues with their parents or suffered through trauma, you might not want to settle and have a family initially or you might refuse to commit to your parenting duties. You can feel unfulfilled in your emotional life easily but also you might get consumed by resentment and anger. You can also project your insecurities and fears of abandonment onto your loved ones making them feel over-burdened by your emotional baggage. You can even become over-protective of your kids/family at the slightest hint of danger or even a misunderstanding. 



You have empathy in abundance with this placement, so you understand where someone is coming from. You are always there to nurture others and help them find stability in their life. You might even heal your inner wounds by forming a family of your own and giving them all the warmth and genuine affection that you lacked growing up. You can also encourage people to open-up emotionally and help them recover from their traumatic past. This placement can help you break generational curses, either from family or your birthplace even. You might even have certain memories from your childhood (or even your past lives). 


You might feel like you are being kept on the side lines or ignored sometimes, especially when your loved ones don’t make you their priority or when they are dealing with their life issues. You might be afraid of failure especially about letting your loved ones’ expectations down. You might even neglect your public reputation to uphold traditions, your family’s duties or help your loved ones. You are willing to make great sacrifices for others. Your inner fortitude will be tested time and again, your emotional strength will serve as an inspiration to others. 


You might have troubles with women/mother or feminine figures, be it in professional or personal life. But you can also be an inspiration to women/feminine figures through your accomplishments and commitment to both your professional and personal relationships. Your loyalty and compassion will help you heal your inner child issues and also motivate others to embrace their emotional self. You will be able to create a secure and strong emotional foundation for your future generations as you heal.

entry.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

You might be having flash backs of bad scenarios that you would rather wish never to be reminded of. But, you might also be ignoring the reason why certain situations, memories or even people from the past are suddenly showing up again. Are you afraid of making impulsive bad decisions Leo? Your fears seem to be extra potent, making you question your past choices in both monetary and emotional situations. Overcoming these fears will help you realize that you are facing them to clear the way for the new adventures in your life. So, even if some memories or guilts from the past hurt your ego, allow yourself to let go of any self-hate or blame and make space for fresh starts. 



You are a born leader, Leo. You always strive to follow your heart. You are joyous & light-hearted in your personal/public life but also stern & serious in your professional life. So, you hold yourself up to high standards. You are more vibrant and enthusiastic about every move you are making. But, you might have noticed a clash in your life purpose & career goals. So, you are likely to be re-evaluating your goals in all areas of your life to make sure that they are in line with your true desires and dreams. With a busy work calendar and lots of new inspirations & passions to follow, you are more focused on your career than on self-care, but you are getting better at maintaining that balance. 


If you have a health scare or issues, it is only trying to get you to slow down a little. With such an intense astrological climate, energy is certainly running low for all of us so take adequate rest whenever you feel the need to (without ignoring your health needs). Your focus is firmly on your goals with renewed positivity. You are also clearing out inner child wounds that are helping you immensely in your own personal reinvention. Your heart will sing with joy again Leo, hold onto your dreams and get ready for positive movement towards your goals in the coming weeks.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Cancer + 4th House 🦀✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Cancer + 4H + Moon Aspects + 4° 16° 28° 🦀✨


LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You are a genuine Sweet - Heart, with the best of intentions towards everyone. This quality can attract a lot of people towards you, especially since being near you can make them feel at ease. You likely have many admirers who also respect you dearly. You are probably the one person they would rather not loose in their life. The same way, they would want to be a special person in yours as well. So, many of your loved ones, friends & family can feel so blessed to have you in their life and be a part of yours. Your family and upbringing can inspire you greatly. 


You might also be quite fond of your culture and country. You can attract admirers from your place of birth, culture &/or country as well since they can feel a Sense of Kinship with you. You are Emotionally Mature and can be very understanding of others without biases. Your Compassion & Innate Emotional Understanding can make you an ideal person to seek help, support & advise from. So, you are likely to attract people who are in need of help. You can also attract a lot of children & animals. 


You might be regarded as a Support System, who is reliable and resourceful, so you can belong to a community that truly values you for who you are. You also make a great spouse who is trustworthy and admirable. The same can be true about being a devoted parent. So, your children may adore and respect you. Hence a loving Family, Fulfilling Marriage and Adoring Children can be your Major Inspiration and/or Goal in Life. There is an Innate Charm about you that can feel so comforting to many, especially those who are subconsciously longing for care, love & comfort. So, you can make any place that you walk into a hundred times more Vibrant and any relationship that much more Loving. 



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You encounter people who can distract you with comfort & security. So, you likely come across those who wish to be resourceful and reliable towards/for you, but by taking away your Self-Sustainability and hence also your Self-Reliance. Hence, Codependent-People and the dynamics that they create with you can become extremely damaging to your Individual Sovereignty. You might be enticed with a loving and a fairly Equal Relationship, but soon realize that they are Emotionally Manipulative and Destructive to your own Sense of Safety (at least emotionally & psychologically). 


There is a Sense of involuntarily making you Sacrifice your True Self in order to stay connected to them and to pour in all of your effort & emotions into that relationship to keep it working no matter how destructive it may be. This can also be true with parents, children or spouse who wish to live off of your hard work or make you work for them (emotionally &/or financially). So, it is vital to have a (True) Solid Support System who can have your back in times when you desperately need them, and to feel safe when in such situations. This of course can also advise you to be careful who you wish to commit to and build a family with, since children or even a marriage can become a huge disappointing trap otherwise. 


If you grew up in a not so caring & loving family, you might have experienced the Negative Side of this Sirene placement where Emotional Manipulation was almost the basis of your childhood, making you feel so much more unsafe, insecure & unsupported in many aspects of your Life. Your vulnerabilities may have been used against you, so you might have learned many lessons about not being an Open-Book to everyone in terms of your emotions, and also to not give your compassion to everybody without first getting to know their True Intentions. You likely have learnt ‘not to let others mistake your Kindness for Weakness’ as well, demonstrating how strong and resilient you truly are.

entry.title: Retrograde Placements in the Natal Chart 🍃✨1 (Planets)
entry.content:
Natal Mercury Retrograde

You see the world differently, usually through your mind. You have insecurities about what others think about you. You might have felt that your opinions are too bold or were afraid of rejection growing up. You might even overanalyze everything others say/do, sometimes misinterpreting them. This can also be true as vice versa, where you are misunderstood by others. Your early experiences may have been hazy yet vivid. Read More →


Natal Venus Retrograde 

Your ability to express compassion and love were limited in your childhood. You might have felt unworthy of love or luxury in some way, this could easily be the opposite case too, where you felt entitled or greedy about money and favors. You might have problems in estimating your own worth and so, also that of others. Read More →


Natal Mars Retrograde 

You might be confrontational or meet people who are always out for a fight. You might even feel uneasy while expressing your opinions in tense situations, or you might avoid being in conflicting places altogether. You might have troubles starting new endeavors, usually due to lack of self-confidence. You might even sabotage opportunities due to fear of “being not good enough”. Read More →


Natal Jupiter Retrograde

Your faith in the divine and yourself always seem to be under test. You might have felt unsupported during your younger years, especially on a spiritual level, you might have felt that you were always enduring bad luck. Some of those early experiences also tested your commitment to your goals and what you felt was your life purpose. Read More →



Natal Saturn Retrograde 

This placement can be scary at first, especially since the lessons are harsher than the direct placement. You might have endured some gruesome experiences ever since your childhood, which could have forced you to become wiser and more mature. Your patience and endurance could have been tested to their limits. Everything felt like one up-hill battle after another. Read More →


Natal Uranus Retrograde 

Your biggest fear might be that of being stuck in a repetitive phase in life. You might have had childhood experiences where you felt trapped or restricted by traditions or other familial/social expectations. You might have lacked encouragement to express your individuality. But as you grew into your adulthood, you might have realized how being trapped in certain mindsets are not serving you anymore. Read More →


Natal Neptune Retrograde 

You could have been unbalanced spiritually where you might have felt like you couldn’t access your deeper subconscious. You might have also neglected parts of yourself or felt neglected by others during your childhood no matter how subtle it was, since in your early 20s and onwards, you might have realized how you have so much more to learn about yourself. You might even feel compelled to dive into spirituality, religion, or philosophy in search of answers to a feeling of emptiness. Read More →


Natal Pluto Retrograde 

You might feel constantly attacked or have fears of being exposed. You might have experienced obsessive/possessive behaviors from others which might have made you feel unsafe. You might not be comfortable tapping into your subconscious, especially from fear of facing bad/difficult memories. You might even have traumas that seem too big to even confront on an emotional level. Read More →

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Capricorn + 10H (+ Conjunct MC Midheaven) 🦬✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Capricorn + 10H + Saturn Aspects + 10° 22° (+ Conjunct MC Midheaven) 🦬✨


LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You have a powerful intuitive guiding force within. You have big visions for your life, you are a forward thinker with a lot of determination to succeed in life. You have a strong character & leadership qualities that add to your charisma. People are often mesmerized by your powerful personality and ‘can-do’ attitude. Many gravitate towards you just to be under the graces of heavens. Whenever you are working on things that seem bigger than you, you seem to build things that can stand the test of time. You can find the right opportunities and the best possible approach to any dream or ambition that you wish to achieve. 


Powerful People & Authority Figures find you quite appealing and are often impressed by your character & your work ethic, they can also help you elevate your work/career/ambitions to a whole new level. You can become an incredible leader and take up Authoritative positions yourself, leading others towards success. You manifest opportunities especially when you are focused on Career Goals. You are also seen as someone whom others can trust (often blindly) to make something big happen. Many naturally respect and appreciate you, they often have high expectations for your future even without meaning to. 


You attract the right situations & opportunities through your Endurance, Self-discipline, Self-confidence, Clear vision & Strong determination whenever you direct your attention, effort & time towards meaningful & great Ambitions. Hence, there is often a huge emphasis on your Career life, whether in a job or business, your life’s Ambitions have a strong pull over you, often enticing you to make your dreams a reality. Success, achievements & accolades can also become an inspiring factor to your almost unstoppable drive & passion. You are a force to be reckoned with whenever you are building your legacy, and others respect you sometimes from a distance or even admire you in secret. You can become a Powerful History Maker with this Sirene placement, in combination with other favorable placements & aspects in your chart.


DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You often encounter people who wish to steal your Success & Legacy. They might fear you and feel intimidated by you, so there are likely people who wish to ‘knock you down a peg or two’ just to feel superior over you (i.e., not to feel inferior to you). Elders with certain Cultural or Ego Issues can target you just to make themselves feel superior as well. They can take advantage of their authority over you. So, this can include your own parents and relatives as well. You might learn that not everyone supports you in your endeavors, no matter how sincere, hardworking & determined you are. You will have to be careful with people who constantly try to smear your name or discredit your efforts. 


All that can just be pure distractions, so you might have to learn the lessons of not paying attention to others’ rude words, rumors & non-constructive criticism. Since, your Excellent work, Accomplishments & True character will shine through and squash their lies & others’ misunderstandings in no time. Even so, be mindful of those that you associate with, the actions of friends & family alike can affect your Social Status & Public Image. There may be deliberate attempts to hold you back from pursuing your goals, from becoming independent & accomplished, etc. in order to undermine your capabilities and discourage you from achieving your rightful goals. 


There may also be attempts at tying you down with responsibilities or guilting you into taking on duties that aren’t yours. So, these kinds of people can even wish to shift their responsibilities onto you to further burden you. Creating delays, obstacles & challenges on the path towards your Higher Ambitions in general. On spiritual & karmic levels, this Sirene Placement can bring numerous challenges that can inadvertently undermine & underestimate both you and your Life’s Calling. Hence also bringing the opportunities to explore your Inner Potential furthermore and fight your way through those challenges, there by taking back Power & Control over your Life’s Path, achieving Great Success and creating a Wonderful Legacy that you & your loved ones can rejoice in, building abundance, admiration & respect over time.

entry.title: Natal Saturn and Uranus Aspects 🐻‍❄️✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn Trine Uranus

Recent: 1971-74, 2002-04, 2016-18. Next: 2047.

You are a patient person yet incredibly agile. You can adapt to seemingly stable situations and to chaotic ones. Your adaptability is what brings you the endurance and persistence to succeed. You are good at managing your Uranian hyperactive curiosity by directing all that concentrated energy into productive things. You are clear and precise in your thinking, so you make the best decisions without doubts or regrets. You can easily form opinions and convey them to others without leaving much room for misinterpretation, which gets better with age. You are an earnest person, since you take responsibilities seriously. 


You like to spend your time learning and experimenting with new & old ideas, trying to be more efficient in everything you do. You are a great visionary, but it’s not always about your goals & ambitions alone since you also think about the betterment of others. You are a born leader, and you can work well with others. Your ingenuity coupled with modesty allows you to work your way up the ladder. You have excellent people skills especially in professional settings. You do well in authoritative positions. Your work ethic and innovative yet traditional take on professionalism earns you great respect & admiration from those around you.


You are freedom oriented but also won’t mind belonging to groups & organizations. You can always find a way to establish your independence in any field of work all while respecting its rules. Your life is often surrounded by sudden changes and unpredictability, yet you don’t always seem bothered, genuinely. You are focused on the solution rather than on the problem, no matter how big or small, which makes you an excellent problem solver. You can also understand patterns and decode complexities. Your accomplishments will bring you many supporters, making you quite influential. You will also be sought after for your expertise and guidance. Whether you realize it or not, you are making subtle yet significant changes in both yours and others’ life, as part of the beauty of this aspect. Your stern decisiveness, passionate yet patient attitude, graceful demeanor, intense work-ethic, serious moral standards, self-discipline, and numerous achievements will bring you honor, power, prosperity and admiration with time.


Natal Saturn Opposite Uranus

Occurs every 45+ years. Next: 1963-68, 2007-11.  Next: 2056.

Saturn’s traditional values and Uranus’s idealism clash often with this aspect. You are courageous, talented and ambitious. You can focus your attention & creativity into productive things. You like to explore the patterns and intricacies of everyone & everything around you, but often times you might forget that you are here as well, hence failing to introspect. You respect individuality but also might have the tendency to criticize others for their choices. You have high moral standards which guide you and help you achieve incredible things, but other times these same high moral standards can prompt you to moral police others, be it for any socio-political issues (or, vice versa, where others often tend to do this to you). 


You have an inner tension of what’s right and what’s wrong. Sometimes you might confuse old & enduring rules as the obvious right guideline to live by, simultaneously dismissing new & improvised ways of being as “conspiracy” or “on the lines of blasphemy”. Your unfiltered opinions and ideas may have landed you in deep trouble often times. But, with time and maturity, you might have realized that some of your views were too hurtful or misleading and the severity of the damage they may have caused. Patience and discernment are the most painful yet powerful lessons that you had to learn. Your ingenuity and uniqueness are not just things that set you apart but also qualities that add color to the world. So, if you ever suspected during your introspection sessions, that you might not have been open to accepting others’ individuality or opinions due to your own fear of being rejected for the same reasons, you might have finally realized what was causing a mental block in you. 


You might have a beginner's problems with adjusting to innovative technologies or new ways of thinking, etc. But you might also come to discover your love for such genius inventions and opinions. You might not always want to be compared or criticized by others so you often choose unique professions which can give you the respect and freedom to express your individuality. So, you might also not work well with others at first, but slowly warm up to them as time goes by. Your biggest challenges, patience and tolerance, can also be your superpowers whereas you mature, you can adapt well to the changes in your life, respect others for who they are & expect the same in return, be more accepting of criticism & learn how to deflect attacks by opposition, etc. You have big ambitions and even bigger visions, but through your life experiences, you might have had the extra insight to tweak a few plans here and there to make them even more perfect. With maturity, self-control and persistence, you will be able to make incredible achievements, gain admiration, respect, & honor.


Personal freedom drives you passionately towards things that give you a sense of independence, be it hobbies, studies, cultures, adventures or even spirituality. This aspect gives a strong intuition not just in terms of gut-instincts but in terms of intelligence and innovative mindset. So, you are likely to research in topics related to science, mathematics, arts, law, philosophy, history, ethics, technology, etc., and may be even stumble upon an invention/discovery or two. 


You often see sudden increases in your material situations (& loses) which seem to happen out-of-the-blue. You might even develop a keen sense of financial management with this aspect helping you research and dive deep into educating yourself on more ways to make money or smart budgeting, etc. Gambling, risky investments, get-rich-quick schemes, etc. can be quite tempting. It is important however to not rely solely on your luck to save you, since you could easily lose as quickly as you gain if you are not being practical. 


You are an enthusiastic person, which might make you prone to risk-taking behaviors, sudden trips and fun-filled adventures that make you feel life in exciting ways. You are blessed with friends who are like-minded and resourceful. You can even make influential connections with people/associates who can help you attain more professional success. Your ideologies and futuristic visions are exemplary and can catch the attention of others easily. You are influential whenever you are expressing yourself authentically and showcasing your knowledge & skills unapologetically, making you quite popular. 


Your independence is of the utmost importance to you, but your eccentric personality can make you unpredictable and unreliable. Such unconventional behaviors & devil-may-care attitude can put you in hot water with elders/authorities. Blending genius with your own set of moral code and eccentricity with reliability will bring you immense success and a solid reputation even with occasional criticism. 



Natal Saturn Sextile Uranus

Recent: 1996-97. Next: 2025-26; 2038-39.

This aspect gives you the best of both worlds, Saturn’s patience with Uranus’s insane curiosity. You have practical ways of implementing unconventional ideas. You have an extraordinary ability to simplify complicated things/patterns, which makes you a gifted problem solver. You know how to break down intricate patterns to its primary elements and rebuilt them in new ways. Your intelligence is sharp and ever evolving. You have a probing mind that allows you to research and dig deep into things that interest you. You value your intellectual capabilities and are always finding interesting new ways to keep yourself intellectually entertained & satisfied. 


You are also gifted in turning things that are old & traditional into new & innovative. Since you are able to find value in the old and add it to the new. You are methodical & logical, so it’s not easy to trick you in anyway, if anything, this aspect can strengthen any weak Neptunian (or other similar) aspects in the chart which can otherwise leave you vulnerable to deceit & lack of self-confidence. You have a good hold over your emotions since you see everything through the lens of logic. You might even seem to be too realistic, but you are also quite imaginative. You might have creative & artistic talents that you can use in your career/projects. 


With this aspect, you can become a master at blending the old with the new, intellect with art and realism with futurism. You have a unique perspective on life, and it reflects in your flighty yet reliable personality. Your charisma and mature demeanor have the ability to draw in people easily. They may be intimidated by you at first, but they also look up to you as a mentor/leader, this could be the reason why most people in your life seek your advice & guidance actively. You are calm & collected and are able to ride the wave of change, giving you great adaptability. You don’t mind being the rebel and changing rules in accordance with the changing times. You value stability yet are actively changing anything that is stagnant. 


Your work ethic blends well with your need for excitement and experimentation, earning you a reputable position in your profession and society. You crave excitement and security at the same time, this could make it harder for you to settle down at a young age, but with time you will be able to make serious commitments without feeling tied down. You are well-grounded even when others think that you’re unpredictable. Your vision for the future is idealistic and has practical means as its foundation. Your contribution to the world is immense and always appreciated by others. This aspect will reward your self-less yet discerning efforts with blessings & insights by directing you towards your destined path to success & fulfilment.  


Natal Saturn Square Uranus

Recent: 1998-2001, 2021-22. Next: 2043.

You are extremely independent, yet you are also a team player. You love to live life in a structured and orderly manner, yet you will never sacrifice your independence & get consumed by such systems. So, you always give yourself the space to develop and improve, thereby respecting your individuality. You are a walking contradiction, not in the way where you don’t follow what you preach, but more in the way that you can’t stick to traditions that you admire for longer periods of time due to the continual phases of self-evolution (by will or by sudden change of events). There always seems to be an inner tension about what you want in life and what is right for your higher purpose. You might battle over “what true independence means” and simultaneously “why structure & rules are equally important”. You might however realize that no amount of brainstorming or even introspection would ever give a definitive answer to such questions. This can prompt you to voice some controversial opinions, whether you truly believe in them or not, consequently dividing the opinions of others on you.


You’re mature & open-minded. You often wish to break free from any labels or titles. You wander in search of openness and acceptance then rigidity and disapproval, then walk full circle and come back to where you started. There is a strong aversion from facing facts, so you tend to side with either of the far extremes, since you’re used to seeing the world in either black or white, good or bad. So, finding the mid-wavelength of colors will be your life’s biggest challenge. There needs to be a regulating factor in your life, as a hobby, career, mentor, friends circle, family, etc. whose presence alone can help you ground yourself whenever you feel overwhelmed by your thoughts. You are responsible, reliable and genuinely talented. You’re respected and admired by many people, yet you might not understand the extent of your reach & influence on others. So not just your actions, but also your words need to be firm, authoritative, well phrased & clear in intentions. Since, you might have noticed how others often misinterpret what you say. 


Keeping up with the changing times is not a problem to you, since you know how to adapt and utilize the newer technologies & resources. Yet you are quite traditional, be it religion, culture or such structured rules & guidance systems. You are resistant to certain changes in life especially if they’re sudden or upset your peaceful lifestyle in some way. There may be numerous opportunities/relationships that come into your life (sometimes leaving just as quickly, like breakups, downfalls, etc.) to challenge your belief-systems in a good way, often inspiring you to evolve past your own self-limiting beliefs and explore your true value-systems. With time & maturity, you will come to realize just how valuable your ability to “blend the old with the new” truly is. Some of the major leaps in your journey and immense progress were due to your inner genius mixed with self-discipline after all. 


So, understanding the depth of your genius & the need for independence all while following your own moral guidelines will be significant life lessons. You can balance both curiosity & structure, genius & hard work, freedom & belongingness, thereby embracing both Saturnian & Uranian qualities without feeling the regret or the conflict that you are betraying either of those worlds. You can create your own set of moral guidelines, but it is also important not to expect others to agree with you all the time. Controlling the urge to blatantly & bluntly expressing your agreements or disagreements will save you from heartbreaks and public backlash. So, there might be a need for healthy compromise without feeling outrightly attacked or restricted from expressing your opinions. This aspect holds a wealth of knowledge, talents and persistence, but it also needs refinement through patience, wisdom and consistency. You can build your career, ambitions and reputation as you navigate through the ups & downs of this aspect, the push & pull tension will motivate you to make necessary changes that challenge you to redefine everything you have known into something more tangible & grounded. Your innovative genius & a solid work-ethic will help you fulfill your biggest dreams & aspirations. 



Natal Saturn Conjunct Uranus

Occurs every 45+ years. Recent: 1986-90. Next: 2032.

One of the most rewarding combinations in an aspect. You are stoic yet expressive, stiff yet flexible, organized yet chaotic. Finding the right balance is a constant problem for you, but as you mature, you might realize that there is probably no need to choose a side, since you already embody both Saturn’s strength in character & Uranus’s eccentricity. Your childhood might have been chaotic where you constantly felt the existential fear in some way. Even if those events weren’t necessarily bad or life threatening, you might have had to adapt to the abrupt changes that made you conscious of how tumultuous life can be. 


As a result, you are also always reinventing yourself. You level up with every opportunity for change. As you get older, this adaptable flexibility gets easier & easier. Yet in some way, you will always be craving for connections that can ground you, be it a career/ambition, family/community, friendships/acquaintances, partners/lovers, etc. You especially have a lot of respect for elders & authority figures for their guidance & support. Although you are used to changing life circumstances, your rational & inventive mind can understand and map the changes, as to their frequency, rhythm & patterns. This makes you quite intuitive with how easily you are able to predict a pattern or future with just a few known variables.


Although you have grown to love the unpredictability of your life, you still crave for a solid ground to stand on. So, you will use all your ingenuity, resourcefulness and skills to create a strong foundation for yourself. You are practical and realistic, yet imaginative & intuitive, disciplined yet impulsive. This dual nature makes you a genius at planning and building your future. Your ambitions are unconventional, yet they are built from functioning ideas of the past. You have the amazing ability to reinvent old systems & ideas into something that can set a new trend for the future.


Certain situations & phases in your life may have been dark, with addictions, violence, restriction/control, etc. Your life experiences, both good & bad somehow always motivated you to make the necessary changes, no matter how dire or unconventional, be it by strategy, rebellion or through sheer willpower. However, you will have to be careful not to crave unpredictability habitually. Since, chaos can become a programmed part of your behavior especially so if your childhood experiences left a deep inner wound in you. Even if all you saw was success through making erratic changes, you might have to stop yourself from becoming addicted to it. If you are not paying attention to your own inner frustrations & how they affect your decision-making process, you might end up sabotaging what you have built just to feel the rush of excitement or relive your past experiences. 


There is no doubt that you will keep mastering your innate talent of reinvention, no matter what the odds are and how unreasonable it might seem to others. But you will have to gain discernment of what truly needs restructuring and what is just an urge from your early survival mechanism. Healing through past wounds and reprogramming your mindset into accepting peace & tranquility without subconsciously fearing what might happen next will be paramount to your physical/mental health & your success. Cultivating, sustaining, dismantling and reinventing will need order and organization. You will be able to gain wealth, reputation & respect as a result of your patience, persistence & intellect. You will likely build your empire of stability, with periodic renovations.

entry.title: Full Moon in Aries 14° 🌕♈️ Oct 7, 2025
entry.content:
A decisive Full Moon that will break open Internal Block, be it Emotional, Spiritual or Physical. This will be a rather Tense Full Moon (1 week before & after) for those who have Natal Placements in Aries, Capricorn, Libra &/or Cancer. Frustrations & Anxiety can dramatically reach higher peaks, like never before. Severe head aches & fatigue are likely. 


This 🌕 can Open up the Flood Gates to your Inner Wounds, those that you might have either ignored or felt numbed out by a long time ago. These Inner Wounds will need much needed healing ❤️‍🩹, and the time for that is certainly now. In one way or another, Past Wounds, Disappointments & Regrets can prompt you to be honest about your own feelings. 


You will have to see the Truth for what it is, and the same will be true for those around you. Relationships (of all kind, but especially Romantic) will become the focus of this rather abrupt out pouring of Emotions. Whether you are resolving issues with a Partner, or within yourself about relationships in your Life, you will be able to make honest decisions and take the right course of action without second thoughts (especially if you &/or the other person were indecisive before).


This Full Moon will urge you to honor your True Feelings, Intentions & Passions. Leaving behind past hurts, regrets & fears, for a promising New Future that one you may have always dreamt of. So, you will make the brave move and commit to a worthy decision (be it in a romantic/marital relationships or a business deal/entrepreneurial venture). If not immediately, you will at least take the first decisive step towards this commitment, which will help you break the long-held thresholds of your own fears. 


With this, you will revive your Passions, and find peace within yourself. Attaining balance of Achieving your Ambitions and honoring your Feelings. A firm promise to yourself that you will honor your most precious Dreams and Relationships, overcoming any fear or obstacle both of the past & future. 


So, this will indeed be an extra Fiery & Dramatic Full Moon for those who are at a crucial Turning Point in those Life. The challenges that are ahead will only embolden you to overcome them, since you will have no doubt within that the Success & Fulfillment of the commitments you are making now are absolutely worth the fight.

entry.title: Mars Retrograde Guide : Handle Mars Rx like a Warrior 🐯✨
entry.content:
Mars, the Red Planet of Passionate & Gallant Spirit represents our vitality, inner passions, drive & determination. As the Ruler of Aries/1H and Scorpio/8H, Mars in Astrology affects ‘what we desire, how we get what we desire, and our deepest fears that keep us from attaining those desires’. With the archetype of a Sacred Hero, Mars represents our Journey through Life full of Passion, Ambition & Enthusiasm to Create. Hence when Mars stations Retrograde, the themes associated with Mars, Aries & Scorpio also see a significant slowing down. 


Mars takes about Two years to Transit a Sign, and spends around 2.5 to 3 Months in Retrograde during a transit. As Rxs slow down our lives and allow us to Internalize, Reflect & Realign: Let us delve into the themes that become apparent during a Mars Retrograde, what to DO and NOT to DO in order to handle this Rx like a True Warrior. 


Delays & Obstacles

It is often the case during Mars Rx when every important project or endeavor we undertake gets significantly delayed. The Challenges only seem to mount, Obstacles show up out of nowhere and Inner Pressures make things even more worse.

x Avoid (DON’T) : Trying to push through the obstacles & challenges using sheer force will only seem to bring more troubles, adding to your frustrations. Working extra hard or putting in more & more effort can also lead to exhaustion especially when the results are underwhelming & unsatisfying. It is hence fair to expect the same if you are starting something new during this Rx.

+ DO Instead : When faced with seemingly insurmountable challenges, take a step back, allow yourself to identify ‘the root-cause’. As some things during this Rx will have an element of ‘being out of your direct control’, give yourself the grace to see things for what they are and face obstacles head on. Use this as an opportunity to make course-corrections and change your approach.


Introspection of Inner Desires, Ambitions & Passions

As Mars represents our Passions, when in Rx Mars often allows us to take a deeper look into “What we are pursuing” and “Why”.

x Avoid (DON’T) : Since Mars also represents our Primal Needs & Desires, introspection into such deep & intimate aspects of ourselves can also bring up negative manifestations of Desires & Passions such as Obsessions, Controlling & Oppressive tendencies. Adding to or indulging in these Negative Tendencies (rather Overpowering Aspects) of Mars can be a bit dangerous during Rxs. Since, this can increase your impulsivity, aggression and unwillingness to be stopped or delayed, which of course can lead to unnecessary troubles, destructive tendencies or even self-sabotage. 

+ DO Instead : Take a deeper & honest look into your Core Principles and everything that defines your Ambitions & Character. Utilize this Rx to gain a Clearer Perspective into what ignites your Passions. Handle any Obsessive or (Self/) Destructive Tendencies with maturity & honesty, find the source to such negative manifestations of Mars. When you realize & internalize your Inner Desires & Passions, you will find it enlightening to pursue your goals & ambitions without letting any impulsivity or self-sabotage to override your drive & intentions.


Feeling Unmotivated, Inadequate & Lacking

When Mars Rx slows everything down, it can naturally trigger our insecurities of not being able to accomplish what we set out to do. Constant barrage of obstacles, challenges & even conflicts during this time can further add to the Inner Frustration. 

x Avoid (DON’T) : While the Retrograde can leave us feeling frustrated, it is imperative not to give into it. Avoid allowing challenging circumstances to Demotivate and Discourage you. Make sure to not let your insecurities & inadequacies to overwhelm you, as this brief period doesn’t have to define all of your Life’s Accomplishments and/or Failures. 

+ DO Instead : Feeling beaten down by life & circumstances during this transit can be seen akin to the journey a Sacred Hero/Warrior takes. Remind yourself that being pushed against the wall is only part of the process that builds your Character & Inner Strength. When feeling discouraged, look back at how far you have come, reminisce on your past successes and remember what kind of future you are building. In many ways, this Retrograde can present itself as a ‘Character-Refining Process’, even as a time period that humbles you just a little. Allow yourself the grace to let this Transit work its Transformational Magic with Faith.



Lack of Vitality

Mars in Rx generally induces an unusual feeling of lethargy and even fatigue that are not just physical but also psychological. You might feel a general lack of energy, tiredness, muscle ache, or even mental fatigue. This can also affect your appetite, libido and sleep. 

x Avoid (DON’T) : It’s best not to push yourself physically or mentally during this Rx especially when feeling physically unsupported health-wise or mentally by lack of motivation. If anything, you will need to be extra cautious of not falling ill due to chronic & stress induced health conditions. Pushing yourself to the limit despite health barriers will only lead to much bigger troubles. The same can be true about neglecting health issues. 

+ DO Instead : Although this might not seem like a comfortable time to Rest & Relax, you may find it beneficial to rethink certain important areas of your life and how the lack of care/focus in those areas may be hindering you in other areas. This could be about your Daily Routines/Habits, Diet & Health Choices, Personal & Mental Hygiene, etc. 

(Thankfully) Even when you don’t have any Major Health risk, it can still be a good time for a General Check-up to get an Over-all Health Report, and so on, just to be on the safer side. Take occasional breaks, slow down stressful parts of your life and prioritize on efficiency & productivity rather than speed, this way you can stay focused on your endeavors and not let all the stress affect your health adversely. Cultivate a Patient attitude towards Life & Circumstances, as Haste & Impulsivity will only overwhelm you, leaving you with not much energy or motivation. 


Test of your Determination

Along with disappointing experiences come the obvious Test of your Determination. “Will you let unavoidable circumstances deter you from pursuing your goals?” or “Will you stay motivated no matter what?”.

x Avoid (DON’T) : This certainly adds to the “Sacred Hero’s Journey” Theme of Mars Rx, where we are left with choices that will test our courage to keep moving forward. In many ways this will be about how you deal with lack, conflict, uncertainty & such extremes effectively and transform yourself into a newer version for the next chapter of your Life. Hence, avoid giving into pressures, disappointments & the fears that come with them, as they will seem like an easy way out in the moment, but can perpetuate the Cycle of Self-Defeat if not careful. Knowing when to quit and when to push forward will be vital to your self-esteem. Avoid falling into the trap of hopelessness or giving up on things that you truly wish to achieve, especially when you can recognize that this may just be ‘a brief period of struggle’, which is precisely when you will need to stay strong & steadfast.

+ DO Instead : Stay committed to your goals and responsibilities. This is likely when you will need to dig up all the Inner Resolve that you can. Stay unyielding to external pressures, fears, challenges and uncertainty. Make sure to see things to their completion. As Retrogrades offer us the opportunities to re-evaluate our goals and to analyze if those goals are well-planned or worth all the effort. Rxs also help us weed out goals/plans that may not be in our Highest Good after all, while also granting us the extra determination to double-down on the ones that are truly well-worth our efforts.


Conflicts (both Internal & External)

One of the direct effects of Mars in Rx is the chaos & conflicts it brings into our lives, uninvited & unintended. Allow me to elaborate, Mars Rx puts us all on edge in one way or another, which naturally makes us prone to emotional outbursts, breakdowns, projections of anger & frustration, etc. Not to mention others’ behaviors can massively affect our mood & intentions during this time.

x Avoid (DON’T) : Stay out of conflicts as much as you possibly can, try your hardest not to initiate arguments and even harder not to indulge in someone else’s. Since, no one can predict where things can go in the heat of the moment, a small tif can end disastrously. This is especially true when Mars in Rx is also making Harsh Aspects to other placements in the Transit Skies (especially with Pluto, Saturn, Chiron, Moon, Uranus, Mercury &/or Lilith. That makes almost every Astrological Placement, but I hope this emphasizes on how things can go array with such difficult aspects). On an even more serious note, catch yourself ‘when perceiving enemies where there are none’. 

+ DO Instead : Try to adapt a more Venusian approach to conflicts, that way you can win without giving up on your principles and simultaneously stand your ground (at least Lawfully & Righteously). Negotiations & Compromise may not always be effective, since during the extreme negative effects of this Rx, most people may temporarily lose the Ability to Compromise due to Lack of Reasoning & Rational Evaluation of the issue/conflict at hand. Yet, it is wise not to allow others’ poor conduct to affect you adversely (which can be a challenge in & of itself), to maintain your Character & Composure during such trying times. ‘Damned if you do, Damned if you don’t’ situations will need more than tack & patience indeed.  


Serious x Special Case: Test of Courage

This might seem like an extreme scenario but, these things do often happen during particularly difficult Mars Rx’s, where you might encounter opponents/enemies who would resort to fear mongering, violent threats or even violent actions to get what they want, either for you to back out of (or) give up on something, etc. This is especially true if Mars is Rx in your 1H, 3H, 4H, 6H, 7H, 8H & 12H. The goal may be to silence, intimidate or force you to overlook (not expose) what they are doing as well. This is precisely when one’s True Character & Grit will come to question. Since, if you choose to back out, you might actually be giving into unreasonable demands and totally compromising your principles & values just to appease those that have none of their own. While if you choose to Stand Strong, evaluate your safety & protection of others involved, you might be taking a risk but you’ll be doing exactly what your Principles & Values truly stand for. 

This can present itself as the “Perfect Test of Courage” for someone on “a Journey to becoming a Sacred Hero”. Fighting against malice & evil, pushing through adversity & obstacles to become the True version of Yourself, setting an Inspiring Example. Or giving up & giving in to be deemed weak & cowardly. 


Healing your Inner Divine Masculine

Mars primarily represents Divine Masculine Principles in Spirituality & Astrology. Hence, during Mars Rxs, wounds w.r.t. our Inner Divine Masculine (and by at large the collective-awareness of Divine Masculine) comes to the forefront. Wounds and Blockages in harnessing & harmonizing Inner Masculine Energy can become very apparent. These can primarily show up as severe emotional dis-regulation, outbursts, inner conflicts, outer hostilities, fears, feelings of inadequacy, etc. 

x Avoid (DON’T) : When experiencing any emotional ups & downs (which are likely in extremes), develop healthy coping mechanisms instead of seeking an outlet in conflicts or self-destruction. Facing extreme situations can tempt you to give into your Instinctual Reflexes where anger, rage & erratic behavior can lead to (often) irreversible outcomes. An intense feeling of losing ground & control can further make you blind to your own actions. Of course, this can be vise-versa where you might have to deal with someone much like described above. Regardless, there may be a Sense of Danger & Chaos looming over your life & others’ during the extreme effects of this Rx. Avoid fueling addictions that either give you a False Sense of Control or seemingly calm your frustrations, as this can go out of hand very easily. 

+ DO Instead : Even if you are not prone to outbursts, a bit of Conscious Anger Management can do you wonders now. Understand & Integrate your Inner Masculine by digging deeper into questions that may very well be existential such as : “Where does my anger & frustration come from?”, “What are my deepest desires, How is my passion serving me to attain them?”, “How do my fears govern me?”, “How am I expressing my dissatisfactions about myself, my relationships, loses or just my Life in general?”, “What do I seek to protect?”, “How do I defend Myself.”, “How do I react to Competition & Conflict?”, etc.


Delve into things you would wish to improve about Yourself; your Approach, your Drives & your Intentions. Analyze what triggers come up to the surface & how they affect you. Understand your Purpose and give direction to your Desires. Transcending Primal Fears, Instincts, Animalistic Nature, Anger & Rage, Lust & Conquest, Power & Control, etc. will become a Conscious part of your Healing Journey. Therapy to resolve certain Painful Experiences or even Mindsets can be extremely Rewarding during this Transit.


Bravely embark on “a Journey of Re-Self-Discovery”, where you get to Heal aspects of yourself that may be hindering you, where you can face the oppositions & challenges by utilizing your Inner Strength, breaking Unhealthy Patterns of behaviors, reactions & cycles. Find your Inner Potential, Integrate into Yourself and become “a Sacred Warrior” of your Life and Destiny.
