entry.title: Sirene x Black Moon Lilith Major Aspects (Natal) 🦉✨
entry.content:
Sirene x Black Moon Lilith Major Aspects (Natal) 🦉✨


Black Moon Lilith and Sirene’s combination is a Phenomenal aspect to see in a chart (especially in a close Conjunction). Your biggest insecurities can inspire you to become that much more powerful in order to overcome those vulnerabilities. You are likely seen as someone who knows a lot, who have been through a lot, but also as someone who has overcome a lot. So as much as this quality attracts others’ admiration, it can also intimidate them immensely. There is a calmness about you that most people can’t seem to ignore, the kind of calm that hides a layer of intensity underneath which can become explosive at any given point in time. You hence have a commanding presence, whether you wish to be the centre of attention or not, and for that matter whether the attention is good or bad. You have a hold on others that can be subtle yet obvious, so in personal, romantic & intimate relationships, this aspect can be more apparent. There is something so unconventional about your personality, physical appearance, life style & career choices, etc. that is quite alluring to many, so you are likely to be quite popular, even with many secret admirers. 


It is also very very Very likely that you encounter people who may have all of your desired characteristics, yet have an alternate personality that can be much more appealing to you. So, this can also be vice versa, where others may be extremely attracted to an alternate personality of yours or a side of you that you like to keep hidden or sacred. Also, with Black Moon Lilith & Sirene’s combined effect, you are likely to encounter people who are really dark in their persona, thoughts & lifestyle. This can be something most people would consider unconventional, or dark as in DARK. The risks and dangers of this combination are hence numerous. You might have to be careful not to let your curiosities to be used against you. In many ways, the experiences bought by this aspect along with your Inner Child wounds & past traumas can also lead you towards immense Personal Transformations in life, awakening you to your Inner Power, Strength and Potential. 


You likely either have a past of injustice & wounds of victimization, or you have witnessed immense injustices around you. Your experiences and journey hence can be such an influential element in the fight for justice & rights of those things that you have first-hand-knowledge about. Your opinions may not be so popular, nor even the causes that you are involved in, yet your positive influence on them can make a huge difference. With everything, of course this can be vice versa. Yet still, Black Moon Lilith & Sirene are the two Feminine Archetypes that have similar connotations, stigma & hence influence tied to them particularly in Astrology. So, this combination of aspect in your Natal Chart hence needs to be utilized with the utmost care and responsibility. Being conscious of their effects on your personality, relationships & life in general can help you avoid the combined Dark Attributes and immensely amplify the Light Attributes. There is so much Raw Power, Resilience & Determination that can be harnessed through this aspect; in order to manifest your Greatest Desires, achieve Incredible Success and attract Immense Abundance.

entry.title: Transit Mercury Conjunct North Node in Taurus | April 6, 2023 🌈✨
entry.content:
Mercury has just entered the sign of "beauty and practicality" making a Conjunction with the North Node at 4 deg. This marks the last Mercury - North Node conjunction in Taurus for the next 18 years. North Node in Taurus has been a chaotic yet graceful transit with lots of opportunities to transform both our inner & outer worlds. With a Mercury retrograde coming up this month in Taurus, this will be a wonderful time to take some time to revise on all the important lessons we have learnt through this North Node transit. Mercury’s conjunction here will help us memorize all the bitter-sweet lessons of the past 1.5 yrs. of this glorious transit, one last time before North Node transits into Aries in the mid-July.


South Node in Scorpio has collectively shaken up our inner stability, prompting us to heal and rebuild our lives on a solid foundation of true stability & security. With Uranus Conjunct North Node for essentially a year added fuel to the chaos and helped South Node to dismantle anything & everything that wasn’t aligned with our true purpose anymore. In the process, we learnt how flimsy our idea of financial & material stability was, with major economic losses worldwide, worsened by the dreadful pandemic. Gaining back momentum to balance and get a sense of direction in recreating financial security has been everyone’s priority ever since. 


North Node in Taurus ensured that we would find solace in community and strengthen our faith through friends, family & roots. With Uranus’s help, we gained a sense of courage through sustainability and ingenuity. Scorpio South Node helped us access our inner resourcefulness and utilize it to the fullest, providing us resilience to endure the storm and its aftermath. Now, with Pluto in Aquarius squaring Taurus North Node, there is an inner tension building up and about ready to boil over from within us. Strong urge to overcome any kind of stagnancy and instability seems to be motivating us on a personal & collective level. 



Mercury here is urging us to review our plans for the future, for at least the next 5-6 years (long term) with regards to career & money, home & security, etc. With many people working for long-term monetary goals, money management and financial education have become essential tools to help us navigate the path forward more safely and smartly. Saturn in Pisces & Mars in Cancer are providing wisdom, endurance & courage with the current Sextile to North Node & Mercury. It will be a great time to map out & visualize your future goals; consider lucrative career or business ventures; create new & resourceful connections; start courses in money management & investments or even consider educating others, etc.


You might even realize how your mindset & thought patterns have changed since the last year, especially about your self-worth, intimate relationships and finances. This will mark the period of a final revision until July, before the North Node moves into Aries. So, if you have been feeling the urge to wrap up projects; revamp your personal style, be it fashion, lifestyle, body language or communication; finally breaking free from toxic patterns/cycles/bonds; healing your self-esteem issues, etc. this conjunction (along with Saturn, Mars Sextiles and Pluto, Lilith Squares) will motivate you and guide you through the process. 


We also have a serene Full Moon in Libra tonight, marking the end of a 6–12-month cycle. Expect to reap karmic rewards, and of course, also expect to see karmic justice to play out in your favor. So, this period of time certainly indicates to many karmic cycles ending, bringing relief and solace, opening up new & destined cycles with bountiful of opportunities. Closing out major cycles and walking through brand new doors of blessings, this Summer truly looks promising. 🌈✨

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Capricorn (10th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)


Natal Chiron in Capricorn (10th House)

You have a strong desire to accomplish your ambitions in life. You are driven to create a legacy of your own. But your inner wounds may have an inhibiting effect on you. Your childhood experiences left a strong impression on you. You might have felt belittled, neglected or overburdened by carrying out huge responsibilities as a child. You might have had to live up to certain standards or positions from a very young age making you feel robbed of a simple and playful childhood. You might have even had the responsibility to take care of others in your family due to circumstances. Your reliable nature can be impressive in your adult life, but you might be too hard on yourself sometimes. 


You might even push yourself to attain goals even when you might not feel fully ready to pursue them or feel like you need to over-compensate in some way. You might feel like you need to prove your capabilities to others, especially if you grew up in a restrictive or demeaning household. You might have experienced discrimination or disrespect in your workplace, even have had stressful power struggles with your coworkers and higher-ups. You might feel over-looked despite your efforts and accomplishments. You will have to heal your deeper wounds of rejection, since you can dismiss your own capabilities to succeed sometimes. As a result, you might fear success even more than you fear failure. 


You will also need to draw healthy boundaries in how much work you take on and how others treat you in your professional field. Your character will be strengthened through all the ups and downs. Your stamina and inner strength will help you leave a lasting impression on others. Your public and professional reputation will help you elevate in your life and fulfill your dreams by building your idealistic life and reach your goals without subjecting yourself or others to tyranny. Since, you might even have to be careful not to project on your coworkers or employees if you are in a higher position yourself, because unresolved inner wounds can make you unforgiving and domineering towards others. 



You will have to cultivate a good work ethic; hence under-working or over-working can be detrimental to your overall productivity. Your struggles and downfalls can be quite public, meaning, others might be able to witness you at your lowest or your professional setbacks can make you feel like you are being judged by others. You have excellent organizational skills, you are methodical and well-equipped with knowledge and resources to accomplish all your goals and ambitions, but you will need to consciously use these incredible skills to manage your time and efforts. 


Your self-doubts and negative self-talks will need to be consciously shifted towards a more realistic yet positive mindset. You will however have to make sure not to expect excellence from your loved ones the way you would from your coworkers/employees. You will also have to find peace with your inner wounds from childhood. Your healing through your career accomplishments will help you to establish a fulfilling family/home life. You can release excess pressure of maintaining a certain position or status in society by being true to yourself and your craft. 


This way you can also be proud of your accomplishments without seeking external validation. You will have to be authentic in all your professional dealings and your public image must reflect your true character, otherwise your reputation will take a hit eventually since others can easily recognize when you are acting out of dubious intentions. Your authentic and responsible personality will earn you a good reputation, respect and support along with many honors.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Libra + 7th House 🦢✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Libra + 7th House + Venus Aspects + 7° 19° 🦢✨

 LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

 You have such a sweet personality that others may initially think that ‘you are too good to be true’. You might have developed excellent People & Communication skills since your childhood. You are someone who craves fulfilling friendships, and love that is eternal. You are also likely quite talented in arts, poetry, music, etc. You can socialize and form wonderful connections overtime. You can be inspiring to many with your simple yet a Soft Charm; your voice, body-language & demeanor can be so captivating. 


This is a Sirene Placement that can be very subtle in its effects yet quite effective. You are a skilled negotiator, talented at bringing people together (or onto your side, depending on the situation). You are also good at avoiding conflicts, you know how to find your way out of any confrontation or bind. This can be quite helpful in legal and other risky situations. So, all your charm, intelligence and resourcefulness can attract a lot of people who would wish to be on your good side/team. This also means that you can attract exactly the right kind of people into your life, be it for business/career, friendship or love. 


Your innate Gentleness and sharp Intellect can be a valuable combination in both your Personal & Professional life. So, you are likely to choose careers that are stress free, comfortable & exciting all while providing you the space to express yourself and make the best use of your skills & talents. You also naturally make a great First Impression and can keep it up with your good Social Skills, so you are generally well-liked, even admired bringing you effortlessly Good Social Status and Popularity.



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You often encounter people who are very good at making you question yourself. They are highly manipulative; intellectually & mentally. They can act like your ally but backstab you without seeming suspicious the whole time. Frenemies are a huge problem with this placement. Caution in Marriage/Legally binding contracts. In romance, you can encounter people who may prey on your vulnerabilities, who at first seem like ‘everything that you are looking for in a partner/spouse’, but can turn into something completely different once the mask falls. So, these are the kind of people who are skilled at mirroring you, and presenting themselves as something they are not. It is likely that there can be instances of the ‘wandering eye’ and the temptation to cheat, by either your partner or you, even on Intellectual & Emotional levels if not physically. 


Another thing about Sirene’s negative effect here can be your own lack of assertiveness. Constantly avoiding conflicts/confrontations can lead to not dealing with important issues that can become bigger & more difficult to solve as time goes by, building up resentment along with it. This can also mean that you don’t take assertive steps towards securing your own future or sustaining balance & peace in your life, which can be a Red Flag to others, or a loop hole for manipulative people to take advantage of you in someway. 


You will also need to be careful not to become too dependent in relationships, or entertain codependency from others, since that can become burdensome (on either or both sides) leading to resentment and/or manipulation. Standing strong in your Personal Identity, Character & Goals in life will be extremely important to not become shallow, attention-seeking or lowering your standards in life. It is hence important not to rely solely on other’s opinions or to try your hardest to be liked by others at your detriment. Fitting into other’s expectations can lead you astray from your true fulfillment in life.

entry.title: Natal Sun and Midheaven MC Aspects 🍋✨
entry.content:
Sun Conjunct Midheaven MC

☌ You might consider your life purpose as your personal identity, so you pursue your dreams relentlessly.

☌ This can be a motivating factor to you, although you also take failures & setbacks seriously. Every win and lose affects your self-confidence profoundly.

☌ You have a bigger than life personality and your goals embody your passions well. So, you always give your best and then some more.

☌ This also makes you a fierce competitor. Others in your field respect you for your courageous approach to career/business. You somehow always have the upper hand over your enemies/opponents with this aspect.

☌ Your ambitious personality attracts many admirers as well. You might even be seen as a role model by many who are inspired by your accomplishments & strength in character. So, you can be quite popular.

☌ You face obstacles and challenges head-on. You rarely back down in the middle of the task, so you always finish what you start.

☌ You are responsible, and you take your job seriously. This also makes you a brave leader, since you know when to take risks and when to approach methodically.

☌ You are extremely proud of your achievements, and you can even be boastful sometimes. You will always find recognition for all your efforts. However, you must stay humble throughout your journey and maintain a healthy ego, since your mood can rise & faint with successes & failures, so you might seem arrogant or docile to others accordingly, neither of which are good for your public image.

☌ You might even climb to the top positions easily or be an entrepreneur with excellent leadership skills. Although you might not like to take advise from authority figures sometimes, causing tensions in those dynamics. You are also quite studious with this aspect; you will refine your skills & talents to stay up to date with the trends/changing times.

☌ You’ll likely pursue your ambitions with a brave heart; create incredible works/services and inspire others through your accomplishments; earn many acclaims & rewards; be a fierce leader/pioneer in your chosen field; gain wealth, prosperity, honor & respect from your career/business/public endeavors and express your authentic self through your many achievements.


Sun Sextile Midheaven MC

✱ You have a good hold on your capabilities and are confident enough to pursue your goals.

✱ Your desire to find success helps you to attract significant opportunities & helpful people towards you. 

✱ You take every opportunity with gratitude. You are responsible and you work diligently to reach your goals.

✱ You are studios and curious when learning new skills, refining talents and implementing them into your career/business.

✱ You have a positive self-image, which helps you to stay committed to your goals even through tough times, hence you overcome challenges with a renewed sense of self.

✱ Your friendly personality also makes you approachable further adding to your popularity. You have good people skills, so you are able to make influential connections easily as well. You are reliable and consistent in your efforts which help you make a good impression on authority figures and others in your professional field. 

✱ This authentic quality also helps you to gain their favor easily, so you might climb the ladder much quicker or become a notable figure in your business field.

✱ You have an impactful presence that can draw in people who admire you and so your works/services can easily gain recognition.

✱ Your efforts can even bring you many note-worthy accomplishments and rewards. So, you are able to achieve your ambitions with grace even through all your struggles.

✱ You’ll likely work diligently towards your goals; create inspiring works; spread positivity & joy; learn and teach from your successes & failures alike; express your gifts authentically; gain respect, wealth, honor and good reputation through your accomplishments and find contentment in your contribution to public/career/professional endeavors.



Sun Square Midheaven MC

□ This aspect can make you career driven, to attain success more than anything in life. But care must be taken so as not to become too focused on your career life alone.

□ You are extremely confident in your capabilities, sometimes you can even be too consumed by your ambitions. This can make you seem intolerant to others with no room for imperfections, especially when you’re in authoritative positions yourself.

□ Humility and patience may be important yet painful lessons with this aspect, since sometimes you can become consumed in your own goals and forget that others are working equally hard to reach where they want too as well. This is also true with your emotional connections to loved ones, since you might neglect your family life in order to attain career success, which can cause tensions in your close-personal relationships.

□ You might also become too focused on your public image, so much so that you wander off the path of success and slip into gaining outside validation.

□ Your early life experiences may have had a profound influence on your worldview, making you more focused on gaining financial stability and recognition.

□ You are a charismatic individual with a lot of skills & gifts, which you successfully use in your career/business.

□ You are also able to attract many significant opportunities & connections that can elevate you further on your career path.

□ Although, you might have to be committed to your efforts since inconsistency in your work/services’ quality can majorly impact your public/professional image.

□ Your incredible work-ethic can gain you a good reputation and popularity. Many will admire your journey to success. 

□ You’ll likely work hard to pursue your ambitions; create impressive works/services through your exceptional skills; make impactful changes in your personal/professional life; lead by example; gain wealth, position, respect & merit by following your desire to succeed.


Sun Opposite Midheaven MC

☍ You are talented, and you are driven to succeed in life. You pursue your goals relentlessly.

☍ You might have grown up looking up to your parents or elders as role models. However, you might have a hard time taking orders/advice from others.

☍ You are studious, and your curiosity helps you to refine your skills to their highest potential, but you might not fully appreciate criticism from others.

☍ You might also feel restricted to pursue your ambitions due to certain circumstances or opposition at first, but this only adds to your drive. 

☍ Your boldness makes you a fierce leader, even when you don’t feel like you are ready to lead others. Your passionate disposition attracts all kinds of people & opportunities towards you. 

☍ You are humble & down to earth, but you might also seem bold & arrogant when you are in high spirits. Others might also find it hard to work with/for you for the same reason. So, humility & patience will help you preserve your reputation.

☍ Your work-ethic and passion for your career also help to draw in a lot of admirers, so your efforts will find recognition and popularity.

☍ Although, you might not always feel confident about your capability to accomplish your goals. You might also feel overwhelmed by responsibilities that come with success, so there might be occasional fears of success.

☍ Your early life struggles also majorly impact your confidence levels throughout your life. But your journey to success and your accomplishments will keep inspiring you to keep going farther than you ever thought you could.

☍ You’ll likely use your talents to pursue your goals with diligence; embrace your gifts & uniqueness; believe in yourself through your dreams & aspirations; inspire others through your journey; gain respect, honor, position & prosperity through your career/public/business endeavors and hence find contentment in your accomplishments.



Sun Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ You might have a lot of insecurities in regard to being successful. Especially since recognition brings the need to be on the center-stage. 

^ So, you might fear success just as fiercely as you fear failure. You might doubt your capabilities to achieve your goals.

^ You are incredibly gifted, yet you might not be comfortable showcasing your talents. 

^ Your early life experiences might have had a profound influence on you, making you eager to succeed, yet you might feel defeated by your fear of inadequacy.

^ Your self-confidence might also be affected by life’s ups and downs easily. Especially if you experience setbacks in areas of your life where you expected sure success.

^ You might down-play your charisma, even when you are able to attract significant opportunities and people towards you.

^ You might experience social anxiety as a result. Although, you have excellent people skills, you might feel even more withdrawn in tense situations.

^ Your ability to reach success after challenges makes you an inspiring figure, gaining admirers, but you might feel unworthy of all the popularity or feel more pressured to do better.

^ You will be forced to face your insecurities and embrace your originality since your achievements will motivate you to have more faith in yourself. This renewal of confidence will also help you to be grateful for all the opportunities you have had and yet to have.

^ You’ll likely work through your insecurities and trust in your inner calling; find peace & contentment in your career path; inspire others through your authenticity; create incredible works/services; learn to accept both success and failure with humility & grace; gain wealth, prosperity, respect and honor through your diligence, following your passions unapologetically.


Sun Trine Midheaven MC

△ You have a strong sense of self and a brave character. You are sure of what you wish to accomplish in your life.

△ You are honest and down-to-earth. You rarely take anything for granted, since you are aware of all the hard work and lucky breaks that helped you reach where you are at this moment.

△ You’re able to attract many significant opportunities and connections that can further elevate you on your career path.

△ You are responsible and diligent, which can make a strong first impression on others, especially on authority figures. So, you’re able to find support from others and reach higher positions, even if it's at your own pace.

△ You have a healthy ego; you are humble and rarely ever boastful. You value your public/professional image, and hence you always strive to walk your talk.

△ You are willing to learn more and refine your skills, so you don’t mind constructive criticism and hence you are also able to gain favor from elders/mentors/authorities. 

△ You have excellent people skills. Others see you as a charismatic leader, you are well-respected by your peers.

△ Your efforts will always be recognized. But your popularity will also attract competitors/enemies. You are however able to rise above any competition & obstacles even when you are facing opposition or unnecessary conflict.

△ With all the success and admiration, you might have to be careful not to give into your ego and become self-centered. Since, others can easily see when your self-confidence fluctuates, and so they can tell the different between confidence and egotism with this aspect. Hence, your public/professional image is always under a magnifying glass, especially since you show such great potential.

△ You’ll likely garner admiration for your originality and contributions; inspire others through your success story; lead by example; spread positivity and joy; gain wealth, respect, prosperity and honor pursuing your ambitions through courage & humility, and so finding contentment in your accomplishments.

entry.title: Annular Solar Eclipse + New Moon in Aquarius 28° 🌑♒️ Feb 17, 2026
entry.content:
⚡️ The first Solar Eclipse of the year will bring enlightening insights and revelations about both the cycles of the past that are being closed out and the new ones that you are excited to explore.


⚡️ With major cycles closing from the past (along with the Mercury Rx that is about to begin in Pisces), expect people & events from the past to revisit you in one way or the other now, whether pleasantly or otherwise. 


⚡️ Reminisce the Major lessons learned and Spiritual Rewards gained. 


⚡️ With a tight Square to Uranus in Taurus however, caution with impulsivity. Be it rage, remorse, regret or sorrow. 


⚡️ Also best not to provoke or get provoked by others, as emotions can run high and tensions can escalate. 


⚡️ Whole new perspectives and Visions for life can ignite your Passions in the best way possible.


⚡️ Let the ambers of Inspiration shine through, yet plan & proceed cautiously and patiently.


⚡️ This can be an incredibly ungrounding energy (during the two weeks before and after the Eclipse) that can increase irritability, frustration and distractions. 


⚡️ Patience & Temperance especially with the New (projects, relationships, chapters). 


⚡️ That which is your “dream come true” will feel “wish (almost) fulfilled” and “just out of your reach” now, only, just for now. 


⚡️ Gracefully allow the fruits of your hard work to unfold naturally. Embrace the chaos without getting caught up in it. Trust that Divine timing is always working in your favor. 


⚡️ Reacquaint with your True & Authentic Self this New Moon, as you are stepping into the Portal of unprecedented Growth, Prosperity & Success.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Virgo (6th House) Generation 🐹✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Virgo (6th House) Generation 🐹✨

Saturn in the house/sign of details, day-to-day affairs and health, feels at home with it being in the Earth Element. You are diligent and hard working; you can work tirelessly towards your goals and ambitions. You have a brilliant mind that can solve complex problems easily. You rarely look over even the slightest things, so you are excellent at detail-oriented work. You have a natural tendency to push harder than your limits to accomplish a task. You are extremely responsible and rarely complain about any amount of work or effort that is needed from you. You are also appreciative of others for their service. You might not always feel welcomed in your workplace or career field. You might feel as though you are being outcasted, bullied or ridiculed either by the people or the system in some way regardless of what career you are a part of. 


You might have to endure working in toxic work environments for the early part of your career life which might have a profound influence on your world view. You might not always enjoy what you are doing. Even when you are in your dream job/career, you might feel it as your prime duty than something that you do for personal satisfaction. As a result, you might have to consciously put in the effort to experience the joy of your work, since you are truly doing your best, eventually with time and maturity you will be able to feel content in your chosen profession without feeling any sense of unease or guilt. You might also not feel appreciated for your hard work in the early years, but your persistence will eventually attract the right people and opportunities that will help you reach higher and making you feel recognized. 


You might undervalue your efforts quite often due to your self-critical mindset and the experiences you have had before. As a result, you might settle for jobs that have toxic work cultures or get underpaid, etc. Saturn here will protect you karmically from such poor experiences, but you will also have to recognize your own true potential and never settle for less again (if ever), this might be one of the most crucial lessons you might have to learn. You might be able to attain mastery in the field of your work. You might even be sought after by many for your guidance and expertise. You are also a giver at heart, since you are always willing to be of help to others, be it to your loved ones, coworkers/acquaintances, community or even the country. So, you might find donating, social service, activism, environmentalism, etc. to be spiritually grounding.



You might have had a harsh upbringing, either due to family issues or due to the environment you were raised in. Your early experiences may have made you realize that life is all about hard work and only those who work deserve to be content. You might have also struggled to find your inner self as you reached adulthood since in one way or another, you might have spent your childhood being a mature adult already. Introspection is your greatest tool, yet you might find it hard to turn off the self-criticism setting in your mind. You are always aware of every single thing you do, especially your mistakes, no matter how small or insignificant. In a way, this honesty is what makes you a perfectionist and a quick learner. 


Although, you will have to realize that self-criticism is supposed to uplift you and not dwindle your hopes. Since, even though you are a mentally strong person, under excessive negative self-talks you can break too, and nobody should ever be under such pressure, externally or internally. So, keeping your mind positive, practical and realistic will be a challenge but comparatively it's only a small issue for your intellectual mind to solve. Likewise, you can be overly critical about others, especially those who don’t take their work or life seriously. You dislike wasted effort, and you certainly don’t tolerate irresponsible behaviors. You hold everyone accountable for their actions. You are organized and methodical; you are also a good conversationalist. So, managerial positions, Human Resources, collaborative works, marketing, etc. along with medicine, engineering, science, service-based jobs like nursing, environmentalism, armed services, etc. can be some of your career interests. 


You are a perfectionist none the less, you demand the best of best in every aspect of your life and never lower your standards for anyone. You will however have to be careful not to be too demanding in your workplace, from your coworkers, subordinates to your boss even, since not everyone may be able to keep up with your efficiency or quality of work. So being pushy or overly critical of others can create strife your professional life. Likewise, expect jealousy, envy or even drama in the workplace as a result of others’ projecting their insecurities onto you. You might have had the opportunity to work from a young age or struggled to find a career that suits your interests, either way, even the rejections & delays may have been blessings in disguise with this placement, since Saturn here can eventually lead you to your destined career/life path.



You might have struggle with time management, multi-tasking, everyday routines, etc. during your childhood. You might have had to put in extra effort to learn essential skills that made you feel like you have the control over your life. This is extremely vital to you, since if you feel that even one of the things in your life is out of order or messy in some way, you might feel distraught until you can fix it. So, in your adulthood, you might be well-organized in everything you do. This is all thanks to your solid self-discipline. You might have endured physical ailments, accidents, illnesses or even misdiagnosis, etc. during your childhood. Such experiences may have scared you initially and eventually made you health conscious. 


You might have chronic illnesses, or you might be extremely susceptible to seasonally allergies, etc. that need to be regulated carefully. It might need a lifelong effort to maintain a well-balanced lifestyle, with regular exercises, conscious & nutritious diet, self-care, meditation, etc. You are also advised to take periodic rest days to indulge in doing what relaxes you. You might like to keep your environment tidy and clean since you despise mess. So, you might even enjoy cleaning activities in your free time or be extremely particular about how your home, office, etc. are maintained. This placement can also caution you about OCD, hypochondria, or similar issues hence you might have to be careful about such tendencies. You might have to be extra careful about your mental health, especially since you unknowingly take on a lot of responsibilities. Your positive mind frame is key, otherwise, negative thought-process alone can create problems when there are none. Any sort of excess stress can affect your mental health, and with this placement, your mental health can affect your physical health as well. 


So, staying in a productive yet positive state of mind will always benefit your mental & physical well-being. 6th House/Virgo can also represent hidden enemies in the chart; hence, you might have to deal with challenging situations like court cases, rumors, unnecessary conflicts, etc. It is also quite crucial to your over-all wellbeing to carefully choose your inner and outer circle of trusted people, since you might encounter those who may have hidden agendas, willing to take advantage of your kindness, or those who are wishing you harm even if its as subliminal as evil eye/intention. So, protecting your work, health and efforts will help you stay away from unnecessary drama and chaos. Saturn here will guide you through your routines by expecting you to maintain schedules & budgets, taking control of your health & wellness by conscious efforts, your work & reputation through diligence, spiritual balance through selfless services/donations & community work, and above all, by encouraging peace & tranquility in your day-to-day life.

entry.title: Natal Saturn and Pluto Aspects ⛰️✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn Trine Pluto

Recent: 2006-08, 1995-98. Next: 2031.

You have experienced trying situations and challenging times throughout your life with dignity. You are confident. You have a solid personality, a strong sense of self and firm belief in your capabilities. You face your fears & insecurities head-on, always ready to break out of any restriction and transform yourself from the inside out. You have a strong determination and a mature mindset that allows you to overcome any obstacle in your path. You are resilient and driven by your passions. You seem to have the inner fortitude to endure even the most gruesome and intense situations in which others would have easily crumbled. You take a structured approach to problems. You have great organizational skills. 

 

You often try to use all your inner resourcefulness to your personal & professional advancement. This in-turn makes you a formidable person, in any and every aspect of your life. You don’t back down under pressure and persist in-spite of challenges. You see challenges as self-improvement lessons, which add to your polished character. You earn the respect of those around you, especially in your career, who could be both intimidated & inspired by your achievements. There may be themes of obsession in your public life, on a positive note this could make you quite popular, on the negative side, you could be targeted by those who envy you quite often, you’ll have to deal with such people using your ingenuity and come out on top.


You have a hard time believing in others, especially in professional settings. There may have been instances with elders or authority figures that trigger deep feelings of mistrust which will often prompt you to work in secret or have plan-b-z just in case you need them. It may be important that you don’t dismiss those around you purely out of past trauma or misunderstandings, since you can very well find people who believe in your capabilities & are supportive in your endeavors. You have a tremendous amount of self-control and patience. You know how to pay the long game when facing obstacles or opposition. You know when to wait and when to strike. You are good with adapting to new situations and finding the right avenue/career/role that helps you reach your goals. 


You are extremely ambitious; your moves are well-planned and often hidden until the time of execution. You can see the bigger picture and know how to bring your visions to reality. You may be gifted in reviving old structures or methods, reform them up to current standards, making them a useful again in the modern time. You do well in positions of authoritative power, management and organization. You have a gift of intuition that helps you move towards your ambitions, guiding you through obstacles and distractions. You will likely attain power, wealth, reputation and prosperity through your incredible work-ethic and determination. 


Natal Saturn Conjunct Pluto

Occurs every 30+ years. Recent: 1981-84, 2018-20; Next: 2053.

This aspect is one of the most difficult yet powerful aspects to find in the chart. You know pain more than you know anything else in life. Your early upbringing wasn’t normal, from your relationship with parents/family to the circumstances you had to grow up in. One of your parents certainly had a profound effect on you, be it in a supportive way or in a domineering way. Restriction, extreme control, overwhelming burden of expectations, lack of either resources or emotional security, or both, could have made you grow up & mature quicker than usual as a survival mechanism. Your early experiences taught you how not to ever let anyone have control over you.


Although you have had traumatic circumstances, sometimes even feeling deprived of emotional support when you most needed it, you don’t let anything bring you down easily. If anything, you have the inner fortitude to turn pain into power. You are naturally resilient and everything you have been through added to your character development. This inner strength alone makes you formidable. You know how to turn any situation to your advantage. You like to play the long game when met with opposition, since you can out last anything/anyone with your sheer will power alone. 


You understand power-dynamics very well, if anything your struggles with domineering & manipulative people/situations helped you gain a discerning eye. Your past failures only empower you. So, you likely come out of any depressive & disempowering situation with a renewed sense of self and strength. You’re extremely methodical & persistent. You calculate every move and their consequences, since you don’t want to repeat lessons & mistakes from the past. You are a master at micro & macro management. You are an excellent leader that commands the respect of others. People in your life are intrigued and intimidated by you. You are a great mentor, many likely seek your guidance frequently. 



You have a bigger vision for your life, and you will build on it one brick at a time. You are self-reliant and rarely ever seek help from others, due to the lessons you have learnt from your past experiences. You are extremely resourceful. So, you will succeed in everything you put your mind towards. You’ve a single-minded focus, yet you can multi-task very well, putting your many skills & expertise to good use. You are also extremely influential. People are drawn towards your magnetic & mysterious aura. Many can notice your powerful personality and wish to partner up & support you. Your social & communication skills, wit and intellect can impress anyone. So, you make helpful, even affluential connections. 


Although you have had difficult experiences with authority figures or elders during your childhood, you are drawn towards mentors and powerful people. Your diligence and immense potential can impress powerful & influential people who might even take you under their wing and guide you. You are grounded and full of gratitude, especially in your adulthood, so you don’t take any opportunity or blessing for granted. You take your responsibilities seriously as well. So, you are hard on those who work with/for you, but you are harder on yourself, always expecting the absolute best from yourself first. 


With great power comes great responsibility, which is even greater to uphold with this aspect, since you might be tempted to control/manipulate others when you become an authority yourself, or to climb up the ladder of power & position. Such devious intentions alone can get you into trouble since both Pluto & Saturn will always hold you up to higher standards of morality. This can be true to ethical & legal themes as well. You will always be judged by karmic laws, so you will receive divine punishment or blessings as a result of your own actions. 


Your impeccable work ethic & self-discipline are some of the many qualities that you will be revered for. You shoulder responsibilities brilliantly, so you will find recognition from higher authorities, helping you advance to greater heights in your career. You are ambitious, so you will likely create an empire of power and wealth (especially if that’s on your list of accomplishments to make). Since, you will likely leave a mark on the world with your many achievements, a legacy built through your unbreakable spirit and faith.


Natal Saturn Sextile Pluto

Recent: 1989-90, 2012-14. Next: 2026.

This Saturn-Pluto aspect can indicate immense inner-strength, practicality and untapped potential. Your early life might have had hints of chaos or even destruction in the background which could have subconsciously motivated you to succeed in life. You have an optimistic outlook on life and your ambitions reflect your desire to achieve great success. You are humble yet resolute, so although you are friendly & respectful, you don’t tolerate disrespect or any forms of control & manipulation. You are able to recognize your talents, gifts and skills to apply them in productive ways. You are confident in your capabilities and assert your skills in modest ways. 


You will likely seek ways to master your craft. You are always improving your skills & talents, staying up to date, adding to your efficiency. You might be blessed with guides/mentors who recognize your potential and support you through your endeavors. Focus and self-discipline are incredible keys to your success. So, you are likely organized and methodical in your approach. You are goal-oriented and can envision your future well. You can divide your work and plan your ascent slowly, one firm step after another. 


Your reliable personality is well liked by others. You can easily make resourceful connections who will back your raw potential. So, you can create a supportive community that believes in your capabilities and root for your success. You are competitive yet not obsessive or destructive, since you like a healthy competition where everyone involved can learn & grow. So even when facing opposition, you tend to focus more on win-win outcomes and avoid confrontations if possible. But, when pushed beyond certain lines, you will stand your ground and fight with valor to uphold your dignity.


You are grounded and spiritually sound. Your character is well-developed. You respect others and expect the same in return. You face challenges with the inner belief that you can overcome them victoriously. Through your life experiences you have realized that changes and chaos are necessary parts of self-development, so you welcome transformational phases even painful ones with an open heart to evolve from the inside-out. You know how to learn from both your success & failures, gains & losses. Whenever you face hardships, sometimes even downfalls, you allow yourself to surrender the course of your life to fate. This faith in the universe/divine helps you to rise from the ashes, refined and more powerful than ever. You will be able to gain recognition, honor, and position through your undeterred drive, creating prosperity and success in due time.



Natal Saturn Opposite Pluto 

Occurs every 30+ years. Recent: 1964-67, 2000-03. Next: 2035.

This aspect represents the clash of the karmic powerhouses, Saturn & Pluto. You are a grounded and humble person. You are able to bounce back from anything since you have the inner strength to reinvent and transform your life, although this reservoir of inner confidence might have been restricted in some way during your childhood. Your early experiences may have shown you the extremes of power, control, manipulation, poverty, or corruption. These situations shaped you into a fighter of justice, but sometimes you might not know where to direct your anger & frustrations while facing such issues. You might be too skeptical or even paranoid by the experiences you have been through which in a sense may have robbed you of your inner peace. So, for the most part of your early adulthood, you might feel constantly persecuted or antagonized for your behavior. You might have even had to fight for your freedom in some way.


Your drive and determination to succeed comes from the depths of your soul to feel life for what it is and experience the abundance in store. But your life experiences have a reverberating effect on your subconscious & conscious decisions. It is likely that you faced power-struggles with elders, authority figures or parents that left you feeling hopeless during your early adulthood. Power-struggles in any & every way can trigger your anger or even violent backlash. But you might have been prompted to take matters into your own hands many times in such desperate situations. You feel strangely comfortable in chaotic or even dangerous situations, which when you start to introspect and reconnect with your true self can finally help you break free from toxic patterns or addictions that you might have picked up as coping mechanisms. 


One of those toxic traits might be the unquenchable thirst for power and control. You might have to realize how exerting dominance & commanding respect through fear will only cause suffering especially since you have been through the same thing in your past. The karmic over-lords, Saturn and Pluto will make things worse for you whenever you stray from the path of righteousness. You can rest assured that karmic balance will be restored in due time for every way that you have been wronged. Faith in the universal laws of karma and yourself, will help you uphold your integrity and also be able to witness justice served to anyone/thing that wronged you.


You are spiritually gifted and grounded. You can assert your power & independence through modest and healthy ways. You are reliable & responsible, wise & considerate, loyal & passionate, resourceful & ambitious; but you will have to out-grow your fears & insecurities, even feelings of resentment for past injustices in order to embrace a promising new future where you will be able to enjoy your karmic rewards. You can achieve great success and prosperity by surrendering to the flow of change with the belief that everything is playing out in your favor. Your righteousness and graceful demeanor will earn you a stern and regal reputation with time.  


Natal Saturn Square Pluto

Recent: 1992-94, 2009-11. Next: 2028.

With this aspect, you will be able to utilize the Saturnian discipline and Plutonian intense drive to achieve your ambitions in remarkable ways. The only problems that can stand in your way may be very fundamental yet extremely important to resolve. You have a strong sense of self, with immeasurable self-confidence and belief in your capabilities. You are a hard & a smart worker. You are able to envision your future with great clarity and work towards fulfilling your goals. You obtain the necessary resources, expertise or training in order to stay up-to-date and keep improving. You are a powerhouse of passion and determination. You have a single-minded focus that helps you break through any obstacles thrown at you. You are courageous enough to face the opposition no matter how serious their attacks may be. 


You can overcome all the hurdles on the outside, but sometimes, your worst enemy that remains will be you, yourself. You might be resistant to change, often ignoring the transformation that your life needs to go through. You might even try to control how certain changes happen, at what rate and to what extent, etc. which can cause a huge imbalance in the process in itself. Whenever you encounter setbacks or failures, you might be quick to point fingers outside and find reasons as to why things may have gone wrong, but sometimes you might fail to realize that it is also important to question yourself, your approach or even intentions. Since, no matter how much you try to fix things on the outside, if the problems lie in your subconscious, you will still keep encountering the same issues. 


You are quite introspective but sometimes you might overlook your own flaws and so choose not to correct yourself. This can create an unhealthy display of ego and false sense of superiority, which can in turn cause you to not take criticism, warnings or advice from others, even from your loved ones. This can lead to power-struggles, trust issues and eventual endings in your personal relationships. So, it is important to let your ego take a back seat when it comes to the matters of the heart. Allow room for self-growth, modify your approach when needed, learn from your previous mistakes, and use self-discipline to take control of both your inner & outer world. 


A bit of grounding and humility can help you enjoy the results of your hard work without becoming obsessed with the idea of attaining more & more success. Accepting changes and redirections as part of life’s natural transformational process will be an essential key to your success. You will be able to leave a mark on the world through the professional success you attain using your tenacity, raw intensity, disciple and patience.

entry.title: Partial Solar Eclipse in Aries 8° 🪽✨ Mar 29, 2025
entry.content:
An incredible Partial Solar Eclipse takes place in Aries at a Powerful 8°, marking the last Eclipse in Aries until the next 9 years (when Lunar Nodes enter Aries-Libra axis once again). This Eclipse will Sextile Pluto in Aquarius, while also activating Chiron & Mercury R in Aries; North Node, Neptune & Venus R in Pisces. If the recent Lunar Eclipse in Virgo paired with Venus & Mercury Retrogrades have left you feeling as though you are reluctantly closing out old cycles & slow walking into a New Chapter, then this Solar Eclipse will kick-start your passions & bring back your enthusiasm.


Solar Eclipses generally bring good news (albeit shocking or sudden), clarity in direction and simultaneously an end to the old ways of doing/being as the Sun & Moon meet the Lunar Nodes releasing past karma & lessons, while renewing your Life-Path & You as a whole. This Eclipse will be a lot more interesting & intense than usual, as Pluto’s Sextile will bring sudden enlightening changes almost instantly ending old & beginning new cycles. 


This Sextile can also bring sudden clarity from unexpected sources, so if you have been pondering about certain issues or trying to find direction/answer lately you are likely to find them or rather, they will find you. It also adds to your understanding & enthusiasm towards a new beginning, be it in career, relationships or love. Things are likely to get busy soon, so expect forward movement in the early part of April (even with Mercury & Venus still wrapping up their Retrograde). 


It is important to take charge of your life (in some way) now, especially if you haven’t been (/able to). Allow inspiration to flow, tap into your inner passions and bring your visions to life. This will hence be an excellent time for business & entrepreneurial endeavors, also for inventive or innovative projects. These may be short-term or long-term goals, small projects or grand ambitions. 



Since the Eclipse has the influence of both Chiron in Aries & Pisces Transits, you’re likely to feel a lil disassociated or confused, while feeling excited & driven. The persistent feeling of being in-between two worlds, the past & the present. As both Neptune & Saturn are closing out their journeys in Pisces (along with Venus & Mercury), there will be a sense of closing the book on certain relationships/situations/patterns in our life from the past and moving into new ones. 


An inevitable change that either needs your attention or initiation can trigger your most intense fears & insecurities (likely from your childhood or even your past lives). So, if you’re faced with choosing between the old & the new, when the old clearly seems like the place/situation that you can no longer stay in, then you are left with choosing the new unequivocally. Yet, this can create a dilemma and bring back nostalgic memories or fears of leaving the familiar. 


Facing these difficult feelings and consciously stepping into the new that is presenting itself in your life (in one way or another) will feel like a choice-less choice. So, regardless of the fears, sorrows or regret, seeing the next step as a chance to make peace with the past will help you make this transition into a conscious healing process. Hence, when you are faced with such a situation in the next 3-4 months where you will have to accept the inevitable, you can use this as a self-empowering experience to boldly close an old chapter and walk into the new. 


Remember to allow your instincts to show you the path when faced with old fears. Although turbulent and a lil scary, this Eclipse will bring brilliant new ideas, experiences and ignite your confidence & passion for life. Many Wonderful News & Good Luck will burst through as we embrace a whole new perspective on both our own self-identity/confidence & life as a whole. I pray & hope that this new chapter of our journey to be filled with enthusiasm, confidence, love, harmony (with-in & with-out), abundance & prosperity. 🪽✨

entry.title: Full Moon in Scorpio 11° 🌕♏️ May 1, 2026
entry.content:
🐦‍🔥 The Powerful Full Moon in Scorpio brings much needed Clarity, Tenacity and Inner Strength. 

🐦‍🔥 With Uranus’s recent ingress into Gemini (along with a positively uplifting Trine to Pluto in Aquarius), this Full Moon can feel extra Light in terms of Energies that otherwise felt restrained.

🐦‍🔥 Although pleasant and transformative, this Full Moon can ramp up the tensions both within oneself and others, thanks to the Pluto T-Square.

🐦‍🔥 Ulterior Motives, Deceptions & Negative Intentions cannot stay hidden forever, especially not when the 🌕 in Scorpio’s Deep Psychic Awareness and Keen Perception can reveal any hidden Truth & Lie.

🐦‍🔥 This also means that we will be faced with not just our fears & scars, but also with our own Shadow (and hence of others’). 

🐦‍🔥 It is best to avoid confrontations, and rather to step back & consider the situation from all possible perspectives. 

🐦‍🔥 This is potent time for deep reevaluation of your own Inner World; feelings, emotions, memories, intentions & fears that you have to consciously and honestly reflect on. 

🐦‍🔥 You are likely at the threshold of completing (if not already done with) the Past Karmic Chapters, prolonged Cycles of Intense Pain & (possibly even) Disempowerment. 

🐦‍🔥 The same is also likely true with completing Generational Cycles & Patterns, putting an end to parts of the Pain & Trauma from your past (and that of your Family Line).

🐦‍🔥 This period will hence mark the beginning of New Cycles with Karmic Rewards & Blessings.

🐦‍🔥 Wash away the sorrows, regrets, anger & despair of the Past under the Empowering Light of the Full Moon. 

🐦‍🔥 🌕 can feel like a Resurrection of your Passion, Self-Confidence & Inner Strength, inspiring your next big steps towards worthy Success & astonishing Milestones. This may be the time to take back control over your Inner World and hence your Life Path.

🐦‍🔥 Rest well and recuperate from any residual Emotional & Physical Fatigue, while making determined plans for the future.

🐦‍🔥 This may be the time to revisit Grand Goals or Passion Projects that for whatever reasons could not be achieved in the (/recent) past. 

🐦‍🔥 Spend time envisioning your Life, the Ambitions that drive your Passions. Embrace the Transformative Energy of the Scorpio Full Moon and build a Sustainable, Prosperous & Balanced Future.

entry.title: Natal Lilith Conjunct Venus ✨
entry.content:
You are exceptionally intense, passionate, creative yet sensitive, compassionate & nurturing. You have a strong relationship with your Inner Devine Feminine (regardless of your gender). If anything, this is your most cherished bond to/with yourself as you likely had to fight to accept your Inner Femininity for the longest part of your early life. This aspect means that you are one with your Instincts and your Intuition. 


To most others you are extremely attractive, mesmerizing & irresistible, yet not many can see how equally nurturing, caring & supportive you are. You are in touch with your sexual desires along with your sensuality. Since, it might be that most people can only cast their projections, prejudices & envy at you without ever attempting to actually know you. Likewise, you can also be extra protective of yourself and who gets to know the real you. 


You likely have a Lifestyle, Self-Image, Public Image, Career, Relationship dynamics, etc. that are unusual or unconventional, at least out of the ordinary, hence it can go against the societal norms. Your approach to sexuality & gender roles can also be based more on broad-thinking & independent preferences rather than traditional expectations. You may be bold, decisive and like to have control over your life rather than to let anyone or any system to tell you what to do. 


You know what you deserve and nobody can manipulate you into lowering your Standards. So you are determined to only entertain situations, possibilities & relationships that are well-deserved of you and can give you what you deserve & desire. You hence don’t stay where you don’t feel appreciated or respected; dynamics that create unnecessary hardships & toxicity that you don’t deserve to experience. You only stay where you are respected, cherished & adored, just the way you love, care & nourish (yourself & others).


So, you may be considered as “wild, unruly and too much”, even when you are only being yourself (or may be that’s exactly what their problem is: you being unapologetically yourself). This “wild” side of yours also adds to your attractiveness. An “untamed” allure that others want to know more about. This aspect hence inadvertently increases tensions among other’s expectations along with your sex appeal, charisma & magnetism. 


Now, how you use this exceptional allure & a bit of infamy is up to you, but it is wise not to give into opportunism, promiscuity, rebelliousness and blurring the moral boundaries. Instead, it is advised to use it with discernment, to explore your sexual desires and fantasies without putting yourself &/or others in danger (as that is a very real thing to be aware of with this intense aspect). 


In general, you likely are going to break a lot of hearts whether you are aware of it or not (likewise, whether you enter into relationships with someone or not). Since, most may admire you from a distance and think that you are unattainable/unapproachable (for whatever reason). Be weary of stalkers or other obsessive abnormal behaviors from certain people. 


Many people with malicious intentions can be attracted to you. They may often be eager & desperate to form Karmic bonds with you (through romantic, familial or career). It is hence extremely vital to cultivate discernment in all kinds of offers and proposals (even temptations). You need to maintain extra strong boundaries not just with strangers but even with those you already know & trust, since Lilith can often indicate to danger and hence the need for Self-preservation (as a precaution). There may be some who might have ulterior motives in making you a third party or bringing in a third party in your romantic relationships, be weary of compromising your principles in relationships. The same is true with matters of Money & Financial Stability, where these kinds of people may want to destabilize you Financially or take advantage of you in some way monetarily. 


You may be considered as someone who can’t be easily tied down in relationships (which may or may not be true). Yet, most may love the chase more than the prize, if you know what I mean. The same can be true about your approach to romance, where you might be passionate & driven but you are also easily dissatisfied after attaining what/who you want. This can (however) be said more about dating than actual Commitments, so you are likely to have a very different approach to Serious Relationships & Marriage. 


It is likely that you might have deep desires to get married and have a happy family of your own, but traditional expectations in Marriage & Serious Commitments may clash with your free-spirited & independent nature. So you are likely to commit to a Serious Relationship only if your partner: is not too traditional in their mindset & expectations, respects your individual life choices, and understands you very well. A marriage & commitment based on mutual trust, respect & understanding where you are both faithful to each other yet have independent aspects/priorities of your life (like family - career) that you both support equally even if you are not fully involved in those areas of each other’s life. 


In other words, morally sound yet traditionally unconventional marriages work the best for you. In fact, this may be true for all kinds of Relationships, since you need a level of autonomy & space to be truly yourself. Otherwise you’re likely to feel stifled, restricted & chained, which can lead to feelings of resentment, anger & grief. Such a marriage may seem peculiar yet worthy of envy to most others, since you are both able to transcend certain Archaic limitations to achieve Great Personal & Marital Success (without sacrificing one for the other).


Maintaining your sovereignty is vital to you, since it is likely that you often deal with Power-dynamics in relationships, especially in those relationships where one can have a sense of Entitlement by the sheer virtue of a familial &/or romantic bond (societal norms). You will prioritize to always be able to get out of any relationship, especially if in the past you have been in situations where you felt trapped & unable to get yourself to safety in any way. The same is true with disrespect, as you may have been in relationships where the other person was clearly derating you (in one way or another) to either satisfy their own tiny ego &/or to simply ruin your reputation. 


With Lilith’s influence, you are likely to be talked about by others, often with malicious intentions, yet you are able to ward off rumors and other nefarious attempts at tarnishing your reputation through the strength of your Character & Tact. You are wise, calculated & skilled at handling tricky people/situations/dynamics. Your naturally Likable and Lively personality coupled with Wit & Social Intelligence can save you from any trap or unjust scrutiny by your opponents (and most others in general). You are likely to develop resourceful connections who can be your ally. Although Friends / Family / Romantic partners / Acquaintances / Business partners alike will include both who are traitorous and those that are passionately by your side. You are however a very good ‘judge of character’ who can often figure out others’ intentions easily.


With Lilith’s influence, you’re likely to be acquainted/related to people who may be shady and not forthcoming. This may be something to be weary of in both Personal & Professional relationships. On the other hand, you are also open-minded, empathetic & generous of heart, so you don’t often judge people with a heavy past (e.x. who have reformed themselves and are true to living an upright & honest life). The same is true about those that may have experienced injustice & ostracism in the past, since you empathize with their feelings through your own experiences. 


You have a natural understanding of what is right, just & balanced especially in Relationships & Social contracts. So, when in dysfunctional or unequal Power dynamics, you don’t hesitate to demand a balanced & harmonious bond, instead of disrespectful, codependent or other Power Imbalances. You are also not hesitant to walk out of such situations or even sever ties regardless of Social expectations (e.x., when in an abusive household, you are likely to cut-ties with parents or other family members regardless of how others feel about your decision). 


You have a deeper sense of Justice & Balance, so it is not easy to deceive & coerce you into staying in and entertaining a clearly unfair dynamic, especially where there is abuse of some kind (psychological, emotional, physical). Whether you have personally experienced such terrible situations or have witnessed it growing up, you are likely to fight for those in similar situations either in your own Personal life & as a Social cause. You always clearly expect Fair, Harmonious & Mutually Empowering dynamics in all relationships and would not hesitate to break away & move on when that (simple) standard is not met and you don’t see any potential for it. 


You are naturally in-sync with your Creativity, with a vast potential for Artistic Excellence. You can attain Fame, Popularity and Acclaim through Creative ventures and Artistic Self-expression. Hence, you can build a successful career through your Talents & Skills. You are able to attract numerous Financial Opportunities, some through conventional others through unexpected ways. You develop excellent Financial skills through education and real-life experiences alike. This aspect can help you heal from Inner Wounds related to Poverty (be it from experience or mindset) and naturally align yourself towards Abundance. 


You are able to experience the finer things in life and naturally align towards a comfortable Lifestyle, Career, Romantic & Home life. You are likely to secure a Luxurious, Comfortable and Stable Financial foundation overtime (if not already affluent). You are also likely to marry into money (or vice versa) and can create profitable Business(s) / Career(s) with your spouse. Attaining Professional Success and elevating Social Status can be some of your most enjoyable goals to prioritize on. Abundance and Prosperity are naturally attracted to you, (especially) since you are in-tune with your Inner Divine Feminine and True Sense of Self. 


It is likely that you have experienced issues & insecurities w.r.t. your body and appearance. Even when most people find you attractive, you still deal with a fair amount of Self-image & body related issues (mainly through self-criticism) that you eventually overcome. You are able to develop a high level of Self-acceptance which also boosts your Self-esteem. This level of Personal Transformation through Honesty & Self-love is inspirational to others who may be struggling through similar issues. This is also something that others may be jealous of you for, so you are likely to be hated & envied for your Natural Beauty, Fashion/Artistic Skills, Appearance, Self-Confidence, etc. (yet still, they are taking notes 😏.)


Self-worth may have been one of the serious concerns growing up. You might have experienced certain life changing situations / relationships early on that helped you develop a Healthy Sense of Self and hence cultivate good Self-Worth. This is were you also develop a high Self-esteem hence equally high Standards for your Life as a whole. You have high Morals and great Values. You are able to develop a Righteous, Prestigious & Positive character that others both admire and envy. You are really good at creating Self-care routines, nutritious diets, healthy lifestyle, etc. for yourself (and your loved ones). Your Self-Respect makes you want to have/do/be everything that reflects just how you are full of Self-Love.


This aspect gives you exceptional charisma, vivacious sensuality, sexual appeal, elegance, passionate desires, ambitions & aspirations that are out of the ordinary. Drive & determination, tact & social skills, etc. that can help you attain inevitable Success in Social, Personal, Romantic & Professional Life. Hence, Lilith Conjunct Venus can be one of the most significant & powerful aspects in your chart that can indicate to Wealth, Prosperity, Comfort, Harmony and Security. However with all Lilith aspects, how you cultivate your Inner-self and with what intentions you utilize this unusually expectational aspect can determine the Success and attainment of your deepest Dreams & Desires.

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

You have such incredible focus dear Virgo, you are so good at what you do, sometimes you forget to take some time for yourself. But, lately the increased responsibilities and the stress may have weighed you down immensely. So, even through the pressures & tensions in your everyday life, you might feel your body naturally calling for you to take rest and re-energize this week. So, this week is likely to be one to relax and indulge in some much needed self-care. Your mental & physical health will need a lot of your attention even if you don’t find any troubles with them, since energy-wise, you will feel the intense draining sensation which can indicate the need for a good emotional recharge. 



You are likely starting to feel the fresh momentum urging you to start new projects or review old plans with a new perspective. You have been facing & healing through quite a few intense fears & insecurities for some time now, yet, your views on life are changing positively. You might even feel backed against the wall when it comes to your healing journey, but you also realize just how much you have grown as a person and how truly strong you are in character. Your personal life might bring up some issues which may trigger you a little this week. You might even be feeling tied down by your loved ones, whether you see it as burdensome or not. You might be questioning certain commitments to relationships and second-guessing them, since, you like to be extra sure about the serious responsibilities that you will be taking on for/with them. 


You might even have fears of losing your independence, but you will be able to make the best decisions since this confusion will help you introspect carefully about your true needs & wants, both individually and with regards to your loved ones/situation. Your optimism & positive outlook on life are helping you stay strong in every new & re-direction that you are taking. You will even be able to notice miraculous signs & synchronicities that will lead you towards incredible opportunities. So, rely on both your brilliance & intuition when making important decisions or taking leap towards new experiences, Virgo, you are gearing up for exciting adventures that are ahead.
