entry.title: Natal Saturn in Leo (5th House) Generation 🐬✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Leo (5th House) Generation 🐬✨

Saturn in Leo/5th House can be a particularly difficult placement yet an enlightening one none the less. First thing’s first, your inner child might be extremely deprived of joy & comfort due to either early life circumstances or even past life experiences. You might feel the heaviness of your inner wounds as time passes by, especially in your adulthood. Due to numerous reasons, both known and unknown, you might feel depleted and neglected deep within, you can feel a huge void of loneliness. As a result, you might feel restricted to love, find acceptance, be recognized & appreciated in life. Sometimes, you might catch yourself treating others badly even when you love them just the way you often treat yourself unkindly. There may be deep sorrow and anguish that seem to be hidden behind a confident mask which is very fragile. 


Even if you were born in a loving & secure household you might still feel like you are unworthy of anything good in your life. These are some of the most unfortunate feelings to harbor within oneself, but it can be even tougher to deal them as well. You might have to dig deep within to face your inner wounds and nurse them with love. Since, you might have a harsh tone towards yourself, your self-talk may be negative, or you might not even recognize how you might be treating yourself poorly. Self-love may be a foreign concept with this placement, you might imitate the love you received from your parents, friends, etc. or you might think that you are doing just fine, but there could be many other ways you may be sabotaging and depriving yourself of self-love. 


That’s one of the most interesting things about this Saturn placement, since, it often goes unnoticed, sometimes even masked behind what you think is right. So, a lot of introspection is essential to deal with such self-confidence issues. It is quite crucial that you recognize your own self-sabotaging patterns, be it over-confidence, arrogance, impatience, impudence or lacking self-confidence, allowing toxic people/situations to take advantage of your kindness, not standing up for yourself, etc. There may be many such subtle yet loud signs that are hiding in your self-expression and behavior, which you will have to carefully deal with since it concerns your inner child.



Your ability to express yourself may be majorly impaired (especially if you grew up in a restrictive household). As a result, your creative side might be suffering from lack of self-confidence as well. You might hold back from having fun or do the exact opposite if you are masking your low self-esteem, you might have a lot of fun throwing responsibilities aside but suffering deep with from guilt and discontent. You might often feel that you deserve no happiness or satisfaction, since you feel that luck is not always on your side or that bad things seem to happen all the time. You might however realize your true potential is hidden in your creativity. 


You will have to face insecurities and feelings of inadequacy in order to cross the obstacles that are in front of you. But you will understand just how invaluable your inner world truly is since you have a big heart that is kind & knows what love is through pain & disappointments. You might feel emotionally distant to others even to your loved ones. Your romantic side may be hidden from the rest of the world, and you might prefer to keep your love life as private as possible. You might feel unappreciated by your loved ones often due to the emptiness you feel within. Your partner(s) can sense the emotional distance and feel unloved as well.


You might have experienced disappointments in relationships due to a lack of clear communication, expression of feelings, misunderstandings, etc. You might have even encountered those who tried to take advantage of your insecurities, or you might have been in toxic relationships (with other challenging placements or aspects, this may be vice versa, where you could have toxic traits and not know how to love others in a healthy way, possibly even manipulate others’ feelings, etc. So, care must be taken in recognizing any such red flags from others & yourself). These experiences may have prompted you to turn to self-love since only the love you have for yourself can prevent others with such motives from hurting your heart. 



You might even have to be careful not to fall victim to attention seeking behaviors since your need to be recognize might tempt you to overcompensate for others’ dismissive attitude or over exaggerate your true feelings. You will have to find the right balance between being liked and not caring about others’ opinions about you. Since, your self-esteem alone can help you find the appreciation that you truly deserve from the right people. Your karmic duty with this Saturn placement will be to always remain authentic to your true self, treat others and yourself with love & compassion all while embracing fun & happiness.


You might see parenting as a duty, but that attitude alone might make things harder for you to handle since much like romance & socializing, parenting also involves expressing one’s true feelings without restrictions. So, with children, pets, etc. you might find it particularly challenging to fully understand their needs & desires if your inner child already feels restricted. You might find that you are breaking your inner child free through much needed self-love and child-like self-expression. Kids and pets may then become a major part of your life teaching you while simultaneously learning from you. Saturn might sometimes bind you to kids or pets in some way, like teaching, day-care, baby-sitting, coaching, etc. If not even as your own children/pets to raise & care for them. 


You might have to deal with difficult circumstances, often questioning your own self and finding deeper insights as a parent/caretaker. When with younger people/kids/pets, you might be able to understand more about yourself and also learn how to better socialize with others. You might have to be careful however not to become an extremely strict/doting parent since you might come off as controlling/obsessive which can eventually ruin the precious relationship with your kids. Saturn’s placement in a sign or (especially) house can often indicate where you can find your career path & life purpose (along with North Node & MC placements). So, Saturn in Leo/5th house might indicate a successful career in arts, creative fields, film industry, theatre, dancing, music, sports, teaching, coaching, fitness, etc. 



You see your creative talents as a personal responsibility and so you take them seriously. You might also see your hobbies as something that must make you productive, yet relaxing and having fun is crucial with this placement. Since only through an open-heart space can you access your creativity, and so depriving yourself of fun can severely damage your self-expression. This placement can prove to be challenging since your experiences and pessimistic outlook on life may affect your mental health severely leading to depression or other serious issues. 


Self-love, allowing yourself to have fun, experience the lighter & brighter side of life, enjoying the small things, developing your sense of humor, collecting happy memories, making positive connections, indulging in your creative side & hobbies, etc. will be vital to yourself/character development. Saturn will force you to face your own insecurities in order to heal your inner child. Although with time & maturity, you will realize how rewarding the journey of self-discovery & healing is with this placement, you will be able to embrace yourself with all your greatness & faults, just as others who recognize & love you for who you are.

entry.title: Natal Saturn Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
This placement can be scary at first, especially since the lessons are harsher than the direct placement. You might have endured some gruesome experiences ever since your childhood, which could have forced you to become wiser and more mature. Your patience and endurance could have been tested to their limits. Everything felt like one up-hill battle after another. But you might have also realized that you are stronger than you ever thought you were. 


You might have discovered some exceptional talents/skills or potential in the process. Hence, this retrograde placement puts enough pressure to turn you into a diamond. Your self-confidence will keep going through phases of transformation as a result. You will also have to face your fears of both success and failure, since only by being true to yourself will you ever be able to overcome your limitations. 


Methodical approach and organization will be biggest assets. You might have also experienced power-struggles with elders/authority figures, this could have been in terms of control/manipulation. Being your own authority and taking back control of your life could have been painfully rewarding lessons. Your early experiences taught you how cruel and hopeless life can be, but it also taught you that you are fully capable of building a beautiful & fulfilling life of your own. 


With age & maturity, you might have realized how self-discipline and diligence help you to tackle obstacles and reach greater success, since you know how to turn pain & fears into opportunities & strength. You might even see your hard work paying off, with karma & luck finally turning in your favor. You will be rewarded for all your good intentions & honest work with abundance and blessings.

entry.title: Relationship Specific: Natal Saturn x Venus (Conjunction + Opposition + Square + Inconjunct) • On the Road of Self Love towards True Partnership 💝✨
entry.content:
Background Image by FreePik

It often delights me as to how Saturn and Venus seem like an odd match, yet they are often considered to be Friends in Astrology. Saturn brings arduous experiences in life which are amplified by difficult aspects to other placements, so it can be daunting when we see Venus in a particularly tense aspect like Opposition, Square, Inconjunct/Quincunx & a bit of Conjunction (of all, much less) with Saturn. 


Saturn being the Planet of maturity, constraints & long-term rewards; staying grounded, humble & devoted becomes the only way one can overcome the life lessons that he brings. Whereas Venus urges us to take things slow, enjoy the sweetness & comforts of life. These two though with different ways of expressing themselves, have quite a lot in common, making their bond an odd-yet-strong one. 


In tense aspects, more notably in Oppositions & Squares, you often see how it becomes harder to access your natural Venusian powers. Since Saturn tends to overpower Venus (or any other placement for that matter) bringing a sense of extreme control over its functions. This can be especially true if Venus is in Signs + Houses of :

Scorpio + 8H, Aries + 1H, Virgo + 6H

and if Saturn is in the Signs + Houses of :

Aries + 1H, Cancer + 4H, Leo + 5H

where they are both in a difficult position hence exaggerating the negative impacts caused on each other. On the other hand, if Venus & Saturn are (both or either) in their most favored positions, one can have an easier time balancing the effects of the tense aspects.

Venus : Taurus + 2H, Libra + 7H, Pisces + 12H, Cancer + 4H, Aquarius + 11H • Saturn : Capricorn + 10H, Aquarius + 11H, Libra + 7H, Scorpio + 8H. 


Romance x Marriage x Home Life

You are likely to have a strong connection to your family, but depending on the placements & other aspects, this can be a good thing or really bad. Either your family had very strong opinions & restrictions, usually based on religious, cultural & societal views, and so you might have felt held back in expressing yourself truly, especially empathetically. Harsh circumstances & even recurring conflicts in your relationships can easily turn you cold & distant over-time. In many ways, (regardless of your gender) you might have had to hold your ground and be strong thereby not having the room to settle in & grow in your feminine side. 


Even if you respect your parents & elders, you might have a hint of fear or resentment towards them for how your relationship has evolved with them over time. Your moral-standards are strong and your ethical views keep getter more mature as you age as part of learning important life lessons, so in some ways, a cultural or religious upbringing or just certain societal expectations profoundly shaped your ideals & virtues in life.


There is also blatant disappointment in your personal relationships; feeling unsupported, unloved & unappreciated no matter how hard you try, no matter what you sacrifice to do so. Your early years may have been difficult even with a good parental relationship, you might have had a hard time finding friends, to find common ground with them. Like-minded people likely came into your life later on in your early adulthood, whom you can depend on and truly trust. So, this tense combination can bless you with the strongest bonds in life, be it with family, community, friends, associates, authorities or in romance.


Romance can be a touchy subject due to past trauma, and Yes, I mean to be that dramatic. You likely grew up in a household with parents who didn't have an ideal relationship or were witness to toxic patterns in your family. You can easily spot similar negative patterns in your own romantic life. Since, this is one of the strongest aspect combinations that can indicate Generational Trauma/Curses especially relating to romantic & marital relationships. So, you might have had a hard time in your previous relationships or you might have had difficulty finding a partner. So, dissatisfaction in your romantic life can even (in extreme situations) can deter you from ever falling in love or to ever have a romantic relationship at all. 


Even with an ideal marriage/commitment, it is very likely (along with other placements & aspects) that you will feel the marriage is turning sour over time. This is especially true for Taurus 2H - Scorpio 8H, Aries 1H - Libra 7H & Cancer 4H - Capricorn 10H axis placements. So, serious breakup, divorce, estrangement and/or separation may be likely at least once in your life. But, this aspect can also be a positive combination where your relationship strengthens over time. 



Positives x Remedies x Karmic Lessons & Rewards

The only sort of romance that can work out with Saturn & Venus, is that of maturity (on both sides). So, if you are the mature, poise & well-balanced person, with a partner who is on equal footing with you, you are likely to see the magic of love blossom and take root becoming a strong tree over-time. Even with disappointments, occasional ups & downs, if you and your partner are invested in your commitment, you will be able to overcome all the difficulties and rebalance your relationship. This is where ‘knowing who you are, what you truly want,’ most importantly ‘what you deserve’ becomes extremely vital. 


Don’t accept less than what you deserve in relationships. Infidelity, manipulation, third-party situations, etc. that are both morally & personally devaluing, you will come across major decisive moments in your personal life where you will have to uphold your integrity & dignity. A pattern of noncommittal partners, or those that string along in promise of a wedding/official commitment, future faking, emotional & psychological manipulators (even abusers), etc. can come into your life as massive karmic tests and lessons. 


However, most people don’t understand that they will have to deal with you for a long while, even if it’s just a short interaction, you will most certainly make a lasting impression on them. So, nobody gets away with intentionally hurting/playing you, thats Saturn’s promise to you, to avenge you through karmic repercussions. Hence, your self-respect & self-love will usually have to be weighed against your love & desire for the relationship, to determine if the person is worth all the devotion, effort & wait or is it all just a waste of time. 


Since, if your loyalty & devotion (all the wonderful qualities of Venus x Saturn combination) is being misused intentionally, if the dynamic has turned toxic, you will be tested to uphold your integrity and leave (or depending on your situation to put your foot down firmly). This ability to discern between ‘a downright toxic & possibly abusive relationship’ with that of ‘a difficult yet (re/)buildable with time, patience & mutual effort - kind of relationship’, will be your Life’s Biggest Test(s) of Self-Love, Self-Worth & also in True Love. 


Also, generally time apart from your partner can be beneficial for the both of you. So, you can have a fairly successful partnership with someone who is equally mature, career-oriented & loyal where the both of you can experience life, happiness, love & companionship without being overwhelmed by the pressure of (usually high) expectations from these aspects of Saturn & Venus.


With all Saturn related Aspects, especially with Venus and in terms of Romance & Serious Commitments (Marriage & Business/Career related), it is always wise to take your time in ‘building your self-esteem, understanding your values & needs, along with gaining clarity over what relationships truly mean to you & what expectations do you set for a fulfilling connection, etc’. So, it is often recommended to wait until your First Saturn Return which will be after 29 years of age to get into a serious relationship, engaged and/or married (or even your Second Saturn Return, if you are wishing to start over). 


With all the tension, harsh lessons and even difficult circumstances that these aspects bring into your life, Saturn & Venus’s Incredible Combination can bring a wonderful committed relationship(s), with long-term fulfillment, as your Karmic Reward and something divinely guided & protected.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Capricorn (10th House) Generation 🦣✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Capricorn (10th House) Generation 🦣✨

Saturn here is at home, so it’s quite a prominent placement. You are a firm authority of your own true character, and you don’t take nonsense from anybody. You might like to stay in control of everything from your home life to your career, you have a vision of how your life needs to be and you will always ensure to keep everything in order. You might have to keep your need for perfection carefully in check since it can become obsessive, controlling and overbearing otherwise, to both you and your loved ones’. You have excellent focus, and you always like to stay 10 steps ahead. You rarely shy away from hard work, long term projects/plans suit you well since you are methodical & consistent in your efforts. You always finish what you start, your endurance is one of your most impressive traits. You have clear goals for your life, even if you don’t know where to start or what to focus on at some point (initially) in your life, you might notice how life has a way of guiding you towards what aligns with your visions. 


You have great leadership skills, you also know how to follow others’ guidance, so you can climb the ladder to higher positions effortlessly. You are organized and like to prepare for bigger things in advance. You know how to utilize resources at your disposal to build a solid foundation for yourself. You might even feel burdened to succeed due to societal pressures or a deep sense of calling. You might feel rushed or pushed into being successful through circumstances. Patience and persistence may have been difficult yet powerful qualities that you mastered over time. So, taking things one step at a time and not giving into overwhelming situations will be one of your biggest lessons in life, since success is yours if you can pace yourself & trust in the process. You might feel responsible for others in your life and their well-being, you might even pave the way for your loved ones’ success. You take duty and rules seriously, you might be a little conservative in that sense, but you know that living by certain strict guidelines is a reflection of self-disciple. 


You might not know how to rest since you are always focused on your goals and so your ambitions come before relaxation or your well-being. You might also have to be careful not to neglect your family/loved ones and to make sure to spend quality time with them enjoying the simpler things and happiness in life, hence creating a good work-life balance is essential for both your personal and professional success. You might also have to take time to review your progress and celebrate your achievements every now and then, otherwise you might end up being enveloped in achieving more and jumping from one project/goal to another without reaping the rewards of your efforts. So, you will have to give yourself the due respect and acknowledgment for all your hard work, which can in turn be a positive reinforcement towards fulfilling your future ambitions. Your early life might have been full of experiences and situations that made you realize the harsh realities of life. You might have felt oppressed or bound to certain things or people. You might even have had the chance to work from a young age or might have been under the tutelage for a particular career/role that gave you a sense of direction in life. 



On the other hand, you might have had a hard time finding the right career that suited your interests for a while. Your parents, especially father/father figure may have had a bigger influence on your life since an early age. You might have looked up to them or you might have endured tough experiences from them. You might notice that you seem to attract mentors at crucial times in your life who may be strict yet quite exceptional. You form special connections with elders since you value their wisdom and guidance, even if sometimes you rebel against them. You have a mature outlook on life, as though you are an old soul yourself. You understand the intricate complexity of life and so you are much more grounded. You always take a practical approach to life. You don’t like to waste time or effort since you always give your best to everything you do. You might work harder than most and not rely on others often. You might have experienced obstacles initially that prevented you to fully express your skills, or you felt deprived of certain opportunities that made you resilient. As a result, you might have learnt how to make use of limited resources or create your own opportunities. 


The overwhelming pressure to succeed might turn into a fear in its own if you are not being mindful, just as much as your fear failures you can develop a fear for success as well. However, you might notice that every setback and failure only made you more determined and added to your inner strength. You have a natural eagerness and hunger for power, you might struggle to accept this about yourself at first, but you will one day realize how your desire to leave a mark in the world drives all of your actions. You will have to make sure not to let criticism from outside or your own self-critical thoughts to ever undermine your efforts. Maintaining a positive mindset will be crucial for both your mental health and your productivity. On the other hand, it is also important not to develop a superiority complex and become arrogant, which with this placement can become a problem since Saturn is always keeping an eye on your karma.


You might be put in the spotlight for your potential and your work. You might not like the excess attention it brings since you might find it to be distracting initially but you might also notice that you can get used to it relatively quickly. Your integrity is as important to you as your reputation. You might spend the first 20-30 years of your life building a name for yourself. Your work ethic can be inspiring to others and your will to keep moving forward can impress those in higher positions. Hence, you might gain the support and admiration from others for your potential & drive. When in an authoritative position yourself, you can be the best of leaders, guiding and mentoring others under you. You thrive in such positions well since you know what the initial struggles are and what challenges lie ahead, making you empathetic and a great guide. You might however show tough love and make sure that others are growing their own potential as well. So, even when you are a strict leader others admire you and your guidance. You might gain excellent reputation, social status and wealth with time. 


Likewise, if you take your good fortunes for granted, abuse your power, push your responsibilities onto others and not work on your purpose, you will most definitely experience massive downfalls in your life. Saturn here is especially strict on you and will always put you through the wringer for everything you do wrong and every right thing that you should’ve done. Your reputation is hence the reflection of your true character. According to your deeds and intentions, Saturn here will determine how others respect and trust you during your later years. Since, true success with this placement is usually attained during your 30-40s. You will have to uphold justice, your integrity and truth above all else, since fraudulence, crime or self-righteousness will be punished karmically. You have a greater sense of self and a much greater purpose, hence utilizing your potential and strengths without being subdued by your insecurities will ensure your success helping you to create lasting success. Your achievements will be satisfying & well-deserved, you can leave a legacy of accomplishments through your diligence. Your life can be a success story that inspires countless others to achieve their goals.

entry.title: Part of Fortune in Leo + 5th House + 5° 17° 29° 🗝️🍀💰✨
entry.content:
The Keys to your Innate Fortune & Luck with Natal Part of Fortune in Leo + 5th House + 5° 17° 29° 🗝️🍀

Self Actualization 

PoF here amplifies your Self-Confidence not by superficial Ego Boosts, but rather by increasing your Self-awareness. You are able to connect to your True Sense of Self, to the core of your Character, Personality & Ego along with your Heart, Passions & Desires. You can hence express yourself honestly and live Truthfully. Self-discovery becomes an exciting adventure where you find more about yourself; your talents, passions, fears, insecurities and all. Hence, this marvelous PoF will facilitate the right mindset & attitude towards life for your Self-Actualization. This in and of itself will draw in lucky opportunities & chances that lead you to extraordinary Fortune & Abundance in life.


Effortless Charisma + Magnetic Personality

You are Self-Confident & Self-Assured since you have Absolute Self-Acceptance. You are hence able to be yourself, unapologetically. This level of Self-Honesty naturally makes you standout, with an undeniable Charisma. You strive to have an upright Character and are Honorable. Your Character can be awe-inspiring to many as you are able to carry yourself with such Poise and Integrity. Yet you are down-to-earth and humble. Your fun-loving & high-spirited personality is captivating. Your presence hence creates an atmosphere of Goodness & Positivity that most enjoy. The balanced combination of Fun-loving & Dutiful personality also makes you an exceptional leader that others like to respect and follow, which can bring you Immense Success and Good Reputation. Hence be it in Career or Business, you find Fortune & Fulfillment when you are utilizing your Charismatic Personality & Leadership qualities to your fullest potential. 


Fun + Creativity

PoF here greatly amplifies your Creative Self-Expression. You are likely extremely talented and posses many Artistic gifts. You attract numerous opportunities simply by being expressive. Your dramatic, fun & energetic personality can bring you many fortunate opportunities and much appreciation. You are hence well-recognized ‘for everything that you do and everything that you are’. Being genuinely happy and joyous can bring Luck your way. You are likely to feel the happiest when cultivating your interests & skills, even happier when you can show-case your talents to others and the world. You are likely to find Immense Success when you are being True to your Passions and expressing your Full Potential. This PoF hence indicates to Fame & Popularity (often Awe-Inspiring and likely can invoke Envy in others). 


Heart + Generosity

You are known for your Big Heart and Compassion. You are always there for your loved ones. You are also brave enough to protect others and stand up for them, whether they are people you know & love or they are complete strangers. You are born with Unconditional Generosity that makes you a leader and a protector to everyone around you, a Hero that your loved ones are proud of and others admire. Your brave, yet kind heart is a blessing to others & yourself as your True Courage & Generosity bring Fortunate circumstances towards you. You naturally do good deeds with good intentions often without much thought or worry. This genuine desire to help others and even just to be a good person is praiseworthy. Hence, you naturally accumulate Good Karma which also attracts Abundance & Prosperity. You are not Lucky & Fortune for no-reason after all, ‘a Gracious Heart reflects an equally Magnificent Soul’. 


Romance + Loyalty

You are a lover and a fighter (but mostly you prefer being a lover). Romance comes naturally to you. You are likely to be blessed in Romantic & Committed Relationships. PoF here makes you extra appealing and attractive, likely sought-after by many admirers & love-interests. You are likely to have good encounters with Romantic partners (at least for the most part). This can indicate to finding the right Spouse / Partner in Life. PoF here can greatly increase your Sexual appeal as well, adding some extra flare to your Sex-life. You value loyalty in your relationships, especially in romance. (With good aspects to PoF and other favorable placements) You are likely to have a fulfilling Love and Marriage life. You are committed, loyal and devoted when you find the right person, hence are likely to feel contentment and blessed with a partner who reciprocates your efforts, passion & loyalty. PoF here can indicate to a Blessed Romantic relationship(s) and Marriage(s), along with a Prosperous Private Life with perhaps even Successful Financial endeavors with / support from your relationship(s).


Sacred Inner Child

Whether you grew up as a (fairly) happy child or had to deal with traumatic events during your childhood in anyway, looking back you can always acknowledge just how Blessed you are. You are able to heal and empower yourself out of grief & pain of the past. You don’t often dwell on the past, instead are grateful for all you have & all that you are able to become. You are hence more focused on your present, the here and the now, to fully enjoy & live the life that you desire. This (seemingly) Enlightened attitude towards life reflects a Healthy & Vibrant Inner Child, the source of your Extraordinary & Persistent Spirit. You innately know how to keep your Inner Child happy, healthy & nourished. There is a Sacred connection with your Inner Child that is extremely vital to your development & success on all levels. You likely also share special connection with children (+ pets). With this PoF, you are likely to be lucky in matters pertaining to Children (+ Pets), whether in having / adopting, raising & nurturing, teaching & empowering them, etc. Children & Pets can bring Good Fortune, Reputation and Good Karma in general, along with joy, peace, love and bliss into your life naturally. 



Pot of Blessings + Fortune 💰✨

Abundance naturally flows towards you. You are likely very Lucky as numerous exceptional opportunities and chance events happen in your favor (often like Magic, as if the whole universe is conspiring in your favor). Your lively, fun-loving & open-hearted personality can win many hearts. Taking the centre stage and embracing the spotlight can also come naturally to you. You are extremely creative and talented, expressing them can bring you Immense Recognition, Popularity and Fame. Your Passions & Desires hence when creatively expressed can bring much Acclaim & Success. 


Earnestly following your heart can lead you towards surprisingly lucky opportunities, people and situations. Hence when you align your Goals and Ambitions with your Heart’s desires, wants & needs, you seem to simultaneously align yourself to your Life’s Calling. Your Passions & Dreams hold the keys to your Abundance (on all levels). Your spontaneous and instinctual actions can often bring many achievements and rewards (both expected & unexpected). Your Courage and Decisive-ability to take the right action at the right time puts you on the path of Inevitable Success. Taking risks often lead to exceptional rewards, although it is advised not to give into the temptation of “gambling” with your own Potential & Life as it can become an addictive-self-destructive pattern. 


Your Child-like innocence and playfulness give your an uplifting and delightful aura. With PoF here, you feel Confident and extra Self-Assured when you are genuinely expressing yourself, be it in your Personality, Quirks, Fashion sense, Skills, Interests, Relationships, Career, etc. You need only to be Authentic and Self-Aware of your Inner needs, desires, passions & ambitions to be Successful and Recognized. Your Authenticity and Self-confidence can Inspire others to be Authentic & Confident themselves. You hence attract Good Fortune by just being your True Self, unafraid and unapologetically. 


You are compassionate & generous, the warmth of your Heart can brighten up others’ world. Sharing joy & happiness is second nature to you. Your giving & loving nature will always be blessed & Karmically rewarded. As you love with all of your Lion-Heart, you will also be Fortunate in relationships (of all kinds) to find people who are just as loyal, protective, supportive, trust-worthy and loving. You are likely to meet people who are exceptionally awe-inspiring themselves, some of whom may also be important figures in your community/career that can lead/guide you towards Greatness in some way. You are likely to be supported, encouraged, guided & favored by your loved ones and those around you who see, recognize and appreciate your talents, gifts & Life Purpose. 


The more you genuinely focus your efforts on your Heart’s calling and Life’s Purpose, the grander are your Ambitions and subsequent Successes. You draw in Blessings & Joy in your life by following your Bliss. This can not only be through your career, talents or passions, but also through seemingly simple joys such as your Hobbies & Interests. Being physically active through Sports & Fitness, Adventurous Activities and Explorative Travels can immensely fill you with excitement. Living Life to the Fullest. Sparkling Personality with adornments (+ Gold/Jewelry) and on-fleek Fashion sense can enable you to express your Magnanimous-Self. 


Joyful events such as Festivities, Celebrations + Ceremonies (especially with Family & loved ones), Concerts, Vacations, etc. where there are numerous reasons to be happy and celebrate life, to make & enrich connections and form wonderful memories. You are the life of every party & celebration that you step into. You hence bring Good Fortune & Positivity into others’ Life as well. Your Innate Light shines as brilliantly as the Sun bringing Hope, Love & Support to those around you. Hence you magnetize Good Connections, Chance encounters and Excellent Prospects towards you effortlessly. 


PoF here is one of the most significant and naturally well-placed (among all other placements). Wealth, Prosperity, Contentment, Happiness, Karmic Rewards and Abundance naturally flow into your Life; aligning you towards your Higher Calling, Life Purpose and Heart’s Wishes.

entry.title: Aquarius Super Full Moon and the decisive Grand Cross in the Fixed Signs • Aug 19, 2024 🤍✨
entry.content:
Background Image by FreePik

A Super Moon in Aquarius takes place at 27º Opposing Sun & Retrograde Mercury in Leo, Squaring Uranus in Taurus, along with special guests, Pallas Athena in Scorpio 24º & Vesta in Leo 27º. Hence, a Grand Cross in the Fixed Signs gets activated right after the recent Grand Cross in Mutable Signs on Aug 14, 2024. This Super Moon will indeed be extra potent and powerful, bringing us closer to our inner truth and higher path not just individually but also as a collective. 


With the Super Moon primarily affecting Aquarius Moon & Leo Sun (+ Mercury), we will feel particularly challenged with regards to our Higher Ideals vs. our Inner Passions, Ego vs. the Greater Mind, etc. Balancing your social life & private life will seem important. You might even feel excited to go on vacation & get-to-gathers just to end up feeling that you need more alone-time. Although, friendships & romantic relationships will need your attention. You are likely to enjoy a good time with your loved ones. There may be arguments & small disagreements here & there. Ego-clashes will be common for the next few days. Try your best to be as diplomatic as possible, if anything, you won’t be able to stand down on your opinions yet you can try to smooth out any misunderstandings if you feel compelled to.


Vesta in Leo has been directing our devotion inward through her transit so far. Harness your latent talents around this time, especially if you are building a foundation based on your skills. You will feel more in-tune with your natural desires & passions. This can also help you stay grounded while you reach for the stars. You will be able to cultivate a healthy ego even when you are faced with challenges. Sparks of inspiration & insight can ignite your passions easily, now more than ever. Pallas in Scorpio has been helping us to stand up for our beliefs relentlessly. Our inner world has been under re-construction (so to speak), with transformations of our pain & sorrow. Moving beyond grief, betrayal, anger & revenge is being facilitated for our own healing right now. 


Although, with Pallas Square Vesta, and Uranus forming a T-Square, this is grounds for easy radicalization of our thoughts, feelings & opinions. We might demand justice, take things into our own hands, or at least try to avenge (both in issues of the past & present; in our own lives & others dear to us). This Super (Full) Moon in Aquarius will hence awaken ‘the Sacred Hero’ within all of us. Whether we wish to fight for justice or try to re-stabilize major issues, our instinct will be to seek fairness and to be a savior with all the right motives.


Collectively, we will hence see Activism, even a Revolution (no matter how big or small) happening by the will of people, communities & society as a whole. Shakeups that may be subtle or hair-raising will wake us all up to take action. Instability especially in the way society, culture, institutions & governments function can create an atmosphere of extreme paranoia yet a sudden need for unprecedented change (with Uranus, it’s likely “by any means necessary”). Taking a step back and rationalizing the problems at hand to find adequate solutions can become difficult. This can hence be considered as the Dawn of a new era, which leads to more turmoil before simmering down to a peaceful & prosperous future.


Even beliefs that you thought were true may cause you to slowly change your opinions. This is especially true when it comes to complexities like religion, spirituality, morality, etc. Revelations & epiphanies can shake your belief systems yet they can lead you towards higher truth. Truth is being broken down into pieces, while the lies that surround it dissolves slowly. So, we might be tasked with picking up the right pieces to complete the puzzle, make it whole again. Since, this is a decisive time where we will see the reality setting in, clear as day. This Full Moon will hence also help us connect to our most authentic self, which will make us be wary of anything & anyone that isn’t coming from a genuine place.



This is one of those times where you will have to trust your intuition more than ever. Saturn x Uranus x Pluto x Jupiter are making everything quite apparent at this time. So, even if you feel lost without vital information in the midst of serious issues, you will be able to find the right path & catch on the right details in time. Revolutionary Uranus & Pluto’s team up in Taurus & Aquarius is restructuring our society from its roots. This is however a glimpse of what Pluto’s Transit in Aquarius is here to do. In our personal life, we can see this play out in ways both conscious & subconscious. We will feel compelled to take a deeper look at our everyday lives and how we envision our future. We will be called to make shifts in our practical lives to align ourselves with our biggest dreams. So, this Super Full Moon can easily make us extra ambitious, in building a long-standing legacy in our lives, especially focusing on long-term goals. 


Even while interpreting these crucial Astrological Skies in the past few days, I can understand how blurred ‘the line between global & personal experiences’ has become. Everything happening in your life is likely being impacted by what is happening in your neighborhood, locality, state or country, so this is a collective experience for all of us. Even if you are not following the news or avoiding getting sucked into the mayhem of the world events, this period in time can make it harder for you not to. Saturn x Jupiter form their First Perfect Square also on this Super Moon, so I hope we all stay updated on all kinds of events & news but also to take a step back without jumping to conclusions. Since, public & society in general, we are all on edge in one way or another (mostly rightfully).


This Aquarius Full Moon hence will demonstrate in its entirety as to how powerful people are, hence laying a foundation to how Pluto’s Ingress in Aquarius can play out for the next 20 years. It is not the government, institution, military, business, or bank, but the people hold the Real Power, they always have and now they are waking up to it. That is also the reason why we must be careful not to get radicalized even if we are coming from the right place. So, any distraction, division based on hatred or fear will only backfire on every hierarchy of societal system, when they go against the well-being of people. Sounds Revolutionary right?!? Well, it is what it is. Pluto in Aquarius is often unapologetic that way.


Hence, get ready for some unexpected changes within yourself, that might even hit you like a divine lightening bolt, awakening you to your true potential. There will be a natural calling towards your passions, fueled not only by your desires but also by your highest ideals. Any internal fear, insecurity & inadequacy can only stop you for so long, before you burst through those obstacles of self-doubt & lack. Your self-confidence will boost your ambitious drive, your world-view will become clearer and more firmer. 


This is indeed a new world that we are walking into, but we have to dismantle some old & outdated structures that have been inhibiting our progress (both societally & personally). So, expect incredible changes to take place throughout this month which will pave the way forward. Uranus can bring chaos to restore order and Pluto can dismantle to help us rebuild on the foundations of Truth & Righteousness. I only pray that we stay stronger together & aware, to reinvent our individual lives and our society for a better future. If you have Natal Placements in Aquarius, Leo, Taurus, Pisces & Gemini, 🫂 you are especially tasked with staying balanced through the unprecedented changes happening in your life. Let’s try our best to ride this Crazy Astrological Wave of Energy as safely & as rationally as possible. 🤍

entry.title: Retrograde Placements in the Natal Chart 🍃✨2 (Asteroids)
entry.content:
Natal Chiron Retrograde

This retrograde placement in the chart may be one of the hardest to work through especially since Chiron itself is a placement of painful realizations and deep spiritual healing. It can feel like, the early part of your life was one big “dark night of the soul” kind of experience where you might have endured through heart-breaking, disappointing and hopeless situations, events that seem to rub salt on your inner wounds. It’s as if your inner wounds are out in the open, for those with bad intentions to hurt you even more. Read More →


Natal Juno Retrograde

The first thing that might come to mind when you see Retrograde Juno in your chart is that “you are doomed in relationships for eternity”, so allow me to relieve you from your concerns since this notion is just too much of an exaggeration. It can bring problems relating to committed relationships and possibly even delays in finding/marrying an ideal partner, but that’s about it. Read More →


Natal Vesta Retrograde

There may be a split between your devotion to traditions and loyalty to yourself. You might have grown up thinking you need to dedicate your efforts & time towards your family, household, culture or even country and somewhere along the line you might have put your needs to the side. This can even manifest as being ashamed of your sensual & sexual nature. Read More →


Natal Ceres Retrograde

This retrograde placement can cause immense lack of self-worth. Self-love and care become vital with this retrograde placement, since either you didn’t get enough care & nurturing during your childhood, be it emotionally/physically or you didn’t understand how to care for yourself or both. Since you feel a lack of stability and security deep within, you might expect others to treat you badly or neglect your well-being.  Read More →



Natal Retrograde Pallas Athena

You are an avid thinker, but you might hesitate to take action on your thoughts/plans. You might have a hard time being by yourself, since your most profound internal dialogues are the loudest when you are alone. But you might eventually realize how your ability to introspect is your biggest gift. Being mindful of your actions, making well-thought-out decisions, strategic thinking, etc. are some of the skills that you may not be good at since a young age, but you understood their importance and might have even learnt them later on.  Read More →


Natal Retrograde Aphrodite (1388)

You might have self-confidence issues regarding your body image or sexuality. You might have felt inadequate in personal relationships, especially in romantic ones. You might have been dragged into conflicts over lovers, compared based on popularity or been unfairly judged through impossible beauty-standards, etc. You might have felt unappealing or undesirable in your adolescence (even if it wasn’t true). But, moving past such experiences, you might have found how truly beautiful, attractive and loved you are. Read More →


Natal Retrograde Eros (433)

This retrograde placement can initially create confusions in your sexuality, or possibly even making you uncomfortable in expressing yourself sexually/romantically. You might have been objectified by others (or vice versa) which may have left you feeling disrespected or even exploited. You might not know what you truly desire in your partner, or what kind of relationship satisfies you both physically & emotionally. Read More →


Natal Psyche (16) Retrograde

A part of you might have felt disconnected from the other, particularly your intuitive & psychic side from that of your physical & practical side. You might have experienced challenges in relationships (usually due to external interferences/influences) that made you feel like you had to fight for what/who you love. Disappointments and separations in romantic relationships may have encouraged you to go inwards, in solitude, or even seek spiritual practices to better understand the reasons. Read More →

entry.title: Pisces Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

Patience my dear Pisces, you will have tests of faith that can prompt you to make impulsive decisions this week. Your vision for the future & life goals are getting a new boost of inspiration after a hazy period of confusion. So, naturally you are also gaining clarity about what/who to commit to and how you can bring back happiness & balance into your life. But, you are also beginning to understand the limitations around you and the necessary readjustments that you will have to make before you can walk freely into your new path. This realization can hit you hard, wounding your ego a little, but you are naturally wise and grounded, Pisces, so you understand the higher purpose in the temporary delays and blockages that you are currently facing. 



With positive shifts in your physical world showing up as fresh new starts and potential new chapters opening up for you, you feel energized and ready to conquer your new life. Your self-confidence is on the rise and you are getting comfortable with the positive changes happening in your life. So, you are also more focused on gaining back control over your everyday life & routines. Your career & finances will begin to find balance, inspiring you to build stronger foundation of stability. You are more aware of your thoughts and so you are also able to make necessary shifts in your mindsets & thought-patters. You are optimistic in your expectations for the future. Painful and toxic cycles/bonds are slowly dissolving in your life, helping you to understand yourself more. 


Your choices and preferences in all areas of your life are changing dramatically. If past memories or even situations/people are showing up out of nowhere, you can see a major shift in your own attitude towards how you handle them. You are balanced emotionally, you are becoming more and more graceful Pisces, you are reinventing your self-worth. Although, you might be overwhelmed by all the immersive mundane situations. Restlessness & anxiety may be rampant throughout the week. But, you are also getting more involved in the things, people & situations that you truly wish to be a part of (if not, you are certainly getting ready to). Overall, a joyful & busy week is ahead for you, Pisces.

entry.title: Saturn & Neptune in Aries + a Mini Prediction ✨
entry.content:
Here’s one fragment of the prediction for the next 2-3 years. This period will be the most fulfilling for those that are truly spiritually grounded, recognize their Divine Path & Purpose in life, are willing to be patient and to go through mini-many-humbling moments without giving into their false/Shadow-Self and fragile ego tantrums. 


(Although this is not a personal, political or social reference, but a very real & collective one). Now, it will be a mask revealing time for those who are lost in their own delusions, deep insecurities, fear-induced character, etc. as they will become more & more delusional and lost in their own falsehood, unable to cope with reality-checks that Saturn brings during his transit here. They may become even more adamant that everything is going better than ever, continuing to desperately do all the wrong things expecting good returns. 


Saturn & Neptune entered Aries together (beginning of 2025). This greatly (and fortunately) set a Higher Vibrational precedent for Neptune in particular. Saturn although in his ‘fall’ position (in Aries) will still have a greater control over Neptune’s illusionary influence on the Collective’s sense of self (Neptune + Aries).


Those walking on the path of Truth & Humility will of course have their own challenges, but will be immensely Rewarded by Saturn during (and especially after) his transit in Aries. While those who have lost the True Essence of Life, Hard-work & Humility will pay greatly (Karmically + Energetically).


Closing one’s eyes to Reality & Truth will not make it something else. Here, wishful thinking & frivolous way of life can easily turn into arrogance, which Saturn will love to correct by harsh/rude awakenings, anything to restore the Karmic & Dharmic Balance (both individually & as a collective).


The effects of this intense transit combination will carry on as Saturn dips into Taurus (in 2028) and meets Chiron. Now that’s where things will become truly intense & interesting (with all the other Astrological influences), because honestly I can only pray it will be a hopeful time, since I shudder to think otherwise given the combination of Saturn & Chiron in Taurus. 


I might have been a little dramatic but, it has nothing to do with anything personal, political, or whatever else and everything to do with huge Energetic shifts on a collective level. So, the important thing is, we have a lot to ponder on about ourselves and who we are. Shadow, Light and all. So, I will be hopeful that this transit will help us reconnect to our True Self, our Light, with Love & Courage, for the collective Highest Good of us all.

entry.title: Natal Uranus and Midheaven MC Aspects 🌪✨
entry.content:
Uranus Trine Midheaven MC 

△ You’re an innovator, you like to bring the old and the new together. 

△ You have a different approach to your career and life in general, that allows you to explore interesting topics. So, you’ll likely choose a career path that allows you a lot of freedom.

△ You’re hence likely to be extremely skilled and knowledgeable in your preferred career path(s), this with the natural enthusiasm you have to learn new things also means that you’re always a few steps ahead of the crowd.

△ You’re spontaneous in decision making, you’re also methodical in your approach, so you take successful calculated risks.

△ You have a sound intuition. You can make sudden and unexpected jumps in your career path and positions, either forwards or backwards, both with a plan in mind. 

△ Your work might involve bringing different groups of people together, to work for common goals. You might also find a lot of success in careers related to Uranian themes like technology, science, entrepreneurial endeavors, activism, etc. 

△ Your public image is well established even though you tend to make drastic changes in your life and your work. 

△ This uniqueness also attracts a lot of attention, and so you can gain admirers easily. It’s likely that you’re popular, especially if you maintain a positive more innovative self-image and public relations.

△ You have an optimistic outlook on life, and this somehow works out in your favor since you might be led by mysterious circumstances and events that seem out of your control which puts you on the path of success. 

△ You’ll likely work towards careers and causes that make you feel liberated and gives you the opportunity to help others achieve their full potential as well. So, you can make incredible strides in your choice of profession, gain popularity even if your authenticity seems too controversial to others sometimes, and keep evolving further on your life path.


Uranus Conjunct Midheaven MC

☌ You’re a rebel and an innovator. You don’t mind going against the grain.

☌ Although you don’t like to conform to traditions, you will do well following rules and embracing cultures since you might actually be able to stabilize your life with them without foregoing your freedom (especially if there are other placements and aspects that suggest the same).

☌ You are an inspiration to others, so popularity, even immense fame is a good possibility. Many people might want to follow you because of your unique personality and your creative works.

☌ It is however important to be in the good books of karma, since if you are rebelling just for the thrill of it, encouraging dangerous/risky lifestyles and practices, or trying to gain attention in whatever way you think is the easiest, you might end up losing all the fame and favors you were blessed with. Others might catch on to your unreliable/unstable behaviors and distance themselves, or even greatly criticize you. So, although you have the ability to break from any forms of restrictions, you’re still bound by the laws of karma, and so everything you do often has an immediate effect on you, especially since it’s about MC.

☌ On the other hand, you can inspire many to find their creativity, freedom and happiness through diligence and dedication, helping them change their perspective on life, by being a positive example.

☌ You likely have unique skills and talents that you’re able to improve rapidly and apply them to your career path, thereby creating incredible works and breakthroughs. You are also quite intuitive; with other aspects and placements this could also mean that you have latent psychic abilities. Either way, you are comfortable in taking spontaneous risks and land safely on your feet, although backfiring can happen if you’re led by bad intentions.

☌ You’ll do well in Uranian related careers like Technology, entrepreneurial endeavors, science, activism, etc. You might have the feeling that you’re led by higher forces towards successful paths in life through sudden and mysterious events. 

☌ Since Uranus here is also Opposite IC, it’s likely that your relations with family and spouse(s) is quite rocky, especially when you’re overly invested in your career. So, a good work-life balance is important. This also might mean that you hate being controlled by your family/parents, so you wouldn’t want to do the same with your own family/kids. 

☌ Freedom of expression in life and career are extremely important to you, since you might feel constrained by a lot of responsibilities or rules, this could also affect your mental health (especially if Uranus is in 10H). So, you might do well with collaborating with people who can help you stay focused on things without feeling overwhelmed.

☌ You’ll likely create immense changes in your life and that of others, creating unusual yet innovative opportunities and solutions, making a greater impact on the world (for better or for worse), and so creating a remarkable life with your own hands.


Uranus Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ There is a restless energy inside of you that provokes you to make sudden and drastic changes in your life.

^ You often feel confined in a system, since you have incredible skills and talents that you harness almost intuitively, you feel the desperate need to break free, but this feeling of urgency might just be your intense need to succeed and not really about restrictions.

^ So, you can find yourself in deep trouble every-time you rush into things out of pure desperation, even if you feel that you’re being led intuitively, there’s a need for grounding in your approach.

^ You can however impress others by how spontaneously you come up with solutions, create incredible works of inspiration, etc. 

^ Hence, it’s important to pace your intense drive for success instead of diving headfirst. Especially since you’ve a lot to gain, and even more to lose.

^ You are a rebel, but you might have to introspect your motives before going against establishments/authorities. When you’re working for sensible causes, you’ll find that many others will stand with you, and when you’re rebelling just for the sake of it, or without any solid reasoning you’ll be severely criticized. 

^ This is also true when it comes to your career, you can be an entrepreneur or lead others in a group setting, but you’ll have to tap into your natural talents of bringing like-minded people together to work for common goals.

^ So, you’ve the ability to create immense changes in both your life and that of others’, you are a source of inspiration to others whether you realize it or not. 

^ Following traditions and certain rules might not really be a bad thing with this aspect, especially since you need a solid foundation to build from. So, you can always change what you believe in and what needs to be discarded after giving things some time for deliberation. 

^ You’ll likely work through your inner rebel and use it to propel forward instead of giving into its intensity, create inspiring works, gain a lot of wisdom and hence respect, find the right balance to uphold your independence without rebelling defensively, to succeed steadily on your path through your career endeavors and social causes.


Uranus Square Midheaven MC

□ You have a desperate need to be independent just so you can be free to express your true self. You feel frustrated even with the least bit of restrictions, especially if you had a harsh childhood with parents/family that were traditional/in some high position in society to act/behave a certain way.

□ These ongoing conflicts both outside and inside of you might even show up as extreme acts of rebelliousness, risky behaviors/acts/habits, mental health issues, etc.

□ This could also make you unrelenting, so you might not even explain yourself to others, there’s also a danger of being too reckless in your actions and their consequences, especially in your career endeavors.

□ There’s a desperate need for grounding, since you don’t like to be told what to do, you might have to understand the importance of it all by yourself. After a certain point in life, even the success/fame you amass might start slipping through your fingers, due to lack of solid & reliable foundation.

□ If you have a grounding influence in your life, like family/friends/partners, it is advised to take their opinions into consideration every now & then without feeling criticized. 

□ You’re able to create incredible things through the sheer power of your unique talents. There’s a lot of untapped potential inside of you, that needs patience and careful maturing process. So, when you rush before you’re truly ready or make hasty decisions just for the sake of it, you might miss opportunities or ruin them altogether before seeing them come to full fruition. 

□ You’re able to make immense changes in your life and career through your own need for excitement but it's also important not to get addicted to the thrill of it all, since you might either be going too fast or out of sync missing out on the right timing.

□ There’s a lot of inner frustration, that even with maturity & age can keep coming back up as impulsivity, self-sabotaging behaviors, callousness, etc. 

□ So, it's important to have a solid sense of self and a healthy respect for others - family, friends and public as a whole. 

□ You’ll likely work towards finding an inner & outer balance, productive ways to express your creative inner tensions, learn to depend on others while maintaining a healthy sense of independence, pave your own unique path to success hence inspiring others on their journey and attain success and recognition in your career endeavors & life in general.



Uranus Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC)

☍ This aspect emphasizes on your childhood since Uranus is also conjunct IC. Your childhood might have been chaotic in some way, either constant turmoil with parents/family members, lack of emotional or financial stability/security, emotionally unavailable/absent caretakers, etc.

☍ This could have been your early foundation; you might have learnt how to detach from others emotionally and not form stable/deep connections with others and rely only on yourself growing up.

☍ It’s also likely that you might want to create a much stable home/family for yourself in your adulthood or might not settle for any emotional commitments altogether. 

☍ This ability to detach emotionally might bring you great success in your career path, since you’re able to focus all your mental fortitude towards your goals.

☍ However, your inability to form deep & lasting bonds with others might become a detriment to your further ascent no matter how much you try to push through your rational intellect alone.

☍ You might also lose your own sense of stability as a result, since with time you might realize that you’re shutting yourself out while rejecting/detaching from others. 

☍ There’s a need to reconnect with your emotional space in order to open yourself up to your own untapped potentials since your creativity is highly based on your intuition and emotions not just on your intellectual talents.

☍ You’ve an inspiring personality, many people might be drawn towards your uniqueness. You can make essential connections and collaborations to further elevate on your career path.

☍ This also adds to your popularity. Although its important to show humility since the very people who admire you for your incredible works might turn their backs on you due to your indifferent attitude which can seem like arrogance to them.

☍ You’ll likely create inspiring works, pave your own unique path to success, gain fame and respect, while encouraging others to embrace their independence. 


Uranus Sextile Midheaven MC

✱ You’ve an optimistic outlook on life, and full confidence in yourself that helps in making spontaneous decisions to succeed.

✱ You intuitively understand the flow of trends and timing, so you know when to act and when to wait.

✱ You’re able to attract impressive opportunities to advance on your career path through your resourcefulness and connections with influential people, sometimes these opportunities seem like miraculous events guiding you towards success.

✱ You’ve a natural talent to bring people of different backgrounds together to work towards a common goal, so you’re usually successful in collaborative endeavors and leadership positions.

✱ You’ve talents within, that seem untapped at first, yet you might surprise yourself when you discover them out of the blue while working on spontaneous projects.

✱ Your career path might not have been initially established, since you have an open mind about the way to success helping you advance in unexpected ways. 

✱ You can have incredible jumps in your career/public life, and equally long falls, depending on how well-planned your risks are.

✱ You can create inspiring works, and your uniqueness adds to your public image drawing in many who admire you.

✱ You don’t mind following paths less travelled all while embracing traditional methods of approaching career. This often works in your favor. There’s however a danger of being too calculative and risking it all on one bet of an innovative idea. You’ll have to make realistic plans before taking huge leaps since your previous successes don’t guarantee that luck will always favor your recklessness.

✱ You’ll likely create unique works, make alternate and creative paths to success, inspiring many through your daring personality, gaining fame, position, and respect along your career & life path.

entry.title: Healing your Divine Feminine, and relearning how to “receive” 🪷✨
entry.content:
⚠️ These are opinions formed based on my observations and experiences. Some of the things mentioned may trigger emotions/memories relating to childhood trauma, issues with sexuality, etc. 


Divine Femininity & Masculinity are crucial parts of our existence, they’re “creation” itself. Everything and everyone are an essence of this duality, and so balancing both also becomes an important journey on its own, one often leading to a feeling of liberation from the confines of programmed ideologies about what gender roles are and how they must be either one or the other, when in real we’re both, regardless of the gender we were born into, the sexuality that we reject/accept. Since I consciously relate to my Feminine side, I shall speak of Divine Femininity in the following blog: the struggles, the inner wounds preventing the us from accepting our femininity and healing our connection within. 


Some of us, have lived most of our lives being forced into assuming our Masculine side, this could have been situations that prompted us to defend ourselves, or deep wounds concerning our sexuality/inner child, society/cultural/religious beliefs, etc. A childhood of lack and insecurities, either emotional, physical, or financial could have been the main cause for some, and for the others it was sudden/unfortunate incidents that could have forced them to either become defensive/confrontational or feel trapped/disempowered. 


Feminine energy thrives in loving, nurturing, and safe environments. It’s like that quote we grew up reading, “If you want a girl to be an angel, you must first create a heaven for her because angels don’t live in hell.” That sounds exaggerated, but it makes perfect sense considering all the things that could have potentially affected our identity as a person. Living in lack, growing up forced into a mold, or just in unsafe/manipulative environments can affect one’s sense of self severely making us feel like the whole life is just that, where we need to fight for our freedom/abundance/respect, and that nobody else will ever support/stand up for us, vulnerable or strong, it’s all up to us, and this kind of mindset can keep us stuck in the same patterns & situations that we attract. If this was one of the many challenges you lived through, this could have very well affected your mental health, finances, self-confidence, forming stable relationships, most of all, setting healthy boundaries.


This not just affects our personality, even if we are empowered, goal-oriented, over-achievers, there may come an impasse where we might start feeling that we just don’t deserve help at all, and we need to depend only on ourselves to have our backs, creating a barrier around ourselves, unable to accept help. That’s when all the insecurities pop back up, for reevaluation. If you are in this phase of your journey, you could very well have blamed yourself, others, this that & the other for how your life played out in the beginning (rightfully so). But once you’ve let out all that pent up resentment energy, you will arrive at the acceptance phase. You could have also felt how easy others’ have it in their lives (speaking from a woman’s, man’s, everyone’s perspective, because let’s be real here), and how receiving is just a natural state of their existence. This is where you might start to question yourself, if you want to live the rest of your life “surviving” or “living”? 


The acceptance of the fact that it’s your birthright to receive abundance of all sorts, not just financial, but also emotional, familial, professional, etc. “receive”, here being the key word. All the experiences you may have been through, either thought you how to give, worse, over-give and feel depleted, or go-get-it yourself which even if it wasn’t much of a problem (uk, part of being self-reliant) yet caused a deep void of lack. So, somewhere along the tiring path, you forgot what “receiving” even meant, which eventually caused an imbalance, even a sense of rejection of your own inner divinity. 


Healing this wounded part of your soul, becomes crucial going ahead in life, since one could only go so far bleeding their heart. The journey to healing your inner divine feminine can start with making small and simple adjustments to your life and (most importantly) your mindset, being:

  1. You fully accept the fact that, you DO deserve love, abundance & security. 
  2. You’re strong enough to climb the highest of mountains to reach the greatest goals & treasures ever possible, but you can & are safe to rely on others to help you along the way.
  3. Making sure that everyone who wishes to be a part of your life, to respect your need for healthy boundaries, without feeling the guilt/doubt affecting your self-confidence because you are fully aware of what you bring to the table.
  4. You are unapologetic in setting high standards both for yourself and the people/surroundings/experiences you allow into your life. 
  5. You deserve a life of give-and-take, relationships (of all kinds) that help you thrive and grow, with a happy-ending potential, because even Unconditional love without reciprocity & effort is just unrequited.
  6. No matter what your professional/personal goals are, you accept success just as easily as you know how to humbly accept failures & disappointments.
  7. You become familiar with your own self, inside-out and you are comfortable easing into your sensuality.
  8. You take good care of yourself, body-mind-soul; healthy choices & practices, pampering yourself, patient & calm, resting & relaxing, enjoying the finer things in life.
  9. You no longer participate in petty (may be even vulgar) situations and are actively making an effort into being in serene, peaceful environments/situations/relationships, where love, trust and prosperity is reciprocated.
  10. Truly believing that, You ARE Abundant, and everything that is meant for you comes to you with ease. You become comfortable in your goddess energy; benevolent, compassionate and abundant.
  11. Most of all, you allow yourself to receive.


This journey will require you to overcome your own self-doubts, years of disappointments & sorrow, most of all being true to yourself. It can be a painful & repetitive process, but the purge will be well-worth it. You might fall, doubt your journey, but you’ll also love yourself more than ever, years from now, with all the rewards & positivity that comes along with your healing. 🥰
