entry.title: Natal Saturn and Neptune Aspects 🥝✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn Trine Neptune 

Recent: 1975-78, 2001-02, 2011-13. Next: 2036.

This aspect can bring out the best of both Saturnian & Neptunian qualities. You are driven by your ideals, beliefs and faith. Your passions and life goals are well-structured. You know how to solidify your imaginations, so you can give form to your creative insights with ease. You always find practical solutions to even the most intricate problems. You take responsibilities very seriously and seldom give into excuses or laziness. You know the importance of being connected to your inner subconscious. You acknowledge your limits, but you don’t let them define you, you will always find a way to improve your skills/talents. So, in the process you also find new paths to success. 


You are always exploring the depths of your potential, since you understand the invaluable treasures hidden beneath. You are a practical dreamer. You are an optimist and a skeptic. It’s not easy to pull a wool over your eyes. You are firm in your opinions, it’s hard for anyone/anything to persuade you. You are righteous and honest. You are always finding new avenues to perfect your craft/gifts/skills. 


You are deeply spiritual. You might only place your faith on concrete religious' beliefs and be skeptical of anything ambiguous. Your approach to spirituality may be quite traditional, where you believe that structure, solid foundation and dedication are the keys to attaining inner peace. So, you might not always agree with the other side of spiritual practices which include escapism or other unconventional practices. 


Although, it is important not to become extremely self-righteous about your faith & religious beliefs, that you start to criticize the beliefs of others. Since, you might be prompted to feeling morally superior and, in the process, undermine others for their choices. This can cause conflicts especially when people start to find inconsistencies in your actions & words or start to criticize your approach to spirituality.


Your alone time is often spent doing things that bring you a sense of peace & relaxation. Charity, art, social service, activism, environmentalism, etc. are some of the things that you are actively involved in one form or the other. Your reliable and discerning personality can bring you a lot of respect and adoration from others. You might be sought after to guide/lead others through your expertise. Your dedication to your professional life will bring you a lot of recognition. 


You might choose to blend your artistic pursuits & spiritual beliefs into your career creating far more incredible projects/works. You work hard with long term success in mind, so it is likely that you don’t seek instant gratification. You know that the road to success demands the sacrifice of momentary joy & comfort. You have a strong will power and your inner strength is immense, which gives depth to your character. Your contributions to the world through both your career achievements and spiritual involvements will be well-regarded and respected.


Natal Saturn Conjunct Neptune

Occurs every 35-37 years. Recent: 1988-1990. Next: 2026.

This aspect in the Natal Chart can be one the most significant ones to consider. You might have had a harsh childhood, either due to unreliable parents/family, dangerous neighborhood, abusive family dynamics, etc. If you didn’t have a strong emotional foundation, you might have struggled a lot more growing up, and likely had to form your own emotional stability. You might have difficult relationships with father/father figures, mentors, and authority figures in general. You might have experienced hardships/abuse from them, or you might have been controlled/deceived by them, either way, you might have learnt it the hard way to never completely trust such archetypal people. 


Developing your self-confidence is a must with this aspect, since how you treat yourself will set a standard to how you allow others to treat you. If you lack in self-worth and setting healthy boundaries, you might end up in manipulative or even violent situations since it becomes easier for people with ill intentions to take advantage of you. Once you start to believe in yourself, make yourself a priority, and gain a sense of inner strength, you will notice a whole new world full of possibilities ahead of you. 


You have a gift of manifestation, since you can set your intentions high and work on them to make them a reality through practical planning. You can make your aspirations a reality, or bring your nightmares to life with the way you think. Positive mindset and thought process are essential in order to lead a fulfilling life away from the shadows of the past. You will have to make conscious effort to stay grounded with this aspect, since any escapist attitude/behaviors/habits will be shot down by rude awakenings. It’s extremely important that you are living in the moment and seeing things for what they are, since its highly likely that you can drift away in your own world (either of fantasy or horror) instead of facing the reality. 


Staying in that distorted reality can worsen your sense of self and potentially ruin your future. It’s vital that you take accountability for your actions and shoulder the responsibility for the consequences even when it’s hard to accept your (or others’) mistakes. Since, playing victim or shifting blames will only hide you for so long, if anything, with this aspect, you might get engulfed by lies and false narratives to such an extent that you won’t be able to dig yourself out of them. This can be vice versa as well, where you get involved with people who are always playing the victim and are good at escaping reality at all costs. So, it's important that you are grounded and not let any such behaviors/tendencies both from yourself and others to drag you into a place of darkness. 


It’s also important to read the fine print, look for red flags, double-check documents, etc. before getting into any kind of contracts or partnerships (including romantic ones). Making budgets, watching your spending/saving habits, securing reliable income streams, etc. will be a must since this can help in creating a sense of stability. Facing your fears/inner demons is a vital part of your life lesson. Self-sabotaging behaviors, defense mechanisms, additions, toxic patterns, etc. may come up to the surface repeatedly for you to take heed and resolve any inner child issues and traumas. You can break generational patterns, karmic cycles and toxic attachments with this powerful aspect.


Healing from the inside out is a positive manifestation of this aspect after all. It is also likely that you may possess strong intuitive & psychic gifts. You can use your wisdom and talents in your career, this aspect can give you a boost in integrating spirituality, artistic talents or psychic abilities into your works/projects. You can make incredible strides in your career/ambitions with diligence since you are good with using your gifts in a productive way. You can build a reputation through your works from both financial & social success. Having routines, plans and schedules can bring a sense of stability. 


Helping others through their healing journey is a gift you possess, although its best to use discernment when doing so, since you might have already encountered “wolves in sheep’s clothing”. Charity, religious/spiritual practices, social service, activism, environmentalism, etc. are some of the things that can bring you a sense of peace and contentment. You can have a beautiful life with your loved ones, enjoying the fruits of your hard work only when you can overcome your own limitations, work through disappointments & short comings, strengthen your inner self, build emotional security & stability, without losing faith in yourself and your capabilities. This aspect can be a tough one to navigate, but the rewards will be every bit worth the struggles & lessons.  


Natal Saturn Opposite Neptune 

Occurs once in every 35-37 yrs. Recent: 1971 - 1972, 2006 - 2007. Next 2042.

Pessimistic attitude towards oneself and others. Paranoid. The subconscious mind is always on over-drive, thinking & over-thinking, analyzing & over-analyzing. Not being able to distinguish between intuition and fearful thoughts of one's own imagination. Extreme caution and suspicion around people. Projecting fear onto every situation/person. Spiraling down into negative thinking. Either trusting others easily or not at all. Building tall & strong walls around matters of emotions & finances. Using Superficiality as a shield. Susceptible to deceit & fraud. Might turn towards alcohol and other escapist behaviors to cope with their self-isolation. Assuming the worst outcome and believing in it as if it IS the actual truth/reality. Living in their own world full of delusions and unstable comfort zones.


Truly facing one’s own fears and paranoia may help alleviate the energy blockages. Actively reconstructing one's mindset, monitoring excessive projecting, re-building the bridge to the outer world based on trust and compassion. Since it started in the mind, it should end there too. Finding hope in humanity. Being more active in community work, charity, may be even counselling/therapy (embracing the Neptunian qualities under the supervision of Saturn). A positive approach to life, detoxing the mind, getting in touch with the inner self so as to learn how to trust one's own intuition, finding the courage to leave the hurtful bubble of paranoia. 


Natal Saturn Square Neptune

Occurs every 17-19 yrs. Recent: 1997-98, 2015-16. Next: 2033-34, 2052-53.

It can be an overwhelming aspect to deal with, being one of the most difficult Neptune aspects to find in your Natal Chart. There is always a fear of the shadows from the past, paranoia is your constant companion. You must have endured immense karmic events early on in your life that may have drained you of self-confidence. You might have dealt with people/situations that were extremely toxic. Finding the courage to stand up for yourself and to face the illusions/manipulations in such circumstances may have been risky and live altering. You might have allowed others to take control over your reality without even realizing it at first believing in the good of others. Your innocence and sense of compassion without discernment may have often put you in harm's way. 


You might have felt restricted by your fears, thought patterns or illusions that others purposefully placed you in. You are a gifted individual, with a strong intuition, but external influences may have often muddled that connection to your higher self. There may have been dramatic ups & downs in your life that seemed anything but normal. There may have also been dark-spiritual & karmic attributes to the people & circumstances that you dealt with in the past. Self-limiting beliefs may have hindered your personal growth which you might have started to notice well into your adulthood. The same can be said about your spiritual growth as well. You might have realized just how connected you are to your surroundings and the collective consciousness that sometimes leaves you vulnerable to psychic/emotional attacks from people who have darker personalities. 


Cultivating your own belief-systems, strengthening your self-confidence, drawing healthy boundaries, increasing your emotional intelligence & discernment, utilizing your inner strength and facing your fears are your biggest lessons in life. With all things relating to Neptune, it is likely that you are susceptible to addictions and running away from reality to avoid remembering your past hurts. But Saturn here will present many delays and obstacles by not allowing you to move forward in life before you learn from your past and overcome your own fears. These trials & tribulations strengthen the bond between your higher self your physical self, allowing you to ground yourself and take back control over your own life. 


Breaking psychological patterns, karmic ties to people/places/things, shifting into a more optimistic mindset, etc. are some of things this aspect can helps you achieve allowing you to lead you more fulfilling, prosperous and emotionally secure life. You likely have immense artistic gifts & talents that are considerably inspired by your past hardships. You might have a harder time centering yourself and refocusing your life in a more positive way, yet once you accept them as just karmic cycles that you closed out and release those experiences, you will be able to progress much faster & farther on your life path. You can expect to see the growth in your personal relationships, career and spiritual life as you move towards your mid 20s and onwards. Your imaginative & creative abilities can bring you a lot of success. You might even be interested in spiritual-based careers. 


You might find inner peace in spiritual/religious practices, charity, activism, social service, etc. due to how such activities make you feel grounded. You are a practical person even when you’re indulging in your daydreams, so you can access the wealth of your subconscious and bring it into the world through your works/projects. You can be really proud of how far you have come by closing out such harsh karmic cycles/relationships and embracing your limitless future. Since, if you think about how anyone else in your shoes might not have overcome most of what you have, you can find solace in how your faith & inner strength shines through in even the most disappointment situations. You might hence realize how you were divinely protected and guided all along, bringing you blessings & karmic rewards.


Natal Saturn Sextile Neptune

Recent: 1995-97, 2018-19. Next: 2031.

This aspect offers the perfect blend between Saturnian structure and Neptunian imagination. You are spiritual yet grounded in reality. You are a dreamer, and an achiever, since you are painfully aware that ideals are only achieved through practical means. You can bring your dreams into the real world through pure hard work, and you often know how to set realistic goals with good planning. You know that the key to success is to apply your talents/skills in a practical way. This aspect helps ground the Neptunian tendencies. You are able to solidify your imagination & creative insights easily. You understand the value of hard work & sacrifice, you don’t mind going the long distance without losing faith in the process. So, it’s highly likely that you don’t believe in instant gratification. 


You have a great imaginative mind, but you also have a realistic attitude that helps you to be optimistic and practical, drawing out the best of both worlds. So, you are likely to master the fields of your interest with diligence. You have strong belief systems and a firm mind, so it’s not easy to manipulate or persuade you. You are generous and love to help others, yet you have the discernment to know who truly needs your assistance and who in just pretending. You are empathetic and understand the sufferings of the world, and you try to find practical solutions for them.


You are intuitive, and you might even have psychic gifts. You know how to approach inner wounds, since you can understand the patterns and layers of trauma & suffering. Your empathetic insights are invaluable in your own healing. You can be a savior, helping others in their healing journey. This can even be with practical problems where you are able to solve intricate issues. Your leadership skills can be captivating and hence you draw in a lot of people who admire you & your work ethic. You might even be sought after to teach/guide others due to your expertise and excellence. 


Your good deeds & intentions always seem to pay off, since Saturn here will reward you in full. So, involvement in charity, or even just helping your loved ones can come back to you as good karma. Your healing aura can also attract a lot of people who need help. You might have to be careful not to be too practical while dealing with your own suffering and that of others, since you can’t solve every problem that way, so exercising compassion and logic equally in discernment will help you stay grounded and positive at the same time. Your grounded approach to spiritual matters can also help you to stay connected with the collective helping with the evolution of higher consciousness & simultaneously healing the world.

entry.title: Natal Vesta Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
There may be a split between your devotion to traditions and loyalty to yourself. You might have grown up thinking you need to dedicate your efforts & time towards your family, household, culture or even country and somewhere along the line you might have put your needs to the side. This can even manifest as being ashamed of your sensual & sexual nature. You might feel that you need to be bound to your traditional background and so you can’t openly express your sexuality. 


This could be as simple as dressing according to the modern trends or changing your style to fit into the recent times, but in some ways, you might have been conditioned to think that so-and-so lifestyle, fashion sense or behaviors are blasphemous or ethically wrong, etc. You might even have strict-self-restrictions as to how you view sexuality in yourself and hence in others. 


There is nothing wrong with sticking to the traditional values and having your own opinions but if at any point in time you feel that you may be restricting your personal happiness or life style choices to please others and if that is causing you a deep sense of inner conflict, then this retrograde placement will help you change your mindset and move forward confidently to live truly as you feel comfortable & satisfied.

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Pisces (12th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Pisces (12th House)

You are sensitive and compassionate, sometimes to your own detriment. You might have experienced many betrayals and disappointments. Sometimes, you might not even know what is troubling you or why you are feeling certain intense emotions. You have many healing and psychic abilities with this placement, you might even have extraordinary artistic and creative talents. You might feel a strong desire to help those in need, yet you often feel ignored or neglected when you need assistance. You might experience frequent anxiety attacks and you don’t like to stay in tense situations/environments. 


You can pick up on energetic shifts easily hence you can also absorb others’ negativity and distress. So, you might not be able to differentiate your emotions from that of others sometimes. You might even be paranoid of others due to all the disappointing situations and events you have been through in your life. Your mental and physical health are extremely sensitive with this placement. You might have to consciously take part in routines, habits and activities, also surround yourself with trustworthy and positive people in order to stay healthy both physically and mentally. 


Self-love can be a key factor in your healing journey since you might have a hard time being kind to yourself and your needs. You have a unique gift of healing others just by your positivity and presence. You might even notice that people who need healing or comfort are easily drawn towards you. You can be a great help in health and medicine related fields, social services and charitable causes. You strongly advocate for peace, so you do your best to resolve conflicts and bring more positivity into all situations. 



Your creative talents can be put to productive use in your career/services, since you can convey your emotions and opinions intentionally through your work. So, your works and accomplishments can have an inspiring and healing impact on others. You might have a hard time maintaining relationships especially since your generous heart can overlook red-flags and give one too many chances to the wrong people at first. You will learn how to set boundaries and only cherish healthy relationships as you love yourself and understand that self-sacrificing in relationships is not always worth it. You will also learn how to let go of hurt and disappointments as a part of your healing. 


You are quite spiritual even if not religious. Your faith will be tested numerous times with this placement each time making you stronger than ever. You might even find healing in spirituality and such practices that bring you calm and serenity. You will learn how to discern what is good for your personal growth and what is just a hindrance through your life’s experiences no matter how painful. You know how to turn pain into wisdom and healing. Your positive mindset can help you lead a much more fulfilling life, so you will have to consciously change any negative thought patterns or self-talks. 


Your innocence and generosity will help you uplift others by standing in your good intentions. You can bring awareness to mental and physical health issues, social causes, environmental issues, etc. through your work and services. You might even feel divinely guided towards such pursuits. Your dedication and devotion to both your spiritual and healing journey can be reflected in your daily life as serenity, peace and contentment.

entry.title: Natal Lilith Square + Opposite Neptune ✨
entry.content:
Lilith Square Neptune & Lilith Opposite Neptune can create a deep sense of disconnect from both one’s Sexuality, Deeper Desires, Raw Passion & Spiritual Tranquility, Inner Peace, Compassion. This aspect often tends to make one either naively optimistic or blindly unhopeful. Lilith & Neptune’s combination can indicate to severe pain and traumatic experiences that can alter your whole perspective on life. This can result in self-abandonment, early childhood experiences may have triggered serious Fears & Insecurities within yourself, traumatic events may have led to unhealthy coping mechanisms, etc. Hence, this can be one of the most challenging aspects in your Natal chart, with of course a silver lining. 


A defeatist mindset, low self-esteem & self-sabotaging tendencies can further undermine your own Resilience, Inner Power & Healing abilities. A lack of familiarity within your own Inner Divine Femininity can also amplify your low Self-Worth. Your deep fears & subconscious wounds can sometimes make you doubt your own instincts, yet you will learn just how incredibly strong your intuition is. When your Shadow-side is not in your conscious control, your deep hidden desires can often lead you astray from your True Calling. This was likely often the case during your early years (especially early adulthood), where you felt tempted to give into your Shadow Self, to your deep desire and carefree risky thrill seeking side. (Although this tendency may be regulated if you also have balancing aspects to Saturn, Sun or Moon.)


However, your Shadow self might be something you may have not fully understood, yet fantasized about exploring. Since your Shadow self holds your darkest fears, desires, illusions & disparity, when triggered during crucial harsh moments in life, you may have been overwhelmed to see what’s inside your Shadow side. This may have further wounded you to realize that fantasy perhaps of a Dark Feminine Powerful self may also have deep insecurities, fears & darker emotional wounds. 


Being strong-willed & self-assured, independent & in-control of your life may feel daunting especially when you have been through an incredibly challenging life. But, that also will bring the bitter-sweet realization that you must be vigilant in order to keep safe your Inner Child, ever-graceful Innocence, loved ones, Dreams, boundless Love & Empathy. In many ways, the fact remains that you will have to be strong & discerning enough to face the realities of the world, otherwise their illusions will eat & destroy you alive.


This can be a problem when there may be a tendency where ‘you only see, hear & believe what you want to’. Since, you are a dreamer, chasing the ever illusive ideal life & world. This is certainly not a bad thing, but being unrealistic & not accepting things for what they are can land you in serious trouble. Desperation to make something work when it isn’t the right thing for you, can be more detrimental to you than in acknowledging reality and making the difficult yet mature decisions. You can create your own worst nightmare, or create your most cherished dreams as your reality.


When this aspect strikes the lightening bolt of truth, the shattered illusions and the devastating reality will shock you, triggering Deep Soul & Spiritual Awakening. It is however also advised not to get lost in the revelation and shut your eyes in fear of shattering your own built-up fantasies & false hopes, since running from the truth is akin to becoming a blind-complacent-prisoner to those illusions, which will only lead to more hardships and rude wake-up calls with this aspect.


“You need to be cruel to be kind”. Your open-hearted angelic compassion will otherwise be trampled upon and terribly misused. Falling for people who you want to save, but for the most part they may be hopeless and dangerous. It is important to believe people when they show who they truly are, since your idealistic view/version of them & the connection will not change the reality of it, which might only devolve into a delusional trap.


You not only need to awaken to the harsh realities of life, you will frequently encounter people who are blinded by their own delusions. Those who have a twisted Sense of Self, fragile Ego, yet with disturbingly zero self-awareness. They may be extremely pretentious and trying way too hard to get validation. On the other hand, you may even encounter simple people who think they are kind & gracious, but are doing all the wrong things with warped intentions. 


Being Innocent & Pure of Heart makes you a target who is always attacked. Your Kindness is often taken as weakness & naïveté. If you are not careful, you may be coerced into letting your boundaries down so malignant people can wreak havoc in your life. You may be forced to self-sacrifice in order to fulfill their own wishes. This is hence the aspect that indicates to being a victim of “Energy Vampiring”. Programming you to over-give, over-share, over-look, etc. even encouraging dysfunctional behaviors within yourself, accepting dysfunctional behaviors in others, vices and addictions to keep you co-dependent & controlled within their grasp, Stockholm syndrome, Cognitive dissonance, etc. are just some of the darker themes that you may experience at least once in your life. This aspect hence screams that you’re inadvertently a prime target for narcissists & other dark-triad personalities.


Either life puts you through a brief period of psychosis via mind-bending & faith-testing experiences, or those who are living a false & twisted reality will gladly put you through hell. In one way or another, this brief yet often an intense period in your life can force you to undergo immense Spiritual Transformation. The kind of Spiritual Awakening that will entirely change your perspective on nearly everything. Hence, some of your greatest Personal Accomplishments are often on the edge of a metaphorical cliff where you will find the ultimate Hope after having to loose all Faith. Through this healing process, along with a purified Sense of Self, your Emotional Intelligence will become incredibly stronger, hence increasing your discernment. 


Only through such harsh reality-checks will you be able to truly tap into your Raw Inner Power & Potential. Lose, failures, misfortune, hardships, confusing circumstances, illusionary challenges, etc. are some of the many bizarre and dangerous situations that you are likely to encounter. The best advise is still to practice discernment, stay extra caution and not to get involved as much as possible. The more you thread carefully around murky situations, the more you will stay safe from falling into the Muddy Waters of bad Karma. 


Lilith’s involvement here may actually be a blessing in disguise, since you will be able to subconsciously awaken to your hidden Courage & Resilience when you need it the most. You are able to rescue yourself, especially your Inner Child as your own Badass Warrior. Here you are encouraged to find a balance between your Kind, Idealistic & Emphatic side with your Bold, Powerful & No-Nonsense side. Hence, more than just brevity & toughness, your Inner Divine Feminine energy will Empower & heal you. If you ever find yourself in a dilemma whether to abandon your Inner Divine Feminine, Ambitious & Independent self to become completely compassionate, altruistic & complacent, this aspect will likely urge you to instead find a fair balance between the two (and of course the other way around is equally true).


You are extremely susceptible to Spiritual attacks, the same is extra true for Psychological Manipulation. You will need to learn and affirm super strong Boundaries, not just consciously but also subconsciously as you are vulnerable to Psychic, Psychological & Emotional manipulation (even abuse). You may very well be Labeled as unkind and selfish for having healthy boundaries. But, it is still well-worth it to protect yourself instead of letting others take advantage of your kindness, vulnerabilities & gifts alike. You are a natural born healer, believing in your own transformational gifts will help you immensely. You may have encountered supernatural experiences during your childhood, some of which you may not even remember. It is very likely that hard times early on in life may have awakened some Latent Psychic & Spiritual abilities.


It is highly advised not to fall into the trap of pretentious victimhood, as skilled manipulators often will try to form bonds & build trust with you using your unsuspecting compassion & empathy. Learn to say “NO”, especially since your Intuition & Gut instincts will always ring the alarm. No matter what kind of experiences, childhood, upbringing or trauma you have been through, your empathy & compassion are Superpowers to share, nobody has the right to demand or coerce you.


Self-Sacrifice & Unconditional Empathy especially when you are barely aware of the kind of situation you are getting into will unfortunately only lead to Self-Destruction. With this aspect, it is always advised against “playing with fire” so to speak. Best not to willingly walk into the arms of trouble, since this aspect combination can indicate that you are always susceptible to falling into Karmic traps & Mazes that may very well be close to impossible to get out of.


You can be unconditionally loving & Hopeful for a Peaceful World, especially since that is all you truly want and will give/do anything to make it happen. But, you can’t self-destruct & sacrifice to achieve that. This world’s problems are not one person’s responsibility to carry or correct, ever. 

You can never destroy yourself to build someone else’s dreams either, especially those that have no peace or compassion within to fill a void that can never be filled. 


Your Creativity and Spirituality are closely tied to your Independence & Sexuality. No matter how unconventional your Beliefs, Dreams, Ambitions & Passions are, you will go through periods of being rejected, detested, ostracized or at the very least severely unpunished & criticized in some way, before being admired & celebrated (especially once you achieve great things). Distractions will always be numerous; so “how you manage them, what healthy coping mechanisms & habits you will wisen up to cultivate” will determine what lessons you have truly learnt from this aspect.


Other’s good intentions can often cause you immense pain & lose. As their actions although according to them are motivated by good-will, only turns disastrous for you if they are doing it out of desperation or other subconsciously hidden motives. Their Shadow side can hence prompt them to intentionally or unintentionally harm you in the guise of helping you. The same can be true when you take actions out of subconscious fears, desperation or ulterior expectations. Even your kindness & good intentions can backfire on you and potentially cause trouble for others.


You often feel the deep need to be needed by others, to share joy & compassion, to build a peaceful household/society/world, etc. But, you may not always find yourself among the right people who have the same ‘truly-innocent-soul’ or honest intentions as you. In extreme cases, you might actually get trapped in situations where you are being controlled and your goddesses misused. A level of detachment & independent-unbothered-spirit can actually save you from such otherwise unknown dangers. 


As Neptune represents deep Spiritual Relationships, under this aspect’s influence you are likely to encounter Intense bonds that may range from: manipulative - toxic - abusive to uplifting + fulfilling + divine. Here karmically, what you learn from these relationships become more important than what you experience in those relationships. You might not be able to fully manifest your ideals & fantasies of a Divine Connection, but being a little realistic with your expectations will get you closer to achieving most of your dreams & desires (both in relationships and in life).


If past relationships disappointed you and left deep scars, with this wonderful healing aspect you are encouraged to never loose your faith in True & Divine Love. The same is true about life as a whole. So, learn and adapt in life, all while keeping your vision for the future, dreams & aspirations alive. Your unrelenting faith, hope, boundless empathy, altruism, creativity & good-will for the whole entire world are something to be cherished & nurtured, which the world will inevitably come to appreciate.


With this combination of Lilith & Neptune, stay vigilant with matters of religion & spirituality. You may have unconventional spiritual &/or religious beliefs that may raise some eyebrows especially of those that seem to be ultra self-righteous, conservative & orthodox in their beliefs. You may often like to venture out and explore new Spiritual teachings, especially those that may be foreign to where you were born & brought up. Seek knowledge & spiritual wisdom all while maintaining your own independent beliefs & strong value systems, as this aspect can often make you vulnerable to scams & cults that though seemingly convincing can be detrimental & dangerous. This again can also point to people (especially in positions of power & authority) who may try too hard to push their agendas, warped morals & beliefs onto you (so, this can very well included Political ideologies, Social Movements & Altruism). 


There is often a vital need to break free from illusions both outside of you and within you, in every possible way. Going through unimaginable pain and reality checks in life will in turn help you heal & transform yourself to align more towards your True Dreams & Inner Calling. Boldly seek freedom in/through your Creative self-expression along with your Spiritually-grounded beliefs. You will need to be aware of your vices no matter how “not so harmful” or serious they may be, since escapism through hyper sexuality or addictions can only further indicate that you may be subconsciously overcompensating a great lose, disappointment, resentment, repressed emotions or other wounds. Neptune represents our nervous system after all, hence any unhealthy coping mechanism or extreme lifestyle can severely alter your subconscious & so also your conscious mind.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Pisces & 12th House 🫧✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Pisces + 12H + Neptune & Jupiter Aspects + 12º 24º 🫧✨


LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

One of the most wonderful placements for Sirene (after Scorpio) but equally dangerous. Artistic & Intuitive beyond reasoning, blessed by the heavens with captivating talents. Psychic & probably even Prophetic. Dream walking, Past Life memories, Astral Travel, Spiritual Gifts, etc. Poetry, SINGING/Music, Dancing, and other forms of arts can bring good Recognition and hence Success. You might even have Hidden Talents that you will discover over time often in Magical ways. Your Personal relationships will thrive whenever you are open-hearted and compassionate towards them (also especially vice-versa, where you can have equally compassionate & caring people in your Inner Circle).


Religion & Spirituality can have a Massive Impact on your Life. Finding your Purpose and Sense of grounding in Religious and/or Spiritual practices & beliefs. You are likely closer to the Supernatural side of things in general, where you might have bizarre experiences that can influence the way you look at life. So, you are also likely Psychic, with good Intuitive attunement to your Spiritual gifts. You likely encounter Supernatural beings, like angels, guides or even spirits. You might attract animals as well. You can Inspire yourself to achieve your Dreams and make them a Reality. You can draw support from others for Social & Charitable causes. You can capture the hearts of many through your kindness, innocence & gentle personality. Your words & intentions can be extremely powerful tools of manifestation, they can also bring healing not just to yourself but also to many others (who may even subconsciously seek your healing). 


You can attract the right opportunities, people & situations that can lead you towards your Higher Calling by following your Intuitive Nudges and going with the flow of life. You have a Unique Gift of channeling the right information & messages from forces beyond comprehension, so no matter how unusual your Life Path is, you likely find your True Calling in just as such unusual ways. Faith, Hope & Pure Intentions will always be your biggest attributes that lead you towards all the right people, places & opportunities often without trying. There is Magic all around you, Higher Forces guiding you on your Path, Protected & Blessed.


DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

Careful trusting others in all kinds of relationships, particularly those that seem overly compassionate & giving, or needy & co-dependent. This can be vice versa, where your ‘giving & willing’ personality can be exploited, as others can expect you to self-sacrifice, all while your needs are not being met or even considered. You will learn many painful lessons with regards to putting up extra walls of boundaries and not to ignore Red flags in others. Be careful with those who seem to always get you into bad habits or even addictions that are detrimental to you, they can easily take advantage of/through that aspect alone. 


Deceit, scandal, victimization, abuse, etc. are possibilities on an extreme end, but you will have to be extra vigilant with two-faced people, those who seem to have devious intentions, those who don’t have a firm grip on reality (delusional, ego-based, lack self-esteem) & low on morals in general. You can also encounter groups that are spiritually and/or religiously driven, but with hidden beliefs & agenda, often as cults & scams. So, caution when joining any kind of group in the name of religion or a spiritual (even as just a hobby or out of curiosity), it might just be a cult. 


Your Personal insecurities, fears & even subconscious desires can lead you astray whenever you choose to ignore reality and facts, lacking clear vision or purpose in life. Since on the extreme Negative side of this placement, you can deceive yourself if you are not grounded in reality. It is hence also helpful to not isolate yourself (or let others isolate you), which can make you more vulnerable and sensitive to manipulation. You will need to built a strong Mindset and utilize your Inner Strength in order not to give into Lower Vibrational forces, since you can be quite sensitive to mental health issues as well. Higher Purpose and establishing a connection with your Higher Self can keep you safe, guide you towards Success and protect you from Negativity, Spiritual Attacks & Bad Karma, Karmic Relations & Situations, etc.

entry.title: Full Moon in Libra 12° 🌕♎️ Apr 2, 2026
entry.content:
🦢 Balance. Clarity. Harmony. ✨

🦢 The Full Moon in Libra brings much needed Inner Focus & Graceful Balance to ground ourselves through some of the agitation & intensity around us during the tense Aries Season.

🦢 Saturn in Aries Opposes this 🌕 creating a bit of a negative impact on both our Self Image & our Social x Personal Relationships. 

🦢 It is hence advised to take the time out to reflect & introspect about these crucial aspects of your life and ease into the changes you are considering both w.r.t. your Self-Image & Expression, along with that of how you interact with others.

🦢 You might realize how you may be veiling your True Self in order to be likable or to fit into certain relationships where you might feel that (especially in Family & Romantic ones) your Authenticity should be respected & appreciated instead of feared, criticized or rejected. 

🦢 As Jupiter in Cancer also Squares this 🌕, issues around codependency & unhealthy patterns in relationships will become apparent, all while giving you the opportunity to make important changes to your relationship dynamics to positively shift them into balance (or to let go for the Highest Good of all).

🦢 You will have wonderful opportunities to both analyze & realign yourself in these relationship dynamics, where you will honor your True Self while also being authentic in your Relationships. 

🦢 Commitments to your Passions & Ambitions may clash with those of your Personal & Social Relationships. 

🦢 However, these frictions (although stress inducing) will provide the neat little window of opportunity to balance your Personal Goals with that of your Relationships. 

🦢 This Pink Full Moon can facilitate a Win-Win proposition to even the most complicated situations in miraculous ways, only of course if & when everyone involved is onboard with the idea (which in and of itself can give us a greater understanding of who we are dealing with and if this is worth the effort or not).

🦢 So, this 🌕 can seem like ‘an intense Test of our Commitments and the necessary Emotional Maturity that is required to maintain thriving & balanced relationships’ (both within oneself & others). Re/building relationships on Trust, Harmony, Cohesion, Common Values, Care & Love. 

🦢 Ending, detaching & breaking down cycles, relationships & dynamics that are Unjust, Unhealthy & Imbalanced beyond compromise or repair can also be a challenging yet Karmically Important decision that you might have to make. 

🦢 A bit of ‘decisiveness and honesty’ can make this 🌕 a great little Game Changer in our lives. Bring into perspective both your needs, wants & desires along with those of others that you care about. Tact & Emotional Intelligence will go well with your Love & Compassion now. 

🦢 A lovely Full Moon where we can positively surprise ourselves. Enjoy the comfort and discomfort of facing important challenges of the Ego & the Heart, Self & Others. May this splendid Lunar event bring Balance, Peace, Harmony, Love, Bliss & Prosperity into your life and that of your loved ones. 


Many hugs, Much luv. 💕

xo 💋

entry.title: Full Moon in Leo 13° 🌕♌️ Feb 1, 2026
entry.content:
🦁 Leo Full Moon’s opposition to Mars, Venus & Mercury in Aquarius will trigger numerous fears, insecurities, anger, confusion & doubt. 

🦁 This can lead to impulsivity, impatience to make quick decisions & corrections, all of with should be consciously avoided. 

🦁 Pent up rage & anger will need a healthy outlet through purposeful activities & productive work.

🦁 Likewise, the Full Moon will alleviate those tensions and shine light on the right path, action & conclusions. 

🦁 Enlightening experiences w.r.t. Self-Confidence & Personal Strength, often through tense & strenuous events / dynamics.

🦁 Self-Love and opening up to worthy + Heart felt relationships with clarity & intrigue.

🦁 Embracing your Pride, Passions & Purpose even against high oppositions & criticism.

🦁 Standing your ground, pulling yourself together and pursuing your Goals & Ambitions.

🦁 Prioritizing your happiness, peace & prosperity; Choosing independence & personal freedom to pursue your Life Path devoid of self-doubt or fear.

🦁 Rediscovery of your True-Self, Strength, Power, Passion & Purpose. 

🦁 A quite reclaiming of your Power and Self, that rumbles through the Universe aligning & re-aligning you towards your Destiny & Abundance.

entry.title: November Transits 2024 ✨
entry.content:
November 2024 Transits

March • April • May • June • July • August • September • October • November • December
Nov 1, 2024

New Moon
in Scorpio 9°


Reawakening + Clarity + Reinvention. Scorpio New Moon with a good Trine to Saturn in Pisces will bring an excellent sense of balance and stability even in the midst of uncertainty. The ongoing Mars, Mercury & Pisces Grand Trine will contribute greatly to the emergence of a new phase. Pluto’s Opposition to Mars can make this a particularly intense New Moon, so be prepared for shocking revelations and nuanced information to come out. 🌋

This 🌑 can hence be quite a powerful period of Reawakening, especially that of your passions and intense desires that you might have hidden even from yourself. ❤️‍🔥 Past life connection(s) can also become more intense & apparent. Wonderful time to strengthen soulful connections and resolve any trust issue. Many karmic cycles will slowly yet finally come to an end. This 🌑 can hence feel cathartic and transformative. Any internal fears & insecurities about the new uncharted phase that you’re about to step into can feel extra daunting, but you will be able to dig into your inner strength that much more eagerly. 🔥 Exciting new beginnings can wake you up to new frontiers and challenges.

Unfair power dynamics will soon find their equilibrium as well. You will be able to take back your power if in the past you had to give it away or had been restrained unjustly. Oddly (yet not so) this can also be a good time for spiritual cleansing and invoking protection (religiously and/or spiritually), especially if you suspect dark magic or evil eye towards you, you will be able to get the necessary help & support if you wish to seek it. 🪬

Reevaluate your plans for the future, and reignite your passions. Slight adjustments and minute improvements can take you a long way. This 🌑 can immensely charge your desires for success, abundance & stability. So, make the most of it in both your personal & professional life. You can hence Reinvent your life in a major way through this intense & powerful New Moon. ☄️

Happy Birthday to all my Scorpios ♏️💋

Many hugs & much luv 🪭❤️‍🔥

xo

Nov 3, 2024

Mars Opposition
Pluto 2024 🌋✨


The cathartic opposition brings incredible challenges & opportunities along with major abundance.

Pluto’s last transit in Capricorn will end eventfully with an intense Opposition to Mars in Cancer at 29º. This Opposition will bring up many issues, fears & even traumas that you will have to face for one last time as well, if not actually at least mentally & emotionally. Hence, the next few months (until Jan 3, 2025 when Mars & Pluto oppose again at 1º Leo & Aquarius respectively) will bring incredible challenges along with equally rewarding opportunities. With future-focused Capricorn and intuitive Cancer in the mix, the Opposition on Nov 3, 2024 will hence be a major reawakening of your own Passions & Desires, creating a tumultuous whirlpool of intense emotions & restlessness.

Finding peace in chaos, stability in change. Feeling like you are at the precipice of a new phase, leaving behind old belief systems and transforming your values. Getting ready to harvest the fruits of your labor. Completing long term projects, at the last stages, adding finishing touches. Refresh your view on money, stability and inner balance. Big shifts are happening slowly, make room for much bigger things to come. Let go of the old, excess and unnecessary with the intention of making room for newer more valuable things. 🌱

Evaluate your past & the present, make plans for the future. Excellent time to let go of past grievances, pain & sorrow, in order to bring healing. Hence, a wonderful time to work on your heart chakra, allow kindness and inner peace to comfort you during a rather critical self-evaluation. 💎 Leveling up your approach to life, purpose & abundance. Financial & career goals that surpass previous ones.

With Uranus Conjunction to Moon in Taurus, its Time to dream big and achieve higher. ⚡️ Exercise patience and prioritize precision in both planning & execution (Mercury Rx is approaching). Slow down for a day or two around the Full Moon, focus on rest and nutrition.

The Full Moon of building, establishing & sustaining: Greater abundance, sense of security (emotional & material), inner balance and harmony. 🪷

entry.title: A Special Chiron & North Node Conjunction in Aries | March 5, 2024 🚀❤️‍🔥✨
entry.content:
Chiron has moved through half of Aries as of 2023 while North Node is preparing to move further into Aries since its Transit in July 2023. With a Special meeting of the Nodes of Destiny & the Wounded Healer, this year will be a major turning point in our lives. Chiron & North Node have been close to each other since the start of 2024 and will have an exact Conjunction on March 5th, 2024. Since, late February & March will likely be extra tense Astrologically indeed.


Chiron in Aries since 2018 has opened up a new Chapter in our healing journey, with beginnings that seem incomplete or unattainable. Looking back, the last 5-6 years have been a major step in the right direction when it comes to confronting our own ego, identity & confidence struggles. We have been on a long road of Self-Discovery, “back to your Soul”. A lot of things have changed about our view on life & our goals as a result as well. So, although this has been a tough transit, we have been working on how to reconnect to ourselves and how to respect our calling. But, Chiron in Aries also has a dark side, since Aries as an archetype sometimes has a (big) problem with criticism, even from oneself, so anger issues must have become apparent, especially lately. 


With Saturn transiting in an extra (extra) sensitive sign like Pisces, we seem to be currently working through a million triggers all at the same time. It is certainly not easy to confront every painful memory, mistake, failure, trauma & disappointment simultaneously with Chiron in Aries. Although, this is a great challenge to overcome, it’s still a significant leap in our own character development. So, if you have been feeling extremely stuck and unable to explore your own potential (especially since the last 2-3 years), then you are likely feeling the sting of disappointment and a tinge of sadness for how things have turned out (or not). One thing that can make us a little blameless is Saturn’s presence in Pisces, slowing down our entire life just to make sure that we deal with the key elements of our healing journey before we take the next step. So, delays are just preparation for the next big moves that we are desperately ready to make. 


Pluto has also walked into Aquarius on Jan 21st, just at the door step (once again) before it Retrogrades for one last time into Capricorn this year. A historic transit will finally begin, which with Chiron & North Node’s Conjunction will make it a magnificent Astrological event. North Node in Aries started with the tense Square of Pluto last year and that made us acutely aware of many things that we may have been ignoring or hiding from even ourselves. Triggers were everywhere, like walking in a minefield. Those triggers will now be amplified, a lot more sensitive to even an exhale. So, if you couldn’t deal with some of the things that came up last year, or you weren’t fully aware of the magnitude of those triggers, the beginning of this year will make it impossible, absolutely inescapable. 


South Node in Libra will bring up many uncomfortable feelings with regards to certain relationships that don’t seem to fit into our life anymore, while North Node in Aries will bring out our own behaviors, character flaws, insecurities & attitudes that don’t seem to be elevating us on our life path. Issues with setting goals & staying committed to them, or even initiating them over the recent years can bring feelings of self-blame; while codependency or inconsistency in either your effort or others’ in your personal relationships can cause major distress. There is likely a lot of resentment, either on others who held us back or on ourselves. Repressed anger & perpetual disappointment seem to be all that is on the mind. So, it is likely that you are looking back at the last few years (to a decade) and analyzing how you might have done something’s a lot differently. Your sense of self is slowly coming out of its hibernation, a period of rest where you had to heal internally and have patience with yourself while you are going through such an enlightening process. 


Waking up to your conscious world where everything in your life has slowed down significantly and even halted for sometime can feel agonizingly overwhelming. But, this is also where your innate sense of self & patience come to your rescue. Making drastic adjustments & momentous changes to your life may be the very first impulse (thanks to Pluto’s Transit into Aquarius), but you might also realize just how much you have evolved as a person (from within to without). Your vision for the future has likely altered significantly, elevating your goals & ambitions, your passions are likely just getting ready to gear back up again. Although there is enthusiasm for the future, there is also a sense of regret or apathy, a little hint of melancholy. This can also be a great period for some quality alone-time, heart-to-heart conversation with your loved ones or even for therapy sessions. 



With Chiron simultaneously Opposing South Node in Libra, your feminine energy seems to be realizing just how much pain you might have ignored, to the point of suppression. Masculine energy might have felt a complete power-down-moment lately, feeling the lack of passion for life in general. This is a clear connection to Pluto’s square in Capricorn early on in 2023, which is catching up with us now with Chiron’s involvement. So, if you have been ultra feminine or masculine lately just to overcompensate for the other energy within, you likely felt the major imbalance between the two, which is intensified by the Conjunction of Mars & Venus to Pluto in Aquarius (not to mention the Moon & Sun Conjunction to Pluto in Capricorn). 


This is hence also likely a reason as to why dealing with certain people (let’s say Masculine and/or Feminine figures) is now a lot more complicated. Especially if you are Feminine, you might have felt a sudden shift in your romantic interest or ideals about love as well, especially if you felt as if Masculine figures haven’t showed up in the way you deserve or if you have been constantly let down in the recent years. If you are a Masculine, it might have been one thing after another that has been reminding you to go within and confront your fears and find self-acceptance since there may be things that you are either suppressing or trying to run away from within yourself, which has been affecting the way you express your feelings in personal relationships and significantly stifling your productivity/goals.


You might have experienced a big explosive reaction from someone near & dear to you, or you might have been agitated lately to the point of an emotional outburst. There is a clear certainty of explosive anger and uncontrollable frustration. You can easily direct all your pent up rage onto someone unsuspecting, or vice versa. But, this can immediately make you feel regretful of your outburst, whether it was justifiable or not. Feeling hopelessly lost can seem devastating, yet even a little faith in your goals or that wonderful future that you dreamt about might be holding you together, as tightly & earnestly as possible. So, even though chances for self-sabotage or frustrations to give up can overwhelm you, you are likely to stand back up and fight the good fight, knowing intuitively that there is an equally important turning point just ahead that can change everything for the better, that one breakthrough-moment that we have all been desperately waiting for.


North Node & South Node are in the signs of Aries & Libra, which clearly & distinctly represent Masculine & Feminine energies of the universe in Astrology, so, this transit for the next 1 year will be significant in helping us recalibrate our Yin-Yang balance. Whatever is your sex or sexual preference, you are likely able to identify any blocks in the flow of your energy that may have substantially affected your inner balance over the years. So, this Conjunction is truly a great opportunity to get back into that inner divine balance, honoring your Masculine & Feminine energy, being vulnerable to yourself in order to address any grievance, fear or disappointment within. Confronting your own anger with compassion, listening to your suppressed emotions, responding to your feelings, tapping back into your inner strength & equipping yourself with your passion will become more of a desperate yet natural urge, which can start as immense frustration and turning quickly into unstoppable determination.


All the pent up frustrations of not being able to move forward at your expected pace, not believing enough in your own self or maybe even regretting not taking action on important goals/relationships will open you up to your wounds, making you completely vulnerable with no room to hide from your own self. Being absolutely honest about your feelings & your intentions for your life will also open up doors of opportunities that you might have missed or not considered ever before. In many ways, waking up to your highest potential & self-acceptance without any fear of success/failure or insecurity will lead you to your true-self; (with North Node here) as being unapologetically yourself will be the key to open the portal to your destiny, wrapping up unfinished lessons & karma to leave them behind in 2023. This New Year of 2024 can hence (literally) help you meet your “New Me”. So, you will be able to get reacquainted with yourself in a whole new way, like you have never before. A refreshing sigh of relief, even an overwhelming feeling of being quenched from within. Explore the wonders of your inner world and get ready to be fired up by your renewed passions. May this be a wonderful start of a brand new journey. 🚀✨

entry.title: Natal Mercury and North Node Aspects 🍃✨
entry.content:
Mercury Conjunct North Node

☌ Intellectual talents & their development will be one of the main priorities in your life.

☌ With this aspect, Immense communication skills could be tapped into with ease, with little to no effort.

☌ Learning new skills, languages and you're a great orator.

☌ Exceptional mental fortitude and wit will help you progress in life effortlessly.

☌ You have a playful, easy-going and friendly personality.

☌ You know exactly what to say to appease others and this will bring you much popularity.

☌ You may enjoy a big social life with many friends and acquaintances.

☌ You can be progressive in your thinking and bring many new ideas into reality.

☌ Any Mercurial career(s) will be a great choice(s) that can bring you many rewards & acclaims.

☌ There could be a danger of misusing your natural gifts of communication to indulge in fraudulent businesses, manipulating the public opinion, misleading others, spreading misinformation, gossip, using people to your advantage, etc. or you could attract such behaviors/people in your life often that you might have to carefully & skillfully deal with.

☌ You might also have to be careful not to swing with the popular opinions and not stand your ground just to look acceptable, since people-pleasing or image-saving behaviors could easily backfire if not at the moment surely in the long run.


Mercury Square North Node

□ You can be incredibly intellectual or not much, depending on other aspects in the chart which could lead to facing many challenging situations while understanding others and being understood by others.

□ You could have had a childhood full of stressful friendships & situations.

□ You may have faced challenges where you had to develop your intellectual gifts all on your own or with many criticisms/feeling unsupported even by those who were supposed to help you early on in your life.

□ So you might have had to learn that to over-come challenges, you will have to do things on your own without expecting much from others, and each time you come out with better ideas and feel even more empowered than before.

□ This aspect presents a lot of obstacles in your life, and as a result helps you take incredible strides, progressing forward always. But, it is also advised not to get too in your thoughts, as overthinking can lead to missing out on opportunities.

□ You might have many intellectual talents and they will help you immensely the more you work hard in perfecting them.

□ You might sound too intellectual or less of one, and so your ideas might sound far-fetched or outdated accordingly.

□ There may be many who oppose your choices/ideas due to lack of understanding, and this could be very frustrating to deal with.

□ Although any criticism and discouragement will only fuel your confidence even more.

□ One of the many lessons you have to learn will be to trust others the way you trust yourself and not everyone is against you, that you can believe that there are like-minded people out there who can understand you without much drama no matter how rare those people seem to be.

□ Delays & stagnancy can cause a lot of frustration in you, since you might feel like you are lagging behind and your progress has been halted somehow, however with maturity you will be able to trust in the detours of life.



Mercury Trine North Node

△ You are a visionary. You feel like you have a higher purpose in life, with a lot of wisdom to offer.

△ It’s as if life presents you with many opportunities to progress.

△ You are often popular among your peers and are well-respected.

△ Since often times Mercurial aspects tend to not prioritize empathy and may seem cold & intellectual, one of the best traits of this aspect may be that you not only can tap into your intellectual side but can also communicate through your heart.

△ Your loveable & witty personality can win a lot of people’s admiration & respect. 

△ Trine aspect can bring in laziness to even the best of planetary pairings, and with North Node involved, extra effort may be required to stay focused & dedicated to your goals.

△ Your career path can bring you many achievements and acclaims.


Mercury Sextile North Node

✱ One of the very few easy-going North Node aspects. 

✱ Mercurial talents are easy to tap into, and the more you learn, the more you feel fulfilled in life.

✱ Your love for learning new skills, about other cultures, languages, teaching, music etc. will be well supported by your family and mentors.

✱ Your fun-loving and youthful personality attracts a lot of admirers.

✱ You can dive deep into any topic of your interest and master it with much dedication.

✱ You can easily communicate your ideas & visions to others often gaining approval and popularity.

✱ Caution must be paid, since there could be a tendency to blend-in so much so that you lean into sheep-mentality which may come off as being superficial, therefore dimming your popularity in the long run.



Mercury Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ There may be insecurities about your style of communication or may feel the need to not stand out.

^ You may have had to deal with memory or communicative problems early on in life.

^ You may have been sensitive about such issues or could have been bullied.

^ This could have either inspired you to learn and adapt more to your shortcomings to turn it into your own unique trait.

^ Or could have made you recluse from others even more.

^ Either way, you may have to deal with your self-confidence issues to the best of your abilities and trust that you will be supported by others if you opened up.

^ If not careful, much like difficult Mercury aspects (and other equally problematic aspects elsewhere in the chart), there may be a risk of developing personality-disorders or superiority/inferiority complexes which could be just projections of your own insecurities, this could mean you may cause a lot of trouble without little to no remorse (much like a trickster-God). Mostly with this side of the aspect, you may be famous for all the wrong reasons, at the cost of your conscience.

^ On the flip side, you can find a lot of recognition and fame when you decide to accept your uniqueness and heal your inner child. This way you might end up being regarded as an inspiration to many others.


Mercury Opposite North Node

☍ There may be many untapped talents with this aspect.

☍ There could also be a few fears, insecurities or difficulties in expressing those latent talents. 

☍ Your life path may involve communicating with others and the world at large, but you will have to also learn how to express your emotions and not just your thoughts.

☍ You may often have to face situations out of your control related to Mercurial themes.

☍ You may have to be careful how you express your thoughts in public, since they may be used against you, or cause controversies without you meaning to.

☍ Your communication style, playful attitude, wit, curiosity, etc. may be your greatest assets and also on occasion, your biggest downfall, both situations may be played out in destined ways.

☍ You could have been unclear about your purpose. There may be a lethargic approach to your life early on, but you may have had to mature in a rather painful way due to a series of hardships which could have shaped you to be responsible and reliable.

☍ This could have helped you refocus your life and its purpose, helping you progress with dedication and discipline.

☍ This could also help you attain much acclimation and respect in your professional life, reaching further than ever, putting your well-earned talents into good use.

entry.title: Natal Ceres Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
This retrograde placement can cause immense lack of self-worth. Self-love and care become vital with this retrograde placement, since either you didn’t get enough care & nurturing during your childhood, be it emotionally/physically or you didn’t understand how to care for yourself or both. Since you feel a lack of stability and security deep within, you might expect others to treat you badly or neglect your well-being. 


You will have to move beyond such experiences and practice self-care routines consciously. You will have to actively nurture yourself, make efforts to give yourself warmth, comfort and kindness, as a form of re-parenting your inner child. This can be in an emotional way or in a physical way or both. You need to reassure yourself of your worth and hence develop a healthy ego to overcome any lack mentality. 


This can also mean surrounding yourself with positive people/situations/places, being in pleasant environments both at home and at work where you feel safe & loved. Relationships where you can be yourself, and relearn how to share love, money, time, efforts, etc. in a healthy reciprocal way can also help you heal some of your inner wounds, since previously you might have had troubles connecting & trusting others especially emotionally & with your possessions. 


Clinging on to people out of fear of abandonment can cause major rifts in those relationships. So, showing maturity when certain chapters come to an end and letting others make their choices, most importantly, respecting their choices will be a continuing lesson. You might experience similar situations where those who lack of emotional maturity may hold you back from moving on, out of their own fear of abandonment, inner child wounds, etc. Learning to maintain healthy relationships, unlearning toxic parenting, becoming a better parent to yourself will help you understand yourself and also others, especially when you choose to become a parent/caretaker yourself.

entry.title: Part of Fortune in Taurus + 2nd House + 2° 14° 26° 🗝️🍀💰✨
entry.content:
The Keys to your Innate Fortune & Luck with Natal Part of Fortune in Taurus / 2H / 2° 14° 26° 🗝️🍀


Stable Foundation

This PoF placement is one of the best as it represents one’s ability to accumulate wealth. Here, you have a good chance of being Rich, not just in money but also in many other areas of your Life. It is likely that you come from a Well-to-do family, a Culturally Rich Heritage, and/or you might marry into a Rich Family. Material Wealth & Riches naturally flow towards you, so even if you weren’t born Wealthy, you are likely to become Wealthy later on. Your early life experiences & upbringing become the source of Inspiration for you to create a Solid Stable Foundation for yourself (and hence also for your loved ones). You are likely not to gamble with chance & luck to get by financially, and so you strive to make the right choices which will definitely pay off in the long term. You will lay the Foundation for Monetary Stability carefully and Practically in order to build your Financial Prosperity successfully.


Wealth + Gratification

You are humble & grounded, so you enjoy Gratification in every small & big achievement. Accumulating Wealth & Material Prosperity are more than a Personal Goal with this Placement, since it is also a major part of your Life Calling. You will hence be supported & guided in Miraculous ways towards achieving Abundance in Life. You have the Intuitive ability to appreciate Value and hence you can make the best use of your resources to build Legacy beyond belief. Taking on the responsibilities of being reliable, honest & resourceful, you will need to focus your intentions towards achieving Material Prosperity & Abundance for not just yourself or your loved ones, but for reasons that may be bigger than comprehension. 


Practicality + Longevity + Patience

Your most Fortunate Opportunities come when you lay well-planned Foundations, when you take one firm step at a time. Long Term Planning & focus on Steady Growth bring Inevitable Success, the kind of Success that will stand the test of time. So, everything you wish to build, every venture you want to take on, every move you make will need to be fulfilling and long-lasting. Hence, Patience will be rewarded many times over with this Fortunate placement. Making rash decisions and taking impulsive risks are likely not advisable with this placement. Since, Wealth naturally comes to you, you can take a Gamble-free & Assured path to Inevitable Success. Instant Gratification won’t bring you much satisfaction or joy, and may be even detrimental to the Bigger Goals in your Vision. Practical, Methodical & Well-Planned Actions will bring Immense Achievements, Wealth & Lasting Legacy. 


Self Worth + Self Discipline

You are extremely blessed, whether you believe it or not. If anything, you might have doubted this very thing for the most of your early Life. Yet, you also recognize how Invaluable you truly are in every possible way. You need to develop a Healthy Self-Esteem and acknowledge your Self-Worth, removing conscious & subconscious blocks. Every good & bad experience in life will help you to keep refining your Inner Strength & Worth. This also demands a Strong Self-Discipline in order to maintain the abundance that you are blessed with and the ones you are creating. Self Discipline is simply a reflection of your Self-Love and Self-Respect, the Quite Promise to Yourself that resonates Loudly in the Universe, bringing steady Good Fortune your way.


Comfort + Luxury

You love Comfort, may be even more than ‘just Luxury & Riches’. Comfort is Peace & Serenity, which is one of your main driving forces, and likely your Biggest Inspiration. Hence, your Life Style and Living Space are likely to be well-thought of and planned for, not just logically but also through your heart. You crave a Sense of Belonging, where your Home, Work-Space, Neighborhood, etc. become your Safe & Beautiful Abode. A deeper Sense of Safety & Security is what you will always be looking for in the place you live in (and even in travels). You also emphasize on a Stress-Free Life Style, where you can focus on Progress and Prosperity. This Sense of Outer & Inner Balance will bring the best in you, helping you to be more productive, stable and also creative, leading to more Success & Stability, and hence the Positivity Cycle of Abundance Continues. 


Secure Relationships

Here, PoF brings blessings even in the form of Trustworthy Relationships, people who are your Rock, your Safe Space. Family & Lineage become a key part of this placement, so (even if not all), your Family may be your Source of Joy & Strength. You are likely to find Friends, Acquaintances & Business Associates who are honest & resourceful. Romantic Relationships (even if not all) and Marriage Partner(s) are likely to bring more Stability & Blessings into your Life (and hence, this can also be seen as a sign of a good Partner who is the right One for you). Cherishing & Maintaining healthy relationships hence will usher Good Fortune in many areas of your Life, as these relationships themselves are Blessings in their own Right. 


Value + Worth

PoF here gives you the Unique & Innate ability to recognize ‘Value’. You naturally know how to make the right choices in terms of people, opportunities & decisions. To you , Value is deeper than Wealth, Quality or Quantity; the Archetypal energy of this PoF gives you the refined ability to see the Quality & Substance of the people & resources in front of you, essentially giving you a Golden eye for Value & Worth. So, in many ways, everyone you choose and everything you have around you is extremely Valuable, and dare I say, Invaluable. Luxury or Simplicity, both exude elegance when in your presence. So, you also ‘add’ Value to everyone & everything in your life just by being your True Self. 



Pot of Blessings + Fortune 💰✨

This may be one of the most Significant & Influential placements for Part of Fortune. You have a Strong Sense of Self, a healthy Self-Esteem and an Inner Strength that makes you  Formidable. You have an Elegant & Serene presence that captivates people without much effort. You likely have a Sensual & Attractive Personality & Figure, especially your Voice & Speaking style can be extremely alluring. 


You are grounded & practical, yet you have Great Vision for Life. You develop excellent Skills especially relating to your Goals & Ambitions in life, so if you are interested in accumulating Wealth, you are likely to be extremely proficient in Money Management; if you wish to pursue Creative Endeavors, you are likely to become Masterful in those areas, etc. Your Immense Self-Discipline, Purposeful & Relentless Focus make you ‘a force to be reckoned with’. 


You can bring Happiness & Good Fortune just through being healthy and taking good care of yourself. You are able to naturally be in-tune with your body, mind & emotions, hence instinctually making you great at finding the right Life-Style, Nutrition, Fitness, Health Routines, etc. Meditation, Gardening, Nature related activities, etc. can bring Inner Peace & Balance.


PoF here bestows simple ways to enhance the flow of your Good Luck & Fortune. Your Beauty, Looks, Aesthetics and Personal Style can bring Popularity, Opportunities & Invaluable Connections along with a healthy boost to your Self-Confidence. Hence, Self Care = Self Love. You likely have an Innate understanding that such Simple Pleasures are truly the real Prosperity and Luxuries in Life. In essence, you are here to enjoy the Sensual Nature, Earthy, Grounded & Tangible Prosperities of Life.


You have a Strong Value System which adds to your Immaculate Character. You talk your walk and walk your talk, your Integrity is truly Admirable. The Cultural and Familial Influence on your Upbringing is likely Excellent, even if you grow up to understand the nuances & certain inconsistencies in them later on. Your Integral Morals & Values will always be a guiding principle for your Life Goals & Ambitions, hence will bring effortless Abundance & Growth into your Life.


You have the Innate Power to bring the most Fortunate Opportunities towards yourself, especially if it relates to bettering your Life-Style by leveling up your Living Standards. Monetarily you keep progressing forward as well, particularly when you focus on Worthy Goals. Although Wealth & Luxury are subjective, with this Placement, you will create your own Vision of Wealth, Luxury & Legacy that will be Awe-Inspiring to many.


This PoF placement is ‘like a Gift that keeps on Giving’, truly Powerful & Well-suited in Taurus + 2H especially when Utilized (& Activated) to its full potential. Safe, Steady & Assured Investments will bring not just Guaranteed Returns, but also adds to your Sense of Stability & Happiness. Even simply investing in Assets like Precious Metals/Stones, Land, Real Estate, etc. can be extremely profitable. You can create Multiple Streams of Income that overtime with Good Management, Investment & Planning can become almost Self-Sustained and generate more Wealth. 


Part of Fortune represents the Good Karma that we have accumulated through life-times, and hence this PoF clearly shows that you are here to materialize all the Good Fortune that you have acquired through your countless good deeds. Your Innate Ability to Manage (all kinds of) Resources also makes you a Great Manifestor, essentially making you adept at the Manifestation of your Hearts’s Desires, practically turning Dreams into Reality.
