entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Aries + 1st House 🐯✨
entry.content:
Sirene (1009) Asteroid in Aries + 1st House + Conjunct Ascendant  + Mars Aspects + 1° 13° 25° 🐯✨

LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

Your personality & presence are extremely alluring to others. Your self-confidence & self-assurance can mesmerize them, so your assertiveness can draw in a lot of people towards you. You will need a strong Sense of Self in order to make the best use of this placement, since this can be one of the most appealing qualities that can lead you to success & recognition. Your body-image, looks & body-language can be quite seductive as well, even if you don’t intend to, others may perceive you that way. Your Life Ambitions & Zealous approach can bring you numerous opportunities, since others can easily see the great potential within you. Although, patience & maturity can take you much further. 


Your independent & strong personality will attract challenges that will encourage you to win and stay dedicated to your passions. Your daring personality will attract the best of opportunities towards you. Having a clear sense of direction in life, steadily moving towards your personal ambitions & not backing down from your goals will bring many rewards. Invest your time & effort into self-care, physical fitness & sports, refining your body & personality. 


Your authentic and original personality will bring you Popularity and Immense Success. Your self-assuredness can also be infectious to others. You can draw in a lot of opportunities & admirers when you take a decisive stand and become a virtuous leader. Your fiery attitude and charisma can hence naturally attract those who believe in you & in your capabilities, and wish to follow you. Your assertive personality will bring the best out of you. Your self-confidence will keep you moving forward even after many setbacks. This Sirene Placement can hence help you create a life that can be truly fulfilling. With clear intentions & positive expectations, you can make the most of this placement indeed.



DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You can encounter people who feel compelled to steal your identity. Your character & personal charisma can intimidate these people, where “First they hate you, then they copy you” becomes quite a real scenario in your life. Hence, you can attract competition very often, some that are even very confrontational. This can also be in your personal relationships, so there may be a risk of intimate relationships that become dangerous or abusive on the extreme negative side of this placement. You might even encounter people who may be eager to fight you, or provoke you into physical altercations. 


This can also indicate that you can deceive yourself about your true-identity, where you can create a delusion of a personality that will bring you the things that you think you wish to conquer in life, which can be detrimental to both your public image and your mental health in the long run. It is also important not to let self-doubt to deter you from opportunities that can lead you towards your ambitions. Recklessness can also cost you your public image. If you are not careful, you can inadvertently create a self-fulfilling prophecy of not being enough, not being ready and/or not being capable. 


This Sirene placement can also indicate that either circumstances or your own fear of inadequacies can become major distractions, attracting people/places/situations that lead you further and further away from your Higher Ambitions. You might even miss out on many important opportunities to achieve your Goals as a result. Try not to take short cuts in life, especially if you feel impulsively drawn towards certain things (relationships, status, career goals, etc.). Complete your chosen journeys without feeling discouraged, since going the extra mile despite disappointments will lead to exceptional rewards.

entry.title: Total Lunar Eclipse in Virgo 23º 🐝✨ Mar 14, 2025
entry.content:
With the very first Eclipse of 2025, we will begin the journey of re-stabilizing our life from the inside out. North Node in Pisces & South Node in Virgo will test our faith & endurance, allowing us to flex our muscles of adaptability all while maintaining a strong conviction. With the Lunar Eclipse happening over the South Node Virgo at 23º, this Full Moon Eclipse will Oppose Sun in Pisces 23º in addition to Saturn, North Node & Neptune in Pisces. 


This will hence feel like a lonely fight for the Moon in Virgo up against Saturn, Sun, North Node & Neptune. So, this Eclipse will particularly bring shake ups in the foundations of your routines. You might have been feeling the nudge to try different things and explore newness with regard to your health, lifestyle & everyday matters, although it must have been a little bit of a struggle to restructure them in a drastic way to attain satisfactory change & results. 


Uranus in Taurus (Sextile Moon in Virgo) will give you a helping hand through this process by introducing a pinch of chaos just enough to get you moving. The challenge hence will likely only be to not get caught up in the initial shock, and to ride the wave of change it creates for forward momentum. So, a little hint of discomfort in your comfort zone is a good sign. Re-plan, re-evaluate, re-frame & re-organize your schedules, routines, priorities & goals; bring them into alignment with the newness that you are being called to experience. 


With Saturn in Pisces closely Conjunct the Sun, and Neptune closely Conjunct North Node, your Higher Calling for the Next Phase of your Life will feel like an Uncharted New World, a tangible Dream Land that can be materialized straight from your imagination. With a Purpose this Grand, grounding both spiritually and practically will be a worthy challenge as well as a comforting mindset to have. Allow room for innovation in your own thought-patterns, reprioritize and shift perspectives to see your world in a different light consciously. 


This Eclipse of course can heighten your self-awareness, cynicism, self-criticism, & defeatist mindset as it can trigger the Shadow side of Virgo (being the South Node). So, navigate this time period with more compassion but also with self-accountability. Accept constructive criticism, reframe the way you perceive disappointments & failures, have grace for your past-self and also have belief in your own capabilities, take on new responsibilities in order to step into this New Chapter of Life, soulfully & practically. As you settle into these moments of discomfort & process the lessons from your past, you will be able to feel the Passion welling up from within to drive you towards all the Newness that awaits you.


The biggest concern of this Eclipse will be the abrupt health crisis situations that you or your loved ones may face. You may have noticed sudden health issues affecting you or your loved ones in the most shocking ways. Some chronic and some a complete surprise, yet it is likely serious enough to concern everyone involved. So, it is advised to take extra precautions and help others going through such predicaments. With the Axis of Eclipse in Pisces - Virgo, the health concern(s) can bring a complete change to routines, lifestyle & unconscious habits that may have caused it in the first place. If you have a serious issue, it is recommended to visit the appropriate health care facilities and find the medical care of a specialist in that particular field (even in alternative medicine). 


All crisis & chaos during this Eclipse will feel overwhelming at first but they likely (God-willing) have simple solutions. The shake ups now will bring your life into perspective, break you out of repeating (& toxic) patterns, and help you ease into a much better approach to life in general. Rest, Reset & Restore. A little disruption now will be exactly what you need, trust yourself to make the right decisions. Release karmic cycles with grace, you are on your way towards a whole new phase of your life, allow yourself to embrace the journey. 🐝

entry.title: Psyche (16) 💫✨ Mythology x Astrology of Planets & Asteroids
entry.content:
In (Greek) Mythology, Psyche’s story begins as the youngest daughter of a King. Though her two elder sisters were beautiful, Psyche’s natural beauty was extraordinary, so much so that most people admired her more than Aphrodite (aka. Roman Goddess of Love & Beauty, Venus). She received countless marriage proposals, gifts and compliments from people who would soon start to ignore worshipping Aphrodite, thereby angering her. In a pure jealous rage, Aphrodite orders her son, Eros, the God of Lust & Romance, to make her fall in love with the most hideous creature on earth. Eros instead fell in love with Psyche the moment he first laid eyes on her. 


Meanwhile, the King was distraught by Psyche’s future and frightened by a prophecy he received through Apollo, he left Psyche on a mountain to be taken by a beast as his bride. This beast being Eros in disguise. He sought the help of “the West Wind” Zephyr to take her up to a palace on the clouds where the entire palace was filled with beauty and splendor. There she would meet her mysterious lover at night, warned of course by Eros who concealed himself, to never ask her who he was or what he looked like. They enjoyed their nights filled with love and passion, during the daytime, she stayed happily in the palace served by many invisible servants, spending her life in a magical bliss. Soon, Psyche got home sick and wished to invite her family to the palace, but her sisters in particular weren’t so happy for her. Although they married Kings and Princes themselves, they never could let go of their envy for Psyche’s continued good fortune. So, they began to enquire about Psyche’s mysterious husband, and that she must look after her safety by discovering his true identity. 


Psyche though not doubtfully but with pure curiosity attempts to uncover her lover’s identity when he was asleep by her side and finds out it was Eros all along, but accidentally wakes him up (in one of the versions, it seems she was misled by her sisters’ words to try and kill her husband in the sleep to protect herself). He flees mistrusting her intentions. Psyche tries to find him and to explain herself (Demeter advices Psyche to approach Aphrodite and seek her forgiveness) but fails to do so as Aphrodite takes advantage of her woes and sends Psyche on a journey filled with impossible and dangerous tasks so as to test her devotion & love. 


Psyche also gains favor (without her knowledge, mostly by Eros’s secret intervention) from many kind-hearted deities, fulfilling her Trials and Tribulations successfully. She is later rewarded with immortality for her devotion, loyalty and purity of soul. She becomes the Goddess of Purity, soul and Life, thus marrying her true love Eros. Happy Ending. 🥹


Her story is a classic of how ones’ curiosity can lead to disaster and misunderstandings, but ones’ inner purity will eventually earn the greatest reward. Love can help one reach immortality and eternal bliss, soul’s journey through many unnerving trials can help strengthen one’s character by simultaneously testing their inner purity & devotion. Innocence always gains divine protection and favor. There’s also a lesson about being too naive of other’s intentions, one can fall victim to other’s traps and ulterior motives if one always goes by their purity and expect others to treat them fairly just because of that. One’s good character doesn’t warrant others’ good intentions. 


So, Asteroid Psyche (16) in Astrology hold’s significance, where it tells us about our innocence, natural beauty, soul’s purity, journey towards one’s desires, being stripped off of our karma through trials and sacrifice to reunite with our soul’s calling, etc. Psyche thus represents our soul, mind, inner beauty and psychology. This placement, i. e., the house and sign Psyche occupies can show where we seek ourselves through our desires, where our soul longs to reunite with ourselves, the intuition that leads us through all of life’s tribulations, devotion to our true love, recognition of one’s innocence, delving deep into one’s inner self, facing the darkness of the world and illuminating it with our inner light of purity. 


Psyche’s placement and aspects can give us a lot of vital information about how our willingness to follow our true desires will help us discover ourselves and, in the process, reuniting with our biggest wish. Psychology, innocence and the mind become the main focus.


This placement further tells you:

where/how others will envy your natural beauty, good fortune and luck. 

where and what others admire you for without being able to comprehend. 

how others are drawn to your inner beauty.

where your popularity (no matter how innocent and out of your control) can invite envy and jealousy.

(sometimes) where and how a parent/care takers’ ignorance or insecure actions can put you in unnecessary danger, this can also indicate them enjoying honors and respect due to your accomplishments or using all the admiration you get to gain status for themselves in some way (just like how her father’s greed let everyone worship his daughter knowing full well that a mortal being worshipped like that can anger the Gods’ or Goddesses).

where and how others admire you but also make you feel lonely for the same reason since you only see them admiring you for your external beauty or abilities but not your true character. 

where others are afraid to claim you or give you any official recognition due to all the external competition & insecurities (almost too perfect to have you in that area of your life since they feel intimidated or over pressured to meet high standards). 

where/how rejections and projections can make you feel less than who you truly are. 

where/what/who you long for and consider your true love. 

where you attract secret admirers. 

where and why others plot against you and have ulterior motives to their words and actions towards you. 

where and how your innocence and naïveté can cause you harm. 

where and how you will have divine guidance and favor due to your inner purity and good intentions. 

what kind of rewards or divine grants you earn through various trials and tribulations.

your natural gifts, talents and blessings. 

how you can explore your soul and listen to your inner calling. 

how you will be remembered for your strength in character, etc.


Hence it represents a deeply spiritual placement in our chart, especially when it comes to true love or soul calling. The events that transpire in this placement have an element of destiny and a flavor of inevitability, making it a fascinating part of the chart to explore.

entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses

  • Taurus (2nd House)

Natal Chiron in Taurus (2nd House)

Your wounds of stability go deeper than physical security with this placement. You have an intense need to feel safe, within yourself. You might have had financial issues growing up or lacked comfort in some way. You might even feel that your family or parents did not/could not give you enough emotional warmth as a child. You might have issues with materialism, where you either make them your substitute source of comfort or you might reject them altogether. Your self-worth is deeply wounded with this placement, so you might feel forced to accept your flaws even when you don’t want to. 


You might have insecurities about your physical appearance or how you present yourself to others. So, you always make an effort to look and behave elegantly/charmingly. You have self-worth issues that you seem to hide behind grandiosity or by acting overly confident sometimes, especially in professional settings. You might have experienced setbacks in personal/familial relationships that questioned your entire life or had to face your fears. You might however grow up to form stronger and more secure emotional bonds with your loved ones, especially the family that you create. 



You can heal your inner wounds of losing loved ones or not being able to enjoy such close personal bonds by being with the family that you create. You might even be able to provide all the love and affection that you lacked to your future family. You can overcome your fears of lack, both financially and physically by taking calculated risks and believing in your capabilities to succeed. You can accumulate a lot of wealth through hard work and determination, clearing any wounds of lack of financial stability. You will have to pay close attention to your everyday routines and nutrition, since you might feel lethargic whenever you feel pressured to take on many responsibilities or you might just feel lazy and ignore your duties. 


Your focus and sheer will power to stay dedicated to your goals and maintain a healthy lifestyle in every area of your life will reward you with a lot of abundance both in health and financial success. You can gain perspective through spirituality or religion. You also might be extremely stubborn about ethics morals with this placement, but you will have to learn how to let others live their lives without feeling attacked just because they disagree with your belief-systems. You can be a great advisor on financial literacy. Your strength in character and faith will be tested to make you stronger. 


You might also be admired for your grace and beauty of heart since your inner healing can be seen in the way you present yourself. Your self-worth issues will need extra reassurance as you climb further up the ladder of success, but your commitment to accomplish greater things will keep empowering you each step of the way. Your personal and professional relationships can be healing to both you and others involved. Your wisdom and compassion will help others to embrace their strengths & weaknesses, to never give up on themselves.

entry.title: Chiron, the crux of Transcendence 🌟✨
entry.content:
Chiron in our Natal chart (& other charts) can show us what emptiness truly feels like. The seemingly endless void, left behind by unimaginable pain and trauma. Here, you feel utterly helpless & hopeless, worst of all this may be the very thing that you might have earnestly mastered (or were working tirelessly to master). It could be a skill(s), gift(s), talent(s), wealth, health, etc. But when tragedy strikes, it either seems to take it all away or rendered it useless.


 Like how best of the best medicine suddenly can’t cure the ailment it was made for, although it worked like a miracle up until then. Leaving one wonder “There has to be a lesson in here somewhere. Otherwise, the irony of it all is just too unfair.”


Pain of any kind is not never truly comparable. Yet, it also doesn’t have to be an endless suffering. Even though the pain and wound may have been totally out of our control, whatever choices we make lie completely with us, in our control. Much like the Mythological Chiron’s story, we may be faced with an impossible wound (in this area of our life). But, Chiron’s decision (in his story) to Transcend above it all can likewise give us the key to handle and cure our Inner Wounds.


After long endured, Pain becomes pointless, numbing. You get to choose whether you let it eat away at you any longer or do you allow it to transform you. To get to the root of your suffering, to acknowledge the emotional wound and heal it from within. Finding your Purpose to live & thrive again; adding Newness to your own Inner World; bringing back Love, Happiness & Peace into your life. 


Reaching a level of Transcendence. Creating a Selfless Purpose, which also fulfills your own Passions & Desires in a gratifying way, where giving to others also means you are giving to yourself. Opening up your heart to receiving first through selfless giving, then through letting others give good back to you. This way filling up that gaping void inside of you with something even more meaningful, truly fulfilled within.

entry.title: Aries Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

You have been through major transformations lately with a lot of humbling experiences. You are more grounded and in sync with your emotions. Even with all the chaos around you, you have mastered how to stay emotionally balanced. But, this week can test your patience, Aries. You are gaining control over your life especially in your career. You have incredible plans in motion but you seem to be stuck in the initial or at critical phases of execution. The most important thing to remember this week is to not let your impulsivity take the best of you. Since, you might feel the need to catch up on all the time you have lost in key situations and detours that you have taken in the last few years. 



You are already many steps ahead than you think, Aries. You have made incredible progress on your self-development and spiritual path. You have faced your worst fears and overcome major insecurities through the journey. Although, you realize that you have a little more to heal through when it comes to your past experiences and traumas, you will have to stop for a minute to see just how many burdens you have left behind feeling lighter and more focused now. You might have to face deep rooted feelings of inadequacy or even negative self-talk. Facing delays or blockages must never be projected inwards as blame or self-hate. 


So, such coping mechanisms or self-sabotaging tendencies will be highlighted this week. Hence, any sense of urgency or desperation to make immediate progress in key areas of your life will need to be tempered this week. You will be able to see huge momentum that are currently building up behind the scenes. Your happy go lucky attitude with a dash of extra confidence will help you stay concentrated on methodical plans and distracted from frustrations. So, even with minor irritations popping up here and there Aries, make sure to have some fun, connect with people you love & admire to keep the positivity flowing.

entry.title: New Moon in Taurus 7° 🌑♉️ Apr 27, 2025
entry.content:
Restructuring • Pleasant • Positive Change 🫐


New Moon activates the Grand Cross of Mars ♋️ + Pluto ♒️ + Lilith ♏️ + Sun ♉️, bringing the tension of this Grand T-Square to its peak. Pay attention to what triggers, fears & regrets resurface from your past (especially if you have Placements in the 1st Decan Fixed Signs, i.e., 0° to 10°). Massive Cycle Changes will take precedence until the next Scorpio Full Moon. It is however also likely to feel pressured to make the necessary shifts with these imminent changes. It may be hard to cope with sudden shifts in finances, home, career & relationship situations, yet worth taking the Leap of Faith that you are called towards during this time. 


Pay close attention to your stress levels and how you are handling them, as the major changes in your life and the tension created will have a profound impact on your Health (mental, physical & emotional). So Fatigue, anxiety, chronic health issues, insomnia, etc. will find their Equilibrium as the days go by and as the changes in your Life settle into their Natural Rhythms overtime. 🌿


With such Cycle Shifts, leaving behind the past and entering the New will feel more exciting than ever. Although, you will be obliged to face your own demons and battle through your fears & insecurities. The same will be true when dealing with others. You may notice that not many are able to handle these Changes well, and so extreme projections, envy & conflicts will be apparent, hence the need to deal with them consciously. This is however not the time to get into ego-based-conflicts with others as they may be tempting but will only serve as distractions. 


Focus on all the changes happening within & without. Replan & Reprioritize your Lifestyle & Goals accordingly. 🔥 Reclaim your Personal Power, Sovereignty & Values, as you will be tested by both Life’s Challenges & others actions now. Evolve into your Higher-Self and release yourself from past Failures, Regrets & Sorrows. 


A wonderful time to make Massive & Long Term Plans towards your Ambitions. Visualize your Future and utilize this New Moon Activation to build your New Life, your Intentions are Powerful. Plan, Prepare & Progress. No need to hurry, as your Abundant Life is already unfolding in Divine Timing. ✨

entry.title: Natal Mars and Midheaven MC Aspects 🔥✨
entry.content:
Mars Conjunct Midheaven MC

☌ You’re brave, enthusiastic and passionate. You rarely ever back down from what you want and set out to get what’s yours.

☌ Your career path is something you wish to forge with your own hands, so you’re extremely proud of your work and accomplishments.

☌ You’re not competitive, you are the competition. You don’t mind climbing up the mountain on your own, any opposition only makes you more determined to overcome them. 

☌ Hence, you’ll have to take one step at a time without jumping from one stage to the other since the higher you climb the more patience & diligence will be expected from you. 

☌ You are also quite temperamental when others stand in your way, even if they’re only critiquing. You don’t tolerate any negativity thrown your way especially since your passions are like an extension of yourself.

☌ Although you might have to keep your anger in check every now and then to allow loved ones and mentors to guide you through roadblocks that you might be bumping your head against.

☌ You have an almost unmatched stamina to keep going, so your profession might involve physically exhaustive work, or continuous schedules, strenuous long hours, that equally excite you. Since you don’t feel enthusiastic about things that don’t ignite a fire inside you, and you certainly won’t settle for jobs that don’t appreciate your skills & drive.

☌ There might be a tendency to intertwine your self-confidence with your professional success and vice versa, which can cause a lot of issues if not balanced with the right efforts to encourage both your self-esteem & productivity.

☌ You will also do well in leadership positions, or entrepreneurship, although working with others can cause compatibility issues since not many can keep up with your intense drive.

☌ You’ll likely be a trailblazer in your field of profession; an intimidating opponent & an inspiring personality to others; accomplishing one great goal after another; gaining acclaim, status and fame.


Mars Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ This aspect highlights your need to prove yourself to others, which ends up upsetting the connection with others and yourself.

^ You are determined and confident but can also be aggressive in your approach to your career.

^ You might compete with others just to win against them or resent others when they see you as a competition. There’s this tendency of wanting to be above others yet not being able to accept the same if others have some sort of authority over you. 

^ You’re an inspiring person in your profession since you are capable of accomplishing great things through your sheer determination and hard work.

^ Yet you also despise admiration, especially from your own peers. You might automatically assume that they are ridiculing you or secretly competing with you, which might not always be the case.

^ So, your intense feelings of being attacked or cornered might just be manifestations of your insecurities and fear of being betrayed, over-thrown, dominated, & other power dynamic struggles.

^ As a result, you might present yourself as unapproachable to others, especially to those in your own profession. 

^ You might also get defensive about criticisms even those with good intentions. You might end up losing important people and connections as a result of your over-cautious mindset.

^ With time and maturity, you will realize how your defensiveness was putting up walls and keeping you trapped within. You might start to open up to others and gain discernment as to who is looking for a fight and who is genuinely showing their admiration.

^ You’ll likely accomplish great things inspiring many; learn how to quench your passionate drive for success; allow people in without suspicion of betrayal; gain respect, fame, status and honor in your successful career path. 



Mars Sextile Midheaven MC 

✱ You’re ambitious and you get what you want through your own hard work and dedication.

✱ You have the drive and determination to make steady progress on your career path, even if you have multiple opportunities you like to focus on one thing at a time.

✱ You are well-respected by your peers as a competent person in your professional field. You are also admired by many others for your work-ethic.

✱ You rarely ever slip-up on your plans, you take no slack from others who work with/for you either. 

✱ You’re bold and determined, you face obstacles head-on and win through them all. You uphold a level of integrity, even in the face of criticism (& ridicule), since you don’t attach ego to your work and are also pretty self-aware of your own capabilities so nobody can point fingers at you or manipulate (gaslight) you easily.  

✱ You’re well-known as a strong competitor, since you understand how healthy competition can motivate you. You also have a good-competitive-spirit through your wins and loses showcasing humility & inspiration to do better.

✱ You work best on your own passions, but you’re also humble enough to not intertwine your ego with your profession. This allows you to work well with others, even with power-struggles now and then.

✱ You have a good temper, you rarely give-in to anger or irritation. But you’re a force to be reckoned with when provoked unjustly. 

✱ You have a good sense of self and your goals; you know how to implement your skills & hard work into your projects without wasting any of your drive. 

✱ You’ll likely accomplish your goals to the fullest satisfaction; inspire many to work hard & diligently through your passionate accomplishments; reach milestones on your own pace; gaining status, honor, respect and acclaims.


Mars Trine Midheaven MC 

△ You’re adventurous, energetic, independent yet humble and compassionate.

△ You have a strong sense of self, even if you have had to struggle to gain that self-confidence in your early years. 

△ You also have faith in yourself and the direction you choose since you’re flexible to explore the paths before investing your focus in them. 

△ You are often hard on yourself and push yourself to the limit to get the best of your potential to the forefront. Your intense focus and work-ethic can be the source of inspiration to many.

△ You are driven by passion and don’t back down from reaching the highest of heights. You would rather aim high for the stars and reach the moon rather than aim for things that are already accomplished.

△ You might even choose careers that give you the necessary motivation to expend your intense drive, instead of settling for jobs that seem mundane.

△ You like to keep yourself informed and ready for new adventures in your projects, so you are always upgrading your skills and polishing your talents.

△ You seek new frontiers and don’t slow down when facing unfamiliar obstacles, so you often end up creating a path to success that nobody ever explored before.

△ You’re an inspiring person, you have a lot of wisdom to offer since your early years no matter how harsh or secure, gave you the necessary insight into the world. So, many might admire you for how incredibly accomplished yet humble you’re.

△ You’ll likely create works of inspiration; seek exciting opportunities to elevate you on your career path; create healthy competitions to motivate everyone involved; gaining acclaim, fame, honor and respect along the way.



Mars Square Midheaven MC 

□ You have immense drive and determination to succeed in life, you’ve big ambitions and will work towards accomplishing them.

□ You likely had a harsh upbringing, with cruel/unemotional parents, or strict & traditional guidance, which might have modelled your view on yourself and the idea of worldly success.

□ You’re also a formidable opponent in your professional field, you have confidence in yourself enough to take on any opposition or obstacles.

□ This insane work-ethic garners you a lot of respect from your peers and admiration from others. 

□ Although you might be prone to getting suspicious, overly sensitive to criticism, and might not have a healthy competitive spirit. You might respond aggressively or rudely out of misunderstandings & misinterpretation. This impulsivity can make you hard to work with/for, and even harder to be in the same competitive sphere as you.

□ You might even use your power & position to one-up on others who criticize you or raise questions on your behaviors. These feelings of animosity and anger might just be your own insecurities and fear of failure or due to the style of your upbringing that gave you a sense of superiority or inferiority.

□ It’s important to understand how humility and compassion play a bigger role in your career & personal development. Since your actions & behaviors can easily affect others’ opinions on you, which can also directly impact your professional success.

□ Although, if you have a balanced ego, and know when and when not to take others’ seriously, when to exercise silence as a tactical response and when to speak your mind; you will be revered for showing great strength in character. Your willingness to accept guidance from higher authorities & mentors can help you stay focused on your goals rather than in petty confrontations. 

□ It is important to check your ego and how it may be causing you a lot of harm than gain, since your actions have irreversible consequences which directly affect your reputation and everything you’ve worked hard for.

□ You’ll likely face many testing lessons in the public & professional arenas; inspire others by your mental and emotional fortitude; make incredible accomplishments; garner support, respect, acclaim, position and honor. 


Mars Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC)

☍ This aspect brings your childhood & upbringing into focus since Mars is also conjunct IC.

☍ Your early upbringing plays a big role in how you perceive yourself and life as a whole. Your goals and ambitions have their foundations from your childhood-parental dynamics.

☍ If you had a stable home, your parents were bold and confident who encouraged you to be the same, you had the access to develop your personality and talents through their guidance, etc.

☍ If you had an unstable household, with aggressive parents, who had violent tendencies, you might have felt unsafe and even picked up on some of their unhealthy coping mechanisms in the process, unable to fulling develop your true self and hence your self-esteem might have suffered.

☍ Either way, your drive to succeed in life had the begins in your childhood experiences, be it good or bad, they gave you the motivation you needed.

☍ Your relationship with your parents also affects your inter-personal & professional relationships. Hence you might have rocky or stable interactions with your colleagues and authority figures. Your interaction with the public can also be directly connected to your emotional fortitude. You might be admired by many who are inspired by your work.

☍ Although it is important to fully embrace your personality and develop your inner talents & skills to have a healthy self-confidence, since you can have fleeting moments of feeling insecure & inadequate.

☍ There is a sense of stability that always seems to be lacking in your life, which must be dealt with love and compassion, since your inner emotional foundation needs constant reinforcement, by harmonious relationships with family & loved ones. 

☍ You have a strong drive to achieve greatness in life, your work ethic hence is quite impressive to others, especially to those in authoritative positions. 

☍ You’ll likely make great progress in your career through your own personal development journey; create inspiring works that gain the admiration & support of many; garner respect, acclaim and comfort.

entry.title: Part of Fortune in Cancer + 4th House + 4° 16° 28° 🗝️🍀💰✨
entry.content:
The Keys to your Innate Fortune & Luck with Natal Part of Fortune in Cancer + 4th House + 4° 16° 28° 🗝️🍀

Family + Lineage

Family and loved ones play a significant role in your life. You likely share special bonds with your family, especially with Female / Maternal figures along with Children / Younger members of the family. If you are one of the Younger members in your family, you are likely to be extra loved and pampered with care. You can always rely on your loved ones and your loved ones feel safe to rely on you as well, they adore you for being dependable & caring. Much the same way, your Family / Blood Line may be incredibly important to you. You might be proud of your lineage, culture, country, etc. You are likely to explore the historical background of your family and find some surprising information that can brighten up your world. You might come from a Prominent Family / Blood Line that holds much significance in your community, culture or country. Likewise, a Prominent Figure in the Society might come from your family, and/OR you might become a Significant & Famous person in your Community & Society that your family is proud of. 


Strong Support Systems

You likely have strong Support Systems, be it through parents, siblings, family, elders, community, etc. This is primarily due to the deep Loving connection with your loved ones. You also have exceptional People Skills where you often make a good first impression along with your excellent Social Skills. You are resourceful and dependable, you are also blessed with connections that are equally reliable. You enjoy fulfilling connections with Family, Friends and even in Career. You are often well-liked and respected in your Social & Family circles for your Mellow, Sweet & Sensible personality.


Caring + Soulful Connections

The love and support of your loved ones mean the world to you (and they feel the same way about you). You are likely to be dedicated to your family & loved ones where loyalty, respect & love are reciprocated. Depending on other placements & aspects, whether you come from a loving family or not, you likely have a deeper desire to create a wonderful family of your own. You might want a traditional marriage, children, a house with a white picket fence; you might want a partner but choose not to have a wedding and/or children; you might choose to adopt kids; or choose to stay single and adopt pets, etc. No matter what your ideal Family is, you are likely to build a home that is filled with warmth, joy, love and safety. 


Nourishment

You have a deeper intuitive understanding of Nourishment. Cooking hence is likely a niche skill or rather a blessed talent of yours. As nurturing others comes naturally to you, you feel the happiest when you’re taking care of your loved ones. Likewise, your heart is the fullest when you are ‘taken care of’ and loved as well. The strong Emotional bonds & Reciprocity are what matter the most to you in any kind of relationship. Hence, you expect to feel valued, appropriated and your feelings genuinely reciprocated in (especially) Close Personal relationships. So, you’re likely to not feel fulfilled in relationships that are one-sided in devotion, care & effort. 


Home + Soulful Connections

You are able to form Spiritual & Intuitive bonds with your loved ones. You are also likely to encounter people who belong to your Soul-Family, where you share a Spiritual Kinship & Soul Purpose with them. Ultimately creating a Home, Space &/or Community where you feel belonged, loved and nurtured. Building & creating a Home that is both Physically & Emotionally Secure, Abundant & Prosperous becomes your Spiritual Goal in Life; attracting numerous opportunities, resources & relationships that will help you fulfill this dream of yours. This is one of the many Wonderful gifts of this PoF placement, as Team work and Cohesion alone can bring more Prosperity and Good Luck. However, it is vital to be cautious of not taking on others’ Ideals/Dreams/Visions as your own responsibility (or vice versa, not to impose yours on others), since your dedicated nature can easily get distracted from your own Life Calling while trying to fulfill others’ needs, wants & desires. It is also important to be careful not to use others to achieve your goals (and vice versa).


Emotional Fulfillment

Depending on other placements & aspects, you might love to be a parent in some way, be it for a child or pet(s), you are likely to feel called to nurture & care for a little being. The same may be true about your Professional Life, where your Business, Career and/or Creative Projects can become your “baby” that you find fulfillment in successfully developing & growing. Hence, you’re able to bring your Dreams, Desires, Passions & Aspirations to reality through the numerous Opportunities and Lucky breakthroughs in your life.


Emotional Fortitude 

PoF here makes you extra resilient especially in matters of the heart. You likely developed Emotional Intelligence during your childhood, giving you profound insight into your own Inner World and that of others’ feelings. You are hence extremely Emotionally Mature with a huge Emotional bandwidth for all kinds of Relationships & Situations. This PoF can drastically bring balance into your Inner Emotional World. However, it is wise to pay close attention to your Emotional State at all times. Since much like the way others feel safe & loved around you when you are Emotionally Balanced, they may feel manipulated, boundaries breached & smothered when your feelings are Imbalanced. Your Personality & Mental State can hence be easily influenced by your Emotional State, has any Imbalance in your feelings can easily trigger overprotective, possessive and resentful behavior within you. (With other difficult aspects or placements) You need to be careful not to give in-to your Fears & Insecurities, but to rather be reassured that PoF here can greatly enhance your Emotional Fortitude & Maturity. 


Intuitive + Spiritual Gifts

You have a strong Intuition and are likely connected to the Spiritual Realms. Gratitude is part of your Inner Abundance. Your insights & wisdom make you virtuous and worthy of much respect. You likely inherit Spiritual & Psychic gifts from your Family line, this can also include Spiritual Propose & Life Calling. Likewise, you are also likely to inherit Karmic Gifts + Rewards along with Patterns + Curses. In many ways, you may feel called to break Generational Cycles & Curses through your Spiritual Calling and Personal Success. As a result, you are able to unlock immense Karmic Rewards & Prosperity for yourself and your loved ones. Hence, you inherit Good Karma through the deeds of your Ancestors (+Previous Lives) and your loved ones are likely to benefit from the Good Karma that you create overtime. You are also Spiritually protected, also guided & guarded by your Ancestral Line. Your selfless Devotion & Gratitude allows a stronger connection to Nature, the Universe and the Divine, opening up the direct path to Manifesting your Desires, Abundance, Peace, Security & Prosperity. 


Pot of Blessings + Fortune 💰✨

You draw confidence, strength and determination to achieve prominent Success through your secure-supportive-loving family, home & relationships. You might consider this in and of itself as a huge Blessing. You are likely to inherit Family: Name, Assets &/or Business with this PoF. If not by wealth then surely by culture, virtue & integrity. Regardless, you’re also determined to create a Legacy of your own which your family & loved ones can be proud to be a part of and inherit (again be it through Money, Prestige, Reputation, Good Virtue, etc.)


You are likely to have a special connection to the land you are born in &/or move to by the virtue of the Strong Intuitive & Spiritual bond you share with Nature, Ancestors & the Divine. Even in career: Land, Housing & Real estate related professions can bring lucrative Success to you.


You are Sensible and Understanding which adds to your pleasant personality. You are able to be vulnerable with yourself & others, which also means that others can feel safe being vulnerable with you. You are also extremely protective of your loved ones. Their safety & security in certain situations can automatically activate your Protective Instincts.


You share an almost Telepathic & Psychic connection with your loved ones. You are also entirely resistant to Emotional & Psychological Manipulation as you are well aware of such tactics through your early life experiences. Your kindness is hence not your weakness as you are discerning of who truly needs & deserves your Empathy and who is simply trying to take advantage of your giving-nature. Although emotionally vulnerable and open-hearted, you are not so transparent with your feelings & thoughts to everyone. You have well-defined boundaries both with trusted loved ones and others. 


Spending time with your family, friends & loved ones can bring you a lot of joy and vice versa, where your loved ones always feel special, loved & happy whenever they spend quality time with you. Hence creating wonderful memories with your loved ones can activate this PoF and unlock blessings and happiness in your life. Women: Female Friends, coworkers, Mother (/figures), Aunts, Sisters, Grand Mothers, etc. can bring you numerous opportunities, blessings and abundance in many ways. 


You are likely able to master the Art of Cooking & Nutrition, through your Inner desire to be able to care for yourself and others. You might even be good at gardening and agriculture. Your career can also benefit from your caring nature. You might be drawn towards Medical & Health Care professions, Nursing or even Charity & Social Services. You may be interested in running a day-care, school or teaching in general. You can also be a masterful cook/chef whether you choose to use your exceptional culinary skills as a hobby or in a profession. The same is true for Artistic talents, as you are likely Creatively gifted. You are likely to be noticed, admired & appreciated in your chosen career where you can express your compassion, care & nurturing nature. 


Your emotions rule your choices and are closely linked to your desires and passions. Hence, you can find Success when you follow your heart and trust your Instincts. You will often find wonderful opportunities through just flowing where your Emotions want to lead you. Abundance and Prosperity hence are naturally attracted to you. 


You have a healthy & happy Inner Child. You prioritize nurturing & healing your Inner Child, especially since you understand how vital it is to care for your Inner needs, wants & desires. You are content within, a heart full of gratitude and peace. You can access Happiness & Abundance not only through familial & personal relationships, but also through just your own Inner Self. 


You can attract more Good Luck and Prosperity by simply taking the best care of yourself through Nutrition; Emotional, Physical & Psychological Health; Self-care and appreciate Relaxation; Art & Creativity; etc. This PoF hence is a wonderful placement which can strengthen your bonds, bring Harmony in your Private life, more Success in your Professional life, and help you create a Positive and Uplifting environment for yourself, everyone & everything you care about. Blessings, Joy, Love & Positivity overflow and bring more Abundance, Peace & Prosperity as a result.

entry.title: Venus, Lilith & South Node Conjunction in Libra 7° • Sept 4 + 6, 2024 🦢✨
entry.content:
Background Pic by rainhard2 via Pixabay


Venus & Lilith in Virgo continued their tense opposition to Neptune even after moving into Libra, right before they met South Node and this previous Opposition has a profound impact on the current South Node Conjunction. South Node in Libra has bought the most powerful revelations about our relationships and inner harmony for the past year. While Chiron & Mars’s Conjunction to North Node made us more aware of our inner ego and strengthened our self-awareness, Venus & Lilith now will revitalize the connection to our inner feminine and there by making us more aware of our needs, wants & desires in life.


Lilith’s Opposition to Neptune likely exacerbated your deepest wounds related to guilt, shame & betrayal. Most of these dark emotions may have been related to your childhood experiences of being criticized, abandoned & even vilified for being different or for having so called ‘out of the norm’ beliefs. Memories of sexual harassment/Violence, bullying, etc. can rise up from even the deepest depths of your psyche, temporarily putting you in a sort of mental prison (it can also include memories from your past life, SN after all) This can also extend to fears that seem intrusive, some not even your own (we are in a collective immersion phase with all these transits). If you have Neptune and/or Saturn aspects to Lilith in your chart, this transit will impact you the most. 


The same can be true with Venus’s Opposition to Neptune, but more about our fears about relationships and the balance in those relationships. You might go through a sense of disillusionment with regards to your partner, family, friends, etc. but especially your romantic partner. *Cosmic Test of Love* There may have been an increase in doubts as to how authentic your relationship is, and have been in your past. So, past experiences can also reveal some truths that you may not have considered before. Betrayals, manipulations, disappointments, etc. from the past (no matter how severe or trivial) can lead you into a rabbit hole of paranoia, where soon you might not know what is true and what is not, what to be wary of and what is just your fear. 


With both these Oppositions to Neptune, lie the fears of not being able to love or be loved authentically and safely. A sense of unworthiness or even a feeling of bad luck can loom over you for a little while. This phase hence immediately leads you towards a sense of release as soon as Lilith & Venus join the North Node in Libra at 7°. Through the darkness & haze that the Oppositions created comes the light of liberation. A karmic cleansing happens at the South Node where your hard work to spiritually & emotionally transform your life with regards to these intense & uncomfortable feelings pays off. 


Hence, this Conjunction is a particularly enlightening and inspiring one. Not to mention, how the heavy feelings of the past don’t seem so burdensome, threatening or fearful anymore. This can also indicate that as a collective we have the spiritual strength to heal through the traumas of our past & the present. This Conjunction is hence exceptionally powerful to us all, and most impactful for those who have Libra placements, prominent Lilith and/or Venus placements, making aspects to Saturn/Pluto/Neptune/Chiron. I hope this cathartic transit is helping you reconnect to your inner-feminine, to your authentic self, and empowered you through the transformative journey.

entry.title: Privacy Policy
entry.content:
PRIVACY POLICY

Effective date: 2022-08-20

1. Introduction

Welcome to xQUEENo.

xQUEENo (“us”, “we”, or “our”) operates www.xqueeno.com (hereinafter referred to as “Service”).

Our Privacy Policy governs your visit to www.xqueeno.com, and explains how we collect, safeguard and disclose information that results from your use of our Service.

We use your data to provide and improve Service. By using Service, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy. Unless otherwise defined in this Privacy Policy, the terms used in this Privacy Policy have the same meanings as in our Terms and Conditions.

Our Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern all use of our Service and together with the Privacy Policy constitutes your agreement with us (“agreement”).

2. Definitions

SERVICE means the www.xqueeno.com website operated by xQUEENo.

PERSONAL DATA means data about a living individual who can be identified from those data (or from those and other information either in our possession or likely to come into our possession).

USAGE DATA is data collected automatically either generated by the use of Service or from Service infrastructure itself (for example, the duration of a page visit).

COOKIES are small files stored on your device (computer or mobile device).

DATA CONTROLLER means a natural or legal person who (either alone or jointly or in common with other persons) determines the purposes for which and the manner in which any personal data are, or are to be, processed. For the purpose of this Privacy Policy, we are a Data Controller of your data.

DATA PROCESSORS (OR SERVICE PROVIDERS) means any natural or legal person who processes the data on behalf of the Data Controller. We may use the services of various Service Providers in order to process your data more effectively.

DATA SUBJECT is any living individual who is the subject of Personal Data.

THE USER is the individual using our Service. The User corresponds to the Data Subject, who is the subject of Personal Data.

3. Information Collection and Use

We collect several different types of information for various purposes to provide and improve our Service to you.

4. Types of Data Collected

Personal Data

While using our Service, we may ask you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify you (“Personal Data”). Personally identifiable information may include, but is not limited to:

0.1. Email address

0.2. First name and last name

0.3. Phone number

0.4. Address, Country, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City

0.5. Cookies and Usage Data

We may use your Personal Data to contact you with newsletters, marketing or promotional materials and other information that may be of interest to you. You may opt out of receiving any, or all, of these communications from us by following the unsubscribe link.

Usage Data

We may also collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our Service or when you access Service by or through any device (“Usage Data”).

This Usage Data may include information such as your computer’s Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address), browser type, browser version, the pages of our Service that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

When you access Service with a device, this Usage Data may include information such as the type of device you use, your device unique ID, the IP address of your device, your device operating system, the type of Internet browser you use, unique device identifiers and other diagnostic data.

Tracking Cookies Data

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track the activity on our Service and we hold certain information.

Cookies are files with a small amount of data which may include an anonymous unique identifier. Cookies are sent to your browser from a website and stored on your device. Other tracking technologies are also used such as beacons, tags and scripts to collect and track information and to improve and analyze our Service.

You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Service.

Examples of Cookies we use:

0.1. Session Cookies: We use Session Cookies to operate our Service.

0.2. Preference Cookies: We use Preference Cookies to remember your preferences and various settings.

0.3. Security Cookies: We use Security Cookies for security purposes.

0.4. Advertising Cookies: Advertising Cookies are used to serve you with advertisements that may be relevant to you and your interests.

Other Data

While using our Service, we may also collect the following information: sex, age, date of birth, place of birth, passport details, citizenship, registration at place of residence and actual address, telephone number (work, mobile), details of documents on education, qualification, professional training, employment agreements, NDA agreements, information on bonuses and compensation, information on marital status, family members, social security (or other taxpayer identification) number, office location and other data.

5. Use of Data

xQUEENo uses the collected data for various purposes:

0.1. to provide and maintain our Service;

0.2. to notify you about changes to our Service;

0.3. to allow you to participate in interactive features of our Service when you choose to do so;

0.4. to provide customer support;

0.5. to gather analysis or valuable information so that we can improve our Service;

0.6. to monitor the usage of our Service;

0.7. to detect, prevent and address technical issues;

0.8. to fulfil any other purpose for which you provide it;

0.9. to carry out our obligations and enforce our rights arising from any contracts entered into between you and us, including for billing and collection;

0.10. to provide you with notices about your account and/or subscription, including expiration and renewal notices, email-instructions, etc.;

0.11. to provide you with news, special offers and general information about other goods, services and events which we offer that are similar to those that you have already purchased or enquired about unless you have opted not to receive such information;

0.12. in any other way we may describe when you provide the information;

0.13. for any other purpose with your consent.

6. Retention of Data

We will retain your Personal Data only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy. We will retain and use your Personal Data to the extent necessary to comply with our legal obligations (for example, if we are required to retain your data to comply with applicable laws), resolve disputes, and enforce our legal agreements and policies.

We will also retain Usage Data for internal analysis purposes. Usage Data is generally retained for a shorter period, except when this data is used to strengthen the security or to improve the functionality of our Service, or we are legally obligated to retain this data for longer time periods.

7. Transfer of Data

Your information, including Personal Data, may be transferred to – and maintained on – computers located outside of your state, province, country or other governmental jurisdiction where the data protection laws may differ from those of your jurisdiction.

If you are located outside India and choose to provide information to us, please note that we transfer the data, including Personal Data, to India and process it there.

Your consent to this Privacy Policy followed by your submission of such information represents your agreement to that transfer.

xQUEENo will take all the steps reasonably necessary to ensure that your data is treated securely and in accordance with this Privacy Policy and no transfer of your Personal Data will take place to an organisation or a country unless there are adequate controls in place including the security of your data and other personal information.

8. Disclosure of Data

We may disclose personal information that we collect, or you provide:

0.1. Disclosure for Law Enforcement.

Under certain circumstances, we may be required to disclose your Personal Data if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.

0.2. Business Transaction.

If we or our subsidiaries are involved in a merger, acquisition or asset sale, your Personal Data may be transferred.

0.3. Other cases. We may disclose your information also:

0.3.1. to our subsidiaries and affiliates;

0.3.2. to contractors, service providers, and other third parties we use to support our business;

0.3.3. to fulfill the purpose for which you provide it;

0.3.4. for the purpose of including your company’s logo on our website;

0.3.5. for any other purpose disclosed by us when you provide the information;

0.3.6. with your consent in any other cases;

0.3.7. if we believe disclosure is necessary or appropriate to protect the rights, property, or safety of the Company, our customers, or others.

9. Security of Data

The security of your data is important to us but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.

10. Your Data Protection Rights Under General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)

If you are a resident of the European Union (EU) and European Economic Area (EEA), you have certain data protection rights, covered by GDPR.

We aim to take reasonable steps to allow you to correct, amend, delete, or limit the use of your Personal Data.

If you wish to be informed what Personal Data we hold about you and if you want it to be removed from our systems, please email us at xqueeeeno38@gmail.com.

In certain circumstances, you have the following data protection rights:

0.1. the right to access, update or to delete the information we have on you;

0.2. the right of rectification. You have the right to have your information rectified if that information is inaccurate or incomplete;

0.3. the right to object. You have the right to object to our processing of your Personal Data;

0.4. the right of restriction. You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal information;

0.5. the right to data portability. You have the right to be provided with a copy of your Personal Data in a structured, machine-readable and commonly used format;

0.6. the right to withdraw consent. You also have the right to withdraw your consent at any time where we rely on your consent to process your personal information;

Please note that we may ask you to verify your identity before responding to such requests. Please note, we may not able to provide Service without some necessary data.

You have the right to complain to a Data Protection Authority about our collection and use of your Personal Data. For more information, please contact your local data protection authority in the European Economic Area (EEA).

11. Your Data Protection Rights under the California Privacy Protection Act (CalOPPA)

CalOPPA is the first state law in the nation to require commercial websites and online services to post a privacy policy. The law’s reach stretches well beyond California to require a person or company in the United States (and conceivable the world) that operates websites collecting personally identifiable information from California consumers to post a conspicuous privacy policy on its website stating exactly the information being collected and those individuals with whom it is being shared, and to comply with this policy.

According to CalOPPA we agree to the following:

0.1. users can visit our site anonymously;

0.2. our Privacy Policy link includes the word “Privacy”, and can easily be found on the home page of our website;

0.3. users will be notified of any privacy policy changes on our Privacy Policy Page;

0.4. users are able to change their personal information by emailing us at xqueeeeno38@gmail.com.

Our Policy on “Do Not Track” Signals:

We honor Do Not Track signals and do not track, plant cookies, or use advertising when a Do Not Track browser mechanism is in place. Do Not Track is a preference you can set in your web browser to inform websites that you do not want to be tracked.

You can enable or disable Do Not Track by visiting the Preferences or Settings page of your web browser.

12. Your Data Protection Rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)

If you are a California resident, you are entitled to learn what data we collect about you, ask to delete your data and not to sell (share) it. To exercise your data protection rights, you can make certain requests and ask us:

0.1. What personal information we have about you. If you make this request, we will return to you:

0.0.1. The categories of personal information we have collected about you.

0.0.2. The categories of sources from which we collect your personal information.

0.0.3. The business or commercial purpose for collecting or selling your personal information.

0.0.4. The categories of third parties with whom we share personal information.

0.0.5. The specific pieces of personal information we have collected about you.

0.0.6. A list of categories of personal information that we have sold, along with the category of any other company we sold it to. If we have not sold your personal information, we will inform you of that fact.

0.0.7. A list of categories of personal information that we have disclosed for a business purpose, along with the category of any other company we shared it with.

Please note, you are entitled to ask us to provide you with this information up to two times in a rolling twelve-month period. When you make this request, the information provided may be limited to the personal information we collected about you in the previous 12 months.

0.2. To delete your personal information. If you make this request, we will delete the personal information we hold about you as of the date of your request from our records and direct any service providers to do the same. In some cases, deletion may be accomplished through de-identification of the information. If you choose to delete your personal information, you may not be able to use certain functions that require your personal information to operate.

0.3. To stop selling your personal information. We don’t sell or rent your personal information to any third parties for any purpose. We do not sell your personal information for monetary consideration. However, under some circumstances, a transfer of personal information to a third party, or within our family of companies, without monetary consideration may be considered a “sale” under California law. You are the only owner of your Personal Data and can request disclosure or deletion at any time.

If you submit a request to stop selling your personal information, we will stop making such transfers.

Please note, if you ask us to delete or stop selling your data, it may impact your experience with us, and you may not be able to participate in certain programs or membership services which require the usage of your personal information to function. But in no circumstances, we will discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

To exercise your California data protection rights described above, please send your request(s) by email: xqueeeeno38@gmail.com.

Your data protection rights, described above, are covered by the CCPA, short for the California Consumer Privacy Act. To find out more, visit the official California Legislative Information website. The CCPA took effect on 01/01/2020.

13. Service Providers

We may employ third party companies and individuals to facilitate our Service (“Service Providers”), provide Service on our behalf, perform Service-related services or assist us in analysing how our Service is used.

These third parties have access to your Personal Data only to perform these tasks on our behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.

19. Children’s Privacy

entry.title: Natal Chiron Opposite Uranus ✨
entry.content:
A generational transit. Recent: Between 1950 - 1989, a 40 yearlong transit. 

Exemplary inventions, forever changing the direction of history. Accelerated growth in technological developments was seen during this transit.


Desire for Freedom, to break free from traditions & norms, especially those that no-longer serve the ever-evolving society. Seeking freedom from generational wounds, desperate need to keep moving forward, throwing caution to the wind. A rebellious activist, who loses the motivation and drive to fight because of unresolved wound of self in the subconscious. 


Sucked into Mundane life but burnt out in the process years later, leading to identity crisis. Working towards building a society where the younger generations won’t have to live/face the same life/situation/dissatisfactions as them. But eventually giving up on the hopes and ideals, resenting/detesting those who continue marching forward to change the society because of deep rooted/unresolved inner conflicts.


Facing the pain and reflecting inwards, accepting the harsh realities of the past, knowing that they have done their best part. Fixing the current scales of balance in the society. Working on rejection/abandonment issues of the self.

entry.title: Libra Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | August 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes August 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

Aug 1 - 6, 2023

You might be in a more pensive mood this week, Libra. Past memories may be replaying in your mind brining up repressed fears, anger, resentment and guilt. It can be quite tormenting the longer you stay in your thoughts. This can also indicate to negative self-talk. But remember Libra, dwelling on the past won’t fix anything. The only thing you can change is your present and hence your future. Luckily, you will be able to come out of any depressive thoughts or moods easily. You have a more practical approach to dealing with your past, with both good & bad. So, this week will help you remind just how capable you are at turning pain into inspiration. You might be feeling a little disconnected with your social circle & loved ones than usual lately. This week you will feel the need to rekindle old friendships and reconnect with people that you might have been distant with for a while. 



Although, it is advised not to project your insecurities or disappointments onto your loved ones (and vice versa) since with significant healing that you are going through internally, you might feel intense discomfort while dealings with others. So, any misunderstanding or slight projections can trigger others (and vice versa) in a big way this week. Ego battles can go out of hand leaving everyone involved hurt & regretful. Hence this is something to be aware of for the first few days of the week. Everyday work and responsibilities may have started to weigh on you immensely, making it harder for you concentrate on your health and self-care. But, you will be prompted to reorganize your routines majorly to accommodate both work and personal needs. This can feel daunting at first but you will be able to find the right balance soon enough, after all, this is one of your fortes Libra. 


Advised to stay cautious about lending or borrowing money this week. You will feel the need to escape from the intensity of the changes happening in your life, but you will have to face the fears head on regardless. Your emotional fortitude will be tested through small events but you will have the inner strength to handle any insecurity or fear that shows up this week, so believe in yourself and how far you have come on your journey sweet Libra. You are making excellent progress in life, even when you can’t see the results yet. Let this storm pass, soon all the negativity that has been plaguing you will dissipate allowing happiness and stability to be restored once again.
entry.blogger:metaDescription: Libra Weekly Horoscope August 2023

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid in Leo + 5th House 🦁✨
entry.content:
Sirene Asteroid in Leo + 5th House + Sun Aspects + 5° 17° 29° 🦁✨


LIGHT ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You are blessed with a Unique charm and Magnetism that others find irresistible. You are also endowed with immense Talents & Skills that can bring a lot of Recognition. If you are drawn towards Artistic and/or Athletic pursuits, you are likely to achieve massive Popularity & Success. Your passion for everything that you do can seem so inspiring to others. Your Self-confidence and strong Sense of Self, especially your Courageous Demeanor can attract a lot of admirers. You can also manifest a successful Career & Romantic life. 


Your loyalty & grace can make you extra appealing to your loved ones. Your Romantic life can be fulfilling with partner(s) who can match your passion, vibes & values. You not just command attention from others, but others are also equally interested to get your attention. You can draw in many when you take the center stage and embrace the spotlight expressing your Talents & True personality. This is a Sirene placement that does well (i.e., even more Powerful) when one is aware of it. 


You can be Sensually appealing to many, you also have a captivating body language & communication skills. So, you can attract a lot of opportunities for both your Career & Relationships. Own your Confidence, Originality & Allure. Also, go easy on the (conscious) teasing, you can make anyone go crazy in love 😏. Excellent placement for Popularity & Fame, especially in careers/ventures that have to do with being in the Spotlight, Leadership positions, or expressing your Talents.


DARK ATTRIBUTES OF SIRENE

You encounter people who wish to ‘steal your confidence’. This can be very apparent in your Romantic relationships but also with friendships & family. You might have family/friends who don’t support your Artistic pursuits or Personal goals, they may actively hinder your Self-expression. Similarly, you can encounter people who make you feel as though you can’t truly be yourself around them, which can be a major Red Flag. 

In Romantic relationships, it is best not to move too many levels too quickly, especially sexually or even make decisions about commitment/marriage hastily. Since, you might not really give yourself the time to assess their character or True Intentions (as Sirene here can bring you sexually charged excitement very early in your relationship(s), which can be a Red Flag in and of itself). So, on the extreme Negative side of this placement, you might find yourself stuck in a relationship/marriage with someone who wasn’t loyal/serious/mature enough. Or worse, they might have ulterior motives and only like “the chase/challenge of having you”. There may even be temptations to cheat on your partner (or vise versa) when there are lows in your relationship which can only lead to heartbreak, were even simple discontentment can spiral into an abyss of resentment. 

Generally, it is best to be vigilant of  those who constantly criticize you, try to “humble you”, etc. since they may just be manipulating you and ‘chipping away at your self-confidence’. This also makes it important as to why you should hold yourself to a High regard in relationships (of all kind) and have a Strong Sense of Self. However, Self-obsession and not holding yourself accountable can also make you seem arrogant & unlikable, which others may consider as a major Red Flag in you. If you are in Professions where you’re passionate about being in the spotlight, you will need to display your True character and not become too focused on gaining attention/popularity, lest you are deemed Superficial, since your Talents & Passion will eventually bring you all the Recognition & Success that you desire and deserve.

entry.title: Fated Venus & Saturn Conjunction in Pisces 16° 🪷✨ Jan 19, 2025 • Union of Spirituality & Practicality
entry.content:
「 Venus and Saturn will soften the ongoing tense Oppositions with a mellow Conjunction in Pisces at 16º. 」 This Conjunction will bring its own intensity in a subtle yet profound way, especially within our Personal Relationships. Enjoy this pleasant Conjunction of Venus & Saturn, witnessing the like-minded & kindred hearts reuniting in the Astrological skies. 


As the North Node shifts into Pisces, Venus makes a delightful Conjunction in Pisces to Saturn bringing themes of commitments, romances & contracts together with soul connections & ethereal experiences. This week can mark a time of Spiritual Ascension, both with respect to yourself and your romantic relationships. This is when we also get to reevaluate our personal relationships with that of our Inner Truth, to see if they are in alignment with each other, if not, to assess how to elevate the two harmoniously. Hence, Soulful Connections take the center-stage this week leading to some profound experiences.


Twin Flame & Soulmate connections will go through intense Ascension process and Upgrades. This of course will apply to connections that seem Divine and have Deeper Spiritual Roots. Hence if you are in such a Relationship, whether in the physical &/or in the spiritual, you are bound to experience this Conjunction (especially since the 2nd week of January). This also of course means the Deep Catharsis of Emotions. With Jupiter Squaring this Conjunction, it can also lead to a mind-bending, hyper doubtful or intense need to question & seek answers to all that is taking place within yourself and in your relationship, trying to rationalize the ethereal experience which can seem exhausting.



Intense feelings, profound dreams, spiritual awakenings, etc. Whether you are reuniting with your Inner Higher Self, or with a Soulmate or both, this Conjunction will likely bring immense experiences that will help you look deeper inside yourself; to gain wisdom, value & purpose; to find the sacred parts of you that crave for such a spiritually fulfilling connection. 


You will have the courage to face your fears, subconscious blocks, even clear out karmic ties & patterns that are no longer in alignment with the Newer Experience & Reality that you are stepping into. Delving into the depths of emotions from the past lives, trying to making sense of it all, but you might not be able to comprehend or articulate certain things just yet. However, Mercury in Capricorn Sextiling this Conjunction will help you with just that. So, you will not just have the clarity to resolve certain issues within your Inner World, but also in the physical where you will be able to find resolutions to misunderstandings, practical issues & blocks. 


Juno is in Scorpio helping this Conjunction, hence this will be a significant time for the Strengthening of Spiritual Connections, Powerful Commitments can take root during this time, also a wonderful time for Renewal of Vows. Kindred Souls reunite first on the spiritual and then on the physical. Since, Saturn in Pisces along with Venus can bring a Soul Connection from the ethereal into the physical, solidifying it.


Stronger commitments, mature conversations, levelling up, taking on greater responsibilities as a couple, mutual respect & values, sharing common goals & ambitions. This will hence result in Healing, both individually and together, making it easer to be Compassionate towards each other’s previous experiences, troubles & sensitivities. Destined Connections, Unions & Reunions can emerge out of this Fated Conjunction, giving rise to a whole new experience of Divinely Guided Love & Higher Self Love.
