entry.title: October 2023 Eclipses, Annular Solar Eclipse in Libra & Partial Lunar Eclipse in Taurus | Oct 14 & 28, 2023 🔥🌹✨
entry.content:
With the powerful year-end Eclipses of 2023, Great changes are ahead of us. Two eclipses follow each other (as usual) but this year they are in different signs marking the official shift of Lunar Nodes. Total Solar Eclipse in Aries kick-started the shift of the Nodes back in April 2023, and now with Solar Eclipse in Libra on Oct 14, 2023 we are officially entering the Eclipse seasons of Aries & Libra for the next 1 & 1/2 years. Along with Lunar Eclipse later in the month in Taurus marking the end of Lunar Node transit in the signs of Taurus & Scorpio (until 2030s). As one chapter closes the other begins. It symbolizes the end of major cycle(s) and beginning of new ones in our lives. 


Greeted by the first eclipse of Oct 2023, we can look forward to a glorious Solar Eclipse in Libra. Since the Total Solar Eclipse in Aries, there has been a definite shift in our focus. April and May of 2023 felt a lot more chaotic yet new. With the shifts of Lunar Nodes, we could feel the shifts in the direction of the winds of destiny, ever so slightly but with a major twist. Turn of events that took place suddenly had their impactful influence in our lives until now, giving us the time to recalibrate to the changes & shifts in dynamics that are happening. Many of us went through major mindset changes, with our focus for the future becoming more streamlined and infused with inspiration. A little jolt of excitement to explore new territories and expand our world-view. 


Especially with regards to getting in touch with our goals and aspirations of our childhood that were forgotten or left behind. The need to recapture such dreams and ambitions emerged from within the depths of our hearts, gaining more momentum till now. With the second eclipse of Oct 2023 in Taurus closing out the one & half years journey of the Nodes in the sensual & practical pair of Taurus & Scorpio. It is likely that there are endings happening all around us, some chaotic, others cathartic. While in April & May, the emotions rose and washed over our hearts with new inspiration from the intense eclipses in Aries & Scorpio. However this time, we are getting the opportunity to make sense of the journey we have been on so far and the direction we need to take for our true personal fulfillment.



A 9 - 10 year cycle(s) must have ended in at-least one area of your life recently. There might have been a recent end to a long term relationship or end to the dynamics within long term relationships, certain patterns falling away or your relationship to each other is changing for the better (together or apart). This can even play out as job change from a place where you worked for almost a decade, a promotion or retirement, etc. Legal troubles finally ending or settlements going in a favorable direction. This year as a whole felt like a period of “tying up lose ends”, some happening all by themselves, while others needed our active participation. So, the October Eclipses have a flavor of “peaceful resolutions and silent forward movement” through the fading noise of chaos. 


With the Solar Eclipse in Libra, karmic balance plays an important role both on a personal & collective level. The last Lunar Eclipse in Scorpio had dramatic impact on the ares of our lives that needed a finality, which indicated to the end of certain toxic relationships/dynamics that lacked loyalty & genuine intentions, even to the relationship we had to our own fears & insecurities changing once and for all. With Libra’s influence, we will have a new shift in relationship-dynamics. It indicates to completely new patterns, experiences & heights of love, compassions & reciprocity. With South Node now in Libra, we can except to see some relationships (romantic, platonic, business, etc.) to strengthen and others fall away from our life path. Overall, we will be able to see and experience completely new & different relationship dynamics and levels of commitment. 


So, some relationships from the past may get a second chance from destiny. Likewise, our understanding of true love, support and commitment will lead us to walk away from certain relationships that may no longer be in alignment to our life path and our highest good. With Mars (in Scorpio) Opposing the North Node during the Solar Eclipse in Libra along with Pluto (still) Square the Nodes, we are bound to see some major shake ups in our lives with regards to both the ending & beginnings that take place. There may be resistance from both within & without to the changes that are happening, which can create tension & frustrations, but with Venus & Saturn in good aspects to Mars, we can expect to handle any challenge with a level-head without giving into anger or agitations. 



However, Saturn Opposite Venus can create a major hindrance during this time. Since, with Venus being the ruler of the current South Node, we might have a hard time understanding our needs & desires moving forward. It might take us patience & facing our insecurities to arrive at the right decisions. This can even mean fighting through previous sticky situations that have practically ended, since Saturn Opposite Venus can indicate to oppressive or domineering people/situations that are trying way too hard to hold onto you (or some situation) that has already karmically ended. So, if you are holding onto toxic situations or some others are, this Solar Eclipse will rip that out of your path for you, since the universe needs to restore karmic balance, which will be the theme for the next 2 year and eclipses are known to be ruthless when it comes to correcting karmic injustices.


With Saturn & Pluto’s overall influence on the Nodes, Venus & Mars, it is likely that there will be uncertainty to all the decisions we will be faced with. The path ahead can only we walked hence with our faith & not just our sight alone. So this time, we will have choices to make from the knowledge & wisdom of all our previous experiences. With willful Aries & diplomatic Libra, we will be presented with choices for our new path in life, so the approach we take will decide the pace & the outcome. 


Hence, when we arrive at critical junctions of life in the next one & half years, we will have to take responsibility for the choices we make. So, unlike the last 2 years, where many endings felt out of our hands and utterly chaotic, this time around, along with the touch of destiny, we can choose to give things a second chance or let go peacefully. Likewise, any new beginning we undertake will have good luck and fortune. With a refreshed passion for life, new ventures, projects and even lifestyle can bring much needed change in perspective of prosperity. Any new adventures that we dive into for the next year & a half will need our absolute dedication to reach immense success. 



Neptune Opposite Venus during the last Eclipse of 2023 can cause us to question our decisions. We might get trapped in our own insecurities & fears, usually stemming from our past disappointments. But, some truths are just not easy to be clouded by doubts, so, every decision we make regarding both our past & future will need our certainty & clear intentions embedded in them. With the Lunar Eclipse closing out in the sign of Taurus, a 9 - 10 year long cycle related to money, stability & self-worth is also completed. We are now likely to have a new perspective on our own worth & value, along with the kind of life & comfort we need to be fulfilled in life. With Taurus & Scorpio Lunar Nodes, we learnt to build ourselves & our lives up from the poverty/lack consciousness to the mindset of abundance. We now don’t just honor what we deserve but also what we desire. 


With uncertain times ahead, our warrior spirit will guide us forward. New changes need new skills of adaptability and new found courage. North Node in Aries will hence have us focused on finding our passion again. The fire within that is reignited will help up face the challenges and take advantage of the numerous opportunities ahead.

entry.title: Natal Jupiter and North Node Aspects 🐞✨
entry.content:
Jupiter Sextile North Node

✱ You are self-confident and an optimistic person who wants to look at the bright side of life. 

✱ You’re also a realist since you notice what’s wrong in the world. So, know how to blend both attributes to create positive changes in both your life and that of others.

✱ You feel it’s your destiny to spark a revolution or bring much needed changes in otherwise stagnant & unrelenting situations that only seem to cause more harm than good to others.

✱ So you likely are an activist, a leader, a teacher/preacher in your own right.

✱ You are generous and love to help others. You get a lot of joy in making people smile and spending quality time with your loved ones.

✱ Your positive mindset helps you attract the necessary opportunities, resources and people that elevate you on your life path.

✱ You’re also studious and obedient to elders whom you recognize as your guides/mentors, who help you ground yourself and provide you with timely advice & encouragement.

✱ You are humble and know how to show humility in the face of setbacks, and celebration in triumphs. People around you admire your down-to-earth nature.

✱ You face challenges head-on knowing that you’ll overcome them even if you don’t know the details, you have the fullest of confidence that things will turn out for the better in the end.

✱ You’ll likely keep elevating on your life path through optimism & faith, encouraging others to do the same, reaching greater heights, helping - teaching - changing things people and situations for the better by illuminating the way.


Jupiter Trine North Node

△ You have a positive mindset that helps you get through the tough times and enjoy the happy ones.

△ You’re optimistic and a believer of all things good, so you’re naturally able to attract prosperity into your life.

△ You are focused and determined to reach your goals that seem like an inner calling to you.

△ The more you explore your inner callings, the more you seem to attract opportunities that lead you to your goals. Your explorative personality also attracts resources and influential people who are often willing to help you reach your potential in life.

△ So it is likely that you choose your career path based on your inner callings as well, hence gaining support, wealth & respect along your life path.

△ You are blessed with a good physical & mental stamina that helps you stay active, learn new and interesting things, and go on adventures of your own.

△ With all Jupiter aspects, and especially with Trine, it is important however that you never take any of your good fortune for granted or over-indulge & become lethargic after the initial wins. 

△ You’re always ready to involve in activism or charitable causes that are close to your heart, so your self-less deeds can help you amass good karma.

△ You have the right point of view on life, and this perspective helps you advance on your life path easily.

△ Your optimistic attitude and joyous disposition also attract many admirers who would like to learn from you, work with you, and share a good time.



Jupiter Square North Node

□ This aspect brings a lot of inner tension in accepting your inner callings and following what others expect you to do.

□ You might spend the early part of your life being diligent, learning and working towards a certain type of life, or settling for mediocrity, what the society usually considers as the norm, but slowly you might realize that you are exhausted and unfulfilled.

□ You might have to overcome numerous obstacles trying to follow what was expected of you, and through those situations you might end up discovering an alternate way to do things, a much simpler more innovative one.

□ You will have to fully embrace your need for freedom and creativity, since the mundane bores you.

□ You have good karma on your side to help you achieve your goals as long as you believe in yourself and make practical plans to reach them

□ With your optimistic attitude you are able to attract influential people, resources and opportunities that help you advance on your life path. So, it’s likely that you don’t always give ear to pessimistic people or their cynicism.

□ You might initially feel like you wasted your time or that you should have chosen so and so paths before, but you’ll also be relieved to know that you might have actually paved a way for so many others, inspiring them to believe in themselves and explore new paths to fulfil their destiny themselves.

□ You will likely go against the grain every now and then but even through ups and downs you always end up reaching your goals as long as you’re open to learning from your mistakes and successes equally.

□ With this Jupiter and NN aspect, it’s important that you don’t take your blessings for granted and always remember how you had to earn everything you have accomplished so far. It is also critical that you uphold integrity and truth, since it’s very easy to amass good karma through good-intentions and equally easy to amass bad karma through devious deeds.

□ You’ll likely work towards a better future, inspiring others through your successes, gaining respect and wealth along your life path.


Jupiter Opposite North Node

☍ This aspect can cause a bit of confusion with what is your true calling and what is just a distraction.

☍ Jupiter Conjunct South Node gives you a lot of initial success, but you might get stuck in the loop of repeating the same experiences over and over again.

☍ This means you get too comfortable indulging in things that are only distractions, even the work that seems fairly easy and successful might just be holding you back from your true potential.

☍ You might get too relaxed in your comfort zone that it can feel like you have already made it in life.

☍ You’re an optimist and you can attract opportunities to help you advance further than ever before even if they seem extremely challenging. 

☍ However, if you played small, and settled to stay in your comfort zone, or indulge in the things you’ve outgrown, you might end up feeling dissatisfied.

☍ You might have to endure through some harsh wake up calls in the form of karmic cycles and events reminding you that this is just the starting phase, and you still have a long way to go.

☍ So, in your early years, whatever makes you feel comfortable and brings you easy success might not really be your true calling hence will eventually leave you feeling empty and numb.

☍ You will realize how more capable you’re when you start reaching higher, which is usually challenging and out of your norm, but you might also realize that this path brings you a lot of enthusiasm even through the ups and downs.

☍ You might even start to fully appreciate gifts and abilities that you never knew you had, and how you have come much further than you ever thought before, attaining more success, respect, wealth and prosperity along the way.



Jupiter Conjunct North Node 

☌ This aspect can bring the best in you, yet you might have to ground yourself often to not lose sight of reality.

☌ You’re a born optimist, but you might have had to consciously exercise your positive mindset since it wasn't always something you were used to.

☌ Self-belief and self-confidence may also have been things you had to consciously embody during your early years in order to fully make them a part of you.

☌ You know what your life purpose and goals are, and you know how to get there. You don’t mind taking a leap of faith or making spontaneous decisions concerning even the most crucial situations in your life. 

☌ Since you lead by faith and not always by practicality, you might have to exercise patience and methodical planning as well.

☌ Your career(s) are closely related to your life purpose, that makes you determined to accomplish them even more and hence take things seriously.

☌ You will likely find immense amounts of satisfaction and fulfilment while elevating along your life path since your positive attitude towards both failures and successes help you stay focused.

☌ There is however a bigger danger, whenever you over-indulge, rebel for the sake of it, and take your blessings for granted, since this can easily impact your further success and others’ view on you. It is also crucial to stay righteous and uphold your integrity since you can easily amass karma through your deeds and intentions, good and bad alike.

☌ Your ever joyous, expansive, optimistic, and brave personality attracts many admirers towards you, who respect you for your humility and courage.

☌ You’ll likely make an immense impact on others, bring fresh perspectives, attain great success, wealth, happiness, prosperity and honor along your life path.


Jupiter Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ This aspect brings up issues regarding your sense of personal freedom and self-confidence, since they’re both closely related to one another.

^ You might have grown up in restrictive environments, feeling trapped in societal/familial expectations.

^ You might have had a longing for new and more expansive experiences, this could have also made you interested in foreign lands, cultures, lifestyles, arts, philosophy etc. Your need for adventures towards new horizons might even feel like your inner calling.

^ All these constraining situations and your aspirations could have made you lose faith in a better future and hence could have hit your self-confidence levels.

^ But the key to overcome these confining obstacles is also your self-confidence. The moment you realize this you might have been able to break-through the barriers holding you back.

^ You might start attracting miraculous opportunities, that can help you expand beyond the compounds.

^ Or you might find that you have the ability to turn things around to your favor and bring the experiences you long for towards you.

^ You will likely crack the puzzle to reaching your inner callings through your own optimism and self-belief.

^ You might gain immense amount of knowledge and wisdom through all your experiences that can also inspire many others who might be dealing with similar situations. Hence your successes and breakthroughs might become the guiding light of hope to others.

^ You’ll likely work towards improving your current circumstances, finding new and innovative ways to overcome obstacles successfully, making huge leaps on your life path, attaining honor, prosperity and happiness following your life’s purpose.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Pisces (12th House) Generation 🐋✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Pisces (12th House) Generation 🐋✨

Saturn in this ethereal house/sign is a soulful placement. You are extremely aware of yourself, sometimes self-conscious about every little thing about yourself and your surroundings. Saturn here heightens your sensitivity to the outer world, painfully so. Spirituality, compassion and sentiments are inseparable parts of your character. So, you might take your spiritual practices or charitable efforts very seriously. You are well-grounded, but sometimes to the extreme where you might develop low self-esteem (This can be quite a devastating placement if you have other placements and aspects hinting the same). Your subconscious is a vital part of you, even when you don’t realize it. If you are not careful, you can convince yourself that you are your own worst nightmare. Your thoughts and beliefs are powerful, they can create your reality, and so any self-suggestions can manifest in your habits, surroundings, decisions, relationships, etc. Without a purpose in life, you might lose yourself easily, Saturn here will make sure that you find your calling and be dedicated to it. 


Self-seclusion is a great way to recharge yourself, especially since you might feel drained easily by social interactions even when it's with your loved ones. Since this placement can feel like your worst critique is always in the back of your mind, you’re constantly aware of your thoughts and patterns. So, you will have a hard time if your self-talk was your own bully. Saturn here will help you to be practical and grounded all while utilizing your gifts to their fullest, hence, using Saturn’s guidance in a positive way will be a great way to accomplish your goals. Your success and failures affect you deeply, lessons and rewards will enlighten you equally. Sometimes it may seem like you are being forced to live in the reality rather than swimming in your own dream world. Saturn will help you bring the essence and knowledge from your subconscious world, you never know, you might be tapping into the ethers with invaluable knowledge, gifts and wisdom. Hence, creative practicality can be an excellent talent you might have to master. 


You might have a tendency to trust others easily, or be blind to red flags, constantly let others take advantage of your generosity or tolerate toxic behaviors. You might have also endured traumatic experiences in your past life/childhood that stayed deep in your subconscious quietly influencing your decisions and creating your patterns. Unravelling these threads of fate and delusion, distinguishing between the two, will become a lifelong journey of healing. You might have a strong memory, or you might even have the ability to selectively forget details of traumatic situations, either way, you might not realize just how powerful your subconscious may be until a certain point in your life. Sudden events may trigger your psychic ability(s), or you might already be vaguely aware of some since your childhood. You might notice how the circumstances in your waking life may affect your dreams, you might experience frequent nightmares whenever you are dealing with stressful situations, likewise, you might have happy dreams whenever you are feeling content in your waking life. You might even see prophetic dreams with signs, symbols, animals, people, etc. sometimes guiding you and other times warning you of events to come. 



You might have a profound religious experience during your travels (especially to foreign lands) or have a spiritual awakening out of the blue. Spiritual or even mindful practices/routines may help you relieve from insomnia. Your health, both mental and physical will need dedication and attention throughout your life. You might even be able to find help/guidance from professionals if you ever feel overwhelmed by setting up a health routine of any kind. You might be extremely sensitive to allergies, food poisoning, miss-diagnosis, strong scents, etc. You might generally be a selective person when it comes to choosing your friends and trusting your loved ones, but hidden dangers may always keep you on your toes. You might have also experienced betrayals, heartbreaks and drama from people who showed you their true colors when you had no doubts in them before. Harsh lessons early on in your life may have made you vary of everyone in your life. Setting strong boundaries will be extremely important.


This placement can help you access your greatest creative potential. You might have artistic and altruistic talents. You might be a gifted artist, singer, writer, painter, etc. or you might even possess special Clairs. Discipline and devotion can help you bring out the treasures from underneath the oceans with this placement. You will have to wear a thick guard when it comes to criticism since there may be a lot of projection than truth in them. Projections of opinions, negativity, envy, evil eye, etc. may be a big part of your life. Although, any negativity that is projected onto you will go back 10 folds stronger since Saturn here will make sure karma is served, so your good-will and kind heart is sure to be protected karmically. Self-pity, sitting in despair for far too long, escapism, etc. are a big “no, no” with Saturn firmly placed here. You will be reminded time and again that compassion and sensitivity are essential human characters but not learning the lessons and making excuses to not move past painful experiences shall not be tolerated by Saturn’s sternness. 


Losses of all kinds may be extremely heartbreaking for you, be it losing toxic habits, relationships, materialistic things, people in unfortunate circumstances, etc. eventually making you quite mature in dealing with such situations. You might be compelled to establish a solid spiritual foundation for yourself, it may be a hobby, routine, career, charity, activism, environmentalism, etc. Learning about foreign lands, or even visiting such places can help you find some solace. Artistic talents may serve as your purpose and career. Donating unused possessions, volunteering, gardening, cleaning, swimming, regular meditations, etc. can help you access this placement’s true potential. Facing your fears is a big part of your healing, and ultimately, Saturn here will help you rest, truly rest at ease and find your inner peace. Your journey to healing and even salvation may seem like a long road, but this placement will help you master it with devotion, acceptance and self-love. Healing and fulfilling your purpose become your spiritual duties.

entry.title: Saturn Transits into Pisces 2023 🍃✨ March 7, 2023
entry.content:
Saturn will enter the boundless realms of Pisces on March 7, 2023, and will stay there till May of 2025 then again in 2026 for a short period. For the next 2.5-3 years, Saturn will be completing his tour through the zodiac wheel before he moves into Aries for a new astrological cycle. This will be an enlightening time indeed, with many obvious surprises and sudden revelations both in our personal lives & globally. 

On a personal level:

This will be a great time for healing, self-care, and resting all while maintaining the balance of productivity and consistency. Those in the fields of spirituality, healing and higher learning may find this transit to be a rewarding time with more awareness of your gifts & abilities being heightened. Following routines like meditation, qigong, yoga, or even just walking in the nature can be a refreshing (or even a necessary) get-away. Indulging in creative pursuits, music, art, and making time for relaxation will be extremely rewarding. Taking care of your physical & mental health will become an important part of this transit, since otherwise Saturn here can bring rude awakenings in the form of health issues. Emotionally/psychologically abusive or manipulative people in and around your life may be exposed (this can be true about your own or leaned toxic traits) whose behaviors cannot be tolerable anymore. Detaching or severing ties with such relationships/environments can be a way of healing by choosing your wellbeing & realizing your self-worth. 


Rose-colored glasses will be shattered during this transit (with Neptune still transiting Pisces). There may be possibilities of identity crises and mental breakdowns that will lead to introspection and rediscovery of your true self. Any form of victimhood or extreme escapist lifestyle, attitude and/or mindset will no longer serve the new version of yourself that you will be creating thanks to this transit. So, you can use this time to re-program your thought-patterns and mindsets which will further allow you to manifest your deepest desires, since this transit can help you actualize your dreams using your inner resourcefulness and practicality. You may experience creative impulses that lead to major breakthroughs, similarly, there may be spiritual epiphanies and insights that can change your entire perspective on life as a whole. Artistic, spiritual and altruistic endeavors may be challenging yet immensely rewarding during this transit. 



You may notice many cycles ending and beginning simultaneously sometimes even overwhelming your subconscious. There may be major karmic cycles/patterns that see their end, marking your achievement in self-discovery and healing. You might feel burdened to work on your inner healing, but you will also realize how rewarding the journey is with the extra help of this transit. Saturn will always push us towards our true potential, so you might slowly start to feel satisfied with the results of your efforts as the transit progresses. Losses and sacrifices will be major themes with this transit. You might experience unforeseen events that are out of your control which come with their own set of grievances. But you might also find acceptance in those losses and painful experiences since in a way Saturn and Pisces work together to clear out things/people/patterns that don’t serve your highest good. 


This can be a great time for releasing addictions, patterns, relationships, etc. that may be emotionally/psychologically draining you & restricting you from reaching your true potential. This way you can enter Saturn in Aries transit with an open-heart space and lesser mental/emotional baggage, creating room to rebuild yourself and your life goals with a refreshed enthusiasm. There may be a lot of introspection (or events that force it) during this transit that can be painful and triggering yet essential for your soul-evolution. You can expect to come out of this transit with a fresh perspective on life, developing a conscious & productive lifestyle, focus on general wellbeing, acceptance, and taking responsibility for your healing.    


On a global level:

There may be a decline in general fascination with materialism (which is already underway) and more into conscious consumerism. Any form of over-stimulation and extreme escapism may be viewed as repulsive (the other way around can be true as well but reaching its peak and crashing back down again to realistic views on consumerism). There may be a huge shift in the trends of social media for example, being more conscious of how much time is spent online, etc. Social media platforms can undergo many reforms especially with the general public to see changes in the type of contents they are more interested in. There may be many new discussions about how ads, streams, contents, etc. are being regulated and by whom. Streaming services and platforms may have to evolve from targeted advertising and other such tactics to hold onto their viewers but rather find more authentic means of appealing to their customers. Several new restrictions may come and go especially in the social media realm. 


There may be huge developments in the film, art and creative fields from major breakthroughs to criticism for inauthentic inclusivity, etc. Old yet relatable ideas may get mainstream attention once again and be adapted in unique and creative ways. Similarly, conspiracy theories, curated misinformation, and other extreme forms of fantasies like apocalyptic ideas may gain traction. But, simultaneously, mass delusions, misguidance, etc. that are either cultural or institutional will start to crumble. Many organizations and governments may face crises and come under scrutiny. 



Narcissism and other identity/personality related issues will reach a peak, with several controversial downfalls of famous names (which too is underway, further intensified with Neptune & Pluto transits) being revealed, so there may be an upward surge of celebrities, influencers, etc. that will have to face their true selves much like how the majority of the world will be able to see through them, where PR curated falsehood may be exposed (the same trend can also be seen in our personal lives as well). There may be public outrage towards many scandals & crimes (either previously exposed or newly discovered) that are notorious (may be even hidden and pervasive). There may also be identity (gender & sexuality) related topics that will see oppression, as a result positive breakthroughs from activism & mass public support. There may many such concerning social issues that see major revolution. 


There may be global climate changes & events that come as wake-up calls creating urgency to take decisive steps and most of all bring acceptance & responsibility for certain feasible solutions. More people may turn to realistic ways of escapism where developing hobbies, skills, etc. to utilize free time constructively will become a prime focus creating a trend of its own. Simultaneously there may also be an extreme turn towards excessive escapism with dangerous outcomes that will become a big debate about growing rates in depression, mental health issues, crimes, etc. Speaking of which, medicines, healthcare industries, and wellness institutes will undergo major reforms. More progress & breakthroughs may come up in the mental/physical health treatments, medicines, cures, etc. (on the positive side). A collective shift towards community healing, generational health, support and aid may become a focus. Environmentalism can also become a focus of discussion where now more people may find creative and reliable solutions to existing problems, this can also extend to the protection & conservation of natural reservoirs, wildlife, sanctuaries, etc. 


There may be crises in religious & spiritual doctrines, where corruption or other oppressive/regressive issues may come to the forefront. Notorious cult-like activities, practices, or even extremist fandoms may see major downfalls & even investigations. Spirituality (even celebrity worship culture) as a whole can become a polarized topic. Through all that there will be a big shift in consciousness towards spirituality, either through religion or personal revelations, focus will be in finding one’s purpose, spiritual calling, true sense of peace & tranquility. Many may experience the harshness of the ego death and delve into the depths of shadow work while others may complete their previous healing journeys and come out of this transit with a renewed sense of self, soul, and purpose.     

               

This period can be a particularly tumultuous time since collectively there will be a lot of polarizing yet contrasting issues surfacing and fading away simultaneously. This Saturn transit can prove to be an emotionally & mentally taxing one, since we will be preparing to enter into a brand-new astrological cycle after all. So, it's only natural to expect that Saturn will provoke us to take our true purpose and soul journey here more seriously rather than getting lost in the nebulous clouds of Pisces so easily. Expect change, restructuring, reforms, downfalls & upsurges, oppressions & liberations, and such themes cycling in and out throughout this transit.

entry.title: Cancer Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

Your week will be a bit more dramatic than you are comfortable with, Cancer. With your main focus on health and financial stability, you might notice some minor frustrations building up in your personal life. Your loved ones may feel a little distant to you, and vice-versa, but you also seem to be working on important goals that you are committed to. Your personal relationships are currently going through intense transformations which may be reflecting back at your own needs and desires. Your goals, ambitions & aspirations may be under review due to the changes that are taking place in your family life. 



Your preferences, life-style choices and comfort zones will continue to change drastically throughout the week. Your finances seem to be stable, since you are paying more attention to gain a good balance in your saving & spending habits. You might be guided intuitively to make some readjustments in money matters to establish a more secure foundation monetarily. You might even be researching & planning on making major investments or purchases. Although, it is advised to be extra careful and to only take well-calculated risks at this time. This week can feel a bit lonely in terms of interactions with friends & loved ones, especially if there have been misunderstandings or disturbances in your relationships. 


You should be able to work things out with them by the end of the week, so things are likely to settle down slowly but surely. Delays in travel plans may be expected. You might also have disagreements with elders or authority figures that can test your patience. So, it might be best to avoid arguments this week, since others can easily misunderstand you. Also, be careful with how you word your feelings, since others may be quick to interpret you to be rude or mean even if you didn’t intend to. You have a lot of clarity on the direction and purpose of your life which after a long time must have made you feel inspired again. Your inner strength seems to be revitalized by the restoration of faith. This fresh optimism can help you face your fears & insecurities head on.

entry.title: Lunar Eclipse + Full Moon in Virgo 12° 🌑♒️ Mar 3, 2026
entry.content:
💫 The end of massive cycles & chapters in your life that feel liberating & inspiring.


💫 Clarity over long held beliefs and even accepted falsehoods. Breaking the chains of delusions both within and around you.


💫  A vision for the future, a brand new one that aligns with both your worldly and spiritual goals. 


💫 Honor your good honest hard-work and stand in your Spiritual Sovereignty.


💫 (If you can make the time, please) Rest and relax for the day. Seek nature, silence and comfort. Mindfulness & Meditation can help you re-center yourself around this time.


💫 As Mars in Aquarius ♒️ Squares Uranus in Taurus ♉️ (that majorly hints at the Geo-political instabilities & concerning issues), it’s best to practice patience and exercise silence in certain volatile situations. Since things can easily get worse and get out of control. Hence, Try your best to avoid arguments & such conflicts. 


💫 Tap into your Inner Peace and Love, the deep Compassion that wants the best for everyone. Don’t forget to include yourself, as Love, Trust & Compassion for yourself will be vital (especially) now.


💫 (Likewise) Re-evaluate your relationships and possibly cut ties with people who expect you to give selflessly without reciprocating. 


💫 Opportunities to end karmic cycles & bonds in the next few months can help you simultaneously open New Divinely Inspired chapters & connections. 


💫 Avoid confusion, anxiety & overthinking especially about matters of the past as you will soon receive revelations to resolve dire issues. 


💫 Pause. Take a well-deserved break. Re-plan. Re-Align. 


💫 The Lunar Eclipse although chaotic in many ways will lead to significant changes, as we are approaching a turning point in our journey, on the brink of a massive spiritual transformation & elevation (both on a personal level & collectively).


💫 Faith. Hope. Peace. Prosperity. 


Many hugs, Much luv.

xo 💕

entry.title: Capricorn Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | August 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes August 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces


Aug 1 - 6, 2023

You have gone through major upgrades on a personal level Capricorn. Perhaps you are still reviewing the past few years of craziness that you have successfully overcome. The lessons and experiences are changing the way you look at life, your concept of goals, ambitions & success. Your commitment to duties is always immaculate Capricorn. You are fierce about both your personal and professional responsibilities. Reevaluating your share of responsibilities must be in the forefront of late, making you question your past efforts and future role in these relationships (both in career & family). You might also have been a little too hard on yourself about certain decisions that you took in the past. 



You might have taken risks that are making you rethink the opportunities that you have right now. So, even though you might be eager to dive into projects or investments that are in front of you, you might have to step back and thoroughly understand what they entail. If you are experiencing delays or rejections in certain areas, you might have to face your frustrations with maturity and be patient just a little while longer Capricorn. You will be able to make the best use of these opportunities in time. So, if you are to come across sudden turn of events that bring wonderful opportunities your way, you will be able to reorganize your thoughts, or perhaps even get into a positive mindset before you embark on those new adventures. Since, you know well Capricorn, you have been wishing and looking for a breakthrough, and you just might encounter it soon enough (if not already). 


You are gaining a whole new perspective on your life, so with major shifts in your mindset, you are also manifesting shifts in your circumstances. You are facing your fears of failure/success head on as a result too. There might be a sudden break in a contract (or even a relationship) that might have started to become toxic lately. This might come as a shock to you, or you might have been anticipating a chance to break free for a while now Capricorn, and the beginning of this week might just be the time for it. Your self-worth & expectations in relationships (commitments in general) are evolving quickly due to the recent shifts in mindset & priorities. You know what your needs, wants & desires are and you are fiercely protecting your boundaries now. So, feel proud of yourself sweet Capricorn, soon you can expect to see many karmic rewards on the horizon.

entry.title: Sun Opposition Saturn 16° + Jupiter T-Square • Sept 8, 2024 ✨
entry.content:
Background Image by Angela (via. pexels.com)

Clear tension with your practical life with that of your inner-world. There may be extreme mental/physical health issues suddenly becoming more apparent. There may even be issues with finances. This T-Square with Jupiter in particular can highlight loses & deceitful behavior (your own or someone else’s), making things a little too unstable in your finances. Or, there may be stressful schedules & even realizations of toxic work culture that can lead to burnout & a possible outburst. 


On that note, make sure you are not pushing yourself to catch up with the busyness of life, even if you have noticed recently that you may have a few tasks unmarked on the to-do-list which have pilled up over time. Try your best to take things one step at a time, lest this enthusiasm (kind of also driven by guilt of not being super productive lately) can easily leave you exhausted and everything else exacerbated.


This specific Opposition with Sun & Saturn can bring disputes within career & community, possibly even people close to you who have treated you unfairly. Highly critical & even toxic/coercive behaviors can become apparent. Sun Opposition Saturn always brings up the question of “Will you stand up for yourself?”. Ego issues can become obvious. Trouble with Elders & Authority Figures. 



Jupiter in the mix actually lightens things up, especially for the reasons that serious issues now may need an open mind to resolve. With Jupiter, perhaps a much bigger & wiser approach to any situation bothering you right now will become the key. The fear of imperfection can give rise to not trusting your own capabilities.


If you have been stressed, anxious & overwhelmed recently (which I doubt any of us aren’t 🫂🥹), you could be challenged to reprogram/relearn ‘how to ground yourself’ and ‘how to find balance in your life (personal, spiritual & professional)’. 


A stressful week or so, yet a fulfilling one with how much we can overcome in terms of our own mindset & handling others a lil more tactfully. There will be a lot of self-accountability throughout this month (Virgo Season + Eclipse in Virgo & Pisces axis). Yet, try not to be too self-critical. 


This can slip into your outside world where you will be likely to call people out for their irresponsible behavior, so I hope Venus & Juno in Libra will help us with good diplomacy. Take care of your health, & soak in some Sunlight every now & then to relax and recharge. 😘

entry.content:
CSS-Only Animated Accordion

Overview

This CodePen demonstrates how we can animate the opening and closing states of an accordion with fancy reveal animation using only CSS. This concept is suitable for creating FAQ sections, Table of Contents, and more.

How does it work?

We cannot transition height or any CSS property from zero to auto. If we want to smoothly expand a collapsed accordion, we could set a max-height and transition the height property to a large value when we expand the section. However, it may not properly work if the content is larger than the max-height.

So, here we create a CSS grid with a grid item. Then we transition the grid-template-rows property from 0fr to 1fr and the grid item transitions to its content height.

I used CSS clip-path and mix-blend-mode to animate the background and text color of the accordion. Each accordion has two pseudo-elements. We know that opacity, clip-path and, visibility are animatable CSS properties. So when the accordion is selected using the :target pseudo-class, we transition the clip-path circle radius to 200% of the ::before pseudo-element. When the accordion is not selected, we do the same with the ::after but this time with a delay. This creates an illusion as it appears to clip from inside.

Since the accordion's title is an anchor element, users can also navigate through the items with their keyboard.

Inspiration

In a recent video, Kevin showed us a way to animate height from zero to auto value. Seeing that, I couldn't resist experimenting with the idea. Then I came up with this CSS-only accordion component and added the reveal animation too!

I would highly recommend watching his video, where he beautifully explains the technique and points out how he discovered it. Also, read Keith J. Grant's post and Nelson Menezes's post on the same topic.

entry.title: Natal Mercury and Midheaven MC Aspects 🥝✨
entry.content:
Mercury Square Midheaven MC

□ Your intellect is your biggest asset and the occasional cause of your public downfall. 

□ Your career/public life greatly benefits from your active communication.

□ You may be impulsive yet curious, distracted yet informative. 

□ There is however a tendency to speak before proofreading the facts which will be criticized by others often.

□ You are amazing at learning new and interesting subjects which will help you in intellectual settings.

□ There may be many issues from the past that affect your view of future & the way you approach your career path.

□ You might be torn between many career prospects before choosing “one” (or changing to another later on), usually these choices are affected by your past experiences and future expectations. 

□ It is however advised not to take on more work than necessary since there may be a tendency to get bored/distracted easily which may land you in trouble professionally. 

□ If Mercury is Conjunct Ascendant/Descendant, it is advised not to be impulsive while making important decisions and to be conscious about how you present your words so as not to cause any misunderstandings or offence. 

□ Over-active imagination and curiosity, or lack of excitement in life may lead to depression and/or other mental health issues which may need a change in routines/perspective/meditations etc.

□ You may frequently face delays or problems relating to long distance travels.

□ Your career/public life will be immensely rewarding only when you pay attention to the facts and speak with the utmost confidence. 


Mercury Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC)

☍ You are Playful, intellectual, and Active.

☍ You might have had a colorful childhood and family life.

☍ Your ideologies may have been greatly influenced by one of your parents during your childhood.

☍ The same might apply for being encouraged to improve your talents.

☍ You are the kind of person who doesn’t take anything at face-value and would rather question everything before coming to a set-conclusion.

☍ You can easily express your emotions through words, which gives you an endearing personality.

☍ You might also be quite popular/well known in your hometown/community/family/country.

☍ You make an amazing motivational speaker since you are always in-touch with your emotions, and you learn from your past experiences.

☍ Although you must be careful since sometimes you can easily slip into holding grudges or not letting go of the past playing like a broken record.

☍ Your career can easily thrive due to your friendly and intellectual personality. 



Mercury Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ There may be a tendency to doubt/reject one’s own intellectual importance while in the public’s view (or vice versa, of feeling intellectually rejected/doubted by others) with this aspect.

^ Since childhood, you might have grown up learning from elders how important career life is, which could have both excited you & created many insecurities about the future. 

^ You might eventually develop a strong fearful attitude towards your career path, especially in your late teens & early 20s.

^ You might have many Mercurial talents that can easily propel you in your career.

^ You will need to have more confidence in yourself and your purpose in life, no matter how anxious & deterred you may feel.

^ Occasional problems in expressing yourself in public settings, with a few scenarios of negative responses, however, that shouldn’t be a reason to recluse but to take these experiences as learning lessons and move forward.

^ You have a lot to offer, and so you will have to muster up the courage to face the world, stepping out of your comfort zone once in a while will help you grow your inner child.


Mercury Sextile Midheaven MC

✱ Your public life is greatly influenced by your intellectual talents, where you might be well-celebrated.

✱ Learning new skills and applying it to your career endeavors will always bring you many rewards.

✱ This aspect gives you a clear view of your professional purpose in life, even when/if you choose to change careers, you usually have a good plan going forward.

✱ You’re diligent, well-respected, curious, and worldly.

✱ You make an excellent motivational/public speaker.

✱ However there’s always a tendency to be extra cautious while communicating in public.

✱ Being transparent with your intentions will work in your favor without raising much suspicion. 

✱ You might enjoy popularity in your career life, with many helpful and influential people.

✱ Followed by a good professional/public standing.

✱ A lot of people may look up to you for how you can easily blend-in & mingle with all groups of people.



Mercury Trine Midheaven MC

△ Learning new skills and staying informed about the current-world situations can become one of your strong suits while communicating in professional settings, making it easier for others to appreciate your intellectual capacity.

△ This aspect helps you to handle one task at a time without letting your focus scatter. 

△ Your ability to speak with clear intentions always allows you to impress many in your professional field.

△ Popularity comes to you without trying. Ever since childhood, you could have been well-known and sought out for your many (or particular) talents/skills which give you an edge in your later years.

△ Supportive people in positions of power would love to have you by their side, for your significant influence on the public.

△ Many people, young and old alike admire you for your free-thinking and flexible personality.

△ Elders & other experienced people, especially may help you in your career endeavors and guide you through most part of it.

△ You’re Diligent and passionate, you have a keen interest in learning something new and adapting those skills effectively in your career.

△ It is important that you keep yourself busy intellectually, like indulging in hobbies and things that connect well with your inner child, since any sense of boredom can affect your professional performance.

△ You likely will enjoy a high position in society if not working for influential people, either way, with a considerable amount of respect and power.


Mercury Conjunct Midheaven MC 

☌ This aspect gives the person a relatively greater sense of power and resources to improve oneself, a highly captivating mental & intellectual capacity.

☌ But also, there is a greater chance of being unclear about what paths to take in life, and how to fulfil one’s purpose.

☌ You can easily involve yourself in a myriad of tasks/projects & professions (even) all at the same time, without losing the focus and precision in your work.

☌ You’re a true intellectual, an excellent communicator, especially in public settings and on-the-spot situations, you know exactly how to convey your intentions and influence different sets of crowds with ease.

☌ Boredom is however your greatest enemy, and with other aspects (like other Uranus/Neptune aspects somewhere in the chart), can lead to feelings of restlessness which may be a detriment to your mental health. 

☌ You have an insatiable appetite for learning new things, experiences & skills and career advancement(s) happen on its own.

☌ You’re Influential and so can attain a high status in society.

☌ Professional freedom is extremely important to you, since you would rather prefer to experiment with many different ideas before settling for one or few or none at all and carry on with multiple career-titles all at the same time.

☌ You can effortlessly assess a crowd and understand the situations without much context, your keen sense of self & surroundings will always help you win over any challenges.

☌ Most people may see you as lively yet cautious, child-like yet responsible. It’s hard for many to not admire your loveable personality but also be curious as to what your next move would be since you seem to have many unique interests.

☌ It is advised to take as long as you may need while completing intellectual studies (of your own interest/s), and see them through till the end, the main reason you may decide to abandon many of those researches/studies could be because you seem to think that you don’t have the time/patience to pursue further, so you may have to learn how to not let that Mercurial impulsiveness get the better of you. 

☌ There may also be a problem of being too intellectual and not much of a feeler (not calling you insensitive of course, although you sometimes come off as a little too cold and practical which may cause misunderstandings in the public’s view), hence exercising healthy self-expression will add a lot more color to your personality.

☌ This is something not many people talk about, but there may be a few disappointing situations with your family/parents who may have doubted/opposed your career choices/attitude towards professional life, with often different expectations from you (especially heightened if there are other placements/aspects that indicate the same).

entry.title: Part of Fortune in Astrology 🗝️🍀💰✨
entry.content:
Part of Fortune is one of the Ancient Astrological methods that has endured through the ages, invoking perhaps even more fascination in the Modern Astrological Era. Part of Fortune, or even known as Fortuna, Pars Fortuna & Lot of Fortune: is an Astrological Point in the Natal (& of course other types of) Chart that represents our Innate ability to attain Worldly Success, Abundance & Prosperity. Indicating one’s Natural Talents, Good Luck & Gifts, this Calculated Point has the symbol that looks like an ‘x’ inside a circle 「 ⨂ 」


Part of Fortune (PoF) is one of the many Arabic Parts & Hermetic Lots, dating back to its use since 1BC (perhaps much older). Although most famously associated with Arabic Parts (align with 500+ such similar Parts); Lot of Fortune, Lot of Spirit, Lot of Eros, Lot of Victory, … are also some of the Lots of Hermetic (7 in Total, we can dive deeper into them one by one soon enough ;). In general, these are points in our Chart, calculated with Ascendant, Sun & Moon (along with other planets like Venus, Jupiter, etc.). PoF in particular is calculated with one’s Ascendant, Sun & Moon degrees. The exact Time of Birth becomes crucial, since degrees of these placements along with day or night time of birth becomes important for accuracy. 


Astroseek has a quick and easy way to calculate Lot of Fortune using the correct Formulas (along with the calculator for other Lots). (Although not an ad, I absolutely luv this website for its versatility & accuracy ❤︎)


Here is a bit of Math & Geometry if you would like to learn how to calculate the traditional way.

Traditionally there are two Formulas to calculate Part of Fortune, one for the Day Chart and other for the Night Chart. If your Sun Placement lies on the top of the Natal Chart (i.e., from 7th House to 12th House), then you have a Day Chart.

Part of Fortune = Ascendant + Moon - Sun 


If your Sun Placement is in the bottom of your Natal Chart (i.e., from 1st House to 6th House), then you have a Night Chart.

Part of Fortune = Ascendant + Sun - Moon


Now the degree of each Placement will need to be converted in order to equate them to 360° of a circle (Chart). 

Simplest way to do that is to divide every house and equate them to the degrees of a circle, 360° / 12 = 30° each. Here’s a chart for easy reference. 

Now, let’s learn to calculate PoF from an example,

Pisces ♓️ Ascendant 16° 04’ 

Converting : Pisces ♓️ starts at 330°, so Ascendant is at 330° + 16° 04’ = 346° 04’

Sagittarius ♐️ Sun 14° 57’ 

Converting : Sagittarius ♐️ starts at 240°, so Sun is at 240° + 14° 57’ = 254° 57’

Leo ♌️ Moon 4° 02’

Converting : Leo ♌️ starts at 120°, so Moon is at 120° + 4° 02’ = 124° 02’


Let’s assume that this is a Day Chart,

Then,

Part of Fortune = Ascendant + Moon - Sun

PoF = 346° 04’ + 254° 57’ - 124° 02’ = 215° 09’ = 5° 09’ + 210° 

where, 210° is at the start of Scorpio, so 

Part of Fortune here is in Scorpio 5° 09’ (which lies in the 8th House of the respective Chart)


Interpreting Part of Fortune is much like any other placement in the chart.

  1. Sign + House will show you the Key to your Abundance and Success in life. 
  2. Conjunction to PoF is often more significant, likewise Opposition also becomes an important Major Aspect.
  3. Sextile, Trine & Square to PoF take the next precedence.
  4. Degrees reveal extra details about the Archetypical energy that most suits your PoF.


The Sign of PoF shows how best to access your Fortune & Innate Potential. Embodying the energy & archetype of your PoF’s Sign will help you to naturally harness your Inherent Gifts. The House of PoF shows which Themes & Areas of Life present the most Opportune Chances and bring Good Luck to you. Following PoF is much like taking a HighWay to your Ambitious Dreams and making them a Reality. However here, you will have to tap into a hidden Wealth of Knowledge, Wisdom & Virtue in order to make the best use of your own Inner Potential & Talents. 


Since this Point in your Chart is derived from your Sun, Moon & Ascendant, your PoF also becomes a very simple yet Powerful way to harness the Energy of your ‘Big Three’ in a ‘concentrated’ way, i.e., through the combination of One Sign + House. This indeed can cut through the tension created by any harsh aspect between your Sun, Moon & Ascendant, as even Sun Square/Opposite Moon, or Moon Square/Opposite Ascendant and so on can often create Inner Frustrations as to how to balance these very important aspects in your chart individually. By focusing on your PoF, you can easily diffuse the complexity of such harsh aspects between the three most significant placements in your Chart. 


Hence, PoF becomes a Karmic Pass to both your Abundance and your Inner Stability. You can almost simultaneously balance your Emotional Needs (Moon) & Inner Ambitions (Sun), effortlessly turning them into a part of your Life’s Focus (Rising). Part of Fortune is also where you can find Contentment & Joy, where Happiness naturally manifests. So, the Sign + House of PoF can represent the themes of Life where you can find Pleasure, Comfort & Serenity (similar to Lot of Spirit). This is also where you can naturally share wonderful things with those you love & cherish, so Gifts, Celebrations, Donations & Charity relating to your PoF placement can bring both Spiritual & Emotional Gratification.


Part of Fortune is one of the most potent Placements in your chart, accessing which can naturally open the Doors of Opportunity & Prosperity. Good Luck and Good Karma are often connected to PoF. This critical Point in the chart is especially activated through Transits, importantly when Sun, Venus, Jupiter & Saturn make close contact with the PoF. Venus & Jupiter being the Natural Benefics can especially bring Unimaginable Wonders into your life, both when in Aspects to your Natal PoF and during Transits making contact to Natal PoF. 


When consciously activated PoF is a Persona, View Point & Mindset that you can easily embody to Unlock everything that you wish to Achieve, Gain and Prosper in your Life (especially Materially). A Pot of Gold in the Chart from where Wealth, Prosperity, Abundance & Achievements naturally overflow into your World. 


In this Part of Fortune series, we will explore the Mystical Key that can unlock Extraordinary Manifestations through Part of Fortune’s placement in the Natal Chart: Sign + House + Degree of the PoF, along with the Aspects made to significant Placements. (These Interpretations can similarly apply to most other charts as well.)

entry.title: Major Aspects in Astrology 🍇✨
entry.content:
(Conjunctions + Oppositions + Squares + Sextiles + Trines)

Astrological charts in general (especially Tropical) are made of 12 signs occupying 30 degs of a circle covering 360 degs. Each planet, asteroid, other calculation point occupies their places within this circle. Aspects are defined as angles that the planets, asteroids, or calculation points make to one another. 


Throughout the history of Astrology, there have been many different references and ideologies used in determining and interpreting Aspects, over time, main aspects are categorized into Major and Minor Aspects. While calculating aspects, an important thing one would consider/notice are orbs, being the degrees to which the given angle between said astrological points are close to the exact angle. Orbs are significant due to the elliptic nature of planets, asteroids, etc. So, each Aspect has its own degs of Orbs within which it is calculated with relevance. 


Conjunction, Square, Opposition, Trine and Sextile are Major Aspects, while Inconjunct (Quincunx), Semi sextile, Quintile, Biquintile, Sesquiquadrate, Semisquare, Semi quintile and Sesquiquintile are Minor Aspects.


Conjunction

Angle: 0 deg, Orb: up to 8 or 10 degs.

The Conjunction is extremely significant in one’s chart since this aspect merges two said-astrological points into perfect synergy. Hence, it is a powerful aspect to consider. Depending on the planets, asteroids or other calculation points involved, the synergy may work in numerous ways, where it can speak of utilizing those energies for better or for worse, and so every conjunction is not the same. This is also one of the aspects that one can easily feel in the chart, gaining more prominence in imparting character to it. 


Conjunctions to Sun, Moon, Ascendant, Midheaven and Lunar Nodes are especially significant, since they directly reflect on our direction in life, emotional depth, personality, ambitions, soul-purpose, etc. This aspect can help you merge different energies of planets, signs and houses efficiently. Extremist tendencies can naturally arise in this aspect sometimes and so moderation will be a lesson and necessary skill that one learns through this aspect.   


Square

Angle: 90 deg, Orbs: up to 4 or 10 degs.

Squares create tensions and usually the points involved are in angular houses and/or signs of the same mode (e.g., 1H & 4H, Aries & Cancer, etc.). The conflicts and confrontations that this aspect seems to create can cause a lot of instability, frustrations and general lack of co-operation between the said points involved. 


Sometimes, there can also be internal struggles between two different principles, decisions or circumstances yet they seem to have similar solutions or perspectives. Squares can invoke a need for patience and discretion, wherein one tries to choose which way is better and how to approach something with the least amount of conflict since ego will only keep things stuck. This aspect can make one stronger in character and conviction, giving the necessary motivation & tools through circumstance and/or chaos. 


Opposition

Angle: 180 deg, Orb: up to 4-10 degs.

Oppositions generally happen on the same axes lines wherein said points are usually in complementary houses & signs (e.g., Leo & Aquarius are Complementary or Opposite Signs, likewise 4H & 10H are opposing houses). The planets or points involves can either cause tension or a strong desire to unite the themes of the houses & signs. There may be starkly different approaches to a certain situation or topic and hence this can cause confusions and frustrations; likewise, there may be extremely similar views that need immense amount of focus and effort to make things work, so this aspect usually creates a sense of struggle and restriction in the areas of the signs & houses involved. 


Sometimes a compromise between said points can be immensely beneficial to harness the true potential of this aspect. This aspect also helps one to understand the importance of balance since not everything needs to be a struggle nor a sacrifice, the goal involved is still the same, the most viable approach at the time will suffice, and alternating between the two will quell the tension. Hence, this aspect improves maturity and understanding.


Trine 

Angle: 120 deg, Orb: up to 4-10 degs.

This aspect is said to be the most pleasant of all Major aspects since it inherently allows the points involved to work together in harmony and hence can blend their energies without overpowering or underestimate each other (usually in the same elements, e.g., between Fire signs and houses, Earth signs & houses, etc.). This aspect is an integral part of the chart imparting its characteristics significantly. There is a need to let things naturally take their form with this aspect so that there is no resistance, tension or extra effort needed, although this can turn into complacency overtime leading to lethargy or inadequate use of potential. 


This is one of the reasons why active involvement of the points in their houses & signs become such an important developmental exercise. This aspect also allows one to access their inherent talents, skills or gifts and develop them over time through effort and intention, so one can tap into many forms of abundance with this aspect relating to the planets, points, signs & houses involved. Hence, this aspect can teach one how to be aware of both the blessings and dangers involved without losing sight of the goal through consistent effort.


Sextile

Angle: 60 deg, Orb: up to 2-4 deg

This aspect is easy going and intentional in nature. It usually involves points in compatible houses and signs, hence the synergy of these points create a positive flow of energies. In this aspect, the themes of the planets’ houses & signs seem to support each other hence there is little to no resistance experienced. This creates a sort of hand-in-hand forward movement and also provides immense inspiration to keep moving further ahead. 


This aspect can also help one create opportunities through consistent efforts. It also allows one to utilize the potential of the points involved in positive & simplistic ways. This aspect will help to keep the momentum alive in any goal, situation or theme since there will always be consistent focus effortlessly directed towards them, so the motivation never dies out. Hence, this aspect allows the smooth flow of energies and usually goes unnoticed in day-to-day activities yet stays significant as an integral part of the chart.

entry.title: Leo Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | August 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes August 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

Aug 1 - 6, 2023

A positively productive week awaits you, Leo. Lately you are busy and you love it. You have all the energy & motivation to pursue your ambitions. You are locked in on your plans, surprisingly patient and methodical, which is allowing you to make the best decisions without leaving room for mistakes. But, you are also deeply aware of your previous mistakes and the kind of regrets that you would rather not wish to face again. So, your cautiousness may seem as cool and calculated to others but deep down, you are terrified of repeating mistakes. This inner tension is working in your favor, so as long as you are not letting your fears to stop you or negatively affect your confidence, you are golden Leo. 



You are also going through a glow up with Leo Season absolutely lighting up your self-confidence. You are likely reinventing your belief systems and making adjustments to your mindset to better adapt to all the newness in your life. This can bring up unpleasant memories from the past, with disappointments in relationships and how they affected you. Stay as emotionally balanced as possible when dealing with your past this week, Leo, even if they are just memories. If you come across people or situations from the past that you had bad experiences with, you will have the opportunity to face those fears and insecurities to release them once & for all. 


If you are currently wrapping up projects or at the tail end of important contracts, you can expect to feel momentarily anxious over what the future might have in store for you. With many changes happening in your career life, it is wise not to gamble on your reputation in any way at this time, so if you are dealing with internal confusions or emotional distress, it is best to take time for self-care and focus on your mental health. You are more optimistic now than ever Leo with a mix of emotional turmoil that you will have to find balance in. This week will hence be one of those times where you will have to use your Leo Magnetism on yourself to stay mesmerized in your own self-confidence and conquer your goals.
