entry.title: Eris in Aries & Partial Lunar Eclipse in Taurus | The Darkest Hour before the break of a New Dawn, Oct 28 2023 ❣️✨
entry.content:
The Partial Lunar Eclipse in Taurus is probably the most significant and powerful eclipse that we have witnessed in recent times. :( I think it would be better not to focus this post on the current global events. It’s easier to see how this astrological climate is affecting our personal lives and to understand the nuances of the Transits’ effects on us. Since on a larger scale, the details get convoluted and denser to interpret). Focusing on this eclipse, we can see Sun, Mercury & Mars in Scorpio, opposite Jupiter in Taurus, along with Taurus Moon’s Opposition to Sun marking the beginning of the eclipse. Pluto is also a key player, as with the recent eclipses, along with the main star of the show … Eris. The dwarf planet Eris (currently retrograde) takes the centre-stage along with it’s tight Conjunction to the North Node in Aries (both at 24º). 


Eris, is a dwarf planet who is associated in astrology with conflicts, chaos, ego & power struggles, anger & aggression. Since in mythology, Eris is the sister of Mars, who are both associated with War, Passion, and aggression, but Eris usually takes things up a notch. In the stories, she is often seen as an instigator of conflicts, divisions & power-struggles which often leads to disastrous outcomes. With Eris currently Rx in Aries also conjunct the North Node, we can expect conflicts, anger, ego & power hungry behaviors to escalate, causing destruction. There is a level of danger to how much we associate our identity with our ego, and Eris represents that very well. Eris in Aries transit in and of itself can bring out the worst in all of us when we are acting out of pure fear, confusion, misunderstanding & the need to protect our ego at all cost, the price however being too high, unfortunately almost all the time. 



This eclipse hence has the highest potential to bring out the worst in us, hence on a very personal level, we are likely to see those around us acting way out of character. If you have noticed a sudden shift in other’s attitude, behavior and even their manner of speaking, you might have felt a need to be cautious around them, almost as a subconscious survival mechanism. There may have be those around you (even those) that you have known for a significant amount of time suddenly behaving: uncharacteristically rudely, almost apathetic, ‘extremely’ hyper-critical, cynical, etc. to the point where it’s concerning. It’s very likely that Eris Conjunct North Node, Square Pluto (in Capricorn) is the reason why. 


Mars, Mercury & Sun in Scorpio being in Opposition with Jupiter in Taurus is hard enough to handle, and we now have Eris Conjunct North Node along with a Full Moon in Taurus leading to a Partial Lunar Eclipse, that’s certainly a recipe for heartbreak & disaster 😖!!! There may have been conflicts and ego-struggles with your loved one in particular that feel so exhausting. A sudden shift in relationship dynamics, where everything seemed fine a few moments ago and now the connections are hanging in the balance. There seems to be a serious & severe urge to move forward in life with regards to goals & ambitions, that can provoke us all into taking risks, making sudden moves, changing things out of the blue, often without much forethought. Even if you are not initiating such moves, there is likely someone you are connected to who is, and that can bring conflicts into your life.



There is also a general theme of empaths & those with relatively peaceful demeanors being targeted due to their character. Under this astrological sky, those currently struggling with a deeper sense of insecurity & fear based-mindset are likely experiencing huge triggers and their ego seems to be taking all the hits. If their confidence is crushed, or if they sense a threat to their ego, they are likely to become aggressively defensive at this time. (And I mean this in the kindest way possible, since we are going through harsh times. Although I don’t condone anybody’s rude behavior, we are at-least able to understand what’s triggering them). So, if you are an Empathetic person, and you are displaying any form of compassion or love, with no judgements or ego-based reactions, you are likely at risk of becoming a target, gaslit or being called naive, etc. :( at worst, a scapegoat). 


I know, and I understand how daunting & uneasy it sounds, but this is just the kind of times we are in, at-least until the year ends and we step into 2024 (when Eris & North Node are out of Conjunction), we will have to be a little too careful with how we handle tense situations, especially those that have a strong element of ego & power struggle. Since, such confrontations can either trigger our own insecurities & make us more vulnerable, or they can provoke us into defending ourselves fiercely. Eris, although an extremely rebellious & ego driven archetype, still represents “a necessary evil” in astrology. She often plays “the devil’s advocate” to bring out all the buried resentment & anger to help us understand our core wounds better. 



We might feel as if we are in survival mode, where we will have to defend ourselves and take matters into our own hands. Rationalizing & diplomacy don’t seem effective enough (South Node in Libra Square Pluto). There is an urge to take control over our lives, which is a positive manifestation of Eris in Aries, where we learn to harness our inner-strength and push through uncertain times, hence creating unimaginable breakthroughs in our life’s (especially over time). But, that can also make us vulnerable to our insecurities, to live life in paranoia, always anticipating an attack, an ultra-independent drive where we become too self-focused & self-reliant. This can even trickle down into our relationships, where we obsess over security & loyalty, misunderstandings even unwarranted accusations & conflicts become rampant.


So, you will likely see someone/people being atypically entitled of you & your love/loyalty, or they seem extra possessive & protective of you. This can also generally be out of resentment or repressed anger. There may be a hyper-fixation and self-righteousness issue in general. So, with the very last Taurus-Scorpio Lunar Node Eclipse of the season, this will be a good time to assess and determine which relationships are worth of your time, affection & energy, while which ones are no longer serving your highest good. With Neptune still in Retrograde (along with Saturn in Pisces also in retrograde), it is wise to take your time while analyzing your connections. But, since Eclipses usually affect us for about 6 months, we will see these themes play out in our lives for quite sometimes. Until we get to a common ground, we will have to protect our inner peace & compassion by standing up for ourselves when someone disrespects us or tries to pull us into an unnecessary ego-struggle. Since, whoever is dealing with their own shadow needs to battle their insecurities by themselves.



Hence, if you feel that certain connections (that are deeply affected by these Transits) are full of love, with the people who are truly & genuinely compassionate, who have a special bond of shared values, etc., although challenging, you will be able to move through this phase of your relationships successfully. You will be able to gain a better understanding into both of your inner wounds and hence the required healing, so the love grows stronger over time. Whereas, if you have always suspected someone/people to have such red flags, this might be the best time to release those ties. As I mentioned, again, although I don’t condone anybody’s bad behavior, we will just have to navigate through this time with our compassion, love & inner peace intact to the best of our ability. 


So, this period in time, we will be able to understand our own triggers much better. There won’t be room for denials or self-pity either. Since, regardless of if we are the ones embodying Eris’s blunt energy or someone else we are dealing with is, everybody involved will have to take responsibility for our own actions. Saturn is in Pisces, and will come out of Retrograde on Nov 4, at 0º Pisces. So, there will be a time of rebalancing and recalibrating, where those who fell into Eris’s aggression will be able to slowly recover from that ego-driven trance, and fully realize their own intentions behind their actions (again, debatably so, depending on who we are dealing with and what we are dealing with). We are indeed in the Darkest hour, right before the break of a prosperous dawn. Let’s hope for this haze to clear up and bring about a fresh new start. ❣️

entry.title: Jupiter moves into Taurus, the Magnanimous Planet in the sign of Grace & Practicality | May 16, 2023 🌼✨
entry.content:
Jupiter, the planet of luck, expansion & knowledge embarks on a glorious journey in the sign of Taurus starting from May 16th, 2023, until May 25th, 2024. This mega transit is going to be incredible both in terms of our personal conscious expansion & our physical prosperity. With quite a few significant transit-contacts, this ride will be one to remember indeed. This can prove to be a time of relief but with a little bit of tension to bring things back together again. Jupiter Transit of the year will bring motivation & perseverance going forward, so, let’s get excited about a productive year ahead.


With Jupiter in Taurus, working smart and not hard becomes the natural tendency. But lethargy can lead to procrastination too quickly. There is a desperate need to rebuild stability which will be intensified by the Jupiter & Pluto Square on May 18th that will continue to stay active for quite some time. So, there can be a sense of an uphill battle towards regaining control over your monetary situation, which with the influence of both Pluto in Aquarius & Mars in Leo (since May 23rd, until early June) squaring Jupiter in Taurus will increase persistence but with a desperation to get things done. 


So, this particular T-Square (in Fixed Signs none-the-less) can prove to be a tad bit too overwhelming and all-imposing. Finding the right balance between proving your point and working towards a tangible solution will be a hard choice to make, since there can be ego & power struggles blocking the ability to see the bigger picture. A bit of patience will go a long way during this time, which is only the start of Jupiter Transit & Pluto Retrograde. There may be severe financial ups & downs during this period but the damage that the consequences can cause to the ego & inner peace will be the most important to acknowledge. 



Jupiter Conjuncts North Node in Taurus during the last week of May activating a cycle of expansion & prosperity. This Conjunction being one of the major highlights of this transit will bring a sense of purpose to take our earthly matters more seriously, adding a touch of optimism & spiritual gratitude to it. Jupiter in Taurus can further increase the prices on food commodities, daily necessities, housing, land, etc. So, as much as we’d like to enjoy Jupiter’s presence in the sign of luxurious & comfort, it can be hard to loosen the purse strings for the most part. This can create a positive outlook on our consumerism and in just the way we utilize our resources. 


With Saturn in Pisces Sextiling Jupiter for the early part the transit, there will be a conscious perspective-shift in the way we have been using, over-utilizing, misusing or under-utilizing things, especially those that are essential for our everyday life. So, sustainability will become a major focus, also with waste-management & how to prevent excess waste (which can put a smile on Pluto & ease the tension a bit). Even still, it is important not to give into complacency and lose track of the goal. Jupiter here can bring a deep inspiration to work hard, stay focused and pull through challenges, but the exhaustion after every win can set-in heavily as well.


This period will make us more prone to taking things a little easier every time we get the chance to do so; self-care, hobbies, some much needed R&R, vacations, enjoying art & entertainment, good food, happy moments with loved ones, etc. But it can also make us feel comfortable in the relative peaceful times, sometimes to the extreme, where we can become over-indulgent and carefree. So, any tendencies towards over-eating/drinking/spending will have to be carefully monitored. Focusing on moderation will be the key to true contentment. Connecting back to nature, practices that bring a sense of grounding, and consciously cultivating patience will bring spiritual contentment & physical relaxation.



Self-righteous behaviors and even domineering personality-types can easily get on our nerves, since now, our conscious-shift is happening in a more positive direction. This can apply to ultra-rich yet nauseatingly boastful extravagance without any regard to helping those in need, we are sure to get uncomfortable with such people/concepts. With Jupiter in one of the toughest signs, stubbornness can also become a problem, especially with a boost in our self-confidence, ego issues can flare up every now and then. So, humility and compassion will need conscious expression to make sure we are agreeing to disagree and choosing our battles wisely (especially during the last part of Oct 2023 when Jupiter Opposes Mars).


One of the biggest highlights of this transit is the Jupiter - Uranus Conjunction in April 2024 right before Jupiter moves out of Taurus. This, frankly, can be a shocking & surprising period where we can expect literally anything to happen. This transit in Taurus alone is bound to bring enormous changes in the monetary sectors of the society. Added with Uranus’s ingenuity & unpredictability, we can see some positive shifts toward more meaningful changes in financial structure & economy. Innovative ideas and out-of-the-box yet practical solutions can spring up that will have the potential to change everything we have ever known about money, sustainability and harmony. 



Overall, Jupiter in Taurus will bring a much-needed enthusiasm & optimism to reshape our monetary & material situations even through the chaotic events happening in our lives & in the outside world. Pluto in Aquarius & Uranus in Taurus are already bringing exciting yet overwhelming shifts in our perspective of how the economy & society need to handle obvious problems through injecting transformative chaos into the mix. Crises situations especially pertaining to resources, necessities, sustainability and general stability of the collective will continue to be put through several tests & challenges that will simultaneous dismantle old & outdated structures.


Jupiter in Taurus will hence bring us hope in an otherwise unrelenting period of transformation. Maintaining inner-harmony and balance will become key to our journey. Merging productivity with purposeful change will bring prosperity. Comfort, luxuries & adequate rest can become a necessary life-style change without giving into over-indulgence or perpetuating stagnancy. Slowly but steadily building/rebuilding a stronger & more reliable foundation is the only way to ensure its longevity. 


So, this Jupiter transit, it’s a wonderful time to make detailed plans for a beautiful future, with serenity, comfort and harmony; a great idea to invest more in improving money management skills, enrolling in financial education courses, or get curious about investment & savings; taking calculated risks, making confident decisions & smart changes, by paying attention to the bigger picture. May this Jupiter transit bring prosperity, harmony, love & peace, restoring our hope with miraculous opportunities leading towards our highest potential. 🥂 Here’s to a lucky and magnificent journey.

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Leo (5th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Leo (5th House)

You are humble but sometimes to your own detriment. Your kindness can be taken advantage of especially by people you consider your closest. You might even feel pressured to take the center-stage or responsibilities even when you secretly desire to be popular. You might take things too seriously and not allow your inner child to express itself fully. You might feel over-privileged in some areas of your life whereas feel lack in others, especially about simpler joys of life. You might have wounds from childhood where you felt you couldn’t spend much time with your parents or family due to unfortunate events or some other reasons. 


You might be carrying that trauma with you, feeling burdened. You might even feel the need to look happy on the outside just so your loved ones don’t feel upset sometimes, but this placement will make it harder for you to fake your emotions. You might be too generous and outgoing, but you also need your alone time to recharge. Even though you like the attention and admiration you receive, you can feel overwhelmed easily. You like to keep your romance private. But if you are prone to attention seeking behaviors, you might not mind overly displaying your affection to your partner(s) in public, may be even fake your relationships. This is one of the things to be mindful of with this Chiron placement. 


You might even refuse to carry yourself with honesty and integrity but instead play a role of a perfect person just to gain validation from others or fit in. You might feel inadequate in social settings, even when you have no reason to be so. You might be incredibly talented, but you can hide it out of fear of rejection. This self-sabotaging tendency might be the result of your upbringing where you might have lacked encouragement or been overly criticized. Standing up for yourself in the face of danger or opposition can also be a test of your inner strength with this placement. You might encounter people or situations where your integrity will be questioned and only your courage can prove your strength in character. 



You will have to be honest with yourself with this placement and build your personality around that truth. You will have to adapt a positive mindset every time you face rejections or criticism, since you will always have people who support and admire you. Your belief in yourself and your capabilities to succeed must be undeniable in order to heal certain past traumas. If some of those inner wounds were related to your childhood/upbringing, you will have to address them by re-parenting yourself and giving yourself the freedom to express your creative and quirky sides. You can embrace the spotlight unapologetically. 


This placement might also affect the way you see romance, since you might have issues with your partner(s) due to projection of your own insecurities or fears of abandonment, so you will need to be careful not to sabotage an otherwise promising relationship. Likewise, you will also need to be mindful of people who wish to be your friends/acquaintances/partners just so they can take advantage of your popularity or good graces, so drawing healthy boundaries in all kinds of relationships will be one of your lessons. You can heal yourself through your compassionate and graceful heart, you help and protect your loved ones fiercely. 


Your presence in others’ lives can have a positive impact, especially when you actively make an effort to stay optimistic. Your courage and brave personality can serve as an inspiration to others by the way you take the lead, own the lime-light or face oppositions. Your creative self-expression can heal your fears of inadequacy, where you can face your insecurities and gain more confidence in presenting your skills and talents to others and being recognized. Your ego is powerful, but you must not dial-down on your confidence just to please others, so you can unapologetically show case your talents and accomplishments while also staying humble.

entry.title: Serene Pisces Full Moon Lunar Eclipse 15° ☘️✨ Sept 7, 2025
entry.content:
On a Sublime September Full Moon, the Lunar Eclipse happens on the Axis of Pisces & Virgo, during which breaking from comfort and leaping into a Destined Path becomes inevitable. This Lunar Eclipse happens with Mercury in Virgo’s Opposition, Jupiter’s Trine and Saturn’s reentry into Pisces (Rx) making it potent with twists and turns, the kind that can change your entire world. 


You are likely to experience extreme Mood swings, but more importantly, you are likely to experience your feelings on a whole new level, intensified. You might not know how deep some emotions dwelled within yourself, some you might not have even realized until now. Emotions from your Childhood or even your Past Lives can resurface now, and wash over you like a giant wave. This hence will feel overwhelming yet comforting. 


As Lunar Eclipses often provide us with the necessary opportunities to close out Old Karmic Cycles, most memories & feelings that well up now will only wash over and linger just long enough for you to understand them, then to let them go. Hence with such an emotionally charged Eclipse, you can just as easily release Patterns & Cycles that have run their course. 


This is also true with regards to your Habits, Lifestyle choices & Mindsets that are not serving your Highest Good. You might feel the sudden urge to change some of these things in order to get more focused, healthy, organized, productive, motivated &/or simply happy. Anything that may have restricted you from achieving: your Goals, doing the right thing for yourself or being your True Self will now come under re-evaluation. So, this is the Perfect Time to quit certain unhealthy habits, change your routines and reflect on your mindset, especially if you have been feeling the urge to do so in the recent months.


This Eclipse will bring dramatic shifts in your life in both subtle & bold ways. Since Lunar Eclipses are notorious for amorphous endings, you will find it can affect the key areas of your life in one way or another. But rest assured, these changes & endings will lead to wonderful New Beginnings, especially those that are aligned to your True Purpose as the Eclipse is taking place on the North Node of Pisces. Faith and Hope will be your best friends during this time indeed. This will also subtly force you to reset your Mindset and Thought-Processes, especially those that may be too limiting. Envision & Dream your future with an Open-Mind, devoid of distractions & Self-limiting beliefs. Cut through the noise, embrace silence and listen to your Soul. 


Although, it is also important not to get too carried away with this energy as time can feel a little too fluid during this month (at least the beginning of September). You might feel the need to rest more than usual, listen to your body’s rhythm and give yourself time for some relaxation. Day dreaming & listlessness can actually help you de-frag your mind. But too much of it can make you anxious & fearful as well. This will be a vital time to stay extra Grounded & Positive, as you will be manifesting New Cycles, Relationships & a whole new Reality whether you consciously realize it or not. So, Optimism and undeterred Faith will be Key. 


This Eclipse will naturally heighten your Sensitivity & Intuition, may be even awaken your latent Psychic Potential. Most of all, your Hidden Potential can be revealed during such a Spiritual Awakening, where you will be able to access some of your most Precious Talents & Skills. Inspiration, Creativity & Passion can awaken making you determined to turn some of your most Cherished Dreams into Reality. However, it is wise not to jump into anything new too quickly (just yet) as you might be missing the puzzles to a much bigger picture during this time. The coming Solar Eclipse will likely bring much more clarity & illumination to your New Grand Ambitions.


Fears & Insecurities will need to be managed with Patience & Compassion, Anger & Frustration will need some Self-reflection. This Eclipse will feel like a Trigger Mine to navigate, yet these triggers will help you purify your subconscious & conscious Motivations & Drive. It can also affect your relationships, where you will have numerous opportunities to understand both others & yourself on a much deeper-level than ever before. Some of these relationships will reach a New level of Transcendence, reaching incredible heights both Spiritually & Emotionally. 


Allow the Serendipitous Pisces Full Moon Eclipse to cleanse you consciously and subconsciously. The past will transform your present, while the future will become an enticing desire. Leaving behind the troubles of the bygone days and consciously stepping into the Destined Newness.

entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes August 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn

Aug 1 - 6, 2023

Aries, you are busy this week. You are driven by raw passions with your eyes clearly set on your goals. You are becoming more and more serious about your career. You are reorganizing many aspects of your life seemingly flawlessly to help you clear out the way towards absolute success. You might however be hyper-vigilant in this process where your paranoia & insecurities are kicking in as well. You might be stressing too much about small mistakes or details that may be hindering your progress. In a way, you might be playing out scenarios where you are subconsciously looking for distractions. So, if you have any such self-sabotaging tendencies with fear of failure or success, this week’s (and with the last few weeks of) experiences will highlight those coping mechanism or sabotaging patterns. 



It can be a daunting revelation but a necessary one indeed, since you are (or getting ready to) making some serious progress in your life, both professionally & personally, so any old or repeating cycles will be highlighted to be released once and for all. You are seriously reevaluating some of the choices, contracts & commitments that you have made over the years that might not be in alignment with your long-term visions. If you are feeling burdened or duty-bound to those people/places/things lately, you might be making decisive plans to leave/release them for the highest good of all. 


Simultaneously, you might be feeling inadequate or undeserving of the moves that you are making and the blessings that you are awaiting. Momentarily this can take you back to certain childhood traumas or hurtful experiences that made you feel less than of yourself. This week will positively challenge you to overcome those fears, self-blame & regrets, sweet Aries. You will be able to rebuild your inner strength and confidence, releasing yourself from such burdens and blames, all while holding yourself accountable for the part you played (willingly or unwillingly) in the story. Trust that you will come out of this healing journey with a refined sense of self and inspiration for life, Dear Aries.

entry.title: Taurus Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

Your focus this week will be on your private life. Taurus, you have the biggest heart for your family and loved ones, your commitment to them is always imminent, but lately you might have been at odds with some of your closest confidants. You are more motivated to find harmony at your home, but it might be getting harder to keep the peace with minor arguments or misunderstandings. Although, you are still insistent about giving this your all, you will have to be a little careful not to over-extend yourself since you might end up people-pleasing and sacrificing your needs just to hold onto certain relationships that may be at a stand-still at this time. You have been through intense phases of transformation with major endings and upheavals recently. 



You might still be recovering from the loses and sudden changes. Since you are currently wrapping up old cycles and beginning new ones, you are likely to feel exhausted and energetically drained quite often. Taking adequate rest, resetting your thought-patterns & letting go of anything that is ending will be hard yet vital for your spiritual & mental peace. Hence, self-care & some alone time will help you recharge to find your emotional balance. Your career & public life might be amping up inducing anxiety with more responsibilities. You might even feel challenged to take on leadership roles but you will also have to remember how intensely capable you are, Taurus. You have all the skills and natural charisma, not to mention incredible work-ethic. So, overcoming initial fears & insecurities will help you a great deal this week. You might be having a hard time reconciling your feelings about certain truths that recent events & changes may have bought up. 


Your belief system and world-view seem to be a little shaken up. This can cause you a lot more stress & even anxiety attacks. So, it may be best to not let old memories or people to get you out of character. You will be compelled to uphold your integrity when triggered, but others might see it more as a display of pride & ego rather than a natural defense mechanism. You might have to be a lot more patient when expressing your emotions, where being true to yourself and your feelings may not always be appreciated but will have to be honored none-the-less. So, you don’t have to worry about others’ interpretations of your feelings. You are gaining back your optimism and zest for life Taurus, after what seemed like a long and lonesome journey of healing. This week, make sure to have plenty of rest and map out plans for your future, since the energy is gaining momentum, with great things to look froward to.

entry.title: Full Moon in Gemini 13° 🌕♊️ Dec 4, 2025
entry.content:
Everybody’s Shadow-side is out to play this Full Moon (with a tight Opposition of Uranus, Mercury & Lilith + Lilith Conjunct Mercury). Let your Shadow play with others’ as well, but be Consciously aware so as not to let it wander off too faraway from you (and cause/get-into trouble). Beware of Trickster, exploitative & cunning energy (both within yourself and others). Deal with both your Shadow-side and that of others’ through Tact and Emotional Intelligence. Trust that with this Full Moon’s unique Astrological influence, you will be able to understand the triggers, fears & wounds that activate the Shadow. Brace yourself for headaches, chronic fatigue & health issues. Become more aware in order to make the necessary changes to your surroundings, routines, habits & thoughts as you wake up to your True Ideals, Goals & Ambitions in life. 


As Mercury in Scorpio (freshly out of Retrograde) Opposes Uranus in Taurus, your Emotional Intelligence as well as Intuition are heightened tremendously, where you are able to ‘read between the lines’ and ‘connect the dots’ much more easier than ever. Truths and Secrets revealed sometimes in a direct way, other times through subtle clues. You can hence decipher the lies and deceits without the other person/people even ever making the slightest movement. Whether these are your loved ones (who also love you just as much) or random strangers that you interact with, you can peer into the veil where you can see the person behind the mask, the intention behind the lies.


It is however important not to jump to conclusions, even when you see everything you need to at the time. Since as the Full Moon draws closer, the full picture is still only “unfolding”, so you might have to wait and look out for the full clarity, pieces to fall into place before making any decision. This is especially true w.r.t. relationships, as Uranus’s Opposition to Venus now can prompt you to break things off at the slightest hint of betrayal, threat to your independence & disrespect to your integrity.


Certain relationships are meant to go through major changes, as their fate may be hanging in a balance through the events that play out during this Full Moon. Since this Full Moon activates the Lunar Nodes in Pisces & Virgo (13°), making it a pivotal time for Karmic Corrections and Re-alignments in your most significant relationships and other areas of Life in general. So it is best not to make impulsive decisions around this time. It is important to take your Heart & feelings into account, along with your practicality & intellect. Since no matter how sure you may think you are, there’s likely more to the story that might make you reconsider and to avoid an otherwise disastrous outcome. Regardless, you will still have at least a week long time after the Full Moon (and the associated events) to come to a definite conclusion. 


You are likely to feel inspired to go after your long-held dreams & ambitions, but it is important to pace yourself and be methodical in your approach. You might feel pressured to complete old/previous projects & commitments (even cycles) before you can pursue New Ventures & Adventures (as Mars in Sagittarius is Squared by Saturn in Pisces). Although this time period is frustrating and ridden with delays, you will realize how Truly Rewarding a bit of patience & persistence can be, especially as you see old equally significant cycles, projects & commitments through to their natural completion. 


Revelations, Signs & Synchronicities that can be overwhelming. This beautiful Full Moon presents an equally beautiful upgrade to our Conscious Mind, where our Thought-Patterns, Mindsets, Perspectives & Belief System can go through a significant transformation. As shocking-life-changing events activate an awakening, we are able to: cut-through the confusion, change the old narratives and reprogram our mindset to best align with what is Prosperous and can brings Happiness into our Life. Honoring the Bigger Vision over the Noise of distraction.

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Scorpio (8th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Scorpio (8th House)

You are loyal and trustworthy, yet you often encounter people & situations who are not quite honest, leading to betrayals and disappointments. You know how devastating losses and endings feel since you have experienced way too many since childhood. You have seen the worst sides to any situation so surviving through such harsh circumstances made you weary and cautious of everything and everyone. You might have encountered near-death experiences or had to endure the loss of loved ones early on in your life. Your childhood could also have been chaotic in some way that makes you feel destabilized even in your adulthood. 


You might experience losses even in monetary or partnership related endeavors just to learn how to improve your life and financial circumstances drastically later on in life since you are exceptionally talented at such matters. You might have deep wounds relating to sexuality and intimacy. You might even have turbulent relationship dynamics. You can be paranoid of situations that make you feel like you are being controlled or under somebody else’s mercy. You can also be quite controlling in certain areas/situations in your life. You might have strong psychic and intuitive abilities that can help you in all areas of your life even in your career endeavors. 


You possess deep observational skills that allow you to assess situations and people easily. You can develop psychological and emotional intelligence through your powerful insights and curiosity. You might be subjected to distrust or scrutiny by others due to misunderstandings or sometimes even due to hidden agenda/manipulation that made you over-protective of your image and not to become easily accessible to others. You are a passionate individual; you pursue your ambitions and desires with devotion and determination. You are also equally compassionate towards your loved ones, especially in intimate relationships. 



You are a natural lie-detector, your emotional intelligence can help you determine others’ true intentions easily, so you are hard to manipulate or control. You will however have to be careful of your own shadow side with this placement since you can become controlling, possessive or obsessive easily as well. Your healing will help you gain a much-needed inner stability from all the chaos that you experienced externally. Your ability to trust and love others will help you heal parts of you that were subjected to betrayals and feelings of being misjudged. 


You can turn pain into power with this placement, your transformations can be extremely painful yet life changing events. Your strength in character will be tested and solidified as a result. You must however learn to nurture and cherish yourself, since often you might be compelled to neglect your spiritual and physical well-being due to external battles. You will have to find empathy for yourself and self-love just enough to keep you in a positive frame of mind. 


This placement can also help you break generational cycles/patterns and close out painful karmic cycles successfully. You are compassionate and insightful, so you will also realize that vengefulness and other expressions of rage will only leave you depleted in the end, especially since you will come to see karma playing out in your favor in such situations on its own. You will inspire others to embrace their shadow-self and shed light on the deepest darkest parts of their inner-self. You can guide others through their toughest phases in life. Your protective and passionate side will be loved and cherished by your loved ones. You will also see how your healing can clear out pain and sorrow, bringing blessings and karmic rewards into your life.

entry.title: Chiron 🌿✨ Mythology x Astrology of Asteroids
entry.content:
In Greek Mythology, Chiron was said to be the greatest healer, scholar and teacher revered by all. Kronos happened to see a beautiful sea nymph Philyra whom he relentlessly pursued (in between his search for Zeus and other children to devour so as to escape the prophecy of his death). The uninterested Philyra turns into a mare in order to disguise herself from Kronos, but Kronos ends up taking advantage of this by turning himself into a horse thereby impregnating her. When Philyra gave birth to a half human and half horse baby, she was repulsed by the fact that she was tricked and so abandoned the baby Chiron out of shame. Chiron, although a Centaur in his appearance, was essentially a Demigod due to his parental lineage. Apollo finds Chiron and takes him under his tutelage, together with his twin sister Artemis. They taught Chiron various studies including medicine, archery, music, etc. helping him turn into a parodical being, skilled especially in teaching and healing arts. Many young Greek heroes later became his students. 


Chiron was wise, fair, knowledgeable, patient, compassionate, respected and disciplined. He was said to be an accomplished scholar in astrology and a well-known prophet of his time. His life yet again takes a drastic turn when one day Hercules visits his cave to celebrate one of his victories. Centaurs in general were known to be easily swayed by their primal instincts of beastly nature of rage, hunger, lust, alcohol, etc. all of which are not true for Chiron as he was a Titan himself and raised by Apollo & Artemis, making him the most civilized of all centaurs, and an outstanding Demigod of immaculate character. During the celebrations, Hercules insists on drinking but that results in accidentally intoxicating the other centaurs. A big fight breaks out by the unruly centaurs that Hercules tries to fend off using his arrows. The arrows were dipped in the blood of Hydra (meaning, they were poisonous). During the fight, one of Hercules’s arrows accidentally struck Chiron’s thigh thereby wounding him severely. While most centaurs died by the poised arrows, Chiron being an immortal was badly wounded. Chiron, though he was revered to be the gifted healer, could not heal his wound no matter what he tried, or for how long he treated it, leaving him in constant agony. 


He secluded himself after a long and hard struggle treating the poisoned wound, he realized that his immortality was the only bane keeping him trapped in eternal suffering. Meanwhile, Zeus was contemplating on Hercules’s suggestion to relieve both Chiron and Prometheus from their individual sufferings (Prometheus’s punishment can only be released if a Demigod forego their immortality). Hence, Zeus accepted the request of Chiron who was willing to accept his mortality in order to end his suffering by giving his immortality to Prometheus, thereby resolving both of their endless agony. Chiron then enters the underworld of Hades. His heroic deeds and valiant character were celebrated when later he was made into a constellation in the sky (some say its Sagittarius, others say its Centaurus).


Chiron’s story thus illustrates how one can suffer through pain and ill-fate during the period of their life when they have no say in it, like childhood. He was abandoned by his parents, especially his mother whose rejection might have had little to do with his appearance but more with her abuse by Kronos. So, projected shame and guilt became a part of his early life even though he had done nothing wrong or had no control over his birth circumstances. Later, he was confronted by the dilemma of healing himself by a wound that had no cure, as essentially it was designed to be fatal but to an immortal, it became an endless suffering. The very irony of a healer not being able to treat his own ailment serves as a humbling experience in this story. His death too served as a desperate need to finally come to terms with his suffering and understanding the importance of mortality free from pain.


Chiron’s placement in one’s chart gives a deeper understanding of their inner wounds, the wounds that they can’t run from, no matter how or when they happened. Chiron as an asteroid is situated in between Saturn and Uranus, but it also has an irregular orbit. Indicating how events that happen out of the blue can bring fated situations into our life and thus trigger buried fears and pain. Chiron learnt how physical agony can dredge up emotional wounds that may have been overlooked before. He was a healer until the end, since even through his pursuit to cure himself, he was still willing to help others, through which he understood how acceptance played a major role in healing, this compassion earned him the title of “the wounded healer”.


Thus, this placement can further represent:

Your inner wounds, fears, pain and traumas.

Events that might have transpired in your previous life and/or early life (out of your control) that left a deep wound within you.

Sudden events that bring up painful and sometimes unexplainable sorrow relating to the past.

Themes of abandonment, shame or guilt either projected or caused or both.

Wounds relating to childhood, sometimes directly or indirectly caused by parents.

Where you feel the most unfortunate or vulnerable due to repeated karmic events, feelings of insecurity and low self-esteem.

What you are extremely skilled at, where you show a lot of potential in, especially in terms of education.

Where you show excellence in being a scholar or a teacher, also where/how you’re blessed with incredible mentors.

Where/how you seem to encounter people with similar wounds to that of yours, whether you’re aware of those wounds yourself or not.

Where/how you accept those wounds, sometimes, if you choose to accept or reject those wounds, where you are in denial of your wounds.

How you react to those who seek your help when you are in dire need of help yourself.

How you handle self-seclusion, does it bring up old memories of pain, do you take time to heal from them, etc.

Where you are faced with fears, and feel helpless, powerless, or hopeless since even your greatest knowledge & strength may not be enough to bring you immediate relief.

Where you willingly make sacrifices for the greater good.

Where/how you might get dragged into potentially dangerous situations without actively being a part of them.

How you approach matters of eventuality.

How you heal yourself by healing others, where you deepen your understanding of your traumas & pain by helping others understand theirs’.

Where/how you’re compassionate about collective healing.

Where/how you are well-respected for your selflessness.

How your healing can inspire others in their journey to recovery.

How you are favored by higher forces during your time of suffering and how/where you find your salvation, etc.


Chiron thus has a prominent role in Astrology. Chiron helps with dismantling fears, traumas and regrets, essentially all forms of negative emotions and patterns that get accumulated through huge (sometimes) life changing events in our life. This is one of the most powerful placements for shadow work, inner-child healing, emotional & physical recovery, mental health and strengthening of one’s character. This is also a karmic point of healing the self and others, so encountering, evaluating and breaking free from karmic cycles & patterns become a prime focus with this placement. It helps in the evolution of the soul and hence also the collective.

entry.title: The Mighty Conjunction of Jupiter & Uranus in Taurus | April 21, 2024 ⚡️✨
entry.content:
Now you can also find me on YouTube. If you like learning more about Astrology with me, do subscribe to my YouTube channel 🥰

Here’s the video for The Mighty Conjunction of Jupiter & Uranus in Taurus | April 21, 2024 ⚡️✨


Jupiter - Uranus Conjunction happening at 21° Taurus is of the most awaited Conjunctions of 2024. Since it’s Jupiter, this starts a cycle of 12 years. What’s more is that, this exact Conjunction of Jupiter & Uranus hasn’t happened in Taurus since 1941. With the most powerful combination of planetary conjunction, we are witnessing a momentous event this year. 


Uranus has been shaking things up in Taurus since 2018. Our financial situations, matters of currency & global economic reforms have gone through many different levels of restructuring. We have seen living conditions & standards go through major shake ups. Our need to be financially & materially security has driven us into an almost obsessive research & the efforts we are making towards achieving such a stability is immense. Right before Uranus moves into Gemini in 2026, Uranus will make a momentous collaboration with Jupiter here. Things will never be the same for us as a collective. 


Taurus is a rigid sign of Fixed Earth, and Uranus generally doesn’t like transiting in a sign that is too grounded. So, with every change that takes place, it will feel extra chaotic and fear inducing. Cracking foundations that were built over decades, even centuries are not easy to reform, but Uranus has been the lightening that has been repeatedly striking those very foundations and breaking them down into finer elements. If there are structures, be it societal, cultural or even familial, that were resisting the constant warnings and avoiding restricting themselves for the betterment of everybody, they will have to face the reality that they have already been changing & evolving without realizing it all time. 


Now with the Jupiter Conjunction, Uranus is able to pierce through any rigid system that doesn’t respect the evolutionary principles of the universe once and for all. Anywhere you felt held back and restricted by rules or traditions that were painfully outdated, especially if you have been fighting to change those systems or have been rebelling against such inflexibilities, you will finally break through those chains. This is where you will never be able to compromise your freedom and authenticity ever again. 


Whenever Jupiter meets another planet, he tends to amplify the intensity of that conjunction to unimaginable levels. With Uranus, we can probably never imagine the number of possibilities in front of us. 



Globally, 

We can expect sudden economic growth. Job opportunities can increase, demand & supply can see drastic changes. New business ideas, start ups and creative avenues to make money can emerge. Stock markets will rise well beyond predicted levels. But, Pluto is in Aquarius now, so global economy will be extremely unpredictable. There may be incredible growth and simultaneously, we can expect to see an unprecedented decline as well, extreme results cycling in and out throughout Pluto’s Transit. Nonetheless, this Conjunction will bring positive growth and a great relief after the recent deep financial instability. 🍀


With Uranus, of course, this means amazing news for the Tech Industry in general. There will be benevolent changes that can start to take place to improve our ability to make practical use of the rapid technological advances. This means that, hopefully we will be able to consciously adapt to these changes and make the best use of those resources without the paranoia of losing our job opportunities & livelihood. Since, Pluto is in Aquarius, we are already seeing certain things playing out. The greed of those in positions of power will increase during the next 20 years. But, the true Power lies in the hands of people, the Collective. I truly hope that we can find ways to use technology for the greater good of all and not for the select few sitting at the top. So, we will likely work towards building that strong foundation & effective laws around exactly that for at least the next decade.


The overall land value will also rise in the next few years, if not for the next decade. There will be many wonderful developments in agriculture and food production. We might possibly even work on creating clean & safe food. Sustainability will be on all over minds. So, even on small scale levels, animal farms & gardening will gain a lot of popular attention. Ethical & scientifically informed farming methods will become the ever evolving norm. 


This is just my personal opinion, but I do hope that we will be able to find ways to reduce food waste collectively. Because, Jupiter & Uranus can mean excess and that almost always leads to wastefulness. So, this is one thing that I wish we can be a little conscious of even in our daily lives.


On the other hand, collective efforts may start to provide food & resources to those in need. Since, Jupiter represents Charity and benevolence, while Uranus is always looking out for the common good of humanity. There can be collective effort towards creating Charitable Foundations, Organizations and even Government efforts to provide basic food & shelter to those in need.


Global Travel & Trade Markets will see a significant growth. Especially, the Aviation Industry will continue to expand and become more accessible to the public. Foreign tourism will concurrently bring more jobs & revenue. Space Industry will also continue to bring many many wonderful news. We might even be able to do something practical & resourceful with planetary exploration. We might end up finding rare & exciting things out there. The next decade will prove to be incredibly impressive to both Space lovers & Investors alike.



Now on a personal level,

We can expect a massive shift in our standard of living and lifestyle. If you have been working towards achieving financial stability for the past few years, all your efforts may pay off all at once, during the next six months in particular. You might have a windfall of money, a good pay out, profits in investments, promotions or bonuses. Heck, maybe even a jackpot >ᴗ< Basically, this will be the time where you will repeat the rewards of your good karma. These blessings will likely be something tangible, like money, or a big purchase like a new house, car or a business. Something long term and sustainable.


With positive changes in Quality of Living, Cost of Living will increase in many ways as well, which will motivate us to invest more of our efforts towards achieving a level of financial prosperity & security. It might even force us to keep up with the changing times & price hikes. Financial management or investment courses can majorly improve our outlook on handling money now. We might even have epiphanies and sudden insights about new business improvements or even investment & money making ideas. Trust your intuition if you are being guided towards making such decisions, since anything new will feel risky and out of the norm around this time. We must however be careful about how we decide to spend these rewards, since it will be extremely easy to squander all the money & opportunities if we are not being extra smart about it.


Scorpio Full Moon will be just days away (April 23, 2024), so we can expect to feel that intensity along with this Conjunction as well. Full Moons help us release cycles, and with a Powerful Scorpio Full Moon, we will be guided towards releasing any form of instability from within and without. Toxic and burdensome emotions, along with relationships built on unstable grounds will become very apparent to us. Inheritance & shared money matters will likely be at the forefront. So, use these Powerful energies happening in tandem to set intentional boundaries and protect your self-respect while simultaneously ensuring your personal stability. There is often a lot of inner-strength that we can draw from the axis of Taurus - Scorpio which encompasses almost all the aspects of our emotional, material & spiritual world right. So, I hope that we can play it safe in situations that have been difficult, and be wise in our emotional, financial & energetic investments.


This combination of Full Moon & Jupiter - Uranus Conjunction will also bring us massive opportunities to manifest our wishes & dreams as well. If you are into it, this is the prime time for Manifestation Rituals, Vision Boarding, Affirmations, even Day Dreaming about your desired future 🪄. Prime Time, Absolute Prime Time Some late Spring Cleaning and donating things that you no longer need can also help you make room for what you are manifesting. This can be in your home & office or in your private & public life. You will have the right mindset to manifest literally anything that you wish to. Money, Home, Relationship, Career, anything. The next six months will bring these manifestations and then some more. 


Venus will make an exact Conjunction with Chiron in Aries on the same day. Hence, this is going to be an auspicious day. While Jupiter & Uranus are pulling universal blessings into our lives, Chiron is healing the Venus in us. Self-worth related issues will likely be healed through your own effort and willpower. There will be a major awakening, this self realization about how special & beloved you are. Long standing issues related your self-image and inner-stability will be triggered at first, but they will also quickly find their resolutions. 


So, it will be wonderful if you can take a day for yourself, put your feet up, and enjoy indulging in some good self-care routines. Something that can help you truly relax and nourish your body, mind & soul. This break alone can boost your enthusiasm. Poverty consciousness and such deep rooted belief systems around your self-worth & your capability to attain material success in life will change drastically. You will be able to easily tap into Abundance Mindset, resetting your value systems regarding prosperity, comfort & sensuality. This will bring about a wonderful change within your self-acceptance & self-love.


White Moon Selena will be Conjunct Jupiter & Uranus as well. This is what gives me immense confidence & hope that everything happening around this time will lead us to a better future. We can expect positive results & peaceful resolutions to even the most challenging situations that we may have been dealing with. There is a big focus of renewing our self-esteem. Our value systems are going through a major upgrade & improvement, rebuilding our mindset in a positive way. All these changes & the blessings that come with them will restore the Balance in our life. Prosperity will feel accessible once again, and if you have been working towards even higher goals, you will feel inspired to push even further and reach greater heights. You will be able to get back in touch with your Inner Peace, along with a much more stronger intuition.


In general, go wild and be free. Own your authentic self. Be consistent in your efforts and honest in everything you focus your time & attention on. Ground yourself from the inside-out. Find purpose in your work, in everything you touch & feel, in life. Bring practical results through Your passions. Solidify your dreams into reality. This is the time to believe in even the most craziest ideas & dreams. Because, never know, you might just end up manifesting them. ✨

entry.title: Natal Moon and Ascendant Aspects 🌕✨
entry.content:
Moon Conjunct Ascendant 

☌ To begin with, Moon literally represents you, as a person, your temperament, your emotional self, etc. so it makes up your entire identity (just like how Sun represents your ego, your purpose, your drive, etc.). So, this aspect emphasizes that, even if your Moon is in 12H, being Conjunct the Ascendant, others will always see you for who you are, even if you don’t believe it or have a hard time accepting it.

☌ Here, honoring your feminine side becomes extra important regardless of your gender or sexual preference.

☌ There’s an obvious mystery about you that is so appealing to everyone around you.

☌ You wear your emotions on your sleeves, yet you don’t mind it being seen, unless they’re insecurities since you’re very sensitive to how vulnerable you wish to be seen.

☌ You may be the sweetest person that anyone can meet, and I’m not exaggerating it, since your intentions are always out in the open, be it good or bad, others can always make them out, and so you’re effortlessly loveable & trustworthy.

☌ You are emotionally sound (even if your upbringing didn’t happen in an emotionally/psychologically healthy environment) you likely grew up to be a sensible & compassionate person.

☌ You wish to enjoy the company of others, being in your presence can be a soothing experience which reflects your moods, so if you’re not feeling yourself somedays, people can feel it right away.

☌ There’s a level of unconditionality to you that is hard to miss, and this giving-caring side of you can attract many people into your life.

☌ You are naturally popular, even if it’s not so obvious, you are loved, you make friends easily, you know how to form healthy relationships, you crave emotional stability in your interactions with others, you enjoy your daily routines.

☌ You like to include people in your life & work, others around you often feel like you treat them like family, so you bond on a deeper level with them. You might also enjoy taking periodic breaks, just focusing on yourself, recharging & relaxing.

☌ Although with compassion comes over-giving, so you could have learnt that over-sharing, or over-giving love/attention/care never ends well, and since it deeply affects your own sense of identity, also on a cautionary note, (being opposite Descendant) this is extra important in romantic relationships, where (if there’re Lilith/Pluto influences in your chart) you might attract obsessive/manipulative partners who could leave you feeling depleted, so you need to build healthy boundaries in your relationships.

☌ The same can be said about Mother, mother figures, feminine figures in your life no matter in what form, you might share profound bonds with such people in your life, and again, with other placements & aspects in the chart, this could be good or bad, meaning you could expect to experience happiness & harmony with them or jealousy & envy form them (no matter how subtle).

☌ You’re extra sensitive to smells & senses, you might also dislike violence (in your/others’ life & in the world as a whole), emotionally charged situations, disharmony, immorality, etc. 

☌ You are intuitive & might have psychic sensitivities. You have a spiritual bend to your personality.

☌ There must be caution in not allowing others to change your opinions, especially if it’s about yourself. As much as you like to listen to your family & friends, you must still be careful not to take disrespect, envy or manipulation lightly, but rather build your own confidence and stay balanced in your own sense of self. 


Moon Sextile Ascendant 

✱ You are a sociable, friendly and caring person.

✱ You love to interact with people, especially your loved ones, and make memories with them, spend quality time, etc.

✱ You are intuitive and can feel the environment you are in, the atmosphere in a social setting.

✱ You have a calm & serene personality that attracts a lot of people, making you quite popular.

✱ Being genuine with your intentions is a big attribute of this aspect, since they are always on full display to everyone, so fake or sneaky behavior will be called out immediately, being compassionate & well intentions will always be praised by others.

✱ Developing emotional maturity could have been a rewarding yet hard lesson growing up since you wish to have emotional stability in your close personal relationships.

✱ This could have also helped you to become emotionally intelligent, with great communication skills, so you know how to detect good people & avoid the wrong ones.

✱ Your career must be something that deeply inspires you and emotionally satisfies you, otherwise you could feel burnouts more easily, or could lead to mood-swings/emotional-instability.

✱ You often attract supportive people who are good at heart, and they might also help you lead a successful career life or provide you with good advice for your life in general.

✱ You are warm & kind, you wish to see the world be peaceful, you might fight for causes that concern communities, or raise awareness about important causes/issues (especially if Moon is in 11H).

✱ You could benefit a lot by helping others, charity can be spiritually rewarding, or just caring & helping your family & friends will give you a lot of personal satisfaction.



Moon Trine Ascendant 

△ You are warm, compassionate & caring, others appreciate you for who you are and all that you do.

△ You have an easy-going personality that attracts a lot of people who wish to be a part of your life.

△ You love to have a good social circle, with friends & family.

△ You draw-in inspiration from the people you love, so your relationship with family & friends are very important to you.

△ You are fun-loving, you love to see your loved ones happy, this adds to your sense of humor & your optimistic personality.

△ Your caring personality is an endearing trait that most people in your life love about you.

△ You may be quite active in your social life, spending a lot of time with others, making new friends, enjoying good company.

△ You are passionate in your career endeavors, you thrive in group settings, you often find supportive people on your way.

△ You also crave intimacy & romance, you wish to find emotional balance in your close relationships, and you expect your partner(s) to be trustworthy, warm & caring.

△ You may be lucky in social situations (especially if Moon is in 5H/9H), you always seem to be in the right place at the right time.


Moon Opposite Ascendant (Conjunct Descendant)

☍ This Moon aspect can be a very sensitive one, especially since there’s a direct correlation to one’s mother/mother figure.

☍ You are an affectionate person with a lot of love to give.

☍ Your early upbringing could have had a profound effect on your outlook on life, especially that on romantic relationships.

☍ Your relationship with your mother/mother figure could be seen as a guide to all your future relationships, often manifesting the way you looked at them growing up.

☍ If you had an absent mother, you might develop codependent behaviors with your close personal relationships (even friendships), if she was emotionally distant or unavailable, you might attract partners who treat you the same way, or if you had a healthy relationship with your mother you might expect to attract partner(s) who are emotionally available & with genuinely love.

☍ This could be especially true if Moon is in 7H. In 6H, you might find yourself being emotionally invested in your work/career life. You might also find a lot of satisfaction in your daily routines, your choice of career(s), business, etc.

☍ In either case, there may be a caution not to become overly invested or dependent on anyone or anything since you might only be projecting your insecurities. 

☍ You will have to be mindful of your intentions, and especially that of others, in all kinds of relationships. Hence creating healthy boundaries in your relationships (of all kinds) becomes an important part of your life-lesson.

☍ You have a warm heart and know unconditional love yet demanding it from others will only leave you dissatisfied in life, since most issues that seem to come from this aspect has its roots in your childhood or your upbringing.

☍ (Especially if Moon is in 7H) You love to display your emotions to the public, you wish to maintain a good PR, and are often well loved by others, making you quite popular. However, it is important to remember that your emotional stability shows your strength in character, and hence creates a good public perception so if you are being moody or are showing other emotional problems the opposite can also be true.

☍ This is also true in your social life, you love to indulge in your social life, be it with friends or co-workers, you like harmonious & peaceful relationships with them.

☍ You can be an amazing business partner, or a diplomat even, since you know how to blend-in other’s feelings & good intentions into creating something worthwhile. 

☍ You might also find it hard to keep your romantic feelings for someone a secret since Descendant/6H/7H are public aspects of life & Moon here doesn’t make it any easier. You might also like to have PDA moments with your partner(s) & dream of a fairy-tale love-story (with other favorable aspects, and frankly a blessed partner, you might actually make this dream come true).



Moon Square Ascendant 

□ This aspect can indicate struggles in expressing your emotions.

□ You might subconsciously project your own emotional insecurities onto others, which could lead to many misunderstandings & heartbreaks.

□ You could have had a difficult childhood, or a confusing relationship with your parent(s), which might be the root cause of your inability to understand your feelings.

□ You might feel threatened by others’ affections or opinions, even positive interactions might make you feel insecure.

□ You might have dealt with many unrequited relationships (of all kinds), leaving you feeling rather pessimistic about love & affection.

□ Your moods have a profound influence on how you interact with others, and hence how they respond to you.

□ There is also a caution to not run away from yourself & your emotions since sometimes they may consume you. But you might also find many answers to your own questions as intuitive nudges.

□ Your relationship with the public as a whole can also be stressful (especially if Moon is in 10H too), since others might not always know how to approach you, and what reaction to expect from you, and hence some may admire you & others may find you to be unpleasant.

You might also find a lot of success in your career life as a result of your passionate emotional investment in your work.

□ Although like with all relationships, you will have to find a healthy balance between work & play, never over-doing your part. 

□ This aspect can also manifest in over-sharing and over-expecting, since co-dependent issues could also be the flip side of it. So, creating healthy boundaries or being mindful in how much you give & ask for in relationships will become important.

□ There’s a big importance of finding a good emotional balance within yourself, since your internal fears & insecurities may be preventing you from being true to yourself and fully letting others (even your loved ones) into your life. 

□ Your self-esteem & strength in character are admired by a lot of people, but you will also have to be present & appreciative of their love & adoration. 

□ You’ll find a lot of personal & emotional satisfaction in developing a good sense of self, accepting your emotional tides & shifts, facing your fears, creating a balanced routine for your physical & mental health, seeking people who are willing to help you, without rejecting yourself & others, and they may be one of the biggest lessons of this aspect.


Moon Inconjunct/Quincunx Ascendant 

^ This aspect unfortunately can indicate to having self-esteem issues, eventually might also lead to identity crisis situations.

^ You might feel uncomfortable in your own skin (extreme cases, at the very least) you struggle from understanding & accepting your own self. 

^ Somehow your early upbringing, even your relationship with your mother could have been the root of the issue.

^ You might go through extremes in your emotional & mental well-being, feeling ecstatic & distant in a split second.

^ As a result, you might often seek relationships that alter your perception of self, distorting your self-image even further, meaning you might attract toxic/manipulative partner(s). While in healthy relationships you might feel overwhelmed, and even sabotage them out self-doubts.

^ With other placements/aspects suggesting the same, especially with Neptune/Uranus, you might have addiction issues, or even co-dependency issues (particularly in toxic relationships, of any kind) you will be forced to deal with them eventually for your own well-being.

^ Through all these painful experiences, you might end up realizing the good & the bad aspects of yourself, and how they affect your relationships with both yourself & others.

^ You could be talented, yet you might down-play your skills. You could be the sweetest person on earth, yet you might deny yourself to accept appreciation from others, etc.

^ There might be a spiritual aspect to you that often subconsciously guides you through even the most hopeless situations.

^ You might eventually come to terms with your fears & insecurities to build a solid sense of self, accepting yourself for all your greatness & flaws and, hence forming healthy relationships.

^ Your self-esteem & self-value may go through profound changes throughout your life, where you might start accepting yourself for who you’re, realizing that you deserve the good things in life and hence not accepting anything less from yourself & others.

^ Honoring your emotions, believing in yourself, healing through your past experiences, and trusting in your inner guidance & intuition may be the biggest lessons of your life, leading you back to yourself and your true happiness.

entry.title: Mars Transits into Cancer this Spring | March 25, 2023 🔥✨
entry.content:
March 2023 has been a month of intense energy shifts with major transits: Saturn in Pisces, Pluto in Aquarius and now Mars rides into the emotional waters of Cancer, all in one month. Mars wreaked havoc for 7 months with its transit & retrograde in Gemini. We felt the sting of words & battle of wits, sometimes arguments escalating rather quickly to actual fights. That transit taught us how to use our words to make things easier rather than create conflicts that go out of our control within seconds. Skillful negotiations, small talks and witty conversations helped us renew our social meters. 


With Mars now entering Cancer on March 25th, get ready to become a little mysterious & stingy with sharing your energy. Mood swings are a big take away of this transit, passive-aggression and even emotional outbursts may become rampant. It will be easy to lose your patience whenever you feel even a slight glitch in your control over your reality, emotional & financial stability. Your emotional balance will need a good dose of grounding. There may be a compulsion to hold onto people/places/things out of fear. Over protectiveness can turn into possessive streaks. A lot more sensitive to emotional disappointments. 


It is important to notice any such excessive behavior before it starts to affect your health, since it is very likely that added stress and internal frustrations can make you sick & weaken your immune system a lot more easily than usual. It will be extra draining and an exhaustive period. So, self-care and a balanced diet with lots and lots of water (Spring x Summer in Northern Hemisphere) will be a must during this transit. Regular workouts, sports or physical activities can help you direct any internal buildup of Martian frustration into something productive, along with spiritual-based practices like yoga, qigong, meditation, etc. can bring a sense of peace & tranquility. 


Patience and calmness won’t be readily available in your inventory especially when you encounter emotional situations or oppositions, so taking a moment to assess & recenter yourself before responding to anything & everything will be essential. Cancer doesn’t like too many changes in emotional relationships, but Mars here can become a lot more agitated & make impulsive mistakes that can rock the boat, hence adding to Cancer’s frustrations (see why Mars in Cancer is not an easy ride?!?). 



Although, one thing Mars & Cancer can agree on is their protective & assertive nature, so you can expect to see yourself or your loved ones becoming more passionate in your relationships, building stronger emotional bonds. There may not be grand gestures of affection all the time (Mars in Cancer can be shy about these things sometimes 😌), but certainly unconditional love & care with a hint of possessiveness.


On the other hand, there may be tensions in your home situation, either with family members, about the home/property/land, etc. Relationship with your parents/family/kids may be tense with erratic emotions rising up & down. This is especially where your patience will be needed the most. Since, arguments can turn into fights and eventual burning down of bridges. Ego and power struggles can cause major regrets in the long run. Compassion and a little tact can save your bonds from unfortunate disappointments. 


If you are in restrictive or controlling relationships, this transit can help you assert your authority and take back control over your life by breaking free from such connections. For the next two months (till May 20), in any situation, using soft power, a little compromise, kindness and may be harmless manipulation to slide over risky situations (Mars & Cancer after all) will be a game changer in handling this transit. 


This Mars transit will bring a new approach to directing your productive energy by bringing a fiery new momentum. Your passionate nature can be increased especially while working on creating a stronger & more stable foundation in life, be it, emotional, familial and/or financial. You will be able to focus on building your finances and creating a more stable home-environment. Peace and harmony will be hard earned in your private life, but it will be well-worth it considering how this transit can revitalize your drive for life & bring back passion that is not just a raw sense of accomplishment but also of gratification. This spring is guaranteed to be full of fiery passion. 🔥

entry.title: Aquarius Weekly Horoscope 2023 ✨ | July 2023
entry.content:
Weekly Horoscopes July 2023
  • Aries
  • Taurus
  • Gemini
  • Cancer
  • Leo
  • Virgo
  • Libra
  • Scorpio
  • Sagittarius
  • Capricorn
  • Aquarius
  • Pisces

 

July 17th - 23rd, 2023

Aquarius, this week most of your focus will likely be on your social and professional life. However, tensions may rise in your home/work environment due to misunderstandings or disagreements. Even with all the background noises & minor irritations, you are more motivated than ever to work towards your professional goals. Creative inspirations are also likely to be abundant, so you will be able to implement new ideas very well. If you have been stuck on making important decisions or were previously confused about career related things, you will feel the surge of inspiration and rush of clarity to make the best choices this week. There might be risk of minor injuries or ailments, so stay safe out there Aquas. 



You might feel the need to break free from certain obligations and find your unique voice in the world, which might clash with others’ (mainly family) expectations of you. So, communicating without compromising your needs or hurting your loved ones’ feelings will be a bit of a challenge. There might also be major revelations through your dreams or intuitive hits about people who have been constantly against you, whether openly or secretively. You might even have to deal with repressed anger that seemed to have built up over the years. Resurfacing (even past life) memories can have you on a slight edge this week. 


Pessimism or depressive mood swings can become more rampant, so lots of attention to your emotional & mental well-being may be extra recommenced. There may be eventual end to  significant relationships that turned sour (or toxic) over the years. Hence, this can also be a time for new beginnings and fresh new chapters in major areas of your life, marking the transformational emergence of your new life & clear perspectives. If you are single, you might have good luck in meeting potential suitors; if you are in a romantic connection, you might be getting ready to take your relationship to the next level (especially during the mid part of the week ;). Hanging out with friends and little get-aways can be very relaxing.
