entry.title: Natal Jupiter and Midheaven MC Aspects 🐬✨
entry.content:
Jupiter Conjunct Midheaven MC 

☌ You are an incredible powerhouse with this aspect. Your optimism & faith will always lead you towards success.

☌ You have an enthusiastic approach to career & life, even when you’re not sure of what you want in life, you know that you’re capable of handling any responsibilities, so you are open to all kinds of opportunities, but you will likely choose a career that you are truly content with.

☌ You are knowledgeable and are diligent in your duty, you gain the respect of others easily (especially your superiors) for how reliable & competent you are.

☌ Your fun-loving & positive personality also makes you more approachable to others. So, as a result most authorities can easily trust you with PR, marketing, negotiations, etc. Others might even consider you as a lucky—charm or as someone who has a positive public image which in-turn gives you & the organizations/people/associations that are linked to you a good name.

☌ You can attract enemies/opposition due to the same. Hence, your competence will be under constant scrutiny, but your accomplishments will stand the test of time.

☌ You are a leader, and others easily look up to you. Especially since you are righteous and are true to who you are. This can even indicate popularity.

☌ Your ability to draw the attention of any crowd can also mean success in creative/artistic fields. You are exceptionally skilled in everything you put your mind to, so your choice of career will bring you a lot of success & with it a lot of honors.

☌ You attract people & opportunities that can elevate you on your career path easily. Especially since you’re bold enough to take on important responsibilities, you can even ascend to higher positions of authority.

☌ You might however need to maintain your positive public image through your hard work & humility, since you’re always seen as an example. So, whether you like the idea of being an influencer/inspiration to others or not, you’ll be idealized for all your good intentions & qualities. This can also serve as a driving force to achieve more.

☌ You’ll likely take incredible strides towards success; learn from setbacks & also not to make impulsive decisions; spread positivity & joy; create inspiring works/services; lead by example; gain wealth, prosperity, honor & power by following your higher calling with faith and hence fulfilling your life purpose.


Jupiter Square Midheaven MC

□ You are a confident and optimistic person, yet you doubt your own capabilities sometimes.

□ Your adventurous spirit helps you take on tasks that bring new excitement into your life. Although you might have to pace yourself before taking on risky endeavors.

□ Your morals & righteousness will always be in question with this aspect, whether in your personal life or in your professional, you will be expected to take part in legal & ethical deals/contracts. Sometimes even when you’re doing everything by the book, there may be controversies & scandals created by your competitors or enemies.

□ You have a well of knowledge & wisdom, since you see everything as a learning experience. 

□ But you must also be careful not to always seek new adventures, since you will need to create a solid foundation for yourself first. Every set back will make you want to learn more, and every success will make you much more determined.

□ You are capable of making your dreams comes true, but you might either over-estimate yourself or underestimate yourself, either way, you will need grounding in order to set clear goals for your life.

□ You don’t often let others get away with disrespecting or underestimating you. You know how to deliver witty & smart remarks to put such people in their place.

□ Although, you might have to keep your ego in-check, since you can get too caught up in proving others’ wrong. But in doing so, you might take things too far or sometimes go off track from your original plan, which can further delay your success.

□ You have great ideas & a refined set of skills that will help you establish a thriving career/business. You are generous & humble, so even your occasional arrogance will be easily forgiven by others, since your accomplishments speak for themselves.

□ You will likely ride through the ups & downs of life with a renewed sense of confidence; seek & explore your life path; create inspiring works/services; learn from your failures & successes alike; show humility & grace while facing opposition; gain wealth, position, power, & honor following your inner calling.



Jupiter Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC)

☍ This aspect will insist you to be humble & grounded before you attain your worldly desires.

☍ Your childhood could have been pleasant, and your upbringing could have also given you all the necessary opportunities to develop your skills & intellect, which can even be true for a strong & stable emotional foundation.

☍ There may be a sense of urgency in how you handle your career/business endeavors, almost as if you wish to reach the peak of the mountain without even stepping on the ground first.

☍ Even with all the luck in the world, you might be able to reach where you intended to be, but you might find it to be too challenging to handle. Since, only diligence & hard work can prepare you for such burdens.

☍ “With great power comes great responsibilities” after all, so you will have to pace yourself and only jump from one step to another. 

☍ Patience and clear planning are in fact your greatest gifts which must be put to their best use with this aspect. 

☍ Hence, along the way, you’ll know how to maturely fulfil your role and not take anything for granted. You’ll be able to graciously take on big responsibilities and so you will make much bigger accomplishments.

☍ You are able to draw in fortunate opportunities and resourceful people. Your reliable personality can also leave a strong first impression on others, so you gain support from authority figures easily as well.

☍ Your skills & talents can bring you a lot of fame, especially your daring yet down-to-earth personality can win people over to your side. This aspect, however, will make you work extra harder to keep your over-confidence in check, so humility & grace will have to be your best friends, this way you can reach your goals without over-powering others or skipping steps and be able to maintain your position.

☍ You’ll likely work hard to attain your goals; learn to be grateful for all your lucky-breaks & timely-blessings; use your charm & elegance to create many helpful connections; make inspiring works/services; create a pleasant family/home of your own where you can find comfort & joy; gain wealth, position, honor & prosperity through your business/public/career endeavors and hence fulfil your aspirations.


Jupiter Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ You will have to face your fears of rejection, abandonment, and/or even criticism before you can fully embrace your life purpose.

^ You might have deep insecurities, especially stemming from your childhood. You might have felt restricted or controlled in some way, or felt you were always under scrutiny.

^ You might have felt discouraged whenever you wished to pursue your talents or interests, even as small as your favorite hobbies. So, you might have grown up restricting your own freedom.

^ You have a well of talents & skills, even if they are academic or artistic, you’re fully capable of finding success in all your endeavors.

^ But, you’ll have to heal your inner child wounds in order to get to where you want. You might also be confused about what you want to do or what your true calling is. So, healing your inner self will help you reach the right conclusions and find a clear path to what brings you contentment in life.

^ You’re quite empathetic and so you might even be able to help others who may be going through similar inner-conflicts by being a friend, mentor or a guide. So, your inner healing can be an inspiring journey to others.

^ You might also need to pay attention to things that bring you joy and not just to others. You’ll have to find career(s)/business(s) that bring you excitement and allow you to explore the world, different cultures or studies, creativity, etc. Since, only endeavors that can make you expand your worldview can ever bring you satisfaction. 

^ Likewise, you will also need to follow your own calling and not just rely on others’ expectations. You will have to be careful not to seek outside validation with this aspect, since being true to yourself is the key to your fulfilment. 

^ Your skills & gifts are valuable, and this aspect will help you access your capabilities so you can put them to good use in your goals & aspirations. Your works can gain recognition and hence even bring you fame.

^ You’ll likely find your true calling by finding yourself and what makes you happy; self-acceptance will increase your self-esteem; inspiring others through your journey to success; gain wealth, prosperity, honor & position through your career/public/business endeavors and hence finding contentment in your life.



Jupiter Sextile Midheaven MC

✱ You find success in all your endeavors since you have clarity on the direction you need to take.

✱ You attract resourceful people & opportunities, since you’re always at the right place at the right time. 

✱ You have an optimistic mindset, especially about your own capabilities to achieve all your dreams & goals. So, you are able to face opposition/enemies without deterring from your path.

✱ You are genuinely humble, even your occasional arrogance gets a pass since you know when to be extra confident and when to be graceful. 

✱ This makes you grounded in reality, hence, you dream big but are also quite realistic with your approach. 

✱ You are a natural born leader, others see you as capable & brave, since you are able to take calculated risks & win big most of the time.

✱ You are even able to create helpful connections in both your private & professional life that can further add to your public image as popularity, or even fame.

✱ You’re positive & humorous not to mention wise & knowledgeable, so you are seen as an inspiring figure by others. 

✱ Your humility even through struggles, helps you to stay grounded & in high spirits. You know how to get back up with a smile on your face. So, you always rise above the obstacles & setbacks much quicker than most.

✱ You’ll likely make great progress on your goals through your impressive skills & capabilities; spread positivity & joy; create incredible works and inspire others; gain wealth, position, honor and prosperity following your inner calling hence finding fulfilment in all your accomplishments.


Jupiter Trine Midheaven MC

△ You have a great enthusiasm to accomplish your goals. Your positive mindset will always keep you on your toes.

△ This eagerness also brings you a lot of opportunities, since you seek to attract situations & people who can help you attain your goals much easier & quicker.

△ You know how to work hard & smart; you are also patient & methodical in your approach to career/business endeavors.

△ You are humble enough to take criticisms and serious enough to put oppositions/enemies in their place. In a way, your positive mindset also brings you protection from competitors and any harm they may wish to do.

△ You can overcome all setbacks & obstacles through your sheer determination. You see no way but up, since you always search for the silver-lining in any situation.

△ You have a responsible personality, and so you can gain the trust of others easily, especially helpful in making a good first impression. This also helps you form beneficial connections, further improving your professional & public reach.

△ You take every opportunity with gratitude. Since, you are as humble as you are courageous.

Your skills and capabilities help you to create incredible works/services, gaining you a lot of recognition.

△ Your successes might also seem inspiring to others, making you a notable figure in your professional field. You might even be sought by others to be a mentor/guide.

△ You might also attain fame through your career/business endeavors since you have an influential presence. 

△ You’ll likely overcome setbacks & oppositions with grace; create incredible works/services and inspire others; making impressive progress in your professional life; spreading positivity & joy; gain wealth, prosperity, position & honor through your successful business/career endeavors and hence find contentment on your life path.

entry.title: Natal Uranus and North Node Aspects ⭐️✨
entry.content:
Uranus Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node

^ You know restlessness like nobody else. You are both friends and enemies all at the same time.

^ You have a Deep sense of destiny that drives you across boundaries, up the mountains, and into the seas.

^ You might have a sudden awakening to your purpose, like a flash of divine inspiration.

^ You have ideas and insights that come from seemingly nowhere. But all this can happen only when you give-in to your intuitive urges.

^ You have a strong intuition, may be even psychic gifts that seem to guide you to unusual places, situations and people. These callings might seem scary at first or even make you question your sanity, but if you’re brave enough to heed your soul’s truest voice (not your doubts & worries, which is part of the challenge with this aspect), you might just find something incredible.

^ You might even be able to create things that the world never knew it needed. It could be technology, arts, science or just simple solutions to complicated social issues. Your visions and purpose will keep evolving and taking new forms that will fit the changing times and possibly even create trends by themselves.

^ You find genius in simple things. This gives you the ability to see beyond what anybody else can, to see opportunities in failures. So, you might reach unimaginable heights in no time. But there may be instances where you will have to take a break, to rest your mind & body from all the heavy intellectual over-drive. 

^ You might have highs and lows in your excitement, with breakthroughs after breakthroughs, or dull silence for months. So, you might have to learn how to pace your works, even if they’re intuitive and you have no control over them. When you find an outlet to your genius, you will have to be Patient with others to catch up to you, since it might be too much for them to comprehend all at once. So, you will encounter disapprovals & rejections before your visions are accepted & praised.

^ This aspect might however prompt you to take “being a rebel to a whole new level”, which could prove to be for better or for worse. You must be careful since you can become too persuasive, and instead tick off people who initially were willing to listen. 

^ You’ll likely have to look destiny in the eyes, may be in the most darkest time of your life to wake up to a whole new world of your own making; inspire others to follow their inner calling even with the risks & disapprovals since self-belief is the key to genius; create incredible works/services that add to the imagination & curiosity of others; learning how to direct your excitement & intensity into well-paced productivity; believe in others to recognize the importance of your works/services and not lose patience too easily; following your inner callings and bringing your visions into existence.


Uranus Conjunct North Node

☌ You are a creative & an intellectual genius. Although not many are able to appreciate your findings, solutions, creations or even inventions right away.

☌ You feel intuitively guided towards things, people and experiences that change your perception of reality as you once knew it.

☌ You are encouraged to break rules and restrictions that intend to confine you when you are fully ready to follow your soul's calling. Since, this is one of your lessons in life, to discern which rules are important and which ones only are holding people back from discovering themselves.

☌ You have an almost intuitive knowledge about technology, science, mathematics, psychology, astrology or the internet, etc. You can integrate them into your life purpose and create impressive works/services.

☌ You are driven to succeed in life, even when you don't have a clear understanding of what you want to do, you intuitively know that you can make your visions a reality.

☌ You might have psychic gifts too. You have a spiritual blend to your personality that helps you stay grounded. Especially since your impulsivity and intense nature can be damaging to your physical and mental health if not well-regulated by mindfulness, meditation, periodic breaks, and rests.

☌ You know how to find solutions to long standing problems/issues, since you are more focused on the root cause than any other distracting details that most would get caught up in. 

☌ You have a strong desire to bring peace and happiness into the world, so your intentions & opinions always get huge approvals from others, which means you have an impactful personality. So, you can be popular for your accomplishments, selfless services and activism.

☌ You form strong bonds with your family/friends and acquaintances even if not on a deep emotional level. Since, you always seek like-minded people who just get you. Their encouragement and support give you extra inspiration to do more.

☌ You will likely find your purpose in unexplained ways and take the leap of faith to explore it; create incredible & innovative works/services; inspiring others re-evaluate the conventions of the world; bring people together for worthy & important causes; promote positivity, creativity, equality & peace; following your soul's calling and reaching higher than you ever imagined before.



‌Uranus Trine North Node

△ You have an immense amount of self-belief that helps you find your life purpose.

△ You somehow know what you want to achieve in life, so you will find a way, any way to make it happen since you are driven to succeed at all costs.

△ You find strength in yourself and your capabilities, since you are confident in your skills. You are willing to learn more and refine your talents. 

△ You have a strong determination to break free from things that seem to be holding you back, and this intention easily manifests as opportunities and people that will help you in finding your way out.

△ You can blend your intuitive gifts with that of your talents in technology very well, and so you can make incredible works that exude creativity.

△ You have a deep desire to help others, so you might create unique solutions and services to solve societal, economical or other issues regarding inequities.

△ You break rules with no remorse, since you know the importance of change and independence. So, you value your independence since it's an integral part of your personality. Freedom and peace are your greatest inspirations.

△ This individualistic personality even reflects in your personal relationships, with friends and family. You make deep emotional bonds with people and always uphold your promises. 

△ Your non-conformity attracts a lot of people's attention. Your ideas can spark a light inside people who may get profoundly inspired. You have a serious impact on other's lives and their mindsets, since in a way you introduce them to a new way of thinking. This influencing factor can also bring you popularity.

△ You will likely take leaps that most people would be scared to, even so you end up landing on your feat discovering a totally new path to success; realize that the key to your success is originality; make your visions a reality through your sheer will & inner desire to succeed, in a way manifesting your success into life; create enduring bonds with others and inspiring many through your unique perspective; following your life path through the guidance of your intuition where you feel like a force beyond human imagination is helping you fulfil your destiny.


Uranus Sextile North Node

✱ You are intuitively guided towards your destined path. You have the inner desire to take the leap of faith and go with the flow.

✱ You don’t settle for less, that includes from yourself as well. So, you work hard on your visions and bring them into reality through your own dedication.

✱ You like to stay updated with the current trends since it comes easily to you. You constantly refine your skills and talents, since in the process you find the perfect breakthroughs that helps you on your next achievement.

✱ Your curiosity helps you take risks that most wouldn’t. This in itself sets you up for success.

✱ Your unique perspective helps you come up with incredible ideas & your insights can have a profound effect on others, hence introducing them to a whole new way of thinking.

✱ You have a fine-tuned intuition that gives you incredible manifesting skills. You naturally attract people, opportunities and situations that can elevate you on your life path.

✱ You don’t mind being misunderstood, if anything, you might enjoy the thrill of being a rebel sometimes.

✱ You can form important bonds with people who will play a significant role in your life. Since their encouragement and support helps you say grounded.

✱ Your ability to adapt to intense life changes can be quite impressive since you seem to live a chaotically inspiring life with many twists and turns that seem to be taking you on an Adventure. But this high life can take a toll on your physical & mental health eventually. So, periodic breaks, meditation, mindfulness, etc. may be vital for your well-being.

✱ You’ll likely take risks and win big when you are listening to your intuition & not your fears; find ways to fulfil your visions; inspire others to break rules that need change; following your soul’s calling to be free and courageous.



Uranus Square North Node

□ This aspect might help you reach your life purpose even through all the resistance & doubts you may initially show.

□ You might be incredibly driven to succeed but not know where to direct your determination towards.

□ You might focus more on things that don’t work for you, like an opportunity that you thought was good for you, but you were rejected, for example. But you might keep trying again and again thinking you must persevere.

□ But you might soon realize that there’s a much better path for you, that truly aligns with your talents & gifts.

□ You might not fully trust your intuition and its guidance at first, but you will eventually see things unfold all on their own, sometimes in painful or harsh ways.

□ When sudden events sweep you away towards a new direction, you might feel completely ungrounded and so you might try to cling to what worked in your past.

□ In a way, being swept by a tidal wave of sudden events that changed your enter world almost overnight might start to seem more and more exciting over time.

□ Once you start adjusting to all the craziness, you might start to understand what your true calling is. This realization might be cathartic even.

□ You will adapt to your purpose rather quickly fully embracing your calling. Your destiny can involve you breaking rules without even realizing it. With all your ingenuity, you will be rewarded with opportunities to create incredible works of innovation. You might even become well-known for all your unique accomplishments, since you are a one of a kind, and you own it unapologetically.

□ You’ll likely encounter events that change your entire perspective on life, helping you create enduring success through the power of your originality; inspiring others to embrace life’s changes with confidence & optimism; following your life path heeding your soul’s calling and trusting in the divine forces to guide you to your destiny.


Uranus Opposition North Node

☍ You have a great intuition, and you trust your inner guidance. But you can go against your insight sometimes due to lack of clarity in your life’s direction.

☍ You might have been extremely individualistic in your childhood that could have given you a sense of freedom, but you might fear losing that when you need to change perspectives in life during your early adulthood.

☍ So you might cling on to your former Lifestyle and refuse to take on new opportunities that may bring you out of this comfort zone.

☍ You might however be pulled through your fears and right into your true purpose in life. Sudden events can put you at the right place at the right time to discover your destiny, which will eventually ignite a spark inside of you.

☍ You might start to rediscover a completely new person, you. You will ease into the changes and go with the flow even when you feel ungrounded,

☍ Your innate skills and talents, especially those you honed in your childhood days can become important in fulfilling your calling, and you might integrate them into your work creating incredible things.

☍ In the process, you might also realize that the freedom you were trying to protect was only holding you back in a way, since your true calling can introduce you to higher levels of Independence where you will be celebrated for your uniqueness.

☍ You might face challenges as tests of faith, and endure rejections/disapprovals on your path, but you’ll find peace in your efforts and creations that will eventually gain a lot of support.

Through all the craziness and how your life changed for the better, you will realize that your self-belief is also what allows you to invest in your life’s purpose, since you know you have a higher force guiding you on your path. 

☍ By learning how to break your own self-restrictions you will understand the need to evolve with life’s changes. So, your successes will also inspire a lot of people to embrace change and take risks to break out of their comfort zones.

☍ You’ll likely re-invent yourself & your visions by embracing the positive shifts in your life; create incredible & unique works/services; inspiring others to be original & optimistic; spread positivity and happiness; following your life’s calling and trusting in the divine detours.

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid and your Life Calling / Career 💫✨
entry.content:
Sirene Placement in your Natal Chart can indicate to your Calling in Life, hence this Asteroid placement can also indicate to Career(s) that can be both fulfilling & successful. This placement is not only be just about attracting Opportunities, People or Recognition, but also allowing your Inner most Desires to guide you towards your most Gratifying Goals, Ambitions & Passions in life. This is especially true if you have close Conjunctions (0º to 4º orb) to your Natal Planets, Ascendant, North Node, Midheaven and/or Part of Fortune. Hence, in addition to the Sign & House, Sirene’s Conjunction(s) and other Major Aspects to significant placements in your Natal Chart can indicate to Incredible Potential for Career Success, mainly through your own Innate Talents & Gifts. You might realize with especially the Close Conjunctions with certain Placements in your chart (but can also include other Major Aspects like Square, Sextile, Opposition & Trine + 0°), you are likely already involved in a Career relating strongly to that Placement, Sign, House &/or Degree. A general array of careers you can choose based on this alone is listed below. 


Sun + Leo + 5H + 5º 17º 29º

You likely feel drawn towards careers that can have a strong pull over your heart. Entertainment, Theatre, Acting & Arts, Music, Fashion Modeling, Designing, Social Media, etc. where you can showcase your Creative Talents will bring Recognition & Fame. Politics, Entrepreneurship, Managerial positions, Government jobs/positions, etc. can appeal to your Leadership qualities. Adventure Sports, Athletics, Travel & Exploration, Gaming industry, etc. can also be interesting Career fields that bring both Excitement & Success.  


Moon + Cancer + 4H + 4º 16º 28º

You are a natural Hard worker, Healer & a strong Support system. Careers that involve building, managing, or Marketing houses, Family Business and Home-based projects can be quite lucrative, along with careers in art, creativity, spirituality, medicine, nursing & care-giving. Food & Nutrition, products/services for Women & Children, Day/Foster care, etc. can be some of the careers that you are naturally drawn towards and can bring Abundance & Gratification.


Mercury + Gemini + Virgo + 3H + 6H + 3º 15º 27º 6º 18º

You have excellent Communication skills with a sharp Intellect. So, careers in Communication & Media, Arts & Music, Marketing, Journalism, Social media, Managerial positions, Teaching/Coaching, Bureaucracy, Government related jobs/positions, Trading, Travel & tourism, Public Speaking, Writing, Publishing, Community services, Social/Public services, Medicine, Veterinary, Animal care/shelter, Charity foundations, Science & Mathematics, Tech, etc. along with Finances and Entrepreneurial endeavors can be very lucrative & fulfilling.


Venus + Taurus + Libra + 2H + 7H + 2º 14º 26º 7º 19º 

Your sociable, intellectual & practical skills can find fulfillment in careers like Fashion, Designing, Modeling, Arts, Social Media, Entrepreneurial ventures, Managerial positions, Human resources, Counseling, Negotiations, Finances, Investment, Real Estate, etc. Agriculture, Family business, Law & Justice, Diplomat, Advocate, Marriage/Event Organizer, Public relations, etc. can be extremely Successful career choices that can lead to excellent standing in society, bringing balance & abundance. 


Mars + Aries + 1H + 1º 13º 25º

You generally have excellent Vitality, Inner Passion & Drive for Success. You are likely called towards careers in Athletics, Sports (muscle based & adventurous), Military, Law enforcement, etc. where you can utilize your muscle strength & strong determination, along with Politics, Modeling, Entrepreneurship, Managerial positions, Coaching, Manufacturing, Mechanics & Engineering, etc. where you can showcase your Authentic-self, take the lead and become a Trailblazer. 


Jupiter + Sagittarius + 9H + 9º 21º 

Your free-spirited yet morally grounded personality will seek careers that don’t feel too restrictive to your Personal Freedom yet is immensely Purposeful. Travel & Tourism, Exploration & Adventure, Foreign Enterprise, Trading, etc. can bring you a lot of fulfillment. Teaching, Mentoring, Research, Publishing, Science & Mathematics, Philosophy, Ethics, History, Archeology, Mythology, Theology, Astrology, etc. can invoke your vast Wisdom & Intellectual curiosity. Social Media, Journalism, Politics, Government jobs/positions, Law & Judiciary, Bureaucracy, Advocacy, Charity, etc. can bring good acclaim, achievements & abundance.


Saturn + Capricorn + 10H + 10º 22º

Your Self-discipline, Determined & Practical Personality is drawn towards careers that involve Leadership, Intense Focus, Responsibility & Reliability. Government jobs/positions, Politics, Teacher/Guide/Mentor, Managerial positions, Entrepreneurship, Agriculture, Finances, Investment, Global Markets, Manufacturing, Industry, Military & Law, Bureaucracy, etc. can bring a deeper Sense of Purpose and hence help you reach your Higher Ambitions gaining Power, Wealth & Acclaim in the process. 


Uranus + Aquarius + 11H + 11º 23º

You have an excellent Vision for the future and the exceptional Will to create an innovative & unique future. Science & Mathematics, Research, Psychology, Exploration & Expedition, Internet & Social Media, Tech, Aeronautics & Aviation, Astrology, etc. will invoke your Natural curiosity and Latent talents (even bringing Fame). Finances, Social Networking, Investments, Banking, Global Share Markets, etc. can also be lucrative and bring much success. Charity Foundations, Social Services, Activism, etc. can be fulfilling.


Neptune + Pisces + 12H + 12º 24º 

Helping others and being of service is such a vital part of your calling. With your compassionate & mystical approach to life & career, you can find success in Spiritual, Mysticism, Altruistic, or Medicine and other Healing professions. Charities, Activism & other Fund Raising efforts can bring a Sense of Gratification. You can also be drawn towards Therapy, Nursing, Care-giving, etc. Acting & Arts, Music, Modeling, Photo/Videography, etc. can invoke your Artistic skills. Marine, Fishing, Weather & Environmental Sciences, Brewery, Prison & Medical Institute related jobs along with Pharmaceutics & other Medical Manufacturing fields can be interesting careers that bring you closer to your Higher Purpose.


Pluto + Scorpio + 8H + 8º 20º

Your mystical, alluring & intellectual qualities can draw you towards careers that either many are very much interested in or those that many would rather refrain from. Paramedics, Surgical medicine, Forensics, Emergency services, Sex therapy & Medical care, Investigative fields, Research, Pharmaceutics, Psychology, Neuroscience, Therapy & Counseling, Spiritual Arts & Healing, Mysticism, Astrology, etc. can bring your Unique & Special talents into the forefront. Military, Secret & Intelligence services, Government positions, Politics, etc. can also be intriguing career choices. Finances, Banking, Investment, Share markets, etc. can invoke your natural Business-acumen helping you gain Power, Wealth & Security.

entry.title: Saturn Retrograde in Pisces 🗝️✨ June 29 to Nov 15, 2024
entry.content:
Rebalancing Karma, ☯️ Re-Stabilizing Life. 


Auspicious time to naturally end old cycles & begin anew. Major endings in tough cycles & life lessons (especially karmic). Donations & other such charities can bring a sense of spiritual gratification. This can also mean that we need to “clean house” in our life. 🧹 Likewise, tying up loose ends in certain situations can prove to be counterproductive if we haven’t fully learnt the lessons &/or we aren’t being honest about the situation. 


Only patching things up or sweeping things under the rug without fully contemplating the lessons can backfire on us. 🪐 in ♓️ will only make it harder for us to move onto a new stage in our lives if we haven’t done the necessary work & introspection. So, these next few months can bring opportunities to genuinely fix said situations, to do & be done with your part of the responsibilities (which can be the same for others involved as well). 


This is the time to deal with complicated issues one step at a time, with patience & persistence. Delays can slow us down significantly, but also help us gain clear perspective on how to move forward in those areas more effectively. 🐘 Facing fears & insecurities. Self-reflection will be inescapable for the next year or two indeed. 🧘🏻‍♀️


Careful with the kind of contracts that you are signing, it can be long term & burdensome or fulfilling, so pay extra attention to the commitments you are willing to make around this time. Great time to end old burdensome contracts (legal and/or karmic) ⛓️‍💥 and begin new chapters that bring more peace & tranquility. Revisit old projects (especially if unfinished or not up-to your satisfaction before) and breathe new life into them. Wonderful time to commit to work, career & personal goals. Also good for shadow-work, trauma recovery & therapy. 


Reaching a new stage in life 🗝️ Renewed commitment to success on all levels.

entry.title: Ceres 🌾✨ Mythology x Astrology of Asteroids
entry.content:
Ceres is the Roman Goddess of agriculture, nurturing and fertility. She is the Greek equivalent of Demeter, so she is the daughter of Saturn and Ops, with Jupiter, Neptune, Pluto, Juno & Vesta as her siblings. She is one of the central figures of important mythological events although she is not involved in many stories. She was widely worshipped by the Greeks (as Demeter) and later Romans as she was believed to be the benevolent goddess of agriculture and harvest. She has many temples, rituals, festivals, and cults in her honor. She is worshipped as the goddess who protects crops, for fertility of the soil, a bountiful harvest, etc. She is mostly known for her motherly love and generosity. She is often depicted with agricultural tools in one hand and with wheat, fruits or grains in the other. She was also associated with Mother Earth since she was the reason humankind could cultivate, grow food and continue to live peacefully. 


One of the most famous stories in mythology is said to be of Proserpina (Persephone)’s abduction by Pluto (Hades). Proserpina was the daughter of Ceres & Jupiter, she was closely associated to her mother for being the goddess of spring, flowers and vegetation. Jupiter seemed to have promised his brother one of his daughters as his bride. When Pluto sees Proserpina, he falls in love instantly and does everything he can to win her approval. (In one of the interpretations) Ceres refuses to marry her daughter to Pluto since he was the God of the Underworld and Proserpina belonged on the land where she is likely to be happier in the bountiful beauty of life. It is also believed that Ceres was an overprotective mother who couldn’t let her daughter go even when Proserpina accepted Pluto’s love and was willing to marry him. With Ceres’s rejection, Pluto now anxious gets Jupiter’s help to abduct Proserpina and take her to the underworld with him as his bride. 


Ceres finds out that her daughter is missing and goes out to search for her daughter. She roams the earth for many seasons without a trace of her daughter. Since she is the goddess of fertility and harvest, her distress and absence made the world go barren. Soon all life on earth started to suffer and slowly perish. Other Gods and Goddesses start to get concerned about the whole situation, so they ask Jupiter to convince Ceres to return to her duties as the nurturer and fertility goddess. Ceres refuses to do so and demands to have her daughter back. Jupiter tries to reason with her and comes to a compromise that Proserpina can spend half of the year on earth with Ceres and the rest with Hades. Ceres though reluctant accepts and thus reunites with her daughter every year. This is how spring starts when Proserpina comes to the land, when she leaves to the underworld to her husband, is when winter ensues, and so the seasons are described through mythology. 


Here, we can clearly see how the goddess of harvest and agriculture is not only responsible for the nourishment of humanity but also for its protection from famine. Hence, Ceres is a key deity in the Greek/Roman times and so she is often worshipped alongside her daughter with offerings of flowers, grains, and sacrifices of pigs, etc. She is thus associated with growth, preservation and renewal of life. Through her connection to the underworld, she is also believed to protect the souls of children and others who died prematurely or with unfortunate circumstances. Thus, she is one of the central deities with much power and influence in the Greek/Roman society. She is worshipped before and after harvest times, during wedding & funeral ceremonies, for protection of crops, health and prosperity.


In astrology, Ceres is one of the key asteroids (now dwarf planet) in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter. Ceres in the natal chart often represents your feminine & motherly urges, over-protectiveness, generosity, etc.

It can represent:

How you nurture yourself.

How you express your motherly love and compassion.

Your relationship with your mother/maternal figures.

How (or if) you received motherly love and what made you feel safe.

How positive/negative is the role of maternal figures in your life.

How you show compassion and empathy to others.

How you protect/preserve those you love.

Where you feel over-protective and possessive about what you love.

How you nurture your loved ones, especially those under your care & protection, like kids, pets, family, etc.

What is your relationship to food and nutrition.

What nourishes your soul and inner child.

How connected are you to your inner child, and how you can heal your inner child.

Where/How you feel drawn to save those who are helpless, like children, animals, etc.

Where you feel robbed emotionally/physically (usually when retrograde).

Where you find it hard to accept the loss of something/someone dear to you.

Where you are admired for being a strong yet compassionate person.

Where you are regarded as a benevolent individual.

Where you will be called to embrace & heal your divine feminine energy (regardless of your gender or sexual orientation).

How/where your emotional intelligence will help your loved ones.

Where you will be expected to make sacrifices for the sake of your loved ones’ happiness.

Where you will have to be careful not to harm your loved ones through your over-protectiveness, etc.


Hence, Ceres is considered as the ultimate mother figure in both mythology and astrology. Nourishment, care & compassion are key representations of this asteroid in the chart, whereas over-protectiveness, possessiveness and misplaced anger are its shadow sides. This placement can also show your role in the lives of your loved ones through how you take care of them and love them unconditionally. So, you can find your own motherly side as well as the role motherly figures played in your life. This is also the placement that tells a lot about self-love, where you can understand how to heal & nurture your inner child.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Gemini (3rd House) Generation 🐚✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)



Natal Saturn in Gemini (3rd House) Generation 🐚✨

Saturn in Gemini/3rd house can make you an intellectual and resilient person. You have a way with words, and you have a way with silence. You have a more mature view on life due to the tough lessons you had to learn during your childhood. You might have felt coldness or distance from your family either due to circumstances or other serious issues. You might even have siblings that you look up to (or look up to you), on the other hand, you might not be able to connect emotionally with your siblings (family members in general) with ease. Your parents may have been restrictive especially when it came to you speaking your mind. They may have also been very serious about your education. You might also have had to study harder than others since you felt uncomfortable during your early education. 


You might have had to overcome many insecurities regarding schooling and studies. You might have been extremely studious, or you struggled to keep your grades up, either way, you had to develop self-discipline in order to succeed during your schooling. You might have been blessed with great teachers, but you might have also encountered extremely strict ones. You might have had trouble with your early friendships, who may have given you a hard time in some way. You might have met true friends later on who became an important part of your life, making long lasting bonds. You like to keep your friends circle tight even if they are few. You might have had to learn how to stay focused since multi-tasking in the beginning might have overwhelmed you, but with time you might have learnt how to efficiently manage several tasks with ease. 


Although you like the thrill of multi-tasking, you might still prefer to do things one at a time especially since you value the quality of work you put out. You might dislike the idea of wasting time, be it with projects, tasks, careers, or even connections. You have a sharp intellect. You are a keen observer; you prefer to listen a lot more than to speak. You might have had trouble with your voice, speaking or issues related to throat/limbs in some way that may have made you self-conscious. With time and maturity, you might have learnt how powerful your mind is, especially since you are precise in everything you say and do. You might have had to learn how to speak up for yourself and make your opinions knows, which may have been a form of restriction since your childhood. 


You might have also felt neglected when you tried to voice your concerns or ideas. There may have been certain fears and insecurities from your childhood that have become deep inner wounds that might have to heal and recover from. Negative self-talk can be your biggest enemy, especially since 3rd House/Gemini rules your mind. Hence, keeping your mindset positive and undoing any self-limiting beliefs will help you immensely. You might often feel attacked when criticized, you might also have been subjected to unfair criticism and you definitely hate unsolicited advice by others. You can be a harsh critique yourself, especially when you are overcome by emotions of inadequacy. 



You might have to be careful not to hurt others’ feelings or undermine their efforts when you are not feeling your best, just the way you wouldn’t want others to do the same to you. You have a depth of knowledge that others might seek, question, belittle or appreciate, but through all that, you will have to always believe in yourself and your capabilities. You might be good at research-based studies/work, you have an eye for details, and you always seek the truth in everything. You respect truthfulness and you might even despise those who are known to lie. You might not like small talks, gossips and indulging in rumors. 


You are an excellent communicator, but you might have had trouble accepting it for most part of your early life. You might even be good with handicrafts, if not you might be interested in works that need intricate detailing. You might even take up serious and rather difficult subjects like mathematics, science and technology that can stimulate your eager mind. You might not like public speaking, writing or expressing your skills that get a lot of attention. But you might feel a need to focus on improving your stage fear and embracing the admiration that comes with your work. You might even challenge yourself to learn one of these skills that you might have been afraid to try before. You might feel as though you have a calling to teach others. You might consider either to become a teacher professionally or find other means to guide people like blogging, workshops, seminars, tutorials, etc. 


You have a very particular taste when it comes to your surroundings, you might not like untidy places and prefer to keep your house clean, likewise you might prefer to live in a modest neighborhood. You might even consider moving to better locations everything you feel you need a level up in your life. You have a good grasp on finances, you can easily learn different ways of managing money. You might also be good with learning new skills be it writing, driving, swimming, etc. You are artistic and so can develop skills like singing, dancing, painting, crafting, sculpting, etc. You might find traveling to be either a hassle or a liberating feeling. 


You are shrewd and talented. You are strategic, patient and persistent. You can do well in careers related to Gemini/3rd House themes. Saturn here can make you an excellent teacher, artist, marketer, financier, etc. Avoiding scams, indulging in unnecessary rumors, rude behaviors, misleading others, misinformation, etc. aka, Gemini/3rd House’s trickster tendency will save you from Saturn’s harsh judgement karmically (likewise, you will be protected karmically from such fraudulent crimes/people). With this placement, being truthful will be your karmic duty.

New Moon
in Leo 12° ♌️🌑


Spark of inspiration. Clarity in confusing situations. Optimism. Insights to improving your well-being and self-esteem. Natural increase in self-confidence. 🤩 Relief from internal conflicts.

This New Moon brings a sigh of relief (momentarily) from the ongoing tense Saturn x Jupiter Square. Passions ignited. New goals, new expectations, new frontiers to conquer. Things will tense up until the next Full Moon in Aquarius, so the ♌️🌑’s boost in energy will give us the necessary momentum to keep our spirits up. This will be a firecracker kind of Month 🎇. Fabulous Leo Season of the year indeed.

Careful with health related matters. Pay attention to your sensitivities. Prioritize mental health & overall wellbeing. Take your time & slow things down until you can recharge your mind, body & spirit before moving onto any (new) project or plan. Schedule your days & organize your tasks when you feel overwhelmed. Wonderful time for get-togethers. 🫖 Meet ups with Friends, Family & Loved ones, especially those that you couldn’t meet with for a while now. Great time to organize business schedules & to attend career development sessions. Learning new skills or revision of old courses can be rewarding. entry.title: Natal Lilith Conjunct Sun ✨
entry.content:
You are Intense, Dramatic & Self-Empowered. You make a strong & striking First Impression, even when you feel unseen or ignored, you are not. Something about you speaks volumes, like a Quite Power that can take over everything if its left unnoticed. You are extremely passionate, a true force to be reckoned with. This aspect hence gives a level of Mystical Clarity about your Life Purpose, as Lilith’s Intuition aligns with your Sun’s Identity. This of course can make you so much more Powerful, Intense & Self-Confident, thereby also making you intimidating to others. Your Sensual & Sexual Intensity can also become a major part of your Personality, depending on how responsibly you use it, it can also become your Core Strength. 


As our Sun can indicate to a fulfilling Career Path, with Lilith’s Conjunction, you are likely to be deeply connected to your Passions & Ambitions. There may be a bit of unconventionality to the way you approach your Career Life as well, be it the way you work or the profession you choose. Your Public & Professional Image will hence be filled with mystery, taboo or suspicion but certainly surprise. Your Intense Focus & Resilience will bring Incredible Success and Achievements in your chosen path. Abandoning this crucial part of you can however lead to immense dissatisfaction in Career and Life as a whole, so this Aspect will require you to be True to your Wants, Needs & Desires along with being Confident & Self-Assured to pursue those Ambitions unapologetically. 


You likely will have numerous opportunities & experiences that help you to develop a Strong Will Power & a Healthy Ego, a kind of Personality that can be both Powerful & Inspiring. Your ego will need your attention however since if you indulge in too much focus on yourself, you might become deluded by Power or Self-conceited. Here, your Shadow self may not be your enemy who wishes to sabotage or ruin you, but a powerful ally yet with deep wounds & fears who will need healing & empowerment. So, not letting your Wounded-self take over your Life will be a spiritual challenge. As this aspect will require you to understand your Shadow Self, thereby your deepest darkest fears, insecurities, weaknesses, etc. 


You will also have to recognize your deep buried Desires, Intense feelings, Talents, etc. Similarly with others, where you will be able to see their Shadow Self, whether they are self-aware about it or not. So through the influence of this aspect, you get to interact with others & their Shadow, also others consciously or sub-consciously interact with you & your Shadow. Through these experiences, whether pleasant or unpleasant, along with the actions of others & the consequences of your own, you will learn how to refine your Ego, Character and True Self. This hence is an aspect that is best explained through this quote, “Every gold has to pass through fire before it can shine”. 


Lilith & Sun Conjunction gives an edge to your character, a presence that can invoke extreme emotions in others. This can be jealousy, envy, hate or anger. A strange inability to understand you for who you are, especially when you present your True Self. You likely have a history of being targeted, especially when you try to express yourself. Everybody want you to abandon your true self. They will work overtime to make sure that you willingly disconnect yourself from your true self. This can be through bullying, hazing, or to the extremes of harassment & victimization. Trauma that penetrates your Core Identity, where you feel like the only way to handle the initial shock is to abandon yourself. This is also where you learn how to transform yourself, to the point where you get to discover who you truly are and to get in touch with your Inner Power. 


The healing process may seem crude and even unconventional on the outside, as it is unbearably intense, the trauma & the wound is just that deep. But, the person you emerge out as on the other side of that process is downright ‘invincible’. Lilith is the point of projection, so you go through a phase in your life where you are the black sheep, you are the scapegoat. You are almost too perfect to these people who just don’t want to see everything that you are, that which they are not within themselves. On the other hand, when you stand strong on your convictions and insist on expressing your True Self, in the best of situations you are likely to inspire many who will respect & admire your authenticity.


Your Inner Feminine Dark energy is so apparent to others, it is just too intimidating, imagine the Dark side of the Moon (although that isn’t what Lilith represents, but it might as well). There is so much Raw Power, Intensity & Mystery… it’s Pure Magic. In many ways, this is your gift, so owning your Raw Feminine energy will ultimately transform you into an Alluring, Mystical, and Incredible being, almost Other-worldly. Often times, this is what those people, places or things, whoever or whatever they are, tried to suppress and outcast. So, the healing transformation process brings out all this Natural Power that is within you in order for you to amalgamate into your Core Identity, making you a Force of Nature itself. You will hence develop all the necessary skills & resources to stand up for yourself, and not let anyone treat you any less than you deserve.


Of course, this can play out in the other way around, where those with Lilith Sun Conjunction often use their darkest deepest insecurities and project them onto others, creating all the drama & trauma in their wake. With Lilith it’s always about Self-recognition & Empowerment, so this aspect can play out either way. But ultimately, this is one of the most Powerful Aspects for Lilith, and a Purifying aspect in a chart with respect to one’s own Inner Femininity and Self-identity. It makes you extra Self-Assured, Independent & Passionate. This aspect in your chart will always end up demanding your attention towards it. It gives one the most mesmerizing yet almost untouchable presence when in a chart.


You will work towards owning your True Self and embracing your Divine Feminine Energy. Finding yourself through the chaos around you, and creating chaos to fully express yourself. Your Art, Self-Expression & Ambition will indeed draw the eire of those in authority & society in general (especially when also with Saturn’s Opposition or Square). Established conventions & societal norms don’t have any hold over you. That of course doesn’t mean you can abandon all morals and indulge in destructive vices & behaviors either. But, stepping out of the strict conformities and exploring the Potential within the Dark Feminine & Unconventional energy can bring incredible things into this your life & into this world.


Thereby, bringing wonderful new Art & Self-expression, Leadership qualities that inspire people to embrace their creativity, sexuality & passion without being tied down to senseless limitations. The way you embrace yourself and all that Raw Power & Passion will inevitably challenge limiting-beliefs of an overwhelmingly structured & unimaginative system, society or even civilization. Your Authentic Self & Presence can shake things up, especially when old & archaic foundations turn into walls that close in and restrict Personal Potential. This aspect hence will give you a rebellious streak, a feisty rebel with a cause. 


With such Power, you will also need to be responsible not to use it for self-gratification & destruction of good stability. Getting drunk on this power can only lead to Self-Destruction, as Lilith’s Intensity can delude Sun’s Core Identity when boundaries within get blurred or broken down. Use this aspect instead to Empower yourself & others, to challenge the status quo, fight for justice, and bring more Positivity & Fairness. This aspect will bestow many wonderful Talents & Gifts, giving you all the right tools & abilities to handle extremes highs & lows, challenges & victories that will help you transform into your Uniquely Adept, Strong Willed, Resilient, Intense & Mesmerizing Self.

entry.title: Natal Saturn in Cancer (4th House) Generation 🐝✨
entry.content:
Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Cancer (4th House) Generation 🐝✨

Saturn can feel a little uncomfortable in its opposite sign/house of ruler ship. Your childhood, right off the bat, was a significant time of your life, regardless of how many disappointments or enjoyable moments you might have experienced, your early years may have had a profound effect on your mindset and world view. You might have felt pressured to live up to a certain standard, take on more responsibilities, shoulder your household’s burdens, take care of family members or watch them struggle through physical or mental health problems, issues with financial and emotional stability at home, etc. Parents might have played an important and sometimes imposing role. Even if you were born into a wealthy or well-to-do family, you might have experienced a sense of overpowering presence of your parents or other family members whether they meant any harm or not. 


Either due to lack of expressive early interactions or trauma inducing experiences, you might have been conditioned to not express yourself and your feelings without being overly cautious. With maturity, you might come to terms with such inner wounds and resolve them in order to become more comfortable in your own skin, not to mention to acknowledge your emotions without guilt or remorse. You might have a hard time letting go of things and people, sometimes out of fear or abandonment issues. This might make you seem a little over possessive or even controlling. 


Radical acceptance is also something you might have to master in order not to make things toxic in your relationships or to let go of such relationships that no longer serve your highest good, since holding onto something that is not healthy or a relationship that has run its course can be detrimental to everyone involved. There may have been loses of property, money, loved ones, etc. that may have triggered such deep fear of abandonment, which with time and maturity, you will find acceptance in. Saturn here can also indicate to an absent parent(s), either physically or emotionally. You might have even been away from home due to early education and other circumstances, or you might have felt stuck and restricted in your home/town when you were young.


Your immediate environment, close relationships, interests, etc. can also affect your general health and nutrition. Forming a strong emotional foundation can help you not to overlook your health, since mood swings or other stress inducing situations can affect your eating habits and well-being drastically. Saturn will expect you to be disciplined in your approach to such vital topics. Self-care, rest & relaxation, balanced diet, exercise, etc. on a regular basis can help you with your physical and mental health. You are a passionate lover; you are loyal and immersive when in love. You wish to establish a secure foundation built on faith and support with your partner. 



You are protective of your family and loved ones, you might even wish to be the one that they look up to. You are reliable and are always ready to help those in need. Charity and community related services can give you a sense of pride. Women and children especially play a significant role in your life. You might be extremely proud of them, or women in general may walk into your life to teach important lessons (be it good or bad), sometimes you might even feel duty bound to these feminine figures as a guide or support system. Your mother might have been the dominant parent that you either looked up to or resented depending on your childhood experiences. You might have had to take care of your parent(s) in some way, either financially or due to health reasons. 


You might feel extra protective of your children. If you felt lack of emotional or financial support growing up, you might pledge to yourself to give your kids everything they need to never feel that way. You might feel a strong need to create a safe and secure foundation for them, provide them with good upbringing, education, etc. It is however advised not to become over-possessive with your loved ones, since with this placement, they may grow resentful if you come off as being controlling or domineering. You might not be a family-person depending on your experiences and preferences (also aspects and other placements), since Saturn here can also make one reluctant to commitments either due to fear or lack of inner satisfaction. But you still have close knit friendships that are like your family. 


Career is a big part of not just your financial but also your emotional security. You might be invested in your career and base your personal satisfaction on your professional success. You are an excellent communicator; you form resourceful contacts and surround yourself with reliable acquaintances. You might have creative and artistic talents, shrewd in business/financial dealings, interested in a wide range of hobbies, etc. You might be spiritual or even psychic, making you humble and grounded. You are extremely skilled and dutiful. You also hold everyone accountable for their actions. You might be handed big responsibilities at a very young age, or you might have felt the need to make strict changes growing up in certain areas of your life that may have made you develop a strong sense of duty. 



You feel the most secure when you are working hard on your passions, you feel the happiest when you are helping others. Although sometimes, duty in itself might become burdensome. You might even resent certain circumstances in your life that always seem to keep you bound to something or someone, be it family, business, career, region, etc. On the flip side, you might be extremely loyal to your family, lineage, country, heritage, etc. Either way, you are loyal to your cause, whether you like it or not, you take all responsibilities seriously. You like to be secure in all of your relationships and dealings. 


You might work hard to finally own a house/property or help re/build a family business, take care of your heritage, etc. You easily feel stressed if you sense there is even a slight sense of danger to your financial stability or a small shake up in your income, since financial security is extremely important to you. With diligence and persistence, you are likely to build a solid financial foundation for yourself and your loved ones. You have the same attitude towards your family dynamics, you feel easily frustrated if there is a slight change in your loved ones’ behaviors or if there are small disagreements. You might have to deal with any inner child issues that may be causing you to over analyze such situations, since there may be a tendency to overreact or exaggerate their words and misunderstand their actions out of insecurities, there by rocking the peace and straining an otherwise healthy relationship unnecessarily. 


If you ever catch yourself being overly cautious or repeating patterns of over possessiveness, etc. it may be a good chance to heal your inner child wounds. On the other hand, if you find yourself in toxic or dangerous relationships but struggle to move on or leave such situations, you will have to be honest about what true happiness and love means to you. Saturn here can help you break negative patterns and generational curses. Patterns, mindsets and habits of all kinds become a prime focus; hence any negative attachment or repetitive behaviors may become progressively dangerous to deal with, sometimes forcing you to change such mindsets, move on and adapt better and more empowering experiences. Emotional intelligence and maturity are extremely painful yet valuable lessons of this placement.

entry.title: Natal Uranus Retrograde ✨
entry.content:
Your biggest fear might be that of being stuck in a repetitive phase in life. You might have had childhood experiences where you felt trapped or restricted by traditions or other familial/social expectations. You might have lacked encouragement to express your individuality. But as you grew into your adulthood, you might have realized how being trapped in certain mindsets are not serving you anymore. 


You might decide to make sudden changes to your life’s direction, may be even abandon certain places/things/people in order to pursue your life purpose. Since your intense urge to break free from anything/anyone that are holding you back can feel like an inner calling. This can even manifest as emotional outbursts, or rebellious behaviors. 


In a way, you know your truth and you can’t restrict yourself anymore. You might also actively seek excitement to experience life to its fullest. You might have had certain fears or limiting beliefs about technology/science, which with time you become well-adapted to. So, you are also quite curious about new studies/interests/hobbies that can bring you more excitement through learning. 


You can even inspire others through your ingenuity, in a way, your rebelliousness can also motivate others to break free from their own restrictions. With sudden events & circumstances you become more adapted to change and its invaluable need to evolve beyond where you are & what more you can do.

entry.title: Natal Ascendant and North Node Aspects 🍀✨
entry.content:
Ascendant Opposite North Node

☍ You’re a hopeless romantic, yet you feel disconnected from your true emotions often, since you might mistake obsessions for connections.

☍ You might feel the pull towards people who will likely teach you many karmic lessons with regards to relationships, of all kinds.

☍ You might sometimes overlook your own needs in order to fulfil that of others’ and might get hurt in the process just to come back to self and feel unsatisfied. So, it becomes important to involve in win-win relationships and not in one-sided situations which only end in unrequitedness. 

☍ Your biggest lessons in life will be that of self-love that allows you to love others, without over-receiving or over-giving in relationships, especially on one-on-one basis, so this included romantic, platonic, business, familial, etc.

☍ You might have a strong ability to manifest favorable situations in your life, especially if it involves other people, as in collaborations, partnerships, public interests, etc.

☍ You might even be blessed with your perfect mate (especially if North Node is in 7H) or perfect work environment, social circles, etc. since NN is conjunct your Descendant. Although you might have to endure many karmic lessons & relationship dynamics that might leave you feeling pessimistic about your happily-ever-after. 

☍ These painful lessons however only help you realize what toxic patterns you may be over-looking, what your ideal love truly looks like and what it certainly isn’t, so you can make the necessary changes in order to attract and accept healthy-fulfilling relationships into your life.

☍ You’re likely popular, every-time you embrace your true self, instead of settling or wearing a mask of a certain personality. Since your integrity and a strong sense of self (SN Conjunct Asc) are key to how others see you. So, you gain fame and popularity organically & naturally. It is also important to learn the benefits of diplomacy, compromise & negotiation since you might be prone to anger or easily provoked by injustice (especially if SN is in 1H).

☍ You’ll have to understand the healthy balance of self & others in your life. Since your life purpose involves others for guidance/assistance/companionship but not as a necessity or bondage, so detaching from obsessive needs to be with others but instead creating trust-worthy and truthful connections with them will help you reach your highest potential all while helping them reach theirs.

☍ You’ll likely attain respect, honor, fame, prosperity, harmony, and balance in your life through strengthening significant connections and detaching from unhealthy ones, by realizing your self-worth and upholding the integrity of both yours and that of your loved ones’.


Ascendant Square North Node 

□ You might feel like if you wanted to go one way, life always goes the other.

□ There is often a sense of frustration and unrest with how you expect your life to be.

□ Although every missed opportunity, or unexpected U-turn, curve ball, and detour in your life led you to much better places/situations than you ever planned before.

□ You might have to deal with anger issues while facing such spiritual detours in life, since every-time your ego takes the blunt hit. 

□ So even when you end up in much favorable situations you might not be able to appreciate the blessings since you might get caught up in your ego.

□ Hence, it is important that you believe in yourself and your intentions, since your life path can be much more enjoyable if only you trust in all the things that didn’t work out for you and go with the flow.

□ This also helps you shift your view on life, what you thought was your destiny might be something you’ve already overcome (you might be looking at your SN instead of NN), since you have an even more incredible life purpose full of untapped potential waiting for you (NN).

□ This will also help you to detach yourself from pursuing things that may be hindering your growth and to realign your focus on things that bring you a sense of satisfaction. So, it’s important to follow through on your path and realize that the paths that show dead-ends and extreme resistance causing you frustrations might not be right for you, but the paths that challenge you, bring healthy obstacles, helping you reach your potential and hence fulfilment are the right ones for you. 

□ So, through all the ordeals & struggles, you might be able to learn how to discern what is your true purpose in life, and what isn’t part of your journey anymore.

□ You’ll likely attain a sense of purpose and direction, go through intense character development, reach your truest potential and hence fulfill your true goals & wishes in life.



Ascendant Inconjunct/Quincunx North Node 

^ You might have struggled to envision a greater life for yourself, due to lack of clarity or self-confidence.

^ So, you either settled for less or downplayed yourself even when you were presented with opportunities.

^ Although you didn’t likely have clear goals for the future, events in your life could have directed you on uncomfortable yet exciting journeys.

^ Or you might have incredible talents, skills and potential to create an amazing life, yet you struggle to accept that you can accomplish great things & to fully embrace these parts of you.

^ Fated events seem to keep aligning you towards one great thing after another, as if life has much bigger plans for you, especially if you believed in it with full faith.

^ It might feel unsettling at first, and even though you might not fully comprehend the path that you’re on, and how far you’ll reach, you might slowly realize just how incredible the journey is.

^ You might have the ability to attract opportunities, people and events that can elevate you to a whole new level of life without even being aware of it.

^ Although you might have doubts and feel like these twists in fates are too good to be true, you’ll likely be able to appreciate all the blessings along the way.

^ You’ll have to believe in yourself, and develop faith, accepting that there is indeed a higher power that is directing you on the right path each time.

^ You’ll likely be able to appreciate your gifts and your life purpose with time and maturity, reaching higher levels of self-confidence, trusting in the process, eventually attaining prosperity, fulfilment and happiness on your life path.


Ascendant Sextile North Node

✱ You might have a clear goal for your life as to what your purpose is, yet you might be surprised with how much further you’ll go.

✱ You are able to attract people, situations and opportunities that help you elevate your life, sometimes with your willpower and other times without even meaning to.

✱ You have incredible amounts of self-confidence, yet you might have doubts in yourself and your path in your lowest moments, but you’re also blessed with enough self-belief to keep going forward.

✱ You’ll encounter destined events that make you readjust your lifestyle, mindsets, etc. especially with opportunities that come suddenly.

✱ Even so, you’re often in the right place, at the right time to receive such unexpected opportunities.

✱ You’re also blessed with people who encourage you and guide you on the right path, especially in moments of doubts and indecision, you might even be quite spiritual with immense faith that there’s a higher power guiding you along your path.

✱ You might also be an inspiration to others who often seek your guidance in careers and endeavors that you’ve accomplished much in.

✱ Your self-confidence is also a key to your success, although you might struggle with it every now and then, you likely present yourself as a credible person that impresses the authority and people in power enough to trust you with important projects, opportunities, and positions.

✱ You are also a hard worker, with a vision of your own, you know how to make the right use of the opportunities you are given; hence you take things seriously and deliver your best.

✱ You’ll likely garner fame, prosperity, and respect following your life’s purpose, every time you embrace your uniqueness and believe in the twists of fate that life brings to you.



Ascendant Conjunct North Node

☌ You’re self-confident and brave, although these were qualities you had to embrace with a lot of faith.

☌ You might have been blessed with talents and abilities that reflect your true identity, and your life purpose is closely linked with you completely appreciating all that you’re as a person and all that you wish to be.

☌ There may be events that trigger your self-development in sometimes painful ways, yet you might find yourself feeling more in-tune with yourself and your purpose in life.

☌ You are also able to attract people, opportunities and situations that help you elevate on your life path with your sheer Will power.

☌ So, your self-esteem and the belief in your gifts help you create your own destiny, and all twists in fate seem to align you more to your goals and ambitions that you feel are your life’s purpose.

☌ You might also be blessed with soul-full connections, yet you might also experience karmic lessons with some that feel painful to release, making you focus more on yourself and self-love.

☌ There is also a naïveté to your personality that when mixed with your strong sense of self, can attract a lot of people who admire you for who you are.

☌ There may be thought patterns, internal dialogues and beliefs of self that you’ll have to readjust, since with time you might realize that you’re growing into your true self and you’ve to adapt to the changes in your character-development.

☌ Your purpose requires you to accept your truest potential and become self-reliant, so you will have to forego any codependent, toxic and binding relationships, patterns, and environments you may be involved in that keeps you repeating negative & painful cycles.

☌ You’ll likely be admired for your true self (so it’s important to present your best self since others can clearly see through your masks with this aspect), attain honor, prosperity and respect, all while embracing your gifts & reaching your highest potential along your life path. 


Ascendant Trine North Node

△ You have a strong sense of self that allows you to present your authentic self to others.

△ Your self-confidence and brave personality attract the attention of people, especially those in higher positions who recognize your potential.

△ So, you are able to attract people, situations and opportunities that help you elevate on your life path.

△ You have an inner calling that aligns you to your true purpose through your career endeavors.

△ You take your blessings seriously since you know that you’ve a higher purpose to fulfil.

△ You might encounter opportunities and people in the right place and at the right time, so you can call many of these events as destined.

△ You also know how to embrace your gifts and abilities, even with ups and downs in your self confidence levels, you’ll have enough opportunities to appreciate & accept your talents and use them for the better good.

△ You are courageous yet patient, so you are well-grounded to approach your goals and purpose with focus and persistence. Although this is an ability you have to learn with maturity and time.

△ It always seems like destiny has a much better plan for you and you have enough faith in yourself to believe that your life will turn out to be a success.

△ You’ll likely inspire many to believe in themselves and find their true purpose, attain respect, honor, happiness and prosperity, reach higher on your life path with much faith and determination.
