entry.title: Venus Enters Taurus, Conjunct North Node | Mar 16, 2023 🌿✨
entry.content:
Spring is in full bloom this 2023. Venus comes back home to Taurus on March 16th, 2023 bringing with her all the grace and elegance. Expect extra sensuality, extra love, extra confidence, extra stubbornness, and extra everything. Venus already Conjunct North Node in Taurus for about a week now has sparked the deep need to solidify our self-worth and double-down on our desires, making this one of the defining transits of March 2023. The exact conjunction takes place on 20th, and we will be able to feel it all throughout the next week. A feeling of smooth transition through letting go of frustrations and limitations, easing into comfort and reanalyzing your life’s direction. 


With Saturn in Pisces Sextile Venus, there is a sense of inner clarity about what to do and where to go next, bringing a deeper understanding about what you need and if what you want truly aligns with your purpose. There is power in being soft and mellow, pleasant relationships and peaceful environments this season. With North Node boosting your confidence and helping you redefine your self-worth and through increased productivity & determination. Saturn will help you stick to the newer and more refined intentions you are setting for yourself & your life. 


This transit connects the rush of positive energy from the recent Jupiter, Chiron & Venus conjunction in Aries with the stabilizing energy of Taurus. Consistency, patience and persistence go hand in hand with the Taurus’ mantra to create long lasting stability. Venus - North Node conjunction will prompt us to reevaluate our values & core beliefs. A renewed sense of self, with this internal reset you will want to see changes on the outside in terms of your immediate environment as well. 


Positive energies make themselves apparent, with a tinge of healthy materialism. There can be a sudden desire to revamp your wardrobe, make overs, renovations, redecorations, make big purchases, etc. Creative inspirations & spiritual insights can give you a gentle push towards new works/projects. Self-care, meditation, enjoying some time in nature, cooking/brewing, gardening, etc. some much needed R&R can help you relish in the serenity. 


If there has been a feeling of constant chaos lurking in the background, you are probably picking up on Pluto Square Venus & North Node. With Pluto preparing to enter Aquarius, for a brief period of time (which is a lot considering how slowly these two placements move), there is a quite tension building up. Taurus & Aquarius, both are stubborn and rigid in their mindsets & opinions. Although Venus would rather like to enjoy the pleasantness in her home sign, Pluto’s side-eye Square can prove to be a little too dramatic for the upcoming week. 



Lilith in Leo will join the staring Squaring contest along with Pluto, adding to the uncomfortable feeling. So, the North Node & Venus renewal process gets a transformative twist to it, a graceful shift in energy albeit a tense one. This transit can bring up the deep-rooted self-worth issues in how it affects the way we see ourselves and our material world. Issues regarding money, relationships, and self-belief can take center stage, with rather straight forward & brutal questions about what/who is limiting your freedom in these matters. 


This combination can provoke you to break free from people/places/things that are stifling your ambitions & self-esteem by restring your financial flow or denying your emotional & materialistic needs. There may be triggering events that highlight such themes with the focus on independence, and how truly free are you??? Is there someone/something that holds power over you using these themes??? The initial instinct may be to revolt, rebel and become confrontational when you encounter or discover such restricting elements, but the trick with square energies is to find a more peaceful resolutions without compromising your assertiveness. This can help you resolve any area of your life where you feel unsatisfied or being given less than what you deserve. 


So, with the grounding & patient influence of Saturn Sextile Venus-North Node, you can probe for resources that you naturally possess and have accumulated. This can especially help you in relieving any feelings of resentment & frustration out of hopelessness, giving you a calmer approach to navigate through any form of control, lack or even injustice. Diverting your attention towards productively and proactively changing your situations instead of letting your anger take over. North Node in the mix gives us the promise of manifestation when we set our intentions towards our higher calling. So, with the revelations of Pluto & Lilith, support of North Node & the guidance of Saturn, this Venus transit is bound to help us turn over a new leaf, escaping any form of stagnancy, be it in relationships or in financial situations. 


Fresh out of the chaotic yet refreshing period of transformation, Venus later Conjuncts Uranus on 30th-31st March, electrifying your self-esteem, helping you love and cherish the newness. Fun-filled romantic date-nights or invites for get-to-getters with friends can come in suddenly, so be sure to keep your schedule flexible. The next few weeks are sure to bring a mixed bag of excitement, chaos, serenity and blessings.

entry.title: Natal Pluto and North Node Aspects 🌊✨
entry.content:
Pluto Conjunct North Node

☌ You have an intense personality as a result of your unwavering determination to succeed in life.

☌ You might have experienced extreme situations, in the materialistic, physical or psychological areas of your early life. These immense adversities might have shaped your view on the world, and in the process, could have helped you find your life purpose.

☌ You might also have complicated relationships with authority figures, even in family dynamics. You don’t like being controlled by anyone, even in a hierarchy. However, you might have to be careful not to exert your dominance on others or plot your way to the top of the ladder with devious motives, since Pluto & North Node are still extremely strong karmic points in the chart, you can rack-up good karma & bad karma quite easily.

☌ You might have also experienced control-issues, power-struggles or even entrapments where you had to struggle your way out. Or you felt like you were being deceived, used & manipulated by someone/some people and had to fight for your independence, this could also be in regard to personal/physical/professional safety. As a result, you might have a new set of eyes that can see the world & people for what they are, and so you know how to avoid (may be even expose) manipulation tactics, unhealthy connections, deceitful situations. This could also be one of your biggest life’s lessons.

☌ Your life struggles always seem to take you on a personal re-invention journey, where you actively transform parts of yourself/life to come out on the other side with fresh perspectives. 

☌You possess a lot of resilience, and you can endure immense pressure through your life circumstances, that only seem to make you stronger and wiser. This inner fortitude might be admired by many, making you an inspiring figure in their life. 

☌ You might also be prone to rage, especially in unjust situations or betrayals, be it in your life or your loved ones’. But with time & maturity, you might learn how to choose your battles wisely.

☌ Your experiences also help you to understand situations from a completely different perspective, where you develop the skills to analyze pieces of the puzzle, patterns and find common denominators. This gives you the unique ability to detect & alter your own psychological programming, mindsets, and coping mechanism. Likewise, you’re also able to psycho-analyze others’ motives to some extent, or underlying patterns in the society at large and so you might be able to predict certain events, also to think way ahead of others.

☌ You have a strong intuition, whether you are consciously aware of it or not. You likely use your intuitive skills in your career, helping you create exceptionally detailed works, which have elements of change and evolution embedded in them. You likely also have many other psychic abilities, interest in the metaphysics or spirituality, science & medicine, psychology, etc. where you can unrestrictedly dive into deeper levels of knowledge and indulge in research.

☌ You’ll likely pursue your dreams & desires with great determination; use your intuitive & intellectual capabilities to advance in tough situations/competitions; inspire others to transform parts of themselves that need conscious & sub-conscious reinvention; work towards gaining wealth, position, power, respect and prosperity following your life purpose, listening to your soul’s guidance. 


Pluto Inconjunct North Node

^ This North Node aspect might be one of the most difficult aspects in terms of crucial yet intense life-lessons.

^ You might have an empathic inner-self, with a lot of compassion for others, yet you might not receive the same good-will from most others in your life.

^ The hard part might be the fact that, these people are usually your loved ones, close to your heart in some way.

^ Your early life might have been extremely trying, with heart-breaking situations playing out either in your own life or in your loved ones’. You might have grown up dealing with certain traumas, still recovering from them.

^ But you might have to take some time to heal from such harsh experiences, since you might have a tendency to walk right into another excruciating experience. These repeated karmic blows might come as harsh reality-checks/lessons.

^ You might have to deal with critical issues like lose (monetary/health), being controlled by someone/some people, power-struggles or even entrapment with complete loss of personal freedom, mental-health related problems, physical/emotional/psychological abuse, etc. 

^ You might have to overcome such extreme situations and go through intense healing.

This however might help you realize just how resilient and powerful you truly are, and how you always had everything within you that you needed to come out of such unimaginable situations.

^ You might eventually develop a strong inner fortitude with absolute clarity as to who you’re, what you’re capable of; what you want and what you certainly don’t want to ever experience again. You might gain confidence in yourself through reviewing every underlying patterns & information that once kept you trapped (either physically and/or psychologically). 

^ Your life purpose might actually be your entire life’s experience and how you face your fears and transform parts of yourself that needed love & clarity. You might realize just how powerful you’re as a person, and how important your wisdom & life’s story is to countless others who might be inspired by your resilience & strength in character. You have an intense drive, focus and determination to tackle any issue in life, no matter how big or small, how simple or unusual and you know how to turn pain into power, hence also helping you advance in your career & life path through the careful implementation of these valuable lessons.

^You’ll likely grow through intense pressure to learn “just how strong you’re when being strong was your only option”; overcome trying situations with immense clarity & confidence; inspiring others by being a resilient person of integrity; using your experiences to aid others in need & help them heal; gaining & regaining position, respect, power & wealth, following your life path listening to your inner guidance.



Pluto Square North Node

□ This aspect can suggest that your determination to attain your inner most desires might not always be in alignment with your true-life purpose.

□ You might have incredible intuitive abilities, receiving insights and guidance from higher realms. Yet, you might ignore them when you become blind-sided by your ego, vengefulness or sorrow.

□ You might have to go through intense situations that test your inner fortitude. But you don’t always see these lessons as such, you might have a tendency to feel scorned or betrayed instead.

□ This perspective on life might actually work against you in the beginning, since you may be giving into your anger & rage, rightfully so, considering the kind of things you’ve been through, but the lesson in the end is still the same, to rise above the situation and transform the parts of you that needs strengthening and healing through it all.

□ If you’re not careful, you might become vengeful, seeking justice and demanding everybody to believe how horrible the said situation/person was. But you might not always get the acknowledgment you were seeking from others.

□ You might feel disappointed, scorned again by others for not believing in your truth. So, the cycle repeats, in a way, you’ll keep making more and more people as your enemies, even if they don’t see you as one, or vice versa, others may try to pull you into their misery and demand that you support them. There might also be a dangerous implication (since it’s Pluto), that you might even have been the victim (or vice versa) of intense emotional/psychological/physical abuse, addictions, power-control/personal power loss, entrapments, etc. Such gruesome situations might have pushed you to the mindset of “it’s me against the world”, but you might soon realize that it’s not really the case, since you do have support, you will find acknowledgement from others, but first & foremost you might have to focus on self-love and healing, since that’s what you need the most.

□ You will eventually, realize the importance of self-acceptance with maturity and time, allowing yourself to understand the value of the lessons. This realization can set you free from continuing cycles & battles that you’ve already outgrown/won.

□ You’ll also understand that “your truth” is “the truth” but it doesn’t have to be acknowledged or supported by others to be true. Your experiences were real, your wounds & traumas were real, and even without others’ validation, you still won life’s toughest battles through your own will and determination. 

□ You will eventually go through significant personal transformations that allow you to rise above the hurt and pain you’ve experienced. Also, healing and evolving, realizing that you have the great ability to turn pain into power, helping you recover and rest from strife. This significant shift in perspective will help you elevate on your life path and find your soul’s purpose in healing & transformation.

□ You’ll likely fight for your rights and win against all odds; inspire many others who may be going through similar unjust situations; learn how to heal through trauma & wounds, hence helping others through their recovery journey; create incredible works inspired by your pain & healing; gaining & re-gaining your strength, power, wealth, position, recovery and respect following your life path and acknowledging your soul’s calling.


Pluto Opposite North Node (Conjunct South Node)

☍ You are passionate, brave and can move mountains with your sheer will power. But this might become a struggle against change if not careful.

☍ You might have had early life situations that could have given you a sense of power and control, which in-turn made you feel safe and secure. But, with time, you might resist letting go of this convenience, hence halting your personal development.

☍ You might become obsessive, controlling, (even) manipulative or deceitful to keep your hold on whatever gave you initial success, not realizing how you are avoiding necessary self-development and also creating negative karma in the process (with North Node and Pluto involved).

☍ In the process, you might start disregarding essential personal growth/shadow work, and instead you might become more self-serving and find people & things that validate your behavior.

☍ This might cause a lot of harm to your mental & spiritual health, public reputation and even your accomplishments. But life might start getting harder and harder for you to keep continuing this way, with unexpected and sudden collapse in your life, health, respect and position in society; forcing you to finally go through inner transformations that are crucial to your personal evolution.

☍ You might find yourself left with no choice but to heal and let go of control, in a way being humbled by life, a rude awakening. Your inner self needed an intervention and life made way to help you realize how you were resisting change. 

☍ You might have also realized how when things got harder in life, you couldn't reach higher levels, be it personally, relationship wise, or professionally. So, you might appreciate the big shake ups and break downs that came as blessings in disguise.

☍ You will learn how important change and personal transformation are, even in the midst of comfort and success, since only inner level-ups can manifest into elevation in your outer world. 

☍ You might also understand the value of using your intuitive, intellectual and spiritual manifesting abilities wisely, and not to manipulate/control your destiny, (since your higher callings may be bigger than you can ever think) but to learn how to go with the flow, trusting in the higher forces to guide you. 

☍ You'll likely go through intense personal development processes in life; learn how to relinquish control over what you think brings you success and instead believing in your life enough to face new frontiers; release toxic personality traits, behaviors and connections that you may have outgrown; use your gifts and talents to improve your life through transformation and hence inspire others to embrace the positive changes in life; gaining wealth, prosperity, power, position and respect following your life path, learning necessary lessons, and heeding your higher calling.



‌Pluto Trine North Node

△ This aspect indicates that you possess immense personal power and inner strength. You are a force to be reckoned with. 

△ Although you face one big obstacle after another, you have the necessary strength and courage to keep moving forward, undeterred. You face your fears head on, because you know there are great things waiting for you on the other side.

△ You are determined to accomplish greater goals. You understand how to transform yourself and your plans with each level-up. So, you keep elevating on personal and professional fronts.

△ You might have faced manipulation, control, deceit, power-struggles, etc. that could have left you feeling powerless, yet you never back down, especially when it concerns your personal power and freedom. So, you fight your way out, cut out toxic habits/relationships, and leave behind anything and anyone who isn't aligned with your path, much less putting you through dangerous experiences.

△ You will eventually realize just how powerful you are as an individual, and how there are higher forces supporting your growth and battles. This aspect also helps you to have self-control, in order to harness your inner reservoirs of strength and potential.

△ Your life struggles, no matter how unusual or disempowering they were, helped you realize just how strong you are, and how nobody or nothing could ever stop you from your goals and life purpose. So, in a way, you might realize that you were protected & guided even during the harshest times of your life.

△ You might also understand the value of having control over your own life, and to never let anyone/anything else take over your life, destiny and path. Gaining back your freedom and power might feel like the biggest victory to you. 

△ Moving forward, you might realize how you can consciously focus your inner drive and passions into your professional and personal life. You will see how all your previous experiences with power struggle and loss of control helped you tap into your potential, and hence you're able to integrate all the lessons into your success.

△ Your intuition also allows you to always stay connected to your higher self, receiving guidance and insights in regard to the next steps on your life path. You might even be psychic. You also have a spiritual blend to your personality that helps you stay grounded.

Breaking down barriers, accomplishing great things, moving forward with determination and never backing down are your biggest strengths in life, with heart-felt lessons and enduring back-stories to share. You don't take opportunities and successes lightly, so you are also humble and grateful for all the rewards and blessings in your life.

△ You'll likely fight your way out of illusions, deceptions, societal barriers, etc. inspiring many others on their journey; taking back control of your life and purpose through sheer inner strength; creating lasting success; gaining respect, wisdom, power, position and wealth following your life path, heeding invaluable guidance listening to your higher calling. 


Pluto Sextile North Node

✱ You are a powerhouse of determination and strength. You have the willpower and self-confidence to go the distance.

✱ You might have endured a lot of obstacles and challenges on your life path initially, which gave you the necessary stamina to stay focused on your goals.

✱ You are always evolving as a person, your mindsets, goals, and focus go through immense transformations with you. This also means you are constantly refining your skills & talents to reach higher than you ever did before.

✱ You can adapt to changing times; hence you are able to create lasting success. You are almost hungry for success, since, once you finish achieving one goal, you have already lined up more. So, you have a strong competitive spirit through which you gain admiration from your peers.

✱ You are intuitive and know when to take risks and when to plan more. You are often at the right place, at the right time. 

✱ You listen to your inner guidance intently, since you can tap into your spiritual side much easily, even if you don't realize it at first. You seem to be guided by higher forces, also protecting you from potential dangers.

✱ Your intuitive and intellectual capabilities also make you a powerful manifesto, where you can attract resources, opportunities and people that help you reach your highest potential. 

✱ You go through life lessons, challenges and setbacks with humility, but you also make sure that you will never go through such harsh situations again. This determination helps you shift and adjust your plans, mindsets and attitude in order to make necessary course corrections. So, you have a realistic mindset that allows you to recognize opportunities even in failures.

✱ Your ability to rise above trying situations, help you to turn pain into Power, and hence you also integrate your life experiences into your work, which allows you to create incredible works/services that gains further admiration from others. Your journey also serves as a lasting example to others, inspiring them even more.

✱ You'll likely accomplish your deepest desires and goals through sheer will power and hard work; create lasting success; inspiring others through your journey of transformation and healing; gaining wealth, respect, power, position and prosperity following your life path, heeding your higher calling with faith and optimism.

entry.title: Natal Saturn and Midheaven MC Aspects 🐝✨
entry.content:
Saturn Conjunct Midheaven MC

☌ This aspect is the most amazing & equally terrifying MC aspects of all.

☌ There’s always a sense of immense responsibility on your shoulders, and depending on your conviction, you might carry it so well that people see you with high regards (the other way around is also true).

☌ This aspect has a big emphasis on mentorship, you might have been raised into the career you pursue(d), or you had/have incredible guides & teachers who will help you realize your true potential, although it’s not an easy path at all, yet it comes with big rewards which could have been obvious to you from the start.

☌ Nonetheless this is a karmic aspect, depending on other placements/aspects in your chart, and most importantly on how you use your potential. You could build your very own empire or destroy everything you ever had.

☌ Hard work and smart work sound the same to you, since it’s still a lot of work regardless.

☌ You will be held responsible for each and every move you make, and that’s the burden & reward of Saturn. You will be humbled when you think you can get away with something, and you’ll be praise when you achieve something significant, you can’t hide from criticism or recognition even if you tried to.

☌ Your life might not have been an easy one since a very young age, rich or poor, you had to learn the importance of hard work & diligence. You learnt early that you’ll have to earn everything you desire, no matter how simple or grand.

☌ You could have had a controlling parent/household growing up or had a parent that you looked-up to very much, sometimes both. You’ll also find a lot of opportunities in life through authority figures, parents/grandparents/mentors etc. 

☌ Be careful however, to not be manipulated/controlled, or caught up in others’ ulterior motives, since manipulation, humiliation, betrayals, etc. are also possible with this aspect.

☌ You will have to learn how to take control of your own life, regardless of how indebted you’re to others who have helped you, or if you didn’t receive any help growing up to where’re now, you’ll have to accept that this life is your own, and you don’t have to be controlled by (or control) others’.

☌ Since your life path has an element of karma to it, you can’t take anything you do lightly, you might have to be extra careful. It’s easy to acquire good karma through this placement, and even easier to acquire bad karma. (Especially if Saturn is in 9H) You’ll have to uphold morals & righteousness in your career life, or you might be humbled (badly) by Saturn. 

☌ Your work and notoriety will take you further along your life, you’ll be well respected, wealthy, in high positions/status, and you might likely have worked for it from a very young age.

☌ You might even be called to help others along on their journey in your later years.

☌ A lot of people will look up to you and everything you have built & achieved.

☌ Remember, everything you do/say is always in front of everyone to see, no matter how secretive you’re, since MC is the highest point on the chart, and Saturn rules this point & 10H, righteousness & truth are paramount. So, people know both your struggles & rise, failures & successes.

☌ So if you’re ever tempered to use your power/position for grandiosity or entitlement, it will showcase your fear & insecurities to the entire world. The same way, if you rise to a status in life & wish to do good, everyone will be able to recognize your good intentions. 

☌ Either way, you’re hard on others, but the hardest on yourself. You seek perfection, at the very least, a worthy outcome in everything you do. But it is also equally important to take care of yourself, and let others take care of you as well. Maintaining a good work-life balance may be an important lesson with this aspect.


Saturn Trine Midheaven MC 

△ This Saturn x MC aspect is a beautifully inspiring one.

△ You’re diligent & professional, even as a kid, you had a sense of maturity that helped you be disciplined in everything you did/learnt.

△ You might have found your passion/purpose at a young age and worked hard to pursue that path(s).

△ You might have also been inspired by many great people in your life some of whom might have guided you along your way.

△ You might reach great & even greater heights never stopping on the way up. Your successes will always inspire many people.

△ You’re a serious individual professionally, but a warm-hearted person in your private & public life, which gains you a lot of respect and admiration from many.

△ You also know how to maintain a good work-life balance, although that insight might come later on in life.

△ You don’t shy away from hard work, and you continually learn new things to be able to do smart work, amplifying your abilities & efficiency.

△ You don’t mind climbing the mountain at your own pace, since you already know your destination.

△ You are patient and diligent, you know how to make good plans for your future & make consistent efforts towards achieving your goals.

△ Your persistence might also earn you many opportunities. You will likely have everything you need to achieve your dreams once you decide what to do, since in a way karma aligns everything for you.

△ Trine energies can bring-in procrastination, even to a Saturn x MC aspect. Here, entitlement might become an issue, for good or bad reasons. You might have to be careful not to be self-righteous, even with all the achievements or fame. 

△ You will likely achieve great success, wealth, respect and recognition.



Saturn Square Midheaven MC

□ This aspect indicates a harsh childhood, whether it was your upbringing, or poverty, or emotionally demanding/unavailable parents, family conflicts, etc. there might have been constant turmoil in your home where you grew up. 

□ You could have had a hard time even in school(s). You might have had many insecurities and were sensitive to every criticism. 

□ You might have felt a strong sense of instability, and insecurity. Especially since home/family/childhood experiences are the first foundation to one’s sense of self & self-confidence, it might have been extremely stressful, may be even traumatic to deal with such issues even in your adulthood.

□ Your early experiences no matter how subtle or deep might have made a strong impression of the world you were living in, and how it’s not really fair.

□ You might have (or been tempted to) use other means of relief, such as substances, or rebellion, alcohol, smoking, etc. to cope with that cruel reality.

□ You might have however felt guided out of such restrictive (may be even abusive) environments through career opportunities, or a breakthrough where you had to isolate yourself from such toxic situations.

□ So, you might feel a sense of (true) relief from your troubling past with your career endeavors. 

□ You might also be blessed with people in positions of power/influence who helped you navigate through career & life (with other aspects/placements to suggest the same).

□ However, in the competitive world, setbacks are normal, but your past experiences might make it harder for you to cope with, but you have all the tenacity to move forward regardless.

□ So, you will gain a lot more confidence in your work & yourself every-time you don’t let your past experiences define your current responses.

□ You have an exceptional personality, you know how to turn your pain into power, direct it in the right direction. So, you likely work hard, with all your focus, adapting to new situations & places (since in a way you longed for this freedom & peace). 

□ You must be careful not to give into your pain, since it might creep up on you when you’re making significant progress in your career. 

□ You might find people who feel like the family you never had, and/or you might also want to create a beautiful family of your own, which could be one of your biggest dreams in life (especially if Saturn is in 7H).

□ Your true happiness, things/people that bring you a sense of stability & peace of mind later on life (that you deeply craved for/needed in your childhood) could be reflected by where (i.e., the house) Saturn is placed in your chart.


Saturn Sextile Midheaven MC

✱ You might have been encouraged to pursue a successful life from a very young age. Even with struggles in childhood or with riches, you were either motivated by others’ or you had experiences that inspired you. As a result, you have a mature view on life.

✱ You have a strong sense of responsibility and determination. You seldom question yourself as to why you must work hard, since it’s a given to you that hard work is the key to success.

✱ You take a steady & methodical approach towards your career & life in general, since you will have to build from the ground up to reach the top successfully.

✱ You are careful & patient in everything you do, and rarely put everything on the line. 

✱ You likely had to push through many of your insecurities to get to every accomplishment, and it shows as your strength in character.

✱ In a way, your work is your happy place, you find a sense of purpose in everything you do, and you rarely take the opportunities for granted.

✱ Your clear sense of direction in life didn’t happen overnight, since you had your moment of self-doubts & confusion, especially true if you had a difficult childhood.

✱ You know how to stay humble throughout your many successes and failures.

✱ You take your work seriously, and rarely slip up on your duties no matter how simple.

✱ You might even be well-liked by others (especially your colleagues & higher authorities).

✱ You will likely attain a good position in society, with many accomplishments, respect and wealth.



Saturn Inconjunct/Quincunx Midheaven MC

^ This aspect makes you feel quite lonely, painfully so.

^ Early on in life, you might have realized that you were not supported either by others or life itself, everything/everyone seemed to go against your will, you felt like your efforts were never truly appreciated.

^ You could have also grown up in a household that had special double standards for you or expected a lot from you at a very young age without fulfilling your needs. This could have made you used to settling for less, or accept bread-crumbing situations, or even ingrained lack mentality in you.

^ This could have been worse if you have other placements/aspects in your chart that indicate self-doubts/esteem issues.

^ You might have felt like you’re a loner and not many like you, even if it was never true, and you were actually adored by others.

^ You’re extremely hardworking, respectful & responsible, yet you might have found it hard to direct your energy in a particular direction productively.

^ As you grow into young adulthood, you might have realized yet again that your reluctance to put yourself ahead, might be hindering your life & purpose as a whole. As a result, you might have struggled to be more out-spoken, social, etc. Although these attempts might have been in vain if you didn’t work on your core self-worth issues.

^ You might lack initiative in finding a particular career, or to deem yourself worthy of your dream career even with all the potential you naturally possess.

^ You’ll have to overcome your insecurities, lack mindset, and fears before you regret choosing a life that is purposeless & barren. Since this is one of the biggest lessons you’ll be forced to learn with this aspect.

^ You might have to work on your self-esteem issues, stand up for your rights, and to realize that you’re worth it, you have always been, and anyone/anything that said otherwise had no business to do so in the first place. 

^ You’ll start to find many opportunities along the way after you start accepting yourself, believing in yourself & your dreams. 

^ You might also encounter karmic rewards later on in life. This aspect is truly an amazing one, since Saturn blesses you equally for learning such harsh lessons.

^ You will have to believe that you can achieve your dreams and then some more, and you might just find the perfect opportunities that align you to your life purpose. Eventually, you might end up achieving great success with good recognition, social status, & wealth.


Saturn Opposite Midheaven MC (Conjunct IC)

☍ This aspect puts more emphasis on your past/upbringing/childhood. 

☍ You might have grown up in a restrictive household, with a lot of traditions, or religious/ethical practices, or even with a considerable amount of power in society that you had to act accordingly to maintain etc., or you grew up in an unstable household, with emotionally dependent/unavailable parents, family conflicts, financial difficulties, etc. Either way you grew up with a strong sense of insecurity and lack of adequate support.

☍ (With other placements/aspects in the chart) You might have had a support-system(s) no matter how subtle, be it a mentor, mother/father, sibling, etc. But most of the time, you felt alone or felt that you had to figure your own way out towards your goals.

☍ You might have had controlling/manipulative/obsessive parents or family members (may be even narcissistic, with other aspects/placements to suggest the same) which could have caused you a significant amount of trouble, restricting your view on the world and your future.

☍ So it becomes important that you resolve your inner child wounds & traumas before venturing into the career path that you wish to pursue. 

☍ Since Saturn here (especially if in 4H) will keep bringing your past to the surface for you to deal with. Sometimes this could be meddling family members, or just your fears & insecurities.

☍ You’ll have to create a strong foundation for yourself before you plan to build a prosperous future. Or everything you build might crumble.

☍ Here Saturn will help you move forward with a lot of determination & focus in life to attain your goals.

☍ But your lingering guilts or fears from the past might literally haunt you and hold you back from fully reaching your potential.

☍ Worst case scenario, you might become obsessed with being in the spotlight, people pleasing, & attention seeking. Without addressing the core issues of IC (almost jumping from the IC problems to MC), you might become shallow and cold hearted, calculating and scheming to reach the top as quickly as possible. Or even use your resources to stay in the public eye and maintain a façade/fake identity that will keep digging a bigger hole of identity crisis in the future. 

☍ Acceptance, emotional/financial support, and appreciation might be your true needs that for various reasons you couldn’t get in your childhood, but you’ll have to work through those wounds.

☍ You might even build a prosperous & peaceful family of your own as a result of your inner work since you find the necessary clarity.

☍ You might find many amazing opportunities for career success & achievements once you have worked through your insecurities (or if you’re dealing with meddling family members, it could be by cutting ties or by establishing healthy boundaries). 

☍ You might attain a good social standing, respect, and accomplishments throughout your life whenever you move forward with a positive mindset.

entry.title: March Transits 2023 ✨
entry.content:
March 2023 Transits

March • April • May • June • July
March 2, 2023

Jupiter, Venus and Chiron
Conjunction in Aries🍀✨


Jupiter and Venus make a glorious conjunction in Aries on March 1st, 2023. Later in the week, Venus makes an exact conjunction with Chiron as she moves forward through Aries.

Jupiter in Aries has been an exciting transit with increased productivity, passion and a sense of acceleration in life. Venus in Aries has sparked an interest to balance all that intensity while enjoying the spontaneity. These two aspecting each other in a beautiful conjunction is a sight to behold (we can see this glorious conjunction play out in the night sky for the most part of early March 😍)

March 2, 2023

Mercury moves
into Pisces✨

March 7, 2023

Full Moon
in Virgo✨

March 7, 2023

Saturn Transit
in Pisces🍃✨


Saturn enters the boundless realms of Pisces on March 7, 2023, and will stay there till May of 2025 then again in 2026 for a short period. For the next 2.5-3 years, Saturn will be completing his tour through the zodiac wheel before he moves into Aries for a new astrological cycle. This will be an enlightening time indeed, with many obvious surprises and sudden revelations both in our personal lives and globally.

March 16, 2023

Venus's Ingress
into Taurus✨

March 19 2023

Sun moves
into Aries✨


Start of a new Astrological year.

Happy Spring Equinox 2023.

March 21, 2023

New Moon
in Aries✨

March 21, 2023

Venus Conjunct North Node
+ Venus Squares Pluto & Lilith🌿✨


Spring is in full bloom this 2023. Venus comes back home to Taurus on March 16th, 2023 bringing with her all the grace and elegance. Expect extra sensuality, extra love, extra confidence, extra stubbornness, and extra everything. Venus already Conjunct North Node in Taurus for about a week now has sparked the deep need to solidify our self-worth and double-down on our desires, making this one of the defining transits of March 2023.

March 23, 2023

Pluto in
Aquarius 2023-43🦋✨


Pluto is back in Aquarius after 248 years.

We will bare witness to a marvelous shift in the astrological calendar on March 23, 2023, as Pluto moves into Aquarius for the first time since the late 1770s. Pluto will transit back and forth between Capricorn and Aquarius till 2024, until it goes direct in November 2024 in Aquarius where it will stay for the next 20 years.

March 25, 2023

Mars Transits
into Cancer
this Spring 🔥✨


With Mars now entering Cancer on March 25th, get ready to become a little mysterious & stingy with sharing your energy. Mood swings are a big take away of this transit, passive-aggression and even emotional outbursts may become rampant. It will be easy to lose your patience whenever you feel even a slight glitch in your control over your reality, emotional & financial stability. Your emotional balance will need a good dose of grounding.

March 26, 2023

Mercury Conjunct
Chiron✨

entry.title: Sirene Asteroid x North Node Aspects 🌟✨
entry.content:
When Sirene makes a tight Conjunction (or any aspect) of 0º to 4º orb with your North Node, you are bound to feel the profound effects of this mysterious Asteroid. Especially with Conjunction, Sextile or Trine, you can almost hear your Life’s Calling. You are captivated by your Life Path and even mesmerized by what is truly out there for you. Your soul-development can be tumultuous, especially with Square or Opposition, yet thoroughly enlightening. You will likely have to be careful with distractions that seem to pop up every time you have your sights set on your Higher Calling. It might even be possible to loose your path all together just to wake up one day and start your journey once again. 


You might also feel deeply confused as to what your True Purpose in life is, might initially chase after Goals/Life-Paths that aren’t your True Calling, but may have been tough & disappointing lessons instead. Circumstance, devious people or even your own Shadow can pull you away from your Higher Goals in Life; distracted, sometimes tempted, other times stranded; you might have to fight your way back to yourself and there by re-claim your destiny. There is a strong element of karma to your life path, a duty towards your soul’s higher desires and a vow to stay committed to your own future. There will be extreme tests of loyalty with regards to your Life’s Path and what you are willing to do in order not to get tempted out of your own journey towards Spiritual & Material Gratification. This is hence one of the most significant aspects in your chart. 


In Conjunction, Square or Opposition, you will need to be extra careful of those people and/or situations that can tempt you away from your goals & ambitions, here you will also have the opportunity to face your own Shadow Self and hence overcome your vulnerabilities in the process. Since this aspect is highly karmic in nature, on a spiritual level you might even encounter those who wish to switch their destiny with yours, in order to steal your good karma, blessings & rightful abundance. 


Be compassionate towards yourself whenever you realize that you might have drifted far away from your own destined path. Instead, use that experience to awaken not just to your True Calling but also to your own Inner Potential. Utilize your Innate Talents & Gifts to overcome the fears & challenges in front of you. Intuitively walk the Maze of confusion & distraction, redirect towards your Calling, untangle yourself from the webs of Karmic Temptations that taught you the lesson of being aware of the dangers on your journey and the importance of staying committed to your True Ambitions. 


If you have Conjunction, Sextile or Trine, you will naturally have a stronger Inner  alling towards your Higher Goals. You can pick up on the intuitive signs & guidance towards your Life Path innately. You can even attract the right opportunities to reach those goals. Honor your talents & gifts, be grounded & humble in the way you use them so as not to fall prey to the destruction of your own ego. You can seamlessly go with the flow of your Life towards your Destiny, attaining with it your Sacred Desires & Dreams. 


In general, North Node x Sirene Combination may seem ordinary from the perspective of an Asteroid, yet it can affect the journey towards your Life Path in the most subtle ways (both good & bad) possible, as Sirene embodies the Karmic element of the perils, challenges & temptations that show up when we are on our most significant life journeys (along with lessons) and towards our most cherished goals. Hence, it can also reveal the value of the goals that we are chasing, the journey we are taking and the abundance that is waiting for us as a result. 


This aspect in your chart can give you the biggest advantage in terms of your Innate Gifts & being awakened to your True Potential, while also exposing your weakness in the form of Distractions & Temptations. Your willpower, determination, wit, grace, adaptability, focus, clear-mindedness & rationality will be tested and rewarded karmically. Abundance, Spiritual Gratification, fulfillment of Sacred Desires, and attainment of Dreams & Aspirations.

entry.title: Natal Chiron in Sagittarius (9th House) 🧸✨
entry.content:
Natal Chiron in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)
  • Gemini (3rd House)
  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)
  • Libra (7th House)
  • Scorpio (8th House)
  • Sagittarius (9th House)
  • Capricorn (10th House)
  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

Natal Chiron in Sagittarius (9th House)

You are an optimist, yet you hold realistic expectations of life. You see things and people for what they are. You might have experienced crises in your higher education or during your late teens/early adulthood that changed your perspective on life. You might even have troubles with mentors or people who were supposed to be your guides. You have immense faith in yourself, and you believe in miracles, yet your faith often gets tested to the limits and beyond. You feel that your opinions are not always well-received, but you don’t change your mind just because others don’t see things as clearly as you see. 


You might even have to be careful not to force your ideologies or judge others for theirs since that could be the expression of your shadow self. You think and focus on the bigger picture, you rarely waver in your determination once you set your sights on goals. You don’t like small, minded people who dwell in ignorance, you might even become confrontational when you are pushed too far. You are a great guide and a mentor; you have a lot of wisdom to offer to the world. You might wish to teach/guide others on their journey somewhere down the line since you feel like it's part of your calling. 


You love to explore new places, cultures and interests despite your initial reluctance to come out of your comfort zone. You can find a sense of serenity in learning and travel. You might be inclined to spiritual practices even if you are not particularly religious. You are a natural born leader that others look-up too, although you might have a hard time seeing yourself that way. You encounter numerous tests of faith as part of your spiritual journey in life, since your inner strength and belief in destiny get solidified with each lesson. You might even consider yourself to be unlucky initially, just to realize how protected and divinely guided your path has always been. So, in the process you learn to trust in higher forces or divinity. 



Your ability to adjust and realign your focus will help you to manifest your greatest dreams and desires with this placement. You might however have to face situations that leave you disorientated in life, making you realize how off-course you are on your life path or why you must believe in your inner guidance more. You can find success in business or careers that involve traveling or trading in foreign lands, you might even have luck in collaborations over-seas. You can experience a lot of success due to your optimism and unhindered spirit. Your healing will involve your childhood experiences where you had to trust in your own guidance since you might not have had reliable people or support when you needed them the most. 


Your positive mindset will help you get through the toughest times of your life. You might even start to see hidden blessings in such experiences. You value freedom and self-reliance above all else, so you always strive to break out of toxic bondages. You might even have troubles with your family with regards to belief systems and others restrictive mindsets. Since, you evolve your belief system by learning more and seeing beyond the ordinary, upgrading your mindset each time. So, you are open-minded and morally-sound. You have a strap intellect and a high mind, so you are invested in your educational pursuits even if you don’t take formal courses. You love to learn new and interesting subjects to keep sharpening your skills. 


You are physically and spiritually grounded, so you often encounter conflicts that try to take you out of that balance, but your insights and quick responses will help you dodge/diffuse such situations easily. You can find peace, prosperity and abundance with extraordinary faith in yourself and your higher purpose. This placement will help you heal any negative/restrictive mindsets, belief systems or thought patterns that may be holding you back from your true calling in life, so you can pursue your ambitions following your inner guidance, unrestricted. Your healing journey will inspire others to believe in themselves and heed their higher calling.

entry.title: Full Moon in Sagittarius 20° 🌕♐️ June 11, 2025
entry.content:
A Rejuvenating-Light Full Moon. Healing, Cathartic & Wondrous. Think back to the Last Sagittarius New Moon (around Dec 1, 2024), remember what Goals have you achieved or are in the process of finishing now. 🌿 Old ideas can take on New Forms now, so Inspiration & Intuitive Downloads can fill you with Enthusiasm. 


With A Grand Trine to Chiron (♈️) & Mars (♋️), this 🌕 will reignite your Passions and remove any Creative &/or Energetic Block within. Renewed Focus & Ambitious Drive. Wonderful time to work on Passion Projects & New Business Plans. Utilize this rather Enlightening surge of Energy by directing it towards worthy Goals & Ambitions, especially those that add to your Self-Confidence, Purpose & Independent Spirit. 


Productivity can naturally increase, elevating your desire for Success. Allow the Ambers of Ambition in your Heart to both Invigorate & Transform the Vision for your Life. You can lay foundations for Great Achievements now. Caution with impulsivity and take well-calculated risks. 🪽


Being a little (just a little 🥰) selfish with your goals now will feel rewarding & liberating. Explore your Potential, Passions & Aspirations. ♐️🌕 can hence help us break free from Self-Imposed Limits, Restrictions & Lack of Self Belief.

entry.title: Super Full Moon in Taurus 13° 🌕♉️ Nov 5, 2025
entry.content:
A Re-stabilizing + Immensely restorative + Balanced energy. ✨


This Super Full Moon will have many underlying energies working in harmony with each other to clear out the way for a New Cycle to begin. Subtle & Gentle, yet intensely Powerful. You are likely to feel this Full Moon’s effects on your body, health & Energy levels. Fatigue, Head Aches or Short-Impulses of Energy Boosts are to be expected. A bit of indulgence in self-care, rest & a listless day can be deeply nourishing.


With Venus (♎️), Jupiter (♋️) & Pluto (♒️) in a tense T-Square, you will have to take steps slowly yet decisively. You may feel the urge to break free from relationships that no longer serve you, yet dramatically breaking away from such bonds can cause unnecessary stress & suffering on both sides, as these may be very sensitive & long term relationships. However, this is where your Emotional Intelligence & Tact will come to use, as you will be able to find the right ways to break away from Karmic Connections without having to worry about hurting anyone’s feelings, as the severing of ties is primarily Karmic and Energetic. 


Hence, you may receive the necessary clarity to end certain Relationships or simply sever certain Karmic Patterns & Cycles. The Intuitive pull here may be more about gaining back your own Sovereignty rather than anyone or any relationship. So, you will make decisions & changes within yourself as to how you can take control & your Power back in Emotional & Committed Relationships, your Life as a whole. This will be vital to restore the Power & Karmic balance within yourself Life.


With a rare Kite Formation of Saturn, Neptune, Pluto, Mars, Mercury & Jupiter, you are also able to delve deeper into your own Passions & Aspirations to proactively bring them into alignment with your Life Purpose. As you let go of certain Karmic & Emotional burdens, you will have more room to commit yourself to New & equally inspiring Ambitions & connections. You are hence consciously aligning your Heart & Intentions with your Dreams & Purpose. 


With Sun in Scorpio & Moon in Taurus, this Super Moon creates tides of change to both empower & cleanse you Karmically & Energetically. Close out long-term projects & cycles, while preparing to begin anew. This Super Moon will sharpen your Focus & Passions, making you more Confident and ready to conquer your fears & Goals alike. A 6 months plan (from this Taurus Full Moon to the next Taurus New Moon) will be a good time frame to set Passion-filled Goals. Create a strong, well-planned & established foundation for yourself and launch towards your Dreams & Ambitions. Prosperity & Fortune. Good times & Great Success await. 🫐💫✨

Natal Saturn in Signs & Houses
  • Aries (1st House)
  • Taurus (2nd House)

  • Cancer (4th House)
  • Leo (5th House)
  • Virgo (6th House)

  • Aquarius (11th House)
  • Pisces (12th House)

 

Natal Saturn in Sagittarius (9th House) Generation 🌟✨

Saturn in the house/sign of philosophy, travel and higher knowledge can be an incredible placement. You are a student of life, a scholar of philosophy and an avid thinker. You respect knowledge and wisdom. You rarely take things for granted especially when they are opportunities to learn new things and explore the world. You might confine yourself to a small group of trusted people even though you have a good number of friends and acquaintances. Religion and spirituality are an interesting part of your life, since depending on your early experiences, you might reject such doctrines or fully embrace them, in both cases, you are true to yourself which is what matters the most to you. You are a righteous person in every sense of the way. You have a strong moral compass; your ethics are quite clear to you. So, you also likely follow the rules earnestly. 


If you don’t like being chained to any rigid instruction or system of beliefs, you might follow strict regulations that you laid for yourself with righteousness and morals (this can even mean that you like to mix different perspectives/religions/spiritual principles to form your own belief system). Again, there is always a need to follow your heart in every aspect of your life. This placement can help you to stay true to your desires. There is a level of genuine interest and intention that become a must with Saturn here, since if you are not being true to who you are, it's the same as going against your higher self. So, with aspects or placements suggesting otherwise, you might be prone to believing in others’ without examining their motives & facts, you might follow the wrong groups/doctrines or reject things that you may need on your journey, thereby going against your soul purpose in the long run. This is one of the key reasons as to why this Saturn placement is so important and powerful. 


Hence, you will be tested throughout your life, both to correct you when you are straying away from your true purpose and to check your resolve by strengthening your faith. Whether you believe in religion, God, & spirituality or not, you will face situations that will help you reach a higher understanding of yourself and your life purpose in miraculous ways. Education is always a significant life choice for you, whether you had difficulties pursuing your interests or finishing your school/college, you likely encountered events and lessons that may have changed your perspective on life. You might have even felt that you were more mature than your peers in some ways. Your father or grandparents may have played an important role in your life, in either good or bad ways. You might have also had excellent teachers/mentors who believed in your potential (likewise, you might have had those who caused problems unnecessarily). 



Strict yet wise guides always seem to show up in your life at the right place and the right time, either as teachers, friends, partners, family, etc. It is advised to attain mastery in at least one of your favorite topics, be it formally or informally, since this placement can provide enlightening rewards as a result. You might experience delays in travel, especially for long distances. You might even be afraid of leaving your town or neighborhood but might eventually start to like the idea of exploring new places, or you might be eager to visit foreign lands and experience their culture up close, either way, you will have to face certain fears and disappointments that will reward you with beautiful new experiences and memories. 


You might have a rigid way of thinking, this can extend to philosophy, art, politics and religion. If you are too conservative and close minded, you might invite experiences where you may have to put aside your ego and accept new perspectives. So, if you are already an open-minded person, you will enjoy a more rewarding social life with lots of doors to new opportunities opening as a result. You will however have to be careful not to be too realistic and closed off to imaginative pursuits since you can actually benefit from your creativity. You might enjoy a career that helps you to travel often, take periodic breaks, explore your interests, keep your mind occupied with exciting new topics, help others, and make new connections along the way. Charitable, activism, social service, and other such pursuits can bring you a sense of personal satisfaction. Reckless behavior and self-serving attitude can land you in trouble easily.


You might have a profound interest in Spirituality even if you are not particularly religious, or you might reject both and choose to live a realistic & practical life, in both cases, you are someone who loves to question everything. You might even have psychic and spiritual gifts of deep insights. You might find it hard to take criticisms from others. But you don’t hold back while criticizing others. You have a unique perspective on life, and you are not afraid to express your opinions even if others are not always welcoming to such bold and brazen ideas. As a result, you might end up making a lot of enemies and disappointing others. However, it is also important that you don’t become self-righteous while trying to prove your points, since it can backfire easily with this placement. You seek answers for deeper questions, and you might often be riddled about the meaning of life and what your true destiny could be, etc. Certain events in your life may have left you feeling hopeless, testing your faith to its limits, but you also strengthened your character through it all. Your belief in yourself always seems to be your ultimate guiding light. 


Whether you realize it or not, your other worldly wisdom, charm and magnetism are felt by so many others. You might be quite popular even when you don’t wish to be. You know when to follow certain rules, when to bend them to your will and when to break them. This brave and unapologetic personality of yours can attract the attention of many who will admire you. This can also mean that you inspire people by just being yourself. You might even have a higher calling to guide others on their journey through your expertise and deep wisdom. You might even be called to explore your inner spirituality and attain mastery of it, there by imparting that knowledge to others. Your intentions and actions can influence those who admire you, your words hence carry a great impact. Immense fame and popularity are likely with this placement. It is however important to “walk your talk” with this placement. Others will always hold you accountable for your own philosophies, reminding you to follow what you preach. Being righteous in every aspect of your life, especially when expressing yourself & your opinions, upholding justice and respecting the truth will become your karmic duties with this Saturn placement, rewarding you with deep spiritual insights, power and admiration.

entry.title: Neptune’s Conjunction with North Node in Enchanting Pisces 28° 💫✨ Feb 7, 2025
entry.content:
Divinely Inspired  •  Initiation  •  Destiny 🐋


A rare once in a lifetime Conjunction of Neptune & North Node in Pisces brings awe-inspiring changes to our inner-world reflecting it into the outer world. Neptune’s last few months in its own Rulership sign of Pisces will end with this glorious Conjunction to the North Node at an abundant 28°. As the Conjunction takes centerstage we will notice that there is more to this Transit than just the renewal of hope, it also inspires optimism with a whole new world-view.


Easy to get lost in daydreaming and even profound dream/astral times. Pay attention to your moods, visions & flickers of inspirations, they maybe more than just imaginations. Divine Wisdom and Energetic Downloads entwined with your creativity & intuition. Psychic boost, intuitive downloads & energetic shifts taken to whole new heights. 


Dare to wander beyond what you think limits you and your life experience. Love, career, money, family, health, etc. anything that may have been out of your reach can now be accessed through your will, wish & faith. Being realistic may be one thing, but being true to yourself will be the key to manifesting and actualizing your wishes with this transit. 


Trust your conscious urges & subconscious desires, they are likely taking you towards a new timeline. Healing emotionally & psychologically (hence also physically) can come naturally when in alignment with this Conjunction. We have been experiencing this Conjunction getting more prominent since the last few months as North Node Transited closer into Pisces, and will continue to feel this Conjunction until May (2025). 


Connect to your inner self, seek guidance from your higher self, and be spiritually aware of all the life decisions that you may be faced with in the coming months, as they are likely to be new, seemingly risky as you are entering uncharted territories but also enticing, drawing you closer to your dreams & wishes. Clearing out old karma and karmic debts, this is an excellent moment in your life, to celebrate the completion of old cycles and welcome new ones. 


With hope restored and faith strengthened through this transit, break free from limiting beliefs & patterns. Recognize any sign of self-sabotage & addiction that may be fueling the fire of resentment, victim hood, fear, lack or hurt. As North Node eagerly embraces Neptune, reality can bend and imaginations can take life. There is a strange fluidity to life that is almost palpable under these Astrological skies. 


As North Node moves further into Pisces and meets Saturn (exact Conjunction in April, 2025), that is when we will start to see things get more interesting and real.


Escape limitations & temptations to run around in circles. As North Node invites you to jump into a new timeline where you are truly free to be yourself, to dream and aspire. The insatiable curiosity of North Node and the foundational knowledge of Saturn will help this wonderful Neptune x North Node Conjunction. So, dream big, bigger than life. Be willing to follow your intuitive guidance and make your dreams a reality with Saturn’s practical wisdom & North Node’s divine inspiration. 


Align yourself to your true-calling, and witness the marvel of an abundant universe answering your wishes, prayers & faith. Breaking away from karmic restraints and choosing your Destiny. 💫
